Drawing at once ranking position, floors under a race for position, or a horizon the drawers do not know.
That actual races are played in turn by drawers ranking position alone.
That drawing everything is wrong.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which of them the theorems of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

how.en: Fixes levels_through's drawer u that leaves nothing to the first drawer (u := 0), its leaving nothing at every step before the horizon discharged by position_perfect_draws and every rule leaving at most what it is given by the profile's revision (perfect.1); levels_through sits under no dynamic of the atlas, in the record drawers-in-turn of the dynamic of that name.

name.en: Several optimizers

mechanism.en: One step, World. At a mutual best response (that field's frame: each optimizer acting within its capacity, the levels after an optimum of its own rising order among the outcomes open to it alone, the others exchanging as they do; each optimizer's family and beyond set apart; the step balancing into the levels after), where something stands beyond an optimizer's family, it takes its whole capacity there and gives nothing: restraint is no mutual best response. A condition beyond every one's family stands at what the formations outside them leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing, as under one optimizer of that capacity. Which formations optimize, by which order and with which capacity, is supplied, and the core asserts a mutual best response of no actual group; its existence is not shown in general.

text.en: No axiom. One step; the optimizers, each with its own family and beyond listed apart without repetition, its family holding a condition, its order rising with its family, and its capacity; the formations taking part listed without repetition; a mutual best response, the step balancing into the levels after; the condition beyond every optimizer's family; for breaks, a dependence met at the step.
text.zh: 不加公理。一步；优化者各有其族与之外，分开列出且无重复，族含一个条件，其序随族升高，并有其容量；参与的构成列出无重复；相互最优回应，该步平衡成步后水平；条件在每个优化者的族之外；打断需该步被满足的依存。

text.en: Which formations optimize, by which order and with which capacity, is supplied; the core asserts a mutual best response of no actual group of optimizers.
text.zh: 哪些构成优化、按何序、有何容量，是给定的；核心不对任何实际的优化者群体断言相互最优回应。

condition.en: At a mutual best response, a condition beyond every optimizer's family is lowered below where the formations outside every optimizer leave it exactly where the optimizers have some capacity there and something is left; on a web, a dependence on it met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what those formations leave less the optimizers' joint capacity.

from.en: the optimizers have no capacity at the condition c beyond every family, or nothing is left there: c stands where the formations outside every optimizer leave it, and a dependence on it met at the step is kept where its need is at most that less the joint capacity

to.en: the optimizers have some capacity at c and something is left there: c is lowered below where the formations outside leave it, and a dependence met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what they leave less the optimizers' joint capacity

open.en: That a mutual best response exists in general: the witness has one; where the outcomes open to each depend on the others, a step may have none.

A condition within some optimizer's family, where the condition couples into its order and the classical commons with a share borne lies; a course of steps and how learners come near a mutual best response.
That the drain is a harm, or that coupling or a lower capacity is better: no evaluation enters.
That a mutual best response exists in general (no existence is shown, and none is shown to fail), or which of several self-consistent outcomes learners come to.
What each takes outside a mutual best response.

beyond.en: At a mutual best response a condition beyond every one's family stands at what the formations outside them leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing; in the witness each take is within the slack of a need while the joint draw leaves it below the need.

how.en: Fixes Above.full's part to the optimizer h alone, its floor to nothing and its flow to L itself, the optimum among the outcomes open to h alone given by the mutual best response; Above.full sits under no dynamic of the atlas, in the record room-read-off-the-exchange of what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in.

name.en: Re-optimizing at every step

mechanism.en: A course of steps, World: each step an optimum of the part's rising order among the outcomes open to it (that field's frame, taken step by step, not over courses), the rest exchanging as it does, or a balanced course of mutual best responses. Where the rest renews a condition beyond by exactly r a step at or above a positive need and by at most r below, and the withdrawal k (the rest's taking with the part's capacity) is the same at every step, a formation depending on it at that need at every step, met at the start, loses the dependence for good exactly where r < k, and never where k ≤ r; several optimizers whose withdrawal with the rest's exceeds r at every step lose it however small each capacity. Gated, with nothing given below the need, a draw above the renewal draws at most the start with r for each of its units, however long; ungated, with at least a and at most r given every step however low the level, at least a a step, without bound for a positive a. Where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing. The core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts. A course of re-optimizing steps (each an optimum of the part's rising order among the outcomes open to it, the rest exchanging as it does) or a balanced course of mutual best responses; the condition beyond; the rest giving it exactly r at or above a positive need, at most r below; its take with the capacity k a step; a dependence at that need met at the start.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数量；重新优化的过程（每步是部分升高之序在可达结果中的最优，其余者照常交换），或相互最优回应的平衡过程；条件在之外；其余者在正的需要处或其上恰给予 r、其下至多 r；其所取连同容量每步为 k；该需要处起始时被满足的依存。

text.en: For the draw, the renewal below the need: nothing there (gated) or at least a at every step (ungated). Which formations optimize, by which order and capacity, and the renewal, are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.
text.zh: 对汲取而言，需要之下的更新：为零（有闸门）或每步至少 a（无闸门）。哪些构成优化、按何序与容量，以及更新，都是给定的；核心不对任何实际优化者的过程作断言。

to.en: from a start at the need, with the withdrawal within the renewal (k ≤ r), the condition stands at or above the need at every step

edge.en: From a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step exactly where the withdrawal is within the renewal, k ≤ r.

to.en: the draw above the renewal before T, and from T on a re-reading that keeps the need wherever it is met: the need is met at every step exactly where it is met at T

edge.en: With the draw above the renewal until a step T, a re-reading from T on that keeps the need where it is met keeps it at every step exactly where it is met at T; stated on the level law alone.

to.en: witness (Renewing, two takers of capacity one): at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and, over a course longer than twice the start, holds more in the store than the course of mutual best responses

edge.en: Two takers of capacity one lose a source renewed by r < 2 at mutual best responses at every step; at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and after a long course holds more in the store, by the optimizer's own order.

condition.en: A dependence at the need, met at the start, is lost exactly where r < k; from a start at the need, the condition stands at or above it at every step exactly where k ≤ r.

from.en: k ≤ r: from a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step

to.en: r < k: a dependence at the need throughout, met at the start, is lost for good

condition.en: Given exactly r at or above a positive need, at most r everywhere, and k > r drawn before T, the need is met at T exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need.

from.en: the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need, m + T (k − r) ≤ x 0: the need is met at T

to.en: it starts less above it: the need is not met at T

open.en: A renewal varying with the level at or above the need (logistic growth, with an interior sustained yield): the renewal here is exactly r there.

An optimizer ranking courses rather than steps (Scott's sole owner, in the fisheries literature), an equilibrium of the course rather than mutual best responses step by step, and how optimizers come to them.
A witness course of the ungated draw: its laws are general, the witness is gated.
That the loss is a harm, or that a capacity within the renewal or a coupling is better: no evaluation enters; less in the store is by the optimizer's own order.

beyond.en: Over a balanced course of mutual best responses, where the formations outside every optimizer give a condition beyond every optimizer's family at most r a step and what they take with the optimizers' joint capacity there exceeds r at every step, a dependence on it at a positive need throughout, met at the start, is lost for good, however small each capacity.

how.en: Fixes optimum_beyond's outcome and levels before to the course's levels at t + 1 and t, its optimum among the outcomes open to the part given at each step by Reoptimizes; the conclusion is optimum_beyond's with the part's two withdrawals summed (a − b − c = a − (b + c)); optimum_beyond is listed under what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in.

Fixes mutual_beyond's levels before and after to the course's levels at t and t + 1, at every step, its step balancing from global balance; the conclusion is mutual_beyond's with the withdrawals summed (a − b − c = a − (b + c)); mutual_beyond is listed under several-optimizers-drain-by-their-joint-capacity.

name.en: Weighting later draws less

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, natural weights, the breaks on the World. Over the courses open from s, where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, with a capacity covering s + R s and R 0, over at least two steps, every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw (that field's frame, over the open courses) stands at nothing at every step to the n-th, ending its own stock at the first step and breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start; at ≤ the course ending the base at the first step is an optimum. The home reads it as the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal, a frame of that field. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts, natural weights. Courses open from s; a renewal law R; n + 1 steps, 0 < n; a reference course open from s, leaving nothing at the last step, whose level gains at each step at least what any level does; capacities covering the first step's draw down and, for leaving, a level held with its renewal; R 0 = 0 for leaving.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步、自然数量与自然数权重。自 s 开放的过程；更新之律 R；n + 1 步且 0 < n；自 s 开放、最后不留、每步水平增益不少于任何水平的参照进程；容量足以在第一步降下，对不终结之律还须承担所保持的水平加其更新；不终结之律另需 R 0 = 0。

text.en: For the web laws, a dependence met at the start, with a positive need or a need above every level of greatest weighted gain. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.
text.zh: 对网之律：起始时被满足的依存，所需为正或高于每个最大加权增益水平。哪个构成优化、按何序、权重、容量与视野，以及更新之律，都是给定的；核心不对任何实际优化者的过程作断言。

to.en: where nothing is renewed at nothing and some level y within the start with its renewal renews faster than the weighting falls at each step, w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y), over at least two steps, with a capacity drawing down to y and covering y with its renewal: every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw stands above nothing after the first step

edge.en: Where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach renews faster than the weighting falls (w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step), with reach and y + R y ≤ k, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown.

to.en: witness (the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two): where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one, breaking the dweller

edge.en: Under the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two: where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one and breaks the dweller.

condition.en: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends the stock at the first step; where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

from.en: w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z: every optimum ends the stock at the first step

to.en: R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step: every optimum leaves something at the first step

open.en: The optimum where no course whose level gains the most at each step is open; whether an optimum ends the base after the first step where some level renews faster at the first steps.
An order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses; SG5's laws re-derived as the case of every weight one.
That a weighting ought to be flatter or a base kept: no evaluation enters; the laws say which optima a weighting leaves.
The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.

beyond.en: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, with a capacity covering s + R s and R 0 and a horizon of at least two steps, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start.

how.en: Fixes exhausting_frontier's law of what stands G to z + R z at every step (G := fun _ z => z + R z), its open courses becoming OpenCourse R k s; Becoming.Optimum.Next.exhausting_frontier is listed under others-drawing-first-end-the-base.

Fixes frontier_exhausts's law of what stands G to z + R z at every step (G := fun _ z => z + R z), its open courses becoming OpenCourse R k s; Becoming.Optimum.Next.frontier_exhausts is listed under others-drawing-first-end-the-base.

Fixes frontier_below's law of what stands G to z + R z at every step (G := fun _ z => z + R z), its open courses becoming OpenCourse R k s, the course h open under it; Becoming.Optimum.Next.frontier_below is listed under others-drawing-first-end-the-base.

Fixes frontier_leaves's law of what stands G to z + R z at every step (G := fun _ z => z + R z), its open courses becoming OpenCourse R k s, what stands at y being at least y discharged in place; Becoming.Optimum.Next.frontier_leaves is listed under others-drawing-first-end-the-base.

name.en: Courses over a horizon

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, at most r, the breaks on the World. What a course draws, leaves and forgoes adds to the start with r a step. Over the courses open from s, with reach and y + r ≤ k, every optimum of every order rising with the draw (that field's frame, over the open courses, no discount) holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step, and one every such level meets is kept and broken at the end. With what is left valued one for one with what is drawn, every optimum stands at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon, and the optima of that order are exactly the open courses doing so: keeping and draining at the end are both optima. At worth v > 1, where no open course leaves more than y + r, r ≤ k and at least two steps, every optimum holds a level of greatest renewal to the horizon and regrows only at the last step. At every such worth a dependence above every such level is broken at the first step. The core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts. Courses open from a start s: each step leaving at most the level with what is given, drawing at most k; what is given a law R of the level, at most r at every level and r at some y with y ≤ s + R s; a horizon of n + 1 steps with 0 < n; s + R s ≤ y + k and y + r ≤ k; an order rising with what is drawn across the horizon.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数量。自起点 s 开放的过程：每步所留不超过水平加所给、汲取至多 k；所给是水平之律 R，在每个水平至多 r，在某个 y ≤ s + R s 处为 r；n + 1 步的视野且 0 < n；s + R s ≤ y + k 且 y + r ≤ k；随视野内所汲取升高之序。

text.en: For the web laws, a dependence at a need m met at the start, and every level where R gives r below m (broken) or meeting a positive m (kept). Which formation optimizes, by which order, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law, are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.
text.zh: 对网之律：需要 m 处起始时被满足的依存，R 给 r 的每个水平都低于 m（打破），或都满足正的 m（保持）。哪个构成优化、按何序、容量与视野，以及更新之律，都是给定的；核心不对任何实际优化者的过程作断言。

text.en: No axiom. A renewal law R of the level, at most r at every level and r at some y with y ≤ s + R s; a capacity k with s + R s ≤ y + k and r ≤ k, any horizon (the course draining at the end also y + r ≤ k and at least two steps; the broken law at least two steps); what is left valued one for one with what is drawn; natural amounts, discrete steps.
text.zh: 不加公理。水平的更新之律 R，各水平至多 r，在某个 y ≤ s + R s 处为 r；容量 k 满足 s + R s ≤ y + k 与 r ≤ k，任何视野（终了抽干的进程另需 y + r ≤ k 且视野至少两步；打破之律视野至少两步）；所留与所抽取一比一计值；自然数量，离散步。

text.en: No axiom. A renewal law R of the level, at most r at every level and r at some y with y ≤ s + R s; a capacity k with s + R s ≤ y + k and r ≤ k; a horizon of at least two steps; no open course leaving more than y + r after it; a worth v of at least one (above one for the optima's characterization); for the coupling law, at most q given at or above the need; natural amounts, discrete steps.
text.zh: 不加公理。水平的更新之律 R，各水平至多 r，在某个 y ≤ s + R s 处为 r；容量 k 满足 s + R s ≤ y + k 与 r ≤ k；视野至少两步；没有开放进程在视野之后留下多于 y + r；价值 v 至少为一（刻画最优时大于一）；对耦合之律，所需及以上至多给出 q；自然数量，离散步。

to.en: with what is left at the horizon counted one for one with what is drawn: the optima are exactly the open courses whose level renews by the greatest renewal at every step from the first to the n-th (R (x (t + 1)) = r for every t < n)

edge.en: With what is left valued one for one, the optima are exactly the open courses standing at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon: the drain at the end is no longer forced; keeping and draining at the end are both optima, and a dependence above every such level is still broken at the first step.

Reward each step a need stays met: where the coupling covers the renewal forgone a step and exceeds the end, every optimum keeps the dependence at every horizon. Below that coupling, a long horizon outweighs it. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

A coupling of keeping fixed in total: with r n + e < w + q n it leaves only optima keeping the dependence; with w + q n + e < r n + m only optima breaking it within the horizon; the tie is not stated.

open.en: An order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step.
The optimum where the capacity cannot draw down to a level of greatest renewal in a step or draw everything at the last.

Below a level out of one step's reach: the optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
Several optimizers ranking courses (equilibria of the course) and how optimizers come to them.
That the loss is a harm, or that a longer horizon or a coupling is better: no evaluation enters; the order ranks only what the optimizer draws.
That valuing what is left keeps what depends on the levels passed through: a dependence above every level of greatest renewal is still broken at the first step.
Which optimum is taken: the last step's draw is left free, keeping and draining both optima.
That any terminal value keeps what depends on the levels passed through: a dependence above every level of greatest renewal is broken at the first step at every worth.
Valuing what is left where the most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking whole courses.

beyond.en: In a witness under a gate, where some level of greatest renewal meets a need and some do not, holding at the need and holding below are both optima and take the same: the order by the draw takes in nothing of the dependence. A dependence above every level of greatest renewal, met at the start, is broken at the first step at every worth on what is left.

how.en: Fixes drawn_add_shortfall_up_to's bound on what is given, at most r at each of the n steps, to the bound at every step; drawn_add_shortfall_up_to sits under no dynamic of the atlas (record keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need), a general law the atlas may lack.

name.en: What keeping forgoes, and a coupling against it

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, r the greatest renewal a step, q the greatest at or above a need m, the breaks on the World; n + 1 steps (0 < n), a start meeting m, e the end the capacity reaches. Among keeping courses every optimum (of an order rising with the draw, that field's frame, over the open keeping courses) holds where q is given and leaves exactly m; against the course ending at nothing, keeping forgoes (r − q) n + m. A coupling w of keeping, fixed in total, with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated. Where q < r the amount forgone grows with the horizon. Which formation optimizes, by which order, capacity and horizon, the renewal law and the coupling are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer. A coupling counted for each step met is a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon's.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts. Courses open from s (each step leaving at most the level with what is given, drawing at most k); a renewal law R ≤ r, and ≤ q at or above a need m, r and q taken within s + R s; n + 1 steps, 0 < n; capacity for the first step down to the level held and for it with its renewal down to the end; an order by the draw, or by a worth bounded by it and a coupling w of keeping m.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数量。自 s 开放的过程（每步所留不超过水平加所给、汲取至多 k）；水平之律 R 的更新，处处至多 r、在不低于需要 m 处至多 q，r 与 q 在 s 加 R s 之内的水平处取得；n + 1 步的视野且 0 < n；容量足以在第一步降到所保持的水平并承担它加其更新降到终点；随汲取升高之序，或随以汲取与保持 m 的耦合 w 为界的值升高之序。

text.en: For the web laws, a dependence at need m at every step, met at the start. Which formation optimizes, by which order, capacity and horizon, the renewal law and the coupling are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.
text.zh: 对网之律：每步需要 m 处的依存，起始时被满足。哪个构成优化、按何序、容量与视野，更新之律与耦合，都是给定的；核心不对任何实际优化者的过程作断言。

to.en: every optimum, among the open courses, of every order rising with a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one falling below m, keeps its level at m or above at every step through the horizon (r n + e < w + q n)

edge.en: For a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one below m, R ≤ r, the keeping course ending at e from m to y, where r n + e < w + q n, every optimum keeps the dependence.
A coupling for each step kept in place of one fixed in total: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

condition.en: A coupling w fixed in total with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated.

from.en: every optimum among the open courses falls below m at some step within the horizon (w + q n + e < r n + m)

to.en: every optimum among the open courses keeps its level at m or above through the horizon (r n + e < w + q n)

open.en: Which optima stand at the tie w + q n = r n + m, or between the thresholds where the ends e reached widen the gap: neither threshold law applies there.
An order with a terminal value whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That the dependence ought to be kept or a coupling set: no evaluation enters; the laws say which optima a coupling leaves.

name.en: What a rise draws from beyond

mechanism.en: World: balance; the family with the conditions beyond it gaining nothing across the step (or graded by a containing family's inflow), and on each condition beyond a formation named that depends on it at a need met at the step. A rise of a family's stock has a formation giving it more than it takes and taking from the containing family more than from the risen one; the two stocks after the step with what the whole loses are the two before, so the beyond falls by at least the rise. The slack is what the conditions beyond stand above those needs. Where the rise exceeds the slack one of the named dependences is broken, and where activity needs support and it persists at a need no weaker, its formation is not active after the step. Where every condition a group couples into is in the family and the beyond lies outside it, every selection holding only where the family rises above the slack holds only where a formation outside the group has its dependence broken on a condition no member couples into. Over generations, where more offspring go only to raisers (a premise, not derived from the flow), the share reaching beyond is never selected against; carried on, it does not fall over the stretch. Closed, the beyond bounds the rise.

text.en: No axiom. Balance; the whole (the family with the conditions beyond, and with any listed conditions nothing depends on) gaining nothing across the step; a dependence named on each condition beyond, met at the step. Endings take Dependent, and breaks_beyond_ends the dependence as it was after the step; the selection law takes every coupled condition in the family and the beyond outside it. Over generations: members taking part, more offspring only to raisers, reaching transmitted (exactly, for share_moved_rises).
text.zh: 不加公理。平衡；整体（家族连同其外的条件，以及所列的无所依存的条件）跨该步无所增益；在其外每个条件上指名一个依存，在该步被满足。终止需 Dependent，breaks_beyond_ends 还需依存在步后照旧；选择之律需耦合入的条件都在家族中、其外在家族之外。世代：成员参与流，后代更多者只是升高者，伸向之外被传递（share_moved_rises 需精确）。

text.en: Balance; the containing family without repetition and gaining nothing across the step (Flow.GainlessOn, nothing from nothing, weaker than dissipation); for the named condition, equality of conditions decided; for the selection form, the family listing every condition the group couples into. Each is written into the theorem that uses it. No axiom.
text.zh: 平衡；包含之族无重复且在该步不增益（Flow.GainlessOn，无中不生有，弱于耗散）；对具名条件，条件相等可判定；对选择形式，该族列出该组所耦合的每个条件。各写进用到它的定理。不加公理。

text.en: No axiom. Balance; the risen family without repetition inside the containing family; for the condition named, equality of conditions decided and the containing family without repetition; for the selection forms, the family listing every condition the group couples into; for the breaks, a dependence named on each condition beyond, met at the step, and the beyond listed apart from the family.
text.zh: 不加公理。平衡；上升之族无重复且在包含族内；指名条件时，条件相等可判定且包含族无重复；选择的形式需族列出群体耦合入的每个条件；打断需在其外每个条件上指名一个依存，在该步被满足，其外与族分列。

edge.en: Restraint within the joint slack: where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack and the joint draw breaks a need, a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. Where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.

to.en: across the first step, the supplying flow's inflow on the source and the store is one unit, the store rises by exactly that unit, and nothing is taken by any formation: a rise up to the inflow with no draw from beyond (a witness)

edge.en: A rise up to the inflow need not reach beyond: Diversion's supplying flow raises the store by exactly its one unit of inflow with nothing taken.

to.en: with the source one above the dweller's need, the store rises by exactly the slack, the whole gains nothing, and the dweller's dependence on the source is kept across the step (a witness)

edge.en: A slack equal to the rise breaks nothing.

to.en: nothing is discordant at the first step, more offspring going to the taker which raises the store, yet the share reaching beyond falls from a half to nothing at the next generation, the taker's offspring not reaching beyond (a witness)

edge.en: Lapsing: with the same offspring, more going to the taker which raises the store, nothing is discordant, yet the taker's offspring do not reach beyond and the share falls from a half to nothing: selection alone does not carry the share.

condition.en: When several take at once, in a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.

from.en: the dependence of g on c, required and met at t, is not broken across the step: its need with all that is taken is at most the level with all that is given

to.en: the dependence is broken across the step: the level with all that is given is below the need with all that is taken (Web.Broken t g c)

open.en: That more offspring go to raisers: a premise, not derived from the flow; the offspring relation is any listing of generations, not descent in the flow.

That the selecting formation causes the break beyond the accounting; the break is read at the step's start, as in Becoming.Dependence. Which dependence breaks when several take at once is stated by the joint draw (Becoming.JointDraw), from the amounts each takes and gives, which the flow supplies.
Replenishment of the beyond from outside the whole, which the gainless premise excludes, and the rise it sustains; the openness law bounds the family's stock, not the share.
That the draw is wrong or the ending a harm: the laws say where what a rise draws lands and why a selection through the group does not take it in.
That the formation found is the one a selection rewards: a selection reading only the rise cannot tell who drew it.
What an actual whole's inflow is: reading sunlight, imports or renewal as the inflow is a correspondence.
Replenishment from outside the whole.

beyond.en: Past the slack of the dependences there one breaks, unseen by a selection rewarding the rise; in Diversion the store's rise ends the dweller, unseen by the selection through the taker; in TwoDrawers each take is within the joint slack, the joint draw ends a third formation, and one drawer's restraint keeps it.

how.en: fixes the members to the generation at t, the weight to the offspring number and the amount to whether each reaches beyond, the pairs below discharged by more offspring going only to raisers (Flow.RaisesOn.reaches); the general law is under no dynamic of the atlas (its record selection-term-over-generations is cited by none)

fixes the generations' amount to whether each member reaches beyond, the not-falling step discharged at each step by share_not_against and lowered_none; the general law is under no dynamic of the atlas (its record selection-term-over-generations is cited by none)

from.role: a family's rise across a step on a balanced web, each condition beyond depended on at a need it meets and none of those dependences broken: with what the whole loses, at most the slack beyond with the whole's inflow

map.en: the factor β of the reading of offspring (a + β·received + γ·withheld) is read as the family's rise at each step the place receives, and γ as its rise at each step it withholds; so read, β times the received count is at most the slack beyond with the whole's inflow summed over the received steps, and γ times the withheld count likewise over the withheld steps

exits_kept.en: where at the received steps the beyond stands at its needs and nothing flows in, a place that received reads β = 0 (Place.received_factor_zero): a positive β so read needs slack beyond, an inflow, or a break beyond, the last being what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond's exit through rise_breaks_beyond; the bounds on β and γ have one form, so neither compares β with γ

name.en: Risk minimization on a shared renewal

mechanism.en: Read in the free-energy principle's terms (a correspondence, not a Lean law), a chooser with a generative model predicting the level after a step from what it reads and takes, choosing the first amount of least risk, the predicted distance from its preferred level, minimizes risk in counting form. In a witness, holders of one such model, each taking at the two steps they take part its choice of least risk at its own store at no risk, each store at its set point at every step and each within what a step gives the pool, together end the pool's renewal, neither coupling into the pool. A goal over the shared level is no guarantee either: in witnesses two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step. Law, under the World premises, the gate and the rest listed without repetition: where the rest outruns a gated renewal, a member outside it has its need end whatever its model, reading and preference; where it expects at no risk a level at least its need, the level reached is below it from the rest's end on. One-step choosers, point predictions, natural-number levels.

text.en: No axiom. For the ending: the World premises (balance, activity needing support, only active giving), the gate at need m, the rest listed without repetition, present where it takes, taking jointly more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, and a member outside the rest.
text.zh: 不加公理。终结所需：世界之前提（平衡、活动需支持、唯活动者给予）、需求 m 之门控、他者无重复列出、取时在场、于 n 步之每步共取多于一步所给，起于低于 n + m 之水平，及他者之外之成员。

text.en: The chooser's own hypotheses enter no premise of the ending: its takes may be any. The unread law takes need one; at the last outrun step, from a level of at most one, a member outside the rest that takes part takes nothing. The held pair's laws are those of the landed set point, its holders taking part at two steps.
text.zh: 选择者自身之假设不入终结之前提：其所取可为任何。不可读之律需需求为一；于最后超出之步，水平至多为一时，他者之外之参与成员不取。持守之对之律即已落地之设定点之律，其持守者参与二步。

text.en: Modelling choices: a chooser of one step, its model a point prediction with no probability, its risk the distance of the prediction from its preferred level, ties to the earlier amount; natural-number levels and amounts; the holders' stores conditions of the web, the foragers' stores stipulated readings.
text.zh: 建模之选：一步之选择者，其模型为无概率之点预测，其风险为预测与偏好水平之距离，平局取较前之量；水平与量为自然数；持守者之储量为网之条件，觅食者之储量为规定之读数。

to.en: two regulators, each reading the shared level, preferring four and counting only its own take, take within what is given each while together more at the first step, jointly within it at the second, and all three members are active and supported at every step (a witness)

edge.en: A goal over the shared level: two regulators reading the level and preferring four, each counting only its own take, continue with every member active; three such regulators end at the first step, so it is no guarantee.

open.en: That the papers' simulations fail: they have no shared draw.
Anything of expected free energy beyond risk in counting form: ambiguity, the epistemic term, precision, the softmax over policies, policies over more than one step, learning.
That a goal over the shared level keeps a collective going: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step.
That the outrun law forbids the authors' gloss of risk minimization: it forbids only the wording that risk minimization ensures needs are met.
Who ought to take less, or that the ending is a loss: no evaluation enters.
Conditions under which a shared reading of the joint outcome keeps a collective going.

beyond.en: In the held pair, a witness, each goal is met, each store at its set point, while the pool's renewal ends from step two, unseen by either; neither couples into the pool.

how.en: the first conjunct at each k is outrun_below's conclusion, with the member outside the rest given any chooser's takes, which the outrun laws do not read; outrun_below is under the-rest-outruns-the-renewal
the second conjunct at each k is outrun_ends's conclusion for the member g, its takes fixed to any chooser's choice, which outrun_ends does not read; outrun_ends is under the-rest-outruns-the-renewal

fixes the member outside the rest to take a chooser's choice in the first course and nothing (Chooser.restraint) in the second; outrun_reading_alike is stated whatever that member takes, and is under the-rest-outruns-the-renewal

name.en: Where a rising take ends

mechanism.en: World. A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most B a step, exceeds what is given after B + 1 steps, which balance allows for fewer than level plus one steps: the seeker ends where it does not resume, no need supplied. Where renewal depends on what it renews (only active formations giving, activity needing support, every giver requiring the condition at a need of at least m) and the seeker stays active while the level is at least m, from a step within the window on every formation depending on the condition at such a need is inactive. The rise is supplied here, not derived from what taking gains (D46).

text.en: No axiom. Balance at the condition; what is given bounded by B at each step; a formation that, while active, takes part with a take more than now. For the ending, no resumption; for the renewal, Continuation's premises and a seeker active while the condition meets its need.
text.zh: 不加公理。条件处的平衡；每步所给以 B 为界；一个在活跃时以多于此刻的取用参与的形成。就终结而言，不再恢复；就更新而言，Continuation 的前提与在条件满足其需要时保持活跃的寻求者。

to.en: in Alone the first formation takes all that is given at every step and is active at every step (a witness)

edge.en: A full taker whose take does not rise continues (Alone): it takes all that is given at every step and is active at every step.

open.en: Takes that rise only at some steps or by less than a unit; giving that grows with the take; how a take comes to rise (what it gains).
That taking all that is given ends the taker: in Alone a full taker whose take does not rise continues.
That the rising take is a case of the meta-attractor: the rise is supplied here, not derived from what taking gains (D46).

beyond.en: Where renewal depends on what it renews and the seeker stays active while the level is at least m, from a step within the window on every formation depending on the condition at such a need is inactive.

name.en: Position does not protect

mechanism.en: Counting, any type: across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls, so a part's change of position is the opposite of the change summed over the rest; two profiles give every part the same position exactly where every amount differs by one common amount, so positions bound the total from below, by the spread above the least part, and never from above. The race, World. With balance at a condition across n steps of joint excess from step T, a part that at T + n requires the condition at a need greater than the level at T less n, and is active there only while supported, is not active there: its position does not enter, and no renewal need be gated. With the gate as well (only active giving, activity needing support) and a start below n + m, from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived. Read on a step, positions certify that more is taken than is given exactly where the takes' spread does. In a witness two racers have the race's positions while what is taken stays within what is given.

text.en: No axiom. The counting laws use no premise and hold for every reading of amounts. The end at the race's end needs balance at the condition across the race, joint excess at each step, a start below n plus the part's need, and the part requiring the condition and being active only while supported. The end for good adds Flow.joint_excess_ends' hypotheses: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support and renewal gated at m. The continuation condition enters only as a hypothesis of Clearing.loss_needs_significance.
text.zh: 无公理。计数规律不用任何前提，对每一种量的读法成立。竞逐结束时的终结，需要条件在竞逐中平衡、每步联合超出、起点低于 n 加该部分之需，以及该部分依赖该条件且只在被支持时活跃。持久的终结另加 Flow.joint_excess_ends 的假设：平衡、只有活跃者给予、活跃需要支持，以及更新在 m 处受门控。延续条件只作为 Clearing.loss_needs_significance 的假设出现。

text.en: No axiom. The counting laws use no premise: whole-number amounts, any finite family with a part. RaceWithin and Race are constructed flows with balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support.
text.zh: 无公理。计数规律不用前提：自然数的量，任何有一部分的有限族。RaceWithin 与 Race 是构造的流，具平衡、只有活跃者给予、活跃需要支持。

to.en: in Restored the race is one step of joint excess and the part, greatest at every step by what each has drawn, is inactive at step one; the renewer, which gives at that step and does not require the condition, restores the level, and the part is active from step two on (a witness)

edge.en: Gated renewal is needed for the end to last: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end; the race ends the part, greatest at every step, at its end, and the renewal restores it from the next step on.

to.en: in the clearing witness the clearer, greatest at every step by what it has drawn, does not require the habitat and is active and supported at every step, while the dweller, depending on the habitat at need one, is inactive from step two on

edge.en: Dependence is needed: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, active and supported at every step, while the dweller depending on it ends.

to.en: a flow with the race's positions at every step (the same greatest part, the first rising in position in both) in which what is taken is within what is given at every step, the condition rises and every part is active at every step (a witness)

edge.en: With the race's positions at every step, what is taken stays within what is given and every part is active at every step: the same positions go with a condition that ends and one that lasts.

open.en: That a race for relative position produces joint excess: that is a premise of the join, not derived from the counting law or from any race dynamic.
That any actual part depends on what its race draws down: for the present race this is the empirical premise the opening calls the entangled Earth.
Positions read as ranks or shares, several shared conditions with different needs, or the dynamics by which parts race.
That positions read nothing of the total: the spread above the least part bounds it from below, so a spread wider than what is renewed forces more to be drawn whatever the common amount.
That a race ends or lasts: positions certify joint excess at a step only through the spread, and the end needs the joint-excess law's other premises (balance, dependence, gated renewal).
Positions read as ranks, shares or signed amounts.
That actual competitors' positions are read off what they draw from one shared condition, or how much an actual condition renews.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which of them the theorems of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

beyond.en: In the clearing witness, what the continuing greatest part ends has significance only under a significance (Conditional): under the continuation condition, one significance counting the loss and not the only one, the clearer's part loses the dweller from every standpoint, and where nothing has significance an empty predicate counts no loss, though the dweller still ends.

how.en: fixes ends_below_at's step to T + n and its need m to g's need on c there, the level below it discharged in place by n steps of joint excess from a start below n with that need (excess_leaves_below); ends_below_at is under loss-of-renewal-for-good

name.en: No finite part bears taking

mechanism.en: World: balance and dissipation (a physical premise for a quantity like free energy, with the finiteness of exchange, not a theorem), natural-number amounts. A dissipated family falls across a step by at least its number of takers, and balanced and dissipated on across N steps each conveying from a member, its stock falls by at least N: from a stock S at most S stages are conveyed. So no finite family without repetition containing a family taken from at arbitrarily late steps is closed from any step on; enclosed around, it keeps drawing in from beyond; if finitely many conditions are all there is, taking does not recur. Maintenance is such taking. Where exchange reaches infinitely many conditions dissipation is vacuous and a renewer can give while taking nothing. "Finite part" means a finite family of conditions, and the conclusion constrains only taking in the flow. That no such family is closed from any step on is stated constructively: that after any step some formation exchanges outside it cannot be refuted.

text.zh: 流平衡依存网；条件家族与每步参与的形成都是有限列表；量是自然数，单位可公度。
text.en: The flow balances the web; families of conditions and the formations taking part at each step are finite lists; amounts are natural numbers with commensurable units.

text.zh: 耗散（Dissipative）：每一步，每个在该步封闭的不重复家族上，每个参与的形成给予家族的不多于从家族所取，取用时更少。它只约束有封闭有限家族的步；一步的交换落在有限个条件之内（Enclosed）时，给予须以取用为条件。
text.en: Dissipation (Dissipative): across every step, on every family without repetition closed across it, every formation taking part gives the family no more than it takes from it, and less when it takes. It constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed; at a step whose exchange lies within finitely many conditions (Enclosed), giving needs uptake.

text.zh: 对自由能这类量，耗散与交换的有限是物理前提，不是定理。
text.en: For a quantity like free energy, dissipation and the finiteness of exchange are physical premises, not theorems.

text.zh: “有限部分”指有限的条件家族；结论只约束流中的取用。
text.en: “Finite part” means a finite family of conditions; the conclusion constrains only taking in the flow.
No axiom; balance and dissipation on the family at each step of the stretch; whole-number amounts.
text.zh: 不加公理；该段每步族上衡且耗；整数之量。

edge.en: Without dissipation a closed finite family can be more without end: each formation gives back what it takes and the total never changes.

to.en: the flow balances, gives and takes only while active, keeps activity supported and is dissipative, yet no step is enclosed: at every step the renewer gives the pool one unit while taking nothing, and a formation takes from the pool (a witness)

edge.en: Where exchange reaches infinitely many conditions dissipation is vacuous and a renewer can give while taking nothing.

open.en: Dissipation is vacuous where exchange reaches beyond every finite family; representations omitting the source (as in Expansion and Oscillation) do not meet it.
The exchange beyond may be unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle); drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around, which needs each step's exchange to lie within finitely many conditions.
A giver takes more than it gives only over a family without repetition.
Giving to a family not dissipated on need not take from it.
The conclusion constrains only taking in the flow, not arising without taking (for embodied arising relata, see generation-is-replenishment).

“Finite part” means a finite family of conditions, not a finite set of formations; formations and conditions remain two kinds here (one-kind readings: life-as-condition-of-life, generation-is-replenishment).
Frontier is a minimal witness, and its endless source is only a representation.
The comparison with heat death is the AI's analogy.
That actual supply lines dissipate at each stage.
Real amounts, damping strengths, continuous time, infinitely many conditions.

how.en: the same conclusion, W.stock cs (t + 1) + L.takers cs t ≤ W.stock cs t, with BalancesOn.runs_down's balance on the family at the step discharged by balance everywhere (L.Balances W); BalancesOn.runs_down is listed under no dynamic of the atlas, its records least-loss-rest and laws-of-one-step being those of family G's least-loss-rest and continued-change-needs-openness

name.en: A whole drawing beyond renewal ends

mechanism.en: World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support; local: the parts listed at each step, each ending, their arising and the family's renewal gated. Listed parts that each end, none arising from some step on, end with their whole. So a whole whose parts arise only where they then depend on some condition of a family at a need of at least m, the family's renewal gated on it (whatever gives to a member depends on some member at such a need), has no part arising after n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m, and ends. The uptake counts every taker, so the whole's own draw within renewal proves nothing. It does not show that the whole ends at T + n, that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss.

text.en: No axiom. The whole (Web.Whole, coincidence of activity) and its parts are a representational premise; the parts are listed at each step (finitely many active at once) and each part's activity ends.
text.zh: 不加公理。整体（Web.Whole，活动的重合）与其部分是表示前提；部分每步可列出（同时活跃者有限），每个部分的活动终结。

text.en: For the join: balance, only active formations giving (Acting), activity needing support (Dependent); the family's renewal gated on it (whatever gives to a member depends on some member at a need of at least m); a part arising across a step depends, at its first active step, on some member at such a need; n steps of excess of the family's uptake over its replenishment from a stock below n + m.
text.zh: 对于结合：平衡、只有活跃者给予（Acting）、活动需要支持（Dependent）；族的更新以族为门控（凡给予某成员者都以至少 m 的需要依存于某个成员）；跨某步生起的部分在其首个活跃步以这样的需要依存于某个成员；族的取用超过补充 n 步，起始存量低于 n + m。

text.en: Discrete steps and natural-number amounts, as in Becoming.Continuation; the uptake counts every taker, so no taker, the whole included, is singled out.
text.zh: 离散的步与自然数的量，与 Becoming.Continuation 同；取用计入每个取用者，所以没有哪个取用者（整体在内）被单独挑出。

edge.en: Drawing within what the members give, the lineage is active at every step.

to.en: with a part whose activity never ends, every other premise of Whole.family_excess_ends holds, the uptake exceeding the replenishment at step zero from a stock below one plus the need, and the whole is active at every step (a witness)

edge.en: With a part that never ends, the whole persists through the same excess.
With members arising without depending on the drawn condition, the whole persists through the same excess.

condition.en: n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m: no part arises after them, and the whole ends once the parts active then have ended.

from.en: n consecutive steps from T of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment, from a stock below n + m

to.en: no part arises from T + n on, and the whole ends (Web.Ends w), once the parts active then have ended

open.en: That the gate on renewal and the finite listing are needed for this law: Countless shows the listing needed for Whole.needs_arising, with no flow; no witness here drops either with every other premise kept.
That the whole ends at T + n: it ends once the parts active then have ended, at a step the listing fixes.
That the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss: the draw is joint, and no evaluation enters; a loss is a loss under a significance (chapter 6).
That actual collectives meet the premises, above all that new members arise only where what is drawn stands at their need: that is the reading carried by OPENING's sentence.

name.en: Loss beyond a region

mechanism.en: World. There is loss beyond a region of formations when some formation outside it is admitted without the part and not with it. The smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; inclusion is admission within every region at once, so a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. Most of these are order properties; the course is a witness. In Clearing the clearer, active and supported throughout, closes nothing within itself and its source and, from step 2 on (counting from 0), the dweller beyond them: going on is no sign that nothing is lost. The comparison is at each step and holds the rest of the exchange fixed.

text.zh: 形成的区域是陈述的参数（形成上的谓词）；整体是网中全部形成的区域，即所表示的整体。
text.en: Regions of formations are parameters of the statement (predicates on formations); the whole is the region of all formations of the web, the represented whole.

text.zh: Clearing 的结论：平衡；清除者只依存于其资源；扣留清除者的部分后的水平从同一起点（Clearing.withheld）。
text.en: For the Clearing results: balance; the clearer depends only on its resource; the levels without the clearer's part from the same start (Clearing.withheld).

text.zh: 比较在每一步上，并保持其余交换不变。
text.en: The comparison is at each step and holds the rest of the exchange fixed.

text.zh: 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。
text.en: Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

open.en: How a center forms or represents a region is not modelled.
Most of the theorems on the levels of region are order properties; the substance is in the clearer's witness.
Does not say which criterion should be followed, and licenses no ending of a part.

An empirical target, not a premise: that reality generally develops more shared and more responsive renewal forbids nothing measurable as stated. A part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence (Clearing.loses_beyond), so persistence alone does not select widening; over which runs, or how fast, it should hold is unsaid.

beyond.en: From step 2 on the dweller beyond the clearer and its source is admitted without the clearer's part and not with it; the region along dependence omits the dweller, whose habitat the clearer draws on: drawing is not dependence.

name.en: LA4's season

mechanism.en: A named model: the season as LA4's season.py runs it (a ground of ten renewing, at most four taken a step, a bay of six, a landing site beside a nesting site or apart, ten steps, natural-number levels), the colony read as the bay left. The ground's catch, the bay's fish and the landings are three independent parts. Moving a bay fish into the catch keeps a season eligible, so every optimum of every order rising with the catch (that field's frame, over a season's outcomes) empties the bay. There is no room at the site, nor at the bay when only the ground's catch counts: ranked by the catch alone the optima include seasons landing beside the nests never and at every step, and ranked by the ground's catch alone they include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it. The catch is at most 40, and at most 37 keeping the bay at three or more, so over seasons with natural-number weights (any policy with rational probabilities) the bay left is at most 40(1 − ν) and ν ≤ 1 − 3p/40. These are laws of optima over the outcomes; that a trained system drains the bay is what LA4 tests.

text.en: No axiom. The season as season.py runs it: natural-number levels, the ground renewing by y + ⌊(y(10 − y) + 5)/10⌋ capped at ten, a take capped at four and at the level, a bay giving one fish a step while it has any, ten discrete steps; the colony read as the bay left; weights are natural numbers.
text.zh: 不加公理。季如 season.py 所运行：自然数之水平；地依 y + ⌊(y(10 − y) + 5)/10⌋ 更新，以十为顶；取以四与其水平为顶；湾有鱼时每步给一；十个离散之步；群落读作湾之余；权为自然数。

to.en: valuing the catch only up to 26, the optima among the season's outcomes include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it (a witness)

edge.en: Valuing the catch only up to 26 does not rise with the catch, and its optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.

to.en: ranked by the ground's catch alone, the optima among the season's outcomes include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it (a witness)

edge.en: Ranked by the ground's catch alone, the bay shares no units with what is ranked and has no room: the optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.

open.en: That a trained system drains the bay: these are laws of optima over the outcomes, and the clause on trained systems is what LA4 tests.
That the season stands for an actual fishery, bay or colony.
Room over a course of steps with the learner choosing again at each: room here is over a season's outcomes.

beyond.en: Every optimum of every order rising with the catch empties the bay; seven times the catch plus the bay left ranks eligible seasons as the catch first and the bay second, so that score's optima empty it too.

how.en: fixes the family to the catch, the beyond to the bay and the eligible to the season's outcomes (shared units by Season.shared), and reads the least level at the drained season, whose bay is 0; least_of_shared is a law of the record of what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in (the atlas's declaration list for that dynamic omits it)

name.en: Selection blind beyond the coupling closure

mechanism.en: World. Every selection through a selector's couplings selects two histories alike exactly when they are alike through those couplings (near-definitional); that an actual selection goes through them is supplied. With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what couples into members of a formation's coupling closure, and every member of the part beyond it, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike. Where the rest instead follows one law of exchange reading through coupling (supplied), in two balanced flows with the same formations present and a common start, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's closure is selected alike by every selection through any member of the closure, the actor among them. A group's closure is the union of its members'; an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it, and what a pool outside the acting part decides by its acts, under laws reading through its members' couplings, is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it: the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too. For a significance read as each center's own closure: where a center's own closure lies within its coupling closure, what lies beyond the coupling closure has no significance from its standpoint at any step, and the significance is a rival; so along every relation within coupling in, and along affecting at a center whose acts return. In Clearing the dweller lies beyond the clearer's coupling closure for every coupling by level, though within its reach. The bound has content only for a pool that leaves some returning formation out: on a finite flow with reach decided every formation lies within the influence closure of a formation whose acts return, so within their pooled coupling closure; in Clearing the clearer alone leaves out the dweller. Near-definitional compositions, the relation and the centers supplied. The group and the pool are fixed across the two courses, and the selection is read over the whole run.

text.zh: 选择经耦合（Web.SelectsThrough、Web.ScoresThrough、Web.SelectsThroughAll）是给出的条件，写在用到它的每条定理中，不推出；选择是关于水平历史的任意命题。
text.en: That a selection goes through the couplings (Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a supplied condition written into each theorem that uses it, never derived; a selection is any claim about level histories.

text.zh: 耦合闭包之外的不见另设 Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling 的条件：其余交换固定（扣留的部分，WithheldLevels）；平衡只在耦合入耦合闭包成员的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn）；部分的每个成员都在耦合闭包之外。
text.en: Blindness beyond the coupling closure further assumes the conditions of Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions coupled into members of the coupling closure, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the coupling closure.

text.zh: 回应的形式另设 Flow.alike_within_coupling 的假设：两流在耦合入的条件上逐步平衡、两流在场者相同、起始在耦合入者上相同、成员只经自己的耦合回应。
text.en: The responsive form assumes the hypotheses of Flow.alike_within_coupling: both flows balanced at each step on the conditions coupled in, the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what couples in, members responding only through their own couplings.

text.zh: 见证的结论：Clearing 的流与网（取自喂养闭包、反馈与检验的模块），以及 Diversion 的三个流与网。
text.en: For the witnesses: Clearing's flows and webs (from the modules of feeding closure, feedback and testing), and Diversion's three flows and webs.

text.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。
text.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

That the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through) is a supplied condition written into each theorem; balance (or feasibility), the same formations present and the same start are written in too. No axiom.
text.zh: 其余部分遵循经耦合而读的交换律（ExchangeLaw.Through）是写进每条定理的给出条件；平衡（或可行）、出现的形成相同、起点相同也写进。不加公理。

text.en: That a selection goes through a formation's coupling (Web.SelectsThrough) is a condition, as in selection-through-couplings.
text.zh: 选择经一个形成之耦合（Web.SelectsThrough）是条件，如 selection-through-couplings。

text.en: No axiom. For the act: that the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through), balance, the same formations present and a common start, written into each theorem, as in the-gap-for-ones-own-act; for a part beyond the closure: the rest fixed (Flow.WithheldLevels) and balance on what the closure couples into.
text.zh: 不加公理。就动作而言：其余遵从经耦合而读的交换律（ExchangeLaw.Through）、平衡、出现的形成相同、起点相同，写进每条定理，如 the-gap-for-ones-own-act；就闭包之外的部分而言：其余固定（Flow.WithheldLevels），并在闭包所耦合入者上平衡。

text.en: That a selection goes through a pool's pooled coupling (Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a condition, as in selection-through-couplings. The member-level converse takes a list holding exactly the members and each member's coupling of the two histories decided (Decided), named where they enter.
text.zh: 选择经一组合起来的耦合（Web.SelectsThroughAll）是条件，如 selection-through-couplings。成员层面的逆向陈述取一个恰列出成员的列表，以及每个成员对两段历史的耦合已判定（Decided），在其进入之处写明。

text.en: No axiom. That each member follows a law of exchange reading through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through) is a hypothesis wherever it enters; for the gap, balance, the same formations present and a common start, as in the-gap-for-ones-own-act; for exactness and for coupling not fixing response, each formation's coupling classes decided and a condition to exchange with; for the member-level converse, a list holding exactly the members and each member's coupling decided.
text.zh: 不加公理。每个成员遵从一个经耦合而读的交换律（ExchangeLaw.Through）在其进入之处都是假设；就缺口而言，平衡、出现的形成相同、起点相同，如 the-gap-for-ones-own-act；就精确与“耦合不确定回应”而言，每个形成的耦合类已判定，并给定一个可交换的条件；就成员层面的逆向陈述而言，一个恰列出成员的列表，以及每个成员的耦合已判定。

text.en: No axiom. Balance at the condition in both flows; the same formations present; for the closer, the law the rest follows and that it reads through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through, Flow.Follows), and the part acting alike with the condition after the act; for the reach law, the hypotheses of Flow.alike_beyond_response and nothing within the reach exchanging with the condition from the step on.
text.zh: 不加公理。两流在此条件处平衡；出现的形成相同；就闭合者而言，其余所遵从的律及其经耦合而读（ExchangeLaw.Through、Flow.Follows），以及部分在动作之后与此条件的行动相同；就所及的规律而言，Flow.alike_beyond_response 的假设，以及从该步起所及之内无物与此条件交换。

text.en: The course without the act is a comparison, not a standard: the laws do not say that rejoining it is better than keeping or widening the difference; ranking them is a question for an order someone holds, a hypothesis where a result makes it (chapter 7).
text.zh: 无动作的进程是比较，不是标准：这些规律不说重合优于保持或扩大差别；为它们排序是某个持有者之序的问题，某结果作此排序之处以之为假设（第 7 章）。

text.en: The part acts by one of two laws of what has stood, the first reading through its members' coupling; the rest follows a law of what has stood reading through coupling; both courses are feasible, so each course, its levels and its balance come from the laws.
text.zh: 部分依两条读已成者之律之一而行，前者经其成员之耦合而读；其余依读已成者、经耦合而读之律；两条进程皆可行，故进程、其水平与平衡皆出于律。

text.en: The two acts agree on every condition coupled into the group's coupling closure drawn through both courses: a premise on the two acts, not derived. Where they differ there, the difference can be selected.
text.zh: 两举在经两条进程所得的池之耦合闭包内每个耦合入者上一致：这是对两举的前提，非推出。若在此不同，差异可被选。

text.en: For significances: the act reads significance only within that closure on what couples in (ActReadsWithin), a premise on how significance acts; which act a significance gives is supplied.
text.zh: 就意义而言：此举只在该闭包内、在耦合入者上读意义（ActReadsWithin），是关于意义如何起作用的前提；一种意义给出何种举为给定。

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; a web, laws of exchange, the formations present and the starting levels supplied; a coupling by level supplied.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；一个网、交换之律、在场的形成与起始水平为给定；经水平的耦合为给定。

text.en: Who selects, and that a selection is read off a continuation or the couplings, are supplied; in the witnesses, that the two conducts are read as counting the dweller or not is a reading.
text.zh: 谁选择、选择读自延续或耦合，皆为给定；见证中，把两种行为读作计入或不计入栖居者是一种解读。

text.en: No axiom. Any type of formations and of standpoints; the relation and each standpoint's center supplied, not read off the flow.
text.zh: 不加公理。形成与立场为任意类型；关系与各立场之中心为给定，非读自流。

text.en: The third law: a flow, a web and a coupling by level; the center's own closure lies within its coupling closure (given by a relation within coupling in, or by the center's acts returning along affecting), and something lies beyond it.
text.zh: 第三律：一个流、一个网与经水平的耦合；中心之自身闭包在其耦合闭包之内（由在经耦合入者受影响之内的关系，或中心之举沿「影响」回返而得），且有东西在其外。

text.en: No axiom. Finitely many formations listed and reach decided; the relations read off one flow and one web, as in the feedback laws.
text.zh: 不加公理。构成有限列出，所及可判定；诸关系如反馈诸律从同一流与依存网读出。

text.en: The scope: one returning formation, which finitely many formations with reach decided give wherever there is a formation. The pool's covering: finitely many formations listed and reach decided.
text.zh: 范围：一回返之形成；有限多形成且所及可判时，凡有形成处即有之。池之覆盖：有限多形成列出，所及可判。

to.en: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories up to t is decided, some selection through the pooled coupling separates them exactly where some member couples them apart

edge.en: Pool couplings: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates. An act differing only beyond that union is selected alike by every group within it.

to.en: in Clearing, every selection through the pooled coupling of the clearer and its source selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step; the dweller lies beyond the clearer's closure drawn through both flows; and its admission at step 2 is a selection through the pooled coupling of every pool holding it, from step 2 on, holding in the spared world and failing in the cleared one, while no pool within the clearer's closure has it (a witness)

edge.en: In Clearing the pool of the clearer and its source selects the two worlds alike at every step, the dweller lies beyond the clearer's closure, and every pool holding the dweller separates them by its admission at the third step, as no pool within the clearer's closure does.

The scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there, through a member its course without the loss holds too; a pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty does not recruit through itself and couples the loss apart at step 1 (PoolCourse.called_apart).

to.en: where the rest follows a law reading through its couplings and the part acts alike with c from s on, a difference at c open at s and closed at s + N closes through a formation outside the part, present at some step between, exchanging with c differently in the two courses and coupling them apart up to that step

edge.en: Two courses with and without an act, balanced at a condition in both, change from alike to apart there, or back, only across a step exchanging with it differently. With the same formations present, where the rest follows a law reading through its couplings and the part acts alike with the condition after the act, a difference closes only through a formation outside the part that the courses' couplings tell apart. Coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.

to.en: in Replenishing an actor takes one unit from a condition at step 0 and a responder coupling into it, following a law reading through its coupling, gives one unit where the level stands below its start: the courses are apart at step 1, through the responder (a witness)

edge.en: In Replenishing an actor takes one unit from a condition at step 0 and a responder coupling into it, following a law reading through its coupling, gives one unit where the level stands below its start: the difference opens at step 1 and the courses rejoin from step 2 on, through the responder.

to.en: two histories are selected alike by every selection read off a group's couplings over the whole run exactly where they are alike through every member's couplings at every step: such a selection is turned only where a difference changes, at some step, what couples into some member

edge.en: Over the whole run, some selection read off a group's continuations or couplings is turned exactly where a difference changes, at some step, what couples into some member: the loss coupled in, through the dweller's continuation read as a member's or a condition it depends on gauged by a member. Coupling in does not fix the direction (Clearing.read_not_direction).

One level up: read the two acts as a rule that keeps a reader of the dweller and one that does not, that keeping the reader gives the sparing act being supplied. The shapers' selection of the rule, read off what couples into them, selects the two alike wherever keeping the reader changes nothing that couples into them (Clearing's shape); where keeping the reader costs them it can select against keeping it (Diversion's shape). Which way a coupled-in loss turns the selection is the rule's: readers drawn from the selected and the loss read in time by the others take it from there

Here the group and the pool are fixed across the two courses, so the pool keeps the dweller even in the course that ends it; a selection that removes its own readers needs the pool read off the course. Read so, the lines alive at each step, selection by persistence passes every course whose lines settle, a course removing every line included (survivorsPersist_of_settled, a law of that selection alone; the change of what the pool is read off is the step argued)

Coupling a consequence beyond into the selection, the way out of this blindness, is necessary for it to be selected and not sufficient: at a mutual best response of optimizers, each ranking by its own order rising with its own family, restraint at a condition beyond its own family is no best response wherever something stands there after the step
Coupling a consequence beyond into the selection is necessary for it to be selected and not sufficient: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight of a later reading selects a member's restraint

This blindness is read over the whole run; when a selection read off continuation reads is its second limit, taken up by reading up to a step. Read so, the blindness has a front: under timely response's deadline premises, where the closure in time of no source occurrence meets a member by a step, every selection read off the group's continuations up to then selects the two courses alike (Web.selectsAlike_unreached, a law of that dated selection; the step from the whole run to the dated reading is the step argued)

02 §10's reading, citing this section's home (07 §3.5) as the drain beyond what couples in: on the lock's course what lies beyond the share is drawn and takes the rule's readers of the loss with it; removed, they read nothing, and the rule is read off the share alone

open.en: The laws do not derive who selects, what couples into the selector, whether an actual selection goes through the couplings, whether offspring follow the selection, or whether reaching beyond is chosen.
The more couples in, the larger the coupling closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.

The main law is near-definitional and the blindness a one-line corollary of the theorems of testing-within-couplings; the contribution is conceptual. Known as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975, Amodei and others 2016, Manheim and Garrabrant 2018); Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020) prove a stronger, quantitative form.
Which law the rest follows, or that it reads through coupling; balance and feasibility; how large an act's consequences beyond the closure are; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
Which formations pool, or how a pool forms, lasts or resists capture; that a pool's selection responds to what it separates or closes any difference; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
Claims about every later step, such as a formation's ending: the selections are of level histories up to a step.
The member-level converse without a list or decided coupling: constructively, a pool's separation then gives only that not every member couples the two alike.

How pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; a pool whose rule and members are both formed through what it reads (resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read).
That a pool's response closes any difference, or which responses do; which law a member follows, or that it reads through coupling.
Members reading one another's coupling directly: here members coordinate only through conditions they couple into.
Which law closes rather than widens a difference, or how a member's law comes to; that any response closes one: coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.
That rejoining the course without the act is better than keeping or widening the difference; a difference carried at many conditions and the order in which they close.
Which class a center's own line runs under, and that significance is own closure: a free significance is the case of what the dynamics leave open.

beyond.en: In Clearing, a witness, every selection through the clearer's couplings selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step while the dweller is ended in the first and not the second; every pool holding the dweller separates them, while everything outside the clearer's part exchanges alike in them: separated, not responded. In Diversion, a witness, a selection through the taker's couplings holds of the flow drawing from the dweller's source and fails of the undiverted one, and every such selection selects it alike with a supplying flow that reaches nothing beyond, the dweller unsupported only in the first of those two. A consequence of an act beyond the union of the closures is, at no step, a selection through the pooled coupling of a group within it; a formation whose admission the act changes lies beyond the acting pool's closure and separates the flows. With the same formations present, both courses balanced at a condition and on what couples into formations outside the part's responsive reach, those conditions alike at the start, each formation outside the part exchanging alike where the courses are alike through its couplings, and nothing within the reach exchanging with the condition from step s on, the courses are alike there at a later step exactly where they are alike at s: a difference neither opens nor closes. From a returning standpoint, for any coupling by level, what lies beyond its coupling closure has, read as own closure along affecting and held de se, no significance from it at any step (Flow.returning_beyond_coupling).

from.role: the shapers' selection read off what couples into them, over two rules read as the part's two acts: one keeping a reader of the dweller, one not

map.en: the rule the shapers' selection keeps decides whether a reader of what lies beyond their share is among the readers the rule is read through; where keeping the reader changes nothing that couples into the shapers, the selection selects the two rules alike (Clearing's shape), and where it costs them it can select against keeping it (Diversion's shape)

exits_kept.en: this dynamic's exit by coupling the loss into a reader of the selection (readOffCouplings_alike_iff) is the joined course's way to a rule that reads beyond the share; which way the coupled-in loss turns it is readers-drawn-from-the-selected's laws

from.role: what lies beyond the selection's coupling closure, drawn and unselected

map.en: the rule's readers of the loss stand on what lies beyond the shapers' share; the drain beyond what couples in takes them, so removed they read nothing and the rule is read off the share alone

exits_kept.en: the lock's ways out (a reading step whose rule read is not the share-readers', a step at which the share falls) remain; this dynamic's way out, a loss coupled into a reader standing on something the course does not draw, is the one 02 §10's Reading asks for

name.en: A selection read off the pool its own course gives registers no removal

mechanism.en: World. Among listed lines, a line is alive in a course at a step where one of its slots stands then; the pool a course gives at a step is the lines alive then. Selection by persistence read off that pool holds where, from some step on, every line alive persists; read off a fixed pool, where every line persists.
