A course removes a line alive at the start and, from some step on, not; a selection removes its own readers where it holds at a course removing a line of readers, which lines are readers being supplied. Read off its own pool, selection by persistence registers no removal: every course in which, from some step on, each line persists or is not alive passes it, a course removing every line included (classically every course with finitely many lines settles; argued, not in Lean). Read off a fixed pool every removal turns it, and passing it there passes it read off the course's pool. Under the blindness's premises on the two acts and the rest, a reader within the group's coupling closure drawn through both courses, its own standing coupled in, stands at every step in the one course exactly when in the other. Near-definitional. Nothing makes a selection prefer a course removing its readers: the shape of the meta-attractor with persistence for the share, not the meta-attractor.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; lines listed with their slots; a line alive where a slot stands.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；诸系连其诸位列出；一系于其一位立处为活。

text.en: For the reader kept alike: the premises of act_courses_unselected_throughout, the reader within the group's closure and its own standing coupled into it.
text.zh: 就两程无别之读者：act_courses_unselected_throughout 之诸前提，读者在该组闭包之内且其自立耦合入之。

text.en: In the witness, reading the dweller's line as a reader of the habitat is a reading: its continuation hangs on the habitat's level.
text.zh: 见证中，把栖者之系读作栖地之读者是一种解读：其延续系于栖地之水平。

to.en: read off a fixed pool, selection by persistence fails at every course removing a line alive at the start: the removal registered

edge.en: Read off a fixed pool, selection by persistence fails at every course removing a line alive at the start (not_allPersist_of_removes); passing it there passes it read off the course's own pool (AllPersist.survivors), not conversely (Habitat.cleared_removes_its_readers)

to.en: not reached here: the meta-attractor itself, a selection by share coming to select for control of its rule, would need RuleShaping's counts read off the pool the course gives, a join not made; read off its survivors the selection reads nothing beyond them as closed capture reads nothing beyond its share, a likeness of shape (SurvivorsPersist beside Unread), not a law

edge.en: Read off the pool its course gives, selection by persistence reads nothing beyond its survivors, as 02's closed capture reads nothing beyond its share, a likeness of shape (SurvivorsPersist beside Unread), not a law; here with persistence for the share and no rule formed from it: the meta-attractor's shape, not the meta-attractor. A selection by share coming to select for control of its rule needs RuleShaping's counts read off the pool the course gives; that join is not made

Read as generative alignment's first condition on the flow: keep the readers in a pool that does not depend on the course selected, or couple their loss back into the selectors' own continuation; where the loss returns, what turns is the selecting line's own persistence, the selection read off its survivors still passing (Habitat.clearedBack_survivors_pass)

Where revision copies the reading of a relatum standing then, the update keeps a region wherever both lie in it, and from a step on every relatum standing carries the region, as on a course that has removed the lines carrying the other readings, the region is closed under revision from that step on, so fixed then it stays fixed: removing the readers removes the revisers, under copying

The ways 07 §4.12 names for a selection that removes its readers still to register the removal, a pool independent of the course and a removal returning to the selecting line's own continuation, and its condition for alike outcomes, are read on the lock's laws for selection by share as regimes of who reads what lies beyond, each a law on the map: closed capture's turned_by_loss, readers drawn from the selected, the loss borne by the shapers. Selection here is by persistence, there by share; the reading of one as the other is argued, not a law

open.en: The meta-attractor as a selection by share coming to select for control of its rule: RuleShaping's counts are not joined here.
That a reader whose loss returns to the selectors is kept in general: one world, where the selecting line's own persistence turns.
A reading in time for a pool read off the course: reading-a-loss-in-time states it for a group fixed across the two courses.

beyond.en: In the witness where the dweller's line renews the source, the course removing it removes the selecting line too, and selection by persistence read off the course's pool still passes it: what turns there is the line's own persistence, not the selection read off its survivors (Habitat.clearedBack_removes_both, Habitat.clearedBack_survivors_pass).

how.en: fixes the pool to the reader r alone and the selection to whether r stands at t, its being read off r's couplings discharged in place by r's own standing coupled into it (obs r r); act_courses_unselected_throughout is under unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure

name.en: Reading in time: a selection read off continuation reads a loss before its point of no return, or too late

mechanism.en: World. A selection read off a group's continuations up to a step, the group fixed across two courses, can first tell them apart at their first step apart, the first step at which some member is admitted under one and not the other; a given family of such selections reads no earlier, and may never. By that step the arriving gap has crossed a member's margin: where one course admits a member, the other does wherever the gap on every condition it requires stays within its level less its need. And, under timely response's deadline premises, it is not that the closure in time of the source misses every member by then. With the same formations present before a step and a source that goes on from step to step, what a potential route of exchanges has carried by then is exactly what the closure in time of a source occurrence meets, read through either course: the condition in time's relation and timely response's route are one. A course is recoverable at a step where some feasible course agreeing with it so far keeps what is asked (feasible and kept supplied); its point of no return is the first step at which it is not. A loss is readable in time exactly where the first step apart comes before that point. Where what is kept includes every member's admission at every step and the other course admits every member throughout, a group reading the continuation of what is lost reads it only once it has happened. Which way a reading in time turns the course is not stated. The timing laws are near-definitional and compositions, the identification of the two routes a short substantive induction; the witness is computed.

text.en: No axiom. One web's requirements and needs read on two level histories; a group of formations fixed across them.
text.zh: 不加公理。一网之所需与需量于两水平史上读；一组构成于二者间固定。

text.en: For the route's bound, timely response's deadline premises up to the step: balance before it in both courses, the same formations present, a common start, and every formation other than the source exchanging alike wherever it is alike through its couplings by the responders' coupling.
text.zh: 路之界需及时回应至该步之期限前提：二过程于其前皆平衡、所在之构成相同、起点相同，且源以外每个构成于经应者之耦合无别处交换相同。

text.en: For the margin's exact form, the loss lowering each condition the member requires at the step.
text.zh: 余裕之确切形式需失降低该成员于该步所需之每一条件。

text.en: No axiom. The courses compared, the feasible courses and what is kept are supplied; the feasible courses are read as those the part can still take.
text.zh: 不加公理。所比之过程、可行之过程与所保有者皆为所给；可行之过程读作部分仍可取之过程。

text.en: For the route's form, timely response's deadline premises up to the step; for the margin's form, the members admitted by the other course.
text.zh: 路之形式需及时回应至该步之期限前提；余裕之形式需另一过程容诸成员。

text.en: In the witness: four flows written out, each balanced, the formations exchanging by what their levels then stand at; the clearer's stopping courses as the feasible ones.
text.zh: 见证中：写出之四流，各自平衡，诸构成按其水平当时所在而交换；清除者之停止诸过程为可行者。

text.en: No axiom. Two flows read on one web's requirements, with a coupling by level supplied; the same formations present in both before the step; for the converse, a source that goes on from step to step.
text.zh: 不加公理。二流于一网之所需上读，经水平之耦合为所给；二者于该步前所在之构成相同；反向需源逐步延续。

to.en: too late: the courses are not readable in time, and no family of selections read off the group's continuations reads them in time

edge.en: Where every member is admitted alike under the two courses up to a step at which the losing course is past return, the loss is not readable in time, for the earliest reading and every family read off the group's continuations. Two ways it comes: under the deadline premises the route from the source meets no member by then (Web.too_late_of_unreached), or the other course admits every member and the gaps stay within their margins until then (Web.too_late_within_margin)

to.en: read only once it has happened: where what is kept includes every member's admission at every step and the other course admits every member throughout, the courses are not readable in time by the group's continuations, and no family read off them reads them in time

edge.en: Where what is kept includes every member's admission at every step and the other course admits every member throughout, the courses are not readable in time: coupling in the one who bears the loss, the way the blindness beyond the coupling closure lifts, shows the loss only once it has happened

In FourReaders, once the clearer stops the habitat is a regime under the dweller's draw, its point exact at 2, and the cleared course is recoverable exactly while its level stands at that point or above: the point of no return is the regime's point, step 3, while the dweller ends at step 4 (FourReaders.noReturn). A gauge needing the habitat at 3 reads in time; one needing it at 2, and a listener two relays away, read at the point, too late

In MA2's and MA4b's models the step at which the others read the loss is a supplied bound; read here, it is the first step apart of a selection read off the others' continuations, and MA4b's deadline bounds what is here the point of no return. Their models are pools of readers drawn from those they select, not flows, so no law joins them

condition.en: Given the first step apart T and the point of no return N, the loss is readable in time exactly where T < N.

from.en: readable in time: the first step apart T comes before the point of no return N (T < N)

to.en: too late: the first step apart is at or after the point of no return (N ≤ T), the losing course past return when the first selection read off the continuations can read

open.en: A group or pool that changes with the course: the group is fixed across the comparison.
That the feasible courses are those a law of exchange generates: they are supplied.
That a reading in time keeps what is lost: which way it turns the course is not stated.
That the first step apart comes when the route arrives: what arrives can stay within the members' margins.

beyond.en: In FourReaders the dweller still stands at the point of no return and ends a step later; a reader of its own continuation is first apart only then, after the loss has happened (FourReaders.dweller_late, a witness).

how.en: fixes the coupling to threshold only (read off the continuations) and the step to the first step apart, separates_all's hypothesis (not alike through every member's couplings up to T) discharged by a member admitted differently at T; separates_all is a law of selection-through-couplings, a record of unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure (the atlas's declaration list omits it)

from.role: the first step apart of a selection read off the others' continuations, and the point of no return

map.en: the supplied step N from which the others read the loss in MA2's and MA4b's models is read as the first step apart of a selection read off the others' continuations, and MA4b's deadline as a bound on the point of no return

exits_kept.en: this dynamic's too-late exits (too_late_of_alike, too_late_of_own) would bound when the others can read; loss-read-in-time-by-the-others' own exits are kept as its laws state them

name.en: The capture of a target

mechanism.en: Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and other parents at most b < a, both kinds present, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others, read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step.

text.zh: 份额定理只设后代计数的界；后代带着亲代的目标（传递）是读作份额所需的前提，如 Becoming.Evolution 中的 TransmitsWithin。
text.en: The share theorems assume only bounds on offspring numbers; that offspring carry their parents' target (transmission) is the premise needed to read them as shares, as with TransmitsWithin in Becoming.Evolution.

text.zh: 世系的定理设所立者每步被列出，这是写在定理中的局部条件；perturbation_reabsorbed 设下一配置不取决于状态。
text.en: The descent theorems assume what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into them; perturbation_reabsorbed assumes the next configuration does not depend on the state.

text.zh: 离散的步；自然数的量。
text.en: Discrete steps; natural-number amounts.

open.en: Re-absorption is shown only where the next configuration does not depend on the state, a strong condition; where winners rewrite the rule, making it depend on the state, the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held.
It derives neither that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry their parents' target, nor that winners shape the rule.

name.en: Capture through the rule

mechanism.en: On a two-level course, let selection not lower a target's share under a rule favouring it (Raises) and the rule read at each reading step be a monotone function of the share (ReadsShare); with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. Locked, neither share nor rule falls, and a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share every course locks from its second reading step, so only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. That actual rules read the share is the premise; the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.

text.en: No axiom. Each statement names its hypotheses: the fast step does not lower the share under a favouring rule (Raises); the rule read is a monotone function of the share alone (ReadsShare); favouring is kept upward; and, as the statement needs, the start locked (Locked), the start's rule and every rule read favouring, or the reading favouring at every share. The order statements add selection monotone in the share and the rule. On counts, offspring numbers per carrier and per other, others present.
text.zh: 无公理。每条陈述列出其假设：快步在偏向的规则下不降低份额（Raises）；读出的规则只是份额的单调函数（ReadsShare）；偏向向上保持；以及按陈述所需，起点锁定（Locked）、起点规则与每个读出的规则都偏向，或读法在每个份额都偏向。次序陈述另加选择对份额与规则单调。在计数上，每个承载者与其他每个的后代数，其他者在场。

text.en: No axiom; the premises of favouring_locks for the pair: selection under both favouring does not lower the share, each rule read monotonically from the share and favouring at every share.
text.zh: 不加公理；favouring_locks 对一对规则之前提：两者皆偏向时选择不降份额，各由份额单调读出且在每一份额偏向。

to.en: from the locked configuration carriers two to one under hi (each carrier four offspring to each other's one), the rule reversed to lo and held one step before the threshold reading reads: the course is locked the other way from step 1, neither share nor rule rises at any later step, and the rule after the first reading step is below hi

edge.en: A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: from the step after it neither share nor rule rises, and the rule after the first reading step is below the one before (a witness, under a threshold reading).

condition.en: Where the reading favours at every share, every course, whatever its start, is locked from the step after its second reading step; the bound is exact (from one to one under lo, the course is not locked at the step after its first reading step).

from.en: a course from any start, share and rule perturbed or the rule against the reading included, under a reading favouring at every share: not necessarily locked at the step after its first reading step

to.en: locked from the step after its second reading step

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: this is the premise ReadsShare, where "the winner shapes the rule" of Becoming.Capture enters.
Real-valued shares and rates, rules that read more than the share, many levels, or noisy readings.
Left by drift, as a reading not stated as instances: a favouring rule read from the share that leaves the disfavoured kind a positive weight at every mixed count.

name.en: Closed capture (meta-attractor, in the glossary's sense)

mechanism.en: A loop of selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects. Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond the share (Unread), courses alike in share and rule stay alike, exactly then along every schedule; where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked and neither share nor rule falls below the start. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

text.en: No axiom. Each statement names its hypotheses: Unread (neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond); Accrues (each step adds at least one beyond); RuleCapture's Raises, ReadsShare and favouring kept upward; a locked start; for the readings, the reading formed monotonically from the share (ReadsShare on mind) and the rule read monotonically from the reading and the share.
text.zh: 不加公理。各陈述列出其假设：Unread（下一份额与读出的规则都不读份额之外者）；Accrues（每步在份额之外至少加一）；RuleCapture 的 Raises、ReadsShare 与向上保持的偏向；锁定的起点；对读法，读法由份额单调形成（mind 上的 ReadsShare），规则由读法与份额单调读出。

text.en: For the lock line, the premises of lock_outlives_loss (selection not lowering the share under a favouring rule, the rule read monotonically from the share, favouring kept upward, every step adding to the loss); for the line under favouring, those of turned_by_loss (any reading favouring at no loss past a bound, a reading step past it, a favouring start); discrete steps and natural-number losses.
text.zh: 锁之续设 lock_outlives_loss 之前提（偏向之则下选择不降份额，则之读随份额单调，偏向向上保持，每步增损）；偏向之续设 turned_by_loss 之前提（读于过界之损皆不偏向，有读之步过界，始而偏向）；离散之步，损为自然数。

forbids.en: such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone; such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case; a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading; a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

to.en: at the step after every reading step r with N ≤ b + r, the rule in force does not favour, so the course is not locked there, whatever the share

edge.en: Read what lies beyond the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed.

to.en: along the joined two-level step, from a start whose rule favours, the line under the class of favouring or not is not unending: past the reading step the rule no longer favours

edge.en: Read in the grammar: along a two-level step whose reading favours at no loss past a bound, with a reading step past the bound, the line under favouring or not from a favouring start is not unending.

condition.en: Where the rule read favours at every reading and every share, every course is locked from the step after its second reading step, whatever rule and reading it starts with.

from.en: a course from any start, whatever rule and reading, the rule read favouring at every reading and every share

to.en: locked from the step after its second reading step

open.en: That any actual rule, or how it is read, is formed from the share it selects: this is the premise ReadsShare, on the rule and on mind.
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58).
Real-valued shares, noisy or partial readings, readings that read both the share and part of what lies beyond, and the calibration of any of this to the present world.
Selection of selection as a law relating two grains: here the two levels are one law on one joint carrier, read at one grain.
A reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.
Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

beyond.en: Where every step adds at least one to what lies beyond (Accrues), from a locked configuration the loss at step t is at least t above where it started, so it passes every bound, while the course stays locked. That what lies beyond the share is a loss to any formation is a significance's to say; here it is a count the loop does not read.

name.en: Readers drawn from the selected

mechanism.en: Read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings, each carrier among the readers reading it as u and each other as v, the readers counted as the population counts them; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where v is not above u. Against a mirrored reading the counts decide; where only the others read the loss, once it reaches a bound, with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', the lock is kept for good, the rule in force favouring the carriers, exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read, and turned for good, the rule in force favouring the others, exactly where the others are at least as many. The premise is moved to who reads, not removed: that actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown.

text.en: No axiom. Each statement names its hypotheses: the pool form (two kinds of reader, each reading alike, summed unnormalized, counted as the population counts them); the others' reading not above the carriers' (readers); for the loss, Accrues and a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound; for the counts, the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers' and the carriers' reading favouring strictly.
text.zh: 不加公理。各陈述列出其假设：汇合之形（两类读者，每类读法相同，未归一求和，如人口那样计数）；其他者之读法不高于携带者之读法（readers）；对损失，Accrues，以及损失已达其界的读取步；对计数，其他者迟来的读法为携带者读法之镜像，且携带者之读法严格偏向。

forbids.en: a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

to.en: where the carriers are fewer than the others at the reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers, the course is not locked for good under the late pool from the next step on

edge.en: The loss read by the others: with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read; read from the start, the same readers reading the same loss lock the course the other way (witness).

condition.en: Against a mirrored reading, the carriers' reading favouring them strictly, the pool favours the carriers exactly where they are at least as many as the others, and the others exactly where they are at least as many as the carriers.

from.en: the pool favours the carriers: they are at least as many as the others

to.en: the pool favours the others: they are at least as many as the carriers

condition.en: With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', at a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers, the course is locked for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others there; the rule in force favouring the others, it is locked the other way for good exactly where the others are at least as many.

from.en: at the reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers and the carriers at least as many as the others: locked for good under the late pool

to.en: there the rule in force favouring the others and the others at least as many as the carriers: locked the other way for good

open.en: That any actual rule is the pool of readers drawn from those it selects, or that each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind: within the pool ReadsShare is equivalent to that comparison, so the premise is moved to who reads, not removed.

Readers of one kind reading differently, weights other than counts, readings formed by argument; the pool sums readings unnormalized, so a reading's size weighs with its count (mirrored readings have equal sizes).
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58, D67). Nor the calibration of any of this to the present world.

beyond.en: Read late, both favouring the carriers, the lock holds while the loss grows and every other reader reads it.

name.en: The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it

mechanism.en: Where a selection's carriers shape the rule that selects them, the rule favours them (weakly) at a step exactly where what comes back to them alone covers its cost, whatever comes to every member alike; across a stretch the counts of steps before and with what comes back decide, and the shared part, being part of the base, can turn the verdict. Listed in groups of m whose shapers give the group's shared part, the condition is Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ the share of the spread among groups, exactly where c < s + m q ρ. Where the rule is read monotonically from the share and covers the cost, the loop locks; that offspring carry their parent's capacity, and that what comes back is read from the share, are premises, and the courses are without noise.

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: discrete steps, natural counts and others present (RuleCapture's counts); a positive; two kinds, shapers and others, offspring carrying their parent's kind (transmission, a premise as in Becoming.Capture); for the loop, what comes back read at reading steps as a function of the share; for the tipping point, the threshold where the shapers are at least as many as the others.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：离散之步、自然数计数、他者恒在（RuleCapture 之计数）；a 为正；二类，塑造者与他者，后代携其亲之类（传递，如 Becoming.Capture 之前提）；于回路，所返于读之步为份额之函数；于转折点，门槛在塑造者不少于他者处。

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: discrete steps and natural counts; a positive; groups listed as given, of equal size m for the spread among groups and of any sizes, with a positive common multiple n of the sizes, for the covariance form; each member shaping (one) or not (none); in each group the rule after shaping with the shared part q times the group's shapers, the cost counted as extra offspring to the others; the whole read as the whole's spread with the step law's exact transmission.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：离散之步与自然数计数；a 为正；群如所列而给，经群间离散者等大 m，经协方差之形者大小任意，取诸大小之一正公倍数 n；每成员塑（一）或不塑（无）；每群中塑规后之规则，其同得为 q 乘群之塑造者数，成本计为他者多留之后代；整体以整体之离散读之，步律需传递精确。

to.en: the shapers' share falls strictly at every step of the run, nothing coming back to them alone, the cost positive and shapers present at the start

edge.en: Shaping that brings nothing back to the shapers alone: with a positive cost and the shapers present, their share falls at every step; where something does come back, the shared part can turn a stretch, and cheaper shaping raises the selection for control.

condition.en: At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c ≤ s and disfavours them (weakly) exactly where s ≤ c, whatever p comes to every member alike.

from.en: c ≤ s: the rule after shaping favours the shapers, weakly

to.en: s ≤ c: it favours the others, weakly

condition.en: Across m steps before anything comes back and n steps with it, the shapers present, their share does not fall exactly where (a + c + p)^m (a + c + p)^n ≤ (a + p)^m (a + s + p)^n, and rises strictly exactly where the inequality is strict.

from.en: (a + c + p)^m (a + c + p)^n ≤ (a + p)^m (a + s + p)^n: the shapers' share does not fall across the stretch, and rises strictly where the inequality is strict

to.en: the reverse strict inequality: the share falls across the stretch

condition.en: At a threshold, what comes back hi where the shapers are at least as many as the others and lo where they are fewer, with lo < c < hi, from above the share rises strictly at every step and from below it falls strictly at every step, the shapers present; under every schedule of reading.

from.en: the shapers fewer than the others, lo < c, from a start under the rule read there (what comes back lo), shapers present: their share falls strictly at every step

to.en: the shapers at least as many as the others, c < hi, from a start under the rule read there (what comes back hi), shapers present: their share rises strictly at every step

condition.en: The whole selects for shaping exactly where c times the spread of shaping falls short of s times it with m q times the spread among groups: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ, exactly where c < s + m q ρ.

from.en: c times the spread of shaping at least s times it with m q times the spread among groups: the whole does not select for shaping

to.en: c times the spread falls short: the whole selects for shaping (read over the rationals, c < s + m q ρ)

condition.en: In groups of any sizes, each member gaining q for each shaper in its group, the whole selects for shaping exactly where, read over the rationals, c times the variance of shaping falls short of s times it with q times the covariance, member by member, of a member's group's shapers with its group's share of them (in counts, with a positive common multiple of the sizes).

from.en: in groups of any sizes, c times the variance of shaping at least s times it with q times the covariance of a member's group's shapers with its group's share of them: the whole does not select for shaping

to.en: it falls short: the whole selects for shaping

open.en: That actual practices, institutions or trained systems carry a capacity to shape their rule from parent to offspring, or that what comes back to them is read from their share: these are premises, and their calibration to the present world is not established.
Graded capacities, returns growing with the domains captured or passing between them, real-valued shares.
How groups form, and assortment changing over generations or with the share: they enter as given at the step.
Graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains.

name.en: The critical mass: what comes back to the shapers, read by readers drawn from the selected

mechanism.en: Read the rule after shaping as the pool of its readers, drawn from those it selects, each shaper among them reading hi coming back to the shapers alone and each other member lo; the rule read reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and then a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi. From a start under the rule read there, with shapers present, under every schedule of reading, above that critical mass the capacity to shape the rule rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it the capacity falls at every step and the course is locked the other way, without noise; that the readers are so drawn and read with lo ≤ hi, and that offspring carry the capacity, are premises. Drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the critical mass.

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: discrete steps, natural counts and others present (RuleCapture's counts); a positive; two kinds, shapers and others, offspring carrying their parent's kind (transmission, a premise as in Becoming.Capture); the rule read as the pool of two readings, the readers counted as the population counts them (ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool); both kinds of reader reading the same a, p and c and differing only in what comes back to the shapers alone; hi, lo, p and c constants; for the loop, lo ≤ hi and a start under the rule read there; no noise.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：离散之步、自然数计数、他者恒在（RuleCapture 之计数）；a 为正；二类，塑造者与他者，后代携其亲之类（传递，如 Becoming.Capture 之前提）；所读之规则为二读之池，读者依群体计数（ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool）；二类读者所读之 a、p、c 相同，唯独返于塑造者者有别；hi、lo、p、c 为常数；于回路，lo ≤ hi 且起点在彼处所读之规则下；无噪声。

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: DrawnShaping's model (readers counted as the population counts them, a positive, hi, lo, p and c constants, lo ≤ hi for the chain); offspring drawn one member at a time among M + 1, each member counted among its own readers; a step leaving the count weighed only to make every step weigh alike.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：DrawnShaping 之模型（读者如众之计数而计，a 为正，hi、lo、p、c 为常数，链需 lo ≤ hi）；M + 1 成员中逐一而抽后代，每成员计入其自身之读者；不改计数之步加权仅为使每步同权。

forbids.en: such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case

to.en: from a start the rule read there favours, the others reading the loss from step N, steps N and N + 1 reading: locked the other way under the late reading at every step from N + 2, exactly where the late reading favours the others (ties included) at the share of step N + 1

edge.en: Read the loss in time: with lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, the loss growing by one a step, from a start favouring the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, at most one step lies between, and a deadline bounds the window.

to.en: drawn one member at a time, from every count i ≤ M the histories losing every shaper weigh at least ((M + 1)(a + c + p))^i times every later history, above the critical mass too; from shapers present within reach of the top, those fixing them weigh at least a^k, below it too: either lock is left with positive weight

edge.en: Drift: drawn one member at a time, from every mixed count the histories losing every shaper weigh at least down^i times every later history, above the critical mass too, and those fixing them at least a^k within reach of the top, below it too; no new reader and no change in what is read.

condition.en: With lo ≤ hi, the rule read favours the shapers at some share and the others strictly at another exactly where lo < c < hi; with lo ≤ c ≤ hi, it favours the shapers exactly where x.other · (c − lo) ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).

from.en: with lo ≤ c ≤ hi, x.other · (c − lo) ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c): the rule read favours the shapers, and from a start under it the course is locked in their favour

to.en: the reverse strict inequality: the rule read favours the others strictly, and the course is locked the other way

condition.en: With no hypothesis on the readers, the rule read favours the shapers at every share exactly where c ≤ lo and c ≤ hi, and the others strictly at every share exactly where lo < c and hi ≤ c.

from.en: c ≤ lo and c ≤ hi: the rule read favours the shapers at every share

to.en: lo < c and hi ≤ c: it favours the others strictly at every share

condition.en: Where the rule read at s favours the shapers, from s + n with t to the top, losing every shaper weighs, times the shapers' weights over s + 1 … s + n, at most t times down^n times the whole weight; below the mass, fixing them from j + 1 is bounded the other way.

from.en: drawn one member at a time, at counts above the critical mass, where the rule read at count s favours the shapers

to.en: every shaper lost, the histories' weight, times the shapers' weights over s + 1 … s + n, at most t · down^n times the whole weight

condition.en: At an even population the rule read favours the shapers strictly exactly where 2c < hi + lo, risk dominance in counts; which state one member arising fixes more often is a product of weights that can part from it.

from.en: 2c < hi + lo: at an even population the rule read favours the shapers strictly (risk dominance in counts)

to.en: hi + lo ≤ 2c: it does not favour them strictly there

open.en: That control over the selection left unselected and a lock left in time are independent conditions: in this model, whose rule is read from the share alone, every course from the rule read at its start is locked one way or the other (drawn_locked_either), so control not selected does not by itself give a lock left in time, and the converse cannot be shown here; leaving needs a reading beyond the share (ClosedCapture.Thinned), joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others (MA4b).

Readers who learn (hi and lo changing with the share), a cost changing with the share, readers not counted as the population counts them, starts not under the rule read there (a rule in force against the reading can carry the share across the mass, RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed), a loss read by part of the readers once the shapers pass the mass (ClosedCapture.Thinned, joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others, MA4b), and the mixed point where lo > hi and hi < c ≤ lo.

The long-run state under rare mutation, the one with the larger fixation weight (Fudenberg and Imhof 2006), which is cited; mutation and a time to leave a lock beyond the geometric bound are not stated.
That risk dominance decides which state one member arising fixes more often: the two can part under strong selection.

name.en: The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass

mechanism.en: Let a loss start at zero and grow by one a step, and let the others among the readers drawn from the selected read it once it reaches a bound, from then on reading lo' for lo, with lo' ≤ hi, while the shapers keep reading hi. From a start under the rule read there that favours the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading still favours the others, ties included, at the share a step on; once that reading would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, and at most one step lies between, from which a new round can go either way. Whether a reading is in time is decided by the share at the step read and the next; the loss only sets the step from which it is read.

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: discrete steps, natural counts and others present (RuleCapture's counts); a positive; two kinds, shapers and others, offspring carrying their parent's kind (transmission, a premise as in Becoming.Capture); the rule read as the pool of two readings, the readers counted as the population counts them (ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool); no noise.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：离散之步、自然数计数、他者恒在（RuleCapture 之计数）；a 为正；二类，塑造者与他者，后代携其亲之类（传递，如 Becoming.Capture 之前提）；所读之规则为二读之池，读者依群体计数（ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool）；无噪声。

text.en: The others reading the loss once it reaches N, the loss growing by at least one a step (by one a step from zero in MA4's course); all three readings with the same a, p and c, differing only in what is read as coming back to the shapers; hi, lo, lo', p, c and N constants; a fixed schedule of reading steps, the window's laws reading at N and N + 1.
text.zh: 他者于损失及 N 后读之，损失每步至少增一（于 MA4 之进程中自零起每步增一）；三读皆同 a、p、c，唯所读为返于塑造者者有别；hi、lo、lo'、p、c、N 为常数；读步之安排固定，窗口之律于 N 与 N + 1 皆读。

to.en: at a reading step r at which the loss has reached its bound and the late reading favours the others there (ties included), r + 1 reading too: locked the other way under the late reading (lo′ in place of lo) at every step from r + 2, exactly where the late reading favours the others (ties included) at the share at r + 1

edge.en: Where every step adds at least one to the loss and lo' ≤ hi, at a reading step at which the loss has reached N and the late reading favours the others at the share there (ties included), the next step reading too, the course is locked the other way for good from two steps after the reading exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share of the next step; it can do so where control is selected (Window.in_time, a witness).

condition.en: From a start the rule read there favours, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, read from a reading step N, the course is locked for good from N + 1 exactly where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N, and, step N + 1 reading too, the other way from N + 2 exactly where it favours the others (ties included) at the share of step N + 1; at most one step has the late reading favouring the others strictly at its share and the shapers strictly at the next.

from.en: the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N: locked in their favour for good from N + 1

to.en: it favours the others, ties included, at the share of step N + 1, that step reading too: locked the other way for good from N + 2

condition.en: From a start with a shaper present whose rule g read there favours the shapers strictly, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, so that c < hi, the others reading the loss from any reading step N with g.other · c · x.other ≤ N leave the course locked in the shapers' favour at every step from N + 1, under every schedule of reading steps.

to.en: from a start with a shaper present whose rule read there, g, favours the shapers strictly, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, the others reading the loss from any reading step N with g.other · c · x.other ≤ N: locked in the shapers' favour at every step from N + 1, under every schedule

condition.en: Where the late reading with nothing read as coming back (lo' = 0) favours the shapers, every late reading of this form does; with c ≤ hi that is exactly where x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).

from.en: with c ≤ hi, x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c): the least late reading (lo' = 0) favours the shapers, so every late reading of this form does, and read from a later step each keeps the lock

to.en: x.carrier · (hi − c) < x.other · c: the least late reading does not favour the shapers

open.en: A late reading of another form: with its own weight it has another window, and with a weight against the shapers chosen after the share is seen, far enough below theirs, the others could turn the course from any share.

The step from which the window is closed: the deadline is a bound, quadratic in the start's counts (24 in the witness and 96 from two to two, both closed from step 4); none is stated for a weakly favouring start or one with no shaper.

Courses with noise, readers who learn, readings changing with the share, a loss read before it reaches N, and a general law for the round from the one step between, which goes either way in the witnesses.

That leaving control unselected and leaving a lock in time are independent: control left unselected with a lock left in time is not shown, since with two kinds leaving the lock below the critical mass means a rule favouring the shapers.
That a trained judge reads as such a pool: the one frozen test of the timing law on one (LA2, experiments/self-rewarding-lock) found one note in nine turned it, so the law did not apply there.

name.en: A chooser's rule read from the count of its choices

mechanism.en: On RuleCapture's counts let a chooser over two policies take the first where its rule weighs it at least as much as the second, that policy's count rising by one, the rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score. Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy. Joined to a coordinate the loop does not read and that rises at every step, the locked course outlives every bound on it.

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for the selection laws, a reading of each step's values that reads exactly the formation's admission and the conditions coupled into it (ValuesThrough), and for the blindness laws the hypotheses of Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling and Flow.unselected_beyond_pool; for the count laws, discrete steps, natural counts with the second positive (RuleCapture's CarrierCounts), a choice taking the policy its rule weighs more with ties to the first, a standing score entering as two whole-number weights with the second positive, and the rule in force read from the counts at the start.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：于选择之律，每步之值恰读该构成之准入与耦合于其者（ValuesThrough），于盲之律，Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling 与 Flow.unselected_beyond_pool 之假设；于计数之律，离散之步、第二数为正之自然数计数（RuleCapture 之 CarrierCounts）、择其规则予权更多之策且等则第一、常立之评分以两个整数权入之且第二为正，以及起时所行之规则读自计数。

to.en: counts three to two under the score one to two, the rule in force read from them: along every schedule the rule favours the second policy strictly at every step

edge.en: A moved count: three choices to one keep the first policy against a score weighing the second twice as much; one count moved, three to two, locks the other way (witness).

to.en: counts three to one under a new score one to four, read at once: along every schedule the rule favours the second policy strictly at every step; read one step late, the old rule in force, the course is locked for the first policy from step 2

edge.en: A change of score: to one to four, read at once, it locks the other way, while read one step late, the old rule still in force, it leaves the first policy locked (witness).

condition.en: Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves: at or above it the chooser takes the first policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule falls; below it the chooser takes the second policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule rises. Ties go to the first policy.

from.en: κo · other ≤ κc · carrier: the chooser takes the first policy at every step, the course locked, neither share nor rule falling

to.en: κc · carrier < κo · other: it takes the second policy at every step, neither share nor rule rising

open.en: That actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018).
More than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, additive counting's timescale, and that a crossing under posterior counting comes within any horizon.

For a rule read from the count of its choices: more than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, the split among policies that explain a trial equally, a law with a bound for additive counting, and a frozen test of whether a count of choices reverses under a standing score (§9).

beyond.en: Joined to a coordinate that neither the counts nor the score reads, rising by at least one at every step, from counts at or above the threshold with the rule in force read from them the coordinate stands at least b + t at step t while the course stays locked and neither the share nor the rule is below its start; under the hypotheses of the blindness law (World), a part acting only beyond the coupling closure does not change the choice.

name.en: Self-reproducing selection across carriers (the corpus's meta-attractor)

mechanism.en: The corpus's meta-attractor is wider than 元吸引子: an organization whose consequences take part in rebuilding the conditions that select it, continuing across changes of its carriers. Continuation across carriers is the map's 传; the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers.

open.en: Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

name.en: Capture reaching the routes of 明 (the second order)

mechanism.en: A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves.

name.en: Rewarding those who break the routes of correction (the third order)

mechanism.en: A third order, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in, enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows.

beyond.en: enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows

name.en: A habit read as capture by counted choices

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: active inference counts the policy it selects into its prior over policies, its count close to the count of the executed policy, split among policies that explain the trial equally (Friston and others 2016). Its simulation of devaluation shows the persistence: devalued after the habit has formed, the habit persists and strengthens with use, while devalued earlier the agent switches at once. The lock is read as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), and counting the action taken as the value-free habit. What the law (capture-by-counted-choices) adds is exactness for a simplified model, the counts themselves as the prior with no free-energy term, sampling or split, and its edges. It is capture through the rule, closed in the sense of the unread loss; its score stands, so it is not the meta-attractor. In rats, extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation; five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018). As a containment of the free-energy principle it is a restatement (08).

to.en: counts three to two under the score one to two, the rule in force read from them: along every schedule the rule favours the second policy strictly at every step

edge.en: A moved count carries the course across (a witness on the law beneath the reading).

to.en: counts three to one under a new score one to four, read at once: along every schedule the rule favours the second policy strictly at every step; read one step late, the old rule in force, the course is locked for the first policy from step 2

edge.en: A change of score, read at once, locks the other way; read one step late, the old rule still in force, it leaves the first policy locked (a witness on the law beneath the reading).

open.en: Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (cited, not stated); which locks noise leaves is a reading over the proved cases.

Active inference's own scheme: it counts the end-of-trial posterior over policies, close to the executed policy where outcomes reveal it and split among policies that explain the trial equally; its prior is the counts' expected log, not the counts; it has a free-energy term, sampling and inferred precision. The threshold is the model's, not SPM's.

That actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018).
That capture by counted choices is a loss or a gain: no evaluation enters, and a result that ranks courses states the order its theorem takes.

name.en: A counter-rule read from the share it selects

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]. Take a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where selection does not lower its carriers' share under a favouring rule. Where every rule it reads favours its carriers, it locks from any start by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did, and only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. Where its reading favours only above a threshold, a locked start stays locked where favouring is kept upward, and a change carrying the share across the threshold leaves. From a start against its reading it may never lock (a witness). The imperial examination is read as this case in the meta-attractor line: designed to dilute hereditary capture, "it later became a proxy trap of its own". It rests on the capture theorems, not on the law of shaping. That any actual counter-rule reads its share so is the reading's premise.

to.en: from the locked configuration carriers two to one under hi, the rule reversed to lo and held one step before the threshold reading reads: the course is locked the other way from step 1, neither share nor rule rises at any later step, and the rule after the first reading step is below hi

edge.en: Where its reading favours only above a threshold, a change carrying the share across the threshold leaves (a witness, under a threshold reading).

to.en: at the step after every reading step r with N ≤ b + r, the rule in force does not favour, so the course is not locked there, whatever the share

edge.en: Only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long: where each step adds at least one beyond, a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it. A sufficient way out, not shown necessary.

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: the premise ReadsShare of the law beneath this reading.

name.en: A code formed between formations

mechanism.en: Any type; for runs of hearings, equality of formations and of senses decided. A group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it; agreement of all is a rest under every rule. Under hearings that take the form heard, each formation holds the start's form of its origin. From a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree at a sense where the renaming moves every form. Imposing one code makes all agree in a step, keeps every exchange of formations and keeps no renaming that moves a form it gives; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source losing none, and under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step. A resolution written back into the records later cohorts read, records written to offer exactly what was resolved, rests from the next cohort on. Which orders actual exchange takes, and whether actual conventions form this way, are not shown.

text.en: No axiom. The codes, the hearings and the rule of adoption are given; every other premise is named where it is used: hearings closed for a group; hearings that take the form heard; two forms that differ; a list of every formation; a rule reading codes alike after a renaming; a law keeping an exchange and a renaming; a renaming moving every form at the sense; records written to offer exactly what was resolved; decided equality of formations and senses where an order is stepped back through.
text.zh: 不加公理。编码、听取与采纳规则是给定的；其余每个前提都在用到之处具名：对一组封闭的听取；取所听之形的听取；两个不同的形；列出每个形成的列表；在改名后同样读编码的规则；保持一个交换与一个改名的律；在该义上移动每个形的改名；写下恰提供所判定者的记录；在回溯次序之处形成与义的相等可判定。

text.en: No axiom; any type of formations, senses and forms.
text.zh: 不加公理；任意之形成、义与形之类型。

text.en: No axiom; codes as maps from senses to forms, decidable equality of formations and senses where coining is stated.
text.zh: 不加公理；码为义到形之映射，述造形处形成与义之相等可判定。

to.en: every formation gives the sense one form, from every start, after the order of hearings, exactly where the order gives all formations one origin at the sense; agreement of all is then a rest under every rule

edge.en: Out of disagreement: where two forms differ, an order of hearings that take the form heard brings every start to agreement at a sense exactly where it gives all formations one origin at that sense. Being joined through couplings is not enough (Path.never_agree, a witness).

to.en: the group no longer agrees at the sense after the step: a member hearing it took, under the rule, the speaker's form, which differs from its own

edge.en: For a group agreeing at a sense with a member other than the step's hearer, the members agree after the step exactly where, if the hearer is a member hearing that sense and the rule takes the form, the speaker's form is the hearer's.

to.en: leaving needs a formation holding a form other than the imposed one at the sense (or a coined form); without one, every formation holds the imposed form at the sense at every later step, under every rule

edge.en: Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

to.en: the formation hearing tells m from m' at the next step: it holds at m the outside form and at m' the imposed one, though the imposed code merges them

edge.en: A merged distinction returns from a form held outside: where a formation holds the imposed form at one sense and hears, at another the code merges with it, a formation whose form there is not the imposed one, it then tells the two apart.

to.en: every formation tells m and m' apart again: each holds at m the coined form, which the imposed code does not give m'

edge.en: Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.

to.en: in a witness of two formations from a symmetric disagreement, each of three laws brings the two to agree in one step: a centre both take and one hearing in order break the exchange symmetry and keep the renaming one, a preferred form breaks the renaming symmetry and keeps the exchange one

edge.en: From a symmetric disagreement, in a witness of two formations, a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement.

open.en: Which orders actual exchange takes, with probabilities over orders, and how long agreement takes: the voter model's and the naming game's expectations are not stated.
That actual conventions, scripts or the theory's own terms form by hearing in this way, or whether a shared, imposed or kept code keeps or closes 生生, the continuation of life.
That a code is in fact imposed, or that imposing is better than another way to agree.
That names in use are coined deliberately, or that a coined form is heard.

name.en: A code held as counts, learned from what is heard

mechanism.en: Any type of agents, meanings and words; counts in any strict order, natural counts for learning and free energy; discrete steps of a determined law, the hearer given the meaning. Under a law keeping the exchange of agents together with a renaming of the words, from a start related to itself, where the renaming at a meaning is onto and moves every word (or moves every word with the exchange an involution), two exchanged agents never hold one word as each one's uniquely greatest, and where they hold the same counts there those counts have none. Learning from what is heard keeps the relation where the speaker map commutes with the exchange and the rule reads count by count and commutes with renaming; a weight read off the hearer's whole model keeps it where the weight is unchanged by the renaming. Under weights a renaming moving every word fixes, with a positive total, a belief at the free-energy bound over a listing of every word has no uniquely greatest word. Reading [D45], not a theorem: federated inference's law over the reals is read as keeping the relation, for a renaming the same for every meaning.

text.en: Counts of each word for each meaning in any type with an order, irreflexive and transitive for the precision laws; natural counts for adding what is heard and for free energy, read as counts added to a common positive prior every renaming fixes.
text.zh: 每义每词之计数于任一有序之型，精度之律需序非自反且传递；加所闻与自由能用自然数之计数，读作加于每一改名皆不变之公共正先验之数。

text.en: Discrete synchronous steps of a determined law; a renaming of the words for each meaning, the same at every step; relations of counts stated count by count, the pure core assuming no function extensionality.
text.zh: 确定之律之离散同步之步；每义一改名，每步相同；数之关系逐数而陈，纯核不设函数外延性。

text.en: Learning from what is heard: the hearer given the meaning; the speaker map commuting with the exchange; the rule reading count by count and commuting with renaming; for a weight on what is heard read off the whole model, the weight unchanged by the renaming.
text.zh: 由所闻而学：闻者知其义；说者映射与对换可交换；规则逐数而读且与改名可交换；所闻之权读自全模型者，其权于改名下不变。

text.en: For the headline: a law keeping the relation, a start related to itself, and at the meaning a renaming onto and moving every word, or moving every word with the exchange an involution.
text.zh: 主律：保此关系之律、自相关之始，且于该义改名为满射并移每词，或对换为对合而改名移每词。

forbids.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as a guarantee, that language is an emergent property of free-energy minimization fails for every deterministic scheme keeping the symmetry from a symmetric start: free-energy minimization breaks no symmetry, and something else must, a preferred word, an order or centre telling the agents apart, an asymmetric start or chance. Its simulation starts from random parameters and stands.

to.en: from no counts, one hearing of the first word of greatest count, a tie going to the first word, gives both agents that word as uniquely greatest: a shared uniquely greatest word

edge.en: A preferred word: from no counts, a speaker saying the first word of greatest count, a tie going to the first word, brings both agents to hold that word as uniquely greatest after one hearing; that rule does not commute with renaming (a witness).

to.en: from counts 1, 0 for one agent and 0, 0 for the other, one step of adding the speaker's counts gives both agents 1, 0, the first word uniquely greatest for each

edge.en: An asymmetric start: counts 1, 0 and 0, 0, which the exchange with the renaming does not relate to themselves, give both agents 1, 0 after one step of adding the speaker's counts (a witness).

open.en: That federated inference's own law over the reals, with its normalized predictive, its weighting by expected free energy and its forgetting, keeps the relation: that is a reading.
Speaking by sampling: reinforcement with sampled signals reaches a signalling system (Argiento and others 2009); no invariant law for sampled speech is stated here.
How long agreement takes, which asymmetry actual conventions start from, or whether they form this way.

name.en: A reading against the share does not ratchet

mechanism.en: Where the rule is read against the share (the reading monotone into the reversed order), selection under favouring rules does not lower the share, and the rules along the course favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's: the rise the lock rests on does not form. It does not show that such a course is never locked at a step, or that its share falls.

text.en: No axiom; selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share; the rule read against the share (the reading monotone into the reversed order); rules favouring along the course.
text.zh: 不加公理；偏向之规则下选择不降份额；规则逆份额而读（读法单调入反序）；沿历程规则皆偏向。

open.en: That a course read against the share is never locked at a step, or that its share falls.

name.en: The lock draws its readers out

mechanism.en: A rule read through a pool whose readers of what lies beyond the share are present only where the course leaves them. Where no such reader is present, the rule read is the share-readers', read off the share alone, and a lock read off the share is kept along every stretch whose reading steps read so and whose share does not fall; closed, it stays closed where the selection raises the share and brings no such reader back. Readers of a loss, standing while it is below a bound, are removed by it and not readmitted where it accrues; past the bound the course is the share's own loop, a lock formed there kept for good. On whom the loss falls decides its sign: borne by the others it is a return to the shapers and a closed lock stays closed with no reader of it; borne by the shapers past what the rule in force gives them, the share falls strictly.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps; the two-level course with a fixed schedule of reading steps; the fast configuration the share and what lies beyond it.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步；带固定读步之两层进程；快构形为份额与其外者。

text.en: Where a reader of what lies beyond is present is a supplied predicate on the configuration; that the rule read is the share-readers' where none is, and that none is brought back, are supplied.
text.zh: 读份额之外者何处在，为构形上所给之谓词；无读者在处所读即份额读者之规则、且无读者复召，皆为所给。

text.en: The share-readers' rule is monotone in the share, and favouring is kept upward.
text.zh: 份额读者之规则于份额单调，偏向向上而保。

text.en: For closed staying closed: the selection raises the share under every favouring rule on the whole configuration.
text.zh: 就已闭常闭：选择于整个构形上在每一偏向之规则下皆升份额。

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps; a loss growing by at least one a step; the readers' standing ending at a bound of the loss, supplied.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步；损失每步至少增一；读者之立止于损失之一界，为所给。

text.en: For the laws before and past the bound: the share's selection raising it under a favouring rule, the share-readers' rule monotone in the share, favouring kept upward.
text.zh: 就界前界后之律：份额之选择于偏向之规则下升之，份额读者之规则于份额单调，偏向向上而保。

text.en: For the order law: the readers read from when they stand, their own reading monotone in the share and the loss and never more favourably than the share-readers; selection, the share-readers' reading and the drain monotone.
text.zh: 就序律：读者自立即读，其读于份额与损失单调且从不比份额读者更偏；选择、份额读者之读与所取皆单调。

text.en: In the witness, the drain stepping up where the carriers outnumber the others sixteen to one is chosen.
text.zh: 见证中，携者以十六比一胜他者时所取跃升，为所择。

text.en: No axiom. Natural counts; selection multiplying each kind by what the rule in force gives it, the loss borne added as the capacity to shape the rule writes a cost and a return.
text.zh: 不加公理。自然数之计数；选择以所行之规则所给乘各类，所担之损失依塑规之能力书成本与回报之式而加。

text.en: Whom the loss falls on is supplied, as a function of the loss, which grows one a step.
text.zh: 损失落于谁为所给，作为损失之函数；损失每步增一。

text.en: For the lock staying closed: the share-readers' rule monotone in the share, favouring kept upward.
text.zh: 就锁常闭：份额读者之规则于份额单调，偏向向上而保。

forbids.en: A locked start left by a loss whose readers the loss removes before they read it (K ≤ N), the selection raising the share under a favouring rule and the share-readers' rule monotone in the share.

to.en: leaving the lock: only along a stretch containing a reading step whose rule read is not the share-readers', or a step at which the share falls

edge.en: A lock read off the share is kept along any stretch whose reading steps read as the share-readers do and whose share falls at no step; so it is left only where a reader present reads otherwise at a reading step, or the share falls.

to.en: turned for good from step 4: readers standing while the loss is below 4 read against the carriers before the loss removes them (a witness)

edge.en: With the loss one a step, readers reading against the carriers while the loss is below 4, from eight carriers to one, turn the course for good from step 4: the readers read before the loss removes them.

to.en: not locked at step 4, the rule in force favouring the others at step 5: the loss borne by the carriers at four a unit, the share falling across each step from 1 to 4 (a witness)

edge.en: Carriers two to one under four to one, the threshold reading, no reader of the loss: borne by the carriers at four a unit, the share falls across each step from 1 to 4 while the rule in force favours them, the course locked at steps 1 to 3 and not at 4.

condition.en: Where the loss removes its readers before they read it (K ≤ N), a locked start stays locked at every later step and the loss passes every bound; where they stand while it is below 4 and read against the carriers, the witness turns the course for good from step 4, and with forty more drawn where the carriers outnumber the others sixteen to one the readers read twice and the lock is back for good from step 3.

from.en: the readers removed before they read (K ≤ N): locked for good

to.en: the readers reading against the carriers while they stand (the witness, the loss one a step): turned for good from step 4

open.en: The same read in time: when a reading of a loss reaches the rule before the lock draws its readers out, with readers who start reading late; and the readers counted by kind inside the window.
The pool's presence read off lines carrying readings under selection by share, so that how many read and variation at descent, a readmission, enter.
Who bears the loss read off the course too, the shaping choosing where its losses fall, joined to the capacity's selection across a stretch.

beyond.en: The loss, beyond the share: it removes the readers who would read it, and once they are gone nothing in the loop reads it; borne by the others it is a return to the shapers that no reader of the loss registers.

name.en: Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

mechanism.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. "More than now" is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world, no list holding its configurations; "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. On the World model, what stands listed at each step: where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. Under an undetermined law (any process) enough parts in two: some run comes to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration meets the target and can stay; every run does exactly where every reachable configuration that can stay meets the target and every run from it settles. Staying and meeting everywhere do not give settling: with two configurations and every step allowed, the alternating run never settles. That the seeking is 无明 is a reading, filed apart (locked-seeking).

text.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how a target forms is not modelled. The boundary of enough assumes a determined law; the laws of rising and running down assume that what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into the theorems.
text.zh: 目标是配置上的任一条件；目标怎样形成没有建模。够的边界设律确定；上升与衰减的规律设所立者每步被列出，这是写在定理中的局部条件。

text.en: Steps are counted from step 0; quantities are natural numbers.
text.zh: 步从第 0 步计；量是自然数。

text.en: No axiom. A process, a configuration and a target; each theorem names what it takes.
text.zh: 不加公理。一个过程、一个构形与一个目标；各定理写明所需。
耦合闭包之外的不见另设 Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling 的条件：其余交换固定（扣留的部分，WithheldLevels）；平衡只在耦合入耦合闭包成员的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn）；部分的每个成员都在耦合闭包之外。
text.en: Blindness beyond the coupling closure further assumes the conditions of Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions coupled into members of the coupling closure, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the coupling closure.

to.en: the orbit rests with its target met from some step on, exactly where it has reached a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target

edge.en: Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target.

to.en: for every condition, it is not the case that it rises at arbitrarily late steps (exhaustion, not enough); no last rise is named, and nothing is said of the seekers ending

edge.en: Under a census of what stands, where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. It shows only that the rises do not recur, not that exhaustion ends the seekers.

open.en: It does not derive how a target forms or is revised, that a seeker pursues it, or which targets actual formations hold.
Hijacking, how such targets form and pass on and how winning selects them, is not stated here.
Running down shows only that the rises do not recur at arbitrarily late steps, not that exhaustion ends the seekers themselves.

When runs settle is 08's: in a world that a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a reachable change can be undone; that no run keeps changing does not give settling constructively; worlds that no list holds are outside these theorems.
Targets met along a course rather than at a configuration (more than now), choices divided between the seeker and others, and probabilistic enough.

beyond.en: Where a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest draws on what stands, with the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, its losses beyond its coupling closure do not return through its own feedback.

name.en: Locked seeking

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D26, D41, D45; in 02, D26 as revised in D45, D48, D56, D57, D58]: 无明 is seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest. What grounds it is the position every formation selects from, which reaches only what couples in; the position is not itself 无明. Knowing enough (知足) is a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged, knowing where to stop (知止) a target within that boundary; runs that keep changing are not 无明. The law beneath it is Law.rests_iff: a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest never comes to rest with it met. Which seeking is so locked is the reading, not the law. 02 reads what leaves as 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry; 03 [AI reading, D20, D26, D45] reads 明 as a relation, as wide as the couplings joined to a selection, growing as measurement, a model and pools are joined.

open.en: What a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.
Hijacking, how such targets form and pass on and how winning selects them, is not stated here.

beyond.en: Where a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest draws on what stands, with the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, its losses beyond its coupling closure do not return through its own feedback.

name.en: Obscuration and reopening

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize. Reopening is a blocked relation regaining effect, not an apology or a renamed goal. 07's reading of diagnosing closure first (D65) tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure, real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

open.en: Neither 03's reading nor 07's cites a law of when a measure becomes fixed, or of a blocked relation regaining effect. Beside them, not cited by them, in one named history of the periphery: reopening, inspecting and taking up repairs the changed history's judgment, using up the inspection available; reopening and taking up without inspection does not, nor does reopening with no inspection left (a witness, not of every closed practice).

name.en: What a course chosen through its model does not test

mechanism.en: For every blanketed law, from one internal, sensory and active start, two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses. A formation keeping candidate laws drops those the latest answer refutes and chooses its act from those kept. Equality of values sensed decided: where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation chooses that act from the candidates listed, and every one of them predicts that answer, it rests at once on a model its course never refutes. In a witness (two worlds, one specified worst-case choice), it keeps both candidates and senses the middle value at every step in either world, never sensing the high value of the first. And every blanketed law with the witness's answer and stationary worlds, whatever its internal part, update and choice of act, from one internal, sensory and active start in both worlds, that never senses the low value in the second senses alike in both and takes the known act at every step there, and, where the shared start does not sense high, never senses high in the first. From related starts, formations whose steps keep a relation under which values sensed and acts are one sense and act alike, so in a witness an unresolved model and a reversed ranking act alike.

text.en: Any types for the general laws, discrete synchronous steps of a blanketed law; equality of the values sensed decided for the law of a task's breaking and for the loop's candidates; candidates predicting the next value from the value sensed and the act, kept by elimination.
text.zh: 通律于任一型，毯化之律之离散同步之步；毁务之律与环之候选需所感之值之相等可判定；候选由所感之值与行预言其后之值，以排除而守之。

text.en: The law of a task's breaking asks the breaking only of the second world's answer to the first course's own act and value at each step, through the horizon.
text.zh: 毁务之律唯求每步第二世对第一历程己之行与值之答之毁，至其界。

text.en: Any types for the general law; the relation is supplied and must be kept by both steps; the witness fixes the two candidate lists, the two rankings, the start and the world.
text.zh: 通律于任一型；关系为所予，须为二步所守；例定其二候选之列、二排序、起点与世。

to.en: the values the formation senses in the two worlds differ at the step after the first one at which the worlds answer the act it takes, at the value it senses, differently

edge.en: Two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses: the course parts them only at an answer that differs.

to.en: a formation that senses the two worlds apart does not keep the task K at every step in the second world

edge.en: Equality of values sensed decided: where each answer of the second world to the first course's act and value that differs from the first world's breaks a task on the values sensed, a formation keeping the task at every step in the second world senses alike in both.
