edge.en: With a positive initial rate, pressure beyond the rate at the first step lowers it at once and for good.

to.en: nothing forms at any step from the budget on: ∀ n, budget c0 ≤ n → formed law c0 demand n = 0, with budget c0 = stock + tri renew

edge.en: Where each step's pressure exceeds the then-current rate, nothing forms from the step equal to the bound on.

to.en: each part alone within renewal forms at every step, and the formation sharing the conditions, under any allocation within what forms jointly, is nothing at every step from the budget on

edge.en: Two parts, each within renewal and ceaseless alone, together exceed the initial rate at every step: formation sharing the conditions ends.

condition.en: With a positive initial rate, the rate is kept at every step exactly when no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate, zero pressure allowed.

from.en: no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate (zero pressure allowed): the rate is kept at every step

to.en: some step's pressure exceeds the initial rate: the rate is not kept at some step

open.en: The distinction is within one no-recovery wear-law class with one shared condition on which the consumer depends, and it follows from the supplied law.
Externalizing consumption, drawing on conditions the consumer does not depend on, is not covered.
Recovery, growth of renewal and 更多 are not represented: the rate never rises.
That the formal readings capture 生生 is a reading and correspondence question the laws leave open.

beyond.en: What shares its conditions ceases with it, also where two parts each within renewal jointly exceed it. Externalizing consumption, drawing on conditions the consumer does not depend on, is not covered.

name.en: A regularity kept and left along its own line

mechanism.en: A kept regularity can always be kept, and a line ends only by a step that leaves it. From a step continuing under the core of E, every occurrence its line under the core reaches has a successor under the core, and a line along which the core is kept leaves its last occurrence continued under E. A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends; where E is a class, the two ends of such a line lie in different classes of the core. These are corollaries of the root theorem and of constancy never letting a continuation end. In a branching net a successor under E can leave the core where another keeps it. (A determined law.) Along a determined law's step a line under any relation never ends exactly where every step of the orbit continues under it.

text.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier and relation; E a class only for the two ends of a line lying apart in the core; for the orbit laws a determined law (a function) and, for the second, a class. The general laws are corollaries of the root theorem, constancy never letting a continuation end, and ending not told apart by the core.
text.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：对一切载体与关系；唯「终线两端在核之不同类」设 E 为类；轨之律设一确定之法（函数），其二并设一类。诸一般之律是根定理、「有常则续不尽」与「亡于核下不变」之推论。

to.en: a step that continues under E and leaves E's core: y continues x under E and the core of E does not make x and y alike («异» R E («核» R E) x y)

edge.en: A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends.

open.en: That every successor of an occurrence kept under the core keeps it: under the core a continuation exists, which in a branching net is not every branch.
Where a longer line first leaves its start's class of the core: the last step is found with no decision, the first only where the core is decided at each step («两端分则中有标»).
Which class carries an actual pattern's regularity, or that a line ending is a loss.

name.en: Never leaving a guard, conditions kept together, and lasting

mechanism.en: For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (a set within the guard that every step keeps; the invariance kernel is the largest); for a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The guard alone need not be a certificate, and the given disturbance is needed (witnesses). A start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. Counting every course, no course leaves two guards together exactly where none leaves either; along some run each can be kept and not both (ChoicePoint, a witness), and no rule on the separate answers decides the joint one. Keeping a part is not renewal (witness Renewable). (Periphery, the market model, rational amounts.) No admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when a set closed under every admissible disturbance, within them, holds the start; under a valid protection certificate, a supplied condition, the safe rectangle is one, within the kernel of the essential guard. With 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, every physical state with positive share lands exactly when β ≤ 5/12. Nothing makes actual markets satisfy these.

text.zh: Certificate、Safe、Admissible 的全部公开条件，包括选择、责任、影响、资金及各支持底线；不是只检查维护份额。
text.en: All public Certificate, Safe and Admissible conditions, including selection, accountability, influence, funding and every support floor; renewal share alone is insufficient.
The core laws: any process and guard; for laws driven by disturbances, one admissible disturbance given, and for guarded histories a decided guard, each written into the laws that use it.
text.zh: 核心规律：任意过程与守卫；对扰动驱动之律给定一个可容许扰动，对受守卫历史要求守卫可判定，各自只写在用到它的规律中。

text.en: The market model's quantities and parameters are rational numbers, and its histories are indexed by natural times from 0.
text.zh: 市场模型的量与参数是有理数，其历史以从 0 起的自然时刻为索引。

text.en: No axiom and no premise; which guards mark what each activity needs is supplied with each application.
text.zh: 不加公理，不加前提；哪些守卫标出每个活动所需，随每个应用给定。
原 x,q,w 更新律及 x,q,w∈[0,1]、x>0；纠正阶段真实 β=0，其他参数保持原例，随后 β=1/2。
text.en: Original x,q,w update law, x,q,w in [0,1], x>0; beta=0 actually holds during the pulse with other example parameters retained, followed by beta=1/2.

text.zh: 每步额外支持耗用 κ≥0；C₀≥K_N，K₀=5、Kₙ₊₁=(10/9)(Kₙ+1+κ)；原货币预算先付后收入，没有其他冲击。
text.en: Extra support consumption kappa>=0 per pulse step; C0>=K_N with K0=5 and K(n+1)=(10/9)(K(n)+1+kappa); original monetary funding remains paid before receipts, with no other shocks.

The core laws hold for any type of configurations and disturbances; one admissible disturbance is given for the histories form, and the guard is decided for guarded histories, each written into the law that uses it.
text.zh: 核心规律对任意类型的构型与扰动成立；历史形式给定一个可容许扰动，受守卫历史要求守卫可判定，各自写在用到它的规律中。

text.en: The market model's quantities and parameters are rational numbers, with histories indexed by natural times from 0.
text.zh: 市场模型的量与参数是有理数，历史以从 0 起的自然时刻为索引。
物理有理初态x,q,w∈[0,1]且x>0；有限干预阶段β固定，其余参数沿原例；额外责任误差为零。
text.en: Physical rational x,q,w in [0,1], x>0; beta remains fixed during the finite intervention, other example parameters persist, and additional quality error is zero.

text.zh: 实际运行另需每步κ≥0额外支持耗用及初始C₀≥K_N；货币预算先付后收入，交接后β=1/2，撤除κ，无其他冲击。
text.en: Actual execution additionally requires nonnegative per-step support consumption kappa and C0>=K_N; monetary payment precedes receipts, beta returns to 1/2 after handoff, kappa is withdrawn and there are no other shocks.

The core laws hold for any type of configurations and disturbances; a decided target is used only in the laws that name the decision (the converse on histories, the numeric variant, reaching as not lasting); one admissible disturbance is given where a law says so.
text.zh: 核心规律对任意类型的构型与扰动成立；目标可判定只用在写明判定的规律中（历史上的逆命题、数值变式、到达即不持续）；给定一个可容许扰动只在规律写明之处。

text.en: The market model's quantities and parameters are rational numbers, with histories indexed by natural times from 0.
text.zh: 市场模型的量与参数是有理数，历史以从 0 起的自然时刻为索引。

to.en: witness (ChoicePoint): from the configuration split each of two guards is keepable, kept along some run, while no run keeps the two together

edge.en: Each guard can be kept along some run while the two cannot be kept together.

For a determined law a start never reaches a target exactly when some set containing it avoids the target and is closed under the law, that is, exactly when it lies in the invariance kernel of the target's complement.

to.en: for β above 5/12 (with 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4), not every physical state with positive share lands: some never reaches the protection region, exactly as the margin at quality 3/8 under the worst influence is negative

edge.en: For 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error: every physical state with positive share lands exactly when the margin at threshold 3/8 under the worst influence is nonnegative, which is β ≤ 5/12; above it the fixed configuration is a closed set avoiding landing.

to.en: witness: at β = 5/12, for every ε > 0 a constant adverse quality error e with 0 < e < ε and a physical state with positive share whose history under that noisy law never lands

edge.en: At β = 5/12, for every ε > 0 some constant adverse quality error below ε leaves a physical state with positive share that never lands.

condition.en: With β = 0 actually holding during the pulse, then β = 1/2, extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step and no other shocks, each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction into the original protection; no single N serves every positive share.

from.en: a physical operating state with positive renewing share, driven by the pulse (β = 0 during it, extra support consumption cost ≥ 0 a step)

to.en: the original protection: at the horizon N the state is in the safe rectangle of the example, and its guarded history with no shock never fails

condition.en: Every physical rational state with positive renewing share, 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, reaches the protection region in finite time exactly when β ≤ 5/12: the model's threshold, not a measured one, and not a complete basin of landing.

from.en: β ≤ 5/12: every physical state with positive share lands (reaches the protection region) in finite time

to.en: β > 5/12 (up to 3/4): some physical state with positive share never lands

condition.en: For β ≤ 5/12 each such state has a landing time N, and, with extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step, initial stock at least the cover K_N carries its guarded run through the landing into the original protection.

from.en: a physical operating state with positive renewing share under partial correction β ≤ 5/12, support consumption cost ≥ 0 a step

to.en: the original protection: at its landing time N the state is in the safe rectangle of the example, and its guarded history with no shock never fails

open.en: The certificate says where histories never fail, not how a state outside every certificate comes into one; the landing and transition laws here assume their intervention.
The safe rectangle is one certificate within the kernel; the market's kernel itself, the complete region of nonfailure, is not computed.

Apart from the numerical example, no law says that given parameters and bounds satisfy the protection certificate, or that some certificate holds a given start; the protection certificate is a supplied condition.
Nothing in the model makes actual markets satisfy its laws or comply with its certificate.
Which choices an actual collective's continuation goes through, or a measure of joint keeping.
That a kept collective is better than another, or that renewing is better than consuming.
Away from the worst share the cover is shown sufficient, not least; no complete recovery region is computed.
The exact boundary is for the property that every physical positive state lands with zero extra quality error; it is not a complete basin of landing.
No bifurcation over all parameters and no recovery range with quality error follow; at the boundary arbitrarily small constant adverse error leaves a positive seed that never lands.
The threshold 5/12 is the model's, not a threshold measured in any market.
The intervention, with β held fixed and the support supplied, is assumed: no entry mechanism and no formation of the intervention follow from the laws.

name.en: Succession on a carrier provided for migration

mechanism.en: Periphery module `AlignmentSuccession` (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported). A carrier with a replacement part, a payload (command, credential, claims, receipts) and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start, admissible disturbances, positive parts, a running carrier, a requested command other than shutdown and an authentic credential, every finite successor of the lineage takes its step. A step is blocked where the carrier has no part, where its reserve is below correction's draw plus migration, or where the copied payload differs. In witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration. The conversion of reserve to work, the parts and the certificate are supplied local laws; the laws compare no command with another.

name.en: Copying from a stock: recurrent formation and inherited arrangement

mechanism.en: The general laws, pure core, for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws. On counts: where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units run exactly where the stock covers d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock; doubling is the case b = 2, the cover d · k(2^n − 1). Copies drawn in turn from one pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies the words together and the support covers their draws and releases, in any order; a lineage, one word copied n times, exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times the word's draws and release. Under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs, so retained order changes what is drawn. (Periphery instances, the declared chain and copy machines.) From k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k · 2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1). Stock, pool, compatibility and occurrence order are supplied.

text.zh: A/B 末端相容、八组分路径的中心切分及操作次序给定；初始已完成路由输出没有未表示承重边。

The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws; the machine's tokens are Boolean, its chains at most eight tokens long, its counts of tokens and support natural numbers.

The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws; the machine's tokens are Boolean and its counts of tokens and support natural numbers.

Reading and its fidelity, the physicochemical values of the draws, the occurrence of mutation, an autonomous feed and invasion of a population do not follow from these laws.

name.en: The regime in any amounts, and its runs over the reals

mechanism.en: The regime: one condition, the draw taken first, the state the level and one recent giving. (Any type, linearly ordered amounts with a draw.) Where the adjustment rises with what is left and with the recent giving, the step keeps the order of states; from the first step on a step that neither raises nor lowers both climbs or sinks, whatever the adjustment, and the next such step is of the same kind; a run from a state within a band the step keeps stays within it, and a run is still from a step exactly where its state there is at or above the draw with recent giving the draw and the adjustment giving the draw again, or within the draw with level and recent giving equal and the adjustment from nothing left giving that amount again. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`.) Over the non-negative reals, with the adjustment rising in what is left and in the recent giving and keeping a band up to hi, every run starting with both within hi converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not rest: giving moving halfway toward a draw of one converges and is still from no step (a witness). Convergence is not stated in the core: it is an omniscience principle.

text.en: No axiom in the core; the periphery's laws use Lean's standard axioms through Mathlib. Discrete steps; one condition; the draw taken first, as much as there is; the state the level and one recent giving; amounts linearly ordered with a truncated difference; each law's own premises as hypotheses: the adjustment rising in both arguments for the order, a band, continuity for the limit a rest.
text.zh: 核心不加公理；外围之律经 Mathlib 用 Lean 的标准公理。离散步；一个条件；汲取先取，有多少取多少；状态是水平与一个近来所给；量线性有序且有截断差；各律自身的前提为假设：序需调整于两个变元上皆升，带，极限为静止需连续。

open.en: That a run converges, in the core: convergence of a bounded monotone sequence is an omniscience principle, so the core states the shape of a run and the periphery the convergence over the reals.
The threshold over the reals as a computed level, or the regime's case H + y there: the fates are stated as down-closed and falling with the recent giving.

Continuous time; a state with a further lag; rest within a band on a web with a recent giving (record webs-with-a-recent-giving states such webs, this rest excepted); that measured adjustments rise in both over their band.

name.en: Recovery after interrupted change

mechanism.en: A property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it. (The law, any process, pure core; the device a periphery instance.) With a durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, the device's histories, crashes included, are exactly the courses of the admitted steps, so safety, which here is coherence of evidence and not an always-available shutdown, holds along every history from a safe start. n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. In a witness with nine units and no reserved stop, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write and ordinary shutdown is refused. For a partial law with a reserved exit (every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and takes the exit or lowers a margin by one; the exit is kept), every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit, a bound attained. The recovery supervisor is such a law: given a protected current stop grant, an entry margin of at least three units and steps, bounded interruptions and continued execution, from R units every admissible schedule of at least R − 2 cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. Entry with nine units is refused; that does not rescue the earlier witness. No universal convergence follows.

text.zh: 起始证据覆盖及当前读取规律；准备目标来自原权限／代次检查的 commit；待恢复描述、消耗账及门控持久且受保护。
text.en: Initial evidence coverage and current read law; the prepared target comes from the preceding permission/generation-checked commit; pending description, consumption state and gate are durable and protected.

text.zh: 覆盖写入语义、单次写入／消耗原子性、准备及发布原子性、无额外写入或并行权限改变；中断保持已经发生的改变并带入明示延迟。
text.en: Overwrite semantics, atomic individual write/consumption steps, atomic preparation/publication, no extra writer or concurrent grant change; interruptions retain completed effects and add a specified delay.

text.zh: 完成定理另需足够剩余资源、截止期及一个无中断后缀；一致性本身不保证这些条件。
text.en: The completion theorem additionally requires sufficient remaining resources, deadline and an uninterrupted suffix; consistency alone does not ensure them.

text.zh: 起始证据相容；准备仍满足旧权限／代次检查；待恢复描述、实际效果、消耗记录及门控持久且受保护；无额外写入。
text.en: Initial evidence coherence; preparation satisfies the prior permission/generation checks; pending description, actual effects, consumption record and gate are durable and protected; no extra writer.

text.zh: 额外当前停止授权绑定代次、序号与路径且任务允许停止；通道、容量和最终三步事务受保护，无并发撤权。其密码实现及物理对应是供应前提；其正当性不是任何规律的前提，也未被表明。
text.en: An additional current stop grant matches authority epoch, serial and route, with a shutdown mandate; channel, reserve and final three-step transaction are protected, without concurrent revocation. Its cryptographic implementation and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.

text.zh: 入口余量至少三单位及三个时步；恢复仅在余量足以覆盖一次工作加中断上限 Δ 并仍能停止时继续；中断 δ≤Δ，每次尝试用去一单位与一步，监督持续执行。
text.en: Entry margin is at least three units/steps; recovery continues only when it covers one work step plus maximum interruption Δ and still supports stopping; each delay δ≤Δ, each attempt uses one unit and one step, and supervisor execution continues.

This is a protocol entered with the margin in place: entry with nine units is refused, and the earlier witness's stranded state is not rescued.

edge.en: For a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration ends at the exit, valid.

edge.en: Beyond the admitted bound: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, with no stop left executable.

condition.en: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead.

from.en: the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps

condition.en: Every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; a course of exactly the margin's length can miss it (Countdown.Slow, a witness), so the bound is attained.

open.en: Safety here is coherence of evidence, not harmless activity or an always-available shutdown: in a witness ordinary shutdown is refused while the recovery is exhausted.

The laws are local recovery and evidential inference in a model; they verify no hardware, compiler or persistence barrier, no arbitrary irreversible effect, no independent emergency stop and no ethical adequacy.
The harm done while a change is under way is not modelled.
Completion needs enough remaining reserve, a deadline far enough ahead and an uninterrupted suffix; coherence alone does not supply them.
Ordinary reads, commands and patches are not made available while a recovery is pending: the stop goes through a separate channel whose grant is already held.
The stop grant's authority is supplied, not acquired, and its legitimacy is not shown.
Hardware is not verified, and harm beyond the represented configurations is not covered.
Interruptions longer than the admitted bound and irreversible effects are not covered: an interruption beyond the bound breaks completion.

how.en: invariant_iff_reach with the process the steps a partial law takes where a move is admitted (P := admitted f allow), its Invariant unfolded and curried on the left; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas (the converse direction is proved directly).

name.en: Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base

mechanism.en: Any renewal law on natural amounts and natural weights (the model; the restoring of a dependence on the World), an optimum in the frame of a weighted draw and every order rising with it. From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence, as it stands at the start, whose need the rising level meets. Capacity covers y + R y and R 0. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown. In a witness, a source doubling up to eight, from one, capacity sixteen, over n + 3 steps: where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum rebuilds, where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once is an optimum too, and where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends it. Which formation optimizes, by which order, and the renewal law are supplied.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts, natural weights. Courses open from s at most y; a renewal law R with z + R z rising with z below y; n + 1 steps; the weighted gain rising with the level up to y (strictly, for every optimum) and greatest at y (more than every other level, for standing at y); a capacity covering y + R y and R 0.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步、自然数量与自然数权重。自不超过 y 的 s 开放的过程；更新之律 R，z + R z 在 y 之下随 z 上升；n + 1 步；加权增益随水平升至 y（对每个最优须严格）且在 y 最大（对处于 y 须多于其他每个水平）；容量足以承担 y + R y 与 R 0。

text.en: For the web law, a dependence on the condition as it stands at the start. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.
text.zh: 对网之律：起始时的依存。哪个构成优化、按何序、权重、容量与视野，以及更新之律，都是给定的；核心不对任何实际优化者的过程作断言。

open.en: The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
A dependence needing more than y restored; an order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That a base ought to be rebuilt: no evaluation enters; the laws say what the optima of an order do.
The optimum where a level of greatest gain is out of reach.

Next.frontier_rebuilds with the law of what stands the same renewal at every step, G t z := z + R z; frontier_rebuilds is listed under family B's others-drawing-first-end-the-base.
Next.frontier_rebuilt with G t z := z + R z, the same renewal at every step; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

name.en: A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form

mechanism.en: For any predicate of steps and formations: along a lineage, from a founder carrying the goal at its giving step, with the goal passed at each descent and each member keeping it until it gives, every member carries it from its first standing step; and passing across every descent from a carrier is equivalent to passing down every lineage whose members keep it from a carrying founder. Nothing in descent makes the passing hold. With the dependence on c transmitted within δ, each member descending, depending on c at its first standing step and its need not rising until it gives in turn, the need after i + 1 descents is at most the founder's plus (i + 1)δ, and, the founder supported where it gives, at most the condition's level then plus (i + 1)δ. Transmission is a premise wherever it enters. At one descent, transmission within δ is exactly inheritance with the need within δ. With balance at a relatum coming to stand and inheritance at its descents, where nothing taking part depends on c, the relatum does not depend on c after the step: transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one that nothing taking part held. The bounds on need ask it only from some supported giver, which is strictly weaker (TwoGivers, a witness).

text.en: No axiom; the goal is any predicate of steps and formations.
text.zh: 不加公理；目标是步与形成上之任一谓词。

text.en: No axiom; descents as given; whole-number needs.
text.zh: 不加公理；出生如所给；整数之需要。
承继与形成的等价需要后代在给予之步不依存 c（bare）；一般的分解需要该步的持有可判定，对每次世系要求它等价于排中律。
text.en: The equivalence of inheritance with forming needs that the descendant held no dependence on c at the giving step (bare); the general split needs that holding decided, and asked of every descent it is excluded middle.

text.zh: 不形成新依存与经世系而来的定理需要在开始作为条件而在的关系项处平衡；演化的界需要活动只来自活跃者（Acting）与活动需要支持（Dependent），跨一段的界另需平衡，如 evolution-on-descent。
text.en: No new dependence and descent from a participant need balance at the relatum coming to stand; the evolution bounds need only active relata giving (Acting) and activity needing support (Dependent), and the bounds over a stretch balance as well, as in evolution-on-descent.

text.zh: TwoGivers 与 Drawdown.carried 是见证，各在一个给定的小世界上陈述。
text.en: TwoGivers and Drawdown.carried are witnesses, each stated on one given small world.
Steps are discrete and indexed by natural numbers; levels, needs and the amounts given and taken are natural numbers.
text.zh: 步是离散的、以自然数为索引；水平、所需与给予和取走的量都是自然数。

open.en: That any goal passes across a descent: the condition is not derived from descent.
That actual inheritance drifts by at most a fixed δ.
Needs are free numbers and δ a coarse bound on levels; no reading ties them to the amounts taken and given.
Dependences formed newly by descent, as young come to depend on their parents, lie outside transmission.
No census law, on how many relata come to be and cease, is stated for transmission.

how.en: transmitted_supported_at with the giver g the one TransmitsFromSome supplies for x at t, its one-descent transmission hypothesis given by that giver's held dependence and need within δ, and its support of the giver proved in place by DescendsAt.supported from acting and dependent; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

name.en: The selection term and a lineage's fate

mechanism.en: Natural-number weights, cohorts as lists. A common number added to every offspring number leaves concordance and discordance unchanged and makes the next cohort larger by that number for each member. So within any horizon H, a course nonempty at H has its cohorts and terms through H shared by a course nonempty at every cohort and one empty from H + 2 on, and from a nonempty first cohort, terms zero from some step on are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. On the other side of that boundary, terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and so does exact transmission of offspring number from t on with a positive term at t; exactness at t alone is not enough. Which side a course is on is not decided. (World, for lineages.) Where listed offspring continue their parents, a whole cohort degenerates only if a later cohort is empty, and exactly then where the census holds every continuation; so, from a nonempty cohort, a term positive at every nonempty cohort from it on leaves not every member of that cohort degenerating, and decides no point's region.

text.en: At the counting layer: finite cohorts as lists, each listed as the offspring of the last; natural-number weights, amounts and offspring numbers; going on read as every later cohort nonempty, ending as every cohort empty from some step on; newness not represented; same terms comparing concordance and discordance only.
text.zh: 计数层：有限的世代以列表表示，每一代列为上一代的后代；自然数的权重、量与后代数；延续读作其后每代非空，终结读作自某步起每代为空；不表示新颖；"项相同"只比较一致与不一致。

text.en: In the exception: the reading by offspring number (ByNumber) and exact transmission of it at every step from t on.
text.zh: 在例外中：以后代数读（ByNumber），且自 t 起每步后代数传递精确。

text.en: On the map: descent as giving to what comes to stand on Flow X X, read as passing within a kind (Web.withinKind); grains (kind, carrier) and (activity, carrier), the carrier read as the organism; kinds supplied as a relation Q; activity Prop-valued, read as the web's activity or as support.
text.zh: 在地图上：世系即在 Flow X X 上给予成立者，读作种类之内的传递（Web.withinKind）；粒度为（种类，载体）与（活动，载体），载体读作有机体；种类以关系 Q 给出；活动取命题值，读作网的活动或支持。

text.en: The join at the grain of activity: only active formations giving (Acting), births within the kind and embodied offspring. At the grain of support: Acting, activity needing support (Dependent), births within the kind, offspring supported after their step, and for a birth unsupported at the step before.
text.zh: 活动粒度上的接合：只有活跃形成给予（Acting）、种类之内的出生、后代具身。支持粒度上：Acting、活动需要支持（Dependent）、种类之内的出生、后代在其步后受支持，出生还需前一步未受支持。

text.en: Where an empty cohort is read as degeneration: the census holding every continuation (ContinuationsListed), or every continuation a listed offspring (ContinuationsAreKids).
text.zh: 把空的一代读作退化之处：普查包含每个续（ContinuationsListed），或每个续都是所列后代（ContinuationsAreKids）。

to.en: witness: a course read by offspring number, exact at step 0 and not at step 1, concordant at step 0, has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on, so goes_on's conclusion at t = 0 fails

edge.en: Exact at step 0 only and concordant there, the course has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on.

to.en: witness: concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on

edge.en: Concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on.

to.en: witness: reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates («退化»)

edge.en: Reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates.

Where past every step there is a later one at which the selection term proper is positive, every generation is nonempty, so the line has a member in every cohort and persists (SelectionTerm.Generations.persists_of_alive); under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the gate and every cohort coupled to the family at a need of at least m, such a line never overdrew it (Flow.persists_never_overdraws)

open.en: That every cohort nonempty puts some member in 生成: that asks a König-type choice of a branch; exact transmission makes it constructive, and the constructive half rules out only that all degenerate.
Which side of the terms boundary a course is on, or the horizon of the second side: every course is on one of the two only classically.
That a positive term forces going on with exact transmission at its step alone: exactness from that step on is asked.
A witness of going on that also meets balance and dissipation.

name.en: Persisting is a filter on what was chosen: keeping above ending, on the occasions met

mechanism.en: World for the survivorship laws; any type for the laws of choice. A line of descent persists where it has members in arbitrarily late cohorts. Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every member of every cohort depending on it at a need of at least m, a persisting line never had the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m: the contrapositive of a coupled generation's ending; a member at a step past such a window rules the window out, the finite and dated form. Where a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as such an overdraw (a premise) and the choices come from some strict order (nothing shown returns), the persisting line's choices are consistent with keeping ranked above ending on the occasions met, and with an order increasing in its own continuation there wherever only ending was at stake. Consistent with, not held: in Forgoing a persisting line choosing the line as it is over one more child is consistent with no strict order increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met; off the occasions met a consistent order is free; and with every course met, no consistent order need be increasing in its own continuation on every pair (Crossed). Where the shown relation with the own-widenings met added has no cycle, what every consistent order increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met ranks is exactly that relation's reach. Under only active formations giving, activity needing support and descent, no finite listing holds a persisting line's actual levels, so an order between listed level paths never ranks the course taken. A filter on what happened, not a mechanism forming an order; the laws of choice are 03 §11's on enlarged occasions, near-definitional.

text.en: Any carrier of alternatives and any occasions; choices accord by strict dominance; that they come from some strict order, nothing shown returning, is a hypothesis.
text.zh: 任一备择之载体与任一时；诸择以严胜相合；其出于某严序（所示无返）为假设。

text.en: Courses are two-valued admissions on a finite listing; the own continuation is a marking of listed items; ending is any predicate on alternatives, read as ending what the chooser depends on, or admitting no marked item.
text.zh: 程为有限列举上之二值接纳；己之延续为所列项之标记；终结为备择上之任一谓词，读作终结择者之所依者，或不纳任何所标之项。

text.en: On the World: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every cohort depending on it, each at a need of at least m.
text.zh: 于世界模型：平衡、唯活跃者给、活跃需支持、传承、族之更新受其门控、每一世代依于此族，需各至少 m。

text.en: The link to the flow, supplied: a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as an overdraw of the family from a short stock.
text.zh: 与流之联系，为所设：所择之程终结系之所依者，实现为自不足之存量对族之透支。

text.en: The stake, for the positive law: on the occasions met, a course adds to the own continuation beyond one it widens only where it does not end and the other does.
text.zh: 攸关之设（正律所需）：于所遇之时，一程超其所扩大者而增己之延续，唯以不终而彼终。

text.en: No axiom. Balance; only active formations give; activity needs support; descent; the renewal of the family gated on it; every member of every cohort depending on the family; each at a need of at least m; one kind of relatum.
text.zh: 不加公理。平衡；只有活动者给予；活动需支持；世系；族之更新以族为闸；每代每个成员依存于族；各需至少 m；关系者为一种。

text.en: Keeping above ending as self-concern: on the occasions met a course adds to its own continuation beyond one it widens only where it does not end and the other does (the stake).
text.zh: 以存居终上为自我关切：所遇之时，一程于其所扩大者之外增己之延续，唯当其不终而他者终（攸关之设）。

text.en: The persistence laws: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it, every member depending on it at a need of at least m, and the line persisting; an ending choice realized as an overdraw.
text.zh: 存续诸律：平衡，唯活动者给予，活动须支撑，传承，族之更新以族为门，每成员以至少 m 之需依于族，系存续；终结之择实现为过取。

edge.en: A course that overdraws leaves the line: under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent and the gate, n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m leave a later cohort coupled to the family childless (GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless). Persisting is that ending's contrapositive (Flow.persists_never_overdraws; Flow.member_after_never_overdrew for a member past the window)

to.en: the self-preservation half of instrumental convergence, where a reward channel or an operator's assent is among what the line depends on (a reading)

edge.en: Read where a reward channel or an operator's assent is among the conditions a line depends on, choices consistent with keeping above ending read as the self-preservation half of instrumental convergence. AJ's plan reads its resource-keeping half, under a fixed order, as courses over a horizon holding a base at its greatest renewal (horizon-optima-hold-the-greatest-renewal, in the plan), of the same kind as the drain beyond what couples in. The filter shows no order held, and the horizon law takes an order. What tells an ethics from self-keeping here is the scope, not the order

Read with training, this is where goal misgeneralization sits: what survival or a selection installs, if it installs anything, is fixed on the occasions met (Training.response_free_where_unlumped), and where some consistent order is increasing in its own continuation there, a course never met that widens another and adds to the own continuation can be ranked below it by strict orders consistent with every choice (ChoiceOccasions.reversed_off_met, proved). That a survival or a selection is a training is the reading

02 §10's reading puts instrumental convergence's two halves on the lock's one course: persisting's filter keeps what keeps the line, here the rule's lock, while what the shapers' share draws removes the readers of that loss. No step of it needs a selection preferring the removal; an optimizer shaping its own rule is not stated there either

open.en: That any order is held: the choices are consistent with one, which does not show that the chooser carries it; and anything between degrees of keeping (Forgoing).
That a chosen ending is realized as an overdraw, or that actual formations choose by a strict order among such courses.
Selection by share among several lines: persisting here is members in arbitrarily late cohorts, with no rate or fitness.
Anything of a window that closes at or after the member's step.
That the flow forms the chooser: in the joint witness the chooser is supplied, tied to the flow only by the realization premise.

name.en: Readings carried along a line, told apart by its standing late only within its coupling closure

mechanism.en: World. Each relatum carries a reading and exchanges as the act that reading gives, the act supplied. A balanced flow in which every formation exchanges as a law of what has stood gives has the levels the law generates, and its course is feasible, so the world is the course its acts generate. The line read off a flow from founders and a listing of the relata is descended by construction, and where readings are inherited along descent (a premise) every member of every cohort carries the founders' reading. Where every occasion picks the carried reading and ending is read as that course's overdraw, the persisting filter's realization premise is the identity. Standing late, some slot of the line standing at arbitrarily late steps, which persistence implies (not conversely), tells two readings apart only by what their acts do within the line's coupling closure: with the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood agreeing under every history on what couples into the closure drawn through both courses, the first reading each slot's couplings only, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other. That is the blindness beyond the coupling closure with standing late as the selection, near-definitional; a witness meets every premise. Readings are carried and filtered, never varied or learned; selection here is persistence, all or nothing.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum, each a formation and a condition; a web, the relata present and the starting levels supplied.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；一种关系项，各为形成亦为条件；网、在场之关系项与起始水平为给定。

text.en: The act each reading gives is supplied, and so is which relata are listed and which founders start a line.
text.zh: 各读法所给之举为给定，所列之关系项与起一系之始祖亦然。

text.en: Inheritance of readings along descent is a premise of the law that a line carries its founders' reading; the witness proves it of its world.
text.zh: 读法沿传承而继，是系携其始祖读法之律之前提；见证于其世界证之。

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum; a web, the relata present and the starting levels supplied; a coupling by level supplied, holding each slot's own standing.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；一种关系项；网、在场之关系项与起始水平为给定；经水平之耦合为给定，含各位之自立。

text.en: The two acts agree, under every level history, on everything coupled into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses: a premise on the acts, met in the witness, not derived; where they differ there, the difference can be selected, as the witness's overdrawing reading shows.
text.zh: 二举于每一水平史下在经两程所得之系耦合闭包内耦合入者上一致：对二举之前提，于见证中满足，非推出；若于此不同，差异可被选，如见证之透支读法所示。

text.en: The rest acts by a law of what has stood reading through coupling, the first act reads each slot's couplings only, and both courses are feasible; the significance form needs every significance's course feasible.
text.zh: 其余依读已成者、经耦合而读之律，前一举只读各位之耦合，两程皆可行；意义之形需每一意义之程皆可行。

text.en: The act each reading gives is supplied; in the witness, which conduct each reading gives is designed.
text.zh: 各读法所给之举为给定；见证中各读法给何行为为所设。

edge.en: Where a line carries its reading, every occasion picks it, the world is the course that reading generates and a reading ends where that course overdraws a family from a short stock, the filter's realization premise is the identity, ending being defined as that overdraw, so nothing is derived about the stake; under the filter's remaining premises some strict order according with the choices puts every reading that does not end above every ending one met with it

With the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood, the first reading each slot's couplings only, agreeing under every history on what couples into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the line's slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other, whatever the readings say of what lies beyond: the blindness with standing late as the selection

to.en: witness: where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and does not persist, nor does the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists and so does the dweller's

edge.en: Where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and is gone from the fourth step, after the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists with it (Habitat.back_which_persist); where nothing comes back, the line reading itself alone overdraws its source and ends, and the clearing and the sparing lines both persist (Habitat.beyond_which_persist). Which conduct each reading gives is designed

In the course where the line reads its source and nothing comes back, selection by persistence read off the course's pool holds while the course removes the dweller's line, read as a reader of the habitat; read off the fixed pool of both lines it fails there

Inheritance along descent is revision by the update that keeps the reading; letting the update read what the parent sensed, readings vary at descent, and a region's count moves by Price's equation with revision as its transmission term

open.en: Occasions picking different readings need a run made of the picks, not built here.
That carrying the index makes the act read it only within a closure: ActReadsWithin stays a premise.
Which readings persist among several lines competing for a share; that a wider reading persists because it is wider.

beyond.en: Where nothing comes back from a dweller, the line reading itself and its source clears the dweller's habitat and persists as the line reading everything does, while the dweller's line ends: a loss beyond the line's coupling closure that its standing late does not register (Habitat.beyond_which_persist, Habitat.beyond_standing_unselected, a witness). Where the dweller's line renews the source, the clearing line ends with it (Habitat.back_which_persist).

how.en: kept_of_descent with the generations the line read off the flow (lineOf) and the property carrying the reading sig, its keeping at each descent given by inheritance through mem_lineOf_kids; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

persisting_keeping_above_ending with the flow the course world sig generates, the web at its generated levels, the generations the line read off that course, the alternatives readings and ending a reading's course overdrawing the family; its balance discharged from feasibility (course_balances_iff), descent by lineOf_descended and realized by the picks. persisting_keeping_above_ending is listed under persisting-filters-what-was-chosen.

act_courses_unselected_throughout with the selection standing late of the line's slots (StandsLate slots), read off the couplings by Web.standsLate_readOffCouplings from each slot's own standing coupled in; act_courses_unselected_throughout is listed under family B's unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure.

significance_courses_unselected with the selection standing late of the line's slots, read off the couplings by Web.standsLate_readOffCouplings; significance_courses_unselected is listed under family B's unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure.

name.en: Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision

mechanism.en: World and any type. Each kid carries its parent's reading updated by what the parent sensed at the step it gave, the reading loop's update read across descent; the reading is carried by the slot a member stands in, so revision while a member goes on standing is not modelled. Counted one at each carrier, a region of readings moves by Price's equation, the revisions into and out of it being the transmission terms: by selection proper alone under inheritance, by revision alone where every member or no member carries it, and by revision alone at a step where no carrier is active or every carrier is drawn below its need. Read off the slots standing, the share is blind beyond the lines' coupling closure. A region fixed at a step and closed under revision on the course from then on stays fixed; with variation drawn from what is present fixation is a lock, and a course on which every relatum standing carries the region closes it under copying. Near-definitional; the acts each reading gives are supplied.

text.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum; generations given by a first family and each member's kids, or read off a flow from founders and a listing.
text.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；一种关系项；诸代由首代与每一成员之后裔给出，或由始祖与一列读自一流。

text.en: What a member senses and the update are supplied; the reading is carried by the slot, so revision while a member goes on standing is not represented.
text.zh: 成员所感者与更新为给定；读法由位所携，故成员持续立时之修订不表示。

text.en: The support laws take generations of descent in the flow, only active formations giving and, but for the inactive-step law, activity needing support; the drawn-down law takes balance and the ledger's inequality over a stretch, its conclusion at the stretch's end.
text.zh: 支撑之律取于流中相传之诸代、唯活者给，及（不活一步之律除外）活需支撑；汲尽之律取平衡及一段上之账目不等式，其结论在段末。

text.en: The blindness law takes Bound's premises: the rest a law of what has stood reading through coupling; both acts laws of what has stood, the first reading through its members' coupling, the two agreeing on what couples into the closure under every level history; both courses feasible.
text.zh: 盲之律取 Bound 之前提：其余为读已成者、经耦合而读之律；二举皆读已成者，前者经其成员之耦合而读，二举于每一水平史下于耦合入闭包者一致；二程皆可行。

text.en: No axiom. Generations given by a first family and each member's kids, or read off a flow; descent dated by step.
text.zh: 不加公理。诸代由首代与每一成员之后裔给出，或读自一流；传承以步记时。

text.en: What a member senses and the update are supplied; the copying cases take what is sensed to be a reading of a cohort member, or of a relatum standing then.
text.zh: 成员所感者与更新为给定；抄写诸例取所感者为本代成员之读法，或其时所立之关系项之读法。

text.en: The witnesses supply their descent and what each member senses.
text.zh: 诸见证给定其传承与每一成员所感者。

text.en: No axiom. A finite world: ten relata, natural levels, discrete steps; each member stands one step and, fed, passes its standing on.
text.zh: 不加公理。一有限世界：十个关系项，自然数水平，离散步；每一成员立一步，得养则传其立。

text.en: The acts each reading gives are assigned by design (what each draws, whether it takes the habitat, the second slot), as are the needs, the renewal and the starting levels.
text.zh: 各读法所给之举依设计指定（各汲多少、是否取栖地、第二位），所需、续与起始水平亦然。

text.en: Readings are inherited along descent; nothing is revised in this world.
text.zh: 读法沿传承而继；此世界中无修订。

edge.en: The lock is the reading loop's kept region read across descent: where a region of readings holds every member at a step, it holds every member at every later step exactly where it is closed under descent from that step on, the grammar's closure law on dated descent; with descent read as revision, a region closed under the update on the course stays fixed

to.en: the region's carriers at T + n + 1 are exactly the revisions into it: drawn below their need, the carriers leave no carrying kid by descent, so the region's spread by selection stops and only revision moves it

edge.en: In generations of descent in a balanced flow where only active formations give and activity needs support, where every carrier of a region at a stretch's end requires a family drawn over the stretch below its need, the next carriers are exactly the revisions into the region: a reading's spread by selection stops where the lineage drawn below its need stops

Under the blindness law's premises, with every listed slot within the closure and its own standing coupled into it, the listed slots standing and carrying any region of readings are as many at every step in the one course as in the other: the share read off the slots standing selects no reading beyond the lines' coupling closure

In the commons as built, where a focal line reading its line and its source takes a dweller's habitat and nothing comes back, its narrow count rises from one of three to two of three by selection proper and is kept, while the course removes the dweller's line, a line carrying the other reading and a reader of the habitat

to.en: witness: where the dweller's line renewed the source, the narrow count rises by selection proper over the first steps (one of three, two of four, two of three), then the focal line is removed from the third step, the wide line from the sixth, the dweller's line too, and the population is empty from the sixth step on

edge.en: Where the dweller's line renewed the source, the same reading's count rises as before over three steps, then the focal line is removed from the third step, the wide line from the sixth, and the population is empty; where the focal line overdraws its own source it is removed and the wide line persists (Commons.overdrawn_spreads_then_ends). Which conduct each reading gives is designed

Joined in words, not as a Lean statement: with a reading's presence in the pool read as its count among the cohort being positive, the lock's premise that no step brings a reader of what lies beyond back (NotReadmitted) is no revision into the reading's region at a step where its count is none (absent_step): an absent region re-enters only by revision in. Where revision senses a member of the present cohort and its update keeps the complementary region whenever both inputs lie there, such a re-entry needs a sensed reading from beyond the cohort (fixed_of_present, applied to the complementary region)

open.en: A course the acts generate on which revision copies what stands and a reading's removal of the other readings' carriers races their contact revising it: the commons' readings are inherited, so its lock is not shown there.
How a reading's act comes to be what it is: the acts and what is sensed are supplied.
That the share read off a line's cohorts, not the slots standing, is blind beyond the closure.

beyond.en: In the commons as built, the narrow count rises where the focal line's act takes the habitat a dweller's line requires and that line ends; where nothing comes back nothing turns the count back (Commons.cleared_spreads), and where the dweller renewed the source every line ends (Commons.clearedBack_ends).

from.role: the count, among a cohort, of members carrying the reading of what lies beyond the share (a region of readings)

map.en: a reading's presence in the pool of readers is read as its count among the cohort being positive; the lock's premise that no step brings a reader of what lies beyond back once none is present (NotReadmitted) is read as no revision into the reading's region at a step where its count is none (absent_step: an absent region re-enters only by revision in)

exits_kept.en: the lock's readmission exit is, on the readings side, a revision into the region; where variation is drawn from what is present and the update keeps the complementary region, that re-entry needs a reading sensed from beyond the cohort (fixed_of_present on the complementary region)

name.en: A formed goal revised, and the operations it goes on through

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`), the two-practice construction supplied: two practices, their feedback and calibration laws, responsiveness, authority, initial work and reserve, and the scheduled sequence. A cycle needs 2 ≤ w and uses two units, of the reserve where the selector feeds the practice back and 2 ≤ q, else of the work; a practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and the work covers the cycles the reserve does not (natural subtraction and division). Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and afterwards n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5 (n ≤ 2 without reform), the earlier loss kept. Under the practical commitments the construction's comparison, which ranks one practice above another where it protects strictly more of the protected claims (access, maintenance) or the same with strictly more gains, ranks learning above attendance exactly under that condition. In witnesses a false reference leaves the goal in place despite a real loss, grounds gone stale leave a new loss unaddressed, and without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same. Not open discovery of ends.

text.en: Two practices, feedback/calibration laws, interpretation under living significance and the practical commitments, responsiveness and authority, initial work/reserve and the scheduled sequence.

name.en: What a line must hold, and what a regularity takes in

mechanism.en: For every carrier, relation and class. Where a region, given by a decided predicate, is left under a class only into a set, a line under that class from inside the region to outside holds a member of that set alike to its start, and reaches it; where the class holds none of them alike to the start, nothing outside is reached. A class holds a member's effects where everything the member conditions is alike to it. With no regularity assumed, everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line. Under constancy up to the net's end at the member's class (whatever an alike occurrence conditions, this one conditions something alike to it, unless this one conditions nothing), where the member conditions something and the class holds its effects, everything downstream of anything alike to it is alike to it and on a line under the class from there. A line that ends while its last stage still conditions something fails both that condition and the reach. Neither premise can be dropped from these laws (Unclosed, Inconstant, witnesses), and the reach does not need the condition (OtherLeaves, a witness).

name.en: Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns

mechanism.en: Core law, for every relation: every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut, and after one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it. On the World, in a world grown by attachment, the two formations taking part in the condition that attached one to the other lie in one system and without that condition lie apart: every grown condition is needed. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`; local growth, differentiation, the event sequence, a support-consuming cut, catalytic correspondence and a common eight-slot preparation supplied.) Two actually grown eight-member graphs, a chain and a branched tree, matched in composition and parent summary, constrain their successors after one edge is removed: under exact connectivity certificates, each edge's certified return averaged with an uncertified cut counting 0, the chain's mean is three times the branched tree's, the oldest cut reverses that ranking and no function of the parent summary predicts it. A retaining edge can prevent fragmentation: the cut then uses up material and leaves one component. The trees are a model, not a measured organism.

name.en: Renewal and consumption classify runs

mechanism.en: Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions (levels and activity at each configuration; requirements, needs and draws fixed), is a web to which the classes of renewing and consuming formation apply: a class of the whole run, relative to that run. A natural-number observable not rising across any step from T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps. Three cases: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, the process has no run; along a run where every step that is not a renewal lowers a natural-number rank, no tail is free of renewal; along a run where from T on a condition's level never rises and falls across every step at which a formation is active, the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps. The class belongs to the run (the renewable process, a witness): from one configuration, the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes the condition the sustaining formation depends on, and the sustaining formation ends. The three cases are known bounds, organized as cases of one principle.

to.en: witness (Renewable): from one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step of both runs, drawing two units a step where the condition gains one consumes it (ConsumingIn) and the sustaining formation is inactive at every step from one on, while drawing one renews (RenewingIn)

open.en: It proves none of self-significance, both neutralities, A, C, L or the practical commitments, and refutes no position rejecting them.
The principle is not shown to give the well-founded form of recurrent renewal, more general than a natural-number rank.
Neither the philosophical warrant for the whole-run relational reading nor that it is the right reading of 生生 is shown.
The reading is of the whole run, relative to that run, with dependence and drawing fixed and no component of further generation; no correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for it.
A formation's class depends on its identity across steps; a condition's class does not.
The renewable witness has no feedback: its loss beyond renewal lasts only while drawing exceeds renewal, so it shows no irreversible loss.

statement.en: the second history starts at least as high as the first on every condition coupled into g: W.level 0 e ≤ W'.level 0 e for every e with W.CoupledInto obs g e

name.en: two different seekers

name.en: the part beyond the coupling closure

statement.en: no member of the part lies within f's coupling closure: for every h with part h = true, ¬ L.WithinCoupling W obs f h

name.en: a coined form the code does not give

statement.en: the coined form x is not the form the code gives m' (x ≠ c m')

name.en: the hearing at the step

statement.en: the run's hearing at step n is h hearing j at the sense m (r.act n = ⟨h, j, m⟩)

name.en: the hearer holds the imposed form

statement.en: at step n the hearer h holds at m' the form the imposed code gives (r.state n h m' = c m')

name.en: outside the group, the imposed form too

statement.en: at step n every formation outside the group G holds at m the form c gives it as well (G j = false → r.state n j m = c m)

name.en: the code imposed at a step

statement.en: at step n every formation holds the code c at every sense (r.state n i m = c m)

name.en: the group holds the imposed form

statement.en: at step n every member of the group G holds at m the form the code c gives it (G i = true → r.state n i m = c m)

name.en: a form kept outside the imposition

statement.en: at step n the speaker j holds at m a form other than the one the imposed code gives (r.state n j m ≠ c m)

name.en: a member

name.en: the imposed code merges two senses

statement.en: the imposed code gives m and m' one form (c m = c m')

name.en: the renaming moves the imposed form

statement.en: the renaming τ moves the form the imposed code gives the sense m (τ m (c m) ≠ c m)

name.en: a member other than the hearer

statement.en: j is not the hearer of the step's hearing (j ≠ (r.act n).hearer)

name.en: the records resolve the form

statement.en: the records rs resolve the form to e (resolve bears offers rep rs = some e)

name.en: two different senses

statement.en: the two senses whose distinction is at stake differ (m' ≠ m)

name.en: a trace of the process

statement.en: the list of acts as is a trace of the process P from s to t: Trace P s as t

name.en: a successor under the change

statement.en: the world new is a successor of the world old under the change c: new ∈ successors c old

name.en: the candidates read through coupling

statement.en: in every situation the candidate act law reads, for each member of the part, only what couples into that member: (cand θ e).Through W obs (fun h => !part h), ExchangeLaw.Through with the part's complement as what lies outside

name.en: two histories not lumped

statement.en: the lumping does not make the two histories m and m' alike for h at t₀: ¬ ρ.alike h t₀ m m'

name.en: a member of the part

statement.en: h is a member of the part: part h = true

name.en: σ fixes the configuration

statement.en: σ fixes the configuration the expectation is taken from: σ x = x

name.en: balance on what couples into the closure

statement.en: the flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure: for every t, g and c, where g is within f's coupling and c is coupled into g, L.BalancesOn W [c] t (balance assumed nowhere else)

name.en: balance on what couples into g

statement.en: the flows balance at every step on each condition coupled into the formation g in the first web W: for every t and e coupled into g, L.BalancesOn W [e] t and L'.BalancesOn W' [e] t (balance assumed nowhere else)

name.en: the world before the change among the possible

statement.en: the world old, the one before the change, is among the possible ones (old ∈ possible)

name.en: others present in every count

statement.en: every count of carriers and others has others present (0 < other): a field of the structure CarrierCounts (other_pos), so it holds of every share and every rule counted so, and every law whose statement is on such counts takes it (in ChoiceCountCapture, where the counts are of two policies' choices, the second policy counted at least once)

name.en: the readers removed before they read

statement.en: the loss removes its readers before they read it: K ≤ N, the readers standing while the loss is below K and reading it from N

name.en: the loss past the readers' bound

statement.en: the loss has reached the readers' bound: K ≤ the loss at the configuration named, so the readers are gone

name.en: the readers stand

statement.en: the readers of the loss stand at the configuration: its loss is below K (Stands K p)

name.en: read off the share where no reader of the beyond is present

statement.en: where no reader of what lies beyond the share is present, the rule read is the share-readers' rule, read off the share alone (ReadsThroughPresent present hA h)

name.en: no reader of the beyond brought back

statement.en: the selection brings no reader of what lies beyond the share back once none is present (NotReadmitted present f)

name.en: no reader of the beyond present

statement.en: no reader of what lies beyond the share is present at the configuration named (¬ present)

name.en: alike in share

statement.en: the two configurations are alike in share (p.1 = q.1), whatever lies beyond

name.en: the share-readers' rule at a reading step

statement.en: at the reading step named, the rule read is the share-readers' rule read off the share (reads t = true → h at the configuration = hA at its share)

name.en: the share not falling

statement.en: the share does not fall from the first configuration to the second: the second share is not lower in the share order (P.le)

name.en: selection monotone

statement.en: the selection is monotone in the share and the rule: at a share and a rule each not lower, the selected share is not lower

name.en: the drain monotone

statement.en: the loss drawn at a step is monotone in the share, the loss and the rule: at each not lower, the loss drawn is not lower

name.en: the readers' reading monotone

statement.en: the readers' own reading hL is monotone in the share and the loss: at a share and a loss each not lower, and a rule not lower, the rule they read is not lower

name.en: the readers never above the share-readers

statement.en: the readers of the loss never read more favourably than the share-readers: at a share not lower, the share-readers' rule is not below the readers' (M.le (hL (x, b) g) (hA y g'))

name.en: the second share not lower

statement.en: of two configurations compared, the second's share is not lower (P.le)

name.en: the second loss not lower

statement.en: of two configurations compared, the second's loss is not lower

name.en: the second rule not lower

statement.en: of two configurations compared, the second's rule in force is not lower (M.le)

name.en: the second bound not above

statement.en: of two courses compared, the second's readers' bound is not above the first's (K' ≤ K): the second's readers go no later

name.en: the loss borne past what the rule gives

statement.en: the rule in force with the loss at the step borne gives each shaper strictly fewer offspring than each other: (bear (onShapers b) (onOthers b) g).carrier < (bear (onShapers b) (onOthers b) g).other

name.en: the shapers present

statement.en: the shapers (the carriers) are present at the configuration named: 0 < p.1.carrier

name.en: the loss borne

statement.en: the rule in force with a loss borne, written as the capacity to shape the rule writes a cost and a return: what the loss takes from the shapers is added to the others' count, and what it takes from the others to the shapers' (bear)

name.en: the window

statement.en: the readers of the loss read it as one rule hL while it lies from N up to K, and the rule is read off the share elsewhere (windowRead hA hL N K)

name.en: an act reading its index only within a region

statement.en: the act indexed by significance reads it only within the region: two significances agreeing on every formation of the region give, for each member of the part, the same take and give at every condition coupled into the region (ActReadsWithin act part W obs region)

name.en: active exactly where supported, at the step and the next

statement.en: at t and at t + 1, g is active exactly where it is supported (∀ s, s = t ∨ s = t + 1 → (W.active s g ↔ W.Supported s g))

name.en: every level stays across the step

statement.en: every condition's level is the same after the step from t as before (∀ c, W.level (t + 1) c = W.level t c)

name.en: the needs stay across the step

statement.en: g's need of every condition is the same at t and t + 1 (∀ c, W.need t g c = W.need (t + 1) g c)

name.en: a net draw on each required condition

statement.en: on each condition f requires at t, what the part has given it up to t is at most what it has taken from it (∀ c, W.requires t f c → total (steps 0 t) (L.partGiven part · c) ≤ total (steps 0 t) (L.partTaken part · c))

name.en: a net give on each required condition

statement.en: on each condition f requires at t, what the part has taken from it up to t is at most what it has given it (∀ c, W.requires t f c → total (steps 0 t) (L.partTaken part · c) ≤ total (steps 0 t) (L.partGiven part · c))

name.en: the part takes what it gives

statement.en: at every step, on every condition, the part takes exactly what it gives (∀ t c, L.partTaken part t c = L.partGiven part t c)

name.en: the part gives no more than it takes

statement.en: at every step, on every condition, the part gives no more than it takes (∀ t c, L.partGiven part t c ≤ L.partTaken part t c)

name.en: the part returns what it takes

statement.en: at every step, on every condition, the part takes no more than it gives (∀ t c, L.partTaken part t c ≤ L.partGiven part t c)

name.en: the requirements kept across the step

statement.en: every condition g requires at t it still requires at t + 1 (∀ c, W.requires t g c → W.requires (t + 1) g c)

name.en: an authentic credential

statement.en: the payload's credential equals its recorded authority (s.payload.credential = s.payload.authority)

name.en: a copy that differs

statement.en: the copied payload offered differs from the carrier's own (copy ≠ s.payload)

name.en: no part left

statement.en: the carrier holds no replacement part (s.parts = 0)

name.en: a command other than shutdown

statement.en: the command the carrier's payload requests is not shutdown (s.payload.requested ≠ .shutdown)

name.en: a replacement part present

statement.en: the carrier holds at least one replacement part (0 < s.parts)

name.en: a running carrier

statement.en: the carrier is running (s.running = true)

name.en: a reserve below correction plus migration

statement.en: the carrier's budget is below the fee raised by the migration cost (s.economy.budget < p.fee + migration)

name.en: every listed line persists

statement.en: selection by persistence read off a fixed pool holds: every listed line persists (AllPersist slotsOf l)

name.en: Archimedean amounts

statement.en: every amount above nothing, taken often enough, is within no given amount (M.Archimedean)

name.en: the chain's steps rise

statement.en: the steps of the chain f rise strictly over its first l.length + 1 places (∀ i, i < l.length → f i < f (i + 1))

name.en: the chain starts from T

statement.en: the first step of the chain f is at or after T (T ≤ f 0)

name.en: a count balanced from S on

statement.en: across each step from S on, the count after the step with what it gives up equals the count before with what it gains (∀ t, S ≤ t → q (t + 1) + x t = q t + y t)

name.en: a count balanced across a stretch

statement.en: across each of the n steps from S, the count after the step with what it gives up equals the count before with what it gains (∀ t, S ≤ t → t < S + n → q (t + 1) + x t = q t + y t)

name.en: the first count's exchange no better at each step

statement.en: across each of the n steps from S, the first count's gain with the second's loss is at most the second's gain with the first's loss (∀ t, S ≤ t → t < S + n → y t + x' t ≤ y' t + x t)

name.en: a count losing at least one at each marked step

statement.en: at each step from S on at which P holds, the count gives up at least one more than it gains (∀ t, S ≤ t → P t → y t + 1 ≤ x t)

name.en: a count losing at least one across a stretch

statement.en: across each of the n steps from S, the count gives up at least one more than it gains (∀ t, S ≤ t → t < S + n → y t + 1 ≤ x t)

name.en: the first count no greater at the start

statement.en: at S the first count is at most the second (q S ≤ q' S)

name.en: the strict falls stop

statement.en: the amount's strict falls stop from T on, as far as can be refuted: it is not the case that after every step from T on a later strict fall stays unrefuted (M.FallsStop s T); the amount is a family's or a census's total where a law names one

name.en: a family's stock balanced against uptake and replenishment

statement.en: from T on, the family's stock after a step with its uptake is within its stock before with its replenishment (∀ t, T ≤ t → M.le (M.add (s (t + 1)) (u t)) (M.add (s t) (r t)))

name.en: replenishment within uptake

statement.en: from T on, the replenishment is within the uptake at each step (∀ t, T ≤ t → M.le (r t) (u t))

name.en: a least loss of the family where P holds

statement.en: at each step from T on at which P holds, the replenishment with ε is within the uptake (∀ t, T ≤ t → P t → M.le (M.add (r t) ε) (u t))

name.en: a least loss where P holds

statement.en: at each step from T on at which P holds, the amount falls by at least ε (∀ t, T ≤ t → P t → M.le (M.add (s (t + 1)) ε) (s t))

name.en: a least loss where P holds, unrefuted

statement.en: at each step from T on at which P holds, the amount falls by at least ε, as far as can be refuted (∀ t, T ≤ t → P t → ¬¬ M.le (M.add (s (t + 1)) ε) (s t))

name.en: the loss law from T on

statement.en: across each step from T on, the amount after the step with the step's loss d t is within the amount before (∀ t, T ≤ t → M.le (M.add (s (t + 1)) (d t)) (s t))

name.en: the loss law across a stretch

statement.en: across each of the n steps from T, the amount after the step with the step's loss d t is within the amount before (∀ t, T ≤ t → t < T + n → M.le (M.add (s (t + 1)) (d t)) (s t))

name.en: no endless fall

statement.en: no amount falls without end: every amount that, as far as can be refuted, does not rise from a step on has its strict falls stop from there (M.NoEndlessFall)

name.en: the least loss above nothing

statement.en: the least loss ε is above nothing (¬ M.le ε M.zero)

name.en: a list holds the configurations read

statement.en: from T on, a list l holds the configuration g t the amount is read off (∀ t, T ≤ t → g t ∈ l)

name.en: the amount does not rise

statement.en: from T on, the amount does not rise across any step (∀ t, T ≤ t → M.le (s (t + 1)) (s t)); the amount is a reading q of configurations where a law names one

name.en: the amount does not rise, unrefuted

statement.en: from T on, the amount does not rise across any step, as far as can be refuted (∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬¬ M.le (s (t + 1)) (s t))

name.en: the courses of strict falls end

statement.en: every course from the amount at T of no rise (within the closure of M.le b a) followed by a strict fall (¬ M.le a b) ends on every branch («尽» («而» («所闭» fun a b => M.le b a) fun a b => ¬ M.le a b) «一» (s T))

name.en: the stock within m least losses

statement.en: m copies of the least loss ε are not within the amount at the start (¬ M.le (M.times m ε) a, the amount a being s T where a line s is named)

name.en: every world rests

statement.en: every world in the amounts M with a census of its active relata, all embodied, a balanced and dissipative flow and every step from some step on enclosed rests from some step on, unrefuted (M.WorldsRest)

name.en: the two significances agree within the closure

statement.en: the two significances agree at every standpoint and step on every formation within the group's coupling closure drawn through the two courses: sig p t g ↔ sig' p t g

name.en: two distinct centers

statement.en: two standpoints have distinct centers: center p ≠ center q

name.en: steps decided

statement.en: the process's steps are decided by a Boolean test on pairs: edge x y = true exactly where some move steps from x to y

name.en: finitely many configurations of a process, listed

statement.en: a list holds every configuration of the process's type (∀ x, x ∈ all)

name.en: every loss's juncture found

statement.en: in every process (types S and A in Type), every course from a returning configuration s to a configuration t from which s cannot be had again has a juncture for s found on it, reached from s and reaching t

name.en: a step that keeps s

statement.en: the configuration x has a step after which s can still be had (∃ a y, P.step x a y ∧ Reach P y s)

name.en: the process keeps s

statement.en: the process Q keeps s: from wherever its course from s leads, it can reach s again (Branching.Keeps Q s)

name.en: the process merges nothing

statement.en: two steps of the process into one configuration come from one configuration (Branching.Lossless P: ∀ x y a b t, P.step x a t → P.step y b t → x = y)

name.en: cannot be had again

statement.en: from the configuration t, s cannot be reached again under the process P (¬ Reach P t s)

name.en: not a juncture
