statement.en: the configuration x is not a juncture for s (¬ Branching.Juncture P s x)

name.en: a step keeping leaves out

statement.en: the step from x by a to y is not a step of keeping P s: after it s cannot be had, or it is no step of P (¬ (keeping P s).step x a y)

name.en: lost n steps on, under a process

statement.en: the configuration s cannot be had n steps on under the process P: no trace of length n ends at s (¬ Branching.Reachable P n s)

name.en: returns, under a process

statement.en: the configuration s returns under the process P: some step from s leads to a configuration from which s can be reached (Branching.Returns P s)

name.en: a step taken

statement.en: the process takes a step from x by the move a to y (P.step x a y), at a configuration the law names

name.en: a sub-process

statement.en: Q's steps are among P's: every step of Q is a step of P (Branching.SubProcess Q P)

name.en: a relation putting keeping above ending

statement.en: the relation P puts every alternative that does not end above every one that ends and was met with it (∀ x y, ch.Met x y → ¬ ends x → ends y → P x y)

name.en: no chosen alternative ends

statement.en: at no occasion does the chosen alternative end (∀ o, ¬ ends (ch.pick o))

name.en: choices with the own-widenings met, from a strict order

statement.en: the relation the choices show, with every own-widening met added (pairs met together where the first widens the second and adds to the own continuation), has no cycle («无环» (ch.withPairs (ch.OwnWidensMet items own)).Shown)

name.en: choices from some strict order

statement.en: the relation the choices show has no cycle («无环» ch.Shown): the choices come from some strict order

name.en: only ending at stake on the occasions met

statement.en: on the occasions met, a course that widens another and adds to the own continuation beyond it does so only where it does not end and the other ends (∀ a b, ch.Met a b → WidensOn items a b → AddsOwn items own a b → ¬ ends a ∧ ends b)

name.en: a course never met

statement.en: the course a is open at no occasion and chosen at none (ch.Unmet a)

name.en: the standpoint centred on the clearer

statement.en: the standpoint p's center is the clearer: center p = clearer

name.en: strengths into each condition at most M

statement.en: the strengths into each condition at each step total at most M: ∀ t c, inflow cs part k present t c ≤ M (one of 02's standard bounds)

name.en: the list within n + 1

statement.en: the list of conditions has at most n + 1 members: cs.length ≤ n + 1

name.en: no loop upstream by T

statement.en: no condition upstream of c under the couplings acting before T lies on a loop of them: ∀ e, Upstream cs part (strengthsBefore T k) present e c → ¬ OnLoop cs part (strengthsBefore T k) present e

name.en: on no loop of the couplings acting before T

statement.en: e lies on no loop of the couplings acting before T: ¬ OnLoop cs part (strengthsBefore T k) present e

name.en: on a loop of the couplings acting before T + 1

statement.en: e lies on a loop of the couplings acting before T + 1: OnLoop cs part (strengthsBefore (T + 1) k) present e

name.en: a later onset

statement.en: the second onset is no earlier than the first: T ≤ T' (or θ ≤ θ')

name.en: starting gaps at most D

statement.en: every starting gap is at most D: ∀ c, δ c ≤ D (one of 02's standard bounds)

name.en: a step at or before the onset

statement.en: the step t read is at or before the step T (or θ) the law names as where a loop may form: t ≤ T

name.en: the record shows the margin left

statement.en: every course u of the k earliest steps that the record R accepts leaves the level m′ above the need (m + q·(ones of u) = m′ + p·(zeros of u)) without having reached the need on the way (fallsWithin p q m u = false)

name.en: nothing else at or before the center

statement.en: nothing other than each center lies at or before its step: ∀ p x, time x ≤ time (center p) → center p = x

name.en: an earlier step

statement.en: the step t' read is not after t: t' ≤ t

name.en: a net going forward in time

statement.en: every condition comes at an earlier step than what it conditions: ∀ x y, R x y → time x < time y

lean: Becoming.«续无外当且仅当后与独»

name.en: a stock covering the rounds' draws

statement.en: the stock m covers what n rounds of b-fold copying from k units draw, each unit drawing d a round: d * requiredBy b n k ≤ m

name.en: more unlike adjacent pairs

statement.en: the second word has d more unlike adjacent pairs than the first (unlikeFrom y m = unlikeFrom x l + d)

name.en: two words of one length

statement.en: the two words' tails have the same length (l.length = m.length)

name.en: a positive difference in unlike pairs

statement.en: the difference d in unlike adjacent pairs is positive (0 < d)

name.en: a start at the exit

statement.en: the configuration the course starts from is at the exit (exit s)

name.en: counted work

statement.en: while pending, one tick does one unit of work for one unit of fuel; with no work left and fuel left, a tick finishes; without fuel, a tick stalls (CountedWork tick busy done work fuel)

name.en: a plan longer than the margin

statement.en: the plan has more moves than the margin at the start (margin s < plan.length)

name.en: a pending task

statement.en: the configuration s is pending (busy s), for the counted work's busy

name.en: an admitted plan

statement.en: every move of the plan is admissible (∀ a ∈ plan, adm a); for the shutdown supervisor, every attempt of the schedule is admissible under the bound, an interruption delaying at most the bound

name.en: a reserved exit

statement.en: every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and either takes the exit or lowers the margin by one; every move from the exit stays at the exit (Reserved f adm valid exit margin)

name.en: a valid start

statement.en: the configuration the course starts from is valid (valid s), for the reserved exit's valid

name.en: an end step named for every finite world

statement.en: for every world with activity decided that meets the eight premises and is finite, some step E after which nothing arises

name.en: a count

statement.en: n counts the members of the list of which the property holds, as a relation with no decision procedure (Counts as q n)

name.en: a chain coupling at every step

statement.en: the chain v of j couplings holds at every step: each consecutive pair of conditions along it couples at every step (CoupledAlways cs part k present v j)

name.en: a list covers one step

statement.en: the list L holds every member of which p holds at step N (Covers p L N)

name.en: grown by attachment

statement.en: the listed links grew by attachment: each, when added, joined a new end not linked to the earlier links, its two ends different (Cuts.Attaches)

name.en: a link among the grown ones

statement.en: (p, n) is one of the listed links: es = newer ++ (p, n) :: older

name.en: the listed family's states decided from some step on

statement.en: from some step N on, whether p a holds at t is decided (holds or fails, Becoming.Decided) for every a in the list: ∃ N, ∀ a t, a ∈ as → N ≤ t → Decided (p a t)

name.en: BreaksBy

statement.en: the step from s by the move a breaks g's dependence on c: some step from s by a reaches t where g requires c, its need met at s and not at t (Dependence.BreaksBy P s a g c)

name.en: DifferenceOnlyTogether

statement.en: the parts of fs make the difference together and no single one of them does (Dependence.DifferenceOnlyTogether)

name.en: fails at the earlier step

statement.en: the property p of steps fails at the earlier step T (¬ p T)

name.en: fails at the later step

statement.en: the property p of steps fails at the later step t (¬ p t)

name.en: holds at the earlier step

statement.en: the property p of steps holds at the earlier step T (p T)

name.en: holds at the later step

statement.en: the property p of steps holds at the later step t (p t)

name.en: the earlier step not after the later

statement.en: the earlier step T is not after the later step t (T ≤ t)

name.en: MakesDifferenceTogether

statement.en: the parts of fs make the difference together: the step from s by a breaks the dependence, and with all of them withheld the same move can be taken and every step by it keeps the dependence (Dependence.MakesDifferenceTogether)

name.en: the dependence met with a part withheld

statement.en: with the part of f withheld (f, or each member of fs the law names), g's need of c is met: K.need (withhold f s) g c ≤ K.level (withhold f s) c

name.en: the move available with a part withheld

statement.en: with the part of f withheld (f, or each member of fs the law names), the same move a can be taken: ∃ t, P.step (withhold f s) a t

name.en: Overdetermined

statement.en: the loss is overdetermined: the step from s by a breaks g's dependence on c, and with any single part withheld the same move still breaks it (Dependence.Overdetermined)

name.en: the dependence holds with a part withheld

statement.en: with the part of f withheld (f, or each member of fs the law names), g still requires c: K.requires (withhold f s) g c

name.en: Determined

statement.en: the move determines the step: from a configuration, a move has at most one successor (∀ s a t t', P.step s a t → P.step s a t' → t = t')

name.en: the gap a step raised

statement.en: the listed step raised the share by the gap g: (p + q) · h + g = N · p

name.en: the start below the top

statement.en: the start count i is at most M (i ≤ M), so the other kind is present

name.en: c within the whole step weight

statement.en: the least upward weight is at most the whole step weight (c ≤ T)

name.en: the first kind favoured in the draw

statement.en: the downward weight is below the upward weight (b < a)

name.en: one kind

statement.en: the count i is of one kind among M + 1: not mixed (¬ Drift.Replacement.Mixed M i)

name.en: some of the other kind at the start

statement.en: the count t left to the top is positive (0 < t)

name.en: the weight beyond the least upward

statement.en: r is what the whole step weight to the power M + 1 exceeds the least upward weight to that power by: r + c ^ (M + 1) = T ^ (M + 1) (with constant weights, c = a and T = a + b)

name.en: some of the first kind at the start

statement.en: the start count i is positive (0 < i)

name.en: the start within M + 1

statement.en: the start count i is at most M + 1 (i ≤ M + 1)

name.en: every step weighs the whole

statement.en: every mixed count's three weights (up, down, stay) total T (Drift.Replacement.Steps M T u d e)

name.en: the start and the rest make the top

statement.en: the start count and the count left make M + 1 (i + t = M + 1)

name.en: the upward weight at least c

statement.en: at every mixed count the upward weight is at least c (∀ j, Mixed M j → c ≤ u j)

name.en: the next generation split by kind

statement.en: the next generation's size is its sum of the amount plus q (G.size (t + 1) = G.sum (t + 1) + q)

name.en: r is N^N less two

statement.en: r is the whole weight of a sampled generation less the two samplings of one kind alone (r + 2 = N ^ N)

name.en: the start within the population

statement.en: the starting count h of the first kind is at most the population N (h ≤ N)

name.en: a founder carrying the goal

statement.en: the founder xs 0 carries the goal at its giving step ts 0

name.en: a goal kept until giving

statement.en: each member xs (i + 1) of the lineage that carries the goal at its first standing step carries it still at its own giving step ts (i + 1), for every i + 1 < n

name.en: a goal passed at each descent

statement.en: along the lineage, where xs i carries the goal at its giving step ts i, xs (i + 1) carries it at its first standing step ts i + 1, for every i < n

name.en: each descendant depending on c

statement.en: for every i < n, the member xs (i + 1) depends on c at its first standing step ts i + 1

name.en: a lineage of descents

statement.en: for every i < n, xs (i + 1) descends from xs i across step ts i: xs i takes part, gives to xs (i + 1), and xs (i + 1) comes to stand (L.DescendsAt W (ts i) (xs (i + 1)) (xs i))

name.en: a descent within the lineage

statement.en: the descent named, i, is one of the lineage's n descents (i < n)

name.en: a need not rising until giving

statement.en: for every i + 1 < n, the member xs (i + 1)'s need for c at its giving step ts (i + 1) is at most its need at its first standing step ts i + 1

name.en: a lineage with a descent

statement.en: the lineage has at least one descent (0 < n)

name.en: before step two

statement.en: the step t is one at which Exceeding's members take part: t < 2

name.en: the selecting group outside the acting part

statement.en: every member of the selecting group (or pool) is outside the acting part: group h → part h = false

name.en: a law reading the stock only below a threshold

statement.en: the law reads c only below the threshold θ: for every formation outside the part, two level histories that stand at or above θ at c up to t and agree elsewhere up to t are given alike at t (law.ReadsBelow part c θ)

name.en: a selection through a group's acts

statement.en: histories under which every member of the group exchanges alike, by the law, across every step up to t are selected alike (ExchangeLaw.SelectsThroughActs group t select)

name.en: the part's act reads through the part's couplings

statement.en: the act law reads, for each member of the part, only what couples into that member: act.Through W obs (fun h => !part h)

name.en: excluded middle

statement.en: every proposition holds or fails (∀ P : Prop, P ∨ ¬ P)

name.en: the available within what is given

statement.en: the list avail is no longer than what is given to c at t: avail.length ≤ L.given t c

name.en: the root's footprint available

statement.en: the root's footprint lies within the list avail: ∀ a, footprint s a → a ∈ avail

name.en: what is taken is the plan's draws

statement.en: what is taken from c at t is what the plan's leaves draw: L.taken t c = p.draws.length

name.en: a separated envelope

statement.en: every two admitted fault sets leave a domain of the roster outside both (FaultEnvelopes.separated roster faults); where the law names a set, for each of its domains

name.en: a physical pair

statement.en: the initial share and quality lie in [0, 1] (FiniteSupportObstruction.PairPhysical)

name.en: no injection

statement.en: every support shock is nonnegative (∀ n, 0 ≤ (d n).shock 0): nothing is injected into the support

name.en: a small seed

statement.en: the initial share times (3/2)^N is at most 1/6 (initial.x · radius (3/2) 1 N ≤ 1/6)

name.en: stock at the floor or above

statement.en: the initial support stock is at least the floor 5 (5 ≤ stock)

name.en: stock short of the horizon

statement.en: the initial support stock is below 5 + N (initial.stock 0 < 5 + N)

name.en: the selector selecting alternation

statement.en: the supplied selector of the state selects alternation: s.selector = false

name.en: the level above m

statement.en: the level of c at step t is above m: m < W.level t c

name.en: active over the stretch

statement.en: g is active at each of the n consecutive steps from T (∀ k < n, W.active (T + k) g)

name.en: activity not resumed once stopped

statement.en: from T on, the seeker is active at a step only where it was active at the step before: W.active (T + i + 1) f → W.active (T + i) f

name.en: the part acting alike in two flows

statement.en: every formation in the part takes and gives alike in the two flows at every step (L.ActsAlike L' part)

name.en: the part acts alike within the closure

statement.en: each member of the part within f's coupling closure drawn through both flows, coupled alike up to t, exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t with every condition a member of the closure couples into (Flow.ActsAlikeWithin L' W W' obs part f); where the law names a group, for each member f of the group

name.en: the act changes a formation's admission

statement.en: the two flows differ at step s in admitting x: ¬ (W.Admits (W.level s) s x ↔ W.Admits (W'.level s) s x)

name.en: alikeness at the condition changes

statement.en: whether the two courses are alike at c at s + N differs from whether they are at s: ¬ (W.level (s + N) c = W'.level (s + N) c ↔ W.level s c = W'.level s c)

name.en: alone with its family

statement.en: no other formation taking part exchanges with the holder's family across the step (at each of n steps from T, for each holder taking part): g ∈ L.present t → g ≠ h → x ∈ fam → L.take t g x = 0 ∧ L.give t g x = 0

name.en: two distinct formations

statement.en: the full taker f and the other formation g are distinct: f ≠ g

name.en: the courses apart at the condition

statement.en: the two courses differ at c at s: W.level s c ≠ W'.level s c

name.en: formations arising taking from the family at arbitrarily late steps

statement.en: for every N there is a step t ≥ N at which some formation arises and takes from the family at its first active step: L.ArisesTaking W cs t f

name.en: enclosed around the family

statement.en: across each step the law names, some family without repetition that contains the family ds is closed: the step's exchange, with ds, lies within finitely many conditions (L.Around ds t)

name.en: enclosed around what stands

statement.en: across each step the law names (every step from T on, or the step from t), some family without repetition, closed across the step, holds whatever stands before or after it (L.AroundStanding stand t)

name.en: enclosed around what stands from T on, unrefuted

statement.en: across every step from T on, that the step is enclosed around what stands is not refuted (∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬¬ L.AroundStanding stand t)

name.en: balance at what f requires

statement.en: the flow balances at the step named on every condition f then requires: ∀ c, W.requires t f c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t

name.en: balance on what couples into the closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: each flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows: WithinClosure (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) f g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t (and L'.BalancesOn W' [c] t for the second flow); balance assumed nowhere else

name.en: balance on what couples into the pool's closure

statement.en: the flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a member of the group's pooled coupling closure: L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t

name.en: balance on what couples into formations outside the responsive reach

statement.en: each flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a formation outside the part's responsive reach: ¬ L.WithinResponse L' W obs part g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t (and for the second flow)

name.en: balance at a refining unit

statement.en: the flow balances at resolution r: across the step from t the unit splits into r t finer units, and each level after the step, with what is taken from it, is r t times its level before, with what is given to it (L.BalancesAt r W)

name.en: balance between the levels across the step

statement.en: the step from t balances between the levels l before and o after: every condition's level after, with what is taken from it, is its level before with what is given to it: ∀ x, o x + L.taken t x = l x + L.given t x (Flow.BalancesBetween l o t)

name.en: balance on a family across the step

statement.en: the flow balances on the family fam across the step from t: L.BalancesOn W fam t (balance assumed nowhere else)

name.en: balanced on the family over a stretch

statement.en: the flow balances on each condition of the family the law names (L.BalancesOn W ds t, ds the family, or [c] for the one condition c) at every step of the stretch the law names: level (t + 1) c + taken t c = level t c + given t c for every c in ds

name.en: below m from T on

statement.en: the level of the condition c is below m at every step from T (∀ n, W.level (T + n) c < m)

name.en: the level below m

statement.en: the level of the condition c (or of the course x) at the step the law names (t, T, or s) is below m: W.level t c < m

name.en: the beyond apart from the family

statement.en: no condition beyond is in the family: c ∈ rest → ¬ c ∈ ds

name.en: a formation beyond the coupling closure

statement.en: h lies beyond the center's coupling closure: ¬ L.WithinCoupling W obs (center p) h

name.en: each need beyond no weaker after the step

statement.en: after the step, the need of the formation named on each condition beyond is at least its need before: W.need t (dep c) c ≤ W.need (t + 1) (dep c) c for every c in rest

name.en: each condition beyond still required after the step

statement.en: after the step, the formation named on each condition beyond still requires it: W.requires (t + 1) (dep c) c for every c in rest

name.en: an exchange beyond the gap

statement.en: at each step the law names (one step t, or every step from T on), the joint exchange at c is not within the gap to m: ¬ L.WithinGap W m t c, so either what c gives falls short of what it takes by more than the level's excess over m, or what it takes falls short of what it gives by more than the level's shortfall below m

name.en: c in no holder's family

statement.en: the condition c is in no holder's family: ∀ h, holders h = true → ¬ c ∈ fam h

name.en: bounded giving per entry

statement.en: each formation present gives the family cs at most g across a step (Flow.Capacity cs g)

name.en: the configuration carries its history

statement.en: some reading of the family's configuration gives, at every step from T on, the count of its exchanges since T (L.CarriesHistory W cs T)

name.en: the closure responds through its couplings

statement.en: every member h of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows, wherever the flows are alike through h's couplings up to t, exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t with every condition coupled into a member of the closure

name.en: a common start

statement.en: the two flows start at the same level on every condition: W.level 0 c = W'.level 0 c for every c

name.en: the configuration changing at arbitrarily late steps

statement.en: the family's configuration changes at arbitrarily late steps: ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ W.Changes cs t

name.en: takes while active

statement.en: from T on, at every step at which g is active, g takes part in the flow and takes from c (g ∈ L.present t ∧ 0 < L.take t g c)

name.en: f active at every step

statement.en: the formation f is active at every step: ∀ t, W.active t f

name.en: something conveyed from the family at each step

statement.en: at each step of the stretch, some formation taking part takes from a member c of the family and gives to some d: ∃ c d, c ∈ ds ∧ L.Conveys t c d

name.en: dissipated on a family across a step

statement.en: across the step from t, every formation taking part gives the family cs no more than it takes from it, and at least one unit less where it takes (Flow.DissipatesOn cs t); at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch; on that family, not the World premise of dissipation on every closed family

name.en: loss in proportion

statement.en: across every step, every family without repetition closed across it is dissipated on in proportion q: what is given back is at most q parts in q + 1 of what is taken (L.DissipativeBy q); a research-note premise, not the theory's

name.en: each take within the slack

statement.en: each formation taking part at t takes from c no more than the slack: its take plus g's need is at most the level plus all given to c (∀ f ∈ L.present t, L.take t f c + W.need t g c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c)

name.en: equal totals at the start

statement.en: the two webs hold equal totals of the family and the beyond at t: W.stock ds t + W.stock rest t = W'.stock ds t + W'.stock rest t

name.en: the list holds every condition

statement.en: the list holds every condition: c ∈ all for every c (on a finite web of conditions, ∀ i, i ∈ cs)

name.en: every formation listed

statement.en: the list holds every formation: g ∈ members for every g

name.en: the flow exchanges without end

statement.en: at arbitrarily late steps some formation present takes or gives something (Flow.ExchangeRecurs L)

name.en: f a member

statement.en: the formation f read is a member of the family: member f

name.en: the family covered

statement.en: every condition of the family lies in some optimizer's family: ∀ c ∈ ds, ∃ i ∈ opt, c ∈ fam i

name.en: a family drawn beyond its renewal

statement.en: for n steps from T, what the flow gives to the family of conditions ds is less than what it takes from it (∀ k < n, L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k))

name.en: renewal gated on the family

statement.en: whatever formation gives to a member of the family ds across a step depends there on some member at a need of at least m: f ∈ L.present t → d ∈ ds → 0 < L.give t f d → ∃ e ∈ ds, W.requires t f e ∧ m ≤ W.need t f e

name.en: every part needs at least m from the race's end

statement.en: every part of the family needs at least m of c at every step from T + n on: g ∈ p :: ps → m ≤ W.need (T + n + k) g c

name.en: every part requires the condition from the race's end

statement.en: every part of the family requires c at every step from T + n on: g ∈ p :: ps → W.requires (T + n + k) g c

name.en: a family stock below n + m

statement.en: the family's stock at T is below the number of excess steps with the need: W.stock ds T < n + m

name.en: feeders unsupported

statement.en: from T on, every formation feeding g's continuation (taking part and giving to a condition g requires, at the same step) is unsupported there (L.FedBy W (g, t) (f, t) → ¬ W.Supported t f)

name.en: the rest follows the law

statement.en: outside the part, the flow exchanges as the law gives under its level history: part h = false → L.take t h c = law.take t h l c ∧ L.give t h c = law.give t h l c (Flow.Follows law part l); for each of the two flows the law names

name.en: a flow gaining nothing on closed families

statement.en: on every family without repetition closed across a step, each formation present gives it no more than it takes (Flow.Gainless); dissipation asks one unit less besides

name.en: the whole gains nothing across the step

statement.en: across the step from t, every formation taking part gives the family cs (the whole: the family with the conditions beyond it, or a family containing the family) no more than it takes from it (Flow.GainlessOn cs t); at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch

name.en: the gate at need m

statement.en: at each step the law uses (every step, or the first n + k steps from T), every formation taking part that gives to c requires c there at a need of at least m: f ∈ L.present t → 0 < L.give t f c → W.requires t f c ∧ m ≤ W.need t f c

name.en: every member of the generation takes part

statement.en: every member of the generation listed at a step takes part in the flow across that step: p ∈ G.family t → p ∈ L.present t; at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch

name.en: a generation's amount read as reaching beyond

statement.en: each member's amount in the generations is whether it reaches beyond across the step: G.amount t p = L.reach rest t p; at each step the law names, one step or every step

name.en: what is given bounded by B

statement.en: what is given to the condition c across every step is at most B: L.given t c ≤ B for every t

name.en: givers to what f requires supported

statement.en: every formation giving to a condition f requires at the step named is supported then: ∀ c, W.requires t f c → L.GiversSupported W t c

name.en: givers supported

statement.en: whatever takes part and gives to the condition c across the step is supported there (L.GiversSupported W t c), at each step the law names

name.en: a formation giving at the step

statement.en: the formation f gives something to the condition c across the step from t: 0 < L.give t f c

name.en: what the group couples into lies in the family

statement.en: every condition a member of the group couples into is in the family: members h → W.CoupledInto obs h c → c ∈ ds

name.en: a world grown by attachment

statement.en: the flow's links es grew by attachment, each link's condition is taken part in exactly by its two ends, every condition taken part in is an added one or a link's, and no link's condition is added (L.GrownBy W added es cond)

name.en: a held condition drawn while active

statement.en: a formation's held condition is taken from across a step at which the formation is unsupported and active (0 < L.taken t (hold f))

name.en: a held condition unreplenished

statement.en: nothing gives to a formation's held condition across a step at which the formation is unsupported (¬ W.Supported t f → L.given t (hold f) = 0)

name.en: holding its family's stock

statement.en: the holder's family's stock after the step is its stock before (at each of n steps from T, for each holder taking part): W.stock fam (t + 1) = W.stock fam t

name.en: readings inherited along descent

statement.en: whoever descends from a relatum carries its reading (∀ t x g, L.DescendsAt W t x g → read x = read g)

name.en: joint excess at the steps named

statement.en: across each step the law names (one step t, or each of n consecutive steps from T) the formations taking part together take from c more than is given to it: L.given t c < L.taken t c at each such step

name.en: the level at most m at T

statement.en: the level of c at T is at most m: W.level T c ≤ m

name.en: a line reaching a relatum before a step

statement.en: a member of one of the line's cohorts, a member then, at an earlier step took part and took from or gave to a condition the relatum requires at the step (L.LineReachesBefore W G t g)

name.en: living by taking

statement.en: the formation g is active only while it takes part and takes from c: at every t, W.active t g → g ∈ L.present t ∧ 0 < L.take t g c

name.en: losing on the family with c

statement.en: the holder gives its family and c, with its loss l, at most what it takes from them (at each of n steps from T, for each holder taking part, with loss lose (T + k) h): l + total fam (L.give t h) + L.give t h c ≤ total fam (L.take t h) + L.take t h c

name.en: losses together above what the rest gives

statement.en: at each of n steps from T the holders' losses together exceed what the formations outside the holders give c: L.restGiven holders (T + k) c < total (L.present (T + k)) (holders' losses)

name.en: a member of the family

statement.en: the condition e is a member of the family ds (e ∈ ds)

name.en: more without end

statement.en: the flow is more without end on the family: for every K, from some step on at least K formations take from it (Flow.More cs)

name.en: mutual dependence

statement.en: every formation lies within every formation's influence closure: every formation's continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other (L.MutuallyDependent W)

name.en: mutual dependence in time from a step

statement.en: from every formation at step t, every formation's continuation lies within its closure in time at some step (L.MutuallyDependentFrom W t)

name.en: mutual feeding

statement.en: every formation lies within every formation's feeding closure: every formation's continuation is fed, at some remove, by every other (L.MutuallyFed W)

name.en: a need of at least m

statement.en: the formation the law names (g, h or f) needs c at the steps the law names (one step, or every step) at a level of at least m: m ≤ W.need t g c

name.en: each need attained

statement.en: each need beyond is attained by some eligible outcome keeping every dependence beyond: ∀ c ∈ rest, ∃ o, (eligible o ∧ ∀ c' ∈ rest, W.need t (dep c') c' ≤ o c') ∧ o c ≤ W.need t (dep c) c

name.en: needs met at the start

statement.en: every formation's need of c at every step is at most the level of c at step 0: W.requires t e c → W.need t e c ≤ W.level 0 c

name.en: net giving at the condition

statement.en: across step t, c is given more than is taken from it: L.taken t c < L.given t c

name.en: net giving while not below the start

statement.en: at each of the m − level steps from T at which c's level is not below its level at T, c is given more than is taken from it: ∀ k, k < m − W.level T c → W.level T c ≤ W.level (T + k) c → L.taken (T + k) c < L.given (T + k) c

name.en: no member supported at T

statement.en: no member of the family is supported at T: ∀ f, member f → ¬ W.Supported T f

name.en: no raise below m

statement.en: from T on, wherever the level of c is below m, what the flow gives to c is no more than what it takes from it (∀ t, T ≤ t → W.level t c < m → L.given t c ≤ L.taken t c)

name.en: nothing supported at T

statement.en: no formation is supported at T: ∀ f, ¬ W.Supported T f

name.en: only members giving to what members require

statement.en: from T on, only members give to a condition a member requires: ∀ n f c, member f → W.requires (T + n) f c → ∀ g ∈ L.present (T + n), 0 < L.give (T + n) g c → member g

name.en: an exchange opposing the departure

statement.en: at each step the law names, the joint exchange at c opposes the departure from m: where the level is above m, c is given less than is taken from it, and where it is below m, less is taken than given (L.Opposes W m t c; for a family, each condition with its own m)

name.en: the other takes part

statement.en: the other formation g takes part at each step the law names (one step, each of n steps from T, or every step): g ∈ L.present t

name.en: the other takes from c

statement.en: the other formation g takes from c at each step the law names (one step, each of n steps from T, or every step): 0 < L.take t g c

name.en: a formation outside the part

statement.en: the formation h is outside the acting part: part h = false

name.en: own closure within the coupling closure

statement.en: the center's closure under the relation lies within its coupling closure: WithinClosure rel (center p) g → L.WithinCoupling W obs (center p) g

name.en: the part acts alike with the condition after s

statement.en: from s on, every member of the part takes from and gives to c alike in the two courses: s ≤ t → part h = true → L.take t h c = L'.take t h c ∧ L.give t h c = L'.give t h c

name.en: the part beyond the pool's closure

statement.en: no member of the part lies within the group's pooled coupling closure: part h = true → ¬ L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group h

name.en: the pool within the group's closure

statement.en: every member of the pool lies within the group's pooled coupling closure: pool g → L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group g

name.en: the pool within the group's closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: every member of the pool lies within the group's coupling closure drawn through both flows (or courses): pool g → WithinClosureOf (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) group g

name.en: a formation taking part at the step

statement.en: the formation named takes part in the flow across the step from t: f ∈ L.present t

name.en: a formation raising the family

statement.en: across the step from t the formation f gives the family ds more than it takes from it (Flow.RaisesOn ds t f)

name.en: reaching beyond carried to offspring

statement.en: at every step of the stretch, each offspring of a member taking from the conditions beyond takes from them at the next step: 0 < total rest (L.take t p) → k ∈ G.kids t p → 0 < total rest (L.take (t + 1) k)

name.en: a formation whose acts return

statement.en: whatever the formation can affect can affect it (Flow.ReachReturns W f)

name.en: the courses alike again at the condition

statement.en: the two courses are alike at c at s + N: W.level (s + N) c = W'.level (s + N) c

name.en: a relation within coupling in

statement.en: whatever the relation relates to a formation exchanges with a condition coupled into it: rel g h → L.CoupledFrom W obs g h

name.en: a relay reading late

statement.en: the exchange at c is the relay reading ℓ steps late: for every t, what c is given at t + ℓ is M where its level at t is below a and nothing otherwise, and what is taken from it at t + ℓ is M where its level at t is above b and nothing otherwise

name.en: requiring c alone

statement.en: whatever any formation requires at any step is the condition c: W.requires t e d → d = c

name.en: requires the condition while active

statement.en: from T on, g requires the condition c at every step at which it is active

name.en: the rest responds through its couplings

statement.en: each formation outside the part exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t wherever the flows are alike through its couplings up to t (Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling L' W W' obs part)

name.en: nothing within the responsive reach exchanges with the condition from s

statement.en: from s on, no formation within the part's responsive reach takes from or gives to c in either flow

name.en: the rest outruns the renewal

statement.en: at each step the law names (one step t, or each of n steps from T), the rest takes from c jointly more than is given to it: L.given t c < total rest (fun f => L.take t f c)

name.en: the rest's takers take part

statement.en: each member of the rest (a list of formations) that takes from c at a step the law names takes part there: at each such step t, f ∈ rest → 0 < L.take t f c → f ∈ L.present t

name.en: e covers the excess

statement.en: e is at least the excess of the need n with what the other flow takes over the level with what it gives: n + L.taken t c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c + e

name.en: giving no less

statement.en: the restrained flow gives c no less than the other: L.given t c ≤ L'.given t c

name.en: a level as high

statement.en: the restrained flow's level of c at the step is at least the other's: W.level t c ≤ W'.level t c

name.en: taking less by e

statement.en: the restrained flow takes from c at least e less than the other: L'.taken t c + e ≤ L.taken t c

name.en: more offspring only to raisers

statement.en: within a generation, a member with more offspring than another raises the family across the step: G.offspringNumber t p < G.offspringNumber t q → L.RaisesOn ds t q; at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch

name.en: a rise past the inflow

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by more than the inflow of the containing family: W.stock ds t + L.inflow es t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a rise past the slack

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a rise past the slack and the inflow

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond with the whole's inflow: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t + L.inflow (ds ++ rest) t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a rise with the loss past the slack

statement.en: the family's rise with what the whole loses across the step exceeds the slack of the dependences beyond: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1) + L.lost (ds ++ rest) t

name.en: more rising steps than the bound

statement.en: the take rises at more steps than the bound on what is given: B < n

name.en: the seeker active while the level is at least m

statement.en: from T on, the seeker is active at every step at which the level of c is at least m: m ≤ W.level (T + j) c → W.active (T + j) f

name.en: the seeker takes part while active

statement.en: at every step the seeker f is active, it takes part in the flow: W.active t f → f ∈ L.present t

name.en: the selection fails of the second flow

statement.en: the selection does not hold of the second flow's levels: ¬ select W'.level

name.en: the selection holds

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels: select W.level

name.en: a selection holding only where the family rises

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step: select W.level → W.stock ds t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a selection holding only where the family rises past the inflow

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step by more than the containing family's inflow: select W.level → W.stock ds t + L.inflow es t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a selection holding only where the family rises past the slack

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond: select W.level → W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: the set point past the slack

statement.en: the set point's total with what the whole loses across the step exceeds the family's stock before with the slack of the dependences beyond: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < total ds s + L.lost (ds ++ rest) t

name.en: the share moved over the stretch

statement.en: the share reaching beyond at the end of the stretch differs from the share at its start, compared by cross-multiplying: G.size 0 * G.sum T ≠ G.size T * G.sum 0

name.en: a common start on what couples into the closure

statement.en: the two flows start alike on every condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows: W.level 0 c = W'.level 0 c

name.en: a common start outside the responsive reach

statement.en: the two flows start alike on every condition coupled into a formation outside the part's responsive reach

name.en: a start below n + m

statement.en: the level of c at T is below n + m, n the number of steps from T across which more is taken from c than is given to it (by the rest, or jointly) and m the need: W.level T c < n + m (n + 1 where the need is one)

name.en: a start below n with g's need

statement.en: the level of c at T is below the n steps of joint excess with the need of g on c at T + n: W.level T c < n + W.need (T + n) g c

name.en: a step after the start

statement.en: the step t read lies after T: T < t

name.en: a step from T

statement.en: the step t is not before T (T ≤ t)

name.en: a step past the gap

statement.en: the step t read is at least T plus the gap at T between the level and m: T + gap (W.level T c) m ≤ t (for a family, for each condition)

name.en: a step past the shortfall

statement.en: the step t read is at least T plus the shortfall below m at T: T + (m − W.level T c) ≤ t

name.en: the family's stock rises across the step

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step from t: W.stock ds t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a family within a containing family

statement.en: every condition of a family is in the containing family the law names: c ∈ ds → c ∈ es (in the dissipation laws, c ∈ cs → c ∈ ds)

name.en: support gained at arbitrarily late steps

statement.en: some formation gains support at arbitrarily late steps: ∀ N, ∃ t f, N ≤ t ∧ W.GainsSupport t f

name.en: support held at most K steps running

statement.en: no formation is supported at K + 1 consecutive steps from the steps the law names: ¬ ∀ i, i ≤ K → W.Supported (t + i) g

name.en: g active only while supported

statement.en: at the step the law names, the formation g is active only where it is supported there: W.active t g → W.Supported t g (Dependent for g at that step only)

name.en: h takes part

statement.en: the formation h takes part at the step t: h ∈ L.present t

name.en: TakesAll

statement.en: f takes all that is given to c across the step from t: f takes part and takes at least L.given t c (Flow.TakesAll), at each step the law names (one step, each of n steps from T, or every step)

name.en: taking while supported (upkeep)

statement.en: from T on, every formation supported at a step takes part in it and takes at least a unit from the family cs (Flow.TakesWhileSupported L W cs T)

name.en: taking from the family recurs

statement.en: formations take from the family at arbitrarily late steps: for every N there is a step t ≥ N with 0 < L.takers cs t

name.en: transmission from some giver

statement.en: each dependence on c a relatum holds as it comes to stand was held by some relatum giving to it, and the relatum needs c at most δ more than that giver did (L.TransmitsFromSome W c δ)

name.en: unfed while active

statement.en: from T on, at every step at which g is active, nothing that takes part and is supported gives to the condition c (L.give t f c = 0)

name.en: uptake without end

statement.en: the family is taken from, a positive uptake, at arbitrarily late steps (∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ 0 < L.uptake cs t)

name.en: within the coupling closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: g lies within f's closure under being affected through what couples in, in either of the two flows (or the two courses the laws name): WithinClosure (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) f g

name.en: within the group's closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: h lies within the group's coupling closure drawn through both flows: WithinClosureOf (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) group h

name.en: an exchange within the gap

statement.en: at each step the law names, the joint exchange at c is within the gap to m: what is taken exceeds what is given by at most the level's excess over m, and what is given exceeds what is taken by at most its shortfall below m (L.WithinGap W m t c; for a family, each condition with its own m)

name.en: WithinJoint

statement.en: together the formations taking part take from c across the step from t no more than the step gives it: L.taken t c ≤ L.given t c

name.en: every formation a center

statement.en: every formation is some standpoint's center: ∀ f, ∃ p, center p = f

name.en: a formation whose acts return

statement.en: some formation's acts return: ∃ c, L.ReachReturns W c (whatever it can affect can affect it)

name.en: a confined rise

statement.en: a rise within a whole drawing on a family in excess (the lineage founded in the first generation, marked by an amount selection within goes for before the end, drawing on the family during the excess; the family's renewal under the coupled gate; n steps of excess from a stock below n + m), confined to the family from T + n on (Founding.Flow.ConfinedRise L W G h ds m T n)

name.en: a confined lineage

statement.en: from step T + n on, every member of the lineage of h depends on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m

name.en: a group of the first generation

statement.en: every member of the group h is of the first generation (∀ p ∈ h, p ∈ G.family 0)

name.en: a member of a later generation

statement.en: x is a member of the generation of descent at step T + n + k + 1 (x ∈ G.family (T + n + k + 1))

name.en: wholes founded by one part

statement.en: each whole is founded by its one founder, which carries the whole's founding value, and each next founding is a member of the whole at its span carrying there what it carries as a founder (Founding.Nested.Founded)

name.en: sequestered

statement.en: each next founder carries its founder's value (Founding.Nested.Sequestered): an outcome, not a mechanism

name.en: a choice at no risk

statement.en: the chooser's choice at the level read at T + n + k has no risk: ch.risk l (ch.chosen l) = 0 for l = W.level (T + n + k) c

name.en: a member outside the rest

statement.en: the member g is not in the rest: ¬ g ∈ rest

name.en: a preferred level at least the need

statement.en: the chooser's preferred level is at least the need m: m ≤ ch.preferred

name.en: a member taking its chooser's choice

statement.en: at every step it takes part, the member g takes from c what its chooser chooses at its reading there: g ∈ L.present t → L.take t g c = ch.chosen (reading t)

name.en: one of the two steps the takers take part

statement.en: the step t is one of the first two, at which the takers take part: t < 2

name.en: first supported at its step

statement.en: each formation f n is supported at at_ n and at no step from T before it (∀ n, W.FirstSupported T (at_ n) (f n))

name.en: each new formation's needs fixed within the family

statement.en: each formation f n requires, at every step and with the same need, only members of the family cs (∀ n, W.RequiresWithin cs (f n))

name.en: the rest gives the whole nothing net

statement.en: from T on, the rest of the world is at no step a net giver to the list all (∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬ (L.withImbalance W).NetGiver all t none)

name.en: the steps from T on

statement.en: every step at_ n is at or after T (∀ n, T ≤ at_ n)

name.en: the steps rise

statement.en: the steps at_ n rise strictly with n (∀ i j, i < j → at_ i < at_ j)

name.en: the stock rises across the step

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step from t (W.stock cs t < W.stock cs (t + 1))

name.en: the quantity changed

statement.en: the quantity at the course's end differs from that at its start (q t ≠ q s)

name.en: fails at the end

statement.en: the property p fails at the course's end (¬ p t)

name.en: holds at the end

statement.en: the property p holds at the course's end (p t)

name.en: holds at the start

statement.en: the property p holds at the course's start (p s)

name.en: ungated steps keep the quantity

statement.en: every step by an ungated move keeps the quantity q (Gated.KeptBy P gate q)

name.en: a course of ungated moves

statement.en: every move of the course is ungated (∀ a ∈ plan, gate a = false)

name.en: ungated steps preserve the property

statement.en: every step by an ungated move preserves p: holding before the step, it holds after (Gated.PreservedBy P gate p)

name.en: ungated steps reflect the property

statement.en: every step by an ungated move reflects p: holding after the step, it held before (Gated.ReflectedBy P gate p)

name.en: never exhausted (不穷)

statement.en: x is never exhausted under the class: x and every point after it along its line of continuation has a continuation («不穷» R L x)

name.en: «及» (reach)

statement.en: t is reached from c by a finite chain of steps of R («及» R c t)

name.en: generation at an order (阶生成)

statement.en: x generates at order k of a sequence of classes: generation («生成») under the class Es (k + 1) with renewal read at Es k («阶生成» R Es k x)

name.en: «类» (a class)

statement.en: the relation E is a class: reflexive, symmetric and transitive

name.en: «亡» (ends)

statement.en: the occurrence ends under E: nothing continues it under E (¬ «有后» R E y)

name.en: a relation with no cycle (无环)

statement.en: the relation has no cycle: nothing reaches itself («无环» rel)

name.en: «相续» (a line of continuation)

statement.en: a line of continuation under the class E runs from x to y: y is reached from x by steps each of which R relates and E holds alike («相续» R E x y)

name.en: «续» (a step of continuation)

statement.en: y continues x under the class E: x is a condition of y (R x y) and the two are alike under E («续» R E x y)

name.en: «有常» (constant)

statement.en: the class E is constant under R: wherever u and u' are alike under E and u conditions v, u' conditions some v' alike to v (∀ u u', E u u' → ∀ v, R u v → ∃ v', R u' v' ∧ E v v', the pointwise form «有常之逐点» of «有常» R E)

name.en: a predecessor in a line (有前)

statement.en: x has a predecessor in a line under L: some point continues into x («有前» R L x)

name.en: the line starts inside

statement.en: the line's start x is a member of the region P (P x)

lean: Becoming.«定则内至外之线有出步»

name.en: the line ends outside

statement.en: the line's end y is outside the region P (¬ P y)

lean: Becoming.«定则内至外之线有出步»

name.en: every step keeps to the region or goes out

statement.en: every step of continuation under E either keeps to P, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes out of P, from a member to something outside (∀ u v, «续» R E u v → (P u → P v) ∨ (P u ∧ ¬ P v))

name.en: stable membership

statement.en: membership in the region P is stable: whatever is not outside P lies in P (∀ y, ¬ ¬ P y → P y)

lean: Becoming.«不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»

name.en: a symmetric relation

statement.en: the relation R lies within its converse: R x y gives R y x («则» R («逆» R))

lean: Becoming.«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出»

name.en: the courses of falls end

statement.en: every course of steps within Q's closure followed by an F step ends on every branch from the line's place at T («尽» («而» («所闭» Q) F) «一» (g T))

name.en: the falls recur

statement.en: the steps of F recur along the line g: after every place, a later step of g is a step of F («屡» F g)

name.en: no rise from T on

statement.en: from T on, each step of the line g is a step of Q (∀ t, T ≤ t → Q (g t) (g (t + 1)))

name.en: no rise from T on, unrefuted

statement.en: from T on, each step of the line g is, as far as can be refuted, a step of Q (∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬¬ Q (g t) (g (t + 1)))

name.en: excluded middle as a hypothesis

statement.en: excluded middle, taken as a hypothesis of the law: ∀ P : Prop, P ∨ ¬ P

name.en: «尽» (ends on every branch)

statement.en: x ends on every branch under R and L: every continuation from x ends on every branch, inductively («尽» R L x)

name.en: a single line

statement.en: the course is a single line: each point has at most one next under R (∀ z w w', R z w → R z w' → w = w')

name.en: «所及» (reached on the line)

statement.en: y is x, or lies on a line under L from x («所及» R L x y)

name.en: an occurrence alike to the member

statement.en: the occurrence c is alike to the member m under E (E c m)

name.en: «本类至终有常» (constant up to the net's end at the member's class)

statement.en: whatever an occurrence alike to the member conditions, every occurrence alike to the member conditions something alike to it, unless that occurrence conditions nothing at all («本类至终有常» R E m)

name.en: the class holding nothing the line must pass

statement.en: the class makes no member of C alike to the start (∀ c, C c → ¬ E x c)

name.en: everything downstream on the line

statement.en: everything downstream of the member m lies on its line under E (∀ t, «及» R m t → «所及» R E m t)

name.en: an end outside the region

statement.en: the end y is outside the region (P y = false)

name.en: steps out of a region landing in C

statement.en: every step under the class E from inside the region P to outside it lands in C (∀ u v, P u = true → «续» R E u v → P v = false → C v)

name.en: a last stage still conditioning something

statement.en: the occurrence y at which the line ends still conditions something (∃ w, R y w)

lean: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»

name.en: an occurrence alike from the member

statement.en: the member m is related by E to the occurrence (E m x), the member first; for any relation E, a class or not

lean: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»

name.en: the member conditions something

statement.en: the member m conditions something (∃ w, R m w)

name.en: «所缘同于» (the class holds the member's effects)

statement.en: everything the member m conditions is alike to it under E («所缘同于» R E m)

name.en: «至终有常» (constant up to the net's end)

statement.en: whatever an alike occurrence conditions, this one conditions something alike to it, unless this one conditions nothing at all («至终有常» R E)

name.en: a line kept under the core

statement.en: a line under the core of E runs from x to y: y is reached from x by steps each continuing under «核» R E («相续» R («核» R E) x y)

name.en: a step kept under the core

statement.en: y continues x under the core of E: R x y and the core «核» R E (the greatest symmetric relation inside E constant under R) makes x and y alike («续» R («核» R E) x y)

name.en: the cohort after the window coupled to the family

statement.en: every member of the cohort at step T + n + k depends then on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m

name.en: groups with less leave nothing

statement.en: every listed group with less of the amount than another listed group leaves no offspring (GroupEnding.Ended gs w a)

name.en: groups of equal size

statement.en: every listed group has m members (∀ g ∈ gs, g.length = m)

name.en: a generation inactive

statement.en: no member of the generation at t is active there

name.en: a listed group

statement.en: the group named is one of the listed groups (g ∈ gs)

name.en: every group depends on the family

statement.en: every member of every listed group depends at T + n + k on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m

name.en: the groups in the generation

statement.en: every member of every listed group is in the generation at T + n + k

name.en: the groups list the generation

statement.en: the listed groups together list the generation at the step named (SelectionLevels.whole gs = G.family t)

name.en: the group with more leaves offspring

statement.en: the group g leaves offspring: its offspring numbers total is positive

name.en: one group holds less

statement.en: the group h holds less of the amount than the group g (total h a < total g a)

name.en: groups with less depend on the family

statement.en: every member of a listed group with less of the amount than another depends at T + n + k on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m

name.en: groups with less inactive

statement.en: every member of a listed group with less of the amount than another listed group is inactive at the step t

name.en: groups uniform in the amount

statement.en: each listed group is uniform in the amount: all its members hold one value

name.en: a passing cut certificate

statement.en: the cut certificate for the edge e in the growing state s passes (cutCertificate s e = true)

name.en: the held possible keeps widening along the course

statement.en: read from the course's configurations, the possible with the part read by Same held keeps widening (Reaching.KeepsWidening fun n => Reaching.PossibleHeld P Same adm (r.state n)), Same given as the rule kept on an adaptive process or the rules from height n up on a rule tower where a law names one

name.en: the possible under Q keeps widening along the course

statement.en: read from the course's configurations, the possible under Q keeps widening: nothing possible at a step is lost later, and after every step something not possible there is possible later (Reaching.KeepsWidening fun n => Reaching.Possible Q adm (r.state n))

name.en: a list holds the whole possible

statement.en: some list holds everything possible from the course's start (∃ ys, ∀ x, Reaching.Possible P adm (r.state 0) x → x ∈ ys)

name.en: the course comes back to one configuration

statement.en: the course comes back to its configuration at N at arbitrarily late steps (∀ d, ∃ m, N + d ≤ m ∧ r.state m = r.state N)

name.en: what is held stays from T on

statement.en: from T on every step of the course holds the part read by Same (∀ n, T ≤ n → Same (r.state n) (r.state (n + 1)))

name.en: a stretch of moves of Q

statement.en: the course's d steps from N are moves of Q (∀ i, i < d → Q.step (r.state (N + i)) (r.act (N + i)) (r.state (N + i + 1)))

name.en: moves of Q from N on

statement.en: from N on every step of the course is a move of Q (∀ n, N ≤ n → Q.step (r.state n) (r.act n) (r.state (n + 1)))

name.en: a step before the sixty-fourth

statement.en: the step p read is before the sixty-fourth: p < 64

name.en: a step before the twelfth

statement.en: the step p read is before the twelfth: p < 12

name.en: a step after the start

statement.en: the step p read is after the start: 0 < p

name.en: what is active lies in the family from T on

statement.en: at every step from T on, every active relatum is a member of ds (∀ t, T ≤ t → ∀ x, w.web.active t x → x ∈ ds)

name.en: a level changes across the step, in the amounts

statement.en: c's level rises or falls across the step from t, read in the amounts (v.Rises M t c ∨ v.Falls M t c)

name.en: a member of the family

statement.en: c is a member of the family ds (c ∈ ds)

name.en: the total read off the configuration

statement.en: from T on, the total standing (of the family ds, or of the census alive t) at t is q of the configuration g t (∀ t, T ≤ t → v.stock M ds t = q (g t))

name.en: invariant

statement.en: the region R is invariant under the process P: every admissible step from inside R stays inside (Invariant P R)

name.en: a decision of the joint keepability

statement.en: the Boolean rule kj decides the keepability of both guards of ChoicePoint together: kj s = true exactly where some run from s stays within both, at every configuration s

name.en: a decision of the first guard's keepability

statement.en: the Boolean rule k₁ decides the keepability of the first guard of ChoicePoint: k₁ s = true exactly where some run from s stays within it, at every configuration s

name.en: a decision of the second guard's keepability

statement.en: the Boolean rule k₂ decides the keepability of the second guard of ChoicePoint: k₂ s = true exactly where some run from s stays within it, at every configuration s

name.en: a plan realized

statement.en: the joint plan p is realized at s: its leaves are supported by footprints and its pairs by divisions J (JointPlan.Realizes J (Supports footprint) s p)

name.en: balance on the family from a step

statement.en: from T₀ on, the flow balances on the family cs: each member's level after a step, with what is taken from it, is its level before, with what is given to it (∀ t, T₀ ≤ t → L.BalancesOn W cs t); balance assumed on that family only

name.en: the continuation contains carrying on of the supported

statement.en: every formation supported at a step continues itself along R there (∀ t f, W.Supported t f → R t f f)

name.en: the continuation contains carrying on or passing support

statement.en: R holds wherever a formation carries on as itself, supported or not, or passes support to another (∀ t g f, Web.passingContinuation (L.PassesSupport W) t g f → R t g f)

name.en: the continuation contains carrying on while supported, or passing support

statement.en: R holds wherever a supported formation carries on as itself or one formation passes support to another (∀ t g f, W.supportedPassing (L.PassesSupport W) t g f → R t g f)

name.en: a list holds every required condition

statement.en: every condition any formation requires at any step lies in the list all (∀ t f c, W.requires t f c → c ∈ all)

name.en: needs fixed within a family

statement.en: from T on, every formation supported at a step requires, at every step and with the same need, only members of the family cs (∀ t f, T ≤ t → W.Supported t f → W.RequiresWithin cs f)

name.en: from T on

statement.en: the step S is at or after T (T ≤ S)

name.en: running as the kind relay

statement.en: the web and flow run as the kind relay: a formation is supported at t exactly where it holds at t's parity, and g passes support to f exactly where the relay gives at that parity (KindRelay.Runs W L)

name.en: every step but a renewal lowering a rank

statement.en: along the run, every step that is not a renewal lowers the natural-number rank of the configuration

name.en: every step lowering a reserve

statement.en: every admissible step of the process lowers the natural-number reserve of the configuration (P.step s a t → reserve t < reserve s)

name.en: the bound within d of the start's mark

statement.en: the bound B is at most d more than the mark at the start (B ≤ d + q s)

name.en: m + 1 changes at rising positions

statement.en: f gives m + 1 positions, rising up to m, and the run r changes across the step at each (LastChange.Changes r f m)

name.en: the mark bounded along the orbit

statement.en: the mark of every configuration along the orbit from s is at most B (∀ n, q (Law.orbit next s n) ≤ B)

name.en: no change within a loop

statement.en: the run r does not change within a loop: there are no i, p, c with its state at i + (p + 1) its state at i, c ≤ p, and a change across the step at i + c (¬ Settling.ChangesInLoop r)

name.en: no reachable change can be undone

statement.en: no configuration reachable from s has a step to another configuration from which it can be reached again (¬ ∃ x a y, Reach P s x ∧ P.step x a y ∧ y ≠ x ∧ Reach P y x)

name.en: the run starts at s

statement.en: the run's state at 0 is s (r.state 0 = s)

name.en: every reachable staying configuration meets the target
