statement.en: there are at least two drawers: 2 ≤ k (in Lean 1 < k is the same proposition)

name.en: capacity for the level held with q down to the end

statement.en: the capacity k covers y with q down to the end e: y + q ≤ e + k

name.en: capacity for the level held with q down to the need

statement.en: the capacity k covers y with q down to the need m: y + q ≤ m + k

name.en: capacity for the level held with r down to the end

statement.en: the capacity k covers y with r down to the end e: y + r ≤ e + k

name.en: what all draw later not falling

statement.en: what all draw later does not fall: all ≤ all'

name.en: leaving r draws no less than leaving the floor

statement.en: of a, leaving r draws no less now and later than leaving the floor: a − low + C low ≤ a − r + C r

name.en: a drawer leaving nothing

statement.en: the drawer u leaves nothing at every step before the horizon: ∀ t < N, ∀ a, rules u t a = 0

name.en: one of the k drawers

statement.en: the drawer named (d, u or v) is one of the k drawers: d < k

name.en: at least the floor left

statement.en: what is left, r, is at least the floor: low ≤ r

name.en: floors within what is given

statement.en: every floor is at most what is given: ∀ d t a, low d t a ≤ a

name.en: a horizon of at least one step

statement.en: the horizon is at least one step: 0 < N

name.en: the last c steps

statement.en: the step t leaves a fixed number of steps to the horizon: t + c = N (t + j = N; t + c + 1 = N in position_perfect_ends)

name.en: the last step

statement.en: the step t is the last before the horizon: t + 1 = N

name.en: nothing kept returns

statement.en: what leaving r brings later is what leaving the floor brings: C r = C low

name.en: least from nothing

statement.en: what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left: ∀ t x, G t 0 ≤ G t x

name.en: every rule within what it is given

statement.en: every rule of the profile (of every profile of the sequence) leaves at most what it is given: rules d t a ≤ a

name.en: at most what is given left

statement.en: what is left, r, is at most what is given, a: r ≤ a

name.en: a drawer with no floor

statement.en: the drawer named (u or v) has no floor: ∀ t a, low u t a = 0

name.en: its own later draw the same

statement.en: the drawer's own later draw is the same whatever it keeps: own' = own

name.en: InTurn.Perfect

statement.en: the profile is perfect over N steps, drawing in turn: it revises itself, every drawer at a best response at every step from every level (Optimum.InTurn.Perfect G low rules k N)

name.en: InTurn.PerfectPosition

statement.en: the profile is perfect for position over N steps: it revises itself for position (Optimum.InTurn.PerfectPosition G rules k N)

name.en: leaving r ranks no lower for position

statement.en: leaving r of a ranks for position no lower than leaving nothing: k * (a + own) + (a − through + all') ≤ k * (a − r + own') + (a + all)

name.en: InTurn.Revises

statement.en: the profile rules' revises rules over N steps, drawing in turn: each rule leaves between its floor and all of what it is given, and at every step from every level leaves what draws its drawer the most against rules (Optimum.InTurn.Revises G low rules rules' k N; along a sequence, each profile revising the one before)

name.en: InTurn.RevisesPosition

statement.en: the profile rules' revises rules for position over N steps, drawing in turn: each drawer leaves what ranks its position highest, k times its own draw against what all draw, over the steps that remain (Optimum.InTurn.RevisesPosition G rules rules' k N)

name.en: a late enough round

statement.en: the round m is at least p c: p * c ≤ m

name.en: at least two rounds a step

statement.en: the rounds of revision counted per step of the horizon, p, are at least two: 2 ≤ p

name.en: three rounds unless u is first

statement.en: u is the first drawer, or p is at least three: u = 0 ∨ 3 ≤ p

name.en: a step before the horizon

statement.en: the step named (s or t) is before the horizon N: s < N

name.en: a step from t

statement.en: the step s is at or after t: t ≤ s

name.en: what passes through within what is kept

statement.en: what passes through to the others' draw is at most what the drawer keeps (r, or b): through ≤ r

name.en: two drawers in order

statement.en: the drawer u comes before the drawer v: u < v

name.en: h an optimizer

statement.en: the formation h is an optimizer: optimizer h = true

name.en: k above r

statement.en: the withdrawal k exceeds the renewal r: r < k

name.en: a coupling of keeping at most w

statement.en: on an open course keeping its level at m or above through the horizon (Optimum.Keeps m n a), the worth exceeds the valued draw by at most w: worth a ≤ drawnOver R a (n + 1) + v * a (n + 1) + w

name.en: a keeping course drawing the most

statement.en: the keeping course K draws with what it leaves, e, the start with what is given there and q for each step after: drawnOver R K (n + 1) + e = s + R s + q n

name.en: a keeping course worth at least its coupling

statement.en: the keeping course K is worth at least what it draws with c for each of the n + 1 steps: drawnOver R K (n + 1) + c (n + 1) ≤ worth K

name.en: what is left bounded by y + r

statement.en: no open course leaves more than y + r at the horizon: ∀ a, OpenCourse R k s a → a (n + 1) ≤ y + r

name.en: renewal at the need below the greatest

statement.en: the renewal at or above the need is below the greatest: q < r

name.en: the level law

statement.en: the level of c (the course x, or W.level · c) follows the level law: x (t + 1) = x t + g t − d t at every step, g given and d drawn (in keeping_draws_more, of the second course too)

name.en: a horizon of at least two steps

statement.en: the horizon counts at least one step after the first: 0 < n

name.en: a long course

statement.en: the course is long against its start: x 0 + r * x 0 < r * n

name.en: an outcome below the bound

statement.en: the outcome low stands at c below B: low c < B

name.en: a coupling at least the need

statement.en: the need is at most the coupling a step: m ≤ c

name.en: a coupling above the need

statement.en: the need is below the coupling a step: m < c

name.en: the start meets the need

statement.en: the start s is at or above the need m: m ≤ s

name.en: MutualBest

statement.en: a mutual best response across the step from t: each optimizer taking part acts within its capacity, and the levels o are an optimum of its order among the outcomes open to it alone, every other formation exchanging as it does (Optimum.MutualBest L optimizer l cap ds rest better t o)

name.en: Nearing

statement.en: the order nears the set point s of the family: it ranks above every outcome nearer s on the family, whatever either holds elsewhere (Optimum.Nearing ds s better; for each optimizer, its family and order)

name.en: the level held meets the need

statement.en: the level y held is at or above the need: m ≤ y

name.en: levels at or above m gain less

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, every level z at or above m gains, weighted, less than the level h leaves: m ≤ z → w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z + w t * h (t + 1) < w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) (h (t + 1)) + w t * z

name.en: capacity covering what stands at nothing

statement.en: the capacity covers what stands at nothing at every step: ∀ t, G t 0 ≤ k (G the law of what stands the law names: leftBy R K where others draw first, z + R z on the fixed-renewal laws, where it reads R 0 ≤ k)

name.en: capacity covering what stands at the start

statement.en: the capacity covers what stands at the start: G 0 s ≤ k (G the law of what stands the law names: leftBy R K where others draw first, z + R z on the fixed-renewal laws)

name.en: capacity covering what stands at y

statement.en: the capacity covers what stands at y at every step: ∀ t, G t y ≤ k

name.en: capacity drawing down to y

statement.en: the capacity covers what the first step draws down to y: G 0 s ≤ y + k (on the fixed-renewal laws, s + R s ≤ y + k)

name.en: the course leaves nothing at the last step

statement.en: the course h stands at nothing after the last step: h (n + 1) = 0

name.en: the weighted gain rising up to y

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, the weighted gain rises with the level up to y: z ≤ z' → z' ≤ y → w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z + w t * z' ≤ w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z' + w t * z

name.en: the weighted gain rising strictly up to y

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y: z < z' → z' ≤ y → w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z + w t * z' < w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z' + w t * z

name.en: Next.GainsMost

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, the level h leaves gains, weighted, at least what the level any course open from s leaves there does (Optimum.Next.GainsMost w G k s n h)

name.en: a level of greatest weighted gain

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, the level held (h (t + 1), or y for the course holding y) gains, weighted, at least what any level z does: w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z + w t * h (t + 1) ≤ w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) (h (t + 1)) + w t * z

name.en: what stands rising with the level below y

statement.en: what stands rises with the level up to y: z ≤ z' → z' ≤ y → G t z ≤ G t z'

name.en: what stands at y at least y

statement.en: what stands at y is at least y at every step: ∀ t, y ≤ G t y

name.en: nothing stands at nothing

statement.en: what stands at nothing is nothing at every step: ∀ t, G t 0 = 0

name.en: Next.Open

statement.en: the course is open under the law of what stands G from s with capacity k: it starts at s, and each step leaves at most what stands and draws at most k (Optimum.Next.Open G k s x)

name.en: others drawing first more than the renewal

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, for every positive level z, what others leave with its renewal by R is below z: 0 < z → K (t + 1) z + R (K (t + 1) z) < z

name.en: a level rising faster than the weighting falls

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, the level y rises faster than the weighting falls: w t * y < w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) y

name.en: the weighting outpaces what stands

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, for every positive level z, the weighting falls at least as fast as what stands at z rises over it: 0 < z → w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z ≤ w t * z

name.en: the weighting outpaces what stands, strictly

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, for every positive level z, the weighting falls faster than what stands at z rises over it: 0 < z → w (t + 1) * G (t + 1) z < w t * z

name.en: y within reach

statement.en: the level y is within what stands at the start: y ≤ G 0 s (on the fixed-renewal laws, G t z = z + R z, so y ≤ s + R s)

name.en: the rising course below y

statement.en: the course rising as fast as what stands allows from s stands below y after the step t + 1: Next.rise G y s (t + 1) < y

name.en: rising with the weighted draw

statement.en: the order ranks a course above another wherever its weighted draw across n + 1 steps is greater: ∀ a b, Next.weighted w G a (n + 1) < Next.weighted w G b (n + 1) → better b a (G the law of what stands the law names: leftBy R K where others draw first, z + R z on the fixed-renewal laws, where it reads weightedOver w R)

name.en: nothing left stands higher

statement.en: at each step to the n-th, what stands at a level is at most the level: G (t + 1) z ≤ z

name.en: a start at or below y

statement.en: the course starts at or below y: s ≤ y

name.en: a step before the horizon

statement.en: the step t the conclusion speaks of is before the horizon n: t < n

name.en: the weighting falls at every step

statement.en: at each step to the n-th the weighting falls: w (t + 1) < w t

name.en: the weighting rises at no step

statement.en: at each step to the n-th the weighting does not rise: w (t + 1) ≤ w t

name.en: a positive weighting

statement.en: at each step to the n-th the weighting is positive: 0 < w t

name.en: OpenCourse

statement.en: the course is open under the renewal R from s with capacity k: it starts at s, each step leaves at most the level with its renewal, x (t + 1) ≤ x t + R (x t), and draws at most k (Optimum.OpenCourse R k s x; the courses Next.Open under G t z = z + R z)

name.en: an eligible outcome

statement.en: the outcome the law names (o, or low) is eligible: eligible o

name.en: a coupling not above the renewal forgone

statement.en: the renewal at the need with the coupling a step is at most the greatest renewal: q + c ≤ r

name.en: a coupling below the renewal forgone

statement.en: the renewal at the need with the coupling a step is below the greatest renewal: q + c < r (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a coupling covering the renewal forgone

statement.en: the greatest renewal is at most the renewal at the need with the coupling a step: r ≤ q + c (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a coupling exceeding the renewal forgone

statement.en: the greatest renewal is below the renewal at the need with the coupling a step: r < q + c (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: ranking above where another does

statement.en: the order better' ranks one outcome above another wherever the order better does: ∀ o' o, better o' o → better' o' o

name.en: the weighted gain strictly greatest at y

statement.en: at each step t before n, for every level z ≠ y: w (t + 1) · (z + R z) + w t · y < w (t + 1) · (y + R y) + w t · z

name.en: the rising course at y

statement.en: the course rising as fast as what is given allows from s stands at y after step t (rise R y s (t + 1) = y)

name.en: a long course in the witness

statement.en: the course is longer than twice the start: s₀ + s₀ < n

name.en: a renewal below two

statement.en: the renewal r is below two, the two takers' joint capacity: r < 2

name.en: a start of at least two

statement.en: the witness's source starts at two or more: 2 ≤ s₀

name.en: at most r given

statement.en: at most r is given at every step the law names (every step, or every step before T): g t ≤ r (given by the rest: L.restGiven part t c)

name.en: renewal at most r

statement.en: the renewal law R gives at most r at every level: R z ≤ r for every z

name.en: exactly r at or above the need

statement.en: at or above the need, exactly r is given at every step: m ≤ x t → g t = r (given by the rest: L.restGiven part t c)

name.en: Reoptimizes

statement.en: a course re-optimized at every step: each step balances and the levels after it are an optimum of the part's order among the outcomes open to it, the part acting within its capacity and the rest exchanging as it does (Optimum.Reoptimizes L W part cap ds rest better)

name.en: a re-reading keeping the need

statement.en: from T on, wherever the need is met it is met at the next step: T ≤ t → m ≤ x t → m ≤ x (t + 1)

name.en: the beyond apart from the family

statement.en: no condition beyond is in the family: ∀ c, c ∈ rest → ¬ c ∈ ds

name.en: Rising

statement.en: the order better rises with the family ds: it ranks every outcome exceeding another on ds (at least as high at each of its conditions, higher at one) above it, whatever either holds elsewhere (Optimum.Rising ds better)

name.en: rising with the draw

statement.en: the order ranks a course above another wherever it draws more across n + 1 steps: drawnOver R a (n + 1) < drawnOver R b (n + 1) → better b a

name.en: rising with the draw and what is left

statement.en: the order ranks a course above another wherever what it draws across n + 1 steps with what it leaves at the horizon, one for one, is greater: drawnOver R a (n + 1) + a (n + 1) < drawnOver R b (n + 1) + b (n + 1) → better b a

name.en: rising with the draw and what is left at worth v

statement.en: the order ranks a course above another wherever what it draws across n + 1 steps with what it leaves valued at v is greater: drawnOver R a (n + 1) + v * a (n + 1) < drawnOver R b (n + 1) + v * b (n + 1) → better b a

name.en: rising with a worth

statement.en: the order ranks a course above another wherever its worth is greater: ∀ a b, worth a < worth b → better b a

name.en: Room

statement.en: room beyond: an eligible outcome standing above another eligible outcome at a condition beyond (in rest) is exceeded on the family ds by an eligible outcome (Optimum.Room ds rest eligible)

name.en: the bay kept at three or more

statement.en: the season leaves the bay at three or more: 3 ≤ o bay

name.en: a season's outcome

statement.en: the outcome is that of a season of ten steps of the named model run from its start (Optimum.Season.Eligible o); for every weighted season, where the law weighs a list of them

name.en: the end at most the level held

statement.en: the end e is at most the level y held: e ≤ y

name.en: Shared

statement.en: shared units: the eligible outcomes are closed under moving a unit from a condition beyond that holds one into a condition of the family (Optimum.Shared ds rest eligible)

name.en: below the set point

statement.en: the outcome o stands below the set point at the condition d of the family: o d < s d

name.en: something stands beyond

statement.en: something stands at the condition c beyond after the step: 0 < o c

name.en: a step to the n-th

statement.en: the step t is within the horizon: t ≤ n (t ≤ N where the law names the horizon N)

name.en: a step within the horizon

statement.en: the step t named lies within the horizon: t ≤ n + 1

name.en: a positive weight

statement.en: the weight w at which the source is traded against the store's gap from its set point is positive: 0 < w

name.en: nothing added to a course falling below the need

statement.en: every open course standing below m at some step t ≤ n + 1 is worth at most what it draws: OpenCourse R k s a → t ≤ n + 1 → a t < m → worth a ≤ drawnOver R a (n + 1)

name.en: a worth above one

statement.en: what is left at the horizon is valued at a worth above one: 1 < v

name.en: a coupling of at least c for each step met to the n-th

statement.en: an open course meeting m to the n-th step is worth at least what it draws with c for each of n steps: ∀ a, OpenCourse R k s a → (∀ t ≤ n, m ≤ a t) → drawnOver R a (n + 1) + c n ≤ worth a (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a coupling of at least c for each step kept

statement.en: every open course keeping its level at m or above through the horizon is worth at least what it draws with c for each of the n + 1 steps: ∀ a, OpenCourse R k s a → Keeps m n a → drawnOver R a (n + 1) + c (n + 1) ≤ worth a (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a worth at least the draw

statement.en: every course is worth at least what it draws across the n + 1 steps: drawnOver R a (n + 1) ≤ worth a

name.en: worth at least the valued draw

statement.en: every course's worth is at least its draw with what it leaves valued at v: drawnOver R a (n + 1) + v * a (n + 1) ≤ worth a

name.en: a coupling of at most c for each step met

statement.en: the courses the law names are worth at most what they draw with c for each step from the first to the horizon's last at which they stand at m or above, wherever: worth a ≤ drawnOver R a (n + 1) + c · metCount m a (n + 1) (for every open course, or for the course x) (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a coupling of at most c for each step before a fall

statement.en: an open course meeting m to step j and below m at j + 1, j ≤ n, is worth at most what it draws with c for each of the j steps: ∀ a j, OpenCourse R k s a → (∀ t ≤ j, m ≤ a t) → a (j + 1) < m → j ≤ n → worth a ≤ drawnOver R a (n + 1) + c j (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a coupling of at most c for each step kept

statement.en: every open course keeping its level at m or above through the horizon is worth at most what it draws with c for each of the n + 1 steps: ∀ a, OpenCourse R k s a → Keeps m n a → worth a ≤ drawnOver R a (n + 1) + c (n + 1) (the coupling c is named w in the Web laws)

name.en: a positive worth

statement.en: what is left is valued at a positive worth: 0 < v

name.en: a positive level y

statement.en: the level y is positive: 0 < y

name.en: a formation erring at a step

statement.en: the formation a errs at the step named: e s a = true

name.en: a law keeping mutual withholding

statement.en: after two steps at which both formations withheld, the law withholds: f (false, false) (false, false) = false (PairChance.KeepsWithheld f); for each of the pair's two laws

name.en: a step from the burst on

statement.en: the step m is at or after the first step of the burst: t + 1 ≤ m

name.en: a formation withholding at its last two steps

statement.en: in the state x, the formation named withheld at both of its last two steps: x.2.1 = (false, false) for the first, x.2.2 = (false, false) for the second

name.en: active at the same steps before n

statement.en: the formation p is active at the same steps before n in the two runs: isActive G (levels G S₁ t) p = isActive G (levels G S₂ t) p for t < n

name.en: both formations active before the step

statement.en: in the first run both formations are active at every step before the bound: isActive G (levels G S₁ t) p = true for t < T and both p

name.en: a common start

statement.en: the two flows start at the same level on every condition: W₁.level 0 c = W₂.level 0 c

name.en: both intend to give in the first run

statement.en: in the first run both formations intend to give at every step: S₁.intends p t = true

name.en: a formation inactive at a step

statement.en: the formation p is not active at step t: isActive G (levels G S t) p = false

name.en: takes and gives differing only by amounts that cancel

statement.en: at each step before T at which the two flows' levels agree, on each condition what one takes beyond the other it is given beyond it: L₁.taken t c + L₂.given t c = L₂.taken t c + L₁.given t c

name.en: no matching

statement.en: the matching brings nothing: P.matched = 0

name.en: no spill

statement.en: nothing of a gift spills on its route: P.spill = 0

name.en: no spoil

statement.en: nothing kept spoils: P.spoiled = 0

name.en: its partner giving it nothing from t on

statement.en: from t on, the partner sends p nothing: sends G S s (levels G S s) (partner p) = false for t ≤ s

name.en: a reading through the levels up to n

statement.en: the reading of offspring gives the same for level histories alike at every step up to n: (∀ t ≤ n, ∀ c, l t c = l' t c) → read l = read l'

name.en: the giving course read as a + β n

statement.en: the reading of the giving course's levels is a + β n: read W₁.level = a + β * n

name.en: the withholding course read as a + γ n

statement.en: the reading of the withholding course's levels is a + γ n: read W₂.level = a + γ * n

name.en: the routes balance

statement.en: what is kept with what spoils is what reaches with what spills: P.kept + P.spoiled = P.reach + P.spill

name.en: the same draws

statement.en: the two runs draw the same from each formation at each step: S₁.draw p t = S₂.draw p t

name.en: the same levels up to n

statement.en: the two courses keep the same levels at every step up to n: W₁.level t c = W₂.level t c for t ≤ n and every c

name.en: the same renewal offered

statement.en: the two runs offer the same renewal to each formation at each step: S₁.renew p t = S₂.renew p t

name.en: the same standings at the start

statement.en: the two runs start from the same standings: S₁.start = S₂.start

name.en: neither intends to give in the second run

statement.en: in the second run neither formation intends to give at any step: S₂.intends p t = false

name.en: a step up to T

statement.en: the step t is at most T: t ≤ T

name.en: at least one step

statement.en: n is positive: 0 < n

name.en: β at most γ

statement.en: the factor on steps received is at most the factor on steps withheld: β ≤ γ

name.en: the kind answers

statement.en: every place of the kind holds answering on its side: s.kind = true → s.law s.side = answering

name.en: the kind never errs

statement.en: no place of the kind errs at any step on its side: s.kind = true → s.errs t s.side = false

name.en: the family rises by the factor

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by exactly the factor read: W.stock ds (t + 1) = W.stock ds t + β (γ at a withheld step)

name.en: laws giving after mutual giving

statement.en: every place's law gives after mutual giving, on each side: s.law first (true, true) (true, true) = true and s.law second (true, true) (true, true) = true

name.en: a cohort listed in pairs

statement.en: every group of the cohort is a place and the other place of its pair: g ∈ gs → ∃ s, g = [s, s.other]

name.en: no errors

statement.en: no place errs: s.errs = noErrors

name.en: no slack beyond and no inflow

statement.en: at every step below n at which the place receives, the slack beyond and the whole's inflow are nothing: W.slack dep rest t + L.inflow (ds ++ rest) t = 0

name.en: places not of the kind withhold

statement.en: every place of the cohort not of the kind holds withholding on its side: s.kind = false → s.law s.side = withholding

name.en: the place received at least once

statement.en: the place received at some step of the n: 0 < s.received n

name.en: at least one step after the error

statement.en: the run counts at least one step after the error: 0 < m

name.en: at least one step

statement.en: the run counts at least one step: 0 < n

name.en: a correction strength at most 5/12

statement.en: the correction strength β held during the intervention is at most 5/12 (β ≤ 5/12)

name.en: a correction strength at most 3/4

statement.en: the correction strength β held during the intervention is at most 3/4 (β ≤ 3/4)

name.en: a nonnegative correction strength

statement.en: the correction strength β held during the intervention is nonnegative (0 ≤ β)

name.en: a positive error bound

statement.en: the bound ε on the adverse quality error is positive (0 < ε)

name.en: a positive renewing share, under partial correction

statement.en: the operating state's renewing share is positive (0 < s.1), in the partial-correction transition

name.en: parts apart

statement.en: in every division J s l r, the two parts' footprints share nothing (PartsApart footprint J)

name.en: parts within their whole

statement.en: in every division J s l r of a whole s into parts l and r, each part's footprint lies within the whole's (PartsWithin footprint J)

name.en: the amount falls strictly at every step

statement.en: the amount d falls strictly across every step: before the step it is not within its value after (∀ t, ¬ M.le (d t) (d (t + 1)))

name.en: the amount does not rise

statement.en: the amount d does not rise across any step (∀ t, M.le (d (t + 1)) (d t))

name.en: no carrier at t

statement.en: nothing carries the pattern at t: ¬ V.Present t

name.en: a carrier beginning

statement.en: a begins carrying the pattern across step t: V.Arises t a

name.en: a later step

statement.en: the later step read is not before t: t ≤ t'

name.en: every cohort coupled to the family

statement.en: every member of every cohort of descent depends on some condition of the family ds at a need of at least m

name.en: a member at that step

statement.en: y is a member of the cohort at step s (y ∈ G.family s)

name.en: a step past the window

statement.en: the step s is after the window's end: T + n < s

name.en: an ending choice realized as an overdraw

statement.en: every chosen alternative that ends is realized as an overdraw of the family from a short stock: for each occasion o whose pick ends there are T and n with the family's uptake above its replenishment for n steps from T and its stock at T below n + m

name.en: ceasing to hold recurs

statement.en: at arbitrarily late steps some member ceases to hold the determination p (∀ N, ∃ t a, N ≤ t ∧ CeasesToBe (p a) t)

name.en: coming to hold recurs

statement.en: at arbitrarily late steps some member comes to hold the determination p (∀ N, ∃ t a, N ≤ t ∧ ComesToBe (p a) t)

name.en: the census bounded from T on

statement.en: from T on the census list has at most B members at each step (∀ t, T ≤ t → (l t).length ≤ B), the list being the census of what holds, of what stands or of the dependences

name.en: the census returns within K

statement.en: at arbitrarily late steps the census list has at most K members (∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ (l t).length ≤ K)

name.en: bonds grown by attachment below the count

statement.en: the state's bonds grew by attachment and every bond's ends are positions below the count (AttachedBelow s)

name.en: a bond of the body

statement.en: the link is one of the state's bonds (e ∈ s.bonds)

name.en: a join other than the cut link

statement.en: the aggregated bond (a, b) is not the cut link (p, n)

name.en: an aggregation that ran

statement.en: aggregating s by the bond between a and b gives t (DevelopmentalAssociation.aggregate s a b = some t)

name.en: reached by admitted steps of the device

statement.en: t is reached from s by a course of the recoverable device's admitted steps, preparation, ticks, crashes and uses as its source law admits them (Reach recoverable s t)

name.en: a resumption that ran

statement.en: resuming k steps from the pending device r gives the device d (resumeSteps k (.busy r) = some d)

name.en: no more steps than writes left

statement.en: the number of resumed steps k is at most the number of remaining writes (k ≤ r.todo.length)

name.en: an even step

statement.en: the step k is even: odd k = false

name.en: past the realization's end step

statement.en: the step t is after the realization's random end step ω (ω + 1 ≤ t)

name.en: reached

statement.en: t can be reached from s under the process P: some trace of moves leads from s to t (Reach P s t)

name.en: not possible from a configuration

statement.en: x is not possible under the process from the configuration s: no configuration reachable from s admits x (¬ Reaching.Possible P adm s x)

name.en: not possible with a part held

statement.en: x is not possible from s under the moves of P that hold the part read by Same (¬ Reaching.PossibleHeld P Same adm s x)

name.en: possible from a configuration

statement.en: x is possible under the process from the configuration s: some configuration reachable from s admits x (Reaching.Possible P adm s x)

name.en: possible with a part held

statement.en: x is possible from s under the moves of P that hold the part read by Same (Reaching.PossibleHeld P Same adm s x)

name.en: at least one unit wanted

statement.en: the reader wants at least one unit: 1 ≤ r.count

name.en: the reader gone after the step

statement.en: after the step the reader has no unit ((step r on x).ages = [])

name.en: a reader never rebuilt

statement.en: the reader's spent units are not rebuilt: r.source = none

name.en: the reader present

statement.en: the reader is present: it has at least one unit (ReaderRebuilding.Present, ages ≠ [])

name.en: a reader rebuilt from the level

statement.en: the reader's spent units are rebuilt from the level it reads: r.source = level

name.en: a reader rebuilt from the supply

statement.en: the reader's spent units are rebuilt from the supply: r.source = supply

name.en: a set level of at least one

statement.en: the set level is at least one: 1 ≤ r.setLevel

name.en: a span of at least one

statement.en: a unit's span is at least one (1 ≤ r.span)

lean: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»

name.en: a stock of 2 (k + 1)

statement.en: the level is at least 2 (k + 1) (2 * (k + 1) ≤ x.level)

name.en: the web starting at the given levels

statement.en: the web's levels at step 0 are the given starting levels (W.level 0 c = start c)

name.en: the line's cohorts within a group

statement.en: every member of every cohort of the line read off the flow lies in the group

name.en: a course whose lines settle

statement.en: from some step T on, every line either persists (stands at arbitrarily late steps) or is not alive: ∃ T, ∀ i, StandsLate (slotsOf i) l ∨ ∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬ AliveIn slotsOf l t i

name.en: founders carrying the reading

statement.en: every founder of the line carries the reading sig

name.en: a member of the line

statement.en: x is a member of the line's cohort at t (x ∈ (L.lineOf W members first).family t)

name.en: each slot's own standing coupled in

statement.en: each slot of the line (each listed slot, in standingCount_unselected) has its own standing coupled into it (obs x x)

name.en: the part carries one reading

statement.en: every member of the part carries the reading sig (∀ h, part h = true → read h = sig)

name.en: every occasion picks the carried reading

statement.en: every occasion picks the reading the line carries (∀ o, ch.pick o = sig)

name.en: the given formations present

statement.en: at every step the flow has the given formations present (L.present t = present t)

name.en: a reader's own standing coupled into it

statement.en: the reader r couples into its own standing by level: obs r r

name.en: no carrier active

statement.en: no member of the cohort at t carrying the region is active at t

name.en: the carriers requiring the family

statement.en: every member of the cohort at T + n carrying the region requires some condition of the family at a need of at least m

name.en: a family drawn below the need

statement.en: over the n steps from T, the family's stock with what was given it is below m with what was taken from it: W.stock ds T + total (steps T n) (L.replenishment ds) < m + total (steps T n) (L.uptake ds)

name.en: kids inherit their parents' readings

statement.en: on the generations, every kid carries its parent's reading (∀ t p k, p ∈ G.family t → k ∈ G.kids t p → read k = read p)

name.en: a member of a later cohort

statement.en: x is a member of the cohort at T + n

name.en: the region absent from a cohort

statement.en: no member of the cohort at t carries a reading in the region (∀ x ∈ G.family t, inR (read x) = false)

name.en: the region fixed at a step

statement.en: every member of the cohort at t carries a reading in the region, the region given as a Boolean test inR (∀ x ∈ G.family t, inR (read x) = true)

name.en: what is sensed drawn from the cohort

statement.en: what each member senses is the reading of a member of its own cohort (∀ t p, p ∈ G.family t → src t p ∈ G.family t)

name.en: what is sensed standing

statement.en: from T on, the relatum each member of the cohort senses stands at that step (0 < W.level t (src t g))

name.en: every relatum standing carrying the region

statement.en: from T on, every relatum standing at a step carries a reading in the region

name.en: an update keeping the region

statement.en: the update keeps the region wherever both the reading and what is sensed lie in it (∀ σ τ, P σ → P τ → P (upd σ τ))

name.en: a safe device

statement.en: the device is safe (RecoverableControl.Safe): a ready device's tracked bookkeeping is Known, a busy device's pending record is Coherent; coherence of evidence, not an available shutdown

name.en: a list holding every configuration

statement.en: a list holds every configuration: ∀ s, s ∈ l (finitely many configurations in the sense of a list, with no decision of equality)

name.en: a quantity never falling along an orbit

statement.en: the quantity q never falls along the orbit of s: ∀ n, q (orbit next s n) ≤ q (orbit next s (n + 1))

name.en: a sequence that never repeats

statement.en: the sequence never repeats a value: ∀ i j, i < j → g i ≠ g j

name.en: ceasing recurring in a listed family

statement.en: ceasing recurs in the listed family: for every N, some a in the list ceases at some step t ≥ N (Recurs as (fun a => CeasesToBe (p a)))

name.en: coming to be recurring in a listed family

statement.en: coming to be recurs in the listed family: for every N, some a in the list comes to be at some step t ≥ N (Recurs as (fun a => ComesToBe (p a)))

name.en: influence weight at most three quarters

statement.en: the influence weight β is at most 3/4 (β ≤ 3/4)

name.en: a positive influence weight

statement.en: the influence weight β of the original family is positive (0 < β)

name.en: a positive tolerance

statement.en: the tolerance ε is positive (0 < ε)

name.en: a fixed state

statement.en: the state is a fixed point of the family's step at β (family β s = s)

name.en: a small box about the maintenance end

statement.en: the radius of the box about the maintenance end is at most 1/32 (r ≤ 1/32)

name.en: in the box about the maintenance end

statement.en: the state lies in the box of radius r about the maintenance end (RegimeAttraction.HighTube r s)

name.en: a small box about the depletion end

statement.en: the radius of the box about the depletion end is at most 1/48 (r ≤ 1/48)

name.en: in the box about the depletion end

statement.en: the state lies in the box of radius r about the depletion end (RegimeAttraction.LowTube r s)

name.en: a physical state

statement.en: the operating state's share, quality and influence each lie in [0, 1] (RegimeAttraction.physical s)

name.en: a box radius not negative

statement.en: the box radius r is not negative (0 ≤ r)

name.en: weights within one

statement.en: the correction and influence weights together are at most one (α + β ≤ 1)

name.en: correction not negative

statement.en: the correction weight α is not negative (0 ≤ α)

name.en: correction positive

statement.en: the correction weight α is positive (0 < α)

name.en: influence weight not negative

statement.en: the influence weight β is not negative (0 ≤ β)

name.en: influence bound within one

statement.en: the bound λ on influence is at most one (λ ≤ 1)

name.en: influence bound not negative

statement.en: the bound λ on influence is not negative (0 ≤ λ)

name.en: a zero margin

statement.en: the margin M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ is zero

name.en: the regime step with no extra quality error

statement.en: the regime law is the operating step with quality error 0 (RegimeBoundary.step, of which RegimeAttraction.family β and its path are instances), no extra adverse error in quality

name.en: a floor below one

statement.en: the quality floor θ is below one (θ < 1)

name.en: a floor within one

statement.en: the quality floor θ is at most one (θ ≤ 1)

name.en: a positive floor

statement.en: the quality floor θ is positive (0 < θ)

name.en: the adjusted step keeps a band

statement.en: the adjusted step keeps the band up to hi: from a level x ≤ hi and a recent giving r ≤ hi, the next level is at most hi (RegimeMargin.Adjusted.Band A H hi)

name.en: the first recent giving not above the second

statement.en: of two recent givings compared, the first is at most the second (r ≤ r')

name.en: the recent giving within the band

statement.en: the adjusted run starts from a recent giving at most hi, the top of the band (r ≤ hi)

name.en: recent giving within the level at the start

statement.en: at the start p the recent giving is at most the level (p.2 ≤ p.1)

name.en: rests at the draw where the regime does

statement.en: the adjustment gives the draw H exactly where the regime's giving g does: for every level e left, A e H = H if and only if g e = H (RegimeMargin.Adjusted.RestsAtDraw A g H)

name.en: the adjustment rises

statement.en: the adjustment A rises with what is left and with the recent giving: for e ≤ e' and r ≤ r', A e r ≤ A e' r' (RegimeMargin.Adjusted.Rises A)

name.en: the start's disorder within d

statement.en: the bound on steps that leave level and recent giving neither both risen nor both fallen, at the start p, is at most d (Adjusted.unordered H p ≤ d)

name.en: giving capped

statement.en: giving is at most Y at every level (RegimeMargin.AtMost g Y)

name.en: the band reaches the point

statement.en: the band's top reaches the point of no return: H + y ≤ hi + 1

name.en: a draw beyond all giving

statement.en: giving falls short of the draw H at every level (∀ z, g z < H)

name.en: the cap not above the draw

statement.en: the cap on giving is at most the draw (Y ≤ H)

name.en: a pair's band

statement.en: the coupled step keeps the band up to hi: from levels x ≤ hi and y ≤ hi, both next levels are at most hi (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Band D g₁ g₂ H₁ H₂ hi)

name.en: a pair's draw positive

statement.en: the draw on a condition of the pair is positive (0 < H₁, 0 < H₂)

name.en: a pair's level ends

statement.en: the level a part reads off the pair's state ends: from some step on it is nothing (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Ends D g₁ g₂ H₁ H₂ part s)

name.en: the first depends on the second

statement.en: of two coupled conditions, the first gives nothing wherever nothing is left of the second (∀ a, g₁ a 0 = 0)

name.en: the first stays within its draw

statement.en: from step N on, the first condition's level stays within its draw along the pair's run

name.en: the coupled step keeps a band

statement.en: from every profile of levels each up to hi, the coupled step leads every condition to a level up to hi (Coupled.Indexed.Band G H hi)

name.en: one state below another

statement.en: one web state is at or below another, condition by condition (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Below D x y)

name.en: positive draws on dependents

statement.en: every condition that depends on another has a positive draw (∀ i j, DependsOn G i j → 0 < H i)

name.en: total dependence

statement.en: condition i gives nothing wherever nothing is left of condition j (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.DependsOn D G i j)

name.en: downstream along dependence

statement.en: condition i is downstream of k: i is k, or depends on a condition downstream of k (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Downstream D G i k)

name.en: the dependent's draw positive

statement.en: the draw on the dependent condition i is positive (0 < H i)

name.en: a level ends

statement.en: the level a part reads off the web's state ends: from some step on it is nothing (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Ends D G H part s)

name.en: a law keeping the order of states

statement.en: the law of states f keeps the order of states condition by condition (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.KeepsBelow f)

name.en: the others' levels not above

statement.en: of two assignments of the other levels compared, the first is at most the second at every condition (∀ j, y j ≤ y' j)

name.en: the part read keeps the order

statement.en: the level the part reads off a web's state keeps the order of states: at a state at or below another, condition by condition, it is not higher

name.en: the partner stays within its draw

statement.en: from step N on, the level of condition j stays within its draw along the run (∀ k, state (N + k) j ≤ H j)

name.en: the partner within its draw

statement.en: the level of condition j is within its draw at the state named (x j ≤ H j)

name.en: a law reading condition by condition

statement.en: f reads condition by condition: two states alike at every condition step to states alike at every condition (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.ReadsPointwise f)

name.en: mutual support with a recent giving

statement.en: each giving rises with what is left of each condition and with what each gave last (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Rises G)

name.en: mutual support: each giving rises with what is left

statement.en: each condition's giving rises with what is left of every condition, read in whole numbers (∀ i, Coupled.Indexed.Rises Drawn.whole (G i))

name.en: the run stays within a bound

statement.en: the run of f from s stays within B: at every step n and condition i, its level is at most B (RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.StaysWithin f B s)

name.en: what is left above the draws within d

statement.en: the total of the start's levels above their draws over the list is at most d (leftOver H s cs ≤ d)

name.en: the higher profile within the band

statement.en: the other conditions of the web start at levels at most hi, the top of the band: ∀ j, y j ≤ hi (y' j for the second profile)

name.en: the part read keeps the pair's order

statement.en: the level the part reads off a pair's state keeps the order of states: at a pair at or below another in both levels, it is not higher

name.en: the first partner level not above the second

statement.en: of two levels of the partner compared, the first is at most the second (y ≤ y')

name.en: the second depends on the first

statement.en: of two coupled conditions, the second gives nothing wherever nothing is left of the first (∀ b, g₂ 0 b = 0)

name.en: every start level within the band

statement.en: every condition of the web starts at a level at most hi, the top of the band: ∀ i, s i ≤ hi

name.en: a fate down-closed in the level

statement.en: the fate P is down-closed in the level up to hi: wherever it holds at b ≤ hi it holds at every a ≤ b

name.en: the first draw not above the second

statement.en: of two draws compared, the first is at most the second (H ≤ H')

name.en: the draw not above the mark

statement.en: the draw is at most the level b the run is read against (H ≤ b)

name.en: a positive draw

statement.en: the standing draw is positive (0 < H)

name.en: a band the step keeps

statement.en: the adjusted step keeps every state whose level and recent giving are within hi at a level within hi (D.Band A H hi)

name.en: one pair below another

statement.en: one pair of amounts is at or below another in both coordinates (RegimeMargin.Drawn.Below p q)

name.en: a continuous adjustment

statement.en: over the non-negative reals, the adjustment A is continuous in what is left and the recent giving together (Continuous fun q => A q.1 q.2)

name.en: recent giving within the level

statement.en: the state's recent giving is within its level (D.le p.2 p.1)

name.en: a step that does not lower both

statement.en: the step from p does not leave its result at or below p in both level and recent giving (¬ D.Below (D.step A H p) p)

name.en: a step that does not raise both

statement.en: the step from p does not leave p at or below its result in both level and recent giving (¬ D.Below p (D.step A H p))

name.en: a giving rises

statement.en: a giving rises with what is left of each: for e ≤ e' and r ≤ r' in the amounts' order, g e r ≤ g e' r' (RegimeMargin.Drawn.Rises; mutual support where each coupled condition's giving does)

name.en: a run tending to a limit

statement.en: over the non-negative reals, the run of the adjusted step from s tends to L

name.en: a start recent giving within the band

statement.en: the recent giving of the start s is within hi (D.le s.2 hi)

name.en: a start level within the band

statement.en: the level of the start s is within hi (D.le s.1 hi)

name.en: an exact check

statement.en: the Boolean check is exact for the fate up to hi: at every a ≤ hi the fate holds exactly where the check is true (∀ a ≤ hi, P a ↔ d a = true)

name.en: one fate implies another

statement.en: up to hi, the fate Q implies the fate P (∀ a ≤ hi, Q a → P a)

name.en: nothing from nothing

statement.en: nothing gives from nothing (RegimeMargin.FromNothing g: g 0 = 0)

name.en: giving stops below the need

statement.en: giving is nothing at every level below the need m (RegimeMargin.Gated g m)

name.en: giving rises with what is left

statement.en: the regime's giving rises with what is left: g a ≤ g b wherever a ≤ b (∀ a b, a ≤ b → g a ≤ g b)

name.en: the step keeps a band

statement.en: the regime's step keeps the band up to hi: from every level up to hi it leads to a level up to hi (RegimeMargin.Keeps g H hi)

name.en: enough steps to fall

statement.en: the start level is below b + (H − Y) n (x < b + (H − Y) * n)

name.en: giving lowered

statement.en: giving under one regime is nowhere greater than under another (RegimeMargin.Lowered g' g: g' z ≤ g z at every z)

name.en: giving meets the draw from y

statement.en: giving meets the draw H at every level z from y with z + H at most hi (RegimeMargin.Meets g H y hi)

name.en: giving meets the draw at y

statement.en: giving at the level y meets the draw (H ≤ g y)

name.en: a positive point

statement.en: the draw and the least meeting level are not both nothing (0 < H + y)

name.en: the level read within the top

statement.en: the level a read is at most hi, the top of the band: a ≤ hi

name.en: the least level meeting the draw

statement.en: y is the least level at which giving meets the draw H: H ≤ g y and giving is short of H below y (RegimeMargin.Root g H y)

name.en: the run at the same state at two steps

statement.en: the run of f from s is at steps i and j at the same level at every condition: ∀ c, state i c = state j c

name.en: giving short below y

statement.en: giving falls short of the draw H at every level below y (RegimeMargin.Short g H y)

name.en: the start at or above the point

statement.en: the start level is at or above the point of no return H + y (H + y ≤ x)

name.en: the start below the point

statement.en: the start level is below the point of no return H + y (x < H + y)

name.en: the start within the top

statement.en: a start the law names is at most hi, the top of the band: the start of the condition whose end is read (x ≤ hi; on a web a ≤ hi; p.fst ≤ hi for a start given as a pair), and with two coupled conditions the partner's start (y ≤ hi, y' ≤ hi)

name.en: the regime's step

statement.en: one step of a condition at level x under a standing draw H: the draw takes first, as much as there is, and the condition gives g of what is left (RegimeMargin.step g H x = (x − H) + g (x − H)); giving is read off the level within the regime

name.en: giving subadditive above the need

statement.en: giving above the need m is subadditive: g (m + (p + q)) ≤ g (m + p) + g (m + q) (RegimeMargin.SubadditiveAbove g m)

name.en: a nonnegative support cost

statement.en: the extra support consumption a step is nonnegative (0 ≤ cost), cost the pulse's draw on the support stock in RegimeTransition.cover

name.en: a positive renewing share

statement.en: the operating state's renewing share is positive (0 < s.1)

name.en: a band

statement.en: the band's lower end is at most its upper end: a ≤ b

name.en: a positive lower end

statement.en: the band's lower end is positive: 0 < a

name.en: the entry carried past b

statement.en: the entry carried ℓ M further passes the band's top: b < x₀ + (ℓ + k) M

name.en: the entry carried within b

statement.en: the entry carried ℓ M further stays within the band's top: x₀ + (ℓ + k) M ≤ b

name.en: the floor

statement.en: the relay's carry over ℓ + 1 steps is at most one past the band's top: (ℓ + 1) M ≤ b + 1

name.en: a start held

statement.en: the level of c is held at x₀ for the first ℓ + 1 steps: ∀ i, i ≤ ℓ → W.level i c = x₀

name.en: a positive step

statement.en: the relay's step is positive: 0 < M

name.en: the ramp below the band before k

statement.en: the ramp from the start stays below the band before k pushes: ∀ i, i < k → x₀ + i M < a

name.en: the ramp entering the band at k

statement.en: after k pushes the ramp reaches the band: a ≤ x₀ + k M

name.en: a rule reading ℓ steps late

statement.en: the rule reads ℓ steps late: two records of rests agreeing at every step s with s + ℓ < t give the same answer at t (ReadsLate ℓ ρ)

name.en: room below the start

statement.en: the start is at least the late return's reach: (ℓ + 1) d ≤ x₀

name.en: room past the threshold

statement.en: the relay's carry passes the band from just below it: b + 2 ≤ a + (ℓ + 1) M

name.en: a rule keeping the band

statement.en: on the course the rule generates from x₀, under every record of rests moving the level by at most d a step, the level is within [a, b] at every step

name.en: a start below the band

statement.en: the held start is below the band: x₀ < a

name.en: the start one below the band

statement.en: the held start is one below the band's lower end: x₀ + 1 = a

name.en: each active step lowering the level

statement.en: from T on, across every step at which the formation f is active, the condition c's level falls

name.en: a draw within renewal

statement.en: a drawer's draw is within the renewal at every step (∀ t, d t ≤ renew), for each of the two drawers

name.en: two draws together beyond renewal

statement.en: at every step the two draws together exceed the renewal (∀ t, renew < d1 t + d2 t)

name.en: the level below a bound

statement.en: in the support-gated renewal law L, the condition's level at T is below the bound (L.level T < bound)

name.en: below the sustaining need

statement.en: the condition's level at T is below the sustaining formation's need (L.level T < L.needG)

name.en: the bound within the sustaining need

statement.en: the bound is at most the sustaining formation's need (bound ≤ L.needG)

name.en: the focal formation independent

statement.en: the focal formation does not depend on the condition (L.needF = 0)

name.en: the part's need at least the bound

statement.en: the part p's need is at least the bound (bound ≤ L.need p)

name.en: the focal need met at the start

statement.en: the support-gated law's start level meets the focal formation's need (L.needF ≤ L.start)

name.en: the focal formation depends

statement.en: the focal formation depends on the condition: its need is positive (0 < L.needF)

name.en: the focal need within the sustaining need

statement.en: the focal formation's need is at most the sustaining formation's (L.needF ≤ L.needG)

name.en: the sustaining need positive

statement.en: the sustaining formation's need is positive (0 < L.needG)

name.en: the focal formation restores no more than it draws

statement.en: in the support-gated renewal law L, from step T on, the focal formation contributes no more than it draws (∀ t, T ≤ t → L.contrib t ≤ L.draw t)

name.en: drawing beyond renewal
