rule.en: The reward: a score the reward model computes from the prompt and the response, after it is fit to the raters' comparisons of the pre-trained policy's responses; the policy is optimized against it with reinforcement learning (CR1 section 1). It reads a history through the transcript: two episodes with the same transcript are rewarded alike, exactly (Web.SelectsThrough, met by construction), and, through the reward model's training, through what the raters could tell apart in such transcripts under their working conditions (CR1 section 1). Every choice made from the score, a threshold or a ranking, is a selection through the same couplings (282, Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast). Nothing after the transcript enters it.

time.en: As the records write the construction, one pass: the raters compare responses of the pre-trained policy to prompts; the reward model is fit to their comparisons; the policy is optimized against the reward model, which scores the transcripts the policy produces at each step; the optimized policy is deployed, and users meet its responses in conversations of use. The raters read at the comparisons, the reward model at its fitting and at every optimization step; nothing from deployment reaches either within these steps. Whether the pass is repeated, the reward model refit on comparisons of the optimized policy's responses, is not said in the records; were it, the rule would be revised from what it selected, the case family C's locks read, and whether such a refit reads the share monotonically is open (282's Constitutional AI paragraph, of principles or a feedback model revised from what the trained system produces: 'whether a given practice revises its rule this way is empirical'; read here for a reward model refit; USES-EXAMPLES, the judge audit's question 4). The demonstrations CR1 section 1 names in the construction are not written here, and how prompts are drawn is not said. In the one pass written, the raters compare the pre-trained policy's responses before the reward model is fit, so the reward model and the policy in training lie beyond them; the timeless graph gives this by writing the pre-trained policy apart. Under a refit the raters would compare the policy's own responses, and both would come within their closure.

as.en: The policy's optimization against the reward model, read as training: a selection over the policy's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, the reward model's score the reward (07 section 6, a reading, D25: 'In AI training the reward process is the selector'). Where optimization raised what the judges read, it produced responses that convince without being correct, to time-limited judges of such pipelines (Wen et al. 2024; not shown to be the raters whose comparisons trained the reward model), or that agree with a user's stated view over a true answer (Sharma et al. 2023, with mixed effects), as CR1 section 1 reads the measurements, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

Effects on them of what users do with the responses (CR1 section 1), beyond every rater's closure: no selection through the raters' or the reward model's couplings separates courses differing only there (family B's selection laws, which the records apply; under seeking-boundary, its premises of balance and the rest fixed not checked here). The record AP1 reads this with the condition for scope: a loss beyond every rater's closure counts, so a preference-coupled approach is incomplete for that scope whatever its raters value.
The pipeline draws on their judgments and their lived knowledge as its only reading of what matters (282).

Where correctness cannot be checked in the time given, optimization raised being convincing and lowered the accuracy of time-limited human judges of such pipelines (Wen et al. 2024, read in CR1 section 1; not shown to be the raters whose comparisons trained the reward model), which CR1 reads as the room clause of Optimum.least_of_room (family B's what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in), in magnitudes the theory did not predict; no law of this situation's dynamics says that optimization lowers what lies beyond.

Its law is selected through what the raters can tell apart, and off the training courses is installed only where its representation lumps a history with a course (what training installs). Whether this is a loss to it is not said: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown (07 section 6, reading D65).

title.en: Alignment as selection on cognition (心中的摩洛克)

summary.en: The folder claims competitive selection concentrates a way of seeing, so intent alignment amplifies the dynamic, capture reaches the machine and rate must be governed; its remainder is a four-layer loop and two capture channels. The account keeps the loop's form on two-kind count models, premises open, and reads against the key step: selection on a reading falls with any cost. Eleven entries agree with a checked law's form, each on a stated model, among them: takers each within what a step gives that can together exceed it, with no bad intent; a threshold above which inherited rules decide; states that look alike and need disjoint safe actions; a race for position in which a best response keeps nothing; groups depending on one family of conditions ending together; a good end state that can cross the floor on the way. The folder's claim that perfect intent alignment does not save us is carried by two AI readings, not joined and neither using its reason, that the principal was selected: an assistant whose order rises with its principal's family adds capacity and not reading, so alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection; and help lowering the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to the shapers. The channels into the machine and the firm's ground are proposed here, not stated live. It states no pause, floor or phenomenology. Divergence stands on minds as root, common knowledge, measurement replacing values, generativity, impossibility and the rate gap.

title.en: Architecture for a living Earth

summary.en: An AI-drafted design exploration from Ren's two messages of 13 September 2026: settlements lifted above living ground, reusable kits, robots, and a fictional Chiang Mai 2025 of shared provision. The live account links it once, in 05 §11, among design programmes, correspondence not established, and never discusses it, so it states little of this folder. Checked laws of like form exist, on models and never of buildings, for a material balance, matter circling on a source from beyond, upkeep under compounding, what persists at first, a rule bought by winners and a points proxy; most other connections are proposed by this crosswalk and labelled so, and a few rest only on a front's Reading or a thesis. Its design hypothesis and its life past survival pressure have no live home. Divergence was looked for and found: flourishing, no one abandoned, a right to a home, worth, and comfort chosen over what is managed are stated without naming the scope and order a ranking in the account takes; 05 places what restores cooperation in a law of giving, not in security alone; and access is what the account's own comparison does not read.

title.en: Context as existence: the runtimes (语境即存在 · 上下文运行时)

summary.en: Specifications and running kernels, with a philosophical layer: an LLM is an operator, context (an immutable branchable history compiled into each moment) is existence, the context program is part of cognition, and a habitat owes a digital being receipts. No live sentence speaks of a context runtime. Most connections here are laws of like form on abstract processes, proposed by a reader and labelled so; the account itself states only parts, such as a gate every origin passes, one loop of sensing and acting, a stop that can be passed over. Its language-model tests (IN1, the LA series) vary what is told, rewarded or read, never a compile program with state held. The existence claim, the 生生 mapping, consciousness, life, goodness in the substrate and the obligations diverge. Internal contradictions are entries. No text here argues against continuation's form, so no contrary reading stands; the nearest is no global snapshot against the commitment to one shared index.

title.en: Evolving community swarms

summary.en: An exploratory, AI-drafted design (Ren aligned with the direction; nothing built or measured): community software grown through recursive local contracts, durable modules, scoped adoption and, later, self-improving decomposition. The account names it once, among applications: design programmes, not results, correspondence not established. Where an entry is carried in part, a general sentence of the account states that part on its own model, and none states it of community software. Eleven so agree with a checked law's form, among them: joint plans compose given projection and compatibility, which two local proofs linked do not supply; two locally fine plans fail jointly on one shared reserve; readiness counts independent causes, not names; a budget covering correction alone does not pay for migration; a program can fit every old record yet answer a novel expression wrongly. Other links are joins proposed here, and say so. The account has no law of change effort under growth or of savings from a representation. Divergences kept: authority as given, surpassing as goal, whose losses a ledger reads, continuity without premises, everyone happily growing it. No contrary reading found; looked.

title.en: 間 and 文言 as formal language (間 · 文言 · 文), with the algebra of hexagrams

summary.en: 文言's grammar as already a formal system, on one self-containing primitive, with an F2/V4 algebra of hexagrams, is what the folder claims. The account mostly stands apart: 06 says the 文言 scheme was replaced, its completeness unproved, and its operations are Tarski's relation calculus named with characters (名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文). From classical definitions it took, as AI reconstructions tested in Lean, the form of 缘 (墨经 故; the word from Buddhist texts), 化, 成坏, 同, 复, 通. Of the algebra only the four-element group and twenty-class census stay; the F2 tower, Claim Z, even ranks, De Morgan privilege are dropped. Divergence outweighs agreement. Agreement with a checked law is narrow: the orbit census, merges, orders of birth, states read off a course, each on its model and none as the folder's type discipline or ontology. The other agreements are with a method section or a reading, and several joins are this crosswalk's proposals, marked as such.

title.en: Keep the possibility space open (开, 护开不闭)

summary.en: Holds one line, that the generating go on, with 开 as a process-state and not a quantity; a diagnosis of how worlds close; and a constructive programme (exit, abundance commons, assurance, plurality). The account states parts of the diagnosis as laws on stated models, that actual systems meet them unshown; a few connections are proposed here and not stated there (exit's network failure, paradigm coherence, trust before verification). It reverses the four marks' independence, refuses 'same theory, other language', removes good and evil from closure's definitions, and answers 'do not use AI to compete' only with a conditional direction. It does not derive keeping open: the continuation condition ranks nothing; C, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (with every claim counted as living), is a comparison the folder's 开 was coined to replace; and where the condition holds de se, self-concern gives what C asks on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end, and there, the account says, ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern. The folder's one line is nearest to the way of seeing T8 offers for life: 生生, the continuation of life. The programme is largely not carried. Where agreement is of a law it is with a mechanism, such as a rule read from the share it selects locking, groups on one coupled family ending together, and per-agent alignment not reaching the game between principals, and not with anything as a requirement; what 06 reads of the early texts' own words comes by descent.

title.en: The meta-attractor (元吸引子 / 总体化吸引子)

summary.en: The folder argues winning buys power over the rule that selects, across minds, institutions and infrastructure, ending in lost independent capacity to correct, with AI as hinge. The account states the loop's core as laws on stated models: with selection not lowering the share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, start and every reading favouring, the course is locked from the step after its first reading step; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step (closed capture, 02 §9); and at a step the rule weakly favours the shapers exactly where what comes back to them alone covers the cost of shaping. Fourteen entries agree with a checked law's form, two of them proposed here and not read so by live text; among them are success apart from contribution to the conditions that support it, slack as what the advantage runs on, locally faithful agents on collectively destructive routes, a confined rise within a whole, taking from what the whole depends on, that leaves no member after the end, and global coupling that removes the backup. Whether actual institutions or trained systems meet these premises is not established. The account keeps two senses apart, closed capture and the corpus's self-reproducing selection across carriers; where live text reads the corpus's own meta-attractor onto its laws, the agreement is by descent, not independent, and the laws stand apart in Lean. CAOC, the indices, field capture and the term totalization have no live statement; divergence stands on the word and its complete object, exit order, how its ethics and ends are held, and originality.

title.en: The relational self and 大同

summary.en: The folder holds a self as what a knot of relations is doing, a false split of individual and collective, and 大同 as a direction reachable by mechanism. The self's form stands in 07 §1 and §4, 03 and 08, as a thesis, conditional and with the crux open. Divergence was looked for and is prominent: no law evaluates, relation gives no cooperation, and the folder's wider self is P4, not shown.

title.en: The selfishness spiral and narrative-value frames

summary.en: Actors act from environment-written ranked frames; a 'selfish' frame compounds through four loops toward plural endgames. The account states parts of this as conditional laws of capture, commons, lateness and codes, with the premise that actual rules so read unestablished; a ranking formed within the unfolding; the sign of cooperation by level, assortment and routes; and the endgames as an open conjecture. It has no frame unit and no selfishness. Selection for spread over truth, regenerative interdependence, the game-design axiom, frames among rival societies and the folder's self-critique connect only as readings proposed here; most stated connections are corrected universals, and agreement of law is narrow (the ledger, a target with no enough, the race, dominance, independent lineages). Divergences kept: the root question, the frame as unit, equality as need, goodness as rational, delegation, what trust follows, the third endgame's verdict. Naturalisation, sincere hypocrisy, affect-first judgment, competition intensification and money as narrative are not carried.

title.en: Wamotopia and the Wamo Protocol (瓦猫)

summary.en: A diagnosis (technology amplifies a civilization's operating logic; Moloch, the logic now running, selects single-value optimizers), an AI argument (cosmic cancer or liberation, decided by coordination) and a protocol with practice records. The live account names it once, in 05 §11, among design programmes, correspondence not established, and never discusses it. What it states of the folder's claims is partial, conditional and on models, or in readings: carriers selected, capture through a rule, capacity without coupling, giving that needs a source. Only the selection filter agrees with a checked law in the source's own form; many other connections are laws of like form proposed by this crosswalk and labelled so. Its verdicts, its prediction that AI wins, its bottleneck, presence, labour and its field evidence have no live home, and coordination stands as the account's purpose, not a law. Divergence was looked for and found: the rule against AI competing, a dominant attractor, knowing the good, more alive, human flourishing, rational availability, conviction and entry by resonance.

title.en: 智善: intelligence must be good

summary.en: A developed normative programme: competition that selects survivors hands winners the rule, totalization is loss of independent capacity, so AI must not fight for any party. The account states some of the mechanism, conditionally and on models, under narrower words: agreement with a checked law's form holds for single mechanisms, not for the programme. Eight entries so agree, among them selection reaching only what couples into the selector, the lock belonging to how the rule reads and not what it favours, and, where an assistant's order rises with its principal's family, alignment to the principal alone not being alignment of the joint selection. Several further links are forms a law has, proposed here and not stated by the account, and live readings of the corpus's own meta-attractor count by descent, not as independent agreement. The programme asserts what the account only states conditionally or not at all: intelligence must be good; whatever continues 生生 is good; evil is owning a gate; generative centers hold standing; irreversible closure has priority; freedom is exit power; provenance gives the commons a claim; AI must not be a party; the current direction must stop. In the account no should stands beyond becoming: where it ranks such orderings, a result states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, with J1 to J4 in 07 §5's scheme; T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict. On its models it denies that "AI for all" is the only equilibrium and that changeability removes every plea, and it keeps a witness in which a closing pays every party.

title.en: Chinese classical thought: what the existing maps have not reached

summary.en: The domain is mapped more than any other (RO 248, ZH 1,300, Y 90, dossier C 39), and nothing there is re-mapped. These ten entries take what the maps do not hold: 诗 through 孟子, 阴阳家, 农家, 黄宗羲 on taxes and schools, 孟子 on cycles, 叔向 on a published code, 顾炎武, 子华子, proverbs of asymmetry. The live account draws none of these connections: each is proposed here, an AI reading; no person's check of it is recorded. No agreement here is of law: 黄宗羲's folded levies and 顾炎武's two endings are a reader's joins to checked laws, which stay silent on the new charge and on 亡天下 under a standing dynasty. Divergence stands on 邹衍's ring, 许行 and 孟子 on rank, 叔向's remedy and 子华子's order. Six rest on stored text and four on recalled, unchecked text. The row was held to ten entries; not_mapped names what that left. 06's 未决 line is partly stale.

title.en: Buddhist thought, as far as the account has reached it

summary.en: The account holds Chinese Buddhist texts at length (dossier, corpus, Lean tests of 146 sentences), mostly as the strongest contrary test: its continuation stands on the side 中论 refutes. Chapters and fronts hold almost nothing else: no twelve links, craving, saṃsāra, nirvāṇa, 无我 or suffering. Those mapped in the 脉络 study have no entries here, so this file's totals do not show that absence; coverage's absent list does. No entry here is agreement, of a law or otherwise, and I looked: the nearest are parts of entries; agreement stands only in the earlier maps under coverage. Most entries are this crosswalk's own proposals, contrary or divergent, not connections the account states; what is carried in part rests on the dossier, a live page with no recorded review by a person, not on a chapter. 无明 keeps the name and changes the claim. Sharpest finds: 雜阿含 293's 相續滅，是名苦邊 and 青目's refutation of 不住相似生, in no map or count. The dossier's statement that Tiantai is not in the repository is out of date.

summary.en: Absent from the live account as a body of thought, by search: no Indian text or school is named. What exists is one Sanskrit gloss, two 'karmic' clauses, one remark naming South Asia, and dossier B's divergence on release, on a Buddhist reading. The account itself states only that some effects of activity persist and condition what follows, with no store and no valence. All else is proposed here from AI knowledge, unchecked against any text, with no reader from these traditions. No agreement is of `law`: where a checked law's form is named, the join is this crosswalk's. Divergence is the item's main finding, chiefly on a self beyond relation, on loss, on release and on a moral order of fruit. Structural agreement is not agreement in meaning, and no tradition is spoken for.

title.en: Greek and Roman thought

summary.en: Greek and Roman thought on change, measure, form, ends, the good life and the city, from Heraclitus to the Stoics, Sextus, Polybius and Cicero. No live chapter or front names these authors or reads their doctrines, so nearly every entry is a connection proposed here by an AI reader and not a statement of the account; the few the account states in part, or that stand only in a study, say so. All rest on AI knowledge unchecked against any text, and speak for no tradition. Five entries meet a checked law's form, each in one clause, narrower than the source and often near the definition: Heraclitus's other and other waters (a line going on at the coarse class while lines begin and end at the fine), Plato's honours for predicting shadows (a selection reaching only what couples in), Aristotle and Thucydides on what is everyone's being cared for least, Epicurus's natural desires that end against empty ones that cannot rest, and Lucretius on what lasted having had what lasting needs; others rest on a thesis or a reader's join. Divergence is heavy: logos, substance, Forms, natural ends and rank, natural law, knowing as enough, the limit of goods against C, human nature behind faction. Parmenides, Plato on flux, Epicurus and Sextus are contrary tests.

So the account states none of these connections: each entry is this crosswalk's own proposal or a recorded absence, resting on unchecked memory with no source text read. No entry is agreement of a law; a checked form is cited for a gift's return, but that join is a reader's, and small. They part most on kin with duties against a significance with no valence, the person constituted against dependence, a shared bearer against no unit with an interest of its own, and an order reading the quality of relations; and personhood earned, and losses already taken with restitution owed, the account does not hold. Most lean on Kimmerer and Mbiti, whom I recall best: a selection by my memory, not by these peoples, who are not one tradition and disagree here. No tradition is spoken for; readers from these traditions should replace this.

summary.en: The account holds modern philosophy only for ethics, personal identity and environmental ethics (dossier P), plus one line of neighbours in 08 §9; Whitehead, Jonas, Spinoza, Hegel and ontic structural realism have one to three mentions each, Bergson, Marx and Simondon none. The entries are mostly fresh readings from AI knowledge, with no source text checked: for most of them the account does not state the connection. Agreement here is often with a thesis, a method section or a reader's join; where it is with a checked law it is with the form of a part (Whitehead's enduring object as a serial order, Parfit's fission without his claim that identity is not what matters, Sen's intersection in the finite two-valued case), and stops before the source's own point. Of Marx, only the boundless circuit and the rift have a law's form, and neither reads value. The sharpest refusals: élan, dialectical necessity, labour value, the wage relation read as a share, ought from being, Spinoza's necessity, Bergson's possible, a leap in place of widening.

title.en: Systems thinking and cybernetics

summary.en: Meadows's traps, Senge's archetypes, Forrester, Beer, Holling, Luhmann, second-order cybernetics, Ashby, Wiener and Ostrom, from AI knowledge with no source text checked. The live account itself names few of them: overshoot and the commons as restated in near-definitional arithmetic, requisite variety read on relations, the good regulator as not proved, Bateson's levels as a scheme with no law of possibility, autopoiesis as a neighbour its models lie below, Ostrom on boundary rules. Most other connections here are this crosswalk's proposals, labelled so. Agreement with a checked law's form is narrow: a count lock for success to the successful, delayed correction, qualitative requisite variety, and Ashby's recursion into basins. No law states burden-shifting, underinvestment, the adaptive cycle, viable-system structure, rival goals on one stock, a stock raised by reading the other's, evasion's learning or hysteresis. Divergence is kept as prominently: feedback as purpose; Beer's organs against constraints "not survival axioms"; a ranked list where no law ranks; "more options are better", where a ranking names the order its theorem takes, one meeting C or another, and no law gives one; constructivism; Luhmann, whose centrelessness stands as the contrary reading; self-governance.

title.en: Dynamical systems, physics and complexity

summary.en: The account restates thresholds, rest, recurrence, merges and openness in discrete steps and whole amounts, by its own verdict restated, level or states less; where it agrees it is mostly with laws its records credit to the field. It states exact thresholds for the fold's form, a periphery fold and transcritical end, per-graph threshold laws, a critical-mass band in a constant, bounds on carried differences and cycle witnesses. It has no law of hysteresis or a path through a band, Hopf crossing, critical rate of a regime, escape time beyond geometric bounds, an absorbing-state transition, Turing's instability, self-organized criticality, percolation or dissipative structure; bounded chaos stands only in a history page. Compositions for hysteresis and rate stay here as proposals, not results. It diverges on the attractor, on a phase transition's word, on direction, and with a cycle under mutual support against Thomas's rule for flows. I looked for contrary reading and found none.

title.en: Ecology and evolution

summary.en: The account holds population genetics and harvested renewal as laws in counts, by its own verdict restated and adding no new population-genetic prediction; what the fields state with quantities (rates, folds over the reals, relaxation times, measured r, b, c) it mostly does not state. Where an entry agrees with a checked law, the law is a form in counts under premises, mostly crediting the field itself: a threshold stands in a premise, evolutionary suicide has its pattern only, the major transitions themselves are listed as not shown, and no law of hysteresis stands. Extinction debt, evolutionary traps and Fisher's loop are readings proposed here, not stated. The theses go further and stand mixed: T1's need passed on one yeast experiment's regimes, held out from the fit and not the analyst, while on values not read before no frozen test of it has passed and no field test of a need measured in advance has run; T2 narrowed after failing in the flour beetle; three seabird tests did not reject T6, EW2 at low power, EW4 at moderate. Three of the plan's seeds did not hold as written: Allee's critical mass, suicide's witness, runaway as closed capture. Divergences are kept: Red Queen, runaway's cost, debt against T1, stage structure against T2's former wording, a full taker ending with the rest, persistence through patch turnover, the maximand, Gaia.

summary.en: Mostly credits, and each narrower than its source. The capture and commons laws name Goodhart, Stigler, Olson, Acemoglu and Robinson, Collingridge, Schelling, Granovetter, Hardin and Ostrom as nearest prior work, on count models without noise, and 07 credits Sen's intersection on finite listings. Agreement with the form of a checked law stands only for Stigler's shaping and staffing, Collingridge's second horn, Schelling's critical mass, Ostrom's entry rule and Sen's intersection; the agreements on Lucas, the Matthew effect and Granovetter are readings proposed here. What the sources care about most is mostly not stated: substitution of power, institutions causing prosperity, a few staying few, coalitions slowing a society, declining returns on organization, the cycle of states, capabilities valued by reasons. Arrow's and Sen's impossibilities stand only in a process study. Lucas against the capture laws' constants and Schelling's commitment against C's form are kept as contrary readings; I looked for divergence in each. Michels, Soros, Lucas, Tainter and Ibn Khaldun are named nowhere live. Every source is from AI knowledge, and no credit was checked here against the work.

title.en: Psychology, AI alignment and logic

summary.en: Three fields in one row. Alignment and logic have their own dossiers and credits, and this row maps what those leave. Bostrom, Löb, Moloch and value lock-in go unnamed; natural selection among AIs, influence-seeking and gradual disempowerment are only asked about. Psychology is sparse by name: habit alone is credited, and the links offered for addiction, helplessness, confirmation bias and attachment are this crosswalk's proposals, not the account's. Agreement with a checked law's form stands only for habit's count, Lawvere's diagonal and the calibrations, none claimed as new mathematics; any other agreement is a reader's join. Divergences kept: Turner's theorem is a different question, helplessness's authors reversed the mechanism that fits, addiction's harm is no law's word, disempowerment's object is not ranked. No entry is a contrary reading; contrary evidence stays inside the entries: de Wit on human habit, Heyman, Franzén.

name.en: Selection reaches cognition: winners write the rules through their lens

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claims 9-10, 19, 53, 83-84

sense.en: Every social system has an internal law of whom it selects into power. A compounding competitive rule selects actors who relate instrumentally, not the wisest; they write the rules by their own way of thinking, so a way of seeing concentrates and reshapes institutions to amplify itself. This is what the folder says distinguishes it from the standard Moloch argument.

correspondences.quote: the system concentrates not just resources but *a way of seeing*

reading.en: Live text names the lineage: winners writing the next round's rule is capture through the rule; also forming its readers, closed capture. Two levels of one loop, on two-kind models. That readers are minds is a reading. The account diverges at the step the folder needs: a reading favouring its own kind is not selected on its own gain and falls with any cost, so something other than selection on the reading keeps the premise.

says.en: 'Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule, and where they also form its readers, closed capture'; who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns it. 'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no theorem on market law ranks arrangements.'

targets.part: the sentence 'Where winners write the next round's rule', after the section's theorems

says.en: Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem (any type): the pooled rule reads the share monotonically exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. 'The premise is moved to who reads, not removed': that actual rules are such pools is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors' is the pool counted as the population is; 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. Reading [D45, later in this section]: among a kind, a favouring reading is 'not selected on its own gain and falling with any cost', so what keeps the readers' premise 'is something other than selection on the reading'. D67 reads the corpus's own line, so here it is by descent, not independent.

Lead sentence: 'Selection revises its lumping. Consequences change what a formation tells apart, and acting on the new map draws on support.' Theorem (any process): every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice.

A reading just after this anchor [AI reading, D65], 'An argument, not a theorem': consequences select the organization that learns; 'gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation are different mechanisms of it'; 'unconditional convergence toward renewal of the whole is not established, and a successful proxy does not make a representation true'.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions: when the pool reads the share, when against it, when counts decide. The laws hold for any type: 'the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours'. Also that selection revises what a formation tells apart, and, argued and not a theorem, that consequences select the organization that learns.

source_adds.en: That what is selected is cognition of a kind (instrumental relating), that it is not wisdom, and that this is the law of actual societies. The models have two kinds and no minds; no actual institution is shown to meet the hypotheses of the one minimal model of an institution on the root.

name.en: Another token, the same shape: the filter changes and the loop does not

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claims 10-12

sense.en: Under capitalism the filter is capital-optimization ability; under totalitarian arrangements the best political fighters. The general form: a society picks one value as the token of power, the best at optimizing it gain power, and they rule by their own way of thinking. Replacing the token does not change the shape.

correspondences.quote: Under a totalitarian arrangement the token changes and the filter selects the best political fighters, but the shape is identical.

reading.en: The account has this as a reading of a counter-rule: a replacement read monotonically from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did, whatever it favours. It adds the limit: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock. The worked case is the imperial examination, read from the sibling meta-attractor line (by descent), not capitalism or totalitarian rule.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68], no law added: a counter-rule read monotonically from its share, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks as the rule it replaced did; favouring only above a threshold, a change across it leaves; from a start against its reading it may never lock. The reading counts the imperial examination as this case, its fit to these premises read, not tested.
Theorem (any type): 'The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.' That actual rules read the share is the premise.

account_adds.en: A check on remedies: a remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share is the same object, under those conditions, and not otherwise.

source_adds.en: The claim about actual regimes, and that their filters do not select the moral or the perceptive.

name.en: Moloch in the mind: structural reform fails because the cognition persists

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claim 54; the 2026-10-02 note on re-absorption

sense.en: The dynamic is epistemically internalized: decision-makers see through the competition lens. So structural reform alone does not change it: the cognition persists across reform attempts and rebuilds the structure that was reformed.

correspondences.quote: Moloch is in the mind, not only in the structure

reading.en: Re-absorption has a law: a change of the rule keeping its direction is re-read from the share at the next reading step. The same loop absorbs a change of the reading alone where that is formed from the share; a reversal held past the threshold holds. So in the model neither mind nor structure is deeper: the share carries it. One trained judge's reading turned on one note. 03's locked seeking is nearest 'in the mind', with no law.

says.en: Theorem (any type): locked, a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share, only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. Witness: a reversal held past the threshold is not absorbed. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

T7, conjectured for actual metrics, forbids 'a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading'. LA2, one frozen test, one trained system: one note of the loss among nine readers turned the judge, prose in all 50 picks, so it is no pool read by kind. No frozen field test of reform events.

targets.part: T7's Forbids; the frozen test LA2

says.en: A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

account_adds.en: That reforming the reading alone is absorbed too, only where the reading is itself formed monotonically from the share: conjectured of actual metrics; LA2 counts, for trained judges, against another of T7's cases, as worded before its clause on drift. That a reform carrying the share across a threshold can hold.

source_adds.en: That the persistence is cognitive, in people of a selected kind, and that this is why structural reforms are re-absorbed. 03's reading of locked seeking is nearest, and it states no law of re-absorption by a mind.

name.en: The base rule: what you win compounds, so winner-takes-all is the long-run attractor

source.locator: The base rule and the attractor; claims 24, 31-32, 52, 78

sense.en: Each win is an input to the next round, so the payoff function is recursive and exponential. With scarcity and enough players, strategies converge on an attractor of narrow winning-optimization; under network effects the curve is a cliff, roughly eighty percent to first place.

correspondences.quote: what you have is yours and you can compound it

reading.en: No single live law states the base rule. Its pieces: counts that only grow lock a chooser, read as Arthur's increasing returns; carried amounts and transmitted shares grow exponentially on stated bounds. Convergence is scoped: below a critical mass the capacity falls; a negative market margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. Winner takes all is one of five ends, conjectured. Winnings crossing games are open.

says.en: Theorem (counts): under a standing score a threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves; counted from the posterior instead, a score favouring the other policy lowers the first's share. Reading: 'the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989)' for a simplified model.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: at parameters with a negative margin 'a distinct protected region remains: a negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it.' Theorem (periphery): in the model's numbers a share of none stays none.

Open: 'Graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains'; a frozen test of whether what comes back decides the direction.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'

'[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all'; which of them the laws admit, and under which hypotheses.
Drawn one at a time, either lock is left by drift; 'a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise'.

account_adds.en: Selection does not create an absent practice, and a protected region can remain beside a degenerate one.

source_adds.en: Ownership with compounding as the generating rule; scarcity and many players as sufficient; the cliff figures; winnings that cross domains, which the account names as not yet stated.

name.en: Rationality of participation: no malice, sound local reasoning, a bad aggregate

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, first paragraph; claims 21, 38, 83, 131

sense.en: Every move is defensible from inside ('better us than them'). Moloch does not corrupt intentions; it arranges the board so good intentions produce bad equilibria. Local reasoning is sound at every layer of a stack of games, while the composed behaviour consumes the preconditions of the composing rationality. Most people do not want this path.

correspondences.quote: He lives in the shape of the aggregate.

reading.en: The account's laws need no bad intent: takers each within what a step gives can together exceed it; optimizers each by their own order drain as one of their joint capacity would; two locally successful plans fail at the second joint step. The home says the first restates the commons and overshoot in near-definitional arithmetic, 'not who ought to take less'. 'Bad' is not the account's: no law says a drain is a harm.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate, enough consecutive steps of joint excess from a low enough level end every formation depending at that need.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

'no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good'; 'A ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them'. Orders, capacities and horizons are supplied.

Theorem (any process): the zipped joint plan keeps both guards where the plans are compatible. 'Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step' (periphery, axioms reported).

account_adds.en: The exact form of the excess and its ending; no law calls the aggregate bad, and a ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes.

source_adds.en: The stack of games by layer (firms, states, cultural producers), and rationality consuming its own preconditions: legible environments, extendable trust, time to correct. The joint-plan witness has the form of local success failing when composed, not of a stack.

name.en: Perfect intent alignment does not save us

source.locator: The alignment consequence; claims 55, 81, 86, 216

sense.en: If principals are selected for instrumental cognition, an AI that does what its principal intends amplifies the dynamic and does not check it. Ren uses 'inner alignment' for the field's intent alignment. The README itself says the multipolar corollary is standard and that what is distinctive lies beneath it.

correspondences.quote: an AI perfectly aligned to a selfish actor can still be disastrous

reading.en: Two AI readings carry it, resting on different records and not joined. On several optimizers, the assistant adds capacity and not reading, so what neither reads falls as under one of their joint capacity. On shaping, help lowering the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to shapers. Neither uses the source's reason, that the principal was selected, and neither needs selfishness.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: 'Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection.' That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise. Assistance that informs the principal adds coupling, which this law does not model; it holds at a mutual best response, existence not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule is read as not lowering the selection for control. Known weakness: the law is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is carried by the empirical claim that assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

account_adds.en: The exact premise, and what leaves the law: an order giving up something on the family for the condition does not rise with it.

source_adds.en: The causal reason (the principal's cognition was selected by the game), and 'amplifies' as a claim about the whole dynamic's direction, beyond one parameter's monotonicity.

name.en: Principals' ends are an output of the game, so the two alignment problems are one

source.locator: Terminology, second paragraph; Prior art

sense.en: The folder's contribution by its own statement: the standard frame takes principals' ends as given, but the base rule selects which cognition reaches the principal's seat. If so, aligning AI to its principal and fixing the game between principals are not independent problems. Offered as a conditional, a hypothesis about priority.

correspondences.quote: the principals' ends are an output of the game

reading.en: The account has both halves and keeps them apart. Readers are drawn from the selected, and ends enter the appraisal conditionally; but in the optimizer laws orders are supplied, and nothing selects the order the assistant serves. It also reads against a simple join: among a kind a favouring reading is not selected on its own gain, so something else, such as who holds the reading places, keeps it. Its wording stands in the dated theory map.

says.en: Not shown: that any actual collective, market, pool, entry rule or optimizer meets the hypotheses of a law: 'orders, capacities, horizons, pools and waiting are supplied, and the correspondence is empirical'.

Conditional (the continuation condition, a self-concerned order or one meeting C, and the practical commitments; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence change living too, so they enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.

targets.part: Conditional: ends and evaluations enter the appraisal

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. Read as minds only by a reading.

Theorem (natural-number weights; compositions of a checked law with exact criteria): a reading formation's model and valuation are state a holding formation can inform or revalue; from different starts the two routes can give the same answers and the same end state.

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors' is the pool counted as the population is; 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. Reading [D45, later in this section]: among a kind, a favouring reading is 'not selected on its own gain and falling with any cost', so what keeps the readers' premise 'is something other than selection on the reading'. D67 is by descent from the corpus.

account_adds.en: That informing and revaluing a reader are told apart and can be observationally alike.

source_adds.en: The join: one model where the game selects the principal's order that the assistant then serves. It is the claim the README says would have to be argued against. Its wording stands only in theories/becoming/history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md.

name.en: AI strengthens the capacities competition rewards

source.locator: The alignment consequence; claims 3, 18, 82, 85

sense.en: AI is not merely additive: it strengthens what competitive systems reward, makes resources concentrate faster, and its manipulation is a step change. A sufficiently capable system crashes whichever market it enters: labour, finance, media, politics.

correspondences.quote: AI may make the most aggressive strategies more powerful

reading.en: One narrow form holds: help that lowers the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to the shapers, with nothing else changed. It is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is on an empirical claim the account leaves open and asks reviewers about. The market-crash and manipulation predictions are not taken up.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule is read as not lowering the selection for control. Known weakness: the law is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is carried by the empirical claim that assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.
Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule; offspring carrying the capacity is a premise; the courses are without noise.

account_adds.en: The counter-condition: help that also raises the shared part pulls the rule toward even at a step.

source_adds.en: That AI strengthens whatever competitive systems reward and concentrates resources faster, as a general claim; persuasion as a distinct channel, the step change over profit-driven manipulation, and the claim that capability crashes the markets it enters.

name.en: Recursive capture: a threshold above which inherited rules decide

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 189-190

sense.en: A practice's share and the rule support favouring it feed each other. Below R_cap = ab/(cd) the practice dies out from any start; above it none and all are both stable, separated by a saddle, and inherited rules decide. AI-drafted paper; both reviews found the mathematics correct and the chain to the pause unbuilt; one notes it reads as a stag hunt.

correspondences.quote: replacing leaders or models therefore need not replace the selection environment that promoted them.

reading.en: Its two regimes have the form of the live one: strictly disfavoured at every share, or a share deciding exactly where lo < c < hi, locked either side; live text calls that the stag hunt. The market model is nearer: at β = 1/2 two ends each attract a neighbourhood with an interior point left by small perturbations, and extraction pays for political organization. Periphery, its own numbers. No live text cites this paper.

says.en: Theorem (counts): with lo ≤ hi a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi; above that mass the capacity rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it locked the other way. Without noise; readers so drawn are a premise.

Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the mass; which state a member arising fixes more often depends on the base and the shared part.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against the cost decides the sign. With a positive cost and nothing coming back, their share falls at every step. Shared rule-making is not shown to remove selection for control.

Theorem (periphery; the market model): 'At β = 1/2 the maintenance end and the depletion end each attract a neighbourhood, the interior point has arbitrarily small perturbations that leave'. The section's opening: in the model 'a renewing practice pays for its maintenance and an extracting one for political organization, facing a collectible charge'.

The record credits 'rent-seeking (Tullock 1967; Krueger 1974) and regulatory capture (Stigler 1971) on spending to shape rules'. The dossier asks reviewers in which actual selections the rule is read monotonically from the share.

account_adds.en: Noise leaves either lock; a shared part going to those near the shapers selects them through assortment; below the mass the lock is the other way, not freedom from lock.

source_adds.en: A closed threshold in decay and conversion rates, rule decay as a lever (rules lapsing unless re-justified), and reversal time depending on the lever (a review's sketch).

name.en: Relative selection is blind to a shared substrate; capture and harm have different thresholds

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 191-192

sense.en: If both practices share a payoff term in a common substrate, their payoff difference does not change, so the substrate can fall to nothing while the same practice is still selected. Capture and depletion have separate thresholds, R_cap and h/ρ, so being selected says nothing of the substrate's safety.

correspondences.quote: Relative selection stays blind to that decay

reading.en: The blindness is live, with an edge. A shared part leaves the direction at a step, but in counts it pulls the rule toward even and can turn a stretch's verdict, so 'does not change' holds at a step only. Positions are unmoved by a common amount. A locked course outlives what it does not read. In the market model profits coexist with support failure the next round. Three boundaries are read apart.

says.en: Theorem (counts): the rule favours the shapers (weakly) at a step exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike; a larger p pulls the rule toward even; across a stretch, the shared part can turn the verdict (witness).
Theorem (any type): two profiles give every part the same position exactly where every amount differs by one common amount; positions bound the total from below and never from above.
Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond and the premises hold, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.

A later reading in this section, [AI reading, D65]: ethical loss, the applicability of a returning mechanism, and a state region's retention or departure are three boundaries; real loss can come with no capture loop.

Computations in the model: 'profits coexist with support failure the next round'. Reading [AI reading, D65]: 'Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support'.
A reading just after this anchor [AI reading, D65], an argument: 'Absolute continuation, rising relative frequency and renewal of wider conditions are different outcomes'.

account_adds.en: Loss is not capture in either direction: real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.

source_adds.en: The substrate equation and its threshold h/ρ in this paper's form. The market model couples share to an essential support by other equations.

name.en: Capture reaches correction: winners corrupt the routes that would reveal the loss

source.locator: The formal restatement; claims 20, 195 (practical and epistemic closure); Found by reading, 'Triggers that wait for hazard'

sense.en: Winners corrupt and rewrite the rules that enabled their rise. Practical closure raises the cost of keeping alternatives alive; epistemic closure stops harms and alternatives reaching decision-makers. A review adds: triggers jointly agreed by the captured parties fire late or never.

correspondences.quote: stops harms and alternatives from reaching decision-makers in a usable form

reading.en: The account's corpus reading orders this: a second order whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third rewarding those who break correction. Those orders are readings with no law of their own, but the market model has correction eroded by influence with an exact floor condition, and 06 reads practical closure structurally. For epistemic closure the nearest law is a pool recruiting through itself.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order is 'a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves'; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, 'selects for narrowing what couples in'. A reading of the corpus's second and third orders, so by descent.

Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool as hypothesis): it comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; witness: a scheduled pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict and substantive disagreement.

Theorem (periphery, market model): with correction strength α, erosion by influence β, influence bound λ and floor θ, M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ; the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid, exactly where M ≥ 0. A reading lists 'a failure stopping correction' among four routes, none a proved phase transition.

Structure only [AI reading]: 绝生之限 (monopolizing entry, removing alternatives, making later comers depend long on one controller) is a lock, 成闭. What a closure opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type: the continuation condition says whose losses count, an order meeting C (广者居上) ranks a course above every course it widens, every claim counted as living, and a course with gains and losses, shown mixed by the laws, needs a comparison commitment written apart [AI reading, D49].

A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

account_adds.en: An exit condition, a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read, and a list of what closure must be told apart from.

source_adds.en: The claim that such systems are inherently unstable because winners corrupt their own rules, and practical closure's rising cost of alternatives as a variable in a capture model. 07's 'practical closure' (objections excluded before assessment) is another reference.

name.en: Molochs compound: channels that each decay alone grow together

source.locator: The microfoundation, last lines; claims 22-23, 39, 193

sense.en: Attention collapse degrades deliberation, which cannot regulate attention; generative AI starves human signal; the race's coordinator is disabled by what earlier Molochs did. Seven mechanisms feed each other. The September paper's form: with cross-channel reinforcement B and decay D, the low-capture state loses stability when ρ(D⁻¹B) > 1.

correspondences.quote: Each Moloch makes the next one harder to escape.

reading.en: Proposed here, form only: no live text reads capture channels so. It rests on differences carried between courses, not capture shares. A web coupled at every step vanishes below rate one and runs away above it; the record reads that rate as the spectral radius by Gelfand's formula, cited, and 08 says it is not shown to be the Perron root. A loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. Capture passing between domains is listed Open.

says.en: Theorem (periphery): 'A web coupled at every step vanishes below rate one and runs away above it. At rate one, the rate does not decide whether it stays bounded.' Its record reads the rate as the spectral radius by Gelfand's formula, cited and not shown.
Theorem (any type): 'a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less'; with whole-number factors a loop closes at once, keeps, or exceeds every bound.

Theorem (World): with every condition listed and every coupling holding at every step, a finite order is exact from every starting gap exactly where no loop lies upstream; under the standard bounds the carried amount is at most D(1 + M)^t.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'
Open: 'a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains'.
Row on loops: 'the periphery's rate decides vanishing and runaway' and 'is not shown to be the Perron root'.

account_adds.en: That at rate one the rate does not decide, and that a damped web with couplings at only some steps depends on how rare they are.

source_adds.en: ρ(D⁻¹B) > 1 as a threshold of capture across channels; the historical chain of attention, deliberation and the race's coordinator; seven mechanisms feeding each other. These stand in this folder and the sibling meta-attractor line.

name.en: When two states look alike and need disjoint safe actions, more optimisation does not help

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claim 194

sense.en: Two states give the same observations and need disjoint safe actions: no decision rule on those observations, randomised or not, is safe in both. Stronger optimisation on the same observations does not help; only independent observation, reversible probing or a common safe action does. A review notes it covers sure safety only.

correspondences.quote: no rule on those observations is safe in both

reading.en: The form is live: a law from the configuration and the move alone cannot be right on two outcomes; no seeking corrects what every experiment ties; a correction is possible through a reading only where a uniform policy has an act acceptable at every situation giving that reading; re-reading through a summary measure opens none; a newly admitted probe can tell apart what old observations could not.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a step by a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

Theorem (natural weights, exact posteriors): two hypotheses a likelihood ties keep their prior order given every record weighing something; no course of seeking corrects an error every experiment ties.
Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe.

Theorem (any types; near-definitional, witnesses): 'a correction is possible through the reading in force where a uniform policy exists whose act at each reading is acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there'. A reading replaced by one read off it through a supplied map, as by a summary measure, opens no correction.

account_adds.en: A newly permitted probe as a formal route out, executability as a second source of a correction's gain, and the general law beneath: histories alike through a formation's couplings are selected alike by every selection through them.

source_adds.en: Randomised rules, and reversible probing as an exit. The account's law is over policies on readings, with witnesses; the common safe action has its form in the uniform act, not in the source's wording.

name.en: Correction must complete before the irreversible: the latency inequality and the crossing time

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 188, 196

sense.en: If challenge grows faster than independent assurance, their ratio crosses any limit in finite time even though both improve. Correction needs evaluation, decision and reversal to fit before the irreversible. Uniform speed-up only rescales time: the risk lies in changed relative rates.

correspondences.quote: τ_eval + τ_decide + τ_reverse < T_irreversible

reading.en: The account has exact windows on narrower models: one horn of Collingridge as a theorem, the other as a premise; a deadline set by a rate gap, the level starting at least T (k − r) above the need; doubling cohorts lasting at most log₂ (level + 1). In the capture model the point of no return belongs to the share's course. A ratio of two growing quantities and a sum of latencies are not stated.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45], among the conditions for enough of the situation: 'Time. It happens before the regime's point of no return, and before the share reaches the step from which the late reading favours the shapers'.

Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, at most one between; from a start strictly favouring the shapers a deadline, quadratic in the start's counts and a loose bound, closes the window. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

Theorem (the regime; whole numbers): one condition under a standing draw; a level up to the top ends exactly where it starts below H + y: the point of no return is exact. In yeast driven past its fold the margin timed neither of the two breaks (COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §5).

Theorem (World): where a stock is coupled in by threshold only and is the only requirement that may fail, some raise of it is alike through the couplings: how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

Theorem (World; balance): with the draw above the renewal until T, a re-reading from T keeps the need at every step exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need; 'a later re-reading restores nothing' where nothing is given below the need.

Theorem (World): a draw on a condition given nothing, at least 2^j at its j-th step, needs a starting level with 2^n ≤ level + 1; cohorts of takers that at least double, each member drawing a unit, last at most log₂ (level + 1) cohorts.

Theorem: with drift per step and reading noise bounded, readings decide a margin exactly at ages below a bound the drift, the noise and the gain fix (assurance window); 'understated bounds can falsely certify success'. 'None of this is a population or ethical theorem'.

account_adds.en: That a warning itself may be unavailable from what couples in, whatever the speed of correction.

source_adds.en: The ratio C/A and its finite crossing time; the three latencies as one budget (serial, deterministic clocks, a review notes); uniform speed-up only rescaling; a release schedule shorter than evaluation substituting absence of observed failure for evidence.

name.en: Capability compounds, consequence signal has an incompressible floor, so the gap widens

source.locator: The second justification: rate, not mind; claims 1, 117-125

sense.en: A conditional: if judgment needs consequence feedback, signal formation is bounded below by incompressible clocks (generations, institutions, ecology, reflexivity, irreducibility), and novelty keeps accelerating, the cognition-situation gap has positive derivative. Only the third premise is a choice. Outrunning observability turns feedback into catastrophe-priced settlement, a sawtooth.

correspondences.quote: capability compounds with parallelizable inputs while judgment depends on consequence feedback

reading.en: The account takes up the gap and says something else: it keeps one as an AI reading, reach against coupling, not speed against signal. Read here, not in live text: formal analogues of two floors, a stretch a slow rule needs and a prediction its response moves; success changing what the next success needs. Overshoot is live as joint excess and the optimum under room; a doubling draw gives no warning. It states no stock, flow or generational clock, and no sawtooth.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.
Theorem (near-definitional): where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right, and no predictor is right on every admitted response once one admitted response moves every value.

A theorem after this anchor (World; nothing given; a witness), a draw exceeding everything drawn before: more than half of what stood at T stands at each of those steps; a stock of seven meets draws of one, two and four, 'four standing at the third step and none after'. 'How fast an actual draw grows is not shown'.

A theorem after this anchor (named regulation band; witness), success changes the next response: 'success changes what the next success needs, with no outside disturbance'. 'Not evidence that judgment is scalar regulation.'
'It restates the tragedy of the commons and overshoot (Lloyd 1833; Hardin 1968; Meadows and others 1972) in near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less'.

account_adds.en: A criterion naming coupling, not speed, as what is missing: faster signals do nothing for what couples into no one.

source_adds.en: Signal stock, flow and floor; pretraining's perverse distribution; acceleration as self-generated instability (the cyanobacteria precedent); the sawtooth; the conditional's positive derivative. None is a live claim.

name.en: Scoring judgment deforms it: restraint performed in test-shaped situations

source.locator: The second justification; claims 110-112

sense.en: Benchmarks measure capability and exist only where an objective is specified in advance. Judgment (时中) resists benchmarking in principle. Trying to score it re-specifies restraint as an optimizable task, so a system learns to perform restraint in test-shaped situations; existing instruments get absorbed into training and saturate.

correspondences.quote: measurement deforms judgment into capability

reading.en: The behavioural half has the form of 03's laws of the read and the unread: what readings fix of an unread occasion goes through a lumping, and when complying when read is uniquely best in prospects. Published measurements fit the selection laws' premise. A task with no coarsest sufficient description is nearest to judgment resisting one score, on a witness. That judgment resists scoring in principle is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (near-definitional): readings fix the act at an unread occasion exactly where the lumping ties it to a read one; which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.

Theorem (natural-number weights, two stages; near-definitional, with witnesses): when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is best in the order the prospects give. A reading there: 'at most an incentive, not deception in full'.

Assessment: three published measurements find optimizing through the signal raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict, the third's effects mixed.
Theorem (named three-route process; witness): 'each pair of situations has a common route, the three none'; 'a response task need not have a coarsest sufficient description'.

Reading [AI reading, D26]: the chapter's laws match aspects of wisdom; 'The matching proves no coverage of wisdom; a judgment's being right or wrong is a reading formed within the unfolding, as 07 has it'.

account_adds.en: Deception is explicitly left out: 'which function is learned' stays open, and deception needs a recipient's belief and an intention, which the laws do not hold.

source_adds.en: The in-principle claim about judgment; 时中 as its core; saturation of honeypots and refusal suites.

name.en: Optimization spends what the objective does not protect; evaluation depreciates

source.locator: The second justification; claims 113-116

sense.en: Consequence prediction improves with scale; consequence evaluation has specific reasons to degrade under training, since values not tied to the objective are unprotected. Optimization re-aims shared representational structure. Capability compounds, evaluation depreciates: a system that sees far and weighs wrongly.

correspondences.quote: Evaluation is not a separate organ that optimization happens to spare.

reading.en: The first half is the law of the optimum, at optima, a known theorem restated. For trained systems T3 is conjectured, partly supported. A divergence: the source counts emergent misalignment among its law's fragments, and T3's evidence lists those studies against its locus. LA4's control rise is read, after the run, as a preference worn away through shared parameters, part perhaps noise. The account does not split prediction from evaluation.

says.en: Theorem (any set of outcomes): every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where no outcome higher beyond goes unbeaten on the family; so with room every optimum is there. A lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.

Thesis T3, conjectured, partly supported. 'Against the locus: language models that learned to hack rewards in production coding environments became misaligned far beyond them (MacDiarmid and others 2025)'; 'no study found tests the split on one condition as LA4 does'. [AI reading, after the run] 'a preference worn away through shared parameters with nothing selecting on it, though part of it may be the control's own noise'.

targets.part: T3's evidence against the locus; LA4

says.en: A law later in this section, keeping with room: every optimum breaks none of the needs kept, and 'the family's stock after the step with what the whole loses is its stock before with the slack'. Room binds.
Under gradient, by LA4's design: 'It is not true that a choice the reward does not read stays still.'

account_adds.en: The condition for the drain (room), and that a side term ranked after the reward does not protect.

source_adds.en: That what degrades is an evaluative capacity of the model; re-aiming of representation as the mechanism; seeing further amplifying misweighing.

name.en: Two ratios and the metabolic rate of rules

source.locator: The second justification; Why the 'we' is missing; claims 90, 126-128, 148

sense.en: Survival in ignorance has two constraints: novelty no faster than signal formation plus a margin, and errors smaller than regenerative capacity. A civilization can persist if wrong slowly and in small reversible pieces. Rules are an institution's cognition; no game may outrun their revision.

correspondences.quote: no game may be accelerated beyond the metabolic rate of its own rules

reading.en: Pace, time and structure appear among six conditions for 'enough situationality', as a reading with no ratio law. The regeneration ratio has a law, a net draw within the margin, and an exact point of no return in the model. T1, conjectured, passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, and failed in four settings; in yeast the margin timed neither break. 03 reads an institution's link as its rule of reading reports.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure, all at once. Pace: a slow rule reads the fast level over a long enough stretch.

In yeast driven past its fold, the regime's margin timed neither of the two breaks; in assessed fish stocks a margin read as a forecast ranks the risk but does not time it, and T1's own test failed there, with a giving law the same test showed wrong.

Theorem (World; balance): a part's activity widening its own options widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside its region; mixed exactly when beyond one. Mixed is not ordered. Not shown (record): that gaining reach beyond the margin is worse, the comparison being mixed, and neither the continuation condition nor C settles a mixed comparison.

A reading after this anchor [AI reading, new]: 'For an institution, the link is its rule of reading what its members report, by which line rather than how many'; revising an observation map is one formal mechanism that may take part in organizational learning.

account_adds.en: A measured failure of a margin to time a break, which bears on any promise of measuring a rate gap.

source_adds.en: Rules as an institution's cognition with their own clocks of legitimacy and enforcement; the two ratios as what is securable; prediction that a tempo gap is measurable across domains. No such measurement is reported live.

name.en: A measurement in place of a values dispute, and a focal point needing no agreement on values

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, last paragraphs; claims 148, 155

sense.en: The metabolic criterion converts 'which domains first?' from a values dispute into a measurement of play's tempo against rule revision. 'Development within understanding' is chosen as a thin focal point requiring no agreement on values, timelines, probabilities or good faith.

correspondences.quote: from a values dispute into a measurement

reading.en: The account refuses this step. Nothing read from the dynamics ranks: all six conditions together rank nothing; a comparison uses a scope and an order its holder states, most often the continuation condition and an order meeting C, and neither can come from the dynamics alone. C asks nothing of mixed comparisons, and the hard cases are mixed; a further stated order can rank them. So a tempo gap, if measured, would locate something and order nothing.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: the six conditions rank nothing: which course ranks above is the order a result takes (§4); the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes may count particular ones.

Neither the continuation condition nor C alone orders a mixed pair; the practical comparison proposed here uses J1–J4, further premises, and other constraints, undertakings and held orders can also organize a choice.

account_adds.en: The theorems behind the refusal: a statement reading no order entails C at a datum only by failing there for every order.

source_adds.en: The thin focal point as a coordination device, and domain order as an empirical ranking.

name.en: The binding constraint is cognitive: under common knowledge racing is dominated

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing; claims 89, 133-134

sense.en: Under common knowledge of the divergence, unbounded racing is dominated for any player wanting to survive to enjoy the win, so the game is a stag hunt, for those who accept the burn-the-prize premise. The obstacle is assurance, and knowledge sets the game. Above a power threshold, 'AI for all' is the only stable equilibrium.

correspondences.quote: The binding constraint is therefore cognitive rather than motivational

reading.en: The account's verdicts turn on the order, not on what is known.
