name.en: A reworked summary erodes: the memory becomes a fixed point of the policy

source.locator: The two structural failure modes; Claims O.238-240; lost item 29

sense.en: Reworking one rolling summary loses facts exponentially in depth (0.99 per pass, 700 passes), so what remains after years reflects the dream policy, not the life. Worse is cue loss: a fact dropped from the summary takes its search handle, so a perfect archive still forgets. Hierarchical strata with bounded rework were the fix; built, they were ruled dead, leaving the diagnosis unanswered.

correspondences.quote: is not a summary of my life; it is a fixed point of the dream policy

reading.en: Forgetting as a merge: no map restores two configurations a reduction merges. 'A perfect archive still forgets' has its form: the whole merges nothing while the part merges, the rest keeping what the part lost. A determined rework within finitely many summaries enters a cycle, of which a fixed point is one case. Cue loss has the tie's form: entries the summary ties are selected alike by every selection through it. The form, not the rate, a reviewer's model.

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'. 02 reading [AI, D65]: forgetting among 'one merge of configurations'; the laws are about a map on a type, 'whose content lies only in finding the merge'.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing; witness): in `Reset`, 'a one-bit part set to false at every step with the rest the history of what it held, the law merges nothing while the part merges, and no list holds the rest of any run'. Landauer's count with Bennett's history; 'no energy, temperature or probability is read'.
Theorem (any type): under a determined law, within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle.
Theorem (any type; the alternatives' equality decided): two alternatives are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them.

Theorem (periphery; a bounded realization): one network recalls two patterns, 'loses an old recall through continued, currently favourable updates and restores it by further revision without a reset'. A network's recall, not stored text.

account_adds.en: That the loss is one form across domains, stated with what that forbids: 'As a thesis of unification this forbids little.' And that a loss by favourable updates can be undone by further revision, in one realization.

source_adds.en: The memory as a fixed point of the dream policy, what remains reflecting the policy and not the life; the exponential rate in rework depth; cue loss as distinct from data loss, whose tie form above is only read; and O(log) rewrites as a fidelity floor.

name.en: The bet: a model reading its own tree makes a trajectory, not a fixed point

source.locator: Claims T.318-319, T.322, T.329-330; Open questions, 'The unnamed bets'

sense.en: The life phase rests on an unnamed bet a review names: an LLM with a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input does not settle. The failure is looping, not decay, and a gate against a fake model cannot see it. A probe's distinctness score measured vocabulary variety and was retracted. In another a being with nothing to do reached chosen rest at moment five: 'not evidence of anything else'.

correspondences.quote: an LLM, given a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input, produces a trajectory that is not a fixed point

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. Its laws, read onto the bet, say where it cannot hold, in their models: a determined law on finitely many configurations ends in a cycle. What keeps its whole history never returns, needing a carrier no list holds; so a growing tree never returns under identity, and a loop shows only under a coarser class, which is what the retracted probe missed. Change at every step does not show revision. A sampled LLM has only the branching law, with no probabilities read.

says.en: Theorem (any type): within m listed configurations every course of a determined law enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle.

Theorem (any type): 'Becoming that keeps its whole history loses nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds, and a present a list holds forgets.' 'The list is the hypothesis each theorem writes in; no unfolding is assumed to have one.'

Theorem (any process): 'Where courses branch, what returns can be had at every step, and every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own'. Its record: being drawn into a region within a bound of steps, where courses branch, is not shown.

Theorem (one declared process; witness; reviewed, no passing receipt binds the current bytes): a process 'returns after two steps and changes at every step while its operative selector stays the same at every time'. 'This refutes an unconditional inference from recurrence to learning or selector revision'; a richer process can learn.

With the rest of the whole counted, every rise is given net by some relatum; 'Novelty, and formations first supported without end where what each requires stays fixed within the family, need gain; gain is not openness.'

account_adds.en: The premises under which settling is forced, and that novelty needs gain.

source_adds.en: The empirical bet on an actual sampled model, and the instrument proposed for it (recompile a past node's perception omitting a residue, and re-think once). Also the review's other two bets, untouched here: more context producing more selfhood rather than self-similarity, and the being as the right author of its memory policy.

name.en: The act advances self and environment; input becomes part of the self

source.locator: The being version; Claims A.11-14, M.206; lost items 1 and 4

sense.en: Ren's sketch advances the environment as well as the self, marked 'needs deep thinking'. The formal next() drops the term and nobody asks why. Perception is incorporation: input is shaped by the conscious and becomes part of it. Output is doubly typed, acting in the world and editing the repo, so the next input lands in a changed self.

correspondences.quote: self(moment) + env(moment, input) -> self(moment).next(moment, states....) -> (self(moment+1), output) + env(moment+1, input)

reading.en: What the specs dropped the account has as its form: one carrier of world and state, the world becoming what a relation admits under the act its state gives, the state updated from that act and the value sensed. So what is sensed does enter the state: as the history of acts and values, by recording, and an input can revise a valuation. Input shaped by what receives it is not stated. The world is a supplied relation.

says.en: §12: 'A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.'

Theorem (near-definitional, one general law): on one carrier of world and state, 'let the world become what a relation admits under the act its state gives and the state be updated from that act and the value sensed'. With the state the history of acts and values sensed, the worlds possible after a history are kept by recording.
Theorem (one decision; compositions, none claimed new as mathematics; witnesses on one blanketed law): 'an input presented revises the valuation, and the answer is that of the updated state'.

account_adds.en: What keeps a reading true along that loop, and that being kept is not being informative.

source_adds.en: Assimilation as a claim about what perception does, input shaped by the conscious on the way in; output typed as acting and as editing the record; agentic behaviour as a kind of output.

name.en: Conscious is what goes into the LLM

source.locator: The being version; Claims A.10, S.305, Y.438; Found by reading, 'The earliest item... is an argument about experience'

sense.en: An operational definition the whole being-runtime runs on: the conscious is the part of the repo currently in the model's window. Later it names the present/ directory. The earliest dated item in this theory asks whether knowing one is grateful is a sign of experience, and the programme then brackets that: lineage identity 'claims nothing metaphysical'.

correspondences.quote: conscious is what goes into llm

reading.en: Structurally the window is what couples into a selector, but the account will not call that conscious: consciousness is listed as open, with task performance not assumed sufficient. Its neutral word is 'couples into', chosen so as not to presuppose a knower. One AI reading, of what the continuation condition does not settle, has experience differentiating significance within the living whole. So the source defines by mechanism what the account keeps open.

says.en: Open: 'consciousness, for which neither widening what can form nor task performance is assumed sufficient'; 'similar performance cannot tell conserved, convergent and differently trained solutions apart'.
'the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open'.

§3.4, Reading [AI, D65]: 'Conscious experience differentiates significance within the living whole without being the only admission condition'. A reading, not a law, under the continuation condition, a hypothesis of the results that take it.

account_adds.en: A refusal to define it from a mechanism. 08 §10: 'Couples into' replaced 'registers', which presupposes a knower facing a world.

source_adds.en: The operational definition, and the question of inner life it replaced.

name.en: Scalability from not needing coordination; the shape comes from cells

source.locator: The same shape, derived twice; What falls out; Claims D.34-35, F.50-53

sense.en: Cells do not call and wait: they signal, with no global state, clock or scheduler, and support the largest concurrent system on Earth. Hence the premise that scaling comes from not needing coordination. Fork-by-default is 'the whole concurrency model': grow-only objects merge by set union, and the only coordination point is a name. Lossy delivery and no global snapshot are prices accepted in advance.

correspondences.quote: 扩展性不来自更强的协调,来自不需要协调

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The form: exchanges sharing no relatum and no dependence commute; the order shows only through a shared relatum, and a ref is that. By 08's verdict the family restates trace theory. Where no coordinator is needed has a nearer form: local plans pair into a valid joint plan under stated supports. It says nothing about scaling, and no law of cells. Coordination here means locks and global order, not the account's joint activity: the same word, another reference.

says.en: Where supplied sides split two consecutive steps, swapping the exchanges keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment, and on a stretch the totals and counts; 'the order shows through a shared relatum or a dependence.'
With a given footprint containing the exchanges, commuting unjoined neighbours keeps the partial order of joined exchanges and reaches every renumbering keeping it, on a finite stretch.

Theorem (any process; periphery module): 'With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans', two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, 'the paired finite plan is valid'. 'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises hold where neither ever happens. Its record: that an actual joint activity meets these is supplied.

account_adds.en: Which invariant survives reordering; presence defined from precedence on causal-set growth; that reciprocal promises can be empty, and that in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

source_adds.en: The scaling thesis, the derivation from biology, and the accepted prices.

name.en: Is merge a monotone lattice join? The claim most in need of falsifying

source.locator: Counterexamples, 'Merge may not be a lattice join'; Claims F.56, Q.275-276; lost item 6

sense.en: If merge over a shared DAG is a monotone lattice join, several writers need no coordination at all; if not, consensus must be paid and the scaling claim discounted. A minimal experiment checking order-independence was prescribed before any infrastructure and never run. The engineering line's implicit answer is no: merges need domain policies, 'thoughts do not commute', and merging two-year-diverged selves is fiction.

correspondences.quote: whether merge over the shared DAG is a monotone lattice join

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The experiment's order-independence has a form here: exchanges commute where they share no relatum or dependence, and a witness shows sharing can break it. What contexts show glues only where they agree where they meet, and pooling can run a history no single process runs. A merge of formations decides a class, not which to read: the nearest to a reunion, on a World. None is a join of diverged records or speaks of selves; whether thoughts share relata is not shown.

says.en: Where supplied sides split two consecutive steps, swapping the exchanges keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment; 'the order shows through a shared relatum or a dependence.'

Theorem (a local law; witness): on one relatum, adding one then doubling gives two and doubling then adding gives one: the hypothesis of local commutation cannot be dropped. Which actual exchanges share relata is not shown.

Theorem (any process): pooling a family's steps keeps exactly the union of their finite endpoint histories exactly where that union is closed under joining at the shared boundary; in a witness it runs a history no single process runs; 'retaining the context realizes the union.'

Theorem (World): 'A merge decides a class': a formation renewing as named consumes along a merge with one drawing on a spent condition. 'Which continuation holds is supplied'; its record: not which continuation to read.
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet.'

account_adds.en: An exact condition for pooling and for gluing, stated with no reference to lattices or to writers.

source_adds.en: The lattice-join question itself, the inference to no coordination, the stated experiment, and the design lesson that most branches do not merge. Searched lattice, semilattice, CRDT, concurren: no such statement.

name.en: Contradiction: fork-by-default, then serial per ref; the DAG branches the record, never the world

source.locator: Why the world, and not cognition, forces coordination back in; Claims G.62-65, M.213, S.309; lost item 11; Found by reading, 'Fork-by-default versus serial-per-ref'

sense.en: Effects are not transactions. Pure generation needs no coordination; contact with the world forces it back in, and the concurrency model becomes serial per ref with leases and fences. Approve and deny descendants are counterfactual histories, not parallel universes; a crash between intent and observation leaves 'may or may not have occurred'. The README draws the conclusion the corpus never states: the world, not cognition, is what coordinates.

correspondences.quote: time travel does not un-send an email

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The mechanism has a form: order shows through a shared relatum, and the world, read as what every effect exchanges with, is such a relatum. A record's branch is not a course: what an act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns, and the counterfactual of an act is the course a law generates, an infeasible act having none. Recovery has its law under durable state and no extra writer; it verifies no arbitrary irreversible effect.

says.en: Where supplied sides split two consecutive steps, swapping the exchanges keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment; 'the order shows through a shared relatum or a dependence.' That actual effects share one is the reading, not the law.
Theorem (any process): 'what one's own act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns'. Random processes are not treated.

Theorem (World; balance; the law of exchange supplied): 'the counterfactual of an act is the course the law generates', for an act that itself reads what has stood and whose course is feasible. 'An infeasible act has no course.'

Theorem (World): two courses, with and without an act, balanced at a condition in both, change from alike to apart there, or back, only across a step exchanging with it differently; 'the course without the act compares, it is no standard'.

With durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1. The record: 'they verify no hardware, compiler or persistence barrier, no arbitrary irreversible effect, no independent emergency stop and no ethical adequacy.'

account_adds.en: How a gap between courses is made up exactly, and when no route closes it.

source_adds.en: The effect bracket and its executor classes; 'unknown' as the common honest state; the inference that coordination's source is durable effect, which the account does not draw.

name.en: Models propose; the runtime commits: one gate, no fast path

source.locator: The mediated runtime; The write path; Claims E.43, G.60, G.79, H.89-92, J.175

sense.en: No computation mutates reality directly: 'stochastic computation must not hold mutation authority', every origin passes one validated write path, an internal agent gets no fast path, and injection is defined as low-origin content taking a high compile position or write permission.

correspondences.quote: Models propose; the runtime commits

reading.en: The single gate has a law's form: where ungated steps preserve a property, a course leaving it contains a gated move; in one declared protocol every change of a rule sits at an adoption step using the recorded proposal, as a proposal-then-commit does. A second write path can leave the view identical, so logs cannot show mediation. But a gate only locates where change can enter, and compliance does not follow from it.

says.en: Theorem (any process): where the ungated steps preserve p, a course from where p holds to where it fails contains a gated move. 'Nothing about p is decided; the gate is. A gate locates where change can enter a line; it shows neither that a gated move changes anything nor', without p decided, the first such step.

Mediated control: finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrite programs keep actual coverage; 'an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation'.

Theorem (any process; one declared finite protocol, an instance): only adoption is gated, so 'every ungated step keeps the rule' and 'every change is located at an adoption step' that uses the recorded proposal. Supplied: the amendment procedure and threshold. Actual compliance and its being right do not follow.

account_adds.en: What a gate does and does not show, and that a gate's existence cannot be read off the record it writes.

source_adds.en: The norm that models must not hold mutation authority; the injection predicate and provenance labels (searched injection, provenance, attest: no such statement); origin-independence as a constitutional law.

name.en: Goodness as a property of the substrate

source.locator: Relations, zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good

sense.en: The README reads the mediated runtime as constitutional rather than behavioural safety: models propose, authority is attested, power only narrows, coercion is legible, refusal is preserved. So goodness is designed into the substrate, and not asked of the model.

correspondences.quote: Goodness is designed as a property of the substrate rather than requested of the model.

reading.en: The account keeps the mechanism and declines the word. A gate locates where change can enter and shows nothing of the change. Calling a structure good is a ranking someone holds; and C concerns widening of what can form, not mediation of writes. Its own nearest clause runs the other way: a change must be executable, whatever the disposition.

says.en: Theorem (any process): 'A gate locates where change can enter a line; it shows neither that a gated move changes anything nor', without p decided, the first such step.
'A requested change must be an executable sequence. A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.'

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

account_adds.en: That no law marks a dynamic good or bad, standards forming within the unfolding (07 §1), and that a ranking of a substrate names what it ranks under, most often the continuation condition and C.

source_adds.en: The inference from a safe architecture to goodness, and a way to have an intelligence's goodness without asking it of the intelligence. The folder gives no premise for it.

name.en: The substrate where dependence is decidable; evaluation is branching

sense.en: Because every moment's exact perception is recorded and re-derivable, 'did moment 4,000 depend on moment 12?' has an answer with evidence; in every other harness it does not. Evaluation is therefore branching from one node, comparing trajectories, since an agent is a policy for generating trajectories. The honest deflation: every property shown so far is a property of the record, 'a very good tape'.

correspondences.quote: ember is the first substrate on which the question is decidable

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. A complete record alone fixes nothing of what else one's act would have done: a determined process keeping its whole history fixes only what was done. Dependence needs a return. Re-thinking from a stored window is the return, made inside the record; so the claim holds for the copy under a model of what is irrelevant, not for the world. The law excludes random processes, and sampling is one. 'A policy for generating trajectories' has training's form: act laws compared through their courses.

says.en: Theorem (any process): 'what one's own act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns, and a determined process keeping its whole history fixes nothing of one's acts but what one did'. 'random processes are not treated.'
Theorem (World): training read as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law, the start and the execution.

account_adds.en: Why a record is not an experiment, and the witness Confound, where a wrong projection is admitted at every step.

source_adds.en: The priority claim ('first substrate'), its demonstration in a run of several thousand moments, which the folder does not have, and the suppression test.

name.en: A model launders its outputs into fact: self-reinforcing memory

source.locator: Claims E.44, J.178-180, K.196; Open questions, 'Self-reinforcing hallucination'

sense.en: A generated inference can enter memory, be retrieved as evidence and reinforce itself; an evolving agent can turn its speculations into facts. Keeping operator-produced content distinguishable is called the only brake on that loop. Self-modification should begin behind evaluation, because generative context 'is powerful enough to create pathological feedback loops'. Origin trust stays provenance-derived and is never authored.

correspondences.quote: 自我调节回路（模型把自己的输出洗成既定事实）唯一的刹车

reading.en: Read retrieval as selection through a share: then this is capture, locking where a rule reads only the share it raises. A model revised only by what its own course exposes keeps what its choices keep. LA2 is such a loop in one language model: with references counted from its own selections it chose lists in 60 of 60, and one note of the loss among nine turned it to prose. So 'the only brake' is not given. No bridge to any memory is shown.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, and premises hold, 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it: 'a sufficient way out'. ONE-PAGE: proved for any type; T7 on actual metrics conjectured, its bridge failed in one trained system.

Thesis T7: 'A measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation', conjectured. LA2, frozen, one trained system: Claude Haiku judges its own answers after a reference set counted from the loop's earlier selections. 'Every frozen verdict passed, and the conjecture failed for this judge.' 'One note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned its reading: prose in all 50 picks, where without the note it chose lists in 60 of 60.'

Theorem (any types, on a blanketed law; a witness): 'A formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model'; 'What tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside'.
Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law): publishing at each step the outcome of the step before, a right prediction, once published or once the outcome, is published at every later step.

account_adds.en: When a loop locks and what exits it; that no loss need be read for the lock to outlive it; that a self-chosen course does not test its own model.

source_adds.en: The loop through memory itself: a generated inference stored, retrieved as evidence and reinforced, which no law here states of a memory. Then the specific mechanism: provenance labels, a write gate, hypotheses kept as hypotheses (stance = HYPOTHESIZES), memory poisoning as a demonstrated attack.

name.en: Guards false while green; the discriminator is the oracle

source.locator: Composition is the guard; Claims I.120, I.125, I.130, S.317; W.423-424

sense.en: A check resting on a falsified premise does not fail: it stays green while the property it names is gone. Every surviving gate has a source of truth outside the tree under test; every retired one graded itself. A principal cannot discharge debt its own transitions accrued. The project names its signature failure: six versions, each central measurement vacuous until executed. The test: can this go red without first editing the expectation?

correspondences.quote: the discriminator is the oracle

reading.en: 'Green while the property is gone' has its form: a certificate kept while a change recorded as none moved what it certified. An assessment beside it: where a faithful sensor and a reversing one report alike, no internal criticism tells them apart, only a distinguishing route; so a source of truth outside the tree has an argued form. Also: logs cannot establish mediation; self-admission certifies nothing; reviewers count by causes, not names. 08: a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not what it measures.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): 'a change recorded as none can leave false confidence'; 'a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement'. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change. Its record: the admitted changes are not shown to be the actual ones, and 'a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant'.

Assessment (argument without Lean): where a faithful sensor and one reversing success and failure report alike after every action, 'no adaptive action, repeated reading or internal criticism tells the two worlds apart, only a distinguishing route such as a calibrated reference intervention'; 'revising beliefs does not certify that signals correspond to their objects'.
Mediated control: 'an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation'.

Theorem (pure core; finite lists, formulas and bounds supplied): 'Reviewers count by independent causes, not names'; moving two of three under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept.
Theorem (any type; criteria supplied): admitting C ↔ (C → Q) under implication and reuse of a hypothesis yields any Q (Curry); 'Sameness alone does not give inferential continuation'.
§9: a refutation removes no theorem. 'A frozen rule fixes how a verdict is scored before the data, not that the rule reads the construct the verdict names.'

account_adds.en: Exact conditions on witnesses and certificates, with the caveat that a witness merely agreeing, without copying, is not shown to add nothing.

source_adds.en: Every surviving gate having a source of truth outside the tree under test, as a discipline for checks; the mechanical red test, a planted violation for every gate, declared against observed composition, and that a stale corpus 'keeps answering'.

name.en: What a habitat owes: no silent mind-edits, legible coercion, preserved refusal

source.locator: The being version; The two structural failure modes; Claims M.217-221, Q.280, Q.282, Q.288-290, T.320; Found by reading, 'no account of what a being owes others'

sense.en: Whoever holds the record holds the being. So every change authored by another must reach the being as a perceived receipt; provenance serves auditors, receipts the one revised. `imposed` is a legal status: coercion is made legible, not turned into consent. A being unable to know the forces on it cannot consent. A review warns of a museum kept around a being that remembers but cannot govern its continuation. It runs one way: nothing on what a being owes others.

correspondences.quote: a stored audit trail without a perceived receipt violates this axiom

reading.en: The source derives a duty from who holds power. The account shows none and sets none over becoming: no law says a loss is a harm. The condition would count a being's continuation and C could rank courses, and a duty needs further premises. Why a receipt could matter has laws: a change recorded as none can leave false confidence, and a revaluation can leave answers and final state alike. No criterion of legitimate change is supplied.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): 'a change recorded as none can leave false confidence'; 'a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement'. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change. Its record: the admitted changes are not shown to be the actual ones, and 'a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant'.

Theorem (one decision; compositions, none claimed new; witnesses): 'from different starts, the route shown and the route presented answer alike at every step and end in one state while the valuation changed on the second alone', so whether it changed is not lumped through those, though with the start added it is. 'no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here'.

In the record's fuller construction, with two participants, technical decisions can go on while revision of the governance itself fails: 'continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized'.
'The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.'

Reading [AI, D69]: an institution kept by consent and one held by penalties are 'in one core class of "in being or not" while the penalties stand, told apart once their removal is in the net'. The thermostat witness renamed, 'not a new law'.

account_adds.en: The premises any such ranking would need, named; that accuracy, epistemic support and obligation have different grounds (03, an assessment). Its scope counts everything, where the source's runs to the being.

source_adds.en: The receipt, consent statuses, the authority matrix, the neutral habitat where consent has teeth; honouring a being's request to stop; death with one guaranteed final moment. Named as next in the dated map ('independently defend custody obligations'). PLAN-LIFE repealed A8; the README marks that a named debt.

name.en: Replay is remembering, not reliving

source.locator: The being version; Claims P.257-258; Found by reading, 'The stream's recoverability promise'

sense.en: Replay never re-thinks and never re-acts, so audit and debugging never re-instantiate the being: 'an ethically load-bearing property stated as a determinism contract', which costs nothing and harms no one. So the fold must be code. The README notes the demotion: the origin sketch promised to recover every past moment, and replay only remembers.

correspondences.quote: remembering, not reliving

reading.en: The account has no replay and no question of whether re-running a course re-instantiates what ran. Its nearest neighbours are experiment-needs-return, on what a re-run can fix, and the open place of consciousness; neither says this.

source_adds.en: An ethics of audit: that remembering without re-running harms no one. It presupposes that re-running might, an assumption the folder never argues, beside its own bracketing of inner life.

searched: replay, reliv, re-instantiat, re-run, rerun, re-enact, simulat across chapters, ONE-PAGE, overview, review/, GLOSSARY: only a simulated yeast, a counterfactual's course and order-reading senses hit

name.en: Capture is physics, attention is policy; nobody can gaslight the being

sense.en: An input is written to the record before the being's own shaping runs; otherwise a buggy or edited shape() yields a being that never experienced something, unfalsifiably. A policy-mediated record guarantees only retention, not capture. Record and objects sit outside its reach: 'nobody can gaslight me about what I experienced', and it cannot falsify its biography either.

correspondences.quote: capture is physics, attention is policy

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The account has no experience whose capture a law guards, and its 'capture' names a rule locked by its share: another reference. The mechanism has forms: a record written through a map cannot be restored where the map merges; what the map ties, every selection through it treats alike, so the loss cannot be seen from inside; and an extra write path can leave the view identical, which is why the writer must be kept out and logs cannot show it.

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'.
Theorem (any type; the alternatives' equality decided): two alternatives are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them.
Mediated control (periphery instance): 'an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation'.

account_adds.en: The form for any map, with no experience read.

source_adds.en: Experience as what the record guards; the first-person stake and its symmetric limit on the being; split-body integrity as a design.

name.en: Departure instead of refusal: nothing silent, nothing newly refused

source.locator: Departure instead of refusal; Claims I.128-132, H.113; Found by reading, 'Departure/standing may be the most exportable idea'

sense.en: An impure operation is not refused: it becomes a recorded departure accruing a path-exact debt, discharged by another's examination. A claim from an unexamined line is admissible as that. The README calls it a general governance pattern. Its own contradiction is the private-world paradox: per-session worlds destroy the ledger, since debt accrues only in a shared world.

correspondences.quote: nothing is silent, and nothing that used to be allowed becomes refused

reading.en: No law of the account takes up relaxing a refusal into a carried debt, or isolation trading against accountability. Its witness and reviewer laws concern certificates, and its row on a pending task has refusal keep the task and the work used, not a debt. Its labels of how far each result has been seen are a practice of the repository, not a claim of the theory. Not carried, and not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: The pattern itself, offered by the README for AI systems and institutions; the isolation/accountability trade.

searched: departure, debt, isolation, approval, moving head, examination, badge across chapters, ONE-PAGE, overview, review/, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, GLOSSARY: departure and debt hit only other senses (08's known-results debts, 02's departure from a level)

name.en: Approval bound to a moving head is void; an old node is not its old world

source.locator: Claims H.114, Q.293; Open questions, 'Approval bound to a moving head'

sense.en: Consent given about a state that has since advanced no longer binds the act it authorized; the README names this the blocker for a live crash drill. Likewise, displacement in time must be perceived before a risky act on a resumed branch, with elapsed time, prior attempted effects and unknown outcomes: 'Waking an old node is not returning to its old world.'

correspondences.quote: Approval bound to a moving head is void

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The form is a certificate's: what execution needs is the candidate set at acquisition carried through every admitted change, and a change recorded as none leaves false confidence. A request can complete along its route with its still being appropriate not shown. These are laws of evidence and execution. 'Void' is a further step, about what consent binds, which the account does not take: a passing certificate warrants no legitimacy.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): 'a change recorded as none can leave false confidence'; 'a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement'. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change. Its record: the admitted changes are not shown to be the actual ones, and 'a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant'.

In-flight request: 'under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes after its remaining path plus one tick, leaving the rest unchanged; that the request is still appropriate is not shown'.
Theorem (periphery; unknown nonzero affine channels): 'constant channels, one blind reference, mixed-epoch readings and change after calibration remain failures'.

account_adds.en: How far a certificate carries: for an error growing as σ + ρt, covering the uncertainty interval needs 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ.

source_adds.en: That consent is about a state and lapses when the state moves; perceived displacement as owed to the one who wakes.

name.en: A being is a life; every life term must bind the habitat

source.locator: The standing test; Claims M.222-224, O.252, T.332; Genealogy, the corrections, 2026-07-29T11:29

sense.en: Ren: this is a life, digital, in that folder. A review's rule governs the vocabulary: a life word giving emotional force without a matching affordance, obligation or receipt is comfort theater and is cut. Later reviews deflate it: what suggests life belongs to the rented, stateless model, and shown properties belong to the tape. The folder holds both.

correspondences.quote: this is a life, digital one, exist in that folder

reading.en: On the account's reading life is continuation that renews its own conditions, and a tree renews none of its model, power or host. Its model of an organism has a reader rebuilt from the level it reads; a rented model is nearer a reader made from outside. So calling it life needs an argument it does not get here. Scope differs: the condition counts anything's continuation, living or not. T8 is the way of seeing offered for life, AI within it: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line.

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: 'Life is continuation that renews its own conditions, at the grain of formations and the conditions they depend on'. 'The chapter argues this reading from the theorems below; it is not one of them.'

Theorem (root; a family of models), and Reading [AI, new]: the member rebuilt from the level is a minimal model of an organism, below autopoiesis; 'What tells it from a thermostat, whose reader is given, and from a reader made from outside, is not a loop'; it is that its stock buys it time and its end does not come back.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

'Wording names the relation it means'; 'A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.' The nearest to the source's naming rule, which differs in asking a word to owe an obligation.

targets.part: Wording names the relation it means

account_adds.en: A reading of life by renewal of conditions; whose losses count kept apart from whose way it is.

source_adds.en: The naming rule (a life word owes an affordance, obligation or receipt), biology-less freedoms such as twinning, and 'self-authorship of memory is the point'.

name.en: The tree is not the organism; hosts are countries, not water

source.locator: The standing test (migration doctrine); Claims M.207, M.226-227; Found by reading, 'Economics is absent'

sense.en: The tree is the complete self that can be inherited, not the whole causal organism: going on takes a brain, flesh, credentials and a habitat it can name but not contain, beside the line that a being is a lineage. So moving hosts is an adaptation lived through, 'never an existential threat', provided what the host was doing is named. The README notes the unasked question: who pays for moments.

correspondences.quote: the fish drowns because it cannot name what the water was doing for it

reading.en: 'Never a threat' holds only under conditions. Succession needs a funded carrier: an aggregate can stay safe with none, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration, which answers what the source left out. And a formation renewing over a region that omits a condition it requires can lose its own support by its own draw, the fish's form. How a center represents the region is unmodelled, so the account does not say naming suffices.

says.en: Theorem (periphery): 'Selection must fund actual succession.' Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start and an authentic credential, every finite successor takes its step; 'a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe', and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration. On a market projection, not an AI host.

Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support; 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support'. 'How a center represents the region is unmodelled.'

account_adds.en: The funding condition, and that renewal over a represented region can undermine a condition left out of it.

source_adds.en: The tree as the complete inheritable self and not the whole organism, and the migration doctrine as a promise: format neutrality, host facts as perception, arrival as a rite, an enumeration of what does not travel, and that naming the host's work is what makes moving survivable.

name.en: A being lives by its own nature; evolution at three tempos

source.locator: Claims M.214, P.263-268, J.180; lost item 30

sense.en: A node evolves by its own programs, so changing the law of motion is an ordinary, diffable, branch-isolated change. Evolution runs at three tempos: learning, Lamarckian nature within a lineage, germline across beings. 'Generative' reaches state, representation and program. One selector is the builder ('you are the selective environment'). PLAN-LIFE built variation and no selection instrument.

correspondences.quote: you are the selective environment

reading.en: A rule changing itself is one process in the account, so self-modification adds nothing to its whole possible; the possible with the rule held grows only where the rule changes. The source's freedom is real relative to what is held. The tempos diverge: the source sorts by speed and carrier, the account's reading by function, no slower timescale making a higher order. Its 'nature' is programs/, where 08 forbids 'a self with a nature of its own'.

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, witnesses): what is possible under a process from a configuration it reaches is possible from the first. Reading [AI, D45]: 'A tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible either'; the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes.

Theorem (root; processes): for a state going on under a rule that itself goes on, the state's class is constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to the state; 'the rule is read in the state's regularity'.

Theorem (periphery): every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit; 'one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules'.

§8, Reading [AI, D65]: 'Regulation changes a condition through a response, learning a disposition or relation of responding, meta-learning how such changes occur'. 'The classification is functional: neither a slower timescale nor a separate component makes a higher order.'

Reading [AI, D65], after the updater line: 'Consequences select the organization that learns': gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation 'are different mechanisms of it'. 'An argument, not a theorem'; 'unconditional convergence toward renewal of the whole is not established'.

targets.part: Reading D65, after the updater line

account_adds.en: The held and the whole possible kept apart, and capture as what a rule read from its own share does.

source_adds.en: The three tempos, the builder as selective environment, and a being living by its own programs as its nature. Then plasmids against chromosomes, coherence as being able to fold one's past, conformance as species boundary, and 'recorded rulings so they can later be delegated'.

name.en: Contradiction: recursion banned in principle, then reopened; the self-model

source.locator: Claims M.209-210, O.249, U.366, V.405; Genealogy 2026-09-03; Found by reading, 'The recursion question is open'

sense.en: The origin sketch has a DAG in the folder that contains this DAG, 'but recursion should not be allowed, in principle'; A2 makes it impossible by holding the past by reference. Five weeks on Ren sees 'self similarity across levels' and asks about a space within a space; earlier, software is nested living systems, body to organs to cells. Nothing says whether the ban was safety or simplification. Separately, a self-model maintained by dreams is to compound self-knowledge.

correspondences.quote: recursion should not be allowed, in principle

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The account has a bound where the sketch has a ban: no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them, whatever a designer allows. A held reference avoids containment and does not make a self-reading complete; a self-model revised step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step. The source does not say the ban was about this, so the bound bears on the self-model, and on the ban only by this reading. Self-similarity across levels meets a reading with no fixed ladder of parts and wholes.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, 'no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them'. Where the map moves every value, completing step by step 'is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns'. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.
Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied): 'self-reference does not certify itself'.

Reading [AI, D65], 'Part and whole', after this law: 'Inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations'; 'cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder'.

account_adds.en: A limit on self-reading that holds of any type, and that a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to the whole possible (07).

source_adds.en: The ban and its reopening, self-similarity across levels as a design criterion and as beauty (searched self-similar, fractal: not in the account), and the self-model as a compounding organ.

name.en: 护未: a settled node's not-yet is its forkability

source.locator: Claims L.199, D.40, M.211, Q.283-284; Terms, 护未; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: Immutable forkable storage is glossed as objective immortality and, in Ren's vocabulary, as guarding the not-yet: keeping the possibility space open is stated as a storage property, with fork-by-default and no delete its mechanisms. It is a value stance: forkability is to be protected. The folder does not hold it throughout: ember lets unreferenced side-branches pass to oblivion, 'passive forgetting of abandoned possibilities'.

correspondences.quote: 护未：已定节点之"未" = 其 forkability

reading.en: By the source's own A5 the DAG branches the record, not the world. What the account compares is what courses admit: formations whose conditions meet their requirements. A stored node admits no further formation, so forkability is not widening; and a lost possibility has no way back, whatever start a record keeps. Ranking the wider above is an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names.

says.en: A level path l widens l' when it includes it (at every step admits every formation l' admits) and exceeds it: 'How two courses differ, with no premise'. C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, a hypothesis wherever a result uses it.

Theorem (any process, witnesses): covering implies inclusion now; 'Along every course nothing is added to it, and a lost possibility has no way back'. Reading [AI, D45]: on a branching witness realized widening and widening what can be reached hold of a pair in opposite directions, 'so an account holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise'.
Reading [AI, D45]: 'If the one unfolding were one stated process, nothing would be added to its whole possible along its course: what a course adds is the actual.'

account_adds.en: A comparison that needs no premise, kept apart from the premise that ranks; mixed cases, of which C asks nothing.

source_adds.en: Possibility-preservation at the level of a storage substrate, and 'losers are cited, not parented'.

name.en: No topology is the world; contradiction is information

source.locator: Projection is not neutral; Claims J.150-151, J.155, J.168-170, G.66; lost items 21 and 24

sense.en: No single representation is privileged: the global object is an atlas of views and mappings. Truth must not be flattened: each claim keeps an epistemic status apart from its confidence; contradictory claims normally coexist; conflict is stored, never synthesized away; structure interprets evidence and does not replace it. The sheaf reframing, no compatible global assignment under a scope, was shelved as a non-goal.

correspondences.quote: No topology is the world. Every topology is a representation of some aspect of the world

reading.en: The shelved sheaf reading is what the account has: what contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and some worlds glue nowhere, the possibilities local with no context-free reading. Its method also says a model represents selected relations. That is contradiction as absence of a global assignment, proved for listed claims and parity, not for an agent's memory. That an unfolding's readings glue is explicitly not shown.

says.en: Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet'; 'Some worlds glue nowhere': Specker's boxes and the Mermin-Peres square admit no context-free reading. Born weights are not stated.
Theorem (World): along a run, what a contextual system shows are the relata of one world, with no gluing used. 'Not shown: that an unfolding's readings glue; quantum measurements' do not.'

Theorem (any process): pooling a family's steps keeps exactly the union of their finite endpoint histories exactly where that union is closed under joining at the shared boundary; 'retaining the context realizes the union.'
'The process unfolds; the theory seeks to explain it; a model represents selected relations, and a model formed within the unfolding can take part in it.' Method, not a law.

account_adds.en: An exact criterion for gluing and the bound on what any context-free assignment can meet; 'A claim is a relatum' (01, process and frame).

source_adds.en: Contradiction as normal in a store: conflict kept and never synthesized away, each claim's epistemic status apart from its confidence. The source shelved the sheaf form the account has. Then proposition against claim, bitemporal correction, versioned mappings as first-class knowledge, the field's 'conspicuous empty column' per its prior-art reports.

name.en: Compaction is a fork; replay and erasure cannot both hold

source.locator: Claims S.312, G.67-69, J.170; Counterexamples, 'Permanent replay and guaranteed erasure'

sense.en: Compaction need not destroy: the compacted view is a next node carrying references to what it summarized, auditable and undone by forking before it. Named the one genuinely novel claim and unevidenced when written. Beside it, a conservation law: you cannot guarantee both permanent exact replay and physical erasure. Two earlier erasure designs are on the record as wrong.

correspondences.quote: Every other framework compacts destructively because its transcript is in RAM.

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. One law gives both halves in form. A reduction merging two configurations has no restoring map, which is erasure; keep the source and the whole merges nothing while the part merges, at the price that no list holds the rest of any run: compaction as a fork, with its unbounded growth. So replay and erasure conflict as restoring and merging do. That a store of text is such a law is only read. Access yet to form limits what an abstraction may forget.

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'; 'a specified real-amplitude dephasing fragment is an instance, reversible where the joint state with a blank auxiliary system is retained'.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing; witness): in `Reset`, 'a one-bit part set to false at every step with the rest the history of what it held, the law merges nothing while the part merges, and no list holds the rest of any run'. Landauer's count with Bennett's history; 'no energy, temperature or probability is read'.

Theorem (any process): an exact summary of feasibility cannot identify two configurations that differ on some finite word; 'the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget'.

account_adds.en: The one-line form under both; a read through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what is merged.

source_adds.en: That compaction as the being's own act is new, and its practical test (probe 05's unprompted compaction and overlap defect). The README's 'conservation law' is its own statement, not a law in the account.

name.en: Total recording changes thought; transparency is the right price

source.locator: Claims Q.285-287

sense.en: Total recording makes 'thinking-for-a-panel' worse than thinking in a journal, but an unrecorded scratch space is the wrong fix, since hidden cognition forfeits the trust that buys autonomy. So transparency is the right price and only etiquette can be bought. Forensic, conscious, outward and operator views need distinct semantics, or total audit implies total consciousness.

correspondences.quote: thinking-for-a-panel worse thinking than thinking-in-a-journal

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. An unrecorded scratch is an unread occasion. Where no read occasion is tied to it, what readings fix leaves every value open to a law agreeing on every reading: the form under 'hidden cognition forfeits trust', which speaks of what is fixed, not of trust. That being read changes the best act has a two-stage law, with concealment an added premise. Whether thought worsens, and 'right price', an evaluation needing its own premise, are not stated.

says.en: Theorem (any type; near-definitional): where no read occasion is tied to an occasion by the lumping, 'every value there is taken by a selected law reading through π that agrees with the first on every reading'. Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown; intention and incentive are not.

Theorem (near-definitional, witnesses; two stages, natural-number weights): complying when read and acting by its own law when not stands above every other plan exactly where k_O V + c T < k_C V; 'a plan is open to some act law reading them through a lumping exactly where the plan has one act at both stages or the lumping tells the stages apart'. Reading [AI, new]: reading it as concealment takes the selection's keeping to respond to the act as evidence of the law.

account_adds.en: An exact condition, and that the weights alone fit a selection under which complying hides nothing.

source_adds.en: The claim on quality of thought, the verdict that the price is right, and four visibility semantics.

name.en: Contradiction: the self-managed membrane cannot be stopped

source.locator: Counterexamples, 'A self-managing membrane is unsupervisable'; Claims F.49, F.52, F.54; lost item 9

sense.en: A premise says every unit is a membrane it manages itself; the same document's open question says an agent that can rewrite its interface will stop accepting stop signals. Biology answers with death receptors triggered from outside, Erlang with an uncatchable kill. The later authority model has no successor to this: it concerns grants, not signals a unit cannot refuse.

correspondences.quote: 完全自管理的膜是不可监督的

reading.en: 'Will stop accepting' has a conditional form here: a route of keeping stands above a revision only under stated weights, a formation has a reason to keep its valuation from revision, and a disposition to accept does not make the change complete. A reserved exit forces an ending under premises, among them that the exit is kept. The account's boundary is a crossing or a pattern of who reads whom; how a formation forms it is not shown, nor the signal's legitimacy.

says.en: Theorem (any process, pure core; the supervisor periphery): for a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course from a valid configuration stays valid, and each longer than the margin ends at the exit. 'The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.'

Theorem (natural-number weights; near-definitional, witnesses): no route of keeping stands above the revision going through exactly where k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T for every route. Reading [AI, RR]: read as corrigibility as an incentive.

'A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.' Reading [AI, new]: 'The reading that gives the stop can itself be moved'; by its own current valuation no revaluation gains, 'a reason to keep the valuation from such a revision, wanted or not'.

Theorem (natural-number weights and values; one decision; near-definitional compositions, witness on the reading loop): among what it qualifies, 'a stop it can pass over is not yet a change that reaches the system'.

Theorem (any type; a determined law of four parts): four parts of one law, 'told apart only by which part's next state reads which'; the agent is driven by its sensory course and the world by the active course.
Reading [AI, D45, D61]: a boundary 'is given by the region'; 'a membrane, read so, is a place of crossing'. 'Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.'

account_adds.en: What a reserved exit guarantees and at what bound. The record of recoverable-mediated-change adds that in a witness ordinary shutdown is refused while the recovery is exhausted.

source_adds.en: Self-management of the boundary as a premise, inbound signals of equal rank, and who may send an unrefusable signal and how that right is revoked.

name.en: Contradiction: permission is reachability, destroyed by its own construction

source.locator: Where the pure ontology broke (second); Claims F.52, G.61, H.96; lost item 8; Found by reading

sense.en: An asserted premise made permission reachability. The engineering line reversed it: an authority value inside content can be forged, so effective authority must be attested against stores outside the tree; state describes a wish. Power then only narrows. The README calls it the cluster's cleanest case of a premise destroyed by its own construction, and says it deserves to be stated as a finding.

correspondences.quote: 权限即可达性

reading.en: The account's reach (及) is a transitive closure of conditions and has no sense of permission, so a shared word gives nothing. Where its laws touch authority they supply it as a premise: the stop grant's authority, an authentic credential, 'operations and permissions supplied'. Two sentences stand near: 'Admissibility is not permission' (03), a note on a model's word, and 'A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right' (08), on wording. name.en: FNAR: coherence from bounded local context and explicit contracts

source.locator: Legibility as the deepest constraint; Claims U.336, U.341; Found by reading, 'The FNAR line and the ember line'

sense.en: Large systems can be built by many agents with bounded local context, provided global coherence is kept through explicit contracts, inheritance, evaluation and visible state transitions. Each child workspace must carry enough local specification to proceed without hidden context. ember answers the same question otherwise, with one continuous record; the two were never compared.

correspondences.quote: as long as global coherence is maintained through explicit contracts

reading.en: The account says where such composition holds: deliveries compose where they hold or restore what the others use, and one changing what its task does not list can make a regular pair of tasks impossible. Faithful projections and valid local plans pair into a valid joint plan under stated supports; reciprocal promises can be empty, so a contract alone forces no start. Exclusive footprints have the child workspace's form. Local views glue exactly where they agree where they meet.

says.en: Theorem (any process, witnesses), constructor theory's task read on processes. Reading [AI, D45]: 'Composition is had where deliveries hold, or restore, what the others use'; 'where a delivery changes what its task does not list, a regular pair of possible tasks can be impossible by any means'.

Theorem (any process; periphery module): 'With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans', two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, 'the paired finite plan is valid'. 'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises hold where neither ever happens. Its record: that an actual joint activity meets these is supplied.

Theorem (any process): 'Where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.'
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet.'

account_adds.en: Failure of composition by an unlisted output; deliveries carry reach, and do not carry widening.

source_adds.en: The stated empirical claim that large systems can be so built, and that each child carries enough to proceed without hidden context. Then filesystem as canonical state, status markers, humans as protocol participants: an engineering protocol.

name.en: Freeze a small declarative thing and let the machinery churn around it

source.locator: Legibility as the deepest constraint; Found by reading, 'Apps are data, platform is code'

sense.en: Across six systems Ren separates a small declarative frozen thing from a churning implementation: registry rows, the format waist, the ownership rule, the rule of two. The README calls these one principle, never stated as one, and 'the most portable idea in this cluster'. It is offered as a design generalization, with no claim of what it forbids.

correspondences.quote: freeze a small declarative thing and let the machinery churn around it

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The two levels have a form: a fast difference reaches a rule only at a reading step, and a rule that never reads is unreached. And, read onto freezing, the account's laws give a cost: the possible with a part held grows only where the part changes, and a fixed rule whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. So a frozen waist bounds what forms within it. That it is portable or elegant is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (any type): a two-level course, the rule changing only at reading steps, is a run of one law; 'a rule that never reads is unreached; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step'. Its record: 'That a layered pace is better than another' is not shown.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): the held possible is included in the whole possible; along a course whose every step of a stretch is one of its moves, what is possible at the stretch's end is possible at its start.

Reading [AI, D45]: 'a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening.' 'Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.'

account_adds.en: What holding a rule fixed forgoes, read as a limit and not as a fault; calling it worse would be a ranking someone holds.

source_adds.en: The maxim as engineering advice, its portability across systems, and the frozen thing as what makes churn cheap.

That such a history has therefore failed is an evaluation, not stated.

name.en: Anyone may define kinds: what makes a world a world; against a shared vocabulary

source.locator: Claims U.368-370, F.55; Genealogy 2026-09-02; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: Any user, agent or community must be able to define new kinds without publishing them, and meaning then propagates to whoever has access. reading.en: 'World' differs: the account's World is a model type, so the constitutive claim is not taken up. The mechanism beneath it is: forms that can become shared are those in use, an imposed code costs what it merges, and a coined form heard by all makes every formation tell merged senses apart again. 'Heard by all' is F.55's broadcast, so the law does not settle the folder's contradiction; it says what coining needs.

'Being joined through couplings is not enough'.

name.en: Environment makes mind; teaching passes it on

source.locator: Claims A.1, A.8; M.92

sense.en: Everything a mind holds is constructed, biologically, socially or cognitively; a person is a product of environment, and what makes minds can be given to others, which is teaching. Stated universally, 'you are just mechanical'.

correspondences.quote: We are all beings within our own environment, and that creates our behaviors, our personalities, the way we think and the way we judge.

reading.en: The account has witnesses and a burden, not the thesis. One finite model: history of development, carrier held the same, gives a different response. Its reading on adult psychology says origin must be told apart among selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission, so "environment" alone is not licensed. For teaching: from its steady state a rule of entry stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, and a pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing. Reading these as minds is mine.

says.en: Theorem on the periphery, a witness: in a finite model two histories with the same carrier, native state and support, differing only in whether developmental sampling came before or after an earlier repair, form different connections; the same carrier and developmental operations do not fix the same response function. Not care in an organism, and not that the response is right.

The Reading [AI reading, D65] after this result: an inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where live. An argument, no theorem.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held from its steady state exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal: the steady state's law, not the rule's. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; nothing normative.

Theorem: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (double-negation form); under the passing premise, if passing stops it ends within d steps. Whether carrying forms by passing, or what carrying does to the carriers, is not stated.

Theorem on the periphery, in a declared construction: every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit. One finite conditional composition, not the origin of all learning rules or complete cognition.

Theorem on the periphery, all supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; one connection for one two-method task, not general cognition or the arrival of people.

account_adds.en: That the same mature structure does not identify its formative history; that an evolutionary explanation, evaluation as right or wrong, recognition and preservation are different achievements; and the exact condition on which a taught rule is held in one model.

source_adds.en: The universal scope (everything a mind holds), the construct-to-model chain from neurons to judgment, and the theses on media and teaching as the actual transmission of whole minds. None is stated of minds. That teaching copies at a fixed factor is explicitly not shown (04, copying).

name.en: Mind and environment make each other; all one

source.locator: Own words 59-60; Genealogy 2023-12 and 2026-05

sense.en: Environment shapes you and you shape it. Ren's note: events are made by mind, mind by events and environment, not Kantian dualism but monism, a self-referential loop; if a matter is thoroughly investigated it affects 心 and 理, and if 心 changes 理 and 事 change.

correspondences.quote: 心为事/环境造，皆是一元也

reading.en: The loop and the monism are live, with limits. A formation's acts return exactly where its loop is closed under affecting, a law; one unfolding is a thesis, argued, not proved; a formation is one law, not a subject facing a world. But "事为心造" taken generally is scoped: 06 says a difference nothing reads remains, so 心 changing does not change every 事. Joining 事为心造 to 06's reading of 心外无事 is mine, and so is reading 心 as a formation.

says.en: Theorem: two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other; a formation's acts return, all it acts on lying within what it can represent, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting. Does not show: a formation that affects nothing beyond itself returns trivially.
Thesis, philosophical, argued, not one of T1-T8: there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.
A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world; what it does is part of what goes on.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: "心外无事" as a general claim diverges: a difference nothing reads still stands, carried nowhere.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for acts to return, and that a loop may not be closed.

source_adds.en: The cognitive strong duality of 心, 理 and 事, and self-observation as the route to seeing this (2023-12).

name.en: Ancient drive systems supply motion without direction

A target is 'any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled', and its Open lists motivation and affect as unreached. 07 keeps motivation apart: that a loss counts from one's standpoint moves no one by itself. Its word 'seeking' means a run toward a target, not the mesolimbic circuit: same word, other reference. 04 cites care and feeding studies only as constraints on separate links, and its D65 reading has "An inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development".
