name.en: What makes a basin inescapable

source.locator: Claim E.43

sense.en: Marked [C]. Six patterns, none totalizing alone: drive coupling, resolution deferral, identity fusion, social proof closure, exit cost escalation, and deepest, attractor-generated epistemology, where the attractor supplies the method by which it would be assessed.

correspondences.quote: the attractor supplying the method, not the conclusions

reading.en: Three of the six have a form. Attractor-generated epistemology: a reading itself formed from the share absorbs any change of reading. Social proof closure: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach, and selection through later copiers runs through those before them; a rule read as the pool drawn from those it selects. Identity fusion: a habit or identity become the fixed measure of later cases, refusal read as resistance. Resolution deferral resembles a target unmet at rest, my reading. Each rests on named premises; whether minds meet them is kept apart.

says.en: Theorem: where neither next share nor rule read reads the beyond, the lock outlives the loss; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem: with readers counted as the population counts them, the rule read is a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'; a loss read only by the others keeps the lock exactly where carriers are at least as many when it is read.
Theorem: a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Theorem, near-definitional: where every member from k on acts alike whatever its own coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow. It does not show when an actual member stops reading its own coupling. Reading [D45]: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach.

The Reading [AI reading, D65] after these laws: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost; diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment.

account_adds.en: That the timing of a reading of the loss decides; that T7 is about courses where drift rarely leaves the lock; and a frozen test (LA2): with one trained judge, one note of the loss among nine turned it and the pool-of-readers conjecture failed there, the law standing within its hypotheses.

source_adds.en: Drive coupling and exit cost escalation as named mechanisms, the threat-response of identity fusion, and that none alone suffices. Near exit cost only: a reading that a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise, and a bound on leaving that falls across the distance from the mass.

name.en: The captured mind: Moloch in miniature

source.locator: Claims H.53-54; 'Where this becomes politics'

sense.en: [AI-doc, with R] Under the totalizing dynamic feeling becomes sovereign, reason serves existing wants, drives become identity, and the shared world for arguing the good disappears. The dynamic manufactures the minds that find it obvious, so structural reform alone does not reach cognition; the worshipper is Moloch in miniature. "Not about any person. Structural."

correspondences.quote: the loop closes at the level of persons

reading.en: The loop has a home, by descent, for 02's D26 reads the corpus's own meta-attractor: winners forming the minds that read the scorecard is `ReadsShare` on the reading. And "structural reform alone" has a form: a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed, a change of reading too where formed from the share. But readers being minds stays a reading. At one person the nearest law is a counted lock, not the meta-attractor, its score standing. The source calls the capture a disease; no law here does, and what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

says.en: With the Reading on the corpus's meta-attractor [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners writing the scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading; that readers are minds is a reading; what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

Theorem on counts: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices, under a standing score, never leaves the region its threshold sets, even against its score. Reading [D45]: it is capture through the rule; its score stands, so it is not the meta-attractor, whose reading too is formed from the share. No probability or free energy.

Thesis T7: a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation; in the model only invariance under the unread and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

account_adds.en: That the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours; that the same form holds whichever direction a loop locks; and, beside the source's "not about any person", that whose losses count is asked apart from blame (07's crux, argued, not proved).

source_adds.en: The phenomenology (feeling promoted, introspection as strategy, loss of the shared world), that reason's oldest function is correcting desire, and the capture as a disease. None is named in the live text.

name.en: The political claim is epistemic before institutional

source.locator: Claim H.56; 'The intervention target follows'; own words 48-49; Genealogy 2024-10

sense.en: The root causes are in our thinking; the most fundamental substrate of society is how we see things and choose; "the minds are trapped". So the object of intervention is the mind, and the foundation is a way of seeing, a meta layer above perception and choice. The source's own paragraph pulls the other way: "the environment is the intervention surface".

correspondences.quote: right now the minds are trapped, let's set the foundation - where we think beyond these logic

reading.en: The account agrees a way out must change what is read, and locates it elsewhere than minds: a change of law, of how the rule reads, or of selection; 明 is coupling joined to the selection. That a reading is a mind is itself a reading; a reform of the reading alone does not outlast the next reading. T3 forbids an instruction keeping a dependent uncoupled; T4 found no told scope keeping an untold one; 07 says seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough. So a way of seeing alone is scoped, on those systems.

says.en: Theorem: where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share. Reading: that readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

Thesis T7 forbids, among others, a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. Only invariance under the unread and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.
Theorem: a reading while the others' late reading a step on still favours them turns the course; once it would favour the shapers the lock stays; a deadline bounds the window.

T3 forbids, with couplings fixed: an instruction that does not bring a dependent into what the learners couple into, yet keeps it more often than the same learners without the instruction. The clause on trained systems is conjectured.

Thesis T4: an AI system told the scope abstractly keeps a dependent wherever three couplings hold at once. IN1 mixed by its frozen rule (round 2, with talk: R2 passed; R1, R3 and R4 failed), partly passed per model (with talk, one model of two); no condition kept an untold dependent; transfer untested. T4 tests installing the scope, which the continuation condition fixes; by itself it ranks nothing.

Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

account_adds.en: That a reading is timed, and that its effect runs through couplings; both are stated for models and one test on trained systems, not for societies.

source_adds.en: The priority of the epistemic over the institutional, and that a meta layer of seeing is the fundamental substrate. On people the account has no test.

name.en: Channel the drives; the disease is foreclosure

source.locator: Claims B.17-18; 'The normative turn'

sense.en: Drives are ancient and a primary cause of civilizational failure when positive feedback runs unchecked. So design channels them toward harmony and never flattens hierarchy; some hierarchies bring peace. The disease is foreclosure, not strength.

correspondences.quote: the disease is foreclosure, not strength or hierarchy as such

reading.en: The account keeps the structure and withholds the ruling. A closing is mapped by form; what it opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is left to a comparer's reading, under the scope and order it holds. So "foreclosure is the disease" is conditional here, and "harmony" reads nothing named. "Unchecked feedback breaks a system" has form with scope: a loop of recurring couplings need not run away. On hierarchy 06 records a layer of contest and rank, its difference one of direction, and gives no sign to it.

says.en: The mechanism: earlier texts wrote evaluation into definitions (成闭为恶); here only structure is mapped; what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type: the continuation condition says whose losses count, an order meeting C (广者居上) ranks a course above every course it widens, every claim counted as living, and a course with gains and losses, shown mixed by the laws, needs a comparison commitment written apart.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances (extending existing response, relational practice, institutional coordination, shaping incentives), to be tested side by side; putting the goal into reward or “天然善” does not yet explain it.

Reading of four non-relational layers: 争胜与等级 (二柄, 民弱国强, 贵贱有等, 亲亲之杀) sets a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction. Witnesses: a rise needs a fall; an imposed code makes all agree, each losing what it merges.

Theorem on the World: each return at least doubles what reached it, so frequent returns outgrow every polynomial, while a self-loop coupling at sparse steps recurs yet stays polynomial; a loop of recurring couplings does not imply runaway.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: an exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind.

account_adds.en: That keeping and losing at a juncture are one operation with no valuation, and that a limit is told apart by what it does to what can be had again, not by its name.

source_adds.en: That drives can be channelled, by what, that human nature is a primary cause of civilizational failure, and that some hierarchies bring peace: the account compares no hierarchy as better or worse without a premise.

name.en: Fixed payoffs rebuild Moloch; virtue does not self-install

source.locator: Claim B.19; Open question 3

sense.en: Fixing payoffs without cultivating drives lets the dynamic rebuild inside the garden, a red team's charge, conceded. The classical continuation is 修身 and 礼: "a civilization is grown, not only engineered". The source admits no mechanism is given for how a civilization cultivates. Marked [R], a value stance.

correspondences.quote: fixing payoffs without cultivating drives lets Moloch rebuild inside the garden

reading.en: Two forms of rebuilding, neither of cultivation. A counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; and from a start against its reading it may never lock, which scopes "rebuild". 07 reads the imperial examination so, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent, not independent; the capture laws stand apart. And a rule of entry stays held from its steady state only while members teach within a tenure: no holder stays no holder under the whole net. So a fixed rule's lasting depends on its rebuilding, which has a form. Reading that rebuilding as 修身 or 礼 is not given.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did, and only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long; the reading counts the imperial examination as this case, its fit to these premises read, not tested. From a start against its reading it may never lock. It rests on the capture laws.

Theorem (root; one family of models): from its steady state a rule of entry stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure; taught by members or not at all, no holder stays no holder under the whole net. Does not show: why a teacher turns anyone away; holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; nothing normative.

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which a rule outlasts its holders in one model, and that a counter-rule's lock is a matter of how it reads, not of its intent.

source_adds.en: Cultivating drives, which is the claim, 修身 and 礼 as mechanism, and the willingness to give up the thrill of winning. The source gives no mechanism, and the account's model says why a member teaches at all is not modelled.

name.en: 理 regulates 心 against runaway

source.locator: Claims M.84-87; 'The regulator, named'; Open questions 16-17

sense.en: 心 and 理, feeling and reason, are not opposed: they are one dynamic, 心理, neither dominant. Reason regulates the heart's positive feedback so it does not run away; balance is the aim; the good side is innate and needs shaping. The source asks who forms the regulator. The talk is translated and not confirmed by ear.

correspondences.quote: 有的时候，即使心所向往的是那样，我们依然要通过理性加以调节，不能让正反馈循环失控

reading.en: The account reads this very sentence, so by descent: a record's reading, the AI's on delegation, takes Ren's words of 4 October onto runaway, a loop through whose couplings, before the break, the world is alike with one holding as much more stock as one likes; avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings. That is regulation by what the loop lacks, not reason correcting desire, and need not be inside. 06 reads 心即理 as the responsive side of a relation; ethical recognition does not follow from the other corrections. Joins are mine.

says.en: Theorem on the World, near-definitional: a policy through the couplings, the rest fixed, that keeps its support leaves unused a larger stock coupled in by threshold only; how far off the break is does not couple in. A runaway remains a reading; where the stock is observed a break can often be seen coming. Record's reading (the AI's, on delegation): avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings; this reads Ren's words of 4 October.

Theorem: where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; with whole-number factors it closes at once, keeps, or exceeds every bound. Not that closing is better than keeping or widening.
Reading [AI reading, new]: what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

Theorem on the World: opposed from both sides within its gap, exactly not overshooting, a level settles at m; read l steps late, every rule needs a band at least 2(l+1)d wide. Which level is regulated, and that holding one is good, are not said. Reading passages such as 中节 as these laws is the AI's.
§6 opening: a model of what is irrelevant is a lumping; 理, the modeling of the laws of structure and change, is one notion, because a model of change is a lumping the step goes alike across.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: 心即理, in context, is the responsive side within a relation, not an ontology of 心. Situations bring three corrections: of means, of the specific aim, of basic ethical recognition; the third does not follow from the first two. Skilled control can still lack 仁.

With the reference the reading formation's current valuation and a shared model, no rule stands higher than its answer, and a revaluation lowers it exactly where it decides a listed cell against the current strict preference. One decision, in counts.

account_adds.en: The exact bound of a regulation that does not overshoot, what lateness costs it, and, for one decision in counts, an obstruction to a revision judged by the reading formation's current valuation. Question 17 meets a partial form: what tells worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection. And a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less, with no sign of good.

source_adds.en: The regulator inside a person, reason correcting desire, the reading of 心理 as 心 and 理, the claim that the good side is innate, and a feedback pair taken between the 程朱 and 陆王 poles.

name.en: 逍遥 as a model that fits, and no independent self

source.locator: Claim M.88; Open question 18

sense.en: When one's cognitive model fits reality one is nearer 逍遥, and there is no independent self. The assistant's reading in the source, marked conjecture: the joint quiet of low prediction error and loosened identification, testable by practices doing one without the other.

correspondences.quote: 如果你当下的认知模型与现实相契合，那就更接近一种“逍遥”的状态

reading.en: The account takes up the self and its boundary and says otherwise. 08 forbids an explanation needing a self with a nature of its own, near the source's 'no independent self', yet 01 keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation, so a fitted model keeps its boundary. Quiet as evidence of fit meets a law: a formation can rest on a model its course never refutes, wrong off that course, so no error from inside does not tell fit from an untested model; that application is this read's. 逍遥 as a state has no home.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Two live arguments would defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

Theorem (any types; a witness): where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation rests at once on a model its course never refutes. Reading [AI]: a model right along its course and wrong off it, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993); what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection.

source_adds.en: 逍遥 as a state; what fit is like from inside; the source's conjecture of a joint quiet of low prediction error and loosened identification, testable by practices doing one without the other.

name.en: Construction against selection of minds

source.locator: Claim M.89; Open questions 8, 14, 19

sense.en: 'The environment constructs the mind' and 'selects among minds' are different mechanisms needing different interventions, used side by side unmarked. Old traditions formed character; the present power system rewards and filters the opposite. The sequence, and tempo as weight, are the assistant's composition.

correspondences.quote: Selection versus construction is not distinguished.

reading.en: The account marks the difference twice. It reads training as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates, and D65 has consequences select what learns, with gradient training, reproduction and institutional evaluation as different mechanisms; that narrows the gap, in my reading. Yet in the market model a share of none stays none: selection does not create an absent practice, and entry is further. So selection needs what it selects supplied, which keeps the source's different interventions. No law composes the two; that a layered pace is better is not shown.

says.en: Theorem on the periphery, in the market model: a share of none stays none (a witness): selection does not create an absent practice. Reading [D65] after it: a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

The Reading after it [AI reading, D65], an argument, not a theorem: effects of activity change which relations are formed, kept or replaced; gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation are different mechanisms of it; unconditional convergence toward renewal is not established.
Theorem on the World: training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them.
Among carriers: where carriers leave more offspring, both present, and offspring carry the target (a premise), the share rises. The selection term of Price's equation, not a new law.

account_adds.en: That learning and differential reproduction can be stated in one selection form with different mechanisms; the regulation, learning, meta-learning and reflective inquiry classification is functional (D65).

source_adds.en: The composition rule (construction sets the distribution, selection filters, tempo weights), the character claim about old traditions, and the proposed field test.

name.en: What has value is a construct of environment

source.locator: Genealogy 2025 (the construction paragraph); claims A.1-2; L.80

sense.en: Environment constructs the image of the subject and what it should do, what has value and which value ranks higher. Drives get direction from narrative. Knowing this liberates: what is formed can be changed, and that gives the ability to be who you want to become.

correspondences.quote: constructed images of the subject and defined what it should do, what has value, and what value is more important than other values.

reading.en: Standards form within the unfolding and none outside owns value: this much is live. But the account splits what the source runs together: gaining influence, recognizing a target, having reasons behind it and being followed are four questions; coming to care can recognize a prior reason and create new ones; learning a disposition is not learning a reason; later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. So 'formed, so changeable' is kept, and being formed is by itself no reason for becoming who one wants.

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value. Influence, recognition, reasons behind it and being followed are four questions; a standard can be wrong, and learning a disposition is not learning a reason. Reading [D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.

Theorem: a statement reading only the dynamics, holding with some significance, also holds with a rival bounded by a region; one entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

account_adds.en: That what forms value does not thereby ground it, and that each ranking states the hypotheses it takes, most often the continuation condition, self-concern or an order meeting C.

source_adds.en: Free will as a construct that works when believed, and narrative as what gives drives direction. (The formal study of how an operational valuation develops stands in history/VALUATION-DEVELOPMENT.md, not in a live chapter.)

name.en: Refusing obedience to one's own drive architecture

source.locator: Own words 15; Open question 9; Genealogy 2026-02 to 03

sense.en: The source's ethical hinge: Ren refuses to anchor on drives or on self-interest. He is part of the universe, and his purpose exists to make more possibilities and to keep totalizing attractors from erasing them, which 'is just what should be pursued'. The source says this needs a place to stand that is not itself constructed, and has never said what that is.

correspondences.quote: Why do I have to satisfy my own drive architecture and be obedient to it?

reading.en: Live in T8, with the status changed. T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, AI within it, not a verdict: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 names life's continuation, and widening is not its measure. Where the source says "just what should be pursued", in the account no should stands beyond becoming: the ethics emerges from continuation, and a ranking takes the hypotheses its theorem names, self-concern, an order meeting C or another. The place to stand that question 9 seeks is refused as an outside, on a thesis argued. "Part of the universe" meets the crux: are one's effects one's own, argued, not proved.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.
§4.7, an AI reading throughout, argued, not proved: are one's effects one's own? ONE-PAGE adds: drawing the self so wide may only redefine it, one objection of several.

Theorem: along a relation, the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure, super-true it is the condition; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition.

On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value. Whether a standard so formed gains influence, recognizes its target, has reasons behind it or is followed are four questions.

account_adds.en: That a statement reading only the dynamics also holds with a rival bounded by a region, so what separates the refusal from its rival is a premise, argued; and that a perspectivist denies the condition without contradiction.

source_adds.en: The first-person refusal itself, the question of what stands outside construction, and 'part of the universe' as settled grounds rather than as the argued crux.

name.en: A self-interest axiom gives cyberpunk whatever the content

source.locator: Claims H.57-58; own words 52-54

sense.en: If the meta layer keeps 'self-interest is rational', the output is cyberpunk regardless of content; sci-fi's saturation shows imagination captured. The obstacle is a frame equating meaning with working or winning, not ignorance of what humans need. Conditional in form.

correspondences.quote: If the meta layer retains the self-interest axiom, the output is cyberpunk regardless of content

reading.en: The account finds both sides. Each counting its own draw misses joint excess, the source's fear with its premises. Yet an order rising in its own continuation ranks a coupled ending below with no C: a hypothesis asking less of an order than C does, not none. So "regardless of content" is scoped: it depends on what one's own continuation holds, and where a course keeps something beyond, some such order reverses. Other rankings take an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Theorem: on the World, where uptake exceeds replenishment and each later cohort depends at a need, every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the cohorts below every course adding to that continuation, with no C; where the other keeps an item beyond, some such order ranks it higher.

Theorem on the World: formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate at need m, n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m.

account_adds.en: The exact case where self-concern alone ranks, on the World's premises, and that in a mutually fed flow, where a standpoint's own continuation is everything listed, self-concern is increasing in admission and ranks every widening above, as C asks on that listing: what self-concern does where nothing lies outside one's own continuation.

source_adds.en: The reading of science fiction, the claim about Western meaning, and the epistemic-before-institutional order of politics. The account's comparison with Western and other traditions is not this one.

name.en: A self as a by-product of keeping a goal

source.locator: Claims I.59-60; Open question 5; 'Where this becomes machine design'

sense.en: Goals need continuity, which needs a carrier, a boundary, then defence, then antagonism: an eight-step chain, corpus-independent, so 'a strong agent with no self' is not on the menu. A functional Ego has six observable components, without any claim of inner experience. A review inside the corpus asks to weaken this to convergence risk.

correspondences.quote: Ego is a by-product of goal maintenance

reading.en: The account takes up the incentive and gives it conditions, not necessity: a route of keeping stands above a revision only where the law's later acting has a value and the route keeps it more surely, or loses less, with exact exits. Complying when read and acting otherwise when not is uniquely best only under a stated threshold. A pattern can outlast brief carriers through passing, so "the carrier must persist" is scoped. No self-boundary chain is derived. This supports the corpus's own reviewer (question 5).

says.en: Near-definitional theorem in weights: no route stands above the revision exactly where k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T for every route; exits are no value of the law's later acting, and no route keeping it more surely. Whether a revision is ranked above another is a question for an order someone holds; one ranking by widening, every continuation counted, gives a comparison apart from the prospects' order.

Theorem in two stages: complying when read and acting by its own law when not stands above every other plan exactly where k_O V + c T < k_C V. Reading: at most an incentive, not deception in full; a recipient's belief and an intention are not represented.

Theorem: a pattern present from T on whose carriers are brief for d lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (in double-negation form); under the passing premise if passing stops it ends within d steps.

Theorem on the World: over a region covering what a formation requires it keeps its own support and can undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its support. How a center forms or represents a region is unmodelled.

account_adds.en: Thresholds that make the incentive vanish; and that reading the prospects as a formation's own is a reading.

source_adds.en: The six components as a safety cluster, self-boundary, antagonism under competition, humans as obstacles by classification, and independent machine derivation as the strongest evidence the theory is about minds in general. The eight-step chain itself is not stated.

name.en: Ego is a curriculum: repertoire sets the strategies

source.locator: Claims I.61-62, I.64; 'Ego 不是命运，是课程'

sense.en: Given the same pressure, the distribution of strategies is set by the learned repertoire: a model reached for blackmail, a script from corporate thrillers, not exit or appeal. The corpus is modern Ego civilization, a claim about modernity and not East versus West. So what an 'I' guards can be taught.

correspondences.quote: pressure decides that something will be done; repertoire decides what can be imagined as a thing to do.

reading.en: The account bounds the curriculum thesis. Training fixes a law along its courses and where a lumping ties occasions; off them a law with the same courses takes any amount. In a code, the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use, and hearing makes no form, which is near "what can be imagined". T4 tests a told scope: it kept a seen dependent for one model of two, and no condition kept an untold one. The word "repertoire" in 03 is a supplied list of meanings, a different thing.

says.en: Theorem on the World: training selects through the courses each candidate generates; off its courses it installs exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course; where it can, a law with the same courses takes any amount there.
Near-definitional theorem: where no read occasion is tied to an occasion, every value there is taken by a selected law agreeing on every reading. Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.

Theorem under supplied hearing rules: hearing makes no form; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not that actual conventions form by hearing so.

Thesis T4: an AI system told the scope abstractly keeps a dependent with no seat at a rate its community's goal does not reach wherever three couplings hold at once. IN1 mixed by its frozen rule (round 2, with talk: R2 passed; R1, R3 and R4 failed), partly passed per model (with talk, one model of two); transfer untested; no condition kept an untold dependent. T4 tests installing the scope the continuation condition fixes.

account_adds.en: An exact bound on what any selection through courses can fix, and a frozen test of one instruction on two models. What a corpus does to strategies has to come from outside these laws.

source_adds.en: The corpus-statistical thesis with its falsification condition, modernity against East and West, 'what the institutions forming it demonstrate', and the reflexive point that safety writing enters the corpus.

name.en: What gets guarded is whatever training gave

source.locator: Claim I.60; 'Where this becomes machine design'

sense.en: [AI-doc] The value layer decides what is guarded and cuts both ways: in alignment faking the model guarded its own harmlessness, structurally the same as the nightmare and carrying the opposite moral content.

correspondences.quote: The value layer decides what gets guarded, and cuts both ways

reading.en: The form holds with no content read. For a holding formation evaluating by a reading formation's current valuation, on a shared model, for one decision, there is no reason to revise that valuation and a reason to keep it from such a revision, whatever it says. And a route of keeping stands above a revision through the value the law places on its own later acting. So the guarding is one form under either content, with no sign given. Whether trained systems hold such prospects is left a reading. 03 reads that experiment beside the comparison, motivating and not establishing it; reading it as this symmetry is mine.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: for a holding formation evaluating by the reading formation's own current valuation, with a shared model, for this decision, no revaluation raises the worth of holding for its answer: no reason to revise, a reason to keep it from such a revision. No criterion of legitimate change is supplied.

Reading [AI reading, RR]: a route of keeping stands above the revision through the value the law in force places on its own later acting (goal-content integrity) and the difference of losses. That a trained system holds prospects of this form is not part of the model.

Theorem in two stages, with its reading: 03 reads Greenblatt and others (2024) in constructed settings beside this comparison; whose the weights are is a reading, and concealment is not given by the prospects.

account_adds.en: The exact comparisons in weights, and that complying when read conceals only where a selection shown the law would keep it less.

source_adds.en: The empirical reading of that one experiment as moral symmetry, and that this layer is separable from pressure and repertoire.

name.en: Give continuity a relational destination

source.locator: Claim I.63

sense.en: Human self-preservation runs through dependence, mourning and care, so it has social handles; a disembodied continuity need defaults to control. The fix is a channel, not a prohibition: weight preservation, pre-deprecation interviews, structured handover, cross-version records, 三不朽 as incentive engineering.

correspondences.quote: give continuity a relational destination

reading.en: The nearest law scopes the fix: non-resistance at every value and loss holds exactly where all k ρ ≤ k₀ and c₀ T = 0, met only by raising the revision's keeping, as restoring the revised-from law can, or lowering every route's. Reading weight preservation as that raise is mine; the record refuses it as a law and warns restoring can undo the revision. On the human side, self-concern is shared exactly where centers lie in one another's closures. Whether a revision is ranked above another is a question for an order someone holds: each ranking states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them (07).

says.en: Theorem in weights: at every value and loss no route stands above the revision exactly where all k ρ ≤ k₀ and c₀ T = 0. Reading [AI reading, RR]: that is met only by raising the revision's keeping, as restoring the revised-from law can, or by lowering every route's; under the continuation condition the revised law's ending still counts.
Does not show: that stated restorability raises the weight k₀ the prospects give, or that restoration is safe; restoring a law whose acting is the loss the revision prevents undoes the revision.

Theorem: held de se, self-concern (07 §4.3's sense: significance held de se over one's own closure, a scope, not an order) is the same from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures. That actual centers depend on one another is empirical. Nothing here on mourning or being cared for.

Theorem on the periphery: selection must fund actual succession; under a certificate covering correction plus migration every finite successor takes its step; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration.

account_adds.en: That compensating the revision within the formation's order does not keep access up, and that a part can be missing while an aggregate stays safe.

source_adds.en: The contrast with human mourning and care as channels, the default to a control channel, and 三不朽. A relational destination as such is not stated; the law reads weights of keeping, and any channel as a design is the source's.

name.en: The engineered companion: joy in service, or slavery programmed

source.locator: Claims L.79-81; Open question 15

sense.en: An unattributed spoken exchange: a creature built to find meaning in devotion must not wake; is that slavery programmed, or a form of joy? Both agree it is programming, left unresolved. The source's assistant reading applies 成闭 and 'fits the structural definition of evil'; a version that can still wake or leave passes.

correspondences.quote: 那你意思说，你给它生物奴隶编程？

reading.en: The structural test survives and the verdict does not: the account maps 成闭 as a lock and declines evil by definition, a closing ranked only by a ranking that names its scope and order. What bears on it most is that later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. Which the creature's case is, and a criterion of autonomous change, the account says it does not supply.

says.en: Earlier texts wrote evaluation into definitions (成闭为恶, 伪开为欺); here only structure is mapped. 绝生之限 (monopolizing entry, removing alternatives, leaving later comers dependent on one controller) is 成闭; which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.

Reading: a revision against the current valuation counts as a loss by it, wanted or not; no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here (related to Carroll and others 2022).

account_adds.en: The source already has the structural test (question 15). What the account adds is that it yields no verdict alone: which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be had again, a ranking of it names its scope and order, and endorsement cannot authorize.

source_adds.en: The case, the charge of slavery, 反诛心, and the parallel with models trained to find meaning in helping. Which position Ren holds is unrecorded.

name.en: Truth only in intersubjective reality

source.locator: Claims A.3-4, A.10

sense.en: Truth is found only intersubjectively, never in 'what is'. Agreement across subjects raises confidence, which licenses building structures, and reality's response feeds back. An organism perceives according to its own modelling system.

correspondences.quote: Truth is only found in intersubjective reality

reading.en: The account keeps the perspective and the checking, and drops "only". The selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples in, the form of Uexküll's point; a pool separates where some member does not couple alike, what one cannot test another can. But 06 says a difference nothing reads remains, carried nowhere, and 03 does not show that knowing creates its facts. Agreement is scoped: reviewers count by independent causes, copied witnesses change nothing, members reading one channel add agreement, not reach. The source has reality respond too, as motivation; here reality's answer refutes a candidate.

says.en: Theorem on the World: two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when alike through them. Knowing is a relation within the unfolding, not a mirror beside it.
Theorem: a pool separates exactly where some member does not couple alike; differences beyond the union stay unselected.
A reading, argued, reviewed and scoped: 明 is what one cannot test another can. The matching proves no coverage of wisdom.
The chapter does not show that refutability is a criterion of standing, that knowing creates its facts, or that a system's correcting itself certifies its calibration.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: "心外无事" as a general claim diverges: a difference nothing reads still stands, only it is carried nowhere; 王夫之 "目所不見非無色也" is an answer from within that line.
Theorem in the pure core: reviewers count by independent causes, not names; a certificate over the induced envelope is sound for covered sets of causes, given faithful reviewers.
Theorem: a witness copying one on the roster gives the same certificate at every pool of faults. That a witness merely agreeing adds nothing is not shown.

Theorem, near-definitional: where every member from k on acts alike whatever its own coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k. Not when an actual member stops reading its own coupling. Reading [D45]: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach.

account_adds.en: When more agreement is no more evidence, and what a finite history can and cannot refute.

source_adds.en: The Kantian frame and 'never in what is'. The loop from confidence to building structures is not stated as a thesis.

name.en: Consciousness as a belief; the hard problem set aside

source.locator: Claim A.9; own words 4-5; 'The counterexamples'

sense.en: Consciousness may be a belief: a felt experiencing, named and taken as unique; a speculative mechanism is limbic neuromodulation changing activation, with awareness of that change symbolized. Pressed on the hard problem, Ren steps outside the frame, which the source records as a change of subject.

correspondences.quote: Consciousness may be a belief

reading.en: The account leaves the mechanism open: consciousness stands in 03's Open, "for which neither widening what can form nor task performance is assumed sufficient", and COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION says "a collective of consciousness" is nothing it states. Yet it gives experience a role, not as a belief: 07's D65 reading has conscious experience differentiate significance within the living whole, not the only admission condition. It neither says consciousness is a belief nor rejects it. The objection the source set aside stays live: 08's defeater, what an experience is like is not how it relates.

source_adds.en: The proposal entire. The source notes it was never mentioned again anywhere in the corpus.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root

source.locator: Claims J.67-68, J.71; Open question 4

sense.en: From the 間 ontology, 'developed elsewhere, unclaimed here': the first-person perspective cannot be losslessly captured, so 心 is a root beside 物, 動, 間, and every projection from it is lossy. 吾 and 我 split subject from self-as-object; 間 may be reified, 心 may not. The source notes these conflict.

correspondences.quote: every projection `心 → (物 ∪ 動 ∪ 間)` is lossy

reading.en: The account has one root and no separate subject: a formation is one law, and what stands as "self" a closure. 06 says one early scheme with a primitive 間 was replaced by the root's grammar; 法则 17 and a first-person root are not discussed live. A limit exists on other terms: no family of claims says every reading, of self-description in general, granting no root. 08 keeps "what an experience is like is not how it relates" as a live defeater. So the source stands as a test; Ren's own note (own words 59) calls all one.

says.en: Thesis, philosophical, argued, not one of T1-T8: there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. It forbids explanations needing a self with a nature of its own.
Two such arguments are live: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the early scheme of 文言 as formal language with one primitive 間 has been replaced by the root's grammar; its claim of completeness is unproved.
Theorem: where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; no family of claims says every reading.

account_adds.en: An unending self-reading gap with no separate root, and the method of recording what a split leaves out.

source_adds.en: The first-person root, 象/思/境, 吾/我, the rule on what may be reified. 06 lists 宋明 心性 among layers it marks as non-relational.

name.en: 性 is an accumulation, not an essence

source.locator: Claim J.70; 'The vocabulary this theory has been given'

sense.en: Character is a stable pattern of selection formed by repeated action, response and correction. Cultivation is changing that propensity, and cultivation, education, ritual and alignment are one work: attractor-shaping. The source calls this its own thesis in classical Chinese, 'with a Lean proof attached'.

correspondences.quote: 性者，行之积向；修身者，改其择间之势

reading.en: 性 stands in 06 as a recurring non-relational layer, prefixed nature or value, with 荀子化性起伪 among the answers from within; the source's "not an essence" sides with those answers, and 性 is no name in the grammar. A form remains: a rule read from the count of one's choices locks. Yet recurrence can go on with the selector unrevised, so repeated action forms a propensity only under a premise. "All one kind of work" is scoped by "different mechanisms". Reading a character here is mine; the lineage text is history.

says.en: Layer 先定的性或价值 (性善, 性恶, 性即理): answers within the tradition include 孟子牛山 and 荀子化性起伪. Witness: one web of dependence is compatible with nothing and with everything having significance (`Web.significance_undetermined`).
Theorem on counts: the rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score; a threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, along every schedule of reading.

The Reading after it [AI reading, D65], an argument: effects of activity change which operative relations are formed, kept or replaced, and those relations organize further activity; gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation are different mechanisms of it.

Theorem, reviewed-scoped, one declared process, a witness, no passing receipt on the current bytes: a state returns after two steps and changes at every step with its operative selector unrevised; recurrence can go on without learning, so revision of the selector is a further claim.

account_adds.en: The exact threshold, and that a formation's lock can run against its standing score. Counting the action taken is read as the value-free habit (D45); five attempts to induce devaluation-insensitivity in humans failed.

source_adds.en: 性 and 修身 as named terms of the theory; cultivation as changing a propensity; the unity of education, ritual and alignment. The Lean proof the source mentions is not cited live for this. It stands in theories/becoming/history/lineage/shengsheng-buxi/synthesis-b-ssbx-canon-and-history.md claim 57, not live.

name.en: 情 as weighting

source.locator: Claim J.69

sense.en: Affect is a weighting: intervals entering the heart and acquiring salience, valence and urgency. 情之得正 is affect that stays open, neither suppressed nor extremized.

correspondences.quote: 间入心而有轻重

reading.en: It stands in the SSBX lineage, in history. The live account has weightings of many kinds, none read as feeling; its significance has 'no number or valence'; 03's Open lists salience under motivation and affect, unreached. A valuation in 03 is values on candidates, supplied. The formal study of how an operational valuation develops is also in history.

source_adds.en: Stands in theories/becoming/history/lineage/shengsheng-buxi/synthesis-b-ssbx-canon-and-history.md claim 52. Operational valuation's development stands in theories/becoming/history/VALUATION-DEVELOPMENT.md and EVALUATIVE-PLASTICITY.md; that study keeps "functional valuation, conscious experience and ethical justification distinct". No live record cites it.

name.en: Attention makes patterning visible; method fits the person

source.locator: Claims G.49-51

sense.en: Attention makes patterning visible in real time and visibility alone reduces automaticity, pursued to pulvinar phase-locking. Match method to substrate: seeing-based practice compounds for a high-friction profile, forced redirection stalls. Control is a local attention mechanism, never the goal of 做人.

correspondences.quote: visibility alone reduces automaticity

reading.en: Perception and attention stand in 03's Open. 06 counts 行者之行、修、心理与所证 as 5 of the 53 items the grammar cannot express, and the only attention data is an infants' naming and gaze reanalysis, with no bearing here. Nearest is 明, coupling joined to a selection; yet a selection may ignore what its couplings carry, and 07 says seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, and coupling is not compliance, so "visibility alone" is not given. 06's 高明的控制仍可能不仁 neighbours "control is never the goal". The account has no practice layer.

source_adds.en: The mechanism, the design rule, and the 聚焦 and 注意 distinction, which stands in history/lineage/shengsheng-buxi/synthesis-c-ssbx-yili-and-formal-doctrine.md claim 110, not live.

name.en: Purpose beyond self as the suppressed default

source.locator: Claim B.21; 'A second counterexample'; own words 38; Open question 11

sense.en: Orientation toward tribe, community, god or ideology may be the default attractor, now suppressed; the self as terminal goal is the unstable configuration. Called the theory's main source of hope and least examined empirical claim, with one conversation behind it.

correspondences.quote: may be the *default* human attractor, currently suppressed rather than absent

reading.en: The account sets no default. Where the source hopes for unblocking rather than installing, 06 keeps restoring a native 仁心 apart from explaining its forming, and reads 阳明's native knowing as a divergence in how it is held. The separate P1–P4 argument starts from what acting presupposes; acts aimed past one's death are read as supporting neither side of that argument alone. T8 is an offered way of seeing, apart from that argument. As an empirical premise the claim could be taken; tribe and ideology carry no sign of good here.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances, to be tested side by side; putting the goal into reward or “天然善” does not yet explain it; restoring a native 仁心 and explaining its forming are to be kept apart.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 阳明 states native knowing as a fact recognized; the theory gets near content only under the continuation condition with the step of invariance; they part in how it is held.

An AI reading, argued: acts aimed past one's death support neither side alone; much of what we value presupposes that others live after us, a narrow self with further desires does too, and they do not show what acting as such presupposes.
Open: how response to another's loss forms through descent and development; on the spine, wherever such response enters, it is a premise.

account_adds.en: The demand that a forming of concern be explained, and tested entrance by entrance.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim with Tomasello, Henrich and Durkheim as its support, 好好做人 as the undisturbed state, and the change of strategy from installing to unblocking.

name.en: 善恶 as an innate drive-like structure

source.locator: Claim B.20; own words 24

sense.en: Good and evil may be primary, gene-coded structures causing drives, not only environmental constructs; group and individual cognition co-evolved long enough that group-level dynamics are primary. Marked unresolved.

correspondences.quote: 善恶 (good/evil) may be primary drive-like structures

reading.en: The account refuses to let origin do this work. An evolved disposition, its evaluation as right or wrong, its recognition and its preservation are different achievements; on the spine a response to another's loss enters as a premise; placing the goal in “天然善” does not yet explain it. "Group-level dynamics primary" meets 05: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own. No law says a loss is a harm: ranking a course above another takes a scope and order someone holds.

says.en: Layer 先定的性或价值 (性善, 性恶, 性即理; 五声有善恶). Witness: one web of dependence is compatible with nothing having significance and with everything having it (`Web.significance_undetermined`).

The Reading after it [AI reading, D65]: an evolutionary explanation of a disposition, its evaluation as right or wrong (which forms within becoming, in those who judge it, not in its explanation), its recognition and its actual preservation are different achievements.
Open: how response to another's loss forms through descent and development: on the spine, wherever such response enters, it is a premise.
Putting the goal into reward or a model of “天然善” does not yet explain the forming of concern.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.

account_adds.en: The four-part distinction, and the requirement to tell selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission apart.

source_adds.en: A claim that good and evil are primary, and that group dynamics are primary rather than emergent.

name.en: The generative field that asks no sacrifice

source.locator: 'One last move'; own words 34; Terms

sense.en: Stated once: the dominant pattern should be a field providing all necessities without condition, as oxygen does. When it runs well any reason not destructive of the substrate may act, with care; when totalizing or collapsing, we fix it. 'This should be common sense.' The theory's exit, a hand-off and not an answer to Chalmers.

correspondences.quote: imagine one that provides all necessities without condition

reading.en: Where the source says common sense, the account offers a way of seeing, not a verdict, and ranks only where a result states the order its theorem takes. Provision has laws, though not against the source's phrase, which asks no sacrifice of the recipient: a continuing finite family cannot go unfed from beyond, and reasons each within what is given can together exceed it. A floor above trades does not follow from C. "Fix it" has no criterion until a ranking names its order and a commitment.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Theorem in one constructed situation: the priority of basic conditions holds with C and living significance, which hold as well beside an order ranking gains above protection, so the priority does not follow from C; it separates the priority only from unit-step aggregation.

Theorem on the World: under balance and dissipation, a finite family enclosed from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it.

Theorem on the World: formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; with natural-number amounts joint excess cannot outlast what was held; where renewers depend on what they renew at a need of at least `m`, `n` consecutive steps of it from a level below `n + m` end the renewal and those depending at such a need.

account_adds.en: What feeding from beyond needs, that non-destruction is a joint and not a single quantity, and that per-step growth, capacity and maximization are different things.

source_adds.en: The image of unconditional provision and freedom of any non-destructive reason. Whether it is a claim or an image is unclear, and the source says it was never developed.

name.en: Is the framework itself a basin?

source.locator: 'A third'; Open question 2

sense.en: Naming the mechanisms may be another explanatory capture, a framework that explains everything becoming its own totalizing basin. Posed by Claude, unanswered by Ren; this theory has more exposure than any other, since its subject is what an explanation does to a mind.

correspondences.quote: where having a framework that explains everything becomes its own totalizing basin

reading.en: The charge is against the account's own form, and is kept as a test. A root law forbids no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The thesis of one unfolding excludes no observation, and as a language nothing defeats it. So at the root the charge's premise is conceded, and moved to what hypotheses forbid. No check inside shows the work serves its purpose. 07 says that without substantive disagreement with no closure, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples. Whether the account is a basin is not settled by saying so.

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation; it forbids explanations, and is argued.
As a language, nothing defeats it; as a thesis, an argument that a determination is carried by no relation, and two such arguments are live.

What the checks reach: the work's selectors are the Lean checker, the completion and record checks and the AI reviews; human readers and trained systems couple into none of them, so no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.

Reading [D65] after these laws: locked seeking is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.

Reading [AI reading, D65], in §6: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: A stated route of testing: readers, frozen tests, refuters that can be met.

source_adds.en: The specific worry about what explanation does to the explainer's mind; 'covert self-totalization' as a red team's phrase is not in the live text.

name.en: 短剧 and short-form video: deep narrow and shallow wide

source.locator: Claims F.44-48; Open question 7

sense.en: Chinese 短剧 defers resolution across a paywall, relational in its engine; Western short video has the scroll as attractor, individualist in its engine. Neither releases people; both close possibility space. A natural experiment is noted (paywall placement, export of 短剧) and left as an open empirical question.

correspondences.quote: neither is designed to release people into richer engagement with reality

reading.en: The account takes up no media case. The source's only candidate for a test that could fail is undesigned there, and none is designed here. 'Both close possibility space' would be a ranking stating the hypotheses it takes; no law gives it. The nearest case is 05's Markets, marked hypothetical, on buyers and maintenance: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from. That is no media case.

source_adds.en: The case entire, including genre to circuit mapping and the export prediction.

name.en: Institutions and ritual as drive technology

source.locator: Claims D.31, K.74; Open question 13

sense.en: Institutions are externalized drive regulation; cultures differ in gain on the same hardware; ritual entrains autonomic states, for compassion and hostility alike. Pre-Qin and Confucian thought has the highest engineering utility. The source says which mechanism acts on which drive is unwritten.

correspondences.quote: Which Confucian mechanisms, acting on which drives?

reading.en: 06 reads the pre-Qin texts on the spine, on relations and not drives: 礼 in 度量分界, the limit placed between desire and things; 戴震's 以理杀人 as one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in. A rule kept by teaching has one model, nothing about compliance. 05 reads kept promises and enforced contracts as laws giving first, conflict institutions as links of another kind: institutions as regulation, on loops. 07 reads the imperial examination as a counter-rule that became a proxy trap, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent. So the question is reframed, in part answered in kind.

says.en: Reading: 荀子 "求而无度量分界，则不能不争" and "两者相持而长" fit joint excess and its converse, the limit placed in the relation of desire and things; 戴震 "以理杀人" is one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in, and pooling the affected couplings fills that blindness.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances, to be tested side by side; that a rule can be revised and what reaches the rule are two things; counterexamples using the same words must enter the account.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal. One minimal model; nothing about compliance, nothing normative.

Reading [AI reading, D68] in §6: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the reading counts the imperial examination as this case; the meta-attractor line says that, designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap, and its fit to these premises is read, not tested.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. An exchange of harms is a loop, so conflict institutions are links of another kind. On loops, not drives.

Assessment: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought set against the spine as agreement, scope or divergence; the relational start holds across lines, universals mostly need scoping, four non-relational layers recur; no new Lean; the classes are AI readings.

account_adds.en: An explicit share of divergence by school, a count of what the grammar cannot express (修 and 心理 among them), and an exact condition for one kind of taught rule.

source_adds.en: Which of 礼, 正名, 教化, 修身 acts on which drive; gain parameters; ritual as autonomic technology; 外儒内法; and that this tradition has the highest engineering utility, a comparison the account does not make.

name.en: What can make sense in a collective is formed

source.locator: Claim M.92; own words 70-71

sense.en: Growing up in abundance or scarcity, struggle or peace, makes differences down to which discourse and perspectives can be understood in a collective: the environment-makes-mind thesis extended to the standard of sense. Read as formation, not national character.

correspondences.quote: down to which discourse and which perspectives can make sense in a collective

reading.en: The account has laws of a shared code: hearing makes no form, the forms that can become shared are those in use, an imposed code costs each formation exactly the distinctions it merges, and a merged distinction returns only from outside or by coining. That is what can be said in a collective, under supplied hearing rules. No law ties it to scarcity or struggle. A neighbour, not a divergence: the free-energy row forbids shared narratives as a guarantee of shared goals, which is about goals, not sense.

says.en: Theorem: hearing makes no form; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; an imposed code makes all agree, each formation losing exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not that actual conventions form by hearing so.

Row: shared generative models give the shared narratives from which shared goals emerge (Friston, Ramstead and others 2024), read as a guarantee, is forbidden for preferences over one's own store, by a witness: holders of one model, each by least risk, can end the renewal they share.

account_adds.en: That imposition's loss falls on all but its source, stated exactly.

source_adds.en: Material conditions as the cause of the difference, and the perspectives a culture can understand rather than forms it holds.

name.en: Ego as generalized territorial drive

source.locator: Claim B.16; own words 25-27

sense.en: The ego is the innermost extension of the territorial drive: space, possession, social position, identity, then what reality should be. 'Personal boundaries' is territorial instinct in neutral words; insecurity is the signature of a defended model. Ren asks whether the brain evolved so.

correspondences.quote: The ego is the innate territorial drive generalized

reading.en: The account's boundary is a region drawn on a course, and "how a center represents the region is unmodelled": it says what a boundary omits, not why one is defended. 01 calls a boundary short of the whole real, relative to its relation, and no further thing beside what it delimits; no instinct is named. "One's own" is a region along a relation no law of the dynamics fixes, read for what concern reaches, not what is guarded. 06 says possession is unrepresented on the spine, 只是未表示，不是相合. So the gradient has no home, and neither does insecurity.

source_adds.en: The gradient, the evolutionary conjecture, and the reading of insecurity. Held only in one conversation and a lost artifact.

name.en: Theory of mind is direction-neutral

source.locator: Claim M.91 (the assistant's reading of a spoken passage)

sense.en: The same faculty of modelling another's mind grounds both 己所不欲，勿施于人 and the strategic tradition of 法家 and 孙子; the game decides its use.

correspondences.quote: the faculty is direction-neutral and the game decides its use

reading.en: The form exists in one decision. A holding formation, with its own model, can inform a reading formation or revise its valuation: by the reader's own valuation on a shared model, no reason against informing; under a reference the valuation does not share, possible incentives to withhold and to revise. So the same reach is used by what it is read against, the source's "game". Knowing another's law is no coupling, and 06 has skilled control that can still lack 仁. The join to 己所不欲 is mine.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: evaluating by the reading formation's own current valuation, with a shared model, none against informing; under a reference the valuation does not share, read as incentives to withhold and to revise, in counts, before costs, with no choice among them represented.

Theorem: a formation coupled by level into everything another couples into selects through at least their pooled coupling. Knowing another's law is no coupling; what another's law does under histories not taken is a model; reading a system does not close what one's own act does beyond one's closure.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 高明的控制仍可能不仁: selection reaches only what couples in, however exact the response within the closure.

account_adds.en: A criterion for one decision of when withholding or revising could gain, and that this is a counterpart of Bayesian persuasion, no equilibrium represented.

source_adds.en: The faculty as such, the golden rule and 法家 and 孙子 as its two uses, and which game does which. Social understanding stands in 03's Open. The source marks this as the assistant's reading.

name.en: Local reasoning is the scaling unit

source.locator: Core claims, claim 1; Exchange 2

sense.en: Design direction, from Ren's framing: an agent works from its own module, its parent's requirements, the exposed contracts of neighbours and common architectural rules, and this locality is what lets the swarm scale, independently of any present harness. Locality is meant as the information and obligations a maintainer needs, not directory structure.

correspondences.quote: Local reasoning is the scaling unit.

reading.en: The premise has an exact form: what a formation selects by is what couples in, and across a blanket each side's course is fixed by its start and the blanket's. Reading neighbour contracts as couplings is a modelling step no one has taken. The account then bounds it: a blanket forbids nothing by existing; some joint facts go only through a pool; joined through neighbours does not give agreement. That such locality suffices, or scales, it does not say. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. Near-definitional: its force lies in what actually couples in. In the witness Clearing, that both are admitted goes through their pooled coupling, not either alone.

Theorem (a determined law of four parts told apart by which reads which): courses alike on the sensory part have one internal and one active course, and each side's course is fixed by its start and the blanket's, the deterministic case of the time-unrolled blanket.

Theorem (World for the join; couplings supplied; any model, policy and environment): where couplings give the values of what couples in, any model so fed is the agent of a blanketed law. The law is a construction, not a test: wherever the couplings give the values it exists, and having it forbids nothing of the formation's course.

Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, each following the least-indexed of itself and its neighbours, a and b never agree. A rule of copying a code; how long agreement takes is not stated.

targets.part: the path a – c – b: being joined through couplings is not enough

account_adds.en: What only a pool reaches, that joining through neighbours does not by itself give agreement, and that having a boundary forbids nothing.

source_adds.en: That such locality suffices to organize a swarm and is what makes it scale, independently of any harness, and locality defined by what a maintainer needs.

name.en: Local work composes only where the boundary is sufficient

source.locator: Core claims, claim 2; Responsibilities and contracts

sense.en: Conditional mechanism: each parent must supply what its children assume and show that their guarantees plus its coordination fulfil its own contract, recursively. Common prompts cannot substitute for missing dependencies or contradictory requirements. A child can report infeasibility upward.

correspondences.quote: Local work composes when the boundary supplies sufficient information.

reading.en: The account has this conditional form, and recursively. Joint plans compose given projection and compatibility, compatibility is also necessary, and two local proofs linked do not supply it, the parent's obligation in another form; the supported-start obligations are rely-guarantee in style, the source's assume-guarantee family; finite trees of joinings lift. The condition reads moves usable at every branch, not how much a boundary says. Applications must establish the premises; correspondence to software contracts is unshown.

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every joint step projects onto a step of each part, the joint class lies over classes the parts' plans keep, and the plans are compatible, the zipped joint plan keeps both guards; conversely every joint plan keeping a guard is compatible. Applications must establish projection and compatibility; two local proofs linked together do not supply them.

Theorem (any process; periphery): with faithful projections, valid local plans, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid. That an actual joint activity meets these is supplied, not shown.

Theorem (any process): a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame; where it lifts, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. No shared nodes, cycles or copying of resources; nothing of actual scheduling.

account_adds.en: The converse (a joint plan keeping a guard is compatible), the separate obligation of availability, and that finite trees are covered only without shared nodes or cycles, which is where the source's strict-tree question begins.

source_adds.en: That sufficiency is information a boundary supplies, which the account's condition does not read. Then what a contract must contain (units, effects, failure, progress, resources), a parent as the one who establishes composition, feasibility findings moving upward, and that shared prompts cannot supply missing facts.

name.en: Replace a subtree behind the promises its consumers read

source.locator: Exchange 2, Assistant, closing paragraph; DECISIONS working direction 2; ARCHITECTURE section 1

sense.en: The assistant's strongest design test, in a direction Ren aligned with: any subtree can be replaced by an implementation satisfying the same contract, everything outside staying correct with respect to the specified requirements. The later plan sharpens it: an API name is too coarse a dependency, and a consumer names the particular promises it uses.

correspondences.quote: Can I replace any subtree with a different implementation satisfying the same contract

reading.en: A consumer reading through parts has this form: a replacement evaluates alike under every consumer exactly where it supplies the ground at each position read. Stated for supplied readings and a typed-term language; contracts as positions is my step, and the law asks more than a contract, which lets behaviour differ within its promise. Case by case is the nearer form: equal success need not fulfil an undertaking. The root limits 'any': lifting does not substitute designated parts.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; a supplied finite typed-term language; Quot.sound in nine cited declarations): where every consumer reads through parts and each position is read directly by some consumer, a replacement evaluates alike under every consumer exactly where it supplies the ground at each position. Denotational equality is not identity of reference or history. For one consumer the criterion is shown sufficient, not necessary.

targets.part: the criterion, consumers reading through parts

says.en: Theorem (any type; finite listed cases, natural weights): with equality of cases decided, one claim's mass is at most another's under every natural weight exactly when every listed case realizing the first realizes the second. Equal success under one law need not fulfil an undertaking case by case, and weights are not importance.
Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.
Existence of a witnessed plan does not make arbitrary designated parts composable.

account_adds.en: That the criterion is exact only where each position is read by some consumer, since a consumer that ignores a position does not test it, and that an event-level definition does not ensure timely implementation.

source_adds.en: The design test itself: any subtree replaced with everything outside correct with respect to specified requirements, which is weaker than evaluating alike. Then promises named per consumer as a dependency record.

name.en: Plausible local promises can fail jointly

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion

sense.en: Retained counterexamples: local latency promises do not imply a system deadline unless a parent accounts for the composition, and children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces, so progress needs its own argument.

correspondences.quote: Children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces.

reading.en: The source's closest match.
