Two locally fine plans fail jointly on one shared reserve; reciprocal promises can be empty; preservation does not give availability; a circular dependence can be a wait no one can begin; waiting relations have exact laws. Same mechanism, on stated models, for the deadlock half. The latency half fits only with a deadline read as a stock, my step: each within its own count can jointly exceed.

says.en: Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step (periphery, propext and Quot.sound reported), and serialization without renewal does not repair it.

Theorem (periphery): 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens; a law with no successors keeps every property vacuously; in the exchange witness one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.

targets.part: reciprocal promises can be empty; preservation without availability

says.en: Theorem (any formations, any relation of waiting): with memory, one withholding, where every formation lies within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on; under both laws more waiting gives no more at any step. In a ring of three, with memory all withhold from step 2, and a source giving first brings all to give from step 3. It does not show how waiting forms.

Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic over natural numbers, restating the commons and overshoot; not who ought to take less.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions under which a circular wait starts or never starts, a source giving first as what breaks it, and that serializing does not repair an unrenewed shared reserve.

source_adds.en: Time as such and a deadline allocated through a composition, and the design answer, a parent accounting for the actual composition.

name.en: A dependency left off the diagram is still a dependency

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion; ARCHITECTURE section 1

sense.en: Declared boundaries do not make actual dependence disappear: a shared store reached outside them binds the modules anyway. The later plan adds that runtime mediation constrains observable access but cannot establish a concept was completely specified, and that an observed undeclared dependency becomes a repair obligation.

correspondences.quote: A shared database accessed outside declared boundaries is a dependency even when omitted from the diagram.

reading.en: The account's general reading has this form: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part. Its law separates a represented region from actual dependence: a draw over a region omitting a required condition can lose its own support; that concerns draws on a flow, and a database read consumes nothing, so the match is to omission. Closer: a writer outside the interface leaves the public view identical, and states alike under every old observation are told apart by a new probe.

says.en: Reading [AI, D45, D61]: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part in the unfolding; a formation renewing over a region that omits a condition it requires can lose its own support through its own draw. Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.

targets.part: Reading D45, D61: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. The witnesses are minimal and stipulated; how a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Instance (periphery): finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrite programs keep actual coverage; an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied, not shown.

Theorem (periphery: pre-spine; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe. Which supports will be permitted next is not shown.

account_adds.en: That a sufficient region for oneself still leaves others undermined, and that a record-only acceptance cannot exclude an extra writer.

source_adds.en: Detection and repair of the hidden dependency by traces and consumer declarations, and treating an observed one as an obligation; the account leaves how a center represents its region unmodelled.

name.en: Can a contract summarize enough without becoming the whole program?

source.locator: Questions, 2; Proposed tightening

sense.en: A parent reasons from a child's exposed contract as the summary of its subtree. The folder's assessment names the main gap: finding and keeping compact, sufficient boundaries through unforeseen changes, or complexity just moves into the contracts or a central coordinator. Stated as an open question, not a result.

correspondences.quote: Can contracts carry enough meaning without becoming the whole program?

reading.en: A contract as a reduction has an exact criterion: a law on reduced values carries every step exactly where moves keep merged configurations merged; a summary carries futures exactly where what it merges has the same futures. Witnesses limit it: every local state kept while a relation changes, the sufficient summary omitting others, so wider operations need renewed validation; two trees alike in parent summary differ in what a cut returns. Whether a compact one exists or stays compact is untouched.

says.en: Theorem (any deterministic law; the quantum case a witness): some determined law on the reduced values carries every step exactly where configurations the reduction merges are taken by each move to configurations it merges. In a stated two-qubit fragment a relation can change while every local state stays. No minimal summary is shown; the sufficient summary still omits other relations, so enlarged operation scope requires renewed validation.

Theorem (any process): read through a summary, a law takes from each configuration's summary exactly the words that configuration can take exactly where the configurations the summary merges have the same futures. Only the feasibility of finite words is carried: no endpoint, branch identity, probability or policy.

Theorem (any process): where configurations a description identifies match parts and the leaves are read correctly through it, a finite plan is realized at a description exactly where it is realized at each configuration so described.

Theorem (periphery; two grown eight-member trees, a model, not a measured organism): matched in composition and parent summary (counts of kinds, bonds and used material), they differ in what single-edge cuts return; no function of the parent summary gives both mean returns, and a retaining edge can prevent fragmentation.

account_adds.en: An exact criterion for a sufficient description relative to given moves, plans or readings, and witnesses of what a sufficient one still omits.

source_adds.en: The question that matters to it: growth of the summaries over time, whether complexity moves to a central coordinator, and a mechanism that discovers and revises boundaries under change. None is stated.

name.en: Neighbour-only discovery does not find the globally best

source.locator: Discovery and generation

sense.en: A module requests a capability through its parent and a hierarchical directory routes searches through advertised summaries. Summaries can be stale or incomplete, a semantic match only retrieves a candidate, and compatibility still has to be checked.

correspondences.quote: neighbor-only discovery does not guarantee finding the globally best implementation without broader search

reading.en: A local search rests exactly where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood adds rests: the source's limit, with 'best' read by the reward. That law is of moves climbing a reward; the source's directory routes a query, so the match is to the limit, not the mechanism. Stale and incomplete summaries have closer forms: an accurate report goes stale after a rearrangement, an old view cannot rebuild an updated one unread, an inadequate catalogue leaves ambiguity. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World): a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which a given system has, which is read empirically.

targets.part: among settled laws: a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more

says.en: Periphery (propext, Quot.sound): after a supplied rearrangement an access report accurate when made can be stale and change the next choice; surveying again revises it, keeping the earlier reports. Counterexamples: an inadequate catalogue leaves ambiguity; a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

Theorem (periphery: pre-spine; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading. Obtaining a trustworthy reading atomically is a separate implementation.

account_adds.en: That the added rests of a narrower neighbourhood are a bias of the search, exact relative to a reward, and not a failure of it.

source_adds.en: The discovery design, broader search as the remedy, and the distinction between a retrieval match and checked compatibility, which only the stopping witness touches.

name.en: Unrelated growth has small marginal cost; three kinds of scale are separate

source.locator: Core claims, claim 6; soundness assessment table

sense.en: A prediction to test: interaction cost follows active dependencies and change effort follows affected contracts, not installed apps. No constant-cost guarantee for active workloads or shared invariants. Dormant catalog, concurrent agents and accumulated semantic dependence scale differently, and the third is called the largest unanswered question.

correspondences.quote: Unrelated growth can have a small marginal cost.

reading.en: The account has no law of cost in change effort, attention or computation as a system grows. Its nearest forms are non-interference and reach, not cost: what does not couple in makes no difference to a selection, exchanges with disjoint footprints commute, and around loops of couplings acting at every step the most difference that can arrive grows exponentially. Dormancy there runs down a reserve, another mechanism. The prediction was not run and the account does not test it. Not a defect: an engineering hypothesis.

searched: live account: dormant, latency, throughput, concurren, commut, cost of change, coordination cost, communication cost, overhead, modularity, near-decompos, scalab, scal(es|ing) with, marginal, effort, entrench, lock-in

name.en: Reserved resources and attributed cost keep growth local

source.locator: Common runtime and limits

sense.en: Performance under growth needs active design: lazy activation, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources and cost attributed to module versions; maintenance needs owners, budgets and bounded dependencies. A thousand dormant apps and a thousand active simulations are different workloads.

correspondences.quote: Performance requires lazy activation, cached artifacts, bounded queues, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources, and attribution of cost to module versions.

reading.en: Only the reservation has a form here, nested as the source's tree is: parts' footprints within their whole's and apart keep leaf requests covered by the root's, and the joint draw within capacity; without a division each can stay within its own count and jointly exceed. On a balanced flow, not shown of an actual division; and support by the root's footprint does not give a realization of the plan. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): where takes are what leaves of a realized joint plan draw, footprints within their whole's and apart and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given; with such a division at every step the level never falls below its start. Not shown: that an actual division is so, or that the level rises.

Theorem (any process): where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint. Support by the root's footprint does not give a realization of the plan.

Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic restating the commons and overshoot, not who ought to take less.

account_adds.en: The exact reason a partition protects a shared stock, with the balance premise named.

source_adds.en: That performance under growth needs this active design, and that reservation keeps growth local: not stated. Then lazy activation, queues, subscriptions, attribution of cost and all the performance engineering.

name.en: A fork of an interface must not copy what is shared

source.locator: Three demanding worlds; README Several structures; ARCHITECTURE section 5

sense.en: An assistant proposal: definitions, running instances and authoritative records have different identities. A view can fork while its records stay shared, shared code does not imply shared mutable state, and a forked interface should not multiply entitlements such as achievements or assets.

correspondences.quote: interface forks do not accidentally duplicate shared entitlements

reading.en: The account separates describing alike from copying support: lifted parts are described alike and do not duplicate support, requests within exclusive footprints are free of repetition, a tree of joinings does not show a resource can be copied, and in one protocol duplicate votes fail while a fork keeps its source. Reading entitlements as footprints is my step; none speaks of interfaces, and a shared record that is read is not drawn down. Proposed here.

says.en: Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.

Theorem (any process): where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.

Theorem (any process): where a description lifts a joining, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. No shared nodes or cycles; realizing a tree of joinings does not show that a resource can be copied.
In one declared history: a fork keeps its source as one branch and hands off the other, and a position can be present on both; duplicate votes fail where two votes over fourteen days pass.

account_adds.en: That being read alike and being supported are separate obligations, and a position present on both branches of a fork.

source_adds.en: The design distinction of definition, instance and authoritative state, and shared records beneath alternative views.

name.en: New features create options before obligations

source.locator: Starting position; Exchange 4, the product rule

sense.en: From the AI-drafted statement of the direction agreed in the conversation, a working commitment: growth should add useful possibilities without imposing runtime cost, maintenance burden or design preferences on every member, so a new feature should usually be something members can take up, binding no one else.

correspondences.quote: New features should usually create options before creating obligations for everyone.

reading.en: The collective-direction page calls the form a local test: a part's added options widen the whole exactly within others' margins; past one the comparison is mixed and unordered. It locates the boundary and predicts no behaviour. Obligation has its own home, conditionally: an empty plan set generates no duty. The source states an undertaking; as a ranking it would be its holder's, under a scope and order they name. Draws are not software burden. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region (its options) against the levels without its exchange, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside it, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one; with a need met exactly, any net draw on that condition makes it mixed. Mixed is not ordered.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4 and correspondence E; each a hypothesis; an argument with checked consequences): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, and a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

targets.part: an empty plan set generates no duty

account_adds.en: The exact edge at which an addition stops being a widening of the whole, that no ordering holds past it without a further premise, and when a contribution is indispensable.

source_adds.en: The product default itself, and the claim that software's maintenance burden can in practice be kept off non-users.

name.en: Changes have audiences: personal, group, community

source.locator: Core claims, claim 5; Change and adoption; RESEARCH-AGENDA question 5

sense.en: Value stance and product direction: adoption is scoped. Different views can share authoritative records, without assuming every preference can coexist; a shared commitment requires the relevant community decision; a forked view does not silently change an official outcome.

correspondences.quote: Changes have audiences.

reading.en: Formal shapes match in part: a rule's change located at a gated adoption, with two participants enabling a technical integration while governance revision fails; agreement kept in a group through hearings closed for it; an imposed code costing others its merged distinctions, its source nothing. Views over one record have a local-to-global form: what contexts show glues exactly where they agree where they meet, and some local possibilities are parts of no whole. Views as contexts, records as their overlap, is my step. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (any process): a course that changes a gated quantity passes the gate. In a declared rule protocol only adoption is gated and every change of rule is located at an adoption using a recorded proposal; with two continuing participants a technical integration is enabled while revising the governance fails. Supplied: seed mandate, proposal content, participation, compliance; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.

Theorem (any type; further premises named): a group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it. An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that it merges, the source losing none. Not shown: that actual conventions form this way, or whether a code keeps or closes for 生生, the continuation of life.

targets.part: an imposed code; agreement kept through closed hearings

says.en: Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): what contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet. Some worlds glue nowhere: in Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square the possibilities are local and admit no context-free reading, so they are the parts of no whole. Only possibilities are stated; general sheaf theory is not.

account_adds.en: That a rule's change has an exact location in a history, that no function of the counts gives the technical decision in two histories of that protocol, and that local views can fail to glue with every context consistent.

source_adds.en: Audience as a design axis, identifying a request's audience, and a personal change needing no agreement. No law states versions adopted per audience over shared records as such.

name.en: Owners and delegated authority taken as given

source.locator: The user experience; also ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5; PLAN Decisions to make

sense.en: An assistant proposal: every module has a responsible owner, members adopt within their authority, shared commitments follow delegated authority, and communities retain control of them. The folder keeps the mechanism for representing authority apart from any governance policy, as data with a test policy, and leaves rules undecided; what delegation settles is taken as given.

correspondences.quote: A change to a shared commitment follows the authority already delegated by the community

reading.en: What is carried: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides, and among symmetric parties only an asymmetry or a procedure differentiates. The account holds that under premises, J4 and correspondence for authority, with the mandate supplied in its protocol. The source takes delegated authority as its working term, though it too leaves who may decide open, so the divergence is narrow. 'Owner' would need naming as the relation meant, who maintains. This does not say the design is wrong.

says.en: Conditional (living significance; J1–J4; correspondence E for actual classifications, valid undertakings, feasibility and authority; each a hypothesis): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities.

targets.part: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides

says.en: Theorem (two roles; periphery, empty axiom reports): a predicate on two roles invariant under their swap cannot hold of exactly one, while each single assignment fits a task needing exactly one: among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure the parties form; the laws single out none.

Wording names the relation it means: the formation and change of conditions, dependence, participation in decisions. It keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations. A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right. Responsibility needs its own argument.

In the declared protocol: seed mandate, recognition and copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed. The origin of the highest authority does not follow.

Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence): under these premises it can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier. It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority.

account_adds.en: A demand that wording not confer standing, authority named as a premise wherever a law uses it, and an obstruction among symmetric parties.

source_adds.en: A working use of authority in adoption decisions, a responsible owner for every module, and what to do when delegated authority does not settle a question: ask for a domain decision.

name.en: One name, two meanings: attendance

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Matching types do not establish matching meaning. In the worked case one event name conflates observed check-ins and qualification under a policy, and separating them forces downstream changes to badges, eligibility and rewards. An unchanged signature does not count as unchanged meaning.

correspondences.quote: A calendar and badge module can agree on types but disagree about what counts as attendance.

reading.en: The closest form is a typed witness: two well-typed terms of one type, one with a captured binding, give different answers at one input and the same at another, so one coincident value does not reveal the difference. A code's homonyms read back wrongly, and a merged distinction returns only by a coined form or one held outside: the shape of splitting one event name. Those laws are on one code; two modules holding one form at different senses is my further step.

says.en: Witness (periphery; a supplied typed-term language): two well-typed terms of the same type, one using the outer position under a binder and one whose use the binder captured, give different answers at one assignment and input and the same answer at another, so one coincident value does not reveal the capture. Equal evaluation does not establish identity of reference, content or history.

Theorem (any type): a code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense, and only it, exactly where no two senses hold one form: synonyms do no harm and homonyms do. Where all hold a code merging two senses, a coined form heard by all makes every formation tell them apart again.

Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not shown: that actual conventions form this way.

targets.part: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining

account_adds.en: The exact law that synonyms are harmless and homonyms harmful, and that a coincident value can hide a same-type difference.

source_adds.en: That two modules can agree on a type and disagree on meaning: the laws are on one code or one language. Then what the change does downstream: retroactive corrections, rewards already spent, and which historical commitments can stay stable.

name.en: A shared decision cannot be made local or derived

source.locator: Assistant, the attendance chain; also README counterexamples and ARCHITECTURE worked revision

sense.en: Architecture can expose relationships but not dissolve shared disagreement. Modularity cannot make every global change local, shared policy disagreements still need social resolution, and whether to preserve, reconcile or compensate spent rewards is a community decision an LLM cannot derive from types.

correspondences.quote: It cannot make an inherently shared decision purely local.

reading.en: Three forms. Locality: a part's change stays its own only within others' margins. Derivation: a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings, and a frame fixes no order; ordering takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another, and C asks nothing of mixed cases; the continuation condition ranks nothing. Resolution: a law privileging neither side never brings agreement on a code, and among symmetric roles only an asymmetry or a procedure differentiates. Reading spent rewards so is my step.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): the whole widens exactly when the part's net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside its region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission): one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting giving each listed item a weight above zero weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings.

Hypotheses where a theorem takes them, each representing a scope or a property of an order within the account, and, used as hypotheses, neither standing above becoming (07 §4): the continuation condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, and asks nothing of mixed comparisons. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails: immediate, since 'better' is free, it shows that a frame fixes no order.

From a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree at a sense where the renaming moves every form; in a witness a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry. A resolution written back into records later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on.

targets.part: a symmetric start under an exchange and a renaming

says.en: Theorem (two roles; periphery): among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure the parties form; the laws single out none.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4 and correspondence E; each a hypothesis): without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities. It does not supply a complete mixed ranking.

targets.part: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides

account_adds.en: An exact reason the decision is underdetermined, on listed items and weightings, an obstruction under symmetry, and when a recorded resolution comes to rest.

source_adds.en: Social resolution as the actual process, which the account leaves to a procedure the parties form. Then the practical move: predict the wider scope before implementation, proportionate coordination for changes of shared meaning.

name.en: The maintained module outlasts the agents who work on it

source.locator: The organizing model; README The maintained module

sense.en: A durable module holds identity, contracts, state, evidence and maintenance knowledge; workers come and go. Another agent must be able to resume from durable context without reconstructing the whole community's chat, and durable responsibility stays distinct from the temporary task graph of a change.

correspondences.quote: An executing agent is temporary.

reading.en: The map's thesis is general, argued and not a theorem: a pattern goes on while occurrences carrying it begin and end, read at two classes. One model shows it exactly: a rule held after s steps with nothing of the start among its holders. What remains of a recipe can be resumed from where a course stands. That rule passes through members with no records, where the source holds identity in records with no worker active: a real difference.

says.en: Thesis, claimed and argued, not a theorem: a pattern goes on while the occurrences carrying it begin and end: a flame through its fuel, an organism through its cells, a practice through its members. Read at one class, turnover that sustains and turnover that ends look alike; at a fine and a coarse class together they differ.

Theorem (root; a family of models; one minimal model of a rule of entry; records not modelled): in a region closed under its steps, after s steps the rule is held, at the quotas then standing, with nothing of the start among the holders. Not shown: that any actual institution meets these hypotheses.

Theorem (any process): carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands, and resuming it completes the recipe. How a formation comes to remember or sense what remains is not modelled, nor concurrent activity.
In one declared history, handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate.

account_adds.en: That persistence is relative to a chosen pair of classes, and that a kept rule still needs continuing participation.

source_adds.en: An identity held in records through stretches when no worker is active. Then the maintenance dossier as a design, wake conditions, and that durable context lets a new worker resume cheaply: not stated.

name.en: Evolution has to pay for its migrations

source.locator: Core claims, claim 7; soundness assessment; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Versions, migrations, ownership, budgets and consolidation belong to normal lifecycle. Features may get cheap while their shared meaning becomes expensive to maintain; a variant budget must include adapters and migrations, and extraction cost is counted before later savings. The folder says owners and budgets are not yet shown to control the burden.

correspondences.quote: Easy generation alone is insufficient.

reading.en: A budget covering correction alone does not pay for migration, with a missing part stopping realization while an aggregate reads safe. Support during a transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings: a limit on funding, where the source asks only that extraction be counted first. Growth has its price in general form: under upkeep a course keeping widening has ever more takers. On market and World models, parts supplied. Maintaining many forks has no law.

says.en: Theorem (periphery): under a certificate covering correction plus migration and the listed conditions, every finite successor takes its step; in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration. The record's AI reading: the migration of a running service. Not shown: that an actual system is so provided for, or that a succession or its command is right.

Theorem (every law with admissible disturbances and a guard; the cover on the market instance): a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. On the instance: sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

Theorem (World; witnesses): under upkeep, every supported formation taking at least a unit a step from a family, a course keeping widening by name has ever more takers. Natural-number amounts are used. What one course needs does not give the second-order direction of widening.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law): inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

account_adds.en: That the shortfall can be invisible in an aggregate safety reading.

source_adds.en: The economic claim that generation cost and maintenance cost diverge, so features get cheap while shared meaning gets expensive. Then consolidation of forks, ownership transfer and human clarification as a maintenance cost.

name.en: Rollback does not undo writes; transitions must survive interruption

source.locator: Change and adoption; ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5

sense.en: New implementations are published as versions. Persisted state needs a compatible transition or migration, active sessions and jobs need handling, and cross-module changes need durable transitions with retries and specified compensation. A rollback candidate must account for state already transformed; the plan refuses to promise general atomic rollback.

correspondences.quote: Code rollback does not by itself undo incompatible data writes or external effects.

reading.en: The refusal has a form at one remove. Under a fixed law a possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists, and returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between; a code rollback changes the law, which that theorem holds fixed, so the match is to state only. No map restores what a reduction merged unless the joint relation was retained. Protocols carry a change through interruption, with limits: coherence is not harmlessness; completion needs reserve and an uninterrupted suffix.

says.en: Theorem (any process): along a finite trace under a fixed law, every existential endpoint possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists; failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint, which, in a witness, incomplete questions hide. Returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between; where a law comes from lies outside these laws.

Theorem (any type): what an observable reads through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two configurations a reduction merges. The loss is at the reduced interface, not universal: retaining the joint relation reverses it.
Theorem (any process): moves inserted before resuming join into one course and can disable what remains. Concurrent activity and its admission are not modelled.

Law (any process; pure core) with a periphery instance: a law doing one unit of a pending task's work a tick finishes in that work plus one tick; under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes, leaving the rest unchanged. That the request is still appropriate is not shown.

Instance (periphery): with durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. It verifies no arbitrary irreversible effect, and safety here is coherence of evidence, not harmless activity.

account_adds.en: Exact step counts for resumption, that consistency alone does not supply reserve, deadline or an uninterrupted suffix, and that a retained joint relation is what reverses a merge.

source_adds.en: Rollback as such: that code rollback leaves incompatible writes and external effects standing, where the return law holds the law fixed. Then coexisting versions over shared records, migration of stored meaning, spent rewards and compensation, activation pinned against other owners' old promises.

name.en: Retiring a thing while keeping its records and obligations

source.locator: Questions, 6; ARCHITECTURE section 5

sense.en: A module can end as executable software while its history and continuing obligations survive: identify dependents, stop new work, resolve obligations, transfer ownership, preserve records. Compression must not delete unresolved obligations.

correspondences.quote: The system needs a way to stop maintaining executable variants while preserving community history.

reading.en: The account's practical judgment has this shape, conditionally: an ending stands on fulfilment, justified release or loss of warrant, with response to residual losses; renaming, deleted records or hidden undertakings change the judgment; a transfer needs an accepted successor with capacity in time, not nominal succession. An argument, not a law, Conditional on living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E. Along total dependence one end ends everything downstream.

says.en: Conditional (living significance; J1–J4, correspondence E; each a hypothesis; an argument with checked consequences). End: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses; renaming, deleted records, hidden undertakings change the judgment. Transfer: an accepted successor has capacity and support in time for demand; nominal succession or a gap during actual need change it.

Theorem (any number of conditions): along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade.
In one declared history, handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate.

account_adds.en: Which responses a judgment could give (preserve, transform, transfer, end) and what changes each, and that nominal succession does not count as transfer.

source_adds.en: The procedure itself: stop new work, drop executable variants while access to records stays, archival views, a sponsor who leaves, compression that keeps unresolved obligations. No law of deliberately carrying out an ending is stated; the practice of moving superseded text to history/ stands in AGENTS.md, not the live account.

name.en: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity

source.locator: Core claims, claim 8; Three properties

sense.en: Value stance: conversations, identity, commitments, decisions and cultural history matter alongside features and performance, and a new version should keep the relevant records and commitments. Social harmony is called an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee.

correspondences.quote: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity.

reading.en: The source holds as a value what the account gives only under premises: that these losses count is the continuation condition's scope, and a ranking is under an order a result names, one meeting C or another; no law says a loss of records is a harm. Its judgment makes preservation defeasible: for actual continuation, not an institution's survival. Same word, other reference: continuity here is records surviving an upgrade; continuation is relative to a class the law does not warrant.

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; it ranks nothing. C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, widening being one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4, correspondence E; each a hypothesis). Preserve: relations sustain living, alteration lacks advantage or causes avoidable loss; failure, domination, unsustainable burdens or a better alternative change the judgment. Maintaining a common support shares its favourable reason for actual continuation, not an institution's survival.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it. Individuation fixes what counts as a loss; the reading of living is a choice.

Theorem (root): under the full class continuation is 缘 itself, and under a coarser class every continuation remains one. Its only hypotheses: each class an equivalence, and equality on the carrier where identity serves as a class. Not shown: that a class is warranted.

Reading [AI, D65; whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: a condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic: living may continue, and improve, after the way of coordination changes.

account_adds.en: The split between whose losses count and which course ranks higher, what would change a judgment to preserve, and that what continues is relative to the class read.

source_adds.en: The concrete objects of continuity (identity, decisions, cultural history) as what must survive an upgrade, and a stance held rather than conditioned on named premises.

name.en: Agreeing agents are not independent evidence

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; RESEARCH-AGENDA question 7; PLAN Parallel work during implementation

sense.en: Independent agents may reproduce one misunderstanding, an agent can write code and tests sharing a mistaken assumption, review does not establish correctness merely because agents agree, and agents with different role names are not automatically independent. Verification should scale with the scope and consequences of a change.

correspondences.quote: Agreement and implementation-shaped tests are not sufficient evidence of correctness.

reading.en: The reviewer laws have this shape: readiness counts independent causes, not names, the plan's point about role names; moving two reviewers under one cause fails it with all names kept; a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails them all though the roster reads ready, which is the shared misunderstanding. A test excludes only through what couples in, so one shaped by the implementation misses what they share: my step. Mere agreement falls under this only with a supplied common cause.

says.en: Theorem (pure core, no axiom; fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers): reviewers count by independent causes, not names. In computed cases three reviewers with distinct single causes are ready, moving two under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept, and a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer. That the formulas are the actual causes is not shown.

Theorem (any type, no axiom): where each added witness copies one already on the roster, inspection takes exactly the same steps and gives the same certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.

Theorem (World; no premise): a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, and what holds is never excluded. Being alike through the couplings bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition: nonempty bounds, every two leaving a reviewer working under both.

source_adds.en: That agreement as such is not sufficient evidence: the account shows this for copies and shared causes, and says merely agreeing without copying is not shown. Then implementation-shaped tests as a specific failure, adversarial and contract-derived checks, and verification effort scaled to consequences.

name.en: Evidence holds under its premises and needs renewal

source.locator: Sections 2 and 4

sense.en: An assistant proposal: evidence binds property, revision, assumptions, environment and method. Tests expire with code; a compositional argument may stay reusable when a change re-establishes exactly its premises. Tests cannot be summarized up into a proof. Reuse is proposed to make later changes cheaper.

correspondences.quote: Every reuse records the premises and environmental conditions on which it relies.

reading.en: Both sides have forms. Reuse: signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and gains agree in sign, and preserving an assessment through a substitution needs a guarantee and a producer meeting its criterion, the source's re-established premises. Renewal: a record can stay true of its sample while reusing it is wrong; evidence must be carried through admitted change; an old envelope reused after reviewers merge accepts what a recomputed one rejects. The saving from reuse is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (periphery: pre-spine updater constructions): signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and the gains agree in sign, so a change of gain keeping zero and orientation, as from 1 to 2, keeps every sign; constant channels, one blind reference, mixed-epoch readings and change after calibration remain failures.

Theorem (periphery; a supplied language), hypothesis in the record: preserving an assessment also needs a hypothetical guarantee and an actual producer meeting its input criterion; substitution proves neither premise.

targets.part: hypothesis: a guarantee and a producer meeting its criterion

says.en: Theorem (periphery; for two named histories, the moves and local closure supplied): where a reference changes without entering what is retained, no deterministic policy choosing from that view resolves them in finitely many steps, so a rule never answering falsely must abstain. A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong.

Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): what execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change; a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.
Computed case (pure core): the old envelope reused after the merger accepts the two merged supporters, a recomputed one rejects them.

targets.part: computed case: the old envelope reused after the merger

account_adds.en: That inspection is needed for repair: reopening and taking up without inspection does not repair the judgment.

source_adds.en: The case for reuse, that it makes later changes cheaper. Then evidence classes with different invalidation rules and a periodic independent broader check.

name.en: A change compiled into a repair frontier

source.locator: Section 2

sense.en: A proposed planner: consumers of a changed promise receive a delta through declared boundaries and each decides whether its guarantees still hold; propagation stops at a supported boundary or a broader owner. A revised premise reopens an obligation. Predictions are kept so locality is measured, and exhausted budgets stay unresolved.

correspondences.quote: a budget limit never converts unknown compatibility into acceptance

reading.en: The planner is not in the account, but its rules have forms: what needs certifying is propagated through every admitted change, and a change can reopen what was excluded (a revised premise); an understated change leaves false confidence (a hidden assumption); exhaustion keeps a task pending (a budget limit). Its stopping has one too: a region closed under a relation is one that relation never crosses, each relation drawing its own closure. These read arrangements and tasks, not consumers of promises; correspondence unshown. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied, not inferred from a notice or a clock): what execution needs certified is the candidate set propagated through every admitted change, a later report filtered only after expanding through admitted fault and control transitions; a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement, and a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.

Law (pure core) with a periphery instance: a course of draws on a stock is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing; with review drawing one unit and action two, an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course; refusal or exhaustion keeps the task and the work used. Retaining a task is not its actual continuation.
Theorem (periphery; for two named histories, moves and closure supplied): a rule never answering falsely must abstain where a reference changed outside what is retained.

Reading [AI, D45, D61]: along a relation, a formation's boundary is given by a region holding it and closed under the relation, which the relation then never crosses. Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed; the closure is the least.

targets.part: along a relation, a region closed under it

account_adds.en: That abstaining is forced, not merely prudent, for a sound rule on that view, and that what stops one relation need not stop another.

source_adds.en: Propagation of a semantic delta through consumers' declared boundaries, escalation to a broader owner, and keeping predictions so that locality is measured rather than defined afterwards.

name.en: The decomposition itself must be revisable

source.locator: The capability we must invent and demonstrate; ARCHITECTURE section 3

sense.en: The updated ambition, in assistant-authored mechanisms: work reveals an insufficient boundary, agents propose better ones, parents search their neighbourhood first, candidates are scored with migration cost and a cooldown discourages churn, later unseen work tests them. The current structure is useful organization, not an assertion that the first decomposition was ideal.

correspondences.quote: This makes the original responsibility tree an object of learning.

reading.en: The revision step has a form: a rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan. Neighbourhood search, which the source adopts, rests wherever no neighbour scores more. Rules revised at every step can never complete, what its cooldown guards against: my step. A condition indispensable to one way of organizing is not thereby basic; any ranking there takes an order someone holds. Learning its own boundaries, and later savings, are not stated. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (any process; contacts, targets and revision rule supplied): a change of plan keeps every old selection exactly where it retains every old contact; a revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan; a rule not reading failures leaves one unanswered at every plan where no list holds every address. One finite history does not show revision corrects every failure.
Theorem (World): a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. Which neighbourhoods a system searches is read empirically.

Theorem (any process; completion decided; the home's conditional part, under the continuation condition, not used here): where unfinished steps lower the current rule's certificate and a handoff to a revised rule does not raise it, a run certified at most B completes by step B + 1; without the handoff hypothesis rules each finishing when kept, revised at every step, never complete. The rank measures that bound, not ethical value.

Reading [AI, D65; whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms. A condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic.

account_adds.en: That reading failures is necessary for a revision rule to answer them, what a change of plan keeps, and that a search's added rests are a bias of its neighbourhood.

source_adds.en: The claim itself: a responsibility tree that learns its own boundaries through use, with later savings. Then the search: bounded local operations (split, merge, extract, move), scoring, margins, and promotion by trial on unseen changes.

name.en: Future costs follow from the current representation

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass

sense.en: The plan's thesis: if a system improves its boundaries, named concepts, procedures and evidence, later work gets easier, and extra experience should sometimes reduce the reasoning the next task needs. Called the central proposed advantage; explicitly falsifiable if search costs exceed savings.

correspondences.quote: many future costs are consequences of the current representation of a problem

reading.en: The account has no law that a better representation lowers later cost or reasoning: the folder's distinctive claim stands untaken and untested, and the account's reading of meta-learning classifies orders functionally and claims no saving. A proposal: what a lumping settles at unobserved inputs, three probes identifying a compositional code, and one construction counting a reform's later return. That is less left undetermined, not less effort.

searched: live account (chapters, fronts, glossary): meta-learn, sav(es|ing|ings), less work, less effort, less reasoning, reasoning cost, reasoning effort, learning to learn, cost of search, cost of change, compress
read: 03-KNOWING.md #r-generalization-through-lumping, #r-composition-route, #r-formed-goal-revision-continuation, and the Reading D65 on meta-learning

name.en: A learned procedure carries only where its conditions hold

source.locator: Section 4; README Updated ambition; VISION The user experience; PLAN How to react when we lose

sense.en: An assistant proposal, the third of the folder's named mechanisms: learned strategies are kept with provenance and applicability conditions, retrieval checks them, and procedures carry forward without assuming every community means the same thing. If learning helps one community and harms another, require explicit applicability and local adaptation.

correspondences.quote: A learned strategy can become stale or inapplicable; retrieval must check its conditions.

reading.en: Forms exist, each one protocol with much supplied. A practice round completes exactly where the reviewer's recorded method answers as the current context does, and a changed context fails. Applicability has its own law: an endpoint completes exactly where its report clears the relevant risk, and a report correct when sampled need not cover the effect. Faithful reconstruction passes a procedure on, record erasure altering later use. None concerns retrieval or transfer across communities. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; task, records, mandate, participants and more supplied): a practice round by a reviewer and a worker completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; changed context fails. One connection from enacted practice to further participation, not indefinite self-maintenance.

With review drawing one unit and action two, an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course. Correctness at sampling time does not ensure that a report covers the effect; protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason for preferring the practice. Only the two practice protections of a supplied outcome law are covered.

Theorem (periphery): in a declared construction, every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and the procedure bit, as many successors as capacity allows. Supplied: hardware, procedures, laws, encounters, exact copying and a fixed recipe; one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules. Record erasure can preserve offspring count while altering later use.

account_adds.en: That protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason for preferring the practice.

source_adds.en: Retrieval that checks conditions, provenance kept with a strategy, transfer across communities and the cost of learning.

name.en: No layer is exempt: software that learns how to evolve itself

source.locator: Updated vision; What changed; also ARCHITECTURE The organizing model; PLAN Beyond the first win

sense.en: The updated ambition, user-directed in its aim and assistant-authored in its mechanisms: decomposition, maintenance context, procedures, development machinery, even the host and common rules can improve through use, while an independent evaluation reference is preserved. A long-range objective; nothing built.

correspondences.quote: No layer is permanently exempt from redesign if measured bottlenecks justify replacing it.

reading.en: What the account has for a learner changing how it changes are instances with a level held fixed: a failed updating rule can be replaced, in declared networks; a rule changes through an amendment procedure that stays fixed; where a law comes from lies outside the return laws. Currently favourable updates can overwrite an old recall, and rules revised at every step can never complete. So 'no layer' exceeds every stated model, and the source itself exempts its evaluation reference. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; pre-spine modules; declared networks): one network loses an old recall through continued, currently favourable updates and restores it by further revision without a reset; in a finite replacement history failure allows an affordable proposal, and reinstalling the old rule can fail again. Not a population, convergence or ethical theorem.

In one declared protocol a rule changes only at a gated adoption through an amendment procedure that is supplied and fixed. Which proposals a procedure admits and how procedures are themselves kept or dropped are distinct questions; how tasks and tests change is open.
Theorem (any process): witnesses: without the handoff hypothesis rules each finishing when kept, revised at every step, never complete. No universal productive deadline follows from the bound.
The laws concern reachability under one fixed law; where a law comes from lies outside them.

account_adds.en: That an improvement currently favoured can overwrite what was kept, and that unlimited revision can prevent completion.

source_adds.en: A substrate improving its own tools, host and rules through use, with an independent reference kept. The account has no law of open-ended self-improvement.

name.en: Growth must leave the community able to change what it built

source.locator: Beyond the first win; VISION Three demanding worlds and What success cannot be purchased by hiding

sense.en: A limit the plan sets on its own long-range objective: a substrate that discovers better ways to organize itself may not cost the community its ability to use, understand and change what it built. Culture remains something people create and negotiate, and communities retain control of their shared commitments.

correspondences.quote: Each expansion must preserve the existing community’s ability to use, understand, and change what it has built.

reading.en: The account states the distinction this needs: in its rule protocol, with two participants technical decisions go on while revision of the governance fails, so continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized. Under a fixed law a possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists. The source states an undertaking; as a ranking it would be its holder's, under a scope and order they name.

says.en: A copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate, and with two participants technical decisions can go on while revision of the governance itself fails: continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized. One declared construction; seed rule, participation and amendment procedure supplied.

targets.part: continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized

says.en: Theorem (any process): along a finite trace under a fixed law, every existential endpoint possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists. Physical irreversibility does not follow: the laws are of a represented process.

The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; it ranks nothing. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. Where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.

account_adds.en: That operating and being able to revise how one is organized come apart, on a witness.

source_adds.en: The requirement itself, that each expansion must preserve the ability to use, understand and change, as a limit on a self-improving substrate. Then understanding as part of what is kept, and culture as something people create and negotiate.

name.en: Thousands of useful workers

source.locator: Sections 5 and 6; soundness assessment table; EVALUATION Five independent axes of scale

sense.en: Work should run across up to a thousand active workers, measured by accepted change and not activity. Benefit depends on task independence: independent work proceeds concurrently, conflicting obligations are coordinated without global serialization of the unrelated, and an ownership conflict changes the boundary and is not remedied by another worker.

correspondences.quote: Sharding a queue does not prove semantic coordination scales.

reading.en: What is independent has an exact form: exchanges with disjoint footprints commute, order showing only through a shared relatum or a dependence; sharing a relatum, order can matter; a scheduler completes exactly where some interleaving exists. So the source's independence, and its refusal of global serialization, have a form, as order and not as speed. There is no law of accepted work against worker count; the several-optimizers law is draw on a stock, a word match here. Proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World): where supplied sides split two consecutive steps, swapping the exchanges keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment and, on a stretch holding every commuted pair, the totals and counts, under any number of commutations; the order shows through a shared relatum or a dependence.
Theorem (a local law; witness): on one relatum, adding one then doubling gives two and doubling then adding gives one: the hypothesis of local commutation cannot be dropped.

Theorem (World): for a local law with the relata listed, two lists giving every relatum the same own course reach the same configuration; with exchanges told apart, a scheduler completes exactly where some interleaving exists.

account_adds.en: That which exchanges commute is exact given a footprint, and that a shared relatum is where order begins to matter.

source_adds.en: How accepted work scales with worker count: queues, leases, backpressure, useful saturation, and useful concurrency as throughput, none stated.

name.en: Predict scope first; keep failed thresholds as results

source.locator: Provisional advancement gates; What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: Assistant-proposed standard: predict the affected set before implementation, seal outcomes, compare with tuned rivals, report losses as results. Every number is a provisional target; no measurement exists. Surprises must not be relabelled as locality after the fact.

correspondences.quote: Do not revise a failed threshold retrospectively and retain the original claim.

reading.en: Same practice as the account's frozen rules: verdict scored before the data, failure recorded beside the thesis. An agreement of method, not of a checked law. A frozen rule there fixes scoring, not that the rule reads its construct, a limit the folder states less exactly. The folder's own tests were not taken up; the account names it an application, correspondence not established.

says.en: Strength is the observations a claim excludes; how far a claim has been seen is whether it is proved under named premises, supported by frozen tests, conjectured or argued. A thesis adds no theorem, a refutation removes none, and a failure stays recorded beside the thesis. A frozen rule fixes how a verdict is scored before the data, not that the rule reads the construct the verdict names.
Applications elsewhere (design programmes, not results; correspondence not established), naming evolving community swarms among them.

account_adds.en: The distinction between a frozen scoring rule and construct validity.

source_adds.en: The specific tests: ablations, matched baselines, unseen communities, the cost and quality gates. None is frozen or run in the account.

name.en: The goal: surpass the strongest alternative

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass; DECISIONS 2026-09-07

sense.en: Ren's direction is to surpass, not only learn from, existing systems. The assistant-authored reading: more useful change at lower total cost than the strongest practical alternatives, cumulative capability with communities keeping control. The folder ties any superiority claim to a workload, comparison, budget and period.

correspondences.quote: Success means a community can achieve more useful change with less repeated explanation

reading.en: The account takes no growing capability as a goal: no law of the dynamics gives a ranking; widening is a relation between two courses, not a quantity to maximize, silent on mixed cases; institutions have no prior licence to grow. In its conditional judgment (living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E) mere output growth grounds no transformation. The source names what its comparison reads, cost per accepted change on a workload: a frame kept as its own, not an error.

says.en: §1: widening is a relation between two courses on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and where the comparison is mixed the theorems show it mixed and weigh it for no one. The answer in brief: which course ranks above is the order a result takes as a hypothesis, and the page reads the question's generative direction by the dynamics a collective's course enters and leaves.

Ranking, order: a comparison of options, one ranked above another, a relation formed by whoever compares, within becoming, in people and AI. No law of the dynamics gives one: the theorems give how courses differ in what they admit, one widening another, the two keeping the same or mixed, with no premise.

Reading [AI, whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: the laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow; whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Conditional (living significance, which the continuation condition yields; J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Transform: the arrangement damages shared conditions and feasible change restores living with equivalent protections; mere output growth and displaced deprivation change the judgment.

account_adds.en: What a capability ranking would need: an order meeting C or another, and silence on mixed comparisons.

source_adds.en: A measured, competitive target with explicit rivals, which the account does not set itself.

name.en: A self-improving system must not grade itself

source.locator: Workloads and independence; ARCHITECTURE The organizing model

sense.en: Because the system may replace its own components and procedures, the plan keeps an independent evaluation reference: independent authors freeze outcomes, and the optimizing system cannot touch adjudication or cost accounting. Stated as test hygiene, not as a law of self-improving systems.

correspondences.quote: The optimizing system cannot edit sealed adjudication, cost accounting or reference history.

reading.en: Thesis T7 has this form: a measure whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is, drift aside, dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, such as a reader outside the share, not on evidence alone; proved only in part. In frozen test LA2 one note of the loss turned one trained judge of its own answers, counting against T7's fourth forbidden case (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift. An outside reader reaches only what couples in. That a self-improver so reads is a premise. Proposed here; T7 comes down from the corpus's meta-attractor line (02's D26), so by descent as far as it goes.

says.en: Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and, drift aside, is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone. In the model only invariance and the lock outliving an unread coordinate are proved. Frozen LA2, one trained system: one note of the loss turned a judge of its own answers, counting against T7's fourth forbidden case (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift, as a claim about trained judges.

targets.part: Thesis T7 and frozen test LA2

says.en: Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration, under the stated monotone premises, the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course: a sufficient way out. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem (World): what a pool whose members lie outside the acting part decides by its acts (a reward, a vote, a revision), under laws reading through its members' couplings, is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it.
Instance (periphery): an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied, not shown.

account_adds.en: That a reading formed from what it scores can absorb any change made to it, a frozen test on one trained judge, and that independence bounds what an evaluator can respond to without fixing it.

source_adds.en: The practical arrangement: sealed outcomes, independent authors, recorded adjudication.

name.en: Everyone happily making it more powerful

source.locator: Exchange 4, Ren

sense.en: Ren's founding picture: a space that never slows, where members keep adding apps, wallets, voting and badges until it becomes their 'os' and part of the culture. The folder's own README restates harmony as an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee and keeps real disagreement in its question, so the picture is a hope, not a claim of the design.

correspondences.quote: everyone just happily making it more and more powerful

reading.en: The account keeps what the picture leaves out. A course that keeps widening on a finite family has to be fed from beyond and, under upkeep, has ever more takers; starting from relations removes a fixed sum but not rivalry. Reading a shared space as such a course is mine, and untested. The divergence is with the picture, not the folder's hedged design. No law here says a loss is a harm; a ranking is its holder's, under a scope and order they name.

says.en: Theorem (World; witnesses): for a course keeping widening by name, requirements fixed within a finite family, the family's stock passes every bound and a finite balanced world has no such course; under upkeep the course has ever more takers. Natural-number amounts are used. What one course needs does not give the second-order direction of widening.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems: positive-sum structure and real conflict; mixed comparisons stay unranked.

account_adds.en: What growth without end would need, and real conflict as theorem on the reading of position.

source_adds.en: The aspiration itself, and that a shared space can become part of a culture through use.

name.en: A community grows its own software into its culture

source.locator: The idea; The founding example; VISION Three demanding worlds

sense.en: The founding idea: members ask for changes where they use the software, agents help make them, and the space becomes a shared environment for work, play and coordination. Culture stays something people create and negotiate; the software should preserve their ability to do so.

correspondences.quote: A community can develop its own software continuously

reading.en: The account names this folder once, among applications: design programmes, not results, correspondence not established. That is where the founding idea went. Its only software claim is an assessment of selected LibreOffice and Narwhal histories, about what carried activity through partial reorganization, not members reshaping tools by request, nor software as culture. The folder's whole participatory research programme stands outside the account.

searched: live account: evolving community, swarm, software, culture, malleable, community OS, participatory, member request, niche

name.en: Replay can overfit; unseen work tests generalization

source.locator: Section 3; EVALUATION What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: An assistant proposal: past changes can reject poor boundary candidates but cannot confirm good ones, since learning may memorize development fixtures. Promotion requires a trial and later evaluation on unseen changes, and the public fixture cannot serve as a sealed demonstration.

correspondences.quote: Historical replay can reject obviously poor candidates, but it can overfit.

reading.en: Same form, generally and on a named model. With no lumping every unobserved input stays free; where a lumping tells a history from every course, a law with the same courses takes any amount there, so its courses do not fix unseen work. A program fits every old record yet answers the novel expression wrongly, and that record exposes it; a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule. The models are supplied, not software or cognition. Promotion policy is not in the account.

says.en: Theorem (any type): the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input (inputs compared decidedly). Training selects through agreeing on the data: every two members agreeing on the data agree at x exactly where the data determine x within the class. Probabilistic generalization bounds are not stated.

Theorem (World): where a lumping tells a history from every course, with laws reading what has stood and lumping decided, a law with the same courses takes any amount there and responds alike or not to histories it separates.

Theorem (named codes and formation courses; witnesses; much supplied): for the collapsed code a program duplicating one argument fits the old records yet answers the novel expression wrongly; the novel expression's record exposes it, a course with spare parts rebuilds the right program, and without spare parts the error is recorded, not repaired.
Theorem (any type): records only narrow the candidates. A wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

account_adds.en: That a fresh record can expose an error without repairing it, when no spare parts are left.

source_adds.en: Promotion by trial, held-out communities and request families, and a periodic independent broader check.

name.en: A synthetic member cannot establish cultural fit

source.locator: Diagnostic measurements; PLAN stage 6

sense.en: An assistant-proposed limit on evidence: product outcomes must be measured with members (task completion, correction time, adoption, abandonment), since an agent standing in for a member cannot establish fit or satisfaction. No such measurement has been made.

correspondences.quote: A synthetic agent impersonating a community member cannot establish cultural fit or member satisfaction.

reading.en: The account says this of itself, as a reading: a selection reaches what couples into its selector, human readers couple into none of the work's checks, so no check inside shows it serves its purpose, and every review so far is by AI. Its valuer experiments are AI personas, labelled role-play, human valuers untested. It differs in use: it runs such tests and reports verdicts beside the label. T5 is cited only for that label; the continuation condition and C do no work here.

says.en: Reading [AI, D66]: the selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it. The work's selectors are the Lean checker, the completion and record checks, and the AI reviews. Human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of them. So no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.
Every recorded review so far is by AI. No independent human review is claimed.
Evidence for T5: VD1 (96 AI-persona valuers, frozen before any call), every frozen rule failed; VD2, some frozen rules passed and some failed. The judgments are role-play; human valuers are untested.

account_adds.en: The mechanism of the limit, what couples into the selector, and a frozen test of what AI personas do, reported beside the label.

source_adds.en: The general limit, with no law here of what simulated people show, and its object: cultural fit and satisfaction in a community that uses the thing.

name.en: The ledger counts cost to the system
