source.locator: The primary question; VISION What success cannot be purchased by hiding

sense.en: An assistant proposal, thorough in its own frame: charge discovery, search, verification, failed attempts, migrations and continuing maintenance; normalize model and tool prices by a pinned rate table and report raw usage; measure human time and regressions separately. Hidden cost does not count as success. What is read is cost to the project and its members; a worker is temporary, and what a run draws beyond its price has no line.

correspondences.quote: Measure agent/infrastructure cost per accepted request

reading.en: The rate table normalizes actual prices, which the account's wording keeps for economic relations, and human time stays a separate line, so no single unit is claimed. What the account would ask is whose losses have no line: under the continuation condition every continuation's count; a ranking takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another; no law says a loss is a harm. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown. A report can omit what was depleted; the frame stays the source's. Proposed here: the account has no ledger.

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; its content beyond the self's presupposition extends scope to losses that return to no one; it ranks nothing. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. Where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.

Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence): overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts.
Reading [AI, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
Reading [AI, D66], used by analogy: the work's selectors take in no reading of what renews the people who carry it, while its parallel lines each draw on their attention. The work is not a flow.

targets.part: What the work draws on (D66), used by analogy

says.en: Conditions are not necessarily quantities that can be stored or exchanged, and no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable. Wording keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations.

account_adds.en: A question the ledger does not ask: what its comparison omits, and who bears that, with the premises it would need named.

source_adds.en: A concrete, auditable ledger with charges for hidden work and human time, which the account has for no activity, its own included.

name.en: Civilization as an accumulated stock of methods

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims 19, 26-28, 83

sense.en: Civilization is not a sequence of clever objects but an accumulated stock of methods by which people turned real problems into working mechanisms, tangible and intangible on equal terms (law, money, schools, human rights). Ordinary readers should learn that civilization did not happen naturally: it is generation after generation solving problems.

correspondences.quote: 文明不是自然发生的，而是一代代人解决问题的结果

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads civilization or its methods so. Passing has forms: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lasts through passing, under a supplied premise; a rule's change enters at a gated step; a method handed on has one periphery composition, expressly no population model. What accumulates has one AI reading: what can be done with the performer held grows only across changes of the performer. None says a civilization is a stock. 自然发生 here means happening of itself: a claim of cause, not a nature-culture split, and the account states no such cause.

says.en: World, any web: “A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing.” Under the passing premise, supplied, “every beginning is a passing”; without it, a double-negation form that names no carrier.

Periphery: “every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit the exposed formation had”; “one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules.”

Reading [AI reading, D45] of laws near-definitional or by witness: “What grows is what can be done with the performer held, and only across changes of the performer.” The possible tasks carry reach, “along which the whole possible never grows”.

Any process: a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it splits at a gated step that changes it, values decided. “A copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate”.

Root, a family of models: an entry rule on a shared stock passed through members who also keep it. That any actual institution meets the hypotheses, “or that this is what an institution is”, is not shown (record).
“(design programmes, not results; correspondence not established)”: names the human solutions museum among others.

account_adds.en: No law says cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. Where a rule is kept, it can be kept and be the wrong rule [AI reading].

source_adds.en: Civilization as the unit; methods as what accumulates; that what exists results from problem-solving, where 04's reading would tell apart other origins; tangible and intangible creations on equal terms.

name.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical seven-stage shape

source.locator: The argument: The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical shape with separable stages: a real problem, a misreading of it, an insight redefining it, a mechanism on a named substrate, diffusion by a named force, what it solved, the new problems it made. Each stage does work no other does. The README calls this the claim that makes the museum a theory and not a format.

correspondences.quote: a civilizational advance has a canonical shape with seven stages

reading.en: The account has no sequence of stages for an advance: its laws read courses under hypotheses, and the root lists 'inevitable improvement or universal growth' among what is not assumed. The README's counterexamples are to the product; it names no case the shape would exclude, while here content comes through hypotheses that forbid. Live 'stages' are of testing and of inquiry, and 03 says what each needs, 'not a method'. Single stages have neighbours in other entries.

source_adds.en: The seven-stage shape itself, and that each stage can be interrogated separately across cases.

searched: dossier, canonical shape, stages of, civilizational, progress, inevitable improvement, framed, moraliz, privatiz, naturaliz across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary
read: 08-METHOD an-investigation ('No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method') and law
03-KNOWING §9 ('The results say what each stage needs, not a method')
05-COLLECTIVES the reading after r-market-model-share-margin-and-ends, whose four routes of transition are routes, not stages

name.en: Real problems, solved by mechanisms

source.locator: Claims 28, 75; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: Problems are real and exist in a setting. A mechanism solves something, changing behaviours, relations, institutions, risks or capabilities. Inventions are not novelties from nowhere but mechanisms humans developed when facing real problems. The axis is problem to method.

correspondences.quote: 发明不是凭空出现的新奇物，而是人类面对真实问题时发展出的机制

reading.en: The account begins from relations with no solver presupposed. 'Solved' has the form of a standard met or a task delivered, read against something supplied: meeting it says nothing of significance, and widening follows deliveries in neither direction. 'Developed when facing' claims an origin, and 04 reads of dispositions that a present benefit does not establish one. Under the continuation condition what a solution ends counts too; ranking it takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another. The claim concerns humans and is not refuted here.

says.en: “Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.”

Standard: “what something is read against, so that it can be met or missed: a requirement on a level, an acceptable set of acts, a task.” “That a standard is met says nothing of whether meeting it is counted.”
Any process, witnesses. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “widening follows deliveries in neither direction, so they do not carry it”.

Reading after it [AI reading, D65], of a disposition: “A present benefit does not establish origin; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where they are live alternatives.”

“Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance.” “Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]”; “telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number.” The condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, and elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.
In the table of what is shown and supplied, under Supplied: “the reading and the requirement a response answers to, the task, the set level”.

account_adds.en: What a response takes in is mapped, and the requirement it answers to enters as a hypothesis, not as something found in the situation.

source_adds.en: A claim about what humans in fact faced and did, and why inventions arose, which the account does not catalogue; a problem as real apart from a reader of it.

name.en: Moving civilization forward as the selection question

source.locator: Claims 18, 29-31; Relations (zhishan)

sense.en: An exhibit is selected not for novelty, being first or fame, but for moving humanistic civilization one step forward. Five criteria include expanding expression, choice, dignity, freedom, safety, cooperation or understanding. Ambivalent inventions may enter if both what they solved and what they made are shown. The README calls this a usable test of whether a technology is good.

correspondences.quote: 是否扩大了人的表达、选择、尊严、自由、安全、协作或理解能力

reading.en: Near C in form only, and apart in three ways. The source says forward with no premise; here, where the condition holds de se, ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern, self-concern ranking every widening above on a finite listing; elsewhere it is an order a result names, one meeting C. The source lists human capabilities; C concerns what can form, and a part's widening widens the whole only within every outside margin, mixed beyond. An ambivalent invention is a mixed comparison, unranked by widening. That more choice is better is itself a premise, and it stops at named edges.

says.en: The continuation condition: “from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”, which “counts every continuation's loss and by itself ranks nothing”. “Call a life's order over courses *self-concerned* when it ranks one course above another whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove.” Of relations of being affected, “Where those relations close, such an order already ranks one course above another whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and lets more form: proved on models, on a finite listing, and near-definitional; that a life forms such an order is not shown”. Widening, on the lake, is “a relation between the two courses, which does not weigh the lost catch”.

targets.part: The ethics and the paragraph reading it on the case: what a self-concerned order ranks, and where

says.en: Any type, finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights (home, 07): one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting giving each listed item a weight above zero weighs it higher; “a mixed comparison, a gain here and a loss there, is decided both ways by positive weightings”.

World, balance, part and region decided: where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens “exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region”, and is mixed where it goes beyond for one. “Mixed is not ordered.”

“This is not itself a route to C: it says what "weaker" can mean and where each route to an order meeting C rests.” On a finite listing, “calling better what no chooser does worse from and some does better from” is a premise reading an order; that route stops at “imposed admission, another's order, several choosers”. In a witness, widening a menu two choose from lowers what each gets by the payoffs.

Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 is the continuation of life, not novelty or scale; where an expansion admits something another course does not and ends forms of life that course keeps, the two are mixed: widening alone gives no verdict, and T8 ranks neither.

account_adds.en: Widening says which admits more, more future and not a good set over less; it decides no mixed comparison, and weights that do are a further premise. A local test of when a part's gain widens the whole, which is no test of good.

source_adds.en: A named list of human goods and durable influence as admission criteria. The account names no such list; the word technology is absent from its overview, chapters and glossary, and it offers no test of whether one is good.

name.en: Every dossier shows the new problems: no sanctifying, no terminal mechanism

source.locator: Claims 30, 38; Four refusals: Anti-sanctification; Relations (meta-attractor)

sense.en: Any advance may have side effects: misuse, controversy, new inequalities. The new-problems module is mandatory, because a borrower must know the cost. The museum must not sanctify inventions but show their complexity. The README adds that every solution makes a new problem landscape, so no mechanism is terminal.

correspondences.quote: 本馆不应把发明神圣化，而要展示它们的复杂性

reading.en: Proposed here, in three parts; no live text speaks of inventions. The refusal has a form in the account: no law evaluates, and no closure is good or bad by its type. Cost has forms only under clauses: a rise paid from beyond where a containing family gains nothing; a delivery changing what its task does not list can make a regular pair impossible, excluded by listing unavoidable outputs (the likeness to the module is this read's); in a named band, success changes what the next success needs. 'No terminal mechanism' has a form for a fixed rule's possible, not for problems.

says.en: World, balance, the risen family within a containing family gaining nothing: “the rise is paid from beyond in full”. The record does not show “That drawing from beyond is wrong.”

Reading [AI reading, D45]: “where a delivery changes what its task does not list, a regular pair of possible tasks can be impossible by any means, and constructor theory's demand that a task list its unavoidable outputs is what excludes it”.
A named regulation band, a witness: “success changes what the next success needs, with no outside disturbance”. “Not evidence that judgment is scalar regulation.”

Any process: where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “Strict continuing widening relative to a held rule is then a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once”.

“There is no should beyond becoming”, “and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI”; of the lake's two catches, thirty tons a month against fifty: “If it ends a livelihood fifty keeps, the two are mixed, and the theorems weigh them for no one.”

targets.part: The ethics, and the paragraph reading it on the case

says.en: 「一种闭对生生（生命之延续）开什么、闭什么、为谁，由比较者之读来说，不由类型来说」: whose losses count by the continuation condition, an order meeting C (广者居上) ranking a course above every course it widens, every claim counted as living, and a course with gains and losses, shown mixed by the laws, needing a comparison commitment written apart [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: Past the slack, a dependence breaks unseen by every selection rewarding the rise (05 §6). No loss is called a harm.

source_adds.en: That every advance has costs and every solution makes a new problem landscape, as a claim about actual inventions; misuse and controversy as kinds of cost. The folder also reads this module as the meta-attractor's insight; the glossary's meta-attractor means closed capture and “never” the wider working sense.

name.en: The reframing thesis: insight over technology

source.locator: Claims 33-34, 44; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: What pushes civilization forward is usually not the technology but a new insight, of the kind that redefines the problem rather than answering the old version. Dossiers must show how a problem was misunderstood, moralized, suppressed or ignored, and why the old frame bounded the available solutions.

correspondences.quote: 真正推动文明前进的，往往不是技术本身，而是一个新的洞察

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads redefining a problem or an insight so. Redefining a problem changes what would count as meeting it. The nearest law holds acceptability fixed, and its reading says the relation to double-loop learning depends on changing a governing norm. Nearer the source: an AI reading tells informing from revaluing, and, in a shared model for one decision, a formation evaluating by its current valuation finds no reason to revise it. An old frame bounding solutions has a form: a merged pair is a lost choice, and a coined form returns it. 'Usually' stays unread.

says.en: Near-definitional, witnesses on Revising's process: a course opens a correction where no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one at x', “with one acceptability throughout, the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both”. Reading: “here the acceptability is fixed”.

Reading [AI reading, new]: “Informing and revaluing are two ways one part of a loop can move what another part's reading answers”; for a holding formation evaluating by the current valuation: “by that worth, no reason to revise the valuation”.
Periphery, on revising a formed goal: “Not open discovery of ends.”
Any process: every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, “and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice”.
Any type: where all hold a code merging two senses, “a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again”.

account_adds.en: With every act counted acceptable, any configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with acceptability held fixed. On Revising, replenishing alone can open it with the reading unchanged, so insight is neither necessary nor sufficient there.

source_adds.en: The historical thesis that insight usually leads; redefinition of the problem itself, including the discovery of a new end; the typology of misreading (moralize, privatize, suppress, ignore, take as fate).

name.en: A good idea is not an effective change: diffusion asked apart

source.locator: Claim 37; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A good idea is not an effective change. Diffusion must be asked separately: against what resistance, and through what force, whether the state, the market, grassroots transmission or a crisis.

correspondences.quote: 一个好想法不等于一个有效改变

reading.en: The same separation in other terms: discrimination, support and enactment come apart in Revising; seeing, valuing and complying are told apart. Spread has minimal models: hearings with an adoption rule, an imposed code, and in the periphery a market share, where selection creates no absent practice and a transition's support cannot be paid from its improvement. These are codes and shares in models, not a force of diffusion of a mechanism, and resistance is not measured.

says.en: “in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart (a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock)”.

targets.part: in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart

says.en: “**Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough**: where the rest follows a law reading through coupling, a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in … and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects.” “**Coupling is not compliance**: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.”

targets.part: Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough; Coupling is not compliance

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. “Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient”; all six together still rank nothing.

Any type, runs of hearings: under hearings that take the form heard, the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; “An imposed code makes all agree”, each formation losing the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges.
Periphery: “a share of none stays none”: “selection does not create an absent practice”. Reading [AI reading, D65]: “a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.”
Periphery, a finite transition: “support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.”

account_adds.en: These models have no merit in them. From a symmetric start, agreement needs something breaking the symmetry (in a witness, a formation both hear, a preferred form or an order of hearing), and under hearings that take the form heard only forms in use can spread. T7 forbids “a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading”, conjectured of actual metrics.

source_adds.en: Diffusion as its own question, asked of each mechanism: the named forces of spread, resistance as an object of study, and the list of mechanism substrates (materials, institutions, law, movements, commerce).

name.en: Value without mechanism; tool without the problem

source.locator: Claims 21-22, 49; What is actually broken

sense.en: Two field failures. People put forward good value claims and design no mechanism that can land. People build tools without understanding the social problem they face. Movements offering only value and products optimizing only the product both fail.

correspondences.quote: 有些人提出了很好的价值主张，但没有设计出可以落地的机制

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws either link. Value alone has neighbours, none about value claims: in a task protocol, relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails; promises alone force no start, holding on both sides where neither ever moves; in language models an instruction kept no dependent untold. Tool alone has a form: a distinction matters where histories the evidence leaves open need incompatible responses. Apart: the source says such tools fail; the account's centre says a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, so success shows no understanding.

says.en: Conditional, on a versioned task protocol with the practical commitments supplied: “relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails (`CommonTaskRevision.declaration_only_fails`)”.

Any process, periphery module: “Promises do not: “if the other eventually does, I eventually do” holds on both sides where neither ever happens”; in the exchange witness “ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present” (near-definitional).

Core, given a choice over readings: “A distinction matters for a task where histories compatible with the evidence need incompatible responses”; a policy meets the conditions exactly where every observation class admits a common action. “Tolerances, horizon and repertoire are supplied”.

“Its centre: a selection (a reward, a judge, a market, a vote, a training run) is only what couples into it; don can use that up while nothing best on what it reads can draits best, what lies beyond, as far as any allowed outcome does”. Of the lake's two catches, thirty tons a month against fifty: “If it ends a livelihood fifty keeps, the two are mixed, and the theorems weigh them for no one.”

targets.part: What it is: its centre; the paragraph reading the ethics on the case

says.en: “Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them” (record); near-definitional, its force the supplied premise that a selection goes through the couplings.

T4, IN1 mixed by its frozen rule (round 2, with talk: R2 passed; R1, R3 and R4 failed), partly passed per model (with talk, one model of two): “no condition kept an untold dependent”; one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope, the other “kept it in 1 of 10 even with talk”.
Not shown: “Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons”.

account_adds.en: An exact reason a tool's success is silent on the setting: differences beyond a selector's couplings stay unselected, however hard it selects. An AI reading adds “Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.”

source_adds.en: The empirical diagnosis that movements and inventions fail this way, stated without data, and a mechanism that lands as the designer's task. The source's charge can be put to the account itself: it offers a way of seeing, with no motivation or compliance shown; its ranking results state the scopes and orders they take.

name.en: Problems of similar structure, linked and indexed

source.locator: Claims 23, 51, 56, 58-59; Why the index is the theory; Found by reading item 11

sense.en: People who think their problem new often face one of similar structure, met before at several levels. So organize by human problem and link exhibits by problem structure, with seven method relations as the vocabulary and typed, confidence-rated links, so a person can travel to structural ancestors. The README finds 'structure' never defined and the promise unfalsifiable as written.

correspondences.quote: 这些推荐不是因为它们属于同一学科，而是因为它们处理了相似的问题结构

reading.en: Both refuse discipline or shared words as the link. In the account sameness of structure is stated: a map under which steps project and lift; a lumping the step goes alike across; a law whose hypotheses a case is shown to meet. That says what the README finds undefined, for processes and not for problems. For a link it gives a condition, not a check: a fitted rule is right at another case exactly where the world agrees at both, which no data supply. Nothing says a present problem has an ancestor.

says.en: Any process: “The map gives an exact correspondence of finite histories exactly where two things hold: every detailed step projects, and every summary step lifts from each detailed configuration it describes”.

Any type: “a member fitting the world is right at x exactly where the world agrees at x and the lumped observation; the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input”. Lead-in: “what the lumping misses, no data supply.”
相合: 「原文所说的结构，脊柱上有已检查之律与之结构相同。相合不是印证」; 定域 and 相分 defined beside it.
A law with content “can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses”, through a stated correspondence.

“Read as a correspondence, a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict”; reward, training, natural selection, prices and votes as one selection through couplings: “the laws proved; one law across domains conjectured (T3)”.
理: “a lumping that models structure and change at once: one the step goes alike across”.

account_adds.en: Structural readings fail often: of 88 entries a reviser kept, a second checker corrected 84, and two reads are held unreliable (06 §7.1; the ratio not extended beyond them).

source_adds.en: The promise that a person's present problem has a structural ancestor; an index of human problems; seven method relations; confidence on links.

name.en: Reinvention as a retrieval failure of how history is stored

source.locator: What is actually broken; Claims 20, 24-25; Found by reading item 24

sense.en: Movements, products and inventions keep reinventing the wheel, not from laziness but because encyclopedias and museums store inventions as results, not as problem-solving. The corrective is an index change, intervening before action. The README adds that the mis-shaping may be incentivized.

correspondences.quote: it is a retrieval failure caused by an indexing decision

reading.en: Proposed here: the retrieval half is read as having a law's form under another name. An index is a map; what matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off it, and a selection through the map selects what matters only there. If what matters is the problem and the store lumps by result, retrieval cannot reach it: this reading's application, near-definitional. No live text speaks of reinvention or its cause; nearest is the account's verdict that its own central results restate known ones.

says.en: Any type; alternatives' equality decided: “What matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there.” Which map is right, and what matters, are supplied.

Any process: “An exact summary of feasibility cannot identify two configurations that differ on some finite word”; “the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget.”
Following theorem, any type: “a recorder of bounded size does not keep its whole history and go on.” Reading [AI reading, D65]: “Learners, archives and genomes are such recorders.”

“An AI review found none of the central results new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated, and the premise ledger is new only as an artefact”; “the search was not exhaustive”; a column lists “what the closest prior frameworks state that the account does not yet”.

account_adds.en: An exact condition, not a preference for one index: a store serves a selection exactly where what it must find is read off how it lumps. So the corrective holds only for what the new index separates, and a store of bounded size still merges something. The charge also falls on the account, which lists what prior frameworks state that it does not yet.

source_adds.en: That people do reinvent, and this as the cause; how encyclopedias and museums store inventions; re-indexing as the corrective; the incentive to mis-shape; that a problem, and not a result, is what a seeker needs. None is stated live; the repository's search-before-claiming duty is process.

name.en: The eighth module: a method to borrow, adapt or avoid

source.locator: The eighth module is not history; Claims 39, 67, 69, 84

sense.en: The most important part of each exhibit is not history but a method a present actor can borrow, adapt or avoid, written as an action rule and not a slogan. What a user saves is the method, not the exhibit.

correspondences.quote: 用户可以收藏的不是展品，而是方法

reading.en: Proposed here: borrowing from a case is read as generalizing through a lumping: right where the world agrees at both cases, free where nothing fixes it, and two readers agreeing on every read occasion can part at an untied one. The exits match in format: conditional moves, each with its edge, from models and not from history. One periphery construction installs a method by a tested round and fails with a changed context. No live text addresses an actor's use of a historical case.

says.en: Any type: “a member fitting the world is right at x exactly where the world agrees at x and the lumped observation; the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input”.

Any type, near-definitional: where no read occasion is tied by the lumping, every value there is taken by a selected law agreeing on every reading. Reading [AI reading, new]: “two reporters agreeing on every supervised occasion are selected alike”.

A table of exits, each law with model, hypotheses and edge. “Every capture theorem here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise.” What it does not show: “That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system.”

Periphery, everything from task to compliance supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; “missing response or revision, early departure, changed context and untested admission fail.”

account_adds.en: Each exit states where it stops working, including when its window closes.

source_adds.en: That a method a present actor can use is the most important part of an exhibit: methods extracted from historical cases, written for an actor, and the toolbox that carries them.

name.en: The conversion move: a problem turned into a usable tool

source.locator: Claims 28, 35, 46, 56; The eighth module is not history; The gap between the two collections

sense.en: Tangible objects count because they converted a class of human problem into a more tractable, transmissible, usable form. The condom's significance is one move: a problem spanning body, desire, disease, shame and public health became a low-cost, portable, replicable, self-usable tool. One archetype says grand, unregulatable problems must become tools ordinary people can use. The README names these conversion moves, as against regulation moves.

correspondences.quote: 它们把某类人类问题转化成了更可处理、更可传播、更可使用的形式

reading.en: Proposed here: read as a performer (this read's), a tool has one exact form: what each delivery restores. Then what grows is what can be done with the performer held, only across changes of the performer, while the whole possible never grows; so a tool moves what can be done with it, and that it advances anything is not carried. Low-cost replication has a count: copying runs exactly where the stock covers each round's draw. Neither reads tractable, usable or a problem.

says.en: Any process, each law near-definitional or a witness: a region of the performing part's states performs a task where, from each input, the process “reaches an output with the part in the region again”. “A delivery adds nothing to the whole possible”. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “What grows is what can be done with the performer held, and only across changes of the performer.”

Counts: “Where every unit draws *d* from one stock and becomes *b*, *n* rounds from *k* units run exactly where the stock covers” the rounds' total draw. “that teaching or reproduction copies at a fixed factor is not shown”.

account_adds.en: What a tool delivers and what it widens come apart: on the catalytic cycle a delivery narrows the whole possible, and widening follows deliveries in neither direction.

source_adds.en: The move as what gives an invention its significance; tractability, portability and self-use; a bundle of problems converted at once; the archetype's 'must'; the other relations of that kind (risk transfer, rights redefinition).

name.en: The condom rule: tools for what regulation cannot enter

source.locator: Claims 45-47; The eighth module is not history

sense.en: If a problem occurs in highly private, shameful, dispersed, hard-to-regulate settings, the solution must be low-cost, private, autonomously usable, and must not require people first to change into their ideal selves. It comes from reading the condom as converting a bundle of problems into a portable tool.

correspondences.quote: 如果一个问题发生在高度私人、羞耻、分散、难以监管的场景里

reading.en: The account does not state it. A form could be proposed and is not stated: a hard-to-regulate setting as lying beyond what couples into a regulating selector, though within a member's closure, so a tool moves selection to one that does couple in. Only that premise has a law, near-definitional. 'Must', cost, privacy, autonomy and shame have no counterpart, whether a case meets the premise is empirical, and the rule rests on one case.

source_adds.en: The design rule itself, drawn from one case, as the README's own critique of over-abstraction says; the bundle reading of the condom; shame and dispersal as conditions.

searched: private, privacy, portable, low-cost, autonom, self-use, regulat across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary (hits are unrelated, such as a private signal, or regulation of a level)
shame, 羞耻, stigma, taboo (no hits in the overview, chapters, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, ALIGNMENT, SCIENCES or glossary)

name.en: Good tools do not ask people to become nobler first

source.locator: Claim 48; The eighth module is not history; Found by reading item 15

sense.en: Good civilizational tools usually do not demand that people first become nobler; they offer a better option within real human nature, situations and limits. Design for the humans that exist. The README warns that, unamended, this licenses products that meet people where they are and keep them there.

correspondences.quote: 好的文明工具，往往不是要求人先变得更高尚

reading.en: A proposal, with no form in the account: the nearest live sentence, kept promises and enforced contracts as 'laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone', sets an act law against a configuration, not institutions against character, and a nobler disposition would change the law too. Where the rest outruns the renewal one member's restraint decides nothing, but that is one member against the rest, not people at large. 'Good' and 'better' take an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

account_adds.en: What a tool's success reads and what it cannot, as a question of couplings and not of its designer's aim: the form the README's worry about products that keep people where they are would have, if such success is a selection through what couples in.

source_adds.en: An anti-perfectionist stance about human nature and how to design for it; a better option offered within limits. A search for human nature, 人性, virtue, nobler and ideal self found no live statement of it.

searched: human nature, 人性, virtue, nobler, moral improvement, perfectionis, 'as they are' over ONE-PAGE, THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING, chapters, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, ONE-ARGUMENT, GLOSSARY and review (this read); ideal self (the earlier read)
read: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 Exits and §3 What the laws rule out

name.en: Personal failure that a public institution must carry

source.locator: Claim 35; Claim 71 (accessible design); The shape of a civilizational advance; Relations (relational-self-and-datong)

sense.en: One insight archetype: some problems treated as personal failure actually require a public institution to carry them (public health, libraries, accessible design). The 'individual defect' is rewritten as a problem of design or of the public system.

correspondences.quote: 某些被认为是个人失败的问题，其实需要公共制度来承接

reading.en: Part has a form: admission is read on conditions and requirements together, not on the formation alone; a loss can be made only jointly, the but-for holding for no single part; where the rest outruns the renewal, formations end whatever a member outside it takes; an AI reading tells a fault in organized relations from informed harm. So a loss need not be any one part's. 'Must carry' comes only under an order meeting C and J1–J4 with the continuation condition, and fixes no carrier.

says.en: “A course *admits* the formations (what takes and gives) whose conditions meet their requirements.” At the root, “intention and foresight have a place in responsibility, and none has been shown to bound whose losses count”.
Any process, withholding a supplied map: “a law states exactly when parts make a difference only together” (record), which “Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking.”
World, gate local: “every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least `m` ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes”.
Reading after it [AI reading, D65]: “Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm”.

Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence): it can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; “It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority”.

account_adds.en: A statement of which part made a difference, by a supplied withholding map, with no blame in it; and overbuilding that depletes the living basis as the conditional result's counterexample.

source_adds.en: A public institution as the carrier, and the institutional cases; shame and moralization as what hides the structure. The account's institution model has no such role.

name.en: The multicellular organism as a system that eliminated the pattern

source.locator: Claim 2; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 1

sense.en: The first named exception to the runaway dynamic: the multicellular organism, treated as a system, 'successfully eliminated this pattern', and one should ask why and how. Asked in a chat turn, as a question with a premise.

correspondences.quote: multicellular organism, if treated as a system, successfully eliminated this pattern, can you explain why and how

reading.en: The case has a checked form: a rise confined to a whole ends with it, whatever selection within raised, and where next founders carry their founder's value, selection among wholes decides. So 'eliminated' narrows: the rise within is bounded by named clauses, not removed. Sequestering is a hypothesis 'stating an outcome, not a mechanism', so the source's 'how' stays open. 'Successfully' reads from the whole's side: under the condition, ending a cancer is read as mixed. Known results restated.

says.en: “A lineage confined to a whole's conditions in excess has no member once they end, whatever selection within raised” (record); sequestering is “a hypothesis stating an outcome, not a mechanism”; “that a given tumour meets the clauses, or a germ line is sequestered, is empirical”. Not shown: “How parts first come to live as one” (record).

“Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]”; “Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing”. Under the continuation condition, which ranks nothing; a ranking takes an order a result names.

account_adds.en: In a witness a lineage depending on a condition outside the body still has a member a cohort after the end; without sequestering, a variant selected within lowers the founding value. Neither is called better: a ranking is under an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

source_adds.en: That the organism eliminated the pattern, as a success, and the explanation why and how, including the policing the account leaves unstated: apoptosis appears only as a mixed case.

name.en: The research question: which systems resisted, and what the museum dropped of it

source.locator: Claims 2-3; The older question underneath; The gap between the two collections; What was lost item 1

sense.en: The method: generalize the failure dynamic, enumerate the exceptions, extract what they share; hunter-gatherer bands and others are later candidates. The README's AI reading: the museum kept this format and dropped its subject. Conversion and regulation are different shapes, and no module asks what kept a mechanism from capture or what happened when it was captured.

correspondences.quote: these are conversion moves, not regulation moves

reading.en: The account takes up the regulation side the museum dropped: loops that lock, named exits, routes of correction taken over. Its nearest answer to 'what they share' is an AI reading of nine constraints of social viability as laws, 'not survival axioms', with 'regulation and passing are supplied'. It gets them from models, not exceptions, says 'No guarantee', and shows none of an actual collective. 'Worked' and 'resisted' read nothing until a comparison is named.

says.en: “**No guarantee.**” “**exits** from the loops that lock a collective, each holding under stated hypotheses”; achievable “Yes, for named exits”, “none shown to hold of an actual collective”.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: “The constraints an account of social viability lists are read as theorems of what a course does under stated hypotheses”; nine rows. Limits: “regulation and passing are supplied”. “The constraints are not survival axioms.” “Term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule”.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: “A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves”. “That readers are minds is a reading; what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.”

“**Institutions and people.** One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits”; “no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses”; “no test of a thesis run so far has human participants.”

account_adds.en: Windows: a reading of what lies beyond the share counts only while its readers are not yet the fewer [AI reading, D67]. What comes back to shapers alone decides, at a step, whether control over the rule is selected (counts models).

source_adds.en: A comparative collection of exceptions and what they share, the question itself; hunter-gatherer bands, which a search does not find; conversion moves; a state for what worked and was destroyed.

name.en: Value systems as regulators; equality as stability

source.locator: Claim 4; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 3

sense.en: Historical societies held value systems that kept selfishness from compounding beyond regulatory control, which is why they lasted or held equilibrium. This, and not morality, is the root reason equality is needed.

correspondences.quote: This is the root cause we need equality

reading.en: Nearest forms, none about value systems: a reading against the share stops the rise a lock rests on; two-sided regulation settles a level within a bound; a rule held by members can be the wrong rule. 06 reads 荀子's limit on wants by the joint-excess law. Why societies lasted is not addressed. Equality is not derived as stability: in counts, what comes to every member alike pulls the rule toward even and does not decide whether it favours the shapers. The account nowhere says equality is needed.

says.en: Any type: with the reading against the share, “the rise the lock rests on does not form”.
World: “within it, opposing, the level settles at `m`; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever”.

Counts: “At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike”; “a larger `p` pulls the rule toward even”; “With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step”. Reading [D45]: “Whether actual institutions or trained systems meet these premises is not established.”

Any type, on a formation’s level: “a transform strictly concave up to a bound ranks higher moving one step of continuation”, of continuation and not holdings, under a graded significance. Not a reason of stability; the ranking is the graded premise’s.

Reading [AI reading, new]: “neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides: a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 荀子「求而无度量分界，则不能不争」与「两者相持而长」，是合取超取之律及其逆，界放在欲与物的关系上.

“no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.” 'A ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them'.

account_adds.en: Positions sum to zero, so a rise needs a fall (05 §3): conflict stays real and no rule removes it. A regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads [AI reading].

source_adds.en: The historical explanation of longevity; value systems rather than entry rules or count models as the regulator; equality as a stability reason. The one law on equal shares (least-parts-and-equal-shares) concerns meeting needs, not stability.

name.en: Traditions as social technology, with structural advantage

source.locator: Claims 6, 8; Terms: social technology; In Ren's own words 6, 8-9

sense.en: Confucianism is an excellent cognitive framework, a social technology, judged from cognitive and neural science, and classical Chinese narratives have clear structural, not merely moral, advantages against being consumed by Moloch. Are there others of that calibre? The README says the museum's own collection dropped this category.

correspondences.quote: 还有其他同样优秀的social technology吗

reading.en: 06 reads such texts passage by passage against the spine, 50 of them Confucian, as agreement, scope or divergence, and credits no tradition with an advantage or a calibre; the first page says they name the grammar's terms, not its operations. 'Excellent' and 'advantage' would have to say what compares, among what. Its gaps table draws forms from both sides: 二柄 and 壹 for capture through the rule; 天之道, 宽猛相济 and 中和 for two-sided regulation. Forms read, not credit of efficacy.

says.en: “the classical texts name the grammar's terms, not its operations”; every reading on the page “of what a law means for a case, a word or an actual system is AI's unless its home says otherwise”.
Assessment [AI reading, D54]: 248 passages each classed; 儒家 50, of them 17 相合, 21 定域, 12 相分. Limit: selection favours passages with structure to read, so 礼的细节 and others 「最可能进一步相分，表中段数低估了它们」.
Gaps named by passages and since proved: 经由规则的捕获, from 韩非“二柄”, 管子“据有余而制不足”, 商君书“壹”; 一个水平的双向调节，及迟到读法下的调节, from 老子“天之道”, 左传“宽猛相济”, 中庸“中和”.

account_adds.en: Four non-relational layers recur in the texts, each answered inside the same tradition (06 §六); a Confucian critic's 以理杀人 is read as a model applied where others' differences do not couple in.

source_adds.en: Tradition as engineered technology; a comparative judgement of calibre; a cognitive-science warrant; resistance to Moloch, a word the live account does not use.

name.en: A tradition's high point and degenerate mode coexist

source.locator: Claim 7; In Ren's own words 5; Genealogy 2026-03

sense.en: A high point and a degenerate mode of one tradition coexist: Confucian logic also became the value and pursuit of those who held or sought power, especially in prosperous periods. The README reads this as the anti-sanctification rule applied to a social technology.

correspondences.quote: 中国你说的高光时刻和退化模式是同时存在的

reading.en: The account does not state it: nothing on a tradition's high point and degenerate mode, or on Confucian logic becoming power's value. A proposal, kept: a counter-rule read from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did, and 07 reads the imperial examination so (D68, the earlier work's example, so by descent). A tradition turning so would have that form only if its reading comes from its carriers' share. The law gives a lock, not a coexistence. The source's 退化 is a valuation, not the glossary's degeneration; 'high' and 'degenerate' would have to say what compares.

source_adds.en: The historical claim about Confucian logic and prosperity, and the coexistence of the high and the degenerate in one tradition.

name.en: Halakha read as decentralized coordination engineering

source.locator: Claim 9; In Ren's own words 10 (brought forward and endorsed, the README notes)

sense.en: Talmud/Halakha is, from an engineering perspective, possibly the most successful decentralized coordination system in history: dissent preserved, micro-behaviour normed, no territory and no army. A passage brought forward and endorsed in a chat, not authored there; a claim about what it achieved, not a study.

correspondences.quote: 从工程角度看这可能是人类历史上最成功的去中心化协调系统

reading.en: Proposed here: three features have forms, none about this tradition, of which the account says nothing and this reader knows little. No centre: valid local plans under faithful projections pair into a valid joint plan, from a supported start. Kept dissent: a pool adds exactly the differences members hold, an imposed code loses them; a resolution rests later cohorts only where records offer what was resolved (dissent kept falls outside: this reading's). No army: consent and penalty are one witness until removal is in the net. 'Most successful' names nothing it reads.

says.en: Any process, periphery module: “With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans”, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, “the paired finite plan is valid”; in the exchange witness “ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present” (near-definitional).
Reading [AI reading, D54] of 和而不同: 「成员有清单、各自之耦合可判定时，池所增加的恰是差别，相同者合用什么也不增加」.

targets.part: Reading D54 of 和而不同

says.en: Any type: “An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges”. “A resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on”, records written to offer exactly what was resolved.

Root, a family of models: a rule of entry passed through members, “with no compliance and no records”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Reading [AI reading, D69]: “An institution kept by its members' consent and one held by penalties” are one witness read socially, “told apart once their removal is in the net”. “not a new law”.

account_adds.en: A test of what no army would mean: keep and penalty are told apart only when removal enters the net. Being joined through couplings does not suffice for agreement.

source_adds.en: The reading of Talmud/Halakha itself; norming of micro-behaviour; the comparative superlative. The one institution model leaves out the compliance, sanctions and records the source's case turns on. The words Talmud, Halakha and 塔木德 do not appear in the live account.

name.en: The 奏折 as a zero-trust protocol

source.locator: Claims 12-13; In Ren's own words 13-14, 16 (endorsed)

sense.en: The 奏折 is a formatted protocol and the object of study is the whole bureaucratic system: in a low-bandwidth, high-latency, zero-trust setting, minimal metadata plus structured language gave accurate, private, auditable two-way communication.

correspondences.quote: 在一个低带宽、高延迟、零信任的环境里

reading.en: Neither the object nor a format's engineering appears: no metadata or structured language as what makes a report accurate, private or auditable, and no such historical institution. The question beneath it, information upward, has partial forms, and so does a limit on audit, both in cx-hsm-information-upward. 05 §12 models no records.

source_adds.en: The reading of a historical institution as protocol engineering, the claim about what that protocol achieved, and the bureaucratic system as the object.
