name.en: Claim strength exceeded proof strength

source.locator: The third track, last paragraph; claims 284, 292

sense.en: The revision notes say what was shown (R-Family can express many systems) and what was claimed (all must be so expressed). They replace 'is' with 'can be articulated as', 'forced' with 'motivated', and end: 定理已立，证责已明. The folder calls this the corpus's strongest sign of health.

correspondences.quote: Claim strength exceeded proof strength.

reading.en: The account makes this its own method, stricter than the note: every result carries a label saying how far it has been seen, what Lean proves is said exactly, and readings stay marked. Same discipline, no descent shown; 08 applies it to the account's own results. The folder's own Lean compiled nowhere; this account's does.

says.en: 「Lean 检查的是所给的推导，不判定古人的定义之意」. Each classification row is an AI reconstruction, no person's review of it recorded. The chapter's opening marks every result as definition, theorem by base, assessment, reading or open.
The verdict, from an AI review whose search was not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics.

account_adds.en: Checked proof, and a verdict on itself.

source_adds.en: The diagnosis itself, of which the account says nothing since it does not name R-Family; the itemized corrections to R-Family, the vocabulary substitution table, Z-Principle against Z-Conjecture, and the nine proof obligations.

name.en: One primitive, 間 then 系 then 一, whose content is that it contains itself

source.locator: One primitive, and why the number is one; claims 59-73; own words 32-36

sense.en: Several relational primitives presuppose one another, which 'proves' they are perspectives on one. Hence one primitive: 間 (v0.3-v0.8), 系 (v0.9), finally 一 identified with system. 系含系 is definitional, formally W-types, V_α and μX.F(X). Being definitional, it needs no creation verb.

correspondences.quote: 系含系 — recursion is the definitional content of 系, not an operator applied to it

reading.en: 'One' stands as one kind of symbol, 际, a two-place relation on a carrier, nearest to the folder's own counterfactual of 际 as Layer 1 (claim 72), though its 际 had any arity; 06 names the 間 primitive among what the grammar replaced. Self-containment is not claimed or denied: the carrier is a parameter. 无环, nothing reaching itself, is a hypothesis a net may meet, not well-foundedness: an infinite descent has no cycle. 一 survives as the full relation, not a root.

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences. Definition: «际» α := α → α → Prop. The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations. Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model. Without cycles is a condition a net may meet.
Self-changing conditions: a rule that changes by a fixed law is stated in the grammar by taking the rule into the occurrence, the carrier being a parameter.
The explanatory reading is a thesis, argued. What it forbids: as a language, nothing; any carrier, relation and class will do. As an explanation, no observation.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「早期以文言为形式语言之方案（九虚词为核、实词按位定型、一原始之“間”）已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」.

account_adds.en: An explicit statement that the one-symbol language has no empirical bite on its own.

source_adds.en: 系含系 and its W-type identification, the choice among 間, 系 and 一 with the ma image, and the circularity argument as proof.

name.en: Things manifest in 間, and 間 is constituted in their relations

source.locator: The second track; claims 169, 176-177

sense.en: One sentence is the whole system. No actor exists outside a 間, since existence is relational; no single-actor 間 exists, since relation needs two ends; co-being is the default and solitude derived. A cosmic 間 gathers all as the coherence pattern 理, not a super-container.

correspondences.quote: 事物在间中显现，间在事物的关系中成立

reading.en: The account holds the relation-first form as an argued thesis, shown for what is represented, and says it does not show reality has no independent entity. It keeps 'a pair is the least split, not the least relation'. It differs on claim 177: the grammar does not assume that nothing conditions itself, so a one-ended relation is admitted. No cosmic 間.

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued). There is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. Configurations, laws and parts, as represented, need no determination beyond relations; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.

targets.part: the thesis as stated, with its close: argued, not proved; neither shows that reality has none

says.en: Theorem (any type). Describing two parts separately gives back the whole exactly where the whole is rectangular. Reading [AI, D33]: two are a pair by relation; a pair is the least split, not the least relation.
「文法不设不自缘：自缘者在每一类下皆住（`«自缘则常»`）」.

account_adds.en: What would defeat the thesis: relata with natures of their own, or what an experience is like. Equality on the carrier is named as its nearest case.

source_adds.en: The strong existence claim (no 間, no existence), relation needing two ends, the cosmic 間, 間/事/機 as three faces.

name.en: Monism is chosen, and every formalism is a finger pointing at the moon

sense.en: Each primitive is a convention, each axiom a choice, each idiom a tool. A framework is judged by 功用, not 真值. Monism cannot be proved; its warrant is how many deep problems it handles. 一元 is not cardinality: the differentia among monisms is which root. Taking 际 as Layer 1 instead would build a similar ontology.

correspondences.quote: Monism cannot be proved, only chosen

reading.en: Agreement on status, not on the act: the source chooses, the account argues. The one-unfolding thesis is argued, not proved, and by the section's measure has no strength against observation. Against a rival it may tie, and a tie leaves the word adding nothing. Laws differ: 功用 does not replace 真值 where a proof claim is checked in Lean. Modelling choices are named as choices, near own words 43 on axiom against design choice.

says.en: 「By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation」, and that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.

targets.part: how far the thesis has been seen, by the section's measure

says.en: 「A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing.」

account_adds.en: Named live arguments that could defeat the thesis, and its nearest internal case.

source_adds.en: 功用 over 真值 as the general criterion of a framework; which root as what tells monisms apart (claim 74); 一生万物即是真理，乃多元 as a truth claim about pluralism.

name.en: All frames cross-applicable: the one ultimate claim

source.locator: Claims 118-119; own words 44

sense.en: Ren's statement of the framework's one ultimate claim: truth is universal, frames are articulations, and all articulations are cross-applicable, derivations transferable, so the 理 derived in any frame applies in the others. A second-order question follows on regularity between frames.

correspondences.quote: 所有 articulations cross-applicable

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins these to the folder's claim. A lumping carries a law exactly where the law goes alike across it, and which one carries depends on the law: 錯綜 classes carry 互, not 消息. Each model's shared law is proved from the grammar's. What contexts show glues only where contexts agree, and some worlds glue nowhere; those frames are of claims, not the folder's articulations. Transfer runs along a carrying map, not between any two.

says.en: 一种归并承载一律，恰当此律在其上同行. 「哪一种归并承载律，依律而定，所失较多的归并有时反而承载」.
Theorem (root). The five shared laws hold for every carrier and relation, and 「each model's law is proved from the grammar's in its own module」.
Open: 「That every becoming, and the whole theory, has a faithful representation in the grammar.」 The World's is not faithful on its amounts.
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context). A frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere. Some worlds glue nowhere: Specker's three boxes, the Mermin-Peres square.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for a law to pass through a map, and witnesses where no common frame exists.

source_adds.en: Truth as universal across frames, cross-applicability of all articulations as a claim, and the open question of regularity in the transformations between frames.

name.en: A locus is exhausted by its relations: Yoneda in 文言

source.locator: Claims 80, 147

sense.en: 位 is a position with no intrinsic essence: a locus is what it is entirely by the totality of its 际. The text calls this the Yoneda lemma stated in 文言 and refuses to soften it: not a metaphor, the same structure.

correspondences.quote: 凡位之是其位，由其际之凡然定

reading.en: The mechanism is bisimulation and the two-way core, not Yoneda: configurations matching step for step are alike, and a position under the two-way core is fixed by its relations before and after. As represented, a configuration is how it relates. The account gives where this stops: telling occurrences alike in every relation apart takes equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model, not a finding.

says.en: Theorem (any process). Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike. Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move (`identifiesAlike_id_iff`).

Definition: the core read both ways (位核). Theorem (root): what shares a position under the two-way core shares beginning, abiding and ending. 「A position is fixed by all its relations, before as well as after.」
「a configuration is how it relates」 (`identifiesAlike_iff`), as represented.
Time and the four positions 「tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model」.

account_adds.en: The witnessed exceptions: twins, a past no claim tells apart, equality as a commitment of the model.

source_adds.en: The identification with Yoneda and the category-theory reading; the word Yoneda is not in the live account.

name.en: 位⟷际 and 化⟷理 span the ontology, minimum-complete

source.locator: Two duals; claims 79-85

sense.en: Four names, mutually defining but not reducible, span everything: 位/际 lacks time, 化/理 lacks sites. 化 is a trajectory and 理 its time-invariant attractor, one phenomenon under two views. `term : type` is `化 : 理`. The interdefinition is admitted to be slightly circular.

correspondences.quote: Two duals jointly span the ontology

reading.en: The characters stay and their senses move. 化 becomes alteration under a class, its live sense read from 「化，徵易也」 and 荀子, not the folder's trajectory; 理 becomes a lumping the step goes alike across; the root's marks are beginning, abiding, altering and ending. 06 says the older 理 and the live 理 are not one sense. A likeness remains: 理 models structure and change as one notion.

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「“理”在语料之化／理对偶中是轨迹之不变量，与本理论“建模结构与变化之律”二义不并。」
「“化”在本章只有一义，即 Lean 之 `«化»`：`y` 在物之类下续 `x`，而另一类分开二者；它就是文法之异」. 「化，徵易也」（墨经）.
理, the modeling of the laws of structure and change, is one notion, because a model of change is a lumping the step goes alike across, which is a model of structure.

account_adds.en: Theorems of 理 under named premises: where the successor is fixed the core is a 理, and with a successor everywhere the coarsest.

source_adds.en: The minimum-completeness argument, and the attractor reading of 理.

name.en: 势 as the derivative of change, natively a gradient

source.locator: Claims 94, 130

sense.en: 势 is d化/d时, whose shape is 理(化), so at once differential and structural. 孙子's 转圆石于千仞之山者，势也 corresponds to the modern gradient natively, not metaphorically.

correspondences.quote: 势 ≡ d化/d时

reading.en: The 中华本's name table, in history and reported by 06, takes 勢 as a basin: courses that meet, each basin holding one cycle. That keeps the folder's alias 'attractor' and drops its identity with a rate of change. It is a discrete structure of a determined law, and a name-table sense with no declaration in the grammar. No live text claims the gradient identity.

says.en: 「勢在名表是吸引之域，度是给诸选项之数，二者在文法中尚无声明。」
Theorem (any type). Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin; each basin holds one cycle.

account_adds.en: Basin laws on listed configurations, with a bound on entry.

source_adds.en: 势 as a rate of change, and the priority claim for 孙子.

name.en: 几工程: detect the small rising attractor before the threshold

source.locator: The domain sweep; claims 132-133

sense.en: Observe the spectrum of 势, find small but rising attractors and intervene before manifestation. This is early-warning detection plus pre-emption, stated by 中医's 治未病 long before the modern literature, against the Western break-alert-fix model.

correspondences.quote: 几工程 (incipience engineering) is the distinctive Eastern engineering signature

reading.en: The account takes up both halves. Detection is thesis T6: a break is seen coming only through what couples into what breaks; warning statistics read a condition's own return rate, not a dependent's need. Intervention is the juncture laws: a choice matters only at a juncture, and to turn a reader there a source must reach it before. 06 sets 知几其神乎 and 为之于未有 beside them. 其未兆易谋 is scoped. A civilization's signature is not taken up.

says.en: Theorem (any process; every configuration listed, steps decided, `s` returning). At a configuration with a step keeping `s` that is no juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it: 「a choice matters only at a juncture」.
Theorem (World, with a process; premises stated there). 「to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must reach it before」. Finding the reaching outright needs reaching decided.
Table rows: 机之前后 | 系辞「知几其神乎」；孙子「其勢險，其節短」；韩非扁鹊; 为之于未有 | 苏辙注老子「為之于未有者上也」 | 机之前到达之来源.

Thesis T6. Invisible half proved on the World model; seen half periphery (linearized and logistic models); that the split is one law across domains is conjectured. Three frozen seabird tests did not reject it, none establishing conditional independence.

Theorem (periphery, Mathlib; discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest): a rises to one as the margin shrinks at a fold, so the margin to a condition's own end couples into its fluctuations. A dependent's need enters neither statistic.
Reading [AI, D54]: “其安易持，其未兆易谋”定域：对每一过程找出每一失去之机即给出 LPO，「所以易于改变者难于发现，除非读其耦合」.

account_adds.en: Theorems of what can and cannot be detected and when a move can count, each under its premises, and a stated way to refute the thesis.

source_adds.en: Pre-emption as a design signature, a spectrum of 势, 治未病 as early-warning theory (no live occurrence), and the priority claim.

name.en: Time is not a second primitive

source.locator: Claim 70

sense.en: Inside a 系, one process is conventionally designated the standard (sundial, oscillation, heartbeat) and others measure pace against it. That designated process is 时: a coinductive stream and a Lamport clock, not Newton's t. This lets two duals, not three, span the ontology.

correspondences.quote: 时 is not a parallel primitive but a periodic anchoring inside 系

reading.en: Shared: time is no second primitive. The mechanism differs: the order is the reach of the condition relation, strict only where no cycle holds. Nothing live makes a designated periodic process what time is; clocks occur only as a model's named laws. The nearest is 'rates being relative to the reading's unit': idle steps inserted leave the laws of one step, totals, counts and recurrence unchanged.

says.en: 「Nor is a time: its order is the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle」.

With equality of relata decided and each relatum listed once at each step, a world read through a supplied stuttering, idle steps inserted, meets each premise exactly where the world does; the laws of one step, the totals over a stretch, the counts of arising and ceasing (activity decided) and recurrence are unchanged.

account_adds.en: Reach is a strict order exactly without cycles, a hypothesis a net may meet, and feedback is read as a line returning to a class.

source_adds.en: The conventionally designated clock as what 时 is, the coinductive stream, and the Lamport identification.

name.en: History is a DAG with no canonical linearization

sense.en: In the Jian Calculus any linear order of events is a topological sort, a projection. Two observers can disagree about which of two events came first and both be right. No privileged current exists; causal order is reliable and linear time order is not.

correspondences.quote: Prehension makes history a DAG, not a timeline

reading.en: The mechanism has a checked form on causal-set growth: births of unrelated elements commute, and only they, an instance of the core's theorem of Mazurkiewicz, and no order of birth of unrelated elements is common to all courses. With a footprint given, a World stretch's reorderings are such courses. These are courses, not observers disagreeing. A definite global causal order at every interface is listed as not assumed.

says.en: Theorem (causal-set growth, and witnesses). Natural labellings are exactly the orders of birth; births of unrelated elements commute, and only they (an instance of the core's theorem of Mazurkiewicz); with precedence weakly decided, no order of birth of unrelated elements is common to all courses (`Presence.either_order`). Labels carrying no physical meaning is a premise of the model.

With a given footprint containing the exchanges, the exchanges of a finite stretch from the first step form a causal set under the order of joined exchanges, and a renumbering of the stretch is the numbering of some reordering exactly where it numbers them by a course of causal-set growth.
Not assumed: 「a definite global causal order at every interface」.

account_adds.en: Each reading of 'present' answered exactly, with the decision principle each needs.

source_adds.en: Two observers disagreeing and both right; prehension as content-carrying; the audit-free reconstruction of a decision; the claim as an engineering commitment.

name.en: Events are the truth and state is derived

sense.en: Changing state does not exist ontologically: only a new event occurs and derived state changes. Caveat, visibility, legitimacy and boundary are predicates over configurations, never stored. Event sourcing is an ontological commitment, and a reification error is near impossible to repair. State and event are two registers of one reality (動靜不二).

correspondences.quote: Events are the source of truth and state is a cache

reading.en: A general form stands: states and law can be read off a course of values, two moments alike where everything after them agrees. And the grammar's relation holds between occurrences; what comes round is the class; states as occurrences are one model's choice; 静 is the change that stays in place, near claim 181. It gives no rule against storing and no ontological claim about events.

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law read through a map; no premise). Every history of values is a determined law read through a map, two moments alike exactly where everything after them agrees.
A relation between occurrences; 静, identity, 「the change that stays in place」. 「What comes round is the class」. 「Where a model takes states as its occurrences」 is one case.
Assessment: 「两个时刻自此起逐步之值皆同，即是一状……所以文不须先给状，也不须文外的立法者。」

account_adds.en: The exact criterion, with a list needed to name the classes.

source_adds.en: Event sourcing as an ontological commitment, the derived-not-stored rule as a design law, and the default against reifying.

name.en: No view from outside: every observer's view is partial

sense.en: A configuration holds no global state. An observer's view is always a strict subset; bisimulation is relativized and does not transfer between observers. Any monitor is itself a 間 observing from its own place, and the same message is information in one 間 and not in another.

correspondences.quote: bisimulation is relativized and does **not** transfer across observers

reading.en: Stated in form: knowing is within the unfolding; what a formation can select is bounded by its couplings; histories alike through one may differ through another; a pool separates what some member separates. That is relativized likeness, and claim 184's jian-relative information. Not stated: 'always a strict subset'. No law bars a formation from coupling into everything, so the bound is exact, not a fixed shortfall.

says.en: Thesis. 「Knowing is a relation within the unfolding, not a mirror beside it.」

Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap). With a list holding exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories decided, a pooled selection separates them exactly when some member does not couple them alike.

Theorem (any type; each claim within some context). What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere. Some worlds glue nowhere: Specker's three boxes, the Mermin-Peres square.

account_adds.en: Pooling as the exact form of what a second observer adds, and the condition under which a context-free frame exists, with witnesses from quantum contextuality.

source_adds.en: 'Always a strict subset'; relativized bisimulation as a semantics; 'no ambient observer' as a design rule; a 間 as an active detector of what counts as informative.

name.en: Map and territory constitute each other; the map can capture its incompleteness

source.locator: Claims 237-238; loss 40

sense.en: Map ⇄ territory is mutual constitution, fully dual and self-aware, not a map approximating a territory, and deeper than Korzybski. 体 is only ever truncated by some 用, so the map can capture its own incompleteness. The folder lists this among what the conversations hold and the drafts do not.

correspondences.quote: so the map can capture its own incompleteness

reading.en: The account puts knowing inside the unfolding, not beside it. On incompleteness the law is exact and partial: a revising family says its last gap and is incomplete at every step, so it can state each gap, not all. It does not say the two constitute each other, and models stay answerable to tests.

says.en: Thesis. 「Knowing is a relation within the unfolding, not a mirror beside it.」
Reading [AI, D63]: 文理生生把观与证放在模型之外作为元层，「本理论把知放在展开之内」.
Where a map moves every value, completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns.

account_adds.en: How far a map can state its own gaps, as a theorem.

source_adds.en: Mutual constitution as the relation of map and territory; the mediation triangle of 理, 心, 事.

name.en: Always leave an unclassified space outside every metric and type

source.locator: The domain sweep; claim 126; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: 庄子 is the framework's interface to its own limits: 言无言 is the Liar/Russell/Gödel family, 得意忘言 tool-theory, 彼/是 frame-dependence. The engineering consequence is a design rule: always leave an unclassified space outside every metric, type and pattern.

correspondences.quote: always leave an *unclassified* space outside every metric, type and pattern

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins them. A checked law has a like form, and it is a limit, not a norm: where a map moves every value no family of readings within what it reads says every reading, and the liar is a rhythm with no still value. So the outside is not left by choice; it cannot be closed, under that hypothesis. A sequence never revisiting is held by no list. It does not read 庄子 here: 言无言 and 得意忘言 do not occur live.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap. 「The liar is a rhythm with no still value.」 Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.
未: 永不重访的序列不为任何清单所含（`unlisted_of_new`）.

account_adds.en: The diagonal limit as a theorem with its hypothesis.

source_adds.en: The design rule for metrics and types, and the identification with 庄子's 言无言.

name.en: A boundary is the product of a 間's operation; three pathologies

source.locator: The second track; claims 180, 185, 199, 210

sense.en: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition, the implicit shape of its actors' relations: when interaction stops, the 間 dissolves. Health has criteria and three named pathologies, 凝固, 耗散, 自闭. Liveness needs internal activity, self-production and boundary maintenance, and cannot be a stored flag.

correspondences.quote: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition

reading.en: Half stands: a boundary is no given thing placed first. It is given by a region closed under a relation, depends on the relation followed, and a blanket is given with its inside and outside by their readings. The mechanism differs: a region's closure, not the product of a formation's own operation. 04's minimal model is of self-maintenance, not of a boundary, and stops below autopoiesis. How a formation forms its boundary is listed as not shown, and the pathologies are not named.

says.en: Reading [AI, D45, D61]. 「It is given by the region」; a formation's boundary along a relation is a region holding it and closed under the relation; 「Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed」; a blanket is given with inside and outside by their readings, 「what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part in the unfolding」. 「Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary」.

Reading [AI, new]: 「the family's model of an organism, and a minimal one: one constraint, with turnover, regenerated from the flow it regulates, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure, each of which asks more」.
Correspondence: generation as a pattern continuing through the renewal of its parts is close to autopoiesis. Correspondences not proved.

account_adds.en: Which boundaries exist as a function of the relation followed, and how far short of autopoiesis its model stops.

source_adds.en: The boundary as the product of operation, where 01 lists how a formation forms or represents its boundary as not shown; dissolution when interaction stops; 凝固, 耗散, 自闭 as a health taxonomy; 間 themselves as nested autopoiesis; spawn at first interaction.

name.en: AI is relocated: agency is not inside the agent

source.locator: The second track; claim 187

sense.en: An agent's intelligence, agency and understanding are not located inside the agent but are emergent properties of agent, 間, other actors and protocol structure. 間 is not AI added to the actor model; it re-sites AI.

correspondences.quote: AI is relocated

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins these to the claim. The nearest live move relocates alignment, not intelligence: a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, and alignment is first what each one's selections reach, with no ranking read. One law scopes agency: a move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration, and one course does not fix whose it is. Understanding's location is not stated.

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, each coupling by threshold into what it depends on and by level into what it observes.

Theorem (any process). With the laws functions and a configuration of the other side given, the move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration (`partForms_iff`). On a finite stretch with equality of configurations and of moves decided, no policy gives the moves exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied (`no_policy_upto_iff`): 「one course does not fix whose move it is」. Reading [AI, D24]: which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.
Reading [AI, D54]: 同一历程可以被两种“谁的动作”之律所容许，「历程本身不定动作属于谁」.

account_adds.en: What a selection by or of an AI can reach, as laws.

source_adds.en: Intelligence, agency and understanding as located across agent, 間, other actors and protocol.

name.en: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence for monism

source.locator: The domain sweep; claims 83, 107, 110, 131, 138, 148

sense.en: 位/际/化/理 map natively onto category theory, physics, cybernetics, ecology; 墨经's 异 is Shannon's bit, 祖暅 anticipates Cavalieri. Cross-references among viewings are evidence of monism, not redundancy. The folder concedes that cells admit several mappings and that the fit is not bijection.

correspondences.quote: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence, not decoration

reading.en: The account's three relations exclude this inference: a matching structure is not confirmation, law and text are independent. It adds that the same word is neither the same referent nor descent, and rates its own central results as known mathematics. It holds no priority claim. Two AI readings sharing one thread are said not to be independent evidence, of 文理生生 and itself, not of this folder.

says.en: 「相合不是印证：律的成立不靠原文，原文的意义也不由律穷尽。」
Assessment. 读法另有两条界：同语不等于同指，也不等于相承; 每一条目先写原文之义，再写结构之读. 三读是必要的.

The verdict, from an AI review, search not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics; each is near-definitional or a known result restated, and the premise ledger is new only as an artefact.
Reading: 「所以两边的相合是同一线索的两次阅读，不是统计意义上的独立证实」, said of 文理生生 against this theory.

account_adds.en: Counted divergences by domain (19% overall), and the rule that a second checker changes much.

source_adds.en: The twelve-domain operator tours as a programme.

name.en: No domain requires a new primitive; one structure generates the foundations

sense.en: All twelve domains read through the two duals; 系含系 plus Layer 2 generates ZFC, MLTT and ETCS. Bounded: expressive, not proof, completeness; modulo encoding; monism stipulated. A stronger earlier form ('internal limits: 0') was reversed. Ren wants one axiom, everything else a theorem.

correspondences.quote: no domain requires a new Layer-2 primitive

reading.en: The account leaves the universal open and states one failure: processes are represented both ways, the World for its relations and not its amounts. There is no universal minimal concept grammar, only a least reading for a given law and class (said against 文理生生's H3, not this folder). Root laws forbid no relation and take content from hypotheses. On one axiom (claim 75): the empty axiom report concerns logic only; the assumptions lie in modelling commitments.

says.en: Open: 「That every becoming, and the whole theory, has a faithful representation in the grammar.」 Processes' is shown both ways; the World's both ways for its relations and not faithful on its amounts.
「脊柱只有对某一条律、某一个类的最小之读……没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
Bases: every pure-core declaration named has an empty axiom report, 「which concerns logic only; the real assumptions lie in the modelling commitments」.

account_adds.en: A universal stated as open with where it already fails, and a least reading for a given law and class in place of a minimal grammar.

source_adds.en: Mathematics written in 文言, with 数 by von Neumann ordinals, and 'one axiom' as a goal.

name.en: Quantity is a relation: 数是一个集合的关系

source.locator: Claims 54, 97, 149, 295; own words 60-61

sense.en: Number is constructed, never primitive: von Neumann ordinals over 系, ℕ through ℂ. Units are reference events, dates and averages relations, types detected patterns. Ren's own phrase: number is a relation of a set.

correspondences.quote: Quantity is a relation

reading.en: The account has one exact form of this: count as a perfect pairing of units. Balance is represented on the grammar, 'represented and not derived', and near-definitional under the full relation. Beyond that the World's amounts are not read: 08 concedes that no reading of its selected relations gives the count. So a form of the claim holds for equal counts, and stops at amounts until that sort is derived.

says.en: Theorem (root). Balance, represented and not derived: a perfect pairing conserves count (`«守数当且仅当可对»`); under the one a pairing is equal count, so the representation is near-definitional.
Theorem (World; the grammar for its lemmas). The World represented both ways, its amounts not.

「The World's amounts are not: no reading of its selected relations gives the count (`World.standing_not_read`), and balance is represented, not derived」. 「Until that sort is derived from relations, this is conceded there.」

account_adds.en: The exact point of failure, conceded as a case that could defeat the reading.

source_adds.en: The construction of number at every level, and units as reference events.

name.en: Symbols are selected toward a monist attractor

source.locator: The bridge nobody wrote down; claims 111-112, 306

sense.en: Where many groups with different concepts must communicate, surviving symbols are those traceable to a common root: the strongest consensus property and the most robust convergence of a language. Pre-Qin 古文 approximates an ideal 古文. A shared script read across states served as a protocol. Conditional, a conjecture in Ren's speech.

correspondences.quote: the symbols in use are selected toward a monist attractor

reading.en: The account's law of codes gives no such pull on its premises: copying makes no form, the order and start fix what is reached, and a symmetric start never settles unbroken. An order brings every start to agreement where it gives all one origin, but that origin is who was copied, not a concept all derive from. The model does not read traceability to a root, so it neither tests nor refutes this.

says.en: Theorem (any type; premises by row). The start and the order fix the form reached; from a symmetric start a law keeping an exchange and a renaming never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness, a preferred form or an order each breaks one symmetry.
Table row: 在形成之间形成的编码（约定俗成）; 荀子“同则同之”“名无固宜”；止戈之说的写回；书同文; 已证 in 05.

account_adds.en: Imposed codes as a second route: agreement by privileging forms, each formation losing the distinctions merged.

source_adds.en: The monist attractor, the ideal 古文 postulate, and the tribal history of the script.

name.en: Only cooperation reasons: selection on being understood needs 和

source.locator: Claim 113

sense.en: Ren corrects his precondition from egalitarianism to 和 rather than 争. Under contention the self outranks the reasoning and selection runs on winning; only under cooperation does it run on being understood. The folder calls this the missing microfoundation for selection on cognition.

correspondences.quote: 一旦争，则'我对'，我大于理；合作才讲理，斗则讲赢.

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins them. Only a bound stands: a selection can depend on no more than its selector reads, and it is right exactly where what matters is read. That does not make a selector reading the win select the win, since a particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. The source's cause, that contention sets one reading and cooperation another, is no variable in any law, and cooperation itself is not ranked.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 「A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.」

Theorem (any type; for the selection, the alternatives' equality decided). What matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there.

Not shown: any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. 'A ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them'.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for a selection to be right, and capture laws for a rule reading the share it selects.

source_adds.en: 和 against 争 as what decides whether selection runs on being understood or on winning; the self outranking the reasoning. The saying stands in the folder and sources/12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Lineages optimised for 斗 go extinct when the environment shifts

source.locator: Claim 116

sense.en: Lineages evolving in the 斗 direction (male over-optimisation of appearance is the example) are more likely to go extinct at a shift, since such traits are not 生 and adapt poorly. What is recognised as 生, accumulated toward the future, is 理. Conditional.

correspondences.quote: lineages that evolve in the 斗 direction

reading.en: The account separates what the source joins: position is zero-sum by counting, and a race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; those ahead who do not so depend can continue. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise there, not derived. Among groups, one condition shared by all ends all and selects none. Calling what remains 理 or 生 is no law here.

says.en: Theorem. Positions' rises total their falls. 「Position does not protect」: with balance across `n` steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need above the level less `n`, active only while supported, is not active then: 「its position does not enter」; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. 「That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived」.

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws). Where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups. On the World model a member depending at a need of at least `m` on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves no descendant; 「so one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them」.

account_adds.en: The dependence that does the ending, as the variable to read.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim on lineages with its example, and adaptability as what is lost: grep of 04 and 05 for sexual, ornament, peacock, arms race, Red Queen, evolvab and overfit finds nothing; 'adaptab' occurs once in 05, on rules. Those chapters were not read in full for it.

name.en: A relational ontology does not produce coordination failure

source.locator: Claim 191

sense.en: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology its ontology does not produce: substance ontology generates coordination failure in distributed reality, and relational ontology bypasses it structurally.

correspondences.quote: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology 間's ontology does not produce

reading.en: The account denies this on its own premises: starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners and does not remove rivalry. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and who restrains stays contested. Method keeps real losses and conflict in. Calling either a pathology is a comparison someone holds, under a scope and order they name.

says.en: 「Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems」. Reading [AI, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: Positive-sum and conflicting structure together, each with a law.

name.en: 大同 is a mechanism, and 道 exists outside the mind

source.locator: Claims 114-115, 190; own words 54-55

sense.en: From the selection argument: 道 is also a construct but not only one, 道非其他，它存在于心外. 大同 stops being a utopia and becomes a direction in which language and existence automatically manifest toward 理, 善 and 生生不息. Ren marks it as inference ('可能').

correspondences.quote: Therefore 大同 is a mechanism, not a utopia

reading.en: The source gives by dynamics alone a direction toward 理, 善 and 生生不息; in the account the dynamics decide no significance, and a ranking takes the hypotheses a result names, the continuation condition, self-concern or C (06, 道). On 'outside the mind' it partly meets the source: differences nothing reads remain, and the thesis does not show reality has no independent entity. Yet it sets up no formal 道 and derives no 善. 大同 is absent as a word.

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: is it the one complete 道, with 善 derived from generation? 「否：理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词，所表示之动力学与无物有意义、一切皆有意义都相容」; 「生灭变化之外没有应当，也没有凌驾其上的善恶，伦理从延续中生出；排序之果写明其定理所取之假设：延续之条件（谁的损失算数，单凭自身不排序）、自我关切，或广者居上（C）；生命是否会形成自我关切这样的次序，尚未表明」.
「天地之大德曰生」 reads as a comparative commitment, like C, not a theorem [AI reading, D65].
Reading [AI, D54]: 「“心外无事”作为一般主张相分：没有任何东西读取的差别仍在，只是不被带到任何地方」.
「Neither shows that reality has none.」

targets.part: the close: neither shows that reality has none

account_adds.en: Four questions in whether this elucidates 道, answered apart. Readings a ranking names, in place of a mechanism yielding 善.

source_adds.en: Automatic direction toward 善, and 道 as mind-independent. The folder also holds the contrary line of claim 182, that 大同 is no destination.

name.en: 反诛心: no verdict on inferred inner states; 信 is word-deed alignment

source.locator: The ethical constraint; claims 95, 153-158; own words 64-66

sense.en: Only speech and act are third-party observable, so a metric reads those alone, graded, never Boolean, with observation sovereignty and consent-gated body signals. High alignment is coherence, not truth. Low alignment calls for inquiry, not verdict. 信/诚 are infrastructure, not a moral tribunal. Called the project's one concrete ethical safeguard.

correspondences.quote: 反诛心 is a hard constraint

reading.en: The epistemic half stands: acts fix only what they tell apart, and comparisons beyond the shown reach stay unforced. The prohibition does not: root laws forbid no relation, so reading beyond acts is limited, not ill-formed; whether it is wrong is a ranking stating the hypotheses it takes; no law gives it. Observation sovereignty and consent are a holder's rights, where the account starts from relations. Intention is not stated.

says.en: A selection reading a formation's acts goes through what of those acts couples into it, and it fixes of the formation only what they tell apart. Reading it as a training, helper, overseer or court is a reading.
Theorem (root; no premise; near-definitional). Beyond the shown reach no comparison is forced: with no cycle, some strict order according with the choices puts x above y where y does not reach x.
Reading [AI, new]: a law acting alike everywhere can mislead a reader whose readings miss where it is wrong. 「Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.」
Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking 「is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.」
Not assumed: 「independent owners of value」.

account_adds.en: Exactly what choices and readings fix of a formation. 01 lists independent owners of value as not assumed.

source_adds.en: 诛心 as ill-formed; T+E as the only inputs; graded, never Boolean; observation sovereignty; consent-gated body signals; coherence is not truth; inquiry not verdict. Full text in sources/08-jian-wen-language/jian-repo/JIAN_FOUNDATION_NOTE_v1.0.md §IV.5; the SSBX review row A4 reads asking as pooling and declines the later consent form as a rights frame (process, not live).

name.en: The five virtues given a relational ontology: 仁 as 感, 信 as alignment

source.locator: Idioms are library; claims 91-93, 95, 100, 108

sense.en: Layer 3 idioms are reducible but not reduced: 感 is 化 along 际 (仁), 修 is 化 of self (智), 约 a time-locked 理 (义), 礼 the protocol of 际, 信/诚 word-deed alignment. 一以贯之, 忠恕, is called structural unification, not mystical.

correspondences.quote: The five Confucian virtues map onto the framework

reading.en: No definition in its structure: 善, 恶, 智 have no formal predicate, 仁, 义 are names on neither side, 礼, 信, 德 not set up, 感 partial and scoped to what couples in. It does read some, through comparison: 德 as a formed, revisable capacity to respond, 一体之仁 as forming together. 忠恕 has no live occurrence. An evaluation enters as a ranking stating the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C.

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「善、恶、智没有形式谓词」.
不采之字: 仁（带价值）. 「不采不是排斥」: 这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类.
「成生之限（允诺、训练、制止侵害）约束一些步而所约束者仍可得，是护闭之结构」: the nearest live form for 约, with no virtue read.
Assessment, name table: 两边皆不立为名 includes 仁、义; 本表不立 includes 德、礼、信; 部分同构 includes 感.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「德读作形成了的、仍可修正的回应之能」; 「所以德的伦理之义要经过比较」. 「条件说谁的损失算数，而不排序；满足广者居上（C）的次序，把一个进程排在它所扩大的每一个进程之上，在延续条件以从己方式成立之处，自我关切在一个有限列表上也如此；有得有失之结束是混合的，诸律不替任何人去权衡，须另写比较承诺，否则不可比」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「一体之仁读作共同形成。一体之伦理内容，是读到之处沿一体继续为回应，于某些形成中有之，不必然有之……不只是万物有因果联系」.

account_adds.en: The rule that evaluation is not to be written into a definition, and a structure for a binding that keeps what it binds reachable.

source_adds.en: The idioms 修 and 约 as derived operators, and the five-virtue table.

name.en: 工夫四层 and 致良知: direction, not level, marks genuine change

source.locator: The reader is under the same discipline; claims 159-167; own words 67-71

sense.en: Reading is 做工夫 through 学, 见, 化, 忘, phases that are non-linear and local. The felt 'I have seen' cannot tell genuine from counterfeit. 良知 is the answer, an acute discomfort you cannot lie past, and the one marker is deepening sensitivity to one's own unseen. The author is bound too.

correspondences.quote: The only stable marker of genuine internalisation is a deepening sensitivity to what one has not seen.

reading.en: On 良知 the account records a divergence in how it is held (如何持有之相分): 阳明 states as a recognised fact what the theory holds under the continuation condition with the step of invariance. It warns the source's marker of a risk: discounting each failed outcome as not real knowledge leaves nothing testable. Nearest forms for the counterfeit trap, none carrying it: self-reference does not certify itself; selection is blind beyond its couplings; each revision says its last gap; a judgment read from its own share stays locked against a loss it does not read (closed capture). 工夫, 自欺 are absent.

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「若每一不如预期之果都事后排出“真知”，此说便无可检验之内容」; 「阳明把本然良知当作已认出的事实来陈述，理论只在延续之条件加不变性一步之下得相近的内容，所分在如何持有」. “行是知之成”合于实验之律.
「So self-reference does not certify itself」, on the criteria and term language supplied.
「选择在耦合所及之外是盲的，自己的动作也在内」.
「each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap」: a limit on a family of readings, not a marker of a person's change.

Theorem. In a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share.

account_adds.en: A test-based reading of practice: what was walked is fixed, what was not is not.

source_adds.en: The four phases, the counterfeit problem, direction as diagnostic, and 良知 as discomfort one cannot lie past.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root; 知行合一 as a theorem

source.locator: Claims 222, 230-231; critiques 33, 36

sense.en: jian-ontology v7: 事 is the sole ground with four 本 (物, 動, 間, 心). First person cannot be losslessly captured, so 心 is a reflexive aspect and every projection from it is lossy. 知行合一 is five adjunctions. The other tracks disagree: 《气》 forbids representing 心 at all, and R-Family omits it.

correspondences.quote: 心 as the fourth root is v7's key move

reading.en: The name table rejects 心 as a name for its overtone of a single controller, and the account treats what an experience is like as a live argument that could defeat its thesis, not as a root; consciousness is open. 06 reads 心即理, in context, as the responding side of a relation, not an ontology of mind. Reflexive centres appear as standpoints in 07. Rejecting a name does not bar the texts that use it. 知行合一 has a law nearby: what a formation knows, read off its acts, is what its acts are sensitive to (sensitivity is the least coupling), as TM's reading of the stored 《傳習錄》 lands 「未有知而不行者；知而不行，只是未知」; it is not the source's five adjunctions.

says.en: 不采之字 37 个: 道, 气, 天, 心（单一统摄者）, 性, 仁. 「不采不是排斥」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「心即理，在事父之孝一段的语境中，是关系中回应的一面，不是心的本体论」.
What would defeat it: live arguments, that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

targets.part: the live arguments that would defeat it

says.en: 「consciousness is open」.
Theorem. A law reading finitely many conditions under each history reads through what it is sensitive to: up to double negation, sensitivity is the least coupling.

account_adds.en: Naming the first-person case as a defeater, not absorbing it.

source_adds.en: 四本, 三显, 三征, 恒, 吾/我, the semiring 合/和/生 and the adjunctions.

name.en: 開/閉 as the only two-valued operator, seated on 幾

source.locator: Claim 226; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: When the about-to becomes the already, that is 開; when it returns to the not-yet, 閉. Gates give 幾開→生, 幾閉→灭, 勢開→成, 勢閉→反, 機開→转, 機閉→守. It is not an added primitive but the only operator surviving the zero-dimensional collapse.

correspondences.quote: 開/閉 is the architecture's only two-valued operator and it sits on 幾

reading.en: 06 §十 maps the 闭 and 开 of 生生不息论 and 间生论, which the folder's genealogy ties to this operator; it never takes up this gate table. Structure replaces evaluation: closure is an absorbing region, as form no loss, and 可 is reaching a return. Nearest to 機開/機閉 is a juncture, where a choice matters. What a closure opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type (06).

says.en: 「一种闭对生生（生命之延续）开什么、闭什么、为谁，由比较者之读来说，不由类型来说：延续之条件说谁的损失算数，满足广者居上（C）的次序把一个进程排在它所扩大的每一个进程之上，有得有失者诸律示为混合，须另写比较承诺」 [AI reading, D49]. 闭: 律永不离开的区域，闭就其形式而言不是损失.
Theorem (any process; premises there). 「a choice matters only at a juncture」.

account_adds.en: Theorems under each old term, the non-independence of the four marks of 开.

source_adds.en: The gate table on 幾, 勢, 機, and the zero-dimensional collapse argument.

name.en: The paradigm must not totalize: elsewhere substance ontology may fit

source.locator: Claim 202; critique 38

sense.en: 《气》 refuses to totalize: the highest leverage is transcending paradigm, so 間 must not become another totalizing attractor. In pure computation with no coordination, substance ontology may fit better. The folder notes that Claim Z contradicts this and nobody saw the ethical half.

correspondences.quote: 在某些场景（比如纯 computational tasks、no inter-actor coordination）substance ontology 可能更 fit——这种时候不要 force jian

reading.en: The source refuses to apply its paradigm in a named place; the account draws no such place. Its thesis keeps defeaters in view and neighbours named, and its method claims no necessity, but its grammar takes any domain as a language and nowhere says a substance reading fits better. Against a rival it may tie, which makes no reading false. So the source's refusal becomes things that could defeat a reading.

says.en: What would defeat it, by kind of claim: a language, nothing could; the explanatory reading is a thesis, argued, with four things it says, each differing in what could defeat it. 「A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing.」
记为相分不是说原文错了. 「不是本体论的证明，也不是伦理必然性的证明」.

account_adds.en: Stated defeaters in place of a stance.

source_adds.en: A positive statement of where the relational paradigm should not be used, and the highest-leverage argument from Meadows.

name.en: 五行 is a five-node feedback graph, not a cosmology

source.locator: Claims 134-135; critique 46

sense.en: 生 is a Hamiltonian cycle of positive edges, 克 a skip-cycle of negative ones, every node with in-degree and out-degree two: a mass-balanced negative-feedback ring, a stable oscillatory regime. A strong fence: not substances, not a classification. The folder notes the 中医 section may break that fence.

correspondences.quote: 五行 is to be read strictly as a five-node cybernetic feedback graph, not a cosmology

reading.en: 五行 has no live occurrence. It stands in the history 中华本 name table as not adopted, with the reason that the cycles must first pass a test for being real loops and that the cosmic scheme is later; 墨经's 五行毋常胜 is scoped there. The graph itself is not stated even there.

source_adds.en: History: theories/becoming/history/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md name table, row 五行; history/WENLI-AND-BECOMING.md line on names neither side adopts.

name.en: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

source.locator: Claims 298, 196; loss 10

sense.en: The Ship of Theseus answer: an identity stays itself as long as its happening chain is unbroken, however far its manifest drifts. Cross-間 sameness is worldline coherence, not a global id. An identity has a life cycle, with sponsored birth, four kinds of death and a quotable history after. Stated as a design direction.

correspondences.quote: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

reading.en: The account takes up the topic and reverses the order: identity is one reading of continuation under a class, not a fact beneath it. History-continuity is the case under the full class, where continuation is 缘 itself. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition: labels carry nothing, a continuation is a relation and need not be one-to-one, and two-way continuity leaves succession possible across a dormant step. No Theseus answer is given.

says.en: 「The grammar reads it as continuation under a class: identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.」

Theorem (World). Labels carry nothing, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. 「Two-way continuity of activity still leaves succession possible across a dormant step. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition」.
Theorem (root). 「Under the full class continuation is 缘 itself (`«一之续»`)」. 「Continuation is a relation, not an identity.」
Open: 「Identity from continuity, not naming. For continuations read off conservation the formal part is settled; continuations read from informational or organizational relations are not derived.」

account_adds.en: That which continuation counts depends on the class, and that a renaming preserving every reading still can change who continues whom.

source_adds.en: An unbroken chain as sufficient for identity, the default against reifying identity, sponsored birth, kinds of death, and post-death quotability.

name.en: Failure is an ordinary happening, and 复 is cultivation reversed

source.locator: Claim 297; loss 9

sense.en: 失, 塞, 误 and 复 are all just 涉: no happy-path and error-path split, no try/catch. Recovery is cultivation running backwards, 复 = 修 之 反失, which unifies self-healing with self-evolution. 无咎 is not having no loss but being able to return. A design direction, gone from v1.0 and WENYAN.

correspondences.quote: 无咎不是无失，是有失能复

reading.en: One half has a live form: degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding, and closing, turning back and returning are steps of one law. The other half is scoped: return is no general capacity. What returns can be had where courses branch exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own; 穷 can end; a kept history never returns. 复 as 修 reversed is not stated.

says.en: Not assumed: 「Degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding and are not renamed generation.」

Theorem (any process). Where courses branch, what returns can be had at every step, and every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
「穷不保证变，也可以是终」.
转（修正、回返、变通）. 「闭就其形式而言不是损失」 [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: The exact condition for return, and that no type of step decides what a closing opens or closes: a closing can end something whether or not anyone counts it, whether that counts depends on the significance supplied, and a ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes.

source_adds.en: 复 = 修 之 反失, self-healing and self-evolution as one, the failure taxonomy, and no try/catch as a design rule.

name.en: Tradition names stay out of the core: a strict isolation rule

source.locator: Claims 256, 246; critique 40; loss 31

sense.en: Core algebra documents must not use any external tradition's terminology as a core concept name; Pauli, GF(256), 易经 and Greimas bindings are opt-in attachments. Bit patterns carry identity, semantic names are contextual overlays. The folder also records what this cost: the classical semantic layer was lost.

correspondences.quote: A strict isolation rule governs the traditions

reading.en: The account takes the opposite form: its Lean grammar's names are classical characters (际, 而, 非, 续, 化), and the guard lies elsewhere: the operations are Tarski's, not drawn from the texts; in a clash the grammar's name rules; laws do not rest on texts; the hexagram modules hold no predicate of 吉凶 or 德. So tradition enters the core as names carrying no authority, not as an opt-in binding. A table of senses meets the overtones.

says.en: Definition. A relation (际, *jì*) on a carrier, `«际» α := α → α → Prop`, with operations named 而, 逆, 合, 非, 则, 谓, 一, 静, 及.
「两者不同之处以文法之名为准」.
「律的成立不靠原文」.
「模块中没有吉凶、贵贱、德或意义之谓词，也没有判断」.
「这些运算是塔斯基关系演算之运算而有四处不同」, 「并以汉字命名：名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文」.

account_adds.en: Classical names with their senses listed, and a statement of what each name does not carry.

source_adds.en: Language-neutral bit patterns as identity, several bindings coexisting on one layer, and opt-in attachment as a rule.

name.en: What the project refuses to inherit

source.locator: Claim 8

sense.en: Marked a value stance. Refused: the 太极→八卦 doubling scaffold; 阴阳 as a base primitive; post-medieval ontological terms (体用不二, 理一分殊, 法界缘起); verbs with an ex-nihilo causal narrative (造, 生, 元); the ambition of a single universal formal system; and 诛心.

correspondences.quote: refuses to inherit

reading.en: Partly shared in effect, on other grounds and not as a refusal: 不采不是排斥. 阴 and 阳 are set up as names on neither side. 理一分殊 and 法界 do not occur live; 体用一源 occurs only as an internal reply in a table. Divergence too: 生 is a grammar word, the mark 'begins' under a class, with no ex-nihilo narrative, and the grammar states laws for every carrier, though 06 denies a universal minimal concept grammar. The doubling and 诛心 have their own entries.

says.en: 两边皆不立为名 | 16 | 道、气、性、仁、义、天、有、无、阴、阳. 「没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
先在的根据, each tradition's reply within it: 王夫之“乾坤并建，时无先后”；程颐“体用一源”. 表示不需要先于运行之始；这不裁决先在根据是否存在.
Theorem (root). Beginning, abiding and ending are read off the two-way core: 生 names beginning under a class (`«生于位核下不变»`).
不采之字 37 个，各有理由. 「不采不是排斥：这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类。」

account_adds.en: A counted table of names neither side adopts, with reasons by row.

source_adds.en: The list as a stated refusal, with 体用不二 and 造/元 named; refusing a universal formal system outright, which the folder's Claim Z itself breaks.

name.en: The one chosen premise: that it continue

source.locator: The argument, Why openness rather than any particular good outcome; claims 94-95

sense.en: Description settles no aim. Exactly one underivable premise is added and owned as chosen: that the generating of new forms, by living and made systems, go on, as process and not as any state. Every requirement is presented as following from that premise plus checked dynamics.

correspondences.quote: that it continue — that the generating of new forms, carried by living systems and now by made ones, go on

reading.en: The account keeps the move (an aim is a premise, not read off dynamics) and changes the rest. One chosen premise becomes the hypotheses each ranking result states, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, with the ethics emerging from continuation and, where the condition holds, ranking by widening adding no premise beside a life's own concern. Same word, not same reference: the condition says anything's continuation is counted and ranks nothing, not that anything go on. T8 once started from what acting presupposes. Each ranking names its order; §5's practical-judgment scheme uses J1–J4.

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and does not rank anything. C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, widening being one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

account_adds.en: That wanting continuation does not tell generation from keeping; non-entailment results for the condition and for C (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails, ReadsNoOrder.not_entails).

source_adds.en: That one premise suffices, with the dynamics, for the whole constructive programme, with published falsifiers of that derivation; the premise bundling not-ending with novelty, which its own review flags (thinking_06).

name.en: Preserve and expand the possibility space: the form nearest C

source.locator: Claims 12, 93; Found by reading the corpus, 'Ren's own most-quoted formulation'

sense.en: The strongest form of the alignment target: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, shared abundance. Personally: my purpose is to make more possibilities. The README records this as contradicting the anti-optimization clause, and 开 as coined to fix the expansion verb.

correspondences.quote: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, and shared abundance.

reading.en: Preserve-and-expand has widening's form: include all the other admits, exceed it somewhere. An order meeting C ranks that above; so C, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (every claim counted as living), stands nearer this English verb than the 开 the folder preferred, and it answers the maximand worry by partiality, not by leaving comparison. The must does not survive: in the account no should stands beyond becoming, and the alignment direction is offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, its theorems taking J1/J2, not the condition, and comparing moves by what their outcomes admit. No duty shown.

says.en: Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher. 'An order increasing in admission is monotone at its standpoint; where the condition holds de se, self-concern is such an order'; on a listing's frame, every claim counted, such an order is exactly one meeting C.

Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): the direction we offer AI, read under them, aligns AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.
Does not show that anyone must hold the condition, C or the step of invariance, nor any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

The chooser route stops at witnesses: where admission is imposed, an item a net weighting counts below zero can put a widening below what it widens; among several choosers, where a choice bears on what the other gets, widening the one menu both choose from can lower what each gets by the game's payoffs (the prisoner's dilemma read as a menu).

account_adds.en: The split between which admits more (no premise) and which ranks above (C); that widening reads formations admitted, not the listed goods. That for choosers more can be worse where admission is imposed or choices bear on each other; these stop that route to C, not C.

source_adds.en: A requirement on AI, unconditional; freedom, truth and cooperation as named objects of it; the purpose stated in the first person.

name.en: Protecting the open and C are different claims

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 13, 25; Genealogy, 2026-05-02

sense.en: Good is not in more but in protecting the open; evil not in less but in producing closure. The criterion is that the not-yet not be closed. 开 replaced 'expanding the possibility space' as root because expansion sounds measurable and maximizable.

correspondences.quote: 善不在多，善在护开；恶不在少，恶在成闭

reading.en: Name both: the continuation condition, and C, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (every claim counted as living). They meet on a pure closing: the course without it widens it, so an order meeting C ranks that course above, and T8's refuter until 9 November 2026 was a pure closing argued good for life. On a closing with a gain they part: the source gives verdicts both ways (成闭 condemned, 护闭 approved), and C asks for none where the comparison is mixed; which pairs are mixed depends on the reading of living, none chosen. What C requires turns on 'admits more', what 善不在多 refuses. On this reading keeping open is entailed by neither the condition nor C; the account does not derive it.

says.en: Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C does not ask that it be ranked above.

The condition alone ranks nothing. Where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint above overdraw (two parts) and sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings; other rows differ by reading. No reading is chosen.
The reach counts what happens, not what is lost; a loss is read by comparing courses, which the reach does not do.

This is not itself a route to C: it says what 'weaker' can mean and where each route to an order meeting C rests. Route 'what lies downstream': self-concern, with §4.6's P2 and P4, which rank nothing; it stops where one's line ends with its last stage still conditioning and at what lies beyond the listing. On a listing's frame, every claim counted, with every listed item marked, an order is self-concerned exactly when it meets C: 'one requirement on an order in two forms, self-concern and C'.

account_adds.en: That a closing with a gain stays unranked where it is mixed unless a reading of living or further premises (J1–J4) enter; that how orders meeting C form is open and nothing reading no order supplies C; that a loss is read by comparing courses. The routes to an order meeting C on a listing (choosers, standpoints, one item at a time, what lies downstream), each with where it stops, none deriving C; so no route from self-concern or the condition reaches keeping open.

source_adds.en: Never reopening (成闭) as the mark of the bad, whatever it gains; 护闭 approved for what it protects; the refusal of 'more'. Whether C is a fair restatement of 护开 is left open here: this entry says they coincide on pure closings and, on some readings, on overdraw, and no further.

name.en: Keeping open: keeping a possibility, keeping reachable, against what is realized

source.locator: Claims 13, 5; Terms, 开

sense.en: 开 means the not-yet-become is not closed: the process still has what it can become. In English, keep the sample space open. What is kept is not what is realized now but what can still come, and becoming is not to be compressed into an endgame.

correspondences.quote: 开者，未成之域不闭也

reading.en: The account has keeping a possibility by name, and scopes it. On finitely many configurations under a determined law, keeping every possibility is exactly every configuration returning, which 06 reads as lossless return, 不息 without 生生: so keeping alone is no 未, which needs a world no list holds. What a course keeps reachable adds an edge: on a branching witness realized and reachable widening hold of a pair in opposite directions, so holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise; C adopts none.

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): along every course nothing is added to the whole possible and a lost possibility has no way back. On a branching witness no strict partial order contains both realized and reachable widening, nor satisfies C on both frames. Near-definitional or a witness; no order here is adopted by C.

Reading [AI reading, D45], after that law: what it adds is alternatives; an account holding realized and reachable widening needs a rule of precedence, a premise, and covering cannot see when a commitment is made.

Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility; for every process what is lost stays lost. Becoming that keeps its whole history loses nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds.

Theorem (any process): every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
Reading [AI reading, D49]: among the cases of going on, lossless return, the corpus's 不息 without 生生.

account_adds.en: That covering implies inclusion of what each configuration admits now, so what is kept reachable is never put above a course wider now that starts a course; that on a finite determined law keeping everything is only returning.

source_adds.en: 开 as the thing to hold, prior to any comparison, and more than keeping what can already be had. The account defines keeping and covering and adopts no verdict from them; covering compares what is possible, the form 'more possibility here' that claim 15 refuses for 开.

name.en: The possible is itself still generating

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14 (可)

sense.en: 可 says more than that generation can occur: the possible is itself still being generated, not drawn from a fixed list. The space of possibility is not a stock to be kept but something still forming.

correspondences.quote: 可 (generation is still possible, and the possible is itself still generating)

reading.en: The account says exactly where this holds and corrects the universal form. Under any one stated process nothing is added to the whole possible along a course; a tower of rules with no top adds nothing either. The possible relative to what is held can grow, only where what is held changes, and keeping it growing needs endless change, which does not suffice. A reading: 生生不息 needs no growth of the whole possible. 06 §十 maps only 可's first half.

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): along a course, where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible that loses none of it. On a finite listing, widening is what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks higher, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
可 (early sense: generation still possible) maps to a course going on; 未 needs a world no list holds (unlisted_of_new).

Conditional (living significance, correspondence E; a supplied articulation for the reason): where each admitted continuation realizes living content absent before, living significance gives each some relevant content absent before, though no one content need be realized in all; a contributory reason, neither permission nor duty.

account_adds.en: That more still able to form is not the whole possible exceeding the actual, since a course that only returns has that too. A reason for going on into forms not fixed in advance, contributory and conditional.

source_adds.en: An unrelativized growth of the possible, of reality itself. The account states it only relative to what is held, and says if the one unfolding were one stated process nothing would be added.

name.en: Stabilize and keep going: the plain wish, and freezing is no continuation

source.locator: Claims 8, 95; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: The goal is stabilization, not utopia: as long as we can stabilize and keep going, we have a future. Elsewhere continuing means the process: a frozen order that persists while generating stops is not continuation. The folder does not reconcile the plain wish with the verdict on freezing.

correspondences.quote: as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future

reading.en: The account splits what the folder joins. At two grains a course can generate, keep or degenerate; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. So wanting to go on rules out degeneration only and does not prefer generation to keeping (02 §1), as T8 said until 9 November 2026. That frozen is no continuation is not a verdict of the map: keeping is going on. C asks a ranking only where one course widens the other, and generation does not imply widening: it can go on at two grains while what can form only returns.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch); generation and keeping each exclude degeneration (as ONE-PAGE states it). Proved for every relation and class.

Not shown: that generation is better than keeping or degeneration: 'no law says so; an order someone holds, one meeting C among them, could rank them, and whose losses count is the continuation condition's reading'.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the wish stops doing work.

source_adds.en: That persisting frozen is itself a way of ending, and that brittleness for want of variety is why. The account leaves it as keeping.

name.en: Fidelity to the generative process, which intelligence cannot oppose

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 99, 102-104; What openness is for

sense.en: Later drafts: the foundation is not a preference but fidelity to the process reality displays, 'not one value among others' but the condition of all valuing; its constraints cannot be opposed by intelligence as intelligence. Ren in October 2026 affirms the process outright. The README itself flags the drafts' move as reopening the is-ought crack.

correspondences.quote: It is fidelity to the generative process reality already displays.

reading.en: The account refuses this form. It does not assume becoming is good. Supplied as a free predicate, significance is fixed by no statement about the dynamics, by construction of the representation; that shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. A perspectivist denies the condition without contradiction, nothing reading no order entails C, and no should stands beyond becoming: the ethics emerges from continuation, seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one (argued).
