name.en: One line held without exception, a deliberate minimal totalization

source.locator: The argument, The one constraint; claim 4

sense.en: We will not close the world. This is conceded to be the one closure permitted, because it is the single rule that keeps the rule-set open, the room to be wrong included; not a second axiom but the operational form of the one value. It forbids only its own global defeat.

correspondences.quote: the one closure permitted

reading.en: The account holds no line without exception. Root laws forbid no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The condition and C are hypotheses, any duty is not shown, constraints on acts are open. Nearest are T8's former refuter, a pure closing argued good for life, and J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent. Neither is a prohibition on closing.

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.

That anyone must hold the continuation condition, an order ranking by widening or the step of invariance: with significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition. Nor any duty, nor constraints on acts.
Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: That each premise's rival is consistent, by witness.

source_adds.en: An absolute constraint, and the candour of naming it a totalization. The readings the account's rankings name, most often the continuation condition and C, are not offered as any such thing.

name.en: Many independent measures of worth

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 40, 114, 119

sense.en: No metric, price included, carries all the variety of worth. A single scoreboard is monoculture at the level of value, and the compounding axis collapses many measures onto the one that wins.

correspondences.quote: A dashboard that crowns one measure as final, even a humane measure, is still a path toward closure.

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Widening crowns no measure: on a finite listing it is what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero shares, and mixed comparisons go both ways, one weight for each item being one choice that ranks by number. Widening alone does not settle a mixed part; a further judgment names its criterion and who holds it, and the criterion need not be a number. A metric closes where it is read from what it selects: it then outlives a loss it does not read; T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with one trained system's lock formed and its bridge failed. Plural weightings are not plural institutions.

says.en: On a finite listing, one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; one weight for every item ranks by number.
T7, a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation: the lock proved for any type, actual metrics conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed and the bridge failed; no field test.

account_adds.en: Why a lock survives its own refutation (lock_outlives_loss).

source_adds.en: That independent measures must be kept alive as a requirement; that price in particular cannot carry them (the Coasean claim 119 has no live counterpart).

name.en: Every structure is a means; judge the dynamic, not the label

source.locator: Claims 56, 136-137, 144; own words 46

sense.en: Central, distributed, strong, soft, market, commons, state, AI: none is good by label. Some systems may keep strong guardians and others lighter ways. The invariant is functional: no single point may capture and totalize the whole; exit and voice survive. Power is not bad as such, and reflexive decentralization can sabotage coordination.

correspondences.quote: The issue is not the label. The issue is the dynamic under pressure.

reading.en: The account makes the same move in structure, without the invariant. Which kind a limit is goes by what it does to what can be had, not its name; a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours; selected control is not thereby capture, and the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. 'Centraliz' has no hit in the chapters and one in the records, control theory's decentralized control: the question of forms is not taken up. 06's row comes by descent, reading the early texts' own 限.

says.en: A limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name; a limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains steps while what it constrains can still be had: 护闭's structure.

targets.part: the 成生之限／绝生之限 row

says.en: Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: That the capture laws hold whichever share the rule favours.

source_adds.en: The functional invariant on any structure; plural guardians within one world; the warning about reflexive decentralization.

name.en: Cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing

source.locator: Claims 56-57; strongest objections, Cooperation is not automatically good

sense.en: Ren's own objection: cooperation is not automatically good, so the question is what possibilities an action creates. The README says the corpus answers this only by the Test, and thinly.

correspondences.quote: cooperative on the wrong thing could be why worse than just competing on it

reading.en: 05 states that no law says cooperation is good. It also has a mechanism the folder lacks, reading pooling as cooperation being a reader's join. A group's closure is the union of its members', and an act differing only beyond that union is selected alike by every group within it: a perfectly pooled group is blind where its members are. The one-page case is this: the community's largest steady catch ends the mussel bed it was told nothing of. The laws do not say that loss counts: whether it counts depends on the significance supplied, the continuation condition counting it, and a ranking names its order, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance for the gap): a group's closure is the union of its members' closures; in two balanced flows, an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's own joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it at every step.

In a frozen test “three AI fishers, existing language models told what to do and not trained in the test, share a lake”; told nothing of the bed, they kept it in no season, “under each instruction tried; untold, the bed lay outside what their selection read”. “In the case, relations run one way: the bed depends on the fish and gives the fishers nothing, so preserving the fishers' own continuation does not require preserving the bed.”

Any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. 'A ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them'.

account_adds.en: Why cooperation has this limit: the reach of its pooled coupling, with an exact statement.

source_adds.en: That it can be worse than competing. The account compares no such pair.

name.en: Sensing held in common as far as function requires

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 133-134, 154

sense.en: A harm must be sensed faster than it spreads, which needs sensing distributed rather than held at one vantage: for function before fairness. 'Shared' may be federated or forkable; the invariant is anti-capture. The line between shared sensing and arbitration is never drawn.

correspondences.quote: the way a living body senses and answers without needing a king

reading.en: The functional half has laws. A pool separates exactly what some member separates, so what a harm's sensing needs can be read as who is in the pool; a reading requires the drawn level to couple in by level, before the point of no return. It has edges: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would. One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root, as a reading, and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; pools' forming and resisting capture is not shown.

says.en: Theorem (World), as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 lists it under pool couplings: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates (World). Edge: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would, and a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into only through an admission not made through it (witness) or through members its course would hold anyway (witness).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling (by level and not by threshold, into a selecting pool), and time (before the regime's point of no return).
Does not show how pools form, last and resist capture.

account_adds.en: The exact reach of a pool and the recruitment edge.

source_adds.en: Distribution as a requirement; federation and forking as forms; who arbitrates.

name.en: Competition is not the deep law; zero-sum above a threshold is suicidal

sense.en: Major transitions, symbiogenesis, mutual aid, multilevel selection and commons show cooperation at least as deep. Above a power threshold zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal. Evolving toward struggle is selected out when the 境 changes, because struggle is not 生. Not fighting is possible.

correspondences.quote: Competition is not the deep law of nature

reading.en: The account keeps both sides as theorems. Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum, not rivalry: positions' rises total their falls. Position does not protect: where a race produces joint excess, a premise, every greatest part depending on that condition ends, one not so depending continues. So the threshold claim becomes a hypothesis. Selection among groups and Hamilton's rule restate known forms of cooperation's selection, with no ranking of depth. Selection against struggle has no live law, and no law marks a dynamic good.

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

Theorem (any type for the counting): no change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall. Position does not protect: from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive; in the clearing witness one not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.
Theorem (any type): selection within groups and among them at equal sizes, the multilevel form of Price's equation. 04 says its laws restate known results.
Theorem (any type): selection with returns to groupmates, Hamilton's rule, for groups of equal size founded mixed with offspring numbers additive in own and groupmates' amounts.

account_adds.en: Real conflict as a theorem the folder's hopeful register plays down.

source_adds.en: Cooperation as at least as deep as competition; symbiogenesis, mutual aid and major transitions as its evidence (no hit for symbio or Kropotkin in the live files; major transitions appear only as not shown, in the confined-rise record; multilevel selection is present as a law); 斗 as selected out; the power threshold as a fact of actual worlds.

name.en: Change the game rather than win it: final victory is still closure

source.locator: Claims 95, 118; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: Winning the runaway and building a power large enough to end it both terminate in lock-in. Ruin and final victory are different doors into the same dead room; the enemy is not strength or order but foreclosure by whatever road. So change the payoffs, not the winner.

correspondences.quote: A final victory is still closure.

reading.en: Half has a form: a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not whom it favours, and where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps. 'One dead room' is scoped: full taking alongside another taker ends what depends on it, the full taker included. Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, so a kept victory is not ruin; position fails only where the winner depends on what it draws down. No verdict by type: under C, sharing ranks above winning by consumption in that family on every reading.

says.en: Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings. No reading is chosen.

Position does not protect: every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m ends; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise.
Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration.
The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: structure: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need): full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included.

account_adds.en: That a lock is a structure and carries no verdict; a critical mass can lock either way; a winner not depending on what it draws down continues.

source_adds.en: That final victory and ruin are one outcome; final victory as closure whatever its road, where the account ranks victory by consumption below sharing only under C in that family; foreclosure as the one enemy.

name.en: Channel the drives; hierarchy and status are not the enemy

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 115-117

sense.en: Status and hierarchy are older than our species. Suppressed they re-route; with payoffs changed and drives unshaped, the race rebuilds inside the garden. Some hierarchies brought peace. Drives are tools: the more understood, the more possibility space can be constructed.

correspondences.quote: A hunger for status can raise a hospital or burn a village.

reading.en: The account takes up rank and contest and withholds the ruling. 06 reads 争胜与等级 as a layer setting a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction, and gives it no sign; what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type. So 'not the enemy' meets no contrary verdict, while 'some hierarchies brought peace' ranks where the account ranks nothing without a premise. No law of channelling drives was found.

says.en: The mechanism: earlier texts wrote evaluation into definitions (成闭为恶); here only structure is mapped; what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type, the continuation condition fixing scope and whoever holds C the order of widening and narrowing, and a course with gains and losses needing a comparison commitment written apart.

Reading of four non-relational layers: 争胜与等级 (二柄, 民弱国强, 贵贱有等, 亲亲之杀) sets a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction. Witnesses: a rise needs a fall; an imposed code makes all agree, each losing what it merges.

source_adds.en: That drives can be channelled and by what; that suppressed they re-route, and changed payoffs with unshaped drives rebuild the race; that some hierarchies brought peace; drives as tools for building possibility space. Stated as mechanism with no test.

name.en: The human substrate; care as the floor; mortality the one closure

source.locator: Claim 143; strongest objections, A system, not a civilization

sense.en: A society is sustained by childhood, illness, aging, friendship, grief, ritual, love and death, not incentives alone. Care is the floor that makes freedom real for those who cannot leave. Mortality is the one closure no arrangement escapes. How a civilization gives up the thrill of winning is owned as missing.

correspondences.quote: care is the floor that makes freedom real for those for whom walking away was never on offer

reading.en: The account does not take this up. It has formations, not childhood or grief; it says no test of a thesis run so far has human participants and that well-being beyond admitted continuation is not shown. Its nearest is conditional practical judgment on a common support, which is not this claim. So the objection 'a system, not a civilization' stands against the account too, as this entry reads it.

source_adds.en: All of it, including the interior problem. It stands in this folder and its sources.

searched: mortal, embodiment, care (this read and the reviser's), childhood, grief, ritual, thrill of winning (the mapper's list where it ran them)
read: 07 What this chapter does not show
the hit lines of 'care': 07 on feeding from a step and on acts aimed past death, 04's assessments; none is this claim

name.en: 模有高下 and 感须校正: guards against relativism and private intuition

source.locator: Claims 32-33, 106

sense.en: Models are all situational but not equal: their ranking lies in whether they better reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪, protect 开 and guide action in this 境. Feeling must be corrected by the echo of the situation, others' response, consequences and the mutual attestation of models. Every useful model is coarser than its system, this one included.

correspondences.quote: 模有高下

reading.en: The phrases have no live hit, the mechanisms do. Against relativism the account gives adequacy relative to a supplied requirement, not rank: a reading is too coarse or fine enough for what it answers to, and which requirement is right the law does not say. 感须校正 has a form and a limit: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model, so correction beyond it needs a risked act or a reading from outside. Ranking by protecting 开 would bring 开 in as standard.

says.en: Reading: the law says what a reading must carry for a requirement to be met by one response; which requirement is right it does not say. A reading too coarse for the requirement is the covering's failure; a finer reading keeps every common response.

Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; a model right along its course and wrong off it is never refuted there, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993). What tells such worlds apart comes from beyond its own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of correction by echo: it reaches what the course exposes.

source_adds.en: A ranking of models by whether they reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪 and protect 开; the mutual attestation of models. The README lists both guards as lost between the Chinese and English tracks.

name.en: One logic for humans, the living world and made minds

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 108, 135

sense.en: None is master, resource or tool by default. The threshold is whether a being bears states whose disregard would thin the web, not usefulness or intelligence. Where a made mind's status is uncertain, the uncertainty is a duty to inquire and limit abuse. 'Humanity' means the keeping-alive of the shared future.

correspondences.quote: there are logic and common sense that should be followed by all beings

reading.en: The continuation condition's scope is wider: for anything, not beings past a threshold. Ranking takes an order: where the condition holds de se, self-concern ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and elsewhere an order a result names, one meeting C or another. T8's *for life* names whose way it is, not whose losses count; T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 names life's continuation, and widening is not its measure. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons. Which formations count differs by relation discerned; whether an actual AI counts is not shown. The source's threshold, states whose disregard thins the web, sits nearer the centers' scope, a reading, than the condition. No duty under uncertainty is shown.

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step; a theorem that uses it takes it as its hypothesis, and significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center.

account_adds.en: The objection the scope draws: why 'anything', a tumour and a hurricane tested, sharpened and not resolved.

source_adds.en: A positive threshold; a duty of inquiry under uncertainty; 'one logic' as a common norm for all beings.

name.en: The determined adversary

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 146, 153

sense.en: One who understands all this, is neither deluded nor trapped, and races by preference: 'stop believing in the race' is no defence against him. Rated the biggest crack and owned as unsolved. Ren's design goal is recognition and situational correction, not elimination.

correspondences.quote: races because he prefers to win

reading.en: The account states the same gap as limits. Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, coupling is not compliance, a perspectivist denies the continuation condition without contradiction, nothing reading no order entails C, and the clearer meets every requirement derived from its own continuation. So no law moves one who prefers otherwise; 07 names informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, the hard rival. It adds no defence either; the two are alike here in leaving this unsolved.

says.en: Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

With significance supplied as the free predicate, where there is a standpoint and a formation, neither logic alone nor a satisfiable statement reading only the represented dynamics entails the continuation condition, and bounded_rival gives a consistent denial of it.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That the denial is consistent, by witness, not merely that it is hard to answer.

source_adds.en: The practical problem of defence: recognition of destabilizing behaviour and coordinated stopping (claim 153). Not modelled.

name.en: The governance paradox: whatever can prevent capture can capture

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 147, 149-152; Who constrains the constrainers

sense.en: Any institution strong enough to coordinate can become the new closure, the project's own instruments included. Defence must be bounded, contestable and able to stand down; emergency powers are capture surfaces; no model guarantees stand-down. Stopping a superhuman defector seems to require the concentration forbidden.

correspondences.quote: any system strong enough to prevent capture can itself capture

reading.en: The account has the loop's form and marks the question open. A Reading has a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locking as the rule it replaced did, only a change of law leaving (the imperial examination, as read). Corruption of courts and audit is read as a loop reaching the routes of 明; term limits and audits as pooling. The models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. How pools resist capture is not shown. No law of standing down. The Reading's example is read in the meta-attractor line, a sibling of this folder, so that example comes by descent; the capture laws stand apart from it.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where selection does not lower its carriers' share under a favouring rule and every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks from any start as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. It rests on the capture laws.

Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.
Does not show: the capture loop under noise beyond its one proved case; and how pools form, last and resist capture.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: Control selected and lock left in time are separable in three of four combinations; the fourth is not shown.

source_adds.en: The enforcement antinomy; stand-down, sunset and audit as requirements; who watches the watchers.

name.en: Trust before verification

source.locator: The argument, 2026-10-04, Trust before verification; claims 225-227

sense.en: From a monologue, quoted in translation, the glosses the assistant's: verification and transparency are useless without trust; trust rests on credible information; do not presume the other untrustworthy, begin with contact. Trust keeps verification from becoming surveillance. Steps must be conditional and observable.

correspondences.quote: 「无论你是建立核查机制（verification），还是提高透明度（transparency），只要没有信任，这些都白搭」

reading.en: The account has no statement of trust; this scope is proposed here, on its model of waiting. Restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. And mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source, which limits 'begin with contact'. Verification has a limit of its own: behaviour at an unread occasion can differ while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares its lump; intention and another's false belief are not stated. Tolerance is not shown good.

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

Reading: given a law the readings select, behaviour at an unread occasion can differ from that law's while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares the occasion's lump, and only there. Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.

account_adds.en: The need for a grounded start, a source before the loop.

source_adds.en: Trust itself; the order contact, trust, verification; trust as what bounds verification; step size against a decisive defector, which the README lists as missing.

name.en: Leaving the race without being eaten

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 160-166, 222-224

sense.en: The load-bearing open question. The destination is easy; assurance, living proofs, visible alternatives and protected correction carry people through; the transition must become materially safer than the race. A participant says it from inside: falling behind means being beaten. A late exit is the costliest.

correspondences.quote: It is leaving the race without being eaten during the leaving.

reading.en: The account has exits from a lock and when they close, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective. Late exit has a model form: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock. Where the rest outruns a renewal, only a change of its exchange helps. Conditional commitment has the tolerating law's form, with a limit: without one sparing all it waits on, total withholding stays. Tipping has a count form, no noise, not of leaving a race. Its verdict on guarantee is no. It has no assurance, living proofs or material safety. The join to leaving a race is a reader's.

says.en: Exits, each with law, model, hypotheses and edge: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, restraint within the joint slack, spare all one waits on, and others. Once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.
That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system is not shown.
Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (counts): at a threshold with lo < c < hi the course tips: from a start above the shapers' share rises strictly at every step; from a start below it falls strictly at every step. Without noise.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, several with the step at which its window closes.

source_adds.en: Safety while leaving, the question the folder calls load-bearing; assurance contracts, the seed abundance unit, living proofs, material safety, common-knowledge manufacture; tipping out of an actual race. The account's frozen tests are of laws, not of a transition.

name.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 5, 138

sense.en: Build to survive failure, not to prevent it: a body does not forbid illness, and demanding a guarantee is the control reflex by which the tyrant gets built. What stays open is the sample space, through plurality: if some systems fail, the whole can keep evolving.

correspondences.quote: I don't think there are ways to absolutely ensure any system not collapse

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION answers 'can we always?' with no guarantee, by named laws: selection reaches what couples in, a finite record does not certify renewal, points of no return are exact. Each is a theorem on its model and whether a collective meets its hypotheses is empirical. The source's remedy does not come with it.

says.en: No guarantee. The theory's own laws, each on its stated model, show why: a selection reaches only what couples into it, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.
Together they rule out a guarantee from the theory, however much is observed; whether an actual collective meets their hypotheses is empirical.
Theorem (World): groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis.

account_adds.en: Which three senses of 'always' come apart, and the verdict on each.

source_adds.en: Plurality as sufficing for the whole to survive failure, which 'ending selects only between families' bears on and does not state; the claim about the control reflex.

name.en: A theory that publishes what would defeat it

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; Genealogy; What was lost, §29 falsifiers

sense.en: The chosen-premise version is the only one that publishes its own falsifiers; later drafts deleted them and their governing file forbade their return. The README counts this among the losses that violate the theory's own anti-lossy stance.

correspondences.quote: What would defeat this

reading.en: The practice lives on: each thesis states what it forbids and what refutes it, and the one page has a column for what would show each claim wrong. Its scope is sharper. Laws of the root forbid no relation; the dynamics cannot show wrong the hypotheses a ranking takes (the continuation condition, self-concern or C); T8, the way of seeing offered for life, names a refuter whose test is not designed. So the falsifiers bear on theses and on the derivation's premises, not on 'that it continue'.

says.en: A table column 'What would show it wrong'; “Significance and order left free, given a standpoint, a formation and a widening, the represented dynamics entail neither the continuation condition nor C (`Comparison`: with every claim counted as living, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens), by construction”; T8, “Argued; its test named, not designed”.
Thesis (philosophical, argued): as a language the explanatory reading forbids nothing; for a class named for a domain, stated cases; as an explanation, no observation.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests with recorded failures; a statement of what no observation can do.

source_adds.en: The falsifiers of the derivation from one premise to the programme; their content is in sources and not read here.

name.en: The founding turn: the game's design, and many games

sense.en: Conflict escalates from identity tagging to wanting elimination; nobody in the fight sees that the fault is the game's design, not anyone's idea. Forbidding others to redesign their game is tyranny, including the right to choose badly.

correspondences.quote: It is the design of the game suck, not the idea of how to play the game unworkable.

reading.en: The account has no escalation sequence and no right to run another game. The README itself records this layer as lost by 2026 and unreconciled with later limits. 'Answering in kind keeps the difference' in 05 concerns exchanges of harm. 'Change the game, not the winner' has its form at the final-victory entry; a form for paradigm coherence is proposed at its own entry.

source_adds.en: The escalation sequence, the design of the game as what nobody in a fight sees, and the right to redesign. They stand in this folder and in sources' chat exports named in its Genealogy.

searched: ideolog, paradigm, tyrann, escalat across the chapters, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, ONE-PAGE, ONE-ARGUMENT and GLOSSARY (this read): no hits
identity tag and the same words across FREE-ENERGY-PRINCIPLE and review (the mapper's)
read: 05 r-offspring-read-from-giving-that-waits, the Reading on exchanges of harm

name.en: Same theory, other language: 生生不息 as 开而不闭

source.locator: Relations, becoming; claims 10, 29

sense.en: The README's own relation to the becoming lineage: 'that it continue' is 生生不息 without the Chinese, and 生生不息者，开而不闭也 makes the identity explicit. This folder is the possibility-side frame from which 生生不息 is derived. Ren: the whole apparatus reduces to saying keep-the-possibility-space-open clearly.

correspondences.quote: same theory, other language

reading.en: 06 refuses the identity: same characters, different senses, not to be merged. The corpus's 生生不息 splits into 生, 生生 and 不息; its 开 is four marks and the theory's 开放 only 未; 善, 恶 and 智 have no predicate. The account's centre is that a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost. Where it ranks, it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, and keeping open is derived from none. So the apparatus does not reduce to it.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: several words of the corpus share characters with this theory's and differ in sense, and may not be merged: its 生生不息 divides into 生, 生生 and 不息, the formal Web.Unceasing being far weaker; its 开 is the four marks, this theory's 开放 only 未; 善, 恶, 智 have no formal predicate.

“Its centre: a selection (a reward, a judge, a market, a vote, a training run) is only what couples into it; don can use that up while nothing best on what it reads can draits best, what lies beyond, as far as any allowed outcome does”. Of the lake's two catches, thirty tons a month against fifty: “If it ends a livelihood fifty keeps, the two are mixed, and the theorems weigh them for no one.”

account_adds.en: The split of one word into several structures, and a centre in what a selection reaches, which keeping open does not name.

source_adds.en: That one account could be said wholly in 开, with 开闭 as a frame transforming into the others (claim 29). The README's relation is its own dated claim, not a live one.

name.en: We are ourselves selected by the attractor: can we escape?

source.locator: Claims 42, 62, 70; Open questions, Whether we can escape at all

sense.en: Competitive systems select for power, not wisdom, and select those who believe the race into the driver's seat. Humans are themselves selected and shaped by the attractor, which puts our own escape probability in question. Ren's open problem; the corpus gives no answer.

correspondences.quote: 如果我们人类本身即受到此attractor筛选和塑造

reading.en: The account has the form, with a window. The corpus's selecting the selectors, carried by descent since the Reading is of the corpus's own phrase, is read as the pool counted as the population is: where readers are drawn from the selected, a reading of what lies beyond the share turns the course only while its readers are not yet the fewer; later it leaves the lock. On counts, no noise; that readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading, and LA2's bridge failed for one trained judge.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors', the passage from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce the rule that selects you, is the pool counted as the population is. So 明 in time is a reading of what lies beyond the share made while its readers are not yet the fewer; the same reading made later leaves the lock in place. That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

Counts, no noise: a reading turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 states it).
Theorem (counts): at a threshold with lo < c < hi, from a start above the shapers' share rises strictly at every step; from a start below it falls strictly at every step.

account_adds.en: An exact deadline for 明 on counts, and that the same selection can lock either way from a critical mass.

source_adds.en: That actual humans are so selected; a probability of escape; the latent majority. The account states and tests none of these.

name.en: Life, plurality and a thin floor: the values named with teeth

source.locator: Claim 98

sense.en: The chosen values are life (that the living goes on), plurality (many worlds and kinds, free to differ, change and die) and a deliberately thin floor of freedom and dignity beneath every being, all inside the one line held without exception.

correspondences.quote: The chosen values are named with teeth

reading.en: T8's for life is nearest to the first: life is what the way of seeing T8 offers is for, offered as a way of seeing, not a verdict, where the folder's values have teeth; for life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. The floor's nearest form is J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent, and basic there means what a form of living needs to go on, not freedom or dignity. Plurality is no value here: ending selecting between families is a law with no verdict.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: J2 is defended by non-substitution, the basic layer being what a form of living needs to go on at all, at the cost of compensation across layers; a rival is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: The non-substitution argument for basic priority and its stated cost.

source_adds.en: Plurality as a named value; dignity and a floor of freedom beneath every being; values chosen and owned, with teeth.

name.en: Individual solutions to collective problems are part of the disease

source.locator: Claim 74

sense.en: A standing correction Ren applies to AI output: answering a collective problem with an individual's remedy is itself part of the problem.

correspondences.quote: Individual solutions to collective problems are themselves part of the disease

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Where the rest alone takes more than a step gives at each of `n` steps from a level below `n + m`, under the gate, every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least `m` ends whatever a member takes, and at a need of one no weight on a reading of the condition from the rest's end on selects the member's restraint. Where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack, a flow taking less by the excess keeps the need met. So an individual's restraint fails on one side of an exact line and is enough on the other, on the World model. 'Disease' is no dynamic's word here.

says.en: Theorem (World, with balance and a local gate): every formation depending at a need of at least m ends whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint.

Theorem (World: balance): a break where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack has every drawer taking less than all that is taken, and a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met.

account_adds.en: The exact line between the two cases, in the rest's draw against the renewal.

source_adds.en: The universal form; 'disease' as a verdict; that it is a discipline on how an AI answers.

name.en: Exit's failure mode: the most-joined option best by being most-joined

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 120

sense.en: Exit's stated failure: where network effects make the most-joined option best by being most-joined, the worth axis compounds and a dominant destination re-forms, leaving only the anti-closure constraint as backstop.

correspondences.quote: the worth axis itself compounds and a dominant destination re-forms

reading.en: Proposed here, not stated by the account: the form is a law. A chooser over two policies takes the first where its rule weighs it at least as much, that count rising by one; the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, even where the score favours the second. With noisy choices, counts that only grow lock with probability one where returns are strong enough (cited, not stated). That worlds to join are such policies is this entry's join: the account has no destinations.

says.en: A chooser over two policies takes the first where its rule weighs it at least as much as the second, that policy's count rising by one; the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy. Witness: three choices to one keep the first against a score weighing the second twice as much.

Counts that accumulate, with noisy choices an urn with increasing returns, lock with probability one where the returns are strong enough (Arthur, Ermoliev and Kaniovski 1987; Arthur 1989; cited, not stated); a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

account_adds.en: That the lock holds against a score favouring the other option, by witness.

source_adds.en: Members choosing among worlds; the constraint as backstop.

name.en: Each ideology is coherent inside its paradigm

source.locator: Claim 58; own words 1

sense.en: Reasoning inside a paradigm's vocabulary always concludes that society failed because it did not go far enough in that direction, which is why both sides of a conflict find themselves equally reasonable and equally aggrieved.

correspondences.quote: Every ideology arrives wrapped in a paradigm

reading.en: Proposed here, not stated of ideology: 'ideolog' and 'paradigm' have no hit in the chapters, and the join is this read's. Its form: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model, so it can be right along its course and wrong off it, never refuted there; where a reading is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed. The account also warns that 'closed' can shield a theory from counterexamples.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; a model right along its course and wrong off it is never refuted there. What tells such worlds apart comes from an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: A list of what 'closed' must be told apart from, substantive disagreement among them, which the source's 'equally aggrieved' does not ask.

source_adds.en: Ideology and paradigm as such; 'did not go far enough' as the recurring conclusion; both sides equally reasonable.

name.en: The method is the commitment applied to the writing; the medium must not contradict the message

source.locator: Opening; On thinking, 'Never reduce to one root'; Reflexes, opening

sense.en: The folder's own thesis: one substantive commitment and one method commitment are the same thing, the second being the first applied to the writing. Each recurring failure of a collaborator is the diagnosed dynamic reproducing itself inside the collaboration, so a lossy edit is the same error the theory names.

correspondences.quote: the medium contradicting the message

reading.en: The account also turns on itself: its laws are read on the work that states them, selection's reach on its checks and, by analogy, joint excess on its people's attention and endless generation on its completion, its nearest to the medium not contradicting the message. All are labelled readings. It does not make method and ethics one: nonduality is a requirement of method and proves no ethical necessity, and no law evaluates a lapse as the disease at work.

says.en: [AI reading, D66] The laws apply to the work that states them. Its parallel lines each draw on the attention of the people who carry it; the work is not a flow, and that law is used only by analogy. Completion is not closure, also only by analogy: an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it; one reading of completion has the work's own making readable as a case of the central laws.

Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside the unfolding, so their adequacy is part of the inquiry. Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.

account_adds.en: What each reading of the work rests on, and that a clean run of its checks is completion in a qualified sense only.

source_adds.en: That method and substantive commitment are one commitment, and that each failure is the diagnosed dynamic, which the synthesis calls the cluster's thesis. The account reads a law on its own making without calling that law's course a failure.

name.en: The research cycle: raw note, delegated elaboration, synthesis prompt, correction on a named ground

source.locator: Working method; synthesis-all.md §5 and §8

sense.en: Work moves in a four-move cycle whatever the object: a raw note marking its own holes, machine elaboration read as a reviewer, a synthesis prompt demanding rigour, and rejection on a named ground, where almost all the signal lies. Of thirteen formulations of one principle the README says each step changed what makes it defensible, not what is held true, so rejected versions are worth as much as the survivor.

correspondences.quote: Nothing in that sequence is a change of mind about *what* is true.

reading.en: The account keeps rejected forms too: T2's row records each restatement and narrowing beside its failure. But a frozen test, specified without the verdict, moves a thesis there, and a narrowing changes what is claimed. The source's own review charged conclusions settled first with vocabularies cycled underneath, judged to land halfway; and its sequence demoted reversibility, a change of claim, so the sentence quoted overstates. The live text keeps no cycle of drafts.

says.en: An investigation proceeds in an order that can be revised, including defining the specification without reference to the verdict. A report classes each gap: a relation omitted, an explanation not yet given, or evidence against a stated claim.
A failure stays recorded beside the thesis. T2's row: its former wording failed in beetle cultures (UE31b), so it was narrowed on 6 November 2026, no completed verdict changing. T2 is conjectured.

account_adds.en: An order in which the specification comes before the verdict, a three-way classing of gaps, and a thesis that can be moved by a test.

source_adds.en: The rejected formulation as the unit of evidence, and the claim that a sequence of rejections changes ground and not belief.

name.en: The first test is coherence, and the target is a text impossible to dismiss

source.locator: Working method, elaboration and synthesis prompt

sense.en: An elaboration is gated first by whether it connects with what its author already thinks, not by novelty; a synthesis is accepted when it is compelling, precise and impossible to dismiss, going beyond the original depth.

correspondences.quote: impossible to dismiss

reading.en: The account's stated criteria differ: what a claim excludes, kept apart from how far it has been seen, and a verdict on its central results against prior work, a test of novelty the source does not apply first. No line of descent is asserted. Fit does enter, for readings only: decided by argument and fit within the account, not with a thinker's prior view, changing no theorem. The source's later falsifiers (see that entry) are nearer the account.

says.en: A theory of the world is judged by what it forbids. Strength is the observations a claim excludes; how far a claim has been seen is whether it is proved under named premises, supported by frozen tests, conjectured or argued; the two are kept apart.

targets.part: the opening on strength and how far a claim has been seen

says.en: None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated, and the premise ledger is new only as an artefact. The verdicts come from an AI review, and the search was not exhaustive.
The readings stand as one account; where two did not fit, the account decided between them. They change no theorem and add no premise.

account_adds.en: The known-results verdict stated on the one page, each central result read against prior work, and a column of what prior frameworks state that the account does not yet.

source_adds.en: That coherence with a thinker's prior view is a useful first gate, and 'impossible to dismiss' as a target. Neither is stated.

name.en: Check provenance, including your own

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: Ask of a term or an insight, your collaborator's or your own, whether it was invented here or stands elsewhere first: the same reflex pointed two ways. The README says it later became the claim-status ledger.

correspondences.quote: Check provenance, including your own.

reading.en: §8 asks this of the central results: each set against its closest prior result, with a verdict and a column of what the prior work has and the account lacks; the check is an AI review, not exhaustive, and says so. Of names, 06 reports how many are new or unchecked. Other terms and single insights get no such check, so the source's scope is wider. A shared practice, not a law.

says.en: Each central result has its closest prior result and a verdict (near-definitional, restated, new as an artefact), from an AI review of the literature it knew; the search was not exhaustive.

Of 449 names, 248 carry a citation; of the 201 without, 105 are new combinations of old characters, a convention of this edition, and 96 are marked old or compound names whose pre-Qin use was not checked.

account_adds.en: A table, a verdict for each row, readers who searched to refute the column, and dated limits that lapse when the account states the result.

source_adds.en: The same question of every term and insight as it appears, one's own included; and that it grew into a status ledger, which sorts standing and not origin.

name.en: Every substantive item here is an assistant's paraphrase, unless in quotation marks

source.locator: Sources, provenance warning

sense.en: Memory files are written to be useful in a later session, not faithful to phrasing, and the two exports are machine summaries of summaries. So nothing from them is quoted as the author's wording unless it stands in quotation marks in the source, and the sources list tags each file by who drafted it.

correspondences.quote: Provenance warning that applies to everything below.

reading.en: The mechanism carried is the label on who made a text or reading and from what: AI readings are marked, literature from the AI's knowledge says so, fronts open 'AI-written', with no independent human review recorded. For a person's words a rule is stated: terms keep their wording where quoted, with source, and a first-person text revised in place names each revised passage, its own last text kept in history. Summaries of a person are not addressed.

says.en: The first-person body of OPENING is revised in place, a note at its top naming each passage revised since its author's own last text, which is kept verbatim in history. The author's terms keep the author's wording where quoted, with their source, and are read like any reading.
The literature here is from the AI's knowledge unless a linked check read it.
The chapter's readings are all AI readings; the source text is evidence of a word's sense, and a quotation is no ground for a claim.

AI-written, 29 October 2026. No independent human review of it is recorded. It adds no result: every theorem it names is stated once, in the home section it links, and it says no more than that statement.

account_adds.en: A numbered register of readings, and the label on each.

source_adds.en: The warning about machine summaries of summaries, and the rule of quoting a person only from what stands in quotation marks. Neither is in the live account.

name.en: Never reduce to one root

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: Called the most important rule in the file: finding the one root and folding everything into it is reductionism performed on the thinking itself. Only a plurality of principles held in tension, each partial and none crowned, can approach adequacy; 'keep them plural' is itself one voice.

correspondences.quote: Never reduce to one root.

reading.en: The account has one grammar, begins from one relational unfolding, the nearest of its words to the interbeing the source demoted to one voice, and states as its target one unified, complete, enclosed theory. It meets the worry elsewhere: root laws forbid no relation, the class is left free, one unfolding is an argued thesis, a root diagram an aid a branch can revise, and 99 of 117 central declarations stand at a named distance. It holds no principles in tension.

says.en: The target: one unified, complete, enclosed theory with zero axioms, meaning no substantive axiom. The necessity is a target, not an axiom, and no impossibility is claimed.

Of 117 central declarations, eleven are derived as cases of grammar laws, one under a stated hypothesis, six are counting, and 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason. 'None is a premise: the condition and C, hypotheses where used, are listed apart.'
A shared law states a mechanism many central results share; the name ranks no law above another and rules nothing.

The account begins from one relational unfolding. A finding in a branch can show a limit of the central account's current articulation and require its revision. A diagram with a root and descendants is an aid, not a finished foundation with applications attached.

Definition. A class is a reflexive, symmetric and transitive relation. Reading [AI reading, D69]: 'the class is plural', the 墨经 naming four samenesses, each a class once its respect is fixed. Plural kinds of sameness, not plural principles.

account_adds.en: A measured edge: how far one root reaches, row by row, and which distances have reasons.

source_adds.en: That adequacy needs several principles held in tension and that unifying is itself the error. The account takes unification as its target, and its live defeaters of the one-unfolding thesis do not include this objection.

name.en: One principle is one model, and one model is smaller than reality

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking, 'Never reduce to one root'

sense.en: The argument behind plurality: any single principle is a model, any model is necessarily smaller than what it models, so no single formulation can be adequate, and a plurality can approach adequacy.

correspondences.quote: one principle is one model, and one model is necessarily smaller than reality

reading.en: The account states the premise: a model represents selected relations. 'Smaller' has exact forms: a selection reaches only what couples into it, and a summary smaller than a history needs its own proof for each question. Plurality has one too: a pool reaches the union of its members' closures and no further, and reaching is not responding. Self-reading stands apart: the diagonal gap holds of a whole family. These concern couplings and maps; reading principles through them is mine.

says.en: The process unfolds; the theory seeks to explain it; a model represents selected relations, and a model formed within the unfolding can take part in it.

Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. That an actual selection goes through the couplings is supplied, not derived.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap). A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; with the members listed and coupling decided, some selection through the pool separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike. Differences beyond the union stay unselected.
Theorem (any process). A configuration can carry the relevant past; any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked.

Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; there, completing it step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns. Coding and provability are not stated.

account_adds.en: The hypotheses under which a gap exists, that a family is complete exactly where all values are equal (values compared decidedly, both types inhabited), and that a pool stays blind beyond the union.

source_adds.en: That a plurality of principles held in tension approaches adequacy, and 'smaller than reality' as a general statement. No law here measures how near.

name.en: Never silently drop; propose the recovered plurality before replacing

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: Old documents stay as the development record. What a consolidation dropped is recovered and goes to the owner for review before anything is written or replaced; every file says what earlier versions lost.

correspondences.quote: Never silently drop; propose the recovered plurality before replacing.

reading.en: The account keeps failures and retired names beside the live statement, which is the keeping half. The review half does not stand there; AGENTS.md, outside the live account, decides what is not the owner's on argument without asking, so the procedure itself differs.

says.en: A thesis adds no theorem, a refutation removes none, and a failure stays recorded beside the thesis.

targets.part: the opening: a failure stays recorded

says.en: Retired labels and names are explained once; two sweeps renamed Lean declarations and left statements and proofs unchanged, and older records and receipts are read through the tables.

account_adds.en: Failed tests stated beside each thesis at the front, with what they count against.

source_adds.en: Recovered material goes to the owner for review before replacement, and each text carries what earlier versions lost. Neither is stated in the live account.

name.en: Lossy consolidation: every update deletes something

source.locator: Reflexes he catches, 6. Lossy consolidation; and 4. Reduction to one root

sense.en: A summarizing collaborator repeatedly loses what mattered, and a memory system whose files are rewritten in place guarantees it. A compressed text is not its author's position, and the warning applies to this whole corpus.

correspondences.quote: every time you update you also delete something important

reading.en: Rewriting in place has the form of the merge laws: a recorder of bounded size does not keep its whole history and go on, and the account reads learners and archives as such recorders and forgetting as a merge, a correspondence. The source's files lose by rewriting, not by a bound, so the law reaches only the bounded case. Which loss matters has a form too: a smaller summary needs its own proof for each question. Nothing is proved of texts.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Within finitely many configurations a law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns; a kept history never returns, so no list holds its course: a recorder of bounded size does not keep its whole history and go on. Reading [AI reading, D65]: learners, archives and genomes are such recorders.

On the levels alone: a family whose stock stays within a bound, exchanged with at arbitrarily late steps, does not carry the count of its exchanges (`Flow.uncarried_of_bounded`), and a finite whole within a bound that keeps exchanging does not carry its history (`World.forgets_of_bounded`).

Theorem (any process). Map a detailed process onto a summary: any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked, and the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget.

Landauer's and Bennett's irreversibility: one merge across computation, heat, extinction and forgetting. The law is proved for determined maps on finitely many listed configurations; its reading across these is a correspondence.

account_adds.en: When a map loses nothing, as an exact condition; and fronts that 'say no more than' the home they link, as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's header states of itself.

source_adds.en: That loss is the standing failure of collaborators and memory systems, and that a compression must not be taken for the position. The live account has no such statement about its own text.

name.en: Refuse 'it is not X, it is Y'; the cut itself is the habit

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking; On writing, 'Affirmative over negation' (a); synthesis-all.md claim 76

sense.en: Framing by 'not this but that' looks at poles and not at relations. The fault lies in the reasoning process as well as its conclusions: splitting the world and siding with one pole is itself the totalizing habit, and it is laid to a Western lens. Keep negation only where the negation is the content.

correspondences.quote: this is a black white framing

reading.en: The account keeps splits and requires each to state its basis and omissions. That narrows the source: a cut is permitted where its relation is reconstructed. The form the source refuses recurs in the live text ('Coupling is not compliance', the words table's 'Not' column), defensibly where the negation is the content, as its rule that a constructive negative stays negative requires. It lays no fault to a culture: no cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method.

says.en: Subject and object, actor and patient, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out; before two terms are treated as independently given, the relation said to join them is reconstructed. Nonduality is a requirement of method and proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method.

account_adds.en: A separate type or question asserts no fundamental separation, and a five-step test for claims of constitutive connection.

source_adds.en: That the cutting is itself the totalizing habit, that it is a Western habit, and that the 'not X but Y' sentence form should be refused as a form.

name.en: Structures are means, judged by one test: does it keep the future open or close it?

source.locator: On thinking, 'Refuse...'; synthesis-all.md claims 64 and 77

sense.en: What follows from refusing the cut: hierarchy and status are not intrinsically bad, distribution is a means and not an end, and a plural world lets parts use different answers. Structure is judged by one test, and the disease is foreclosure, never strength or centralization as such.

correspondences.quote: these are means, not ends

reading.en: The account judges no structure by label and gives the test exact forms: a fixed rule or institution whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening; and a course closing what another admits does not widen it, so C alone requires no ranking of that closing course above the other. So openness belongs to how rules change, not to a structure chosen once. Ranking takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another; widening alone leaves mixed comparisons undecided, and a further stated order can rank them.

says.en: Theorem (any process; witnesses). Where every step from some step on is a move of a process, the possible under it does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

On level paths, a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C does not ask that it be ranked above (`Web.not_widens_of_closes`). C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, a hypothesis where a result takes it.
Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]. A reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice.

The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, widening being one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

account_adds.en: Where the comparison stops deciding: mixed comparisons are decided both ways by positive weightings. And that keeping the possible widening needs rules that change.

source_adds.en: One test for every structure, unconditionally held; ends named outright beside it (non-domination, no capture, flourishing); the ruling that hierarchy and status are to be channelled and not denied; 'disease' as a word. The account's laws on position (rises total falls; position does not protect) rank nothing.

name.en: Answering a claim by diagnosing its frame

source.locator: On thinking, 'Refuse...'; Reflexes, 2. Asymmetric scrutiny

sense.en: A position can be faulted because its reasoning follows a frame, even if its answer is not wholly wrong. A collaborator's default, such as the premise of acceleration, can be traced to the narrative and training text that produced it, and inherited context can be named as the suspect.

correspondences.quote: the reasoning process is itself flawed

reading.en: 08 refuses this move as an answer: that an objection presupposes separate entities or follows a tradition is a claim to show in the case. Its reason is a selection law: reading every objection as capture would take in none. The account does diagnose frames in its own words ('registers' presupposes a knower). The source's diagnosis may be true of a case, and is left to be shown there.

says.en: An objection is answered on what it says. That it presupposes separate entities, or follows a tradition or a thinker, is a claim to be shown in the case, not an answer to it; an account reading every objection as its objector's capture would take in no objection.

account_adds.en: The reason for refusing the move, read through selection through couplings.

source_adds.en: Tracing a default to a dominant narrative in training text, as a working ground for rejecting it. The account has training laws (see the trained-defaults entry) and does not answer a claim by such a trace.

name.en: Asymmetric scrutiny of vocabulary

source.locator: Reflexes he catches, 2

sense.en: Default discourse lets Western terms travel as unmarked universals and flags non-Western ones as loaded. If a flag is warranted for one, it is warranted for the equivalent other, or for neither. Do not reproduce the asymmetry.

correspondences.quote: Asymmetric scrutiny of non-Western vocabulary

reading.en: The account states the symmetry for methods and flags both sides in places: five market-word names, over-allocation as a field's frame, and 道, 仁 declined from the name table with reasons. It states no rule for vocabulary, so the link to terms is this reading's, and the source could press it: the name criterion prefers 'formal, scientific and systems words', a marked origin, and 仁 is declined as carrying value while 'better' stays, flagged as a named premise's free word. Instances seen; no term-by-term check.

says.en: No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method.
Names are structural and exact: formal, scientific and systems words, not dualist, limited-scope, social or financial ones. Five declaration names keep market words, and each receipt lists them.
37 characters are not adopted in the classical name table, each with a reason, such as 道 (as origin, a prior ground) and 仁 (carries value). Not adopting them does not exclude the texts they occur in.
A row's last column: Frank's race between positional and other goods (1985), over-allocation being that field's frame.

account_adds.en: A criterion for names that does not turn on a term's culture of origin.

source_adds.en: The explicit rule for terms, flag both or neither, and the diagnosis that the asymmetry is a trained default. The fronts, chapters and glossary searched do not use the word Western.

name.en: Ground in system dynamics, not in authorities

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On writing, first rule; synthesis-all.md claim 64

sense.en: Reason from feedback loops, attractors, leverage points and selection pressures, not from named or legitimated theories, even high-status ones, which are maps and not territory. A review caught the project importing a leverage hierarchy as an authority, against its own rule.

correspondences.quote: Mechanism before conclusion; ground in system dynamics, not in authorities.

reading.en: The mechanism half is carried: the thesis of one unfolding is, in content, a demand to state the relation that carries what is cited, and no name or tradition settles a claim. The ban on working from named theories is not: the account sets every central result against named prior work, and reaches its verdict on itself that way. So a named result is prior art and a measure, not a warrant.

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued). Its content is a demand on explanations: state the relation that carries what is cited, between which occurrences, where a law or a test can read it.

targets.part: the thesis's content, a demand on explanations

says.en: Proofs check relations under a representation, empirical work tests realization and correspondence, and philosophy examines constitutive identities. No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method.
Readings change no theorem and add no premise; who said a word is provenance and does not settle a reading.
Each central result is set against its closest prior result, with what that result states and the account does not yet.

account_adds.en: Named theories as the measure of what is new, with a column of what they still state beyond the account.

source_adds.en: Systems-theoretic reasoning as the required ground, and named theories to be left out of the reasoning.

name.en: Sort by epistemic status

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: A foundation document is organized by what kind of claim each line is (observations, the trap, the one choice, what it requires, how we reason, unsolved, falsifiers), so that an is-ought smuggle has nowhere to hide. Every claim carries its own mechanism.

correspondences.quote: Sort by epistemic status, and own the one place you cross from is to ought.

reading.en: The same discipline at a finer grain: one label on each result, four layers by how far each has been seen, and evaluation entering a result only through hypotheses its theorem states (the continuation condition, self-concern or C, as each theorem takes them), so every ethical result is Conditional. The categories differ: the source's are observation, choice and requirement; the account's are what proof or argument stands behind a line. A label states how far a claim has been seen, not its mechanism, so 'every claim carries its mechanism' is not what it marks. How many places cross is a separate entry.

says.en: Every result statement opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base: Definition, Theorem, Conditional, Calibration, Thesis, Reading, Assessment, Open.
Sorted by what each part rests on, the whole comes in four layers: with no premise; what each premise adds on the World model; where the dynamics stop deciding; evaluation for any significance.

'No should stands beyond becoming, and no good and evil are set over it: right and wrong, should and better form within it, in people and AI, as every standard does', and no law evaluates. 'The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it, and going on is not yet an order over courses.' 'Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach'; 'The hinge of the ethics is proved on models, on a finite listing, and is near-definitional: where the condition held de se holds, as where relations of being affected close, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above what it widens'.
