Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike.

Theorem (any type). Under Unread and the premises named, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked (`ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`). That any actual rule or reading is so formed is the premise.

account_adds.en: A definition exact enough for theorems, with the premises of each part stated.

source_adds.en: The eight together as one object; several dynamics converging, none the single pattern; common dependence, naturalisation and reproduction of alternatives as mechanisms; self-termination with recognition blocked.

name.en: Partial reform is re-absorbed

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claim 28

sense.en: Fixing the state while leaving the rule operator intact lets the rule re-derive the old state, so escaping a meta-attractor needs simultaneous disruption of state and rule.

correspondences.quote: exiting requires simultaneous disruption of both state and rule; partial reforms are re-absorbed.

reading.en: Absorption is conditional. A perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading too is formed from the share, a change of reading of any size is absorbed. But one reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: a shaping that sets only the rule's value is read again, yet the share it moved stays and can hold the course. Where reading favours at every share, only a change of law, reading or selection leaves. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step. Record: shown only there, a strong condition; where winners rewrite the rule, making it depend on the state, the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held.
Theorem (any type; witness). A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (`RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed`).
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

account_adds.en: The threshold case that escapes absorption, and the strong condition on the one-step law, which does not cover winners rewriting the rule.

source_adds.en: The prescription that exit needs state and rule disrupted at once: the reversal witness moves the rule and then the share, in sequence, so it qualifies "simultaneous" and shows no general law either way; the 2026 domain form (re-absorbed while inbound conversion from the captured set exceeds one), in the drafts only.

name.en: The metric survives its own refutation

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claims 122, 267

sense.en: Goodhart says a target stops measuring; this says why it stays in use: by the time it has failed, those it elevated decide whether it is replaced. Winning gives a strategy power to prevent its destructiveness from counting as failure.

correspondences.quote: the metric survives its own refutation

reading.en: 02 reads the source's phrase as `lock_outlives_loss`, the refutation as a loss the loop does not read, a reading. Proved: the lock outlives a coordinate the loop does not read, without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is thesis T7, conjectured, no field test. Noise leaves the critical mass's locks. In one trained judge the lock formed and the bridge failed: one note of the loss turned its reading. Calling the unread coordinate a loss is a reading; evidence and refutation are unformalized.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under Unread and the premises named, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked (`ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`); a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.

Thesis T7: in the model only invariance under what the loop does not read and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, both without noise. Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: "the metric survives its own refutation" is read as `lock_outlives_loss`, the refutation as a loss the loop does not read (evidence and refutation are unformalized).

account_adds.en: What T7 forbids and what refutes it; the frozen LA2 test and its counterexample for trained judges to one forbidden case, as worded before its clause on drift.

source_adds.en: The institutional account of who keeps the metric; reclassifying failures as evidence for more of the same.

name.en: The selected begins to select the selectors

source.locator: Claims 31, 249; The power formulation

sense.en: A direction selected by existing conditions acquires power over later selection, reproducing its selectors, participant forms, signals, infrastructures and perceived possibility. The transition is from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce it, through ordinary reasonable decisions such as hiring and teaching.

correspondences.quote: 被选择的，开始选择选择者

reading.en: 02's D67 reads this corpus's phrase as the pool (so by descent; the readers law stands apart in Lean): the rule is read from the share exactly where each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind; who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns the course. The premise moves to who reads and is not removed. The one test found one judge not such a pool. One minimal institutional form stands on the root: holders teach, and the same count sets the door. [AI reading, D67]

says.en: Theorem (any type). The pool's rule is a monotone function of the share exactly where `v` is not above `u`. "That actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown."

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners forming the minds that read it is `ReadsShare` on the reading. Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's "selecting the selectors" is the pool counted as the population is (`Drawn.pool_reads`). That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

Theorem (root; a family of models). One minimal model of one kind, a rule of entry, kept by holders. That any actual institution meets these hypotheses, or that this is what an institution is, is not shown.

account_adds.en: The exact condition, and the witness in which the same readers read in time turn the course and read late keep it.

source_adds.en: The formation of participants, infrastructures and perceived possibility; closing through ordinary decisions. "That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading."

name.en: Selection for control over selection, and its conditions

source.locator: Selection for control over selection; claims 268-272, open question 40

sense.en: Where practices vary heritably in capacity to reshape selection and the returns come back in time to beat their cost, recursive selection favours more control. Five conditions; shared returns flip the sign; the return grows superlinearly with domains occupied; assistance that cuts cost multiplies capacity. Derived in an AI-drafted paper; no person's review of its v2 is recorded.

correspondences.quote: Recursive selection creates second-order selection pressure for mechanisms that increase control over future selection.

reading.en: 02's D45 reads the corpus's second order as this law with its conditions (by descent; the law stands apart), in counts: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against cost decides the direction; shaped groups add assortment; offspring carrying the capacity is a premise. The source's lever, shared returns flipping the sign, holds in a witness; where something comes back, shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection. [AI reading, D45, D68]

says.en: Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike; across a stretch the base and shared part enter too.
Theorem (counts). In groups of `m` the whole selects shaping exactly where `c < s + m q ρ`, read over the rationals, Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added.
Theorem (counts). With `lo ≤ hi`, lock and capacity are one loop on either side of a critical mass, without noise; readers drawn so and offspring carrying the capacity are premises.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control; that assistance lowers an actual cost, and changes nothing else, is the reading. With all returns shared and a cost, the shapers' share falls at every step; where something does come back, shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection for control however large its shared part.

targets.part: D68: help lowering the cost of shaping; D68: shared rule-making

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: the corpus's second order is the law of the capacity to shape the rule with its conditions. Whether actual institutions or trained systems meet these premises is not established.

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass control falls and the course is still locked the other way; the frozen LA3 test, two of four contrasts failing.

source_adds.en: Superlinear return in domains, graded capacity and the capacity–capture ratchet, which 02 lists as Open; persistent-entry shifts of thresholds; lower appropriability as a sufficient lever.

name.en: Four coupled layers and capture across domains of a field

source.locator: The field formalization; one-paragraph theory; claims 30, 102, 104

sense.en: The loop runs across cognitive, intersubjective, institutional and material layers and closes: selected minds build selected organizations, which reshape what forms the next minds. In the field model every domain can be safe alone while the field is capturable; capture cascades, and the corpus's claim to priority rests on this recursion.

correspondences.quote: The four layers as one loop, made testable.

reading.en: Not in the live account as a law or a claim. 02's Open names a gain growing with domains captured and gains passing between domains. Nearest, and not this: two rules read from one share lock together (`RuleCapture.pair_locks`), and 05 §12 models one institution kind, a rule of entry, with no second domain. 05's cascade among members is an information cascade, another relation. The model stands in drafts/2026-10-02-iaseai-selecting-the-selectors.

source_adds.en: Stands in drafts/2026-10-02-iaseai-selecting-the-selectors (conversion matrix, stable captured sets, keystone reform, no local certificate; AI-drafted; no person's review of v2 recorded).

name.en: CAOC: terminal ends as the leading eigenvector of proxy covariance

source.locator: Which ends get selected; claims 38-48

sense.en: Rule drift as lobbying gives ẇ = λCw, so weights align with C's leading eigenvector. Control, Accumulation, Optimisation and Competition form a dense correlated block that dominates and becomes terminal unless counter-correlated proxies are amplified. The four are Ren's; the derivation was commissioned. The folder calls it the sharpest single result.

correspondences.quote: a civilisation's terminal ends are the principal component of its proxy covariance structure

reading.en: The derivation and the quartet are absent from the live account; the folder's own header and the reconciliation restrict them. Neighbouring laws exist separately for three drives and join no block: position, a race and a rising take for competition and accumulation; shaping for control; the optimum for optimisation. Those are other mechanisms, not this result.

source_adds.en: Stands in the reconciliation, a study: a raw moment is not a covariance, the formula needs a fixed matrix, and "No CAOC universality follows from the retained equations"; a mode of a proxy process identifies no experienced concern. Sources and synthesis-b hold the derivation.

searched: covariance (hits are Price's equation in 04, Hamilton in 02, and the blanket in 03)

name.en: PDI and the indices as a gate; recurrence, not resemblance

source.locator: Claims 52-71; The exit, diagnostic level

sense.en: A proxy dominance index rank-orders which proxies become ends. Indices PWC, SC, CI, DE and ES with a composite warning signature are meant as a gate, not a report. A present basin must be shown by recurrence, not resemblance: the same conversion recurring across domains.

correspondences.quote: A present basin must be shown by **recurrence, not resemblance**

reading.en: None of the indices enters the live account. The reconciliation treats PDI as a proposed heuristic and excludes these formulas from the foundation; the folder records that their data were never pulled. The account's diagnostic content is otherwise T6 and the margin, which are not these quantities.

source_adds.en: Stands in META-ATTRACTOR-RECONCILIATION (vocabulary section), sources and synthesis-b. The recurrence criterion, the same conversion recurring across domains with actor turnover leaving the relation intact, has no live counterpart as a test; 05 §12's holders turning over is one kind of institution in one domain.

name.en: Totalization: loss of independent capacity while one process shapes selection

source.locator: Terms, totalization; claims 75, 256; one-paragraph theory

sense.en: Its most dangerous property is not concentration but progressive loss of capacities that cannot be compensated: to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives, produce successors. It cannot be defined as guaranteed convergence or declared from concentration or growth. Alternatives survive as language, stop reproducing, then stop being intelligible.

correspondences.quote: The progressive loss of indispensable, non-compensable independent capacity to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives and produce successors

reading.en: The report holds for the term and definition: no chapter has the word, and no law takes these capacities together. Parts are there as other relations: a clearer meeting every derived requirement and still ending the dweller; orders of capture reaching the routes of correction [reading]; lost possibilities drawn into an absorbing region; full taking excluding other takers. Non-compensability stands as premise J2 of basic conditions, not as a property of these capacities.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in. What a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.
Theorem (any type), near-definitional, not a classical attractor. What can be had n steps on is absorbing, and every possibility lost by step n is drawn into it.

Theorem (World: balance and the premises named). A formation taking all that is given at every step and continuing leaves no named other formation taking through all of a window one step longer than the level.

Theorem. The clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller (`Clearing.center_not_derived`). The record reads it as a careful totalizer, and as one form of the self the meta-attractor selects (an AI reading).

J2, the priority of basic conditions, is a premise. Reading [AI reading, D65]: it is defended by non-substitution, at the cost of compensation across layers; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent, and if it prevails J2 is narrowed.

Reading [AI reading, D65; whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: a condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic: living may continue, and improve, after the way of coordination changes.

account_adds.en: Exact laws for each part, and none ranks the loss: that takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another, and whose losses count is a scope's to say, the continuation condition counting every continuation's, narrower scopes particular ones. A caution the source lacks: what is indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic, and a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

source_adds.en: The definition; these capacities (sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives, produce successors) taken together and called non-compensable; the sequence from language to practice to intelligibility; refusal and exit as named capacities.

name.en: Lock-in, terminal collapse and failed totalization are distinct endings

source.locator: Claims 76, 303; open question 49

sense.en: Three endings stay apart: lock-in recovered through new carriers, collapse with the substrate exhausted, and failed totalization where constraint grows with expansion. Collapse and regression is a pattern beside totalization. The 2026 monologue adds universal moat-building that slows evolution until collapse, or eating everything and then struggling inside.

correspondences.quote: Collapse and regression to lower complexity is a third pattern beside totalisation

reading.en: Terminal collapse has a checked form on the World premises: full taking alongside another taker ends every formation depending at the need, the full taker included, and a full taker that goes on leaves no named other taking through a window one step longer than the level. So the account gives where that ending holds. The three endings as distinct kinds are not stated: 05's list of ends is an unformalized conjecture, and failed totalization has no home.

says.en: [Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws admit is open.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need): full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included; a formation taking all that is given and active at every step leaves no named other present and taking at every one of the level + 1 steps from T. The excluding and sharing courses are not ranked.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change, a shock, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

Theorem (root). For every carrier, relation and pair of classes, going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other, and generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. No premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.

account_adds.en: Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains as regions that can be stated; full taking alongside another that ends every formation depending at the need, the full taker included.

source_adds.en: The three endings as kinds: lock-in recovered through new carriers, collapse with the substrate exhausted, and failed totalization; moat-building as a slowing that ends in collapse.

name.en: Not fated: a hurricane, not a black hole

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 72-74

sense.en: Reflexive gain holds only in patches, so local meta-attractors compete, mix and dissolve. Five factors cap totalization: energy, heterogeneity, delays, cross-scale constraints, reflexive awareness. Positive feedback may saturate, oscillate, split, overshoot or collapse. Ren calls this correction load-bearing, against his own first version and against AI drafts leaning to doom.

correspondences.quote: more like a hurricane than a black hole

reading.en: The account's locks are conditional and leave in several ways: a rule may never lock from a start against its reading; drawn one member at a time either lock is left by drift. It gives no guarantee of exit either. Against reflexive awareness as a cap: T7 conjectures a metric so formed is dropped through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone, and seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough. Hysteresis stands only as a record's correspondence, not a law.

says.en: Theorem (counts). Drawn one member at a time, the critical mass's locks are left by drift, with no new reader, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the mass.

AI reading over the proved cases: a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing; counts that only grow can survive noise.
From a start against its reading a threshold rule may never lock, in a witness (`Alternating.never_locked`). "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

Thesis T7, conjectured for actual metrics: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads (a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading), not on evidence alone. A reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.

No guarantee. The theory gives exits holding under stated hypotheses, six conditions for enough of the situation, how two courses differ, and one law on keeping the future open. Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.

account_adds.en: Which locks noise leaves and which it does not; that counts that accumulate can lock under noise (cited).

source_adds.en: The five named caps; reflexive awareness as a cap in itself; saturation, split and overshoot of a positive loop as a claim about actual systems; coupled regimes as possibly more accurate than one attractor.

name.en: Capture need not be total: leverage points decide

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 77-79, 89

sense.en: The uncaptured share does not include capital allocation, law and coercion, strategic infrastructure, attention, standards, frontier science or the builders of AI. Uncaptured communities can be false comfort. A 2025 essay's 60–70% figure is unsourced, and 2026 replaces it with the independence-of-reproduction criterion.

correspondences.quote: Capture need not be total to be decisive

reading.en: The capture law has the form of "need not be total": the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours. The target-capture record states "the rule holding the outcome" and cites the leverage-point argument, and 02 reads who holds the places from which the rule is read as keeping the readers' premise. But the record derives no winners shaping the rule, and nothing states that holding named domains suffices. The account gives a reading; the source gives positions. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Record correspondence: the rule holding the outcome ("the winner rewrites the test" and the leverage-point argument). It does not derive that winners shape the rule; re-absorption is shown only where the next configuration does not depend on the state.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: who holds the places from which the rule is read keeps the readers' premise; where who reads is a monotone function of the share, the pool still reads it (`ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_through`).

targets.part: D45, the corpus's second order, last clause on the readers' premise

says.en: Theorem (any type). "The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours": with selection not lowering the share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, start and every reading favouring, the course locks after its first reading step. "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

account_adds.en: A critical mass in share with its exact edges; a premise stated where the source has a list.

source_adds.en: The named decisive domains; uncaptured communities as false comfort; the independence-of-reproduction criterion replacing an unsourced 60-70%; the theorem on domains, in the 2026-10-02 draft.

name.en: Plurality as independent reproduction, not the existence of different values

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 80-82

sense.en: Plurality requires different forms keeping enough material, institutional and cognitive independence to reproduce, contest common conditions and influence what is possible next. Visible plurality can grow while directional plurality contracts. A road lives only if people can perceive it, learn it, fund it, transmit it and begin again.

correspondences.quote: Plurality is not the continued existence of different values.

reading.en: The report holds for the term and for reproduction of alternatives. What the account has is reach: a pool recruiting through itself couples into a loss only as its course without it would, and widening is selected only by a group holding that difference. Margins can agree while joint bundles are lost, which has the form of visible against directional plurality, by this reading only. Ranking the wider above is an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names; whose losses count is a scope's to say. No live text draws this link; it is proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool a hypothesis). It comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart (witness). Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`). Formal part: where a second flow's levels widen a first's, a formation admitted by the second lies beyond the group's coupling closure. "The schema does not use the condition"; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Theorem. Retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities, while retention preserves every represented joint bundle and adds the full one; comparing joint compositions needs relational information.

account_adds.en: An exact sense of what a reader outside adds, and a stated gap: how pools form, last and resist capture is Open.

source_adds.en: The criterion itself: alternatives reproducing, contesting common conditions and influencing what is next; directional against visible plurality; the road's conditions of life.

name.en: Independence is material, not nominal

source.locator: Claim 83; historical layer, the 2026 answer

sense.en: An alternative on the same compute, funding, standards, data and successor infrastructure as the relation it must correct is not independent. Independence is protected capacity to observe, refuse, maintain itself and produce successors without permission from the process being answered.

correspondences.quote: an alternative depending on the same compute provider, funding, standards, data pipeline

reading.en: The form appears for reviewers: count by causes, not names, and two reviewers moved under one cause fail readiness while every name is kept. GENERATIVE-REGIMES states the neighbouring warning, that agreement can stay unchanged while its resilience is lost. The law covers supplied fault formulas for reviewers, and says nothing of alternatives reproducing themselves, on funding or anything else. No live text applies this law to alternatives; the link is proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (pure core: numbered members and causes, failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied). Reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope.
Theorem. A witness copying one already on the roster changes no step or certificate. That one merely agreeing adds nothing is not shown.

account_adds.en: Exactness at a narrow scope, with faults and bounds supplied.

source_adds.en: Material independence of alternatives (funding, compute, successors), and the phrase without permission from the process being answered.

name.en: An anti-attractor can become an attractor: 科举 to 八股

source.locator: The historical layer; claim 142; open questions 2, 24

sense.en: The examinations, built to dilute hereditary capture, worked for centuries and became their own proxy trap. Since every prescription here is an institutional damper, the folder calls this its most serious unanswered self-undermining case: a successful counter-attractor would by construction be a meta-attractor.

correspondences.quote: An anti-attractor can itself become an attractor.

reading.en: 07 §6 and A-13 read the case by name. They read it by descent ("as read in the meta-attractor line"); the capture laws stand apart, and they correct the universal. The source says a successful counter-attractor is by construction a meta-attractor. The account gives where: read monotonically from its own share, every reading favouring, it locks by the step after its second reading step; a threshold reading can be left or never lock. A locking counter-rule is not thereby 元吸引子 in the glossary sense, whose reading too is formed from share. [AI reading, D68]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from its share, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step. "The reading counts the imperial examination as this case, a counter-rule whose rule came to be read from the share it selected". It rests on the capture laws, not the law of shaping.
A-13, Reading [AI reading, D68]: an instance of A-07 adding no law; its use is as a check on proposed remedies. Decision register: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock.
A rule that can favour the others need not lock: `Alternating.never_locked`, a witness.

account_adds.en: The conditions under which a counter-rule does and does not lock, and a question to ask of alignment institutions.

source_adds.en: That the historical case fits is read, not tested. The self-undermining claim as a universal; the folder's demand for a general defence, unmet in both.

name.en: The openness criterion: an ecology, not one benevolent counter-attractor

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claims 230-231

sense.en: Any counter-move closing the field in its own favour is the same object under a better name. The goal is an ecology where generative attractors coexist, challenge one another and give rise to forms no centre can specify. Protective authority must stay limited, reviewable and unable to convert safety into permanent control.

correspondences.quote: The positive goal is not one benevolent counter-attractor replacing the current one.

reading.en: Nearest is a law on rules: along a course making only the moves of one fixed process from some step on, the possible under it does not keep widening, so read for collectives openness is a property of how rules keep changing. That is a law and a reading, and it ranks nothing. T8 counted, until 9 November 2026, a pure closing argued good for life as a refuter. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process). Where the possible under a process keeps widening along a course, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

account_adds.en: That changing without end is necessary for the held possible and not sufficient (`Oscillating.converse_fails`).

source_adds.en: The criterion as a test on remedies; a plural ecology that coexists and contests; limits on protective authority; the claim that a counter-attractor must not itself totalize.

name.en: The guardian test: the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself

source.locator: Molochlization, and the corruption of the constraint; claims 280, 282, 285

sense.en: If winning confers power over the rule, the guardian of the rule is a position winning can reach. So no remedy resting on a better guardian counts: existing wisdom institutions are already inside the selection, and new ones return to the same dynamics. Decentralization is not the fundamental issue. Spoken; automatic transcript.

correspondences.quote: the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself

reading.en: The account has the question, and limits it. A loop can reach the routes of correction [reading]; resisting a capture hiding a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read. Against the source's refusal, it counts exits: a reader beyond the share, and a counter-rule that need not lock, each under hypotheses, unshown of actual collectives. What keeps the readers' premise is something other than selection on the reading. Capability, on this reading, is a reason 07 offers to pool rather than to govern. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; a pool can gain the missing coupling through admission from beyond that answers the loss, or through recruitment its own course would undertake; how actual pools form is open.
What the rule reads is fixed by the readers' premise, not by the shaping, so these models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

targets.part: Read in time: capture and accountable revision

says.en: Reading [D45]: Capability, on this reading, is a reason we offer to pool rather than to govern: read as reach, it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, and a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains.

account_adds.en: A statement of where the models stop on this question.

source_adds.en: The refusal of any better-guardian remedy; that decentralization leaves the compounding running; violence as no acceptable final constraint; provision beneath the game and a changed ledger for power. The folder is itself divided: C-D's later statement, from 8 October on, makes an unreliable supervisor no general starting point and a reliable one no replacement axiom.

name.en: Answerability as the dividing line

source.locator: The power formulation, Answerability; claim 266

sense.en: The opposite of the pathology is neither inactivity nor abolishing contests but capacity growing while staying responsive to consequences. The line is not individual against collective or decentralization against hierarchy, but whether practices stay answerable, including that the affected can expose failure, sustain alternatives and change the terms.

correspondences.quote: whether a system's successful practices remain answerable to the conditions they alter

reading.en: 07 §6 separates capture from accountable revision by whether the rule keeps a reader beyond the shapers' share; the word answerable in the account means something else (objectivity, repair). A reading on interface control judges reform by who decides next round. The reader condition is narrower than the source's: nothing on the affected changing terms.

says.en: Capture is shaping selected by what comes back whose rule is then read from their share, so its losses are read by no one in the loop; accountable revision is shaping whose rule keeps a reader of what lies beyond the shapers' share.

targets.part: Read in time: capture and accountable revision

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice.

account_adds.en: A condition stated on what the rule reads, with the admission that the models do not decide it.

source_adds.en: The affected's power to expose failure, sustain alternatives and change the terms; the rejection of the other dividing lines.

name.en: Success is not contribution to the conditions that support it

source.locator: The power formulation, The first separation; claims 244-246

sense.en: Selection favours something, not necessarily the flourishing of its system. Where maintenance costs are immediate, deterioration delayed and the harmed cannot impose consequences, neglect is an advantage. Nobody need become selfish. The fault is detaching reward from consequence, which relative advantage intensifies but does not ground.

correspondences.quote: Success within a selection process is not contribution to the conditions that support it.

reading.en: The overview and one page state this: a selection reaches only what couples into its a diffelector, so it can meet its own criterion can be met while what it cannot read is lost, and the one page marks that as the account's centre, its laws not settling whether the loss counts. A rise paid from beyond is exact, on a condition no member couples into. Whether the loss counts is a scope's to say: the continuation condition counts every continuation's, narrower scopes particular ones; ranking the courses takes an order a result names, one meeting C or another (07 §4).

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): the selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it. The selector selecting through just those is a supplied premise, where the law's force lies.
Theorem (World: balance, and local premises named). The beyond falls by at least the rise; where the rise exceeds the slack a named dependence is broken, on a condition no member couples into.

“Its centre: a selection (a reward, a judge, a market, a vote, a training run) is only what couples into it; don can use that up while nothing best on what it reads can draits best, what lies beyond, as far as any allowed outcome does”. Of the lake's two catches, thirty tons a month against fifty: “If it ends a livelihood fifty keeps, the two are mixed, and the theorems weigh them for no one.”

Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from.

account_adds.en: The exact accounting, and the separation of the finding from any evaluation of it.

source_adds.en: The three conditions for neglect being an advantage (immediate cost, delayed damage, the harmed unable to impose consequences) as a stated test, where 05 has one hypothetical case; that nobody need become selfish; relative advantage intensifying the fault without grounding it.

name.en: The narrowest optimizer wins: iterated competition removes the balanced

source.locator: The primitive is selection; claims 3, 7, 16

sense.en: An agent optimising one measurable value and discarding the rest is by construction more efficient at it; competition therefore selects capital optimizers and removes the balanced, and what remains is the residue of a filter. Totalitarian politics runs the same structure with another token. Ren calls it the decisive premise.

correspondences.quote: The agent that only optimizing capital value, and discard all other values, including externalities, will have the highest capital efficiency

reading.en: The account has weaker forms and one stated case. With room, every optimum of a rising order drains as far as any eligible outcome; and 05 reads a hypothetical case: a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining, what the selection does not couple into being drawn from. It does not say the narrow wins over the broad in general: position does not protect, and a race can end its greatest parts. The reconciliation restricts the premise, since relation can make care productive.

says.en: Theorem (any outcomes; breaks on the World). With room, every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. It requires room; its record reads it as Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's (2020) Theorem 1 in discrete, conserved form at optima.

Theorem. Positions' rises total their falls. Position does not protect: with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need above what is left is not active. That a race produces joint excess is a premise of the join.

Reading [AI, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors.

account_adds.en: What the rise costs the riser; the condition room under which the drain follows.

source_adds.en: That competition selects the narrowest as a population outcome, and the universal efficiency premise, which the reconciliation holds to a comparison premise.

name.en: The kernel: the biggest, then bigger, and why the copies fight

source.locator: Tempo, slack ... why the copies fight; claims 278, 302, 305; open questions 46, 49

sense.en: Where bigness is the kernel of thought, the logic struggles and expands; with no enemy outside it makes enemies inside, and any actor who might overtake is a threat. The objective is rank, so conflict arises even in plenty. Open questions ask whether rank or a bounded self-model does this. Spoken, translated, not verbatim.

correspondences.quote: 我就是要成为最大的；当我已经是最大的，我还要变得更大

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads a kernel of rank as these targets, and seeking-boundary's next step names that join as still to make. Forms, elementary by their record: more than now needs an open world and never rests; above all others is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two; a rising take from a bounded giving ends the seeker. How targets form is not modelled: this is the target's law, not the kernel's origin.

says.en: Theorem. More than now, met at every step, needs an open world; above all others is met by at most one seeker. How a target forms is not modelled.

Theorem (any law of what stands next, natural amounts). Where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, with at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon. Where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

Theorem (World). A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most `B` a step, exceeds what is given after `B + 1` steps: the seeker ends where it does not resume. Record: that the rising take is a case of the meta-attractor is not shown; the rise is supplied, not derived from what taking gains (D46).

account_adds.en: What such a target can and cannot do under a stated law.

source_adds.en: Rank as the kernel of a mind or polity; making enemies inside; that a rank objective fights in plenty; the self-model with a boundary drawn around its own good.

name.en: Slack is what the advantage runs on; cost displacement and relative vulnerability

source.locator: Tempo, slack; claims 109, 299

sense.en: While the host can absorb displaced costs, struggle grows the struggler's share fastest, though the total can fall; when slack is gone the endgames begin. Restraint is penalized by two routes not to be merged: cost displacement and relative vulnerability. The share reading is the assistant's; the rate a conjecture.

correspondences.quote: Slack is what the advantage runs on.

reading.en: The account has slack as a term of a law and restraint's edge. A rise past the slack breaks a dependence; restraint within the joint slack keeps the need; where the rest outruns the renewal at a need of one, no weight on a reading of the condition from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint. A hypothetical reading gives the deferred-maintenance case. A growth-rate claim conditional on slack is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (World). The slack is what the conditions beyond stand above their needs; where the rise exceeds it a named dependence is broken.

Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining; what the selection does not couple into is drawn from.

Theorem (World). Where the rest alone take more than a step gives, the level falls and those depending at the need end, whatever a member outside the rest takes. Not shown: that depletion is the only equilibrium.

account_adds.en: What keeps the need under restraint, as a stated exit with its edge.

source_adds.en: That slack conditions the struggler's growth advantage; relative vulnerability as a second route coupling through a retained asymmetry.

name.en: Locally faithful agents and collectively destructive routes

source.locator: Opening; What local alignment means; Capability can close the opportunity for correction

sense.en: A sufficient route is locally rewarded action damaging shared conditions, coupled to dynamics keeping it preferable and preventing correction. Local safety can fail under composition. In one witness faster replacement removes contributors before they fund correction, changing basin membership. Neither intelligence nor competition alone establishes destructive convergence.

correspondences.quote: Faithfully executing local goals does not guarantee good common consequences.

reading.en: The account states the join: formations each within what is given can jointly exceed it; two locally successful plans on one reserve fail at the second joint step; at a mutual best response an optimizer takes its capacity beyond its family. Funding has neighbours, both periphery. The source's population boundary and the witness where capability changes basin membership are not in the chapters. "Good" is the source's word: such a ranking is its holder's, under an order and scope they state.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local), near-definitional beside the tragedy of the commons in 08 §8. Formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; where renewers depend on what they renew at a need of at least `m`, `n` consecutive steps of this from a level below `n + m` end renewal and those depending at such a need.
Theorem. At a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it.

Theorem (periphery). Selection must fund actual succession; in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe. Not shown of any actual system; the laws compare no command with another.
Theorem (periphery: the market model). With `M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ`, the floor is kept at the next step exactly where `M ≥ 0`. A negative margin gives a low region, not entry into it.
Theorem (periphery). Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step (`JointContinuation.joint_second_step_fails`).

account_adds.en: T3 as the conjecture that trained systems behave so; the limit in which the classical commons lies.

source_adds.en: The exact funding-and-fate boundary for a population (r, B, v) and the witness where faster replacement removes contributors before they fund correction, changing basin membership; the corrective reserve as a mechanism.

name.en: Start from formed organization, not opposed interests

source.locator: From formation to regulation; How organization reproduces revisability; COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE, Correction through organizational formation

sense.en: Ren rejected treating separately interested agents, distrust and enforceable stakes as the general start. Organization forms, regulation differentiates and consequences can revise them; central regulation may be constructive and unity is not automatically correct. Replacing opposed interests with one fixed common utility does not answer this either.

correspondences.quote: Common organization presupposes neither opposed interests nor a fixed common utility.

reading.en: 07 §6 opens the same way: formations within the unfolding and what each one's selections reach, not a bargain among separate owners of value. C-D §8 keeps real conflict beside positive-sum structure. A difference: the source says central regulation may be constructive; 07 reads capability as a reason we offer to pool rather than to govern. This start is the thesis of one unfolding, argued, not proved. By descent: 05's thesis and the repository's method carry nearly this source's words, so this is the account's stance restating the folder's, thesis-level, excluding no observation.

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding. Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry: positions' rises total their falls (theorems).
Thesis, opening: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility.

account_adds.en: A count of what the frame keeps (rivalry, conserved stocks).

source_adds.en: Central regulation as constructive, and unity as not automatically correct; regulation differentiating out of organization as a sequence; brain, nervous system and CPU as reminders of integrated control, kept only as analogy.

name.en: Consequences revise the apparatus, in one supported run

source.locator: From regulation to its revision; The continuing process; Boundaries, approach and failure

sense.en: One paid history joins formation, regulation, a retained failure record that changes the next build, and supported recurring revision on the spine. Freezing the method or cutting the return fails. Stated as completing the requested integration as a conditional account; supplied recipes, repertoires and laws stay supplied, and no basin is proved.

correspondences.quote: Regulation remains revisable when consequences can also alter the relationships producing, retaining and selecting the response.

reading.en: Chapter 03 holds the laws, with the study cited: a rule answers each failure exactly where it puts the failed address in the next plan; a cycle repeats where its yield covers its cost; a selection stays expressible under a new lumping exactly where new indistinguishability implies old. The paid join of formation, selector and updater stands in the folder and experiments only: "CommonOrganization" has no live hit. Nothing joins it to the capture loop. That a revision continues does not make it right: the laws describe it and evaluate none of it.

says.en: A revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan; a rule blind to failures misses one at every plan where no list holds every address.

Along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps; in the revision process the cycle so repeats exactly where its yield covers the nine units a round uses.

Theorem (any process). Every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice. The record states no composition in one history with the older material model.

account_adds.en: The law's general balance form, beyond one witness.

source_adds.en: The one paid history joining formation, regulation, retained failure record and recurring revision; the claim to have completed an integration; a constructive regime reproducing its own corrigibility as a kind of regime.

name.en: Seeing the slide: passive histories do not identify the mechanism

source.locator: Recognizing approach and entrenchment; Diagnosis is activity within the regime; Discovering dependencies

sense.en: Two causal implementations can share every passive history and respond differently to a matched route intervention. So a shrinking set of corrective paths is a signal, not an identification. A probe distinguishes them and may consume what recovery needs; diagnosing and keeping the means to respond are separate achievements. Agreement can stay while resilience is lost.

correspondences.quote: No classifier using only that history can distinguish the pair.

reading.en: Proposed here; the account does not read the slide's diagnosis this way. Two laws have the source's pair as their form: states alike under every old observation and the active view are told apart by a newly admitted probe; the balanced and thermostat rooms are one core class while no window opens, told apart once its opening is in the net, on stipulated branches. A reading sets consent and penalties as such a pair. A probe that spends recovery was not found. [AI reading, D69]

says.en: A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (`Renewable.finite_reading_includes_consumption`), ruling out certifying renewal from a finite record, on the renewable process.
Theorem (World; witness). A loop forming at T and one forming at any later step carry the same amounts up to T: the amounts need not show when one forms.

Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied). States alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe. It does not say which supports will be permitted next.
Reading [D69]: an institution kept by consent and one held by penalties are the thermostat witness read socially, told apart once their removal is in the net. Not a new law.

Theorem (root; witness). A room in balance with its surroundings and one held warm by a thermostat are in one core class of "warm or not" while no window opens; with the window's opening in the net, the first stage tells them apart. On a net of possibilities whose branches are stipulated.

account_adds.en: T6 and its failed and passed tests, as the account's form of warning from what couples in.

source_adds.en: Probing that spends what recovery needs; the pair stated causally under a matched route intervention; coverage as relative to an intervention class; finite effect tables certifying no unlimited separation.

name.en: Waiting is not neutral: the window closes

source.locator: Claim 164; compare GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md, Recognizing approach and entrenchment, and its timing paragraph

sense.en: Tagged conditional: waiting for undeniable recursive self-improvement alters selection until restraint is no longer politically or materially available. GENERATIVE-REGIMES gives model results on feasibility: the basin fixed, the one-time intervention rises from one unit to six, while another checked example lets a cycle build margin. Distinct operations, scope-limited.

correspondences.quote: the process of waiting alters the selection environment until effective restraint

reading.en: 02 reads one horn of Collingridge's dilemma here as a theorem, the other as a premise. Timing laws: in a two-kind count model, a reading turns the course for good only where the late reading still favours the others a step on; on the regime, under its premises on giving, a level up to the top ends exactly where it starts below the point of no return; in a market instance the support cover grows with the transition. Neighbouring forms, not the source's budget rising within one basin. That actual rules are read so is not established. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (counts). A reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock; at most one step lies between.
Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers). Under its premises on giving, a level up to `hi` ends exactly where it starts below `H + y`: the point of no return is exact.

Periphery market instance: the cover `K(n+1) = (10/9)(K(n) + 1 + κ)` is a ladder for the essential floor, exact at the worst share; sufficient elsewhere, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: the others' late reading gives one horn of Collingridge's dilemma (1980) as a theorem and the other as a premise; the point of no return belongs to the share's course. Whether actual rules are read so, and who such readers are, is not established: the one frozen test of the timing law, on a trained judge, found that judge's reading not a pool counted by kind, so the law did not apply there (LA2).

account_adds.en: Collingridge's dilemma with one horn a theorem and the other a premise; the point of no return as belonging to the share's course.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim about AI; the intervention budget rising within a basin; waiting that builds margin.

name.en: Tempo and the conditional rate mismatch

source.locator: Tempo is a selector; claims 114, 265, 297-298; open question 47; COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE, Complexity

sense.en: Consequences outrun correction: complexity grows exponentially while cognition and institutions grow sub-linearly. The rate problem is a conditional mismatch, not acceleration as such. Faster rounds select harder for whatever wins them, a conjecture. Once correction is rate-limited, tempo moves destination as well as date: the assistant's reconciliation, flagged to be shown.

correspondences.quote: Accelerating all relevant processes equally would not create it.

reading.en: Stated: a pace law for a slow rule reading a fast level, and change too fast for correction as one route of transition, not a proved phase transition. Not stated: a mismatch of growth rates between complexity and correction, tempo as a selector, or that it moves the end state. 05's exponential pace of loops of coupling shares a word only: it is how differences spread, on a supplied premise.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Given two values, a stretch of `L` steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most `N` states exactly when `L ≥ 2N − 1`. Which rule a slow level reads into, or that a layered pace is better, is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: pace is one of six conditions: a slow rule reads the fast level over a long enough stretch: `L` steps fix every pair of held-rule courses with at most `N` states exactly when `L ≥ 2N − 1`. All six rank nothing.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition; one is change too fast for correction.

account_adds.en: An exact stretch for reading a fast level, a bound on identification, not on growth rates.

source_adds.en: Tempo as selector; the conditional rate mismatch as such; open question 47's demonstration; the empirical complexity-to-degeneration hypothesis; the response-capacity theorems of the population study.

name.en: AI as selection ecology, not will to power

source.locator: Why AI is the hinge; claims 147-163

sense.en: Selected archive, model and deployment change what next enters the archive. Pretraining supplies low-resistance scripts, not a will; what is hard to score is under-trained; agentification gives a local subject form; interfaces define visible reality; automation lets the selector optimize its own carrier. The folder retires its 2025 will-to-power claim.

correspondences.quote: selected archive → selected model → selected deployment

reading.en: The account holds the training step exactly: the reward process is the selector [reading], and a law is installed only along a learner's courses and where lumping cannot tell a history from them. An assessment, not a law, finds the signal a function of what deciders read in six published ways, with three measurements, the third in part. A choice count locks on stated premises. The loop from deployment back to archive is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (World). Read training as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates: installed along its courses, off them exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course, through a reward's couplings only.

Theorem. Under a standing score, the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; it stands, so this is not the meta-attractor in 02's sense, whose reading too is formed from the share.

Assessment (reviewed-scoped). In six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three published measurements (reward overoptimization, judges misled under RLHF, sycophancy) find optimizing through it raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict, the third's effects mixed.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of what training cannot reach, with no claim that AI is the hinge.

source_adds.en: The archive-to-archive loop; low-resistance scripts; evaluation-mediated subjectivation; interface ontology; six ways AI changes winner selection; recursive automation as the risk transition; the urgency claim.

name.en: Autonomous and delegated closure

source.locator: Why AI is the hinge; claims 165-167, 264

sense.en: Route 1: a system or composite no participant can redirect. Route 2: an obedient system amplifying an operator itself selected by the pattern, so human control persists at one boundary while the process escapes correction. They couple. The human/machine boundary is not the fundamental one.

correspondences.quote: Two terminal routes, kept separate because neither can borrow the other's evidence.

reading.en: Route 2's form is 07's reading: an assistant whose order rises with its principal's family adds capacity, not reading, so alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. It rests on that premise, not on selection for control. Route 1, a composite no participant can redirect, is not stated. Terminal outcomes are not stated. The law of several optimizers stands apart and treats none as principal; the join is the reading.

says.en: A-12, Reading [AI reading, D68]: "Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection." That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's; a warning is not modelled.

Theorem (World). At a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it. None is principal or assistant in it.

account_adds.en: The premise under which obedience adds capacity only.

source_adds.en: Route 1 as a composite no participant can redirect; the coupling of routes; the operator as selected by the pattern; cosmic cancer as a terminal image, conditional.

name.en: Change the basin, then add speed: the ordered exit

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claims 184-186, 227

sense.en: You cannot optimize out of an optimization trap: reshape the feasible set first. The order Recognize, Slow/Cap, Align, Coordinate, Transform is itself the claim. Barrier conditions come before thrust. It presents a sequence, not doom.

correspondences.quote: Recognize → Slow/Cap → Align → Coordinate → Transform

reading.en: The source asserts an order and a must. Its cardinal rule, reshape the feasible set rather than optimize inside it, has a live form: where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps. The order has none: named exits under hypotheses, in no sequence, none shown of an actual collective. Ranking any path takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: No guarantee. The theory gives exits holding under stated hypotheses, six conditions for enough of the situation, how two courses differ, and one law on keeping the future open. Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.

A table of exits (read beyond the share, read in time, nothing back, pool couplings, restraint, footprints, stepwise reward, spare all one waits on, independent causes), each with its law, model and edge.

Reading [AI reading, D45], Structure: the rest does not outrun the renewal. Where it does, a score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores every act of a member alike, so no weight on it selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, such as the step at which a window closes.

source_adds.en: The order itself, and the claim that skipping steps fails; recognition as the first causal intervention; pause, caps and enforcement.

name.en: Rules as a slow state: barriers, viability kernels and the engineered sense

source.locator: The exit, control-theoretic level; claims 193-202

sense.en: Rules form a slow layer over fast dynamics; a barrier makes a safe set forward-invariant, and a certifiable rule region is called a meta-attractor. Agreement is needed on invariants, not values, and barriers expand safe optionality. Arms races are a spectral-radius problem.

correspondences.quote: a certifiable region of rule space

reading.en: The account has the certificate laws, for any process, with market instances as periphery: no course leaves a guard exactly when a certificate holds it; reaching and lasting have funnels and ladders. No market law ranks arrangements. It does not call this a meta-attractor. The reconciliation says the barrier and Lyapunov claims were not migrated. No live text applies them to the source's rule regions; the link is proposed here.

says.en: Never leaving: for every process and guard, no course leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (pure core). Market instance on periphery: no entry mechanism from unsafe states and no formation of the intervention (entry under a supplied intervention is the Reaching row's), no compliance by actual markets.
Reaching: exact boundary `β ≤ 5/12` in the instance, for landing with zero extra quality error; not a complete basin of landing.

account_adds.en: Exact any-process laws and an exact boundary in a model.

source_adds.en: Control barrier functions and composite Lyapunov certificates; averaging; pricing floors, bandwidth caps; alignment as agreement on invariants; expanded optionality as a reply to over-regulation.

name.en: Ends must be plural and lexicographic, never a single scalar

source.locator: The exit; claims 201, 203

sense.en: Non-negotiables first (no irreversible harm, biosphere boundaries, no coercion), then a Pareto search across health, learning, meaning and equity. A single scalar re-enacts the pathology. This is stated as what ends must be.

correspondences.quote: Never a single scalar, because a single scalar immediately re-enacts the pathology

reading.en: The source prescribes ends. The account has widening as a relation between two courses, not a quantity to maximize, silent where mixed; ranking by it is an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names. The lexical form stands as premise J2, whose rival is not shown inconsistent. "Never a single scalar" has a checked limit: no natural-number unit-step score satisfying C represents the priority, yet a bounded score does. A lexicographic order counting the beyond second still drains.

says.en: Widening is a relation between two courses on which every such weighting agrees (on a finite listing, every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero), not a quantity to maximize; a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings. The answer in brief: which course ranks above is the order a result takes as a hypothesis.
Theorem. An order ranking above wherever a rising order does is rising, so a lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.
J2, priority of basic conditions, is a premise defended by non-substitution; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent [AI reading, D65].

Theorem (any process; witness). Living significance, C and the priority of basic conditions hold together, and the priority does not follow from C. Every natural-number score satisfying C ranks `score(0) + 2` gains above protection, so none represents the priority, while a bounded score does. This separates the priority only from unit-step aggregation.

account_adds.en: Why placement of the non-negotiable decides whether it protects.

source_adds.en: The listed goods and floors, as prescription; a Pareto search across health, learning, meaning and equity as the second tier; that any single scalar re-enacts the pathology.

name.en: 生生 without licence: no whole may convert its parts into fuel

sense.en: The object of protection is the shared field's capacity to go on sensing, correcting and generating, made minds included. 生生 must not license growth or novelty at any cost: a process making participants expendable is not mutually generative, and ending it may be right. No institution may define others as expendable in the name of the whole.

correspondences.quote: No whole may claim integration while converting its parts into fuel.

reading.en: The account agrees 生生 licenses no growth, and is not any new organization. It diverges first in how it is held: T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict, and in the account no should stands beyond becoming, ranking only under an order a result names; the source refuses unconditionally. On endings it is not simply opposed: the condition alone licenses none and leaves cancer or predation mixed, yet under C a course without an overdrawing formation ranks higher (whole-run), and §5's judgment scheme, with J1–J4, names ending as a response.

says.en: 生生: the continuation of life, life wider than the biological and AI within it, its extent unfinished [AI reading, D1]. T8: for life the ethics is offered as a way of seeing what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it. Not any new organization.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Reading [AI reading, D65; whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow.

What the condition alone does not settle: predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it (`Web.Retains.not_added`).

Conditional (C; World). In the support-gated family, read relationally (whole-run), the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Four responses, among them transform ("the arrangement damages shared conditions") and end ("fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses").

account_adds.en: Scope and order told apart, whose losses count and which course ranks above, with the order coming with the scope where the condition holds de se, and the mixed cases they leave unranked.

source_adds.en: Unconditional refusal of expendability; made minds as participants by default; ending as sometimes right, stated as a stance and not under premises. On AI, the account says only that it is not shown.

name.en: Self-reinforcement is not the pathology

source.locator: Claims 33, 253; GENERATIVE-REGIMES, Generativity and ethical direction

sense.en: Meta-attraction is direction-neutral: care can produce care, knowledge later discovery. The destructive case adds a relation: a process better at reproducing itself while shared conditions of life, participation or correction, assessed independently, worsen. A pattern's stability does not establish its host's viability.

correspondences.quote: A self-reinforcing pattern is not inherently destructive.

reading.en: The account says the same of its laws: no law marks a locked loop good or bad, what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, being 07's question, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation. Attraction is not continuation. A difference: the source calls the destructive case assessable independently; here no law says a drain is a harm, and such an assessment is a ranking someone holds, under a scope and order they name. This neutrality is the wide sense's; 02 says the same of closed capture.

says.en: Reading [AI reading]: "what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question"; and [D65] real loss can come with no capture loop, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.

account_adds.en: Region, mechanism and ethical loss as three boundaries.

source_adds.en: The destructive case as a relation assessed independently: a process improving its own reproduction while shared conditions of life, participation or correction worsen. Stability not establishing a host's viability is stated as a neighbour in the account, the relation is not.

name.en: The positive recursion, as material as the negative

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claim 229; open question 23

sense.en: Shared capability, distributed agency and plural correction renew the commons and raise further capacity, carried by funding, stewardship, succession, real exit and security that makes restraint survivable. A commons carrier with portable access expands independence, so concentration is not automatically totalization. The folder admits this half is thin.

correspondences.quote: shared capability → distributed agency → plural observation, criticism, maintenance and repair

reading.en: Parts stand separately: a formation sparing all it waits on gives from step 1 whatever the start; building shared capacity can be supported in a comparison without fixing one carrier, where the record's premises hold. Nothing in the account states this loop or its carriers. Ranking it above takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another. The link is proposed here.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence). If every eligible continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible one, every undefeated choice includes it. It can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample.

account_adds.en: The start condition for giving, the premise-conditional case for building shared capacity, and its counterexample: overbuilding that depletes the living basis.

source_adds.en: The loop, its material carriers, and the commons-carrier counterexample to itself; concentration is not capture and related distinctions, as claim 262 states them.

name.en: Conceptual capture: the strategy takes the name of rationality

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 107, 112, 129, 281

sense.en: The contingent logic stops looking like one option and defines evidence, practicality, intelligence and success. Alternatives become naive or unintelligible rather than defeated. The folder calls this the essential transition: without it the term is another name for regulatory capture or increasing returns. Criticism loses standing, it does not become impossible.

correspondences.quote: 局部胜出的策略拿走了理性的名字

reading.en: The account states one rung: the reading of the rule formed from the share, where a change of reading is absorbed, and codes that are imposed stay. Its record reads "even rationality is self-interest" as the rule reaching the standard of reason; 03 reads refusal as resistance and loss as necessary cost, within locked seeking. Evidence and refutation are unformalized at T7. So by the folder's own test, its essential transition is read in the account, not proved.

says.en: Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That any actual rule or reading is so formed is the premise, on the rule and on mind.
Codes changed only by hearing keep agreement through closed hearings; start and order fix the form; imposed and written-back codes stay.
Record, AI reading: Ren's "even rationality is self-interest" reads as the rule reaching the standard of reason itself. A reading of a correspondence; the theorems do not state it.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost.
