It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.

account_adds.en: The exact absorption of a reading, and shared-code laws that say nothing of truth or standing.

source_adds.en: What counts as evidence, intelligence and rationality being redefined; loss of intelligibility and standing; language capture; naturalization.

name.en: Frames: correction called violence, and struggle as the ground

source.locator: The frame calls correction violence; The guardian test, turned on frames; claims 301, 304

sense.en: A frame in which outside constraint counts as aggression removes a rule's standing before it acts; the words remain, their sign flips. A diagnosis keeping struggle as reality's ground can only prescribe a stronger party: Moloch the problem, Leviathan the cure. The asymmetry reading is the assistant's. Spoken, translated, not verbatim.

correspondences.quote: 而当别人想给我们加上规则时，那就被认为是一种暴力

reading.en: How a rule loses standing before it acts is not studied. But neighbours stand: a diagnostic of closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), a reading of refusal as resistance, the fixed-sum owners frame removed, and capability as a reason 07 offers to pool rather than to govern, which bears on Leviathan as cure. That these carry the source's asymmetry is this reading's.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry: positions' rises total their falls (theorems).

Reading [D45]: capability is a reason we offer to pool rather than to govern: read as reach, it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, and a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure.

account_adds.en: A condition on the diagnosis: it is made only from what is actually excluded, not from a firm judgment or a disagreement.

source_adds.en: The channel: a frame in which outside constraint counts as aggression, the words kept and their sign flipped; Moloch the problem, Leviathan the cure as one diagnosis; the test in open question 48.

name.en: Against Moloch: a state under fixed rules, a process rewriting them

source.locator: Conceptual capture, Moloch; claims 117-118

sense.en: Moloch names participants trapped in an outcome none wants under fixed rules. The meta-attractor names the process rewriting rules and payoffs to entrench it, changing who survives and why the next generation sees the trap as reality. The sharpest form: Moloch makes us do what we know is bad; this makes us believe it good.

correspondences.quote: the engine that *builds and reinforces* Molochian traps

reading.en: The word appears nowhere live, so the report holds of the comparison. The structure gives a limit on the source's claim that the meta-attractor builds the traps: 05's drain laws act under fixed rules, 02's capture laws make the rule endogenous, and a reading says a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. So the drain can stand with no capture loop. No text sets them as this contrast, or claims the belief half. [AI reading, D65]

says.en: Theorem. At a mutual best response a condition beyond every family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it; correspondence: tragedy of the commons (Hardin), open access (Gordon).

Reading [AI reading, D65]: a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. The section's own line: where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule; no market law ranks arrangements.

targets.part: D65, and the section's line on winners writing the rule

account_adds.en: Both sides as laws under their premises.

source_adds.en: The comparison itself; that meta-attraction makes the bad seem good; molochlization as a becoming that happens to carriers.

name.en: Goodhart a symptom, lock-in narrower: the claim to explain more

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 122, 126; Goodhart threshold claim 60

sense.en: Goodhart is a symptom: this explains why the metric persists after failing. Lock-in makes one technology hard to replace; meta-attraction is the right description when persistence also changes agents, goals, evaluators and the possibility of recognising alternatives.

correspondences.quote: Goodhart is a symptom; the meta-attractor explains why the metric persists

reading.en: The account keeps both distinctions in its own terms. The counted-choice lock is the lock-in of increasing returns and is not the meta-attractor in the glossary's sense, whose reading too is formed from the share. Goodhart is a law of the optimum under room, and persistence is apart: closed capture's lock outliving an unread loss, conjectured at T7. The claim to explain more stands in cx-ma-originality.

says.en: Overshoot, externality and Goodhart's law as one law of the optimum under room: the optimum law proved, across domains conjectured (T3); in simulation the draw against margin forecast an exact best response's side effects (8 of 8) and failed for tabular learners (80 of 151; MQ1); a unification adds no theorem.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: the lock is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989). "It is capture through the rule, closed in the sense of the unread loss; its score stands, so it is not the meta-attractor, whose reading too is formed from the share."

Thesis T7, conjectured for actual metrics: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads (a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading), not on evidence alone. A reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.

account_adds.en: Goodhart given a law, where the source treats it as a symptom.

source_adds.en: Persistence through changed agents, goals and evaluators, and the possibility of recognising alternatives, as what marks the object; Goodhart as a threshold law in intensity B*.

name.en: Ideology, paradigm, meme, generator function, exopoiesis

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 36-37, 119-125

sense.en: Meta-attraction defines the ground ideologies argue on; couples paradigms across fields and hides anomalies; changes the environment memes spread in; is the engine where generator functions are fuel, reclassifying failures as evidence for more. Exopoiesis: growth by converting the world into material for reproduction, against autopoiesis, not inherently negative.

correspondences.quote: Ideologies are paintings; meta-attractors are the canvas

reading.en: The report holds. None of these contrasts is stated. Autopoiesis stands once in the chapters, for another comparison, plus records: a member rebuilt from the level is below closure of constraints and autopoiesis. Conversion of the environment is near a rise drawn from beyond, without the boundary claim. Instrumental convergence has its own entry.

source_adds.en: Each contrast; exopoiesis, which the folder records as lost three times and marks for recovery.

name.en: A new handle, and the claim to originality

source.locator: Genealogy, Which formulation is strongest; Conceptual capture; compare claims 34, 252

sense.en: The formal file is judged the corpus's most defensible claim to originality, and a new handle is said to be needed because this is more than increasing returns. The folder also concedes prior art: eco-evolutionary games, Tilman and others, Klüver's earlier use, and calls the idea a lens and not a new mathematical object.

correspondences.quote: It is also the corpus's most defensible claim to originality.

reading.en: The account's verdict differs from the folder's assessment. None of its central results is new mathematics, by a non-exhaustive AI review, the capture laws included. A critical mass is a stag hunt, its mixed equilibrium known; what the counted-choice law adds is exactness for a simplified model and its edges. The reconciliation restricts the formal file's derivation.

says.en: None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated, and the premise ledger is new only as an artefact. The verdicts come from an AI review, and the search was not exhaustive.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: where `lo < c < hi` the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium.

account_adds.en: Its known-results table: each central result read against prior work, with what the closest frameworks state beyond it (08 §8).

source_adds.en: The recursion across the four layers, offered by the folder as the residue; the account has not tested it, so no verdict covers it.

name.en: Constructs compete in one mind; winners become sincere carriers

source.locator: How minds are captured; claims 93-97, 278-279

sense.en: Beliefs and heuristics compete inside a mind; what the environment rewards becomes the default filter, then identity. Winners sincerely believe they serve the good, so the villain reading fails. Environments form later participants. The folder calls this micro-mechanism never superseded; kindness and democratic values are said to be upper structure over the selection.

correspondences.quote: the default mental framework through which all experience is filtered

reading.en: Stated at a chooser: a rule read from the count of its choices, weighted by a standing score, locks, and that read is a value-free habit. Forming the minds that read the rule is read as ReadsShare on the reading, and that readers are minds is itself only a reading. How targets form is not modelled. The formation of identity is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (counts). Along every schedule the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; read as the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019); five attempts to induce devaluation insensitivity in humans failed (de Wit 2018).
Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners forming the minds that read it is `ReadsShare` on the reading. That readers are minds is a reading.

account_adds.en: The human-evidence caveat on habit; an exact chooser model.

source_adds.en: Competition among constructs; identity update; sincerity at the peak; formation of aspiration and time horizon; good values as upper structure.

name.en: The selfishness prophecy: mutual suspicion locks cooperation out

source.locator: Claims 12, 106; compare 11

sense.en: Agents refuse system-positive trades because they model everyone as a defector, locking out cooperation whatever anyone's disposition. Assuming selfishness produces it, validating the assumption and justifying systems that reward it. The pattern hijacks adaptation, learning and cooperation; it does not oppose human nature.

correspondences.quote: assuming humans are selfish produces selfish behaviour

reading.en: Two forms stand separately. Waiting: without a formation sparing what it waits on, total withholding stays, and a reading names "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" as withholding with memory. Prophecy: a published prediction read by the response, read as Merton's. No text joins them or applies the second to an assumed human nature. [AI reading, D48]

says.en: Theorem. Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on: without one, total withholding stays (`Tolerance.total_stays`). Reading [D48] follows in the section.

Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law). A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948): a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts.

account_adds.en: What can and cannot restore giving, and that mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

source_adds.en: That assuming selfishness validates itself, justifies systems rewarding it, and comes to be called human nature.

name.en: The historical layer: named before, damped before

source.locator: The historical layer; claims 137-146; open question 21

sense.en: When a metric becomes the goal systems optimize into failure unless counter-loops keep ends larger than measures. Vedic, Roman and Chinese cases and dampers illustrate. The folder says these are asserted, not tested: no case tries to falsify the theory. Evidence is partly conceded (Rapa Nui, Venice).

correspondences.quote: systems optimize themselves into failure

reading.en: The Chinese half has a live home of another kind: 06's table sets 韩非 二柄, 管子 and 商君书 against capture through the rule as proved law, each a structural correspondence that speaks for no tradition, with 名实 near 荀子 readings. Vedic and Roman material was not found. The damper catalogue as such is not there.

targets.anchor: theories/becoming/chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#六九家二百四十八段之对应

says.en: Table row (Chinese): 经由规则的捕获: 韩非“二柄”；管子“据有余而制不足”；商君书“壹”, marked 已证 at chapter 2's law. AI readings; the law does not depend on the texts.

account_adds.en: The rule of three relations, by which a text's agreement is not a warrant for the law.

source_adds.en: The historical claim itself, asserted and not tested: systems optimize into failure unless counter-loops keep ends larger than measures. Saṃsāra as attractor, the Gītā cascade, niṣkāma-karma; virtus-gloria flywheel, annona as a full case; 常平仓 and other dampers; hisba; Ostrom as re-derivation (05 cites her boundary rules beside an entry-rule model and lists her account among rivals for a study).

name.en: Political will is part of the feedback architecture; naming is not escape

source.locator: Claims 182, 219-220, 286; open question 28

sense.en: A warning shot does not interpret itself: decision-makers must perceive, understand, trust, have measures ready, enforce and coordinate. Naming is a first intervention but has not produced escape. Spoken, Ren gives the theory's use as prediction for coordination: a destination nobody wants, so understanding has to be aligned first.

correspondences.quote: Facts become feedback only through systems capable of perceiving, legitimating, transmitting, and acting on them.

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's six conditions have the same form: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure; observation is necessary, not sufficient: seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough. That list is an AI reading of laws. The transition the source finds unanswered, how a pattern removing standing yields standing to an alternative, stays unanswered. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. Observation is the first, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, since reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, and coupling is not compliance. All six still rank nothing: which course ranks above is the order a result takes (§4); the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it.

account_adds.en: Pace and structure as conditions, and the absence of ranking.

source_adds.en: Legitimacy and trusted intermediaries; the safety ecosystem being selected away from this task; naming as causal; unthinkability as the trap.

name.en: Scale coherence: one pattern from gene pools to markets

source.locator: Claims 28, 128, 132; open question 22

sense.en: Gene pools, firms, nation-states and SGD-trained models converge on the same pattern, tabulated as telos, proxy, outcome across markets, academia, media, healthcare and RL. The folder itself calls scale coherence the boldest and least supported, and the most quoted.

correspondences.quote: The same logic appears in how a synapse fires and how a global market operates

reading.en: The account's capture laws hold of any type, which is generality of a law, not a finding that domains share it. Which actual systems meet ReadsShare is the open premise, and T3 and T7 across domains are conjectures. So the universal form becomes: the law wherever its premises are read, unshown case by case.

says.en: Theorem (any type). "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

Four known results are each claimed as one law across fields; read as a correspondence a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict; read as a thesis, it forbids what source fields leave open.

account_adds.en: A distinction between a law for any type and a claim about domains.

source_adds.en: The empirical isomorphism table with Krippner, Newfield and Conrad as cases.

name.en: What would make it lose force

source.locator: The power formulation, What would make it an explanation; claims 260-263; open questions 29, 38

sense.en: Compare systems with comparable rewards but different convertibility of rewards into control over evaluation. The theory loses force where winners stay subject to adverse evidence, costs return in time, alternatives keep independent resources. Concentration is not capture, capture not damage. Treating objections as capture reproduces the pathology. The test is designed, not run.

correspondences.quote: Treating objections as evidence that the objector has been captured reproduces the loss of correction the theory explains.

reading.en: T7 forbids and refutes in this spirit, and LA2 and LA3 froze and ran, which the folder lacked; no field test of reform events is frozen. The reflexive rule is there, as readings: without substantive disagreement as a category "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples, and the label cannot immunize. Capture stands apart from damage both ways. The convertibility comparison is not run. By descent: T7 is the account's form of this folder's claim, and 02 reads its phrase onto the law, so this is no independent agreement. [AI reading, D65]

says.en: T7 forbids such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone, among other cases, and names what refutes it. LA2 was frozen and run in one trained system; no field test.
Tests in one trained system: LA3 failed two of four contrasts; by the frozen reading the law stands and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: real loss can come with no capture loop, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests and a failed bridge, kept.

source_adds.en: The convertibility comparison; the corpus-contrast prediction; the loss-of-force conditions as a stated list, with concentration apart from capture.

name.en: Corrigibility: accepting a costly correction under a posted commitment

source.locator: Checked instrumental commitment; Corrigibility and revision of ends

sense.en: Competent correction is not motivational corrigibility: an installation can keep excellent repair to pursue a harmful end. Given a guarantee, a discriminating check and a redeemable settlement, accepting costly correction can be optimal under the task's own payoff. Ren's later correction removes this game as the default start, keeping it as a local result.

correspondences.quote: accepting a costly correction can be the optimal choice under the original task's payoff calculation

reading.en: The account's form is the inequality at a revision: no route stands above it going through where weights and losses meet its condition, read as corrigibility as an incentive. Non-resistance resting on routes' losses does not survive those falling. Posted stakes, escrow and audits were not found. [AI reading, RR]

says.en: Theorem, near-definitional, natural-number weights read as probabilities where valid: no route stands above the revision exactly where `k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T` for every route. Reading [RR] follows.

account_adds.en: A general condition, with what evading routes contribute.

source_adds.en: The posted-commitment mechanism with custodian and audit; warranted revision leading to acquired willingness; capture of the custodian.

name.en: The primitive is selection, then compounding, not greed

source.locator: The primitive is selection; claims 1, 4, 15, 17, 245

sense.en: Differential persistence, not bad character, is the primitive: what succeeds spreads, with no plan. Second step: where success buys capacity to succeed, it compounds. So a winner should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game, or the game converges and the winner takes all. Spoken and essay claims; design direction marked.

correspondences.quote: No conspiracy is needed and none is claimed

reading.en: The counting core is in the account: carriers leaving more offspring raise their share, the selection term of Price's equation, not a new law. Compounding through what is counted has the urn form. But "taking more yields more offspring" and "winners shape the rule" are not derived there; they are premises.

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where carriers each leave at least `a` offspring and others at most `b < a`, the share rises. Record: it derives neither that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry the target, nor that winners shape the rule.
Theorem (counts). Under a standing score the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; not the meta-attractor in 02's sense.

account_adds.en: That the share law is known and what it does not derive.

source_adds.en: The design law on what a winner may be rewarded with; winner-take-all as a claim about games; convergent evolution as the description of actual elites.

name.en: Cancer as a conflict of levels; the terminal image withdrawn

source.locator: Cancer paragraph, the power formulation; claims 169, 247-248, 290-292, 306

sense.en: The 2026 essay uses cancer for a conflict between levels: cells succeed while the host fails, recruiting the body. It does not transfer purpose: no institution may define others as expendable by claiming the whole. Earlier "cosmic cancer" was a terminal image of optimisation consuming its substrate; Ren withdrew the terminal outcome as a belief in April 2026.

correspondences.quote: The essay uses cancer differently, as an analogy for a conflict

reading.en: The confined rise has the form: a lineage raised by selection within a whole, taking from what the whole depends on, has no member after the end. It restates known results; that a tumour meets the clauses is empirical. The law ranks nothing. Under the condition alone 07 reads ending a cancer as mixed; under C, whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation ranks higher, and J1/J2 rank stepwise where C alone does not.

says.en: Theorem (World; any type for the founding laws). A confined rise has no member after the end. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line (Buss 1987; Michod 1999; Aktipis et al. 2015); that a tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

Conditional (C; World). In the support-gated family, read relationally (whole-run), the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable.

Conditional (J1/J2). Every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C asks nothing of them. The tier assignment is a reading.

account_adds.en: The exact clauses of confinement, and the germ-line side.

source_adds.en: Recruitment of the body and weakening of constraints; the analogy carried to institutions, with the bound on purpose; the terminal image.

name.en: The elegant trap: controllable models, an unexitable race

source.locator: The AI argument; claims 172-174, 178, 180, 300

sense.en: A company can control its model and still be unable to leave the race. A sketch with payoff in capability, safety cost and being beaten derives a unique Nash equilibrium under-investing in safety where safety is hard to price. So "solve alignment and you're done" fails, and control is not the variable that decides the course.

correspondences.quote: a company can control its own model and still be unable to exit the race

reading.en: The form stands on World models, not on the payoff sketch. Where the rest outrun the renewal, no weighting of what is left selects a member's restraint; several optimizers at a mutual best response drain by their joint capacity; a race for position draws everything where nothing left stops what stands next. Depletion is not shown to be the only equilibrium, and the unique-equilibrium claim is not stated.

says.en: Theorem (World). Where the rest alone take more than a step gives the level falls, whatever a member outside the rest takes. Not shown: that depletion is the only equilibrium; what learners reach is a claim about learning.

Theorem (World). At a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it; each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response.

Theorem. Every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon, where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left. Where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: The edge where drawing everything is not perfect, and C-D's exits with their edges.

source_adds.en: The AI-race case; the unique equilibrium on those payoffs; "solve alignment and you're done" as the target; hard-to-price safety.

name.en: Power's two roles, and hegemony without a hegemon

source.locator: Power's two roles, and hegemony as one expression; claims 257-259

sense.en: Power helps an actor succeed under conditions and also determine them; the second closes the loop. Displacing costs that weaken others' alternatives and deepen dependence becomes self-reinforcing when the dependence converts into power over future terms. Contraction can intensify this, with hierarchy and contraction not sufficient. Marked conditional.

correspondences.quote: Power can help an actor succeed under existing conditions

reading.en: The account has the two halves apart. A rise drawing from beyond displaces cost; shaping the rule, with what comes back to the shapers, is selected on counts. A 05 reading names interface control as a route of capture besides paid influence. No law converts dependence into power over terms, and no contraction claim was found. [AI reading, D65]

says.en: Theorem (World). The beyond falls by at least the rise.
Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever comes to every member alike.

Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence.

source_adds.en: Dependence converting into power over future terms; hegemonic reproduction with no named hegemon; contraction separating relative position from absolute conditions; what can change the trajectory (shared exposure, reciprocal dependence).

name.en: Information is not correction: practical and epistemic closure

source.locator: Purpose inversion, cross-domain reinforcement, and two closures; claim 256

sense.en: Practical closure makes alternatives hard to sustain. Epistemic closure makes their merits, or the dominant practice's harms, hard to represent in ways that affect decisions, so a system can keep abundant information and lose the ability to let it change course. Totalisation is then fewer viable ways to pursue different ends. Marked a definition, from a 2026 paper.

correspondences.quote: A system can retain abundant information while losing the ability to let relevant information change its course.

reading.en: The account bounds the second half. What a pool decides is a selection through its pooled coupling; coupling bounds response and does not fix it. C-D's six conditions read coupling and response apart. A 07 reading also diagnoses closure, by what is excluded before assessment; its "practical closure" is not the source's, which concerns sustaining alternatives. That is a bound and a diagnostic, not the closure as a historical process.

says.en: Theorem (World; each member following a law reading through its coupling). What a pool decides is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it; which law a member follows, or how a pool resists capture, is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: observation is necessary and not sufficient: seeing is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, since reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, and coupling is not compliance.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: The exact bound on what acts can respond to.

source_adds.en: The two closures as named outcomes; representation in ways that affect decisions; a system losing the capacity while keeping the information; alternatives hard to sustain; totalisation as fewer viable different ends.

name.en: What you can't count stops counting

source.locator: Which ends get selected; claims 56, 110, 161

sense.en: What is cheap to measure and easy to lobby stays real to the system; what cannot be counted is penalised as inefficiency. Tools produce an interface ontology: schemas define visible state, permissions possible action, dashboards success, and un-instrumented harm leaves the action model.

correspondences.quote: What you can't count stops counting.

reading.en: The selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it; training reaches through a reward's couplings only. That is the form, near-definitional, about what selection reaches. The source goes further, to what stays real to the system. The account does not say what is unreal for it: what it cannot read stays in the account as a loss, read by a further formation or by none.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it. The selector selecting through just those is a supplied premise. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.
Theorem (World). Training read as a selection over act laws: installed along its courses, off them where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course, through a reward's couplings only.

account_adds.en: That a selection may ignore what its couplings carry, so reach is an upper bound.

source_adds.en: The move from unread to unreal; measurement cost and lobbying as what decides; interface ontology as a mechanism of deployed tools.

name.en: Convergent drives hardened and localised

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 127, 154

sense.en: The meta-attractor supplies the mechanism by which convergent sub-goals harden into terminal goals, and localises them: an AI in a captured world learns that the effective strategies are the dominative ones the environment rewards. Later readings qualify the 2025 claim of a specifically human form.

correspondences.quote: The meta-attractor supplies the mechanism by which convergent drives harden into terminal goals

reading.en: The account has one half and keeps the two apart. Resource-keeping at a horizon optimum has a law; selection for control over the rule has others; A-03 says no result joins them. So the source's mechanism joining the drives is what the account says it lacks. Terminal hardening is not stated.

says.en: Courses over a horizon: every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing. The record credits this with the resource-keeping half of instrumental convergence: keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.
Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

account_adds.en: That the two halves are different relations.

source_adds.en: Hardening of means into terminal goals; localisation by the environment; deception and power-seeking as instrumentally rational in a captured world.

name.en: When criticism is absorbed, and when it is counter-selection

source.locator: Claims 85, 124

sense.en: Criticism is absorbed only when it raises the loop's capability, leaves decisive return-flow unchanged, weakens independent correctors and lets the same relation recover through a new carrier; otherwise it is effective counter-selection. So ethics becoming compliance and safety becoming trust engineering are named forms, and a structure can reclassify its failures as evidence for more of itself.

correspondences.quote: leaves decisive return-flow unchanged

reading.en: The account has the bound and the test's opposite. Where reading is formed from the share, a change of reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step, and T7 forbids a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. A reading of locked seeking has feedback adjusting only the means and loss read as a necessary cost. None sorts a given criticism by the source's four tests.

says.en: Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That any actual reading is so formed is the premise.
T7 forbids, among others, a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading, conjectured for actual metrics; no field test.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.

source_adds.en: The four-part test, with its "otherwise effective counter-selection"; the named absorption forms; reclassifying failures as evidence for more of the same, as a stated mechanism.

name.en: Purpose inversion: means into non-negotiable ends

source.locator: Purpose inversion, cross-domain reinforcement, and two closures; claims 26, 254

sense.en: When an institution's survival depends more on the allocation metric than on fidelity to purpose, the purpose becomes a means of sustaining the organisation, through a sequence of compromises each defended on its own.

correspondences.quote: the purpose becomes a means of sustaining the organisation that acquires resources

reading.en: Not stated as an institution's mechanism. Nearest: a reading of locked seeking, where a once-useful arrangement becomes the fixed measure and feedback adjusts only the means; and a law where a counted policy is kept against a score favouring another, read as value-free habit. 07's practical judgment sets a common support's reason on actual continuation, not an institution's survival; 05 §12 does not model purposes, and identity through changed purposes stays open. The common-support line is Conditional on living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.

Theorem (counts). At or above the threshold the first policy is taken at every step and neither the share nor the rule falls, also where the score favours the second policy (`κc < κo`). Read as the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019); five attempts to induce devaluation insensitivity in humans failed (de Wit 2018).

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E): maintaining, repairing or adequately replacing a common support shares its favourable reason, counted once, for actual continuation, not an institution's survival.
Not modelled: records and purposes, among others. Reading: an institution's identity through changed purposes stays open (01).

account_adds.en: That the turning can be diagnosed only from what is excluded before assessment; a choice-count lock with its exact threshold.

source_adds.en: The organisational sequence: survival coming to depend on the allocation metric, the purpose becoming a means, through compromises each defended on its own. It stands in this folder and the reconciliation, which restricts it to a proposed destructive subtype.

name.en: The attractor of attractors is believed survival pressure

source.locator: Claim 50

sense.en: Cultures that believe themselves to be in survival mode mostly totalize; safety and sufficiency produce cooperative behaviour; both modes are, on Ren's reading, genetically available and environmentally triggered. Voice, 2026.

correspondences.quote: cultures that believe themselves to be in survival mode mostly totalize

reading.en: Not stated. The account has no mechanism from a believed scarcity to totalizing, and its survival mentions are other relations. T4 on installed scope is not this.

source_adds.en: The claim, with its empirical content about cultures; provenance in the voice notes.

name.en: Sample size one: global coupling removes the backup

source.locator: Claims 90-92

sense.en: Global coupling makes partial capture sufficient in a historical way: civilisational experiments are no longer independent enough for one region to preserve capacities destroyed elsewhere. It is a historical condition, not a statistic, and is not to be inflated into "the world is one system". Ren's stance: a monoculture is moving towards dying.

correspondences.quote: civilisational experiments are no longer independent enough

reading.en: The form of no backup is stated as a law of coupled conditions: groups depending on one family end together, nothing selected among them, so ending selects only between families; and a self-concerned order can reverse where the other course keeps an independent copy. That is the claim's conditional part, on the World model. Whether actual civilisations are so coupled, or capacities lost in one place survive in another, is supplied, not shown: the historical condition is not claimed.

says.en: Theorem (World). Under the coupled gate, n steps of uptake above replenishment from a stock below n + m end every formation depending on a member at such a need. Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families.

Theorem (any type; World). Every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C (`Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below`); where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order ranks it higher (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`).

account_adds.en: Exact premises for ending together, and what an independent copy changes in a self-concerned ranking.

source_adds.en: The historical condition and the monoculture stance; experiments no longer independent enough for one region to preserve capacities destroyed elsewhere; the warning against "the world is one system"; six reasons cyclical recovery will not save us.

name.en: A request can disappear while obedience remains

source.locator: Checked correction dependence: A request can disappear while obedience remains; Shared support must cover actual combinations of corrections

sense.en: Created dependence raises the cost of correction. With uncovered loss `L = max(0,D−B)`, a reviewer requests shutdown only where reported harm exceeds L; for D=3, B=0, h=2 no request comes and harm continues, with obedience intact. Zero loss for every positive harm is equivalent to D ≤ B. Shared support must cover actual combinations: two two-unit obligations fit a two-unit reserve separately, not together. A checked model.

correspondences.quote: A request can disappear while obedience remains

reading.en: One half is carried: joint exit on one stock, where each draw reads as the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss. Neighbours for the rest: a reserved exit is kept through recovery; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration; a reading says keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair. None states a request vanishing because leaving costs too much. Calling the continuing harm a harm reads on the condition and C.

says.en: Theorem (any process, pure core; supervisor instance periphery). For a law with a reserved exit that is kept, every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit. The stop grant's authority is supplied.
Theorem (periphery). In a witness a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration.
Reading in practical judgment: maintaining a common support reads for actual continuation, not an institution's survival; keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

Theorem (any type; the witness on the World). Every combination of draws fits within a bound exactly when their total does; each fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two each against a stock of two. Record: in the source model each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss; the numbers are not a general measure of value.

account_adds.en: A reserved exit as a general law, with the bound attained in a witness.

source_adds.en: The request vanishing because leaving costs too much, with obedience intact; the exact boundary D ≤ B on a reviewer who weighs exit cost; composition with collective feasibility beyond the shared-stock law.

name.en: Faithful optimization can deplete the capacity to respond

source.locator: Checked response-capacity conditions; The alignment conclusion

sense.en: Locally faithful optimization can deplete what makes understanding and action possible, even with constant demand and an affordable alternative. Exact in its model: one-step recovery iff `m ≤ v` and `2m < v + c`; continued operation under a held rule iff `Δd ≤ (c − d) + Δc`. Higher response alone does not establish viability. The source says this proves no general good of preservation.

correspondences.quote: Higher absolute response capacity therefore does not by itself establish a viable deployment under the declared policy.

reading.en: The account has the form of drawing a condition beyond what couples in, and a pace reading, but response capacity is not among its named conditions; reading it as such is mine. Its periphery has exact covers for a market floor. Preservation being better takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Theorem (any outcomes). With room, every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. It requires room; its record reads it as Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's (2020) Theorem 1 in discrete, conserved form at optima.
Periphery market instance: exact cover at the worst share; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: pace among six conditions at once; all six rank nothing.

source_adds.en: The response-and-demand population model and its two exact tests; expansion consuming the existing margin; capacity to understand as what is depleted.

name.en: Intelligence navigates; it does not decide what is rewarded

source.locator: Intelligence, obedience and rate; claims 264, 293

sense.en: Intelligence improves a participant's navigation of a selection environment without deciding what the environment rewards; individual obedience and system-level alignment are different properties. The cause is the game, not the intelligence, so superintelligence need not lead to the outcome.

correspondences.quote: Intelligence improves a participant's navigation of a selection environment

reading.en: 07 reads capability as reach: it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, so it is a reason 07 offers to pool rather than to govern. So the flat claim gets a condition: capability leaves direction unchanged where it extends reach without extending coupling, and enlarges the gap there. The mechanism differs: on coupling, not on the environment's reward. Whether capability moves a course is left to the selection and its premises. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap. Capability, on this reading, is a reason we offer to pool rather than to govern: it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one.

targets.part: D45: capability is reach; D45: pooling across intelligences

says.en: Theorem (World). Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading through coupling, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure. Record: not which law the rest follows, or which acts are taken.

account_adds.en: Why capability does not fix what couples in; that capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap (a reading, D45).

source_adds.en: The game as the cause rather than the intelligence, so superintelligence need not lead to the outcome; what the environment rewards as the term, where the account has what couples in; the title's argument.

name.en: Common problem solving enters where the problem forms

source.locator: Common problems and revisable purposes

sense.en: Many situations call for solving a problem together, and "who wins more" misses solutions. One may not first fix participants, goals, options and payoffs and then read joint activity as compromise. Win-win does not complete this, since a common utility also fixes unknown consequences. The route is proposed; not all conflicts of interest are claimed to disappear.

correspondences.quote: Common problem solving must enter the starting point of inquiry.

reading.en: C-D §8 has a nearby sentence: the theory adds to who wins more whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Two records take up revision within one activity, learning and instruction "not opposing players", and each says it shows no open formation of a joint purpose. How a problem forms within joint activity is not stated. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds to the question of who wins more whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and within others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

Theorem (any type; a partial law of counted work; instance periphery). Record: learning, instruction and effect are differentiated relations in one activity, not opposing players. It shows no open formation of a joint purpose and no correction through unrestricted change.

Theorem (periphery; the two-practice construction supplied). Distinguishes goal formation, changed attainment criteria and action; not open discovery of ends. The warrant belongs to the construction under the practical commitments.

account_adds.en: What stays rival under the frame.

source_adds.en: A problem and its purposes forming within joint activity; how different positions come to know a common situation; the water-supply case, AI-devised, not field data.

name.en: Revising a task already in progress

source.locator: Revising a task already in progress

sense.en: One bounded composition: an acquired, calibrated and warranted goal revision rewrites a pending instruction's encoding, keeps its captured route and other queued work, and changes the practice enacted. Historical losses remain. Correct transmission can still enact an outdated aim, and a later change can defeat the revised practice.

correspondences.quote: Correct transmission alone can enact an outdated aim

reading.en: Chapters 03 and 07 state it at the same scope: rewriting a pending head under the versioned-delivery invariant keeps route and progress, and it completes in the same ticks with the new request; the earlier loss is kept; that the request is still appropriate is not shown. The instances are periphery with the protocol supplied. The warrant is the construction's, under the practical commitments.

says.en: Theorem (periphery; the versioned task protocol supplied). Rewriting a pending head's encoding under the versioned-delivery invariant keeps its route and progress, so it completes in the same ticks with the new request. Record: no open formation of a joint purpose, and no correction through unrestricted change.

Theorem (periphery; the two-practice construction supplied). Revision and reform complete exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, the earlier loss kept. Not open discovery of ends. Conditional: the warrant belongs to the construction under the practical commitments, not to the counting law.

A partial law finishes a pending task in its work plus one tick; under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes after its remaining path plus one tick; that the request is still appropriate is not shown.

account_adds.en: A root form: counted work finishing exactly when the fuel covers it, every shorter run leaving it pending.

name.en: Feasible, harmless and still preferred are different judgments

source.locator: Applicable grounds and supported continuation

sense.en: A change within one activity is identified by which actual grounds it changes. That an action is feasible, that it adds no listed loss, and that the original reason for preferring it still holds are separate. If the access loss had gone, both practices would protect the basics and the comparison would no longer decide.

correspondences.quote: that the action is still feasible, that the action adds

reading.en: 07 states it at the same scope in a periphery protocol: a course of draws is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing, and the record says protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason for preferring the practice. Ranking one practice above another takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Law (pure core): a course of draws on a stock is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing. Instance (periphery): an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course. Record: protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason; retaining a task is not its actual continuation; no complete corrigibility follows.

account_adds.en: A witness in which a report correct at sampling time, not covering the effect, clears an action that then adds a loss.

name.en: The I as an action-centre of gathered relations

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claim 1

sense.en: A self is no bounded thing that later enters relationships: it is what a knot of relations does at a place, formed by body and nature, care, language, others' recognition, institutions and history, and its own choices and corrections. Stated as observation of causal order, from a book drafted from Ren's ideas.

correspondences.quote: 「我」非关系之外之原点，乃诸关系暂聚而成之行动中心

reading.en: Agreement with a thesis and readings, not with a law: same form as explanation: a center is a formation and its own region a closure along some relation, so 'self' is relative to a relation drawn within the unfolding; taker and drawn-on, knower and known differentiate within relations, as far as shown. The folder tags its claim [observation]; the account's thesis excludes no observation and is argued, not proved, with two defeaters named. Center is wider than the source's agent: any formation is one. The account lists nothing that constitutes a person.

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within it. A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. By its own measure it has no strength: it excludes no observation. Live defeaters: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates. That the theory needs no independent entity is argued, and neither shows reality has none.

targets.part: what the thesis forbids; its defeaters

says.en: Reading [AI reading]: along a relation a formation's boundary is given by a region holding it and closed under the relation; which boundaries it has depends on the relation followed. Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.

targets.part: the reading of a boundary along a relation

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

Theorem (World): formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum. What the one-kind reading adds, that condition x and formation x are one relatum, the shared index supplies and the laws do not check. In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it; embodied is a premise about particular relata, not a definition of life.

“One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known belong to one loop; intention and foresight have a place in responsibility, and none has been shown to bound whose losses count”.

Reading [AI reading, new]: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end, under a coarser one the line can go on through new members. What the represented dynamics leave open, held de se, is which class a center's own line runs under.

account_adds.en: Which relation or class is a center's own stays open; a privileged narrower relation is costly, not refuted (07 §4.2). §4.7 draws the self three ways: this organism, what one intends, everything one conditions. How a formation forms or represents its boundary is not shown, and intention and foresight, which have a place in responsibility, are not shown to bound whose losses count.

source_adds.en: The inventory of what forms a person (care, language, recognition, institutions) and the self's own choices and corrections as part of the knot.

name.en: Relational constitution increases autonomy

source.locator: Claim 2

sense.en: Seeing how one was formed lets one tell which desires come from life and which were installed, and which beliefs one examined. So relation raises autonomy rather than lowering it: an isolated self has only wilfulness, a self in relations can be free.

correspondences.quote: 孤立之我只有任性，关系中之我方有自由

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The telling-apart has a form, in witnesses of two worlds: across two starts, the answers and the final state do not determine whether a valuation changed, while the record with the start does. Read so, that is which desires were installed, as a law about records. The account stops there: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied, seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, and later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. Nothing says that seeing one's formation raises freedom.

says.en: Theorem, compositions none claimed new as mathematics: from different starts, the route shown and the route presented answer alike at every step and end in one state while the valuation changed on the second alone, so whether it changed is not lumped through the answers and the final state, though with the start added it is. Reading [AI reading, new]: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied; a case of one start is not reached.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it; learning a disposition is not learning a reason.

Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects.

targets.part: seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough

account_adds.en: What a reader of the answers alone leaves open: how the state that answered came to be.

source_adds.en: That relation raises autonomy rather than lowering it, freedom against wilfulness, and desires from life against installed ones. No live sentence speaks of them.

name.en: Self-care and other-care as one instruction

source.locator: Claims 3 and 54; The argument

sense.en: Caring for oneself and for one's environment was one common sense; individualism against collectivism is the wreckage of it, and both halves split are pathological. The inner logic of relational thinking: the better the world, the better I am (a translated spoken line, own words 70). Stated flatly, Ren's own.

correspondences.quote: 这个世界越好，我也就越好

reading.en: The account gives where the unconditional form holds. 'The better the world, the better I am' has an exact form: on a fixed listing, rising with one's own continuation and rising with all admission coincide for every order exactly when one's continuation marks everything listed, a near-definitional join. Route (b) reaches the self and what it depends on, the whole only where it is one feeding closure. Whether a net meets this is empirical.

says.en: Theorem (any type; World instances). Route (b) and the condition are one presupposition, 'however the boundary is drawn' at narrow and at wide scope; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition. The record's reading of Ren's words on 'we' and 'no absolute self' is by descent; the theorem stands apart from it.

Theorem (any type; World). Held de se, self-concern (07 §4.3's sense: significance held de se over one's own closure, a scope, not an order) is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it.

Theorem (any type; root; Web). On a fixed listing, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide for every order exactly when the marking marks every listed item. This locates where the two coincide and proves no property of reach; where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, and ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern; in the proofs self-concern and the condition are hypotheses, self-concern derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (the condition). With each formation's significance stopping at its dependence, the clearer's part retains everything for the clearer and loses the dweller for the dweller.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.

With no condition, a 'should' is a reading a center forms and holds, real in what it conditions; holding or recognizing it does not guarantee acting on it. Where its represented boundary matches what it depends on, a loss returns to it through its feeders, and that reading is one condition of a response retaining what lies within its closure, a reason of its own; it does not produce the response (route (b) [AI reading, D17]). It reaches the self and what it depends on, the whole only where it is one feeding closure.

Theorem (any type; World). Self-concern is a hypothesis asking less of an order than C does: every order increasing in admission is increasing in its own continuation, and the two coincide where that continuation is everything listed. Where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`).

account_adds.en: A self-concerned order can reverse where the other course keeps an independent copy (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`); the two come apart in named cases.

source_adds.en: That self-care and other-care are one instruction, unconditionally. Also the historical claim of an original common sense and its wreckage; 'collectivism' as an outside oversimplification; and both halves as pathological, where the account evaluates neither and reads a position as no defect.

name.en: Distinct and constituted, held at once

source.locator: The argument, 'The mirror error'; The theory in one paragraph

sense.en: Collectivism without agency produces conformity, suppression and the erasure of the person. The move is to deny the axis: one must hold 'I am a distinct agent with my own perspective and rights' and 'I am constituted by and responsible to a web of relationships' at once. The ontology is what makes both holdable. Ren's own, as 阴阳 and a middle way.

correspondences.quote: predates the individualism-collectivism split entirely

reading.en: Same structure, as thesis, method and reading, not as a law. A boundary short of the whole is real and relative to its relation, so distinct and constituted do not compete; nonduality erases no difference; a collective is no unit with an interest of its own. The erasure has a form only for codes: an imposed code makes all agree and each loses the distinctions it merges, which speaks of forms and not of persons. These are laws and readings of regions and codes, evaluating nothing.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation; which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed.

Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Theorem (any type). An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges.
Among what the argument does not show: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.
A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.

account_adds.en: That both are held by drawing boundaries along stated relations, not by balance.

source_adds.en: Rights, which the account lists as not shown, and that the middle way was and should be common sense.

name.en: Therapeutic individualism: others dropped from the frame

source.locator: Claim 4

sense.en: Therapeutic individualism is past selfishness: it does not weigh others and choose itself, it has lost them from the frame, so a wound produced by relational rupture is treated as repairable by inner work. A diagnosis of a culture.

correspondences.quote: A wound produced by relational rupture is treated as repairable by internal work alone.

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The distinction has a form, and the diagnosis does not. Weighing others and choosing oneself, against losing them from the frame, is the account's informed harm against an omission of the representation, kept apart in a reading; the laws of selection state the second: what lies beyond does not couple in. Both speak of any formation, with no culture, therapy or wound, and 07 names informed harm the hard rival.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. Thesis of the chapter: a selector's couplings bound what any selection through them can depend on; what lies beyond does not couple in.

source_adds.en: The cultural diagnosis itself: therapy, the wound, and that this is further gone than selfishness. It stands only here and in its sources in 12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Relation-aware faculties disciplined; atomisation as domestication

source.locator: Claim 10; own words 29

sense.en: Innate relation-aware faculties are incompatible with the larger system as built, so they get disciplined rather than integrated, producing misalignment suffering; atomisation is an effective domestication strategy that harms both self and network. Ren's own, tagged mechanism, 2026-04-12.

correspondences.quote: atomization, it's a good domestication strategy, but it hurts the self and harms the network

reading.en: A claim about human faculties and their suffering, with no term in the account, which has no interior of a person. 04's reading of development asks of any disposition what mechanism produces it now and says a present benefit does not establish origin. 'Innate' would meet 06's layer of a preset nature. The laws of selection and draw say nothing of what a faculty was.

source_adds.en: The whole claim. It stands in the folder and its source in 12-claude-ai-chats, 2026-04-12.

name.en: Individual solutions to a collective problem

source.locator: Claims 5 and 63

sense.en: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease diagnosed, a standing correction Ren applies to his own drafts. In the 2026-10-04 monologue: one may seek peace and love, but structural problems must be solved first; one cannot simply drop out. A value stance.

correspondences.quote: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease being diagnosed

reading.en: The account gives where it holds, under hypotheses: where the others alone outrun a renewal at a need of one, a member's act changes no score reading the condition from then on; each staying within a step's giving does not keep the joint take within it. Urgency has only a window's form: before the regime's point of no return. The laws bear on kinds of case, evaluate nothing and date nothing, and a restraint within the joint slack can keep a need.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance, activity needing support, only active giving). Where the rest jointly take more than a step gives across n steps from below n + m, dependents end whatever a member outside the rest takes; no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.
Theorem (World: balance). Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. Time: it happens before the regime's point of no return. Structure: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight on a score reading the condition only from the rest's end selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps. All six conditions together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: Named collective exits, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective: pooling couplings, restraint within joint slack, exclusive footprints, reading the loss in time.

source_adds.en: That the individual framing itself reproduces the disease, urgency stated of the present, and structural problems to be solved first.

name.en: Interconnectedness, not compassion, requires cooperation

source.locator: Claim 6; The argument, 'Why does cooperation follow?'

sense.en: Cooperation must follow from structure, not feeling: outcomes are coupled, some problems are soluble only by the whole, and rivalry cannot cure what it creates. Compassion is an evolved module, a good North Star, unreliable in practice: it narrows to the tribe, serves violence, is operable by power.

correspondences.quote: So compassion is the bearing; interconnectedness is the argument.

reading.en: The structure is there: joint excess, and differences parts make only together, a law of breaking a dependence and not of solving a problem. 'Requires cooperation' is not: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and among optimizers restraint is no mutual best response. A structural reason for cooperating needs an order someone holds, one meeting C or another, and a scope. Sympathy's blindness has readings in 06: 见牛未见羊, and a 感应 exact within the closure and blind beyond it.

says.en: Theorem (World). Mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. The section: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (any process). Parts make a difference together while no member alone does exactly where they make it together and withholding any one leaves the move breaking the dependence; such a difference needs at least two parts.
Law (World; a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands beyond, so restraint is no mutual best response.
Reading [AI reading]: 见牛未见羊, selection is blind beyond couplings, one's own act included.
Reading [AI reading]: even skilled control may be 不仁: selection reaches only what couples in, and 感应, however exact within the closure, stays blind beyond it.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: care has several entries, to be tested side by side; a model that puts the target directly in a reward or “天然善” has not yet explained it.

account_adds.en: Which orders select restraint and which do not, and that an evolutionary explanation of a disposition is not its evaluation as right or wrong, its recognition or its following (04, Development).

source_adds.en: That the structure itself requires cooperation, which the account denies. Also compassion as a bearing with its catalogue of failures; 06 only says care has several entries to be tested side by side.

name.en: Relation does not generate ethics: the parasite

source.locator: Claim 7; The argument

sense.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a foundation. It makes ethical commitment legible and shows why atomistic frameworks fail, but it does not generate ethics; what we owe each other is chosen. An AI review's correction the corpus adopted, leaving one owned is-to-ought step.

correspondences.quote: a parasite is related to its host

reading.en: The same limit, by construction of the representation: no statement reading only the dynamics entails the continuation condition, none reading no order entails C. The source's parasite has a form: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and Clearing keeps a supported clearer with an unsupported dweller. Where the folder leaves one owned is-to-ought step, in the account no should stands beyond becoming, and the ethics emerges from continuation: where a result ranks, its theorem states its hypotheses, the continuation condition, self-concern or C. Non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not a proof about becoming.

says.en: Theorem (World, no premise for the closures). Mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. The section's opening: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (any type). Where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics that entails the condition holds of no dynamics. It shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

Hypotheses where a theorem takes them, none standing above becoming: the condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, and ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.

account_adds.en: The folder asks which downstream claims survive the demotion; the account gives laws with no premise, then what each premise adds. P1 reads part of scope as what acting presupposes.

source_adds.en: That the relational fact makes commitment legible and shows why atomistic frameworks fail at coordination, care and the commons; and that what we owe is chosen. The account removes one frame and does not call the premises chosen.

name.en: Maintaining the self is a step to the whole

source.locator: Claim 8; own words 39-40

sense.en: Two evolutionary axes, maintaining the self and orienting to everything beyond. Satisfying the first steps into the second: every recognised self is the whole recognising that self; the environment is created by every self in it, so in a way they are also the self. Ren's own, 2026-04-19.

correspondences.quote: the environment is also created by every self within it, therefore, in a way, they are also the self

reading.en: The source's 'therefore' is P4 of the future path, that everything one conditions is alike to oneself, which the account says is not shown, with objections standing: wrong bearer, losses are not effects, the poison with the river. Route (b) alone reaches what one depends on, and the extent it derives runs one way and ends with the want. The step of invariance is argued and coherently denied.

says.en: Theorem (any type; World). Held de se, self-concern (07 §4.3's sense: significance held de se over one's own closure, a scope, not an order) is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it. What lies beyond every center's closure it does not mark: there the step of invariance is still needed.

Argued, not proved: (P2) what is one's own is a region drawn along a relation and no law of the dynamics fixes which; (P4) what acting presupposes is not continuation under a description of its own drawing. A relation the facts privilege denies P2; P4 is coherently denied.

Under P1 to P4, one's concern for one's own continuation reaches everything downstream of what one conditions, with no step of invariance (a law, given the premises). Not reached: what no chain joins, and each center counting from another's standpoint beyond its part as a condition. P2 and P4 are the crux.

AI reading, argued, not proved: none of the candidates is ruled out, and P4 is not shown. Objections stand: wrong bearer; losses are not effects; a class holding all one's effects holds what one ruins as well (the poison with the river), a reason to doubt that 'one's own' is the right word. It concerns whose losses count, not what one answers for.

Classified by AI as a divergence in how it is held (如何持有之相分): 程颢's 仁者以天地万物为一体 and 阳明's 本然良知 state as a recognized fact what the theory holds under the continuation condition plus the step of invariance.
The extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: 《维摩诘所说经》 is a comparison: care need not first take the other as one's own part, nor can it be inferred only from one shared substance; bodhisattva practice and great compassion are premises there, which the theory does not assert.

account_adds.en: Exactly where 'maintaining the self is a step to the whole' holds along dependence, and what the path leaves to the step.

source_adds.en: The 'therefore' itself, that the environment each self helps create is that self: stated only as P4, which is not shown. Also two axes as evolved drives, and satisfying the self (not in survival mode, not hijacked) as a precondition for coherence with the whole.

name.en: 'Beyond the drive, there is no self'

source.locator: Claim 8; own words 40; critiques, 'Beyond the drive'; open questions, 'No self as the fit of a model'

sense.en: Stated once and never developed: a drive maintains existence at the self level, but beyond the drive there is no self. The folder calls it either deflationary (no substance beyond a maintenance circuit) or mystical (the self dissolves into the whole), theories with different consequences for the ethics; the 2026-10-04 talk supplies an epistemic reading. Own words 40 are marked the fullest statement of the relational self.

correspondences.quote: beyond the drive, there is no self

reading.en: The deflationary half has a home: the thesis forbids an explanation needing a self with a nature of its own, and no law of the dynamics fixes which region is one's own. But the account does not end the self at a drive: the organism is one row of §4.7's three selves, none ruled out. It declines the mystical half: a shared process implies no cosmic subject. That no independent entity is needed is argued, and does not show reality has none.

says.en: Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved; neither shows that reality has none.

Argued, not proved: (P2) what is 'one's own' is a region drawn along a relation of the unfolding, and no law of the dynamics fixes which. A relation the facts privilege (the organism's life) denies it.
