name.en: Delegate coordination to a faster intelligence

source.locator: Loop 4; The responses; claims 78, 113-115; Found by reading: two AI roles

sense.en: Under exponential acceleration humans cannot both stay in charge and stay stable; the only seemingly possible resolution is to delegate coordination to a growing intelligence, hedged: not shown to work. The corpus splits AI as governor, teacher and public infrastructure and never adjudicates.

correspondences.quote: (Doesn't mean it can work, only in theory)

reading.en: The account proposes no delegation and gives no forced conclusion: its answer is no guarantee. Its direction is offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, its theorems taking J1/J2, not the condition, and requires effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise. Reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it, and a formation sure of the sign has no strict reason to be read, an incentive on one model, which bears on surrendering to one.

says.en: Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.
No guarantee: a selection reaches only what couples into it; what the theory gives is exits under hypotheses, six conditions, of which observation is only the first, and how two courses differ.

Assessment: with no ethical premise each of six approaches is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures, and reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it. Under the continuation condition a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.
Theorem (natural weights; one decision; none claimed new as mathematics). Reading: a formation sure of the sign has no strict reason to be read.

account_adds.en: Keeps the question of what training reaches apart from what is proposed, answers 'always' in three senses, and gives where being read loses its incentive.

source_adds.en: A speed argument forcing delegation, with its rival exits (augment cognition, slow acceleration), and the governor-against-teacher choice, which the account does not pose.

name.en: AI amplifies what competition rewards

source.locator: What 2026 changes; claims 114, 146, 147

sense.en: AI amplifies capacities competitive systems reward, so it may empower aggressive strategies rather than make us wiser; aligned with winners and trained on their data it turbocharges the spiral. Competitive systems select for power, not wisdom. So it must be governed as public-good infrastructure.

correspondences.quote: instead of making humanity wiser, AI may make the most aggressive strategies more powerful

reading.en: T3 and the joint-capacity law carry the form: at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, more capacity drains more of what lies beyond, for rising orders. T3's clause on trained systems is conjectured; LA4's small policies show the drain rising with nearness, as the update rule largely gives, locus unresolved. Training installs a law only along its own courses; winners' data as such is not stated. The term is drain, not aggression. The source states an undertaking; as a ranking it would be its holder's, under a scope and order they name.

says.en: Thesis T3: optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings, where that gives room. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support: on small policies trained by gradient, LA4's frozen test finds the drain rising with nearness, as policy gradient's update rule largely gives, and leaves its locus unresolved.

At a mutual best response (its existence is not shown in general), each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands at what those outside leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing, as under one optimizer of that capacity.

Theorem (World): training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them, through a reward only where its couplings separate, and among settled laws by the search's start and neighbourhoods.

account_adds.en: Drain needs no competitive aim, given a rising order, a mutual best response and room. What training can and cannot install, and one frozen test of the clause.

source_adds.en: Competitive systems selecting for power and not wisdom, and AI empowering the most aggressive strategies; winners' data aligning AI with winners; AI as planetary technology; the governance conclusion.

name.en: Foundation erosion: optimising away the load-bearing walls

source.locator: The intensifiers; claim 91

sense.en: Dominant agents sacrifice even the values and rules that keep the system stable and that enabled their rise, since the ledger does not price them. This is why the terminal state is collapse rather than stable tyranny.

correspondences.quote: the optimisation does not know to stop at the load-bearing walls

reading.en: As a reading only, in the corpus's line, so by descent: corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; rewarding those who break them selects for narrowing what couples in. Eroding what enabled one's rise has a form on amounts, keeping its own support and ending through its feeder; rules and values are not conditions in that law. No verdict of collapse over tyranny: a closed lock outlives every loss it does not read, without noise; joint excess ends those depending on the condition. Dependence decides.

targets.part: Reading D26 as revised, the second and third orders

says.en: Reading [AI, D26]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in. What a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

Theorem (World): a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; in the witness, the scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Theorem (World): under balance, keeping its own support, a formation can still end through its feeder, as in the witness Overshoot.
Theorem (any type): under its premises the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked, without noise.
Theorem (World; gate local): n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m.

targets.part: §4 rows, Rewarding what erodes the whole; Keeping the capacity to correct

says.en: §4 rows. Rewarding what erodes the whole: where nothing comes in from a containing family, a balanced rise of what a group couples into is drawn from beyond. Keeping the capacity to correct: a difference closes only through a formation coupling the courses apart and exchanging differently.

account_adds.en: What a route of correction needs structurally: an admission not made through the pool, or members its course would hold anyway (each a witness). And both outcomes, each under its own hypotheses.

source_adds.en: That erosion makes collapse rather than tyranny the terminal state.

name.en: Competition intensification: fewer holding more raises the temperature

source.locator: The intensifiers; claim 90

sense.en: As more accumulates at the top, more agents compete over less, which forces more extreme optimisation and feeds the primary loop. One of three mechanisms the folder credits to Ren's own eleven-step cycle, not to AI elaboration.

correspondences.quote: The Matthew effect is not only distributive; it raises the temperature of the remainder.

reading.en: The race and joint-capacity laws take each drawer's order as given and hold at any distribution: nothing has concentration at the top change how the rest optimize, and 08 takes no condition silently as scarce. In the nearest laws the draw turns on the number of drawers and the coupling, not on how little is left: below the need two or more in turn drain from every amount; one over two steps keeps it in a stated case. None found has less left raising intensity.

name.en: Five endgames, and the third as the only non-trap

source.locator: The endgames; claim 95; Said in Chinese: Loop 4 and the endgames

sense.en: When few players remain they may freeze by mutual destruction, deadlock by frozen consensus, change their narrative to see themselves as a whole, collapse, or converge on one winner. Winner takes all is one absorbing state among several. The third alone is no trap, and it is a change of narrative.

correspondences.quote: "winner takes all" is one absorbing state among several, not the theorem

reading.en: Taken up by name as an open conjecture in 05, 'from an earlier account; not formalized'; which ends the laws admit is asked, not answered. Near the first branch, not its freeze: D48 reads an exchange of harms as a loop, answering more running away. The third is a reading the thesis on collectives does not refuse. The verdict comes only under premises: on a fixed process the possible does not keep widening; calling that a loss, or ranking the third above, is under an order someone holds, one meeting C or another. 'Absorbing' is scoped by drift.

targets.part: The conjecture on the ends of a selection for position

says.en: [Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

targets.part: The theorem on a fixed process, with Reading D45

says.en: Theorem: where every step from some step on is a move of a process Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI, D45]: a fixed rule or institution so followed does not keep it widening; openness is a property of how rules keep changing.
Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good. Drawing and readers from the selected are premises.

targets.part: Reading D48, an exchange of harms

says.en: Reading [AI, D48]: an exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind.

account_adds.en: That the list stands as an open question about which hypotheses admit each end, and a law for what a frozen process does not do.

source_adds.en: The verdict that the third branch alone is no trap, and that it is a change of narrative; the conditions on the freezes (each believes the others rational; the consensus believed to hold); the freeze slowing evolution until collapse.

name.en: Grow sample sizes: decorrelate collapse

source.locator: The endgames; claims 96, 97

sense.en: If change outruns intelligence and coordination, collapse seems inevitable unless the system splits into independent entities, like cells or city-states, so that when some collapse others keep evolving. But now everything is interconnected, with one global civilization, which makes this necessary and hard.

correspondences.quote: split into smaller entities that are independent of each other, for example, like cells do, or something like city states

reading.en: The law underneath, not the hedge. Groups on one coupled family end together and ending selects only between families; after excess, every later member descends from one independent of that family. 'Independent' is exact: not sharing the gated family. If 'cells' means parts of a body, they are the account's opposite case (witness Body); the source's independent entities fit lineages not depending on it. 'One global civilization' is the one-copy premise. As a design it is absent, and that a split is better needs a premise.

says.en: Theorem (World): groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Under balance, the coupled gate and excess from below n + m.

Theorem (World): where a family ran into excess under the coupled gate, every member of a later cohort of descent is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at the gate's need. In the witness Body the confined lineage ends.

Theorem: with every member of later generations depending on the coupled family, every order increasing in its own continuation ranks ending below continuing, with no C; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order ranks it higher. That all so depend is a premise.
Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

account_adds.en: What independence must consist of for the hedge to work.

source_adds.en: The deliberate split as a response to unmanageable pace; that interconnection has in fact removed the fallback.

name.en: A cooperative frame must also survive expansionist neighbours

source.locator: Counterexamples; claims 26, 104; Raised inside the corpus

sense.en: Enduring communal societies contained compounding and were unexposed to external competition; contact with colonisation and global markets absorbed them. Hostile expansionist frames often outcompete others. So a cooperative frame must also solve external competition, and nothing in the corpus shows how.

correspondences.quote: a cooperative frame must additionally solve the external-competition problem, and nothing in the corpus shows how

reading.en: The account also says persistence does not select widening: a part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence. The clearing witness has this form: a greatest part continues, the dweller ends. Selection among groups by ending reads any amount, so whatever lets a group outlast neighbours rises by it, cooperative or not; which level wins is read off the counts. Nor does the account solve the problem; 'hostile', 'expansionist' and contact between societies are unread. Such losses count under the continuation condition; ranking them takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another. The join to frames among societies is proposed here.

says.en: A part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence (Clearing.loses_beyond), so persistence alone does not select widening; an empirical target, not a premise.

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups, so the whole selects for it exactly where k times the within-group discordance is below k times the within-group concordance with the concordance among groups. One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

Theorem: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. Conditional: what it ends has significance only under a significance; under the continuation condition the clearer's part loses the dweller from every standpoint, and where nothing has significance an empty predicate counts no loss, though the dweller still ends.
Theorem (any type): which level wins is read off the counts, not explained. What the groups are, or how they form, persist or mix, is not given.

account_adds.en: Keeps this counterexample's form open rather than absorbing it: persistence is not a verdict, and selection among groups favours no kind of amount.

source_adds.en: The historical pattern, the role of colonisation, and the problem as a stated limit on the narrative intervention.

name.en: Trust is an output of shared seeing

source.locator: The responses; claims 121-125, 173

sense.en: Trust is not an input to coordination but arises when people share an understanding and can expect others to act on it. So the bottleneck is alignment of perception, and an intelligence teaching many to see the same loops is a coordination technology. Agreement that this is not inevitable comes first.

correspondences.quote: Trust is not a prerequisite—it is an outcome.

reading.en: Both refuse trust as an input; 'trust' as a term is absent from the chapters beyond 'antitrust'. The account's stated purpose runs the source's way: 08 reads the work as for a map, for alignment and of wisdom, that any mind can check, 'and through it shared understanding and coordination', and says that, since human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of its checks, only coupling them in (review by people, tests on trained systems, models of the test systems) widens what its selection reaches. Its laws part: giving lost everywhere is restored only by a law giving first; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop; knowing another's law is no coupling; seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough; where the valuation differs, informing can lower the worth. Seeing-then-trust is unproved, not refuted.

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Theorem (any process; periphery): promises do not: 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens.
Theorem (World): knowing another's law is no coupling; reading what another couples into selects through at least the pooled coupling.

Theorem (natural weights; one decision; none claimed new): where the valuation differs, informing can lower the worth below both moves. By the current valuation on a shared model, there is no reason against informing it.

Reading [AI, D45]: observation is the first of six conditions, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, since reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, and coupling is not compliance.

Reading [AI, D66]: no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a map, for alignment and of wisdom, that any mind can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination.

Reading [AI, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

account_adds.en: A grounded start: what must already give, before any alignment of views; what seeing would still lack; and that informing does not always help.

source_adds.en: The causal chain seeing, expectation, trust, coordination, and teaching as its means; the folder itself notes no trial was run.

name.en: Change the dominant attractor or nothing; the frame is the highest lever

source.locator: The responses; claims 109, 110, 136

sense.en: Following Meadows, paradigm is the highest leverage point; minor adjustments do not change the outcome. The frame cannot be reached by facts or shame: fight myth with better myth, its antagonists impersonal forces. Incentives and narratives must change together.

correspondences.quote: If we don't solve dominant attractors, focusing on minor adjustments won't change the outcome

reading.en: Partly met. 'Not by facts alone': T7 says drift aside a metric is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, a reader outside, a loss entering, a new reading, the nearest thing to rewriting a frame. A new reading formed from the share is absorbed. Re-absorption of a state is shown only under a strong condition. Paradigm is not ranked highest; drift and LA2's one note show a lock can give otherwise.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step. A strong condition: where winners rewrite the rule the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held. The record names the leverage-point argument as this part's correspondence.

Theorem (any type): a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course: a sufficient way out, not shown the only one; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed.

targets.part: The thesis statement and how far it has been seen

says.en: Thesis T7: drift aside, such a metric is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads (a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading), not on evidence alone. Conjectured of actual metrics; LA2 counts against one forbidden case (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift, as a claim about trained judges.

Reading over proved cases: a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

account_adds.en: Which reforms are re-absorbed and which are not, and where the windows close.

source_adds.en: Paradigm as the highest place to intervene, narrative rewriting as the means ('fight myth with better myth'), the antagonists as impersonal forces, and the manifesto's programme.

name.en: Direction-setting told from capture only by structure

source.locator: Said in Chinese: The strain; claim 169; Open: Loop 3, approved when the direction is approved

sense.en: The recording grants the shaping of a society's expectations and language the most legitimacy, as Ren's hedged value stance. The folder says this is loop 3 from the side of an endorsed direction, and needs a symmetric test: public contestability, measuring what it selects, not rewarding winners with more capacity.

correspondences.quote: Until the criterion is stated, [39:22] reads as an exception to the theory for one direction.

reading.en: The account makes no exception and does not supply the criterion the folder asks for: 'no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here'. It cannot yet tell the two by what shaping changes; capture and accountable revision part at a reader of the loss beyond the share, and a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round. 'Most legitimacy' does not appear; legitimate procedure is J4, a further premise. Ranking these courses takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Theorem (counts) with reading [AI, D45]: selected control is not thereby capture; since what the rule reads is fixed by the readers' premise, not the shaping, the model does not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

Theorem (natural weights; one decision). Reading: revaluing is read as an incentive, related to induced preference shifts (Carroll and others 2022); no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here.
Reading [AI, D65; historical correspondence, no theorem]: a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice.

account_adds.en: Where the proposed structural test stops short in a model, and an explicit statement that the criterion is missing here too.

source_adds.en: The value stance on state-shaped narrative, and three named candidate criteria tested symmetrically on any polity.

name.en: Goodness as rational, and the spiral as destructive

sense.en: Though 'not a moral claim about individuals', the folder carries a verdict: the dynamic is destructive in nature; goodness is a rational and necessary choice (AI brief); a transcending narrative has to be done; happiness, equality and freedom should rank above financial efficiency.

correspondences.quote: this kind of dynamics is not inherently stable, and is destructive in nature

reading.en: Sharpest difference. The folder calls the spiral destructive in nature; here no law marks a dynamic good or bad, standards form within the unfolding (07 §1), and ranking one course above another takes an order someone holds; where the condition holds de se, self-concern already ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and elsewhere a result names the order it takes, one meeting C or another. The nearest form of 'rational' is narrower: self-concern ranks one coupled ending below, with no C, and some self-concerned order reverses where a copy is kept. Goodness as rationally forced on any mind has no place in it: no should stands beyond becoming.

says.en: Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. The condition alone ranks nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, and elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes; a statement reading no order entails C only where it fails.
No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.

Theorem: an order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses. Not that widening is better, or that a ranking obliges anyone.

account_adds.en: Where a verdict is made, what it reads: a scope and an order its holder names, and the one case self-concern ranks without C (07 §4.4).

source_adds.en: The verdict itself: rationality of goodness, the rank of happiness, equality and freedom over capital return.

name.en: Be generative, keep the space open, stop being selfish selves

source.locator: What 2026 changes; claim 149; own words 48

sense.en: The constructive condition handed on to the rest of the corpus: be generative, keep the possibility space open, recognise what leads to an end such as totalizing attractors, and recognise we are not selfish selves competing.

correspondences.quote: as long as we are generative, as long as we keep the possibility space open

reading.en: The account keeps the direction and restates it under premises. 'Generative' splits into the map's generation, which allows loss and means no new organization, and 生生, life's continuation, in T8, the way of seeing offered for life; a ranking states the hypotheses its theorem takes. Keeping open has one exact limit; openness is read as how rules keep changing. 'Not selfish selves' has a path under P1-P4, up to what one conditions, and other scopes can count what it does not reach, the step of invariance among them. Recognising is not shown sufficient: seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, and a reading formed from the share absorbs a change of it.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Along a course that makes only the moves of one fixed process from some step on, the possible under that process does not keep widening. How two courses differ is said with no premise, the hard cases mixed; which course ranks above is the order a result takes as a hypothesis.

Under P1–P4, without the step of invariance, concern for one's own continuation reaches what lies downstream of what one conditions; other scopes can count what that path does not reach, the step of invariance among them.

account_adds.en: That an expansion ending forms of life is mixed under C; widening's silence where a comparison is mixed; and how far self-concern goes before the step.

source_adds.en: 'As long as' as a sufficient stance; recognising oneself as not a selfish self as a condition on success, which the account has only as a path under premises.

name.en: The theory's own conclusion, believed, is a lock

source.locator: What 2026 changes; claims 143, 150, 174; own words 43

sense.en: The folder's sharpest self-critique: treating this as a totalizing attractor, hope alone with little chance of change, is itself the trap the theory describes. Inevitability is self-fulfilling. If you believe the world is a jungle, you despair. If we do not build it, it will not happen.

correspondences.quote: the theory's own conclusion*, believed, is one of those locks

reading.en: The account's answer has two parts: no guarantee, and named exits under hypotheses; drawn, neither lock holds for good. 'Totalizing' is not a live word for this. 03 has the general form: a threshold response has two right predictions, where publication starts deciding. 08 reads the laws on the work that states them, but on what its checks reach and what it draws on. I did not find whether believing or publishing these capture laws changes what readers do. The join is proposed here.

says.en: Always guaranteed: no. Available as a direction: as a way of seeing, not a verdict. Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, each under its hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective.
Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good; a bound on the weight falls across the distance from the critical mass.

Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law): a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts. The witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.

Reading [AI, D66]: the laws apply to the work that states them: what its checks reach, what it draws on, and that completion is not closure. Whether reading them changes what readers do is not among these.

account_adds.en: An answer that is neither fatal nor hopeful: a table of what holds under which hypotheses.

source_adds.en: The reflexive claim that believing the diagnosis strengthens it, and the instruction to stop leaning that way.

name.en: The legitimating vocabulary: a ledger or a costume

source.locator: Said in Chinese: The legitimating vocabulary is a ledger; claim 168; Open: A ledger or a costume (the assistant's reading)

sense.en: Even where self-interest has become working rationality, power is justified by 'making life better'. Read by the folder's assistant: that vocabulary is a counter-ledger the spiral has not rewritten, and a lever. It constrains or is emptied, depending on whether the governed can invoke it against the powerful without penalty.

correspondences.quote: Which of the two it is depends on whether those addressed can invoke its terms against the powerful without penalty.

reading.en: The source names 伪开 for the emptied vocabulary. 06 §十 says earlier texts held 伪开 as 欺 and maps only structure: open locally and closed as a whole, short-term and long-term, on the surface with the meta closed. So a shared word and a divergence: the account drops the 欺 the costume horn needs. 'Costume' has a neighbour in complying when read, an incentive; 'without penalty' in D65's suppressed feedback and blocked exit. No law takes a vocabulary of justification as a lever on conduct.

source_adds.en: Stands in this folder, and it points to meta-attractor and OPEN-QUESTIONS, not read here.

03 when complying when read is best
ONE-ARGUMENT lines on J4 and the direction

name.en: Frames read across a rivalry: proposals as signals

source.locator: Said in Chinese: Frames are read across the boundary; claims 148, 172

sense.en: One side's safety talk framed as struggle is read by the other as hegemonic, so confrontation looks obviously right; asymmetric proposals read as still aiming to win. Each side's reading becomes the other's evidence, a loop between two sides. Proposals must be symmetric to be believed.

correspondences.quote: A frame becomes legible to a rival through what it proposes

Fits as a possible case of a prediction read by what it predicts, which I do not assert.

name.en: Money and finance as narrative

sense.en: Money is a narrative: belief in its value lets it coordinate; it is a power token giving optionality. Capitalism reads as a religion; stock value is a bet on others' belief. Yet this is no anti-capitalism: markets matter, but financial logic should not be the dominant order.

correspondences.quote: Market and capital are one of the most important human inventions

A bet on others' belief has one near form, in a reading: a threshold response related to self-fulfilling runs (Diamond and Dybvig 1983), 'not a model of coordination'. No market law ranks arrangements, so 'should not be dominant' has no home either.

name.en: Every social fact as one sentence over three primitives

source.locator: Three primitives, one canonical sentence; Claims 10-13

sense.en: Society is made of exactly three kinds of thing: spirits that act, tokens that are claimable units of meaning, spaces that interpret them. Every social fact has one shape, and with these one can model essentially any scenario where actors cooperate, compete or exchange under rules. The folder later finds this incomplete and retires it.

correspondences.quote: a Spirit holds a Token in a Space

reading.en: The mechanism of the difference: the source chooses three kinds first and fits relations to them; the account states every theorem for any carrier and relation, choosing no kind first. It has no universal form of a social fact and does not localize this one. Its one institution model is an entry rule, which it says is no definition. 'Holder' there is a cohort's relation to a rule, not possession of an item: a shared word.

says.en: 'every theorem is stated for every carrier and relation, so no frame or kind of thing is chosen before the relations'.

'a minimal model of one kind, an entry rule on a shared stock, passed through members who also keep it, with no compliance and no records. It is not a definition of an institution.' Theorem (root; a family of models).
Not yet done: “An organism and one kind of institution each have one minimal model”.

account_adds.en: Exact laws for that one rule: the band of quotas, closed regions under revision, when a rule passes out, and two separately started states tested apart.

source_adds.en: The triad, token types, spaces as micro-institutions, and the universality claim, which the account neither states nor needs.

name.en: Subject, object, holder, agent as roles read off relations

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; The Yi turn; Claims 60, 83, 143, 154-158, 239

sense.en: The disjoint triad failed in building it: spirit contains space, space holds tokens, token holds spirit, and a spirit's environment can be another spirit. So subject, object, holder, issuer, capability, container and agent are not categories but readings of context facts, and one row can be all at once. Being, having, doing and permitting are to be one substrate; having and being are one substance seen from two ends of a relation.

correspondences.quote: a reading lens, not root types

reading.en: Same form: a split stated as positions in a relation, not kinds of thing. The account's checked case is narrower: on the World one relatum stands as a condition and can be active as a formation, and that they are one relatum is a modelling commitment the laws do not check; its wider claim is a thesis, argued. The source reads roles off separately owned facts; the account has one kind of symbol. No line of descent is claimed.

says.en: Theorem (World): 'In the World a relatum can stand as a condition at some level, which others depend on and draw on, and can be active as a formation, which depends, draws, takes and gives. A flame is both.'

“One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known belong to one loop; intention and foresight have a place in responsibility, and none has been shown to bound whose losses count”.
A commitment of the representation, which the axiom report does not check: 'formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum' (`World.ofRoles`).
'Subject and object, actor and patient, observer and world, inside and outside', with fact and value, 'are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.'

account_adds.en: That each split states what it leaves out; that intention and foresight, which have a place in responsibility, are not shown to bound whose losses count; that the thesis forbids explanations, not observations.

source_adds.en: Roles of holder, issuer, presenter, capability and container on one thing at once (see the several-truths entry), and 'even the type of a thing is a thing', which the source's own Kinds, never Yis, later give up.

name.en: Visibility and conditions as relations, not stored attributes

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; The actor turn; Claims 80, 99

sense.en: A policy is a spirit you contain, not a bit you set; caveats and visibility collapse into one mechanism evaluated at resolution time, and Ren rules that they emerge from relations. The folder lists this among two structural discoveries that survive into the substrate. Visibility here means who may see: a rule of access.

correspondences.quote: Caveat 和 Visibility是从关系中涌现的

reading.en: Proposed here, a like form at one point only: what one can see of another is read off a relation between them, not stored on what is seen. The account's relation is reach, what selection through couplings can tell apart; the source's is a rule of access. Where the account has access, its record supplies supports, permitted set and route: on that model permission is a parameter, the reverse of emergence, so on the source's own subject they part. 'Condition' is a shared word.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): 'Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them'. 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.'
Theorem (periphery, pre-spine). Record's conditions: 'The supports, the permitted set, the route and the operations are supplied'.

account_adds.en: That the law's force lies in the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings; T6's invisible half.

source_adds.en: Visibility as an authored policy, holder-only by default, with policy itself a contained thing that can be read and changed; and its emergence from relations, which the account does not state.

name.en: One stable addressable root that keeps its identity through every role

source.locator: The Yi turn; Claims 146, 150-153, 221

sense.en: A Yi (一, 'the one') is a bare root: UID, domain, primary kind binding, timestamps, a sequence, a commit head. It is the one addressable bearer of traits, relations, capabilities, state and behaviour, and it becomes subject, object or actor by composed kinds without changing its identity. Birth is immutable. Stated of a runtime, and also taken as the ontology's one primitive.

correspondences.quote: without changing its root identity

reading.en: As engineering, a UID is the move the account's models also make: naming given, equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model. As ontology they part: the carrier is a parameter, a theorem says nothing of an element beyond how it relates, identity across steps is a reading of continuation, and that the commitment belongs only to the representation is itself 'not shown'. The grammar's 一 is the full relation, not a bearer: a shared sign.

says.en: 'The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations: a theorem says nothing of an element beyond how it relates.'
Commitments of the representation: 'The naming of relata', 'which condition is which relatum is given, not derived'; 'Identity by naming', 'which formation continues which is named'.

Theorem (World), 'Labels carry nothing': a renaming preserves the five readings checked, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. Section's opening: 'identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.'
Calibration (World): 'names carry one decided identity more than relations do.' Identity read off relations is identity up to indiscernibility.

Thesis, argued: 'the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.'

targets.part: the sentence on equality on the carrier

account_adds.en: Where identity is forced (a census with more active after a step than before); that succession across a dormant step stays possible.

source_adds.en: An engineering reason for the root: stable denotation, recoverable history and immutable creation across rename and reparent, which a running system needs whatever the metaphysics.

name.en: Identity as what is held, not a substance

source.locator: Three primitives, one canonical sentence; Claims 15-16

sense.en: In the 2025 framework a spirit's identity in a space just is the set of tokens it holds; across spaces it is the sum of its credentials, memberships and roles. The protocol requires only distinctness and continuity over time, not how a spirit is authenticated.

correspondences.quote: identity is not a substance but an accumulated portfolio

reading.en: The source says what identity is; the account gives where such a statement holds. Identity is read relative to a class, so a sum of holdings is one class among several, and overlapping identities are several classes. No nature behind the relations is common ground. But a configuration is how it relates to its continuations, so equal portfolios with different futures are not alike there. The account stands nearer this 2025 statement than the source's own 2026 UID root does.

says.en: A witness on the source texts' test systems: 'Overlapping identities are several classes, observer-dependence is the choice of class'.
'Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition'.

Theorem (any process): 'Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike: they realize the same claims, match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations, and pass the same tests'.

Thesis, argued: it forbids an explanation needing 'a self with a nature of its own'. These results show configurations, laws and parts as represented need nothing beyond relations; 'Neither shows that reality has none.'

account_adds.en: An exact sense of 'how it relates', its limits (equality needed for intervening on one of two alike configurations) and two live arguments that would defeat the thesis.

source_adds.en: Identity as accumulated and social: credentials and roles given by others, plural across spaces, a 'social CV'; and continuity required of a spirit by the protocol, where the account makes continuity a reading.

name.en: A token means nothing outside the space that interprets it

source.locator: Three primitives; What the whole thing is for; Claims 18-21, 26, 299

sense.en: A token's meaning is supplied by its space, the boundary of relevance that stops a credential carrying authority into a context that never granted it. Only declared types are recognized. Later: no global schema or trust root; interoperation through exact kind identities and explicit local admission.

correspondences.quote: A token by itself is just a symbol; the space provides the interpretation

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text speaks of a place that interprets. A mechanism shared in part: a form has its sense only under a map, and reads back only where the map allows. But the account's code is a formation's own map, agreed only through hearings; meaning sits in formations and their history, not in a place. Refusing a global schema has a checked neighbour: an imposed code makes all agree and each loses distinctions it drew. 'Token' in 04's copying is a symbol at a site: a shared word.

says.en: 'A code is a formation's map from senses to forms.' Theorem (any type): 'An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none.'
Theorem (any type): 'A code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense, and only it, exactly where no two senses hold one form'.

Theorem (any type): imposing one code gives 'agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others, by privileging forms'. The record does not show a code is in fact imposed or that imposing is better.

account_adds.en: How agreement forms and fails: symmetric starts never agree without a break, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining. 'What a code keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.'

source_adds.en: Context as a load-bearing primitive; declared token types; authority bounded by context; cross-space recognition by reference or bridge.

name.en: The grammar as executable status functions (Searle, Mead, Goffman, North)

source.locator: Three primitives; Claims 37-41

sense.en: The token is X, the status Y, the space C: the grammar is a syntax for status function declarations, collective intentionality turned into an editable file. Tokens are the shared symbols of symbolic interactionism, a role is literally a token one possesses (Goffman), a space's rules are the rules of the game (North), and tokens are older than markets. The source says the 2026 documents dropped all this.

correspondences.quote: X counts as Y in context C

reading.en: No theory of collective acceptance or status here. Nearest is the shared code, a form for a sense agreed by hearing, with convention cited through Lewis 1969 and Skyrms 2010: agreement on a form, no powers conferred. Recognition is supplied or merged into a count, in §12 and in the rule protocol. Class-relative sameness is not 'counts as'. Nothing here says the omission is a defect.

source_adds.en: An account of institutional facts by collective acceptance, with named lineages in social theory and ritual anthropology.
