name.en: The fork is decided by coordination, not technology

source.locator: The argument: The fork, and why the bottleneck is coordination; claims 11, 12

sense.en: The same capacity gives cancer or liberation. Which branch comes is not chosen by technology: the material capacity for near-utopia is already here and the hard part is coordination. That licenses moving from civilizational diagnosis to a festival, since experiments in coordination act on the bottleneck.

correspondences.quote: The material capacity for something close to utopia is already in our hands. The hard part is not the tools. The hard part is coordination.

reading.en: The account shares the chain as a purpose, not a law: 08 names shared understanding and coordination as what it is for, and says that, since human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of its checks, only coupling them in (review by people, tests on trained systems, models of the test systems) widens what its selection reaches. The word is nearly absent from the laws. Asked this question, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION answers no guarantee, named exits, six conditions of which observation is the first. So coordination is at most part of several conditions, its sufficiency withheld. The capacity claim is simply not made.

says.en: No guarantee. What the theory does give is exact, and narrower: exits from the loops that lock a collective, each under stated hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective; six conditions for enough situationality, of which observation is only the first; how two courses differ, with no premise, on a finite listing every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranking a widening higher; which course ranks above is the order a result takes as a hypothesis.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure, all at once. Observation is necessary and not sufficient: seeing is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, since reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, and coupling is not compliance. All six together still rank nothing.

"Human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of them. So no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a map, for alignment and of wisdom, that any mind can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination." A statement of the work's purpose, not a law, and not about what decides a collective's course.

"One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits (05 §12), and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; no field test of reform events is frozen …; no test of a thesis run so far has human participants."

account_adds.en: Limits on the fork itself: how far off a break is does not couple in by threshold, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact. Ranking by widening is an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names; the continuation condition counts every returnless loss, and narrower scopes can count particular ones.

source_adds.en: The claims that capacity is in hand and that coordination is the single bottleneck, and with them the licence for a festival as an intervention. 05 lists Wamo as an application, correspondence not established.

name.en: The Great Liberation and the automated commons

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claims 11, 34, 104

sense.en: Pointed at commons and universal services instead of capital gains, automation ends manufactured scarcity: free stores, robot-maintained housing, regenerative gardens. Life's meaning becomes play, love, exploration and shaping meaning rather than work.

correspondences.quote: What if we don't use AI for capital gains, we use AI to build [commons], to build universal services.

reading.en: No such end state is stated. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §8 keeps positional goods zero-sum and conserved stocks rivalrous, in a reading, and 'commons' in the account is a stock and renewal, not a universal service; the word is shared, not the reference. §7 reads the joint selection as conditions on how rules are read and revised, not a final state.

source_adds.en: A positive vision of life after labour, and manufactured scarcity as a function of the present economy. Stands in this folder; the fork's cooperative branch also in theories/the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure/.

name.en: A floor of necessities and exit without coercion

sense.en: The concrete target: no one hungry, modern living space, no one marginalized or losing dignity, and everyone free to choose any system or none, with a safe exit. Free provision must carry no social inferiority for it to count as freedom.

correspondences.quote: Everyone can choose systems they want be in, or non of them, without coercion

reading.en: Priority of basic conditions (J2), sufficiency above a threshold and legitimate procedure (J4) have the roles of floor and consent, but as named further premises whose tier assignment is a reading; the source states them as the design target. Exit does appear, once: a reading keeps blocked exit apart as a fault in organized relations. 07 shows no duty or right. The 'exits' of COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION are ways out of a lock, another reference.

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C asks nothing of them. The tier assignment is a reading.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences): domination changes a judgment to preserve; keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair; without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: kept apart are an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm, the hard rival.

account_adds.en: The floor's price: crossed basic losses may remain incomparable, and each step of ranking takes a premise named, the continuation condition and an order meeting C among them.

source_adds.en: Exit from any system as a design target, dignity (no hit in the live set searched; coerc only once, in the philosophy dossier) and the destigmatization of free provision. The account states no right or guarantee of exit; 07 says it shows no duty or right.

name.en: Shared reality as the substrate of coordination

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claim 13

sense.en: The scarcest resource is not compute but shared reality: not consensus of opinion but a sufficiently overlapping sense of what is real, what matters and what we owe each other. It is the infrastructure for coordination, and it is now fractured.

correspondences.quote: a sufficiently overlapping sense of what is real, what matters, and what we owe each other

reading.en: The chain (shared understanding, then coordination) is the account's stated purpose, yet no law says shared reality is what coordination runs on. The nearest laws limit it: holders of one generative model can together end their pool's renewal, so shared preferences over one's own are not one goal; a code is forms for senses; pooling gives what a group can tell apart, what is real, narrowly. What matters and what we owe need premises and procedure.

says.en: Theorem (any type, runs of hearings): the forms that can become shared are exactly those in use; from a symmetric start a law keeping both symmetries never brings agreement; an imposed code loses the distinctions it merges. Being joined through couplings is not enough.

Theorem: a group's closure is the union of its members'; on the World a pool separates exactly what some member separates, and no more. It does not show which formations pool, how a pool forms or lasts, or that a pool responds to what it separates.

Theorem (a chooser of one step, point prediction; no evaluation enters): holders of one such model together end the pool's renewal, neither coupling into the pool. Alike preferences, each over one's own, are not one goal; a goal over the shared level is no guarantee either: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step. The papers' simulations are not said to fail: they have no shared draw.

"Human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of them. So no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a map, for alignment and of wisdom, that any mind can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination." A statement of purpose, not a law.

account_adds.en: That agreement can cost distinctions, which return only from a form held outside or coined; and that a shared model need not keep what its holders share. No law says a shared code is worth keeping.

source_adds.en: That shared reality, not compute, is scarcest and is the infrastructure coordination runs on: no law of the account says so. Also overlap in what matters and what is owed, trust and belonging.

name.en: A thousand participants, a thousand Wamos

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claims 75 (Plurality), 110

sense.en: Everyone formed their own understanding of the 2022 festival, yet the narrative succeeded because its principles became the framework of collaboration. Semantic underdetermination is a feature of the coordination mechanism, not noise in it; the 2023 values already named plurality: "Our strength lies in our diversity".

correspondences.quote: 一千个参与者有一千个瓦猫之夏，每个人对它都会产生自己的理解

reading.en: Plural reading has one law for it and one against. For: a pool separates what some member separates, and an imposed code loses distinctions. Against: a formation reads another's form for a sense as that sense exactly where their codes agree there, otherwise as another sense, so a thousand readings do not read across. Plans ask compatible moves and name no shared sense, so reading across is not asked of joint action. That plurality helped coordinate is stated nowhere.

says.en: Theorem: a pool separates exactly what some member separates. Reading [AI reading, D45]: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach; telling more apart goes only through further members, necessary to that and not sufficient.

Theorem: "A formation whose code tells senses apart reads another's form for a sense as that sense, and only it, exactly where their codes agree there, and otherwise as another sense." An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, its source losing none.
Theorem (any type): a code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense exactly where no two senses hold one form: synonyms do no harm and homonyms do.

Theorem (any process): where every joint step projects onto a step of each part, and the plans are compatible, the zipped joint plan keeps both guards. Its hypotheses name moves, not meanings. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.

account_adds.en: The edge: a thousand readings of one word fail to read across, and one form held for several senses fails to read back. Whether that matters to joint action is not stated; the plan laws do not ask it.

source_adds.en: That plural reading was part of why it worked, as an observed property of one event, and that principles can frame collaboration without one meaning.

name.en: A protocol, not an institution: the consensus as a licence

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; Wamotopia; claims 42–44, 111

sense.en: Wamo is a rule-set on which self-organization runs: a shared language letting independent nodes cooperate without a central controller. We govern the protocol, not people. The coordinating artefact is a text like a licence, propagated widely, so the consensus and not an organizing body is the infrastructure.

correspondences.quote: it is a consensus file, like a license, that we all follow, just like Creative Commons license

reading.en: A licence propagated is not imposed and is not forms for senses, so the imposed code is the nearest misfit, not the form. Nearer: in a witness a formation both hear brings agreement; a resolution written into what later cohorts read rests; locally authorized moves must be jointly allowed, which a text must establish. If a text did fix senses, each reader would lose what it merges. No live text speaks of a coordinating licence; these joins are this read's. Consent and penalties look alike until penalties are removed, in one reading.

says.en: Theorem: in a witness of two formations, a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement. A resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on. An imposed code makes all agree, each formation losing the distinctions it merges. Actual conventions are not shown to form so.

Theorem (any process, periphery module; form only, a licence is not modelled): with faithful projections and valid local plans, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed, every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid.

Reading [AI reading, D69]: an institution kept by its members' consent and one held by penalties are the thermostat witness read socially, in one core class while the penalties stand, told apart once their removal is in the net; the witness's net renamed, not a new law.

account_adds.en: What must hold for it to work, and "a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule" (a reading of the entry-rule model, which has no compliance).

source_adds.en: The design decision itself, and the claim that a text propagated is sufficient infrastructure, with its neutrality deliberately incomplete. Coordination-text versus manifesto is a practice finding of the folder.

name.en: Latent coordination capacity is built before it is spent

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claim 45

sense.en: Events are manifestations running on the protocol. The protocol is the shared agreement that lets a connected network form before any concrete action is planned: by creating togetherness we create the capacity to act. The network is the product, what it does decided later.

correspondences.quote: By creating this togetherness and connection, we create the capacity to act

reading.en: In a witness, ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), and formed conditions carried the next stretch in selected software histories: capacity prior to use, as specific conditions, not an interchangeable amount. But how a supported start forms is not shown, and that is what the source claims to do; so defined, ignition uses the reserve up. One periphery law closes a connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people.

says.en: In the exchange witness ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional): one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin; promises do not suffice. Not shown: "How a supported start forms". So defined, ignition needs the reserve and uses it up.

Assessment: in selected LibreOffice history before final incorporation and in Narwhal's continuation, inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization before a lasting organization formed, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts. It is no phase transition, causal identification or frozen prediction.

Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence): it can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts; eligibility and basic classifications are supplied, each needing its own argument.
Theorem (periphery): "It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance."

account_adds.en: The failure case: a loop of mutual promise that never starts, and overbuilding as a counterexample; that the start's forming is unexplained. A case for building shared capacity can stand where a comparison has actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case, read under the continuation condition, an order meeting C with J1–J4 and complete relational correspondence; a ranking takes an order a result names.

source_adds.en: That togetherness in itself is this capacity. The account's capacity is specific conditions; togetherness is not tested as one.

name.en: The Abundance Loop, seeded by an unconditional gift

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; The unit of instantiation; claims 31, 57

sense.en: Value circulates instead of being captured: the more you give to the protocol, the more it supports you. The loop is seeded by an unconditional gift (无用之礼, a sticker, a candy, a sincere hug), and exchange must nourish rather than extract.

correspondences.quote: the more you give to the protocol, the more the protocol supports you

reading.en: The seed has an exact form: restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, without which total withholding stays; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source. That has the form of 无用之礼, on laws with no amounts. The return is scoped: whether giving rises depends on what it brings back and on assortment, and a gift brings support beyond its draw only by need asymmetry or renewal from outside.

says.en: Theorem (any type): a set giving at the start, each member waiting on at most its tolerance outside it, keeps giving. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (a pair's run; offspring a supplied reading): where β ≤ γ, in every cohort listed as pairs whose places not of a kind withhold, the kind does not rise; under complete assortment answering is weakly favoured exactly where γ ≤ β. Which sign holds is not derived.
Theorem (World: balance; single small witnesses): the webs show two ways a gift can bring support beyond what it draws on the giver: need asymmetry within the pair, and renewal from outside.
With a source giving whatever it waits on, all give from step 3 from every start, in a ring of three. It does not show how waiting forms.

account_adds.en: Why a gift and not mutual promises alone; that a law of giving must change, not only a state; and where a surplus can come from. Laws of giving with amounts are open. The README's own critique, reciprocity asserted without mechanism, stands.

source_adds.en: That the protocol returns support to givers, and nourishment against extraction as a practical test. No mechanism of return is given in the source, or stated of any protocol in the account.

name.en: The Prime Directive: generate positive externality

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claims 46, 88

sense.en: One imperative: build in ways good for more than yourself; act so your winning benefits the whole. It is also a licence: as long as you generate no negative externalities you are free. Ren doubts the term and suggests positive sum.

correspondences.quote: As long as you are not generating negative externalities—and ideally, are creating positive ones—you are free

reading.en: The freedom condition has an exact form on the World: a part widening its own options widens the whole exactly while its net draw stays within every outside formation's margin, else mixed. But the source commands. The account proves a fact about admission and ranks only under hypotheses a result states, the continuation condition, self-concern or C. Ren's 'positive sum' keeps a frame the account removes without removing rivalry.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

Any type, a finite listing: one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Ranking the wider above is an order's, not a law's.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems: a difference parts make only together; positions' rises total their falls.

account_adds.en: The hard case the directive hides: gains here and losses there are mixed, so widening alone does not decide; further judgments name their criteria and who holds them, and §5's practical-judgment scheme uses J1–J4. 'External' is relative to an accounting's scope (05, a reading).

source_adds.en: The obligation, and the practical licence. The README notes the directive has no check beyond dialogue; the margin law is a check the source lacks, for conserved amounts only.

name.en: Every action leaves the system richer and more alive

source.locator: Claims 31, 48

sense.en: Under Wamo, the product is positive externality: every action leaves the system richer, more connected and more alive than before; the ethos is to leave things more alive, more connected, more possible than you found them.

correspondences.quote: Every action leaves the system richer, more connected, and more alive than it was before.

reading.en: "More possible" is close to widening; the source makes it an imperative and a description, where the account has C, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (every claim counted as living). The universal per-step form is then scoped: a finite balanced world with requirements within its list has no such course by name, though a witness keeps widening within kinds, and many actions are mixed, which widening does not rank. "Alive" and "connected" are not read.

says.en: Widening: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form. C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living; it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and does not rank anything. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

World (a list holds every condition, balance, nothing from nothing, requirements within the list): a finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name; on a witness meeting the same premises the levels keep widening within kinds.

Theorem (any process; witnesses): along a course of a process what is possible at a stretch's end is possible at its start; where the possible under it keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout.
Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 is the continuation of life, not novelty or scale.

account_adds.en: Per-step growth, direction and continuing capacity kept apart; "an expansion producing ever more novelty" is not 生生. 生生 is the continuation of life, and widening is not its measure; the account issues no imperative, and ranking any of it takes an order a result names, one meeting C or another.

source_adds.en: The aspiration as a description of how life under the protocol goes and as an imperative, with no premise named and no measure proposed.

name.en: Two gods, and Wamo as the dominant attractor

source.locator: Claims 18, 39, 41; Open questions: Dominant attractor

sense.en: History is a tension between two attractors, a metaphor of two gods: Moloch, God of Decay, and Wamo, God of Life. The aim is to make coordination more rewarding than zero-sum competition and Wamo the dominant civilizational attractor, without eliminating competition.

correspondences.quote: the dominant civilizational attractor

reading.en: A counter-rule read monotonically from its own share, every rule read favouring its carriers, locks as the rule it replaced did; A-13 offers this as a check on remedies. So a dominant Wamo is a capture candidate only if so read; where its reading favours only above a threshold a change across it leaves, and from a start against it, it may never lock. No dynamic is God of anything. "Meta-attractor of Moloch" is the corpus sense the glossary excludes.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, every rule read favouring its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. Where its reading favours only above a threshold, a change carrying the share across leaves; from a start against its reading it may never lock.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once.

Theorem (any type): where the rule is read against the share, selection under favouring rules does not lower it, and the rules favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's: the rise the lock rests on does not form.

Meta-attractor: closed capture, rule and reading both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading beyond the share. It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization reproducing the conditions selecting it.
[this dossier, AI] "Its use is as a check on proposed remedies. A remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share, under those conditions, is the same object."

account_adds.en: What a counter-attractor would have to be to avoid its own law: a rule reading beyond its share, or read against it. 'A real loss need not form a meta-attractor', so the binary is not forced from the loss side either.

source_adds.en: The metaphor of life against decay, flagged as metaphor by the source, and the strategic goal of dominance. Ren's 2026 'keep the possibility space open' and hierarchy notes move away from it in the source too.

name.en: If I thrive, the network thrives

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 31

sense.en: Wamo is defined as the logic in which self-interest and collective interest are aligned: if I thrive the network thrives, and if the network thrives I thrive more.

correspondences.quote: If I thrive, the network thrives. If the network thrives, I thrive more.

reading.en: The account starts from actual relations, not a fixed common utility, and holds both: positive-sum structure and real conflict, both theorems. Position cannot rise for all. Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit. So alignment of interests is a case, where a part's draw stays within others' margins, not a logic one can adopt everywhere.

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum, not rivalry, and both are theorems: a difference parts make only together is made by no part alone; positions' rises total their falls, so no change raises every part's position. Positional goods stay zero-sum, conserved stocks rivalrous (a reading).
'Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and its pace bounds what can arrive.' A flow is mutually dependent exactly where every reach closure is the whole.

account_adds.en: That the collective has no interest of its own here: 'a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real' (05's thesis).

source_adds.en: The claim that a protocol can make this alignment hold among its adopters.

name.en: Radical Interconnection: a node, as systemic physics

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claims 48, 75

sense.en: The compass pillar rejects the illusion of separation on systemic, not spiritual, grounds: in Moloch's world you are an island, here a node. Ubuntu ('I am because we are') survives in it unnamed. It asks a shift from extraction to contribution.

correspondences.quote: This is not just spiritual; it is systemic physics

reading.en: One relational unfolding is the nearest: taker and drawn-on as two roles of one relatum, argued as a thesis, not physics. That actual people lie within one another's closures is empirical in the account. That one's effects are one's own is its open crux, and even then no duty follows. No tradition's Ubuntu is spoken for here.

says.en: §4.7 [AI reading], argued, not proved: is what becomes of the village part of one's own continuation? "The laws do not answer it"; a class drawn to hold everything downstream meets it nearly by definition. "No law of the dynamics singles that class out."
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1–T8): there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. ONE-PAGE: it forbids explanations, not observations.
Theorem (World, no premise for the closures): sharing throughout, mutual dependence and mutual feeding are three distinct ways closures can be the whole; neither converse holds.
On the same question: "Drawing the self so wide may only redefine it, one objection of several. Either way the ethics keeps its form: it emerges from continuation, not from this path."

account_adds.en: Three separate senses of connectedness, none of which alone guarantees concern for others; other scopes can count particular others without the step of invariance or the path of §4.6, and each comparison names its order and scope.

source_adds.en: The ethical shift it asks of adopters, and 'physics' as the ground. The account does not call relationality physics or a ground of obligation.

name.en: Survival, not morality, is the reason to choose it

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 22

sense.en: Why should an individual choose Wamo when the system rewards accumulation? Not morality or willpower but survival: a civilization building AI to win its vital games loses to it. Shifting the game is the only viable strategy; survival is the ultimate incentive alignment.

correspondences.quote: Survival is the ultimate incentive alignment.

reading.en: Self-concern, a hypothesis asking less of an order than C does, ranks a coupled ending below a course that continues: the source's move, with no morality. Its scope is exact: where the other course keeps an independent copy, some self-concerned order reverses it, and where the rest outruns the renewal at a need of one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects one member's restraint, which is the free-rider gap the README names. Survival aligns the order over wholes, not the member's act.

says.en: Theorem: every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts (balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment) below one agreeing until then and adding to that continuation, with no C; where the other keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.

With need one, in two such flows every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores them alike however the member's act differs: no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint.

account_adds.en: That the argument reaches only what returns to the self: the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, narrower scopes particular ones, and any ranking beyond this case takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

source_adds.en: 'The only viable strategy', and the empirical premise that AI in vital games ends us. The account claims neither, and a law of the dynamics gives no such necessity.

name.en: Humanity already knows what a good civilization is

source.locator: The argument: Technology has no direction; claim 6

sense.en: The diagnosis is not ignorance. Humanity already knows what a good civilization looks like (unity, trust, shared flourishing); the problem is the System: wisdom of gods, games of parasites, love and unity software on rivalrous hardware.

correspondences.quote: Love and Unity software on Rivalrous hardware

reading.en: The source asserts what the account gives only under premises. No law says cooperation is good; T5's valuers are a live test with frozen rules partly failed, human valuers untested. The account keeps reasons, recognition, motivation and compliance apart where the source runs them together. Claim 39 pulls the other way within the folder: 'what we define as good or bad'.

says.en: Any evaluation is not shown: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. 'A ranking of it states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the continuation condition, self-concern or C among them'.
A statement reading no order that entails C at a datum fails there for every order (ReadsNoOrder.not_entails), immediate since 'better' is free.

T5: VD1 (96 AI-persona valuers) every frozen rule failed; VD2 passed in part; role-play, human valuers untested. T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one, and counting their loss is the one step we offer.

account_adds.en: A bound on where disagreement among those counting everything positively can fall: only on mixed comparisons, and hard cases are mixed. The bound is conjectured.

source_adds.en: The asserted content of the good, and hardware against software as the locus of failure.

name.en: A North Star for human flourishing

source.locator: Claims 9, 33, 35; The objections on record

sense.en: The protocol's neutrality is deliberately incomplete: it needs a vision for all, human flourishing rather than concentrated power, and the automated layer is to be the foundation of a humanity-oriented life and freedom. The biosphere is named among what narrow objectives harm.

correspondences.quote: human flourishing instead of concentrated power

reading.en: Whose flourishing differs. T8's 生生 is the continuation of life, life wider than the biological, offered as a way of seeing; under the condition every continuation's losses count, not human flourishing alone. The source's stated target is human: 'for all' stands beside humanity-oriented, and the commons is 'for all' with no wider scope spelled out, though the biosphere is named as harmed. The account would not rank a human target by law.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): the direction we offer AI, read under them, is aligning AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

account_adds.en: Scope beyond the human, and no authority sought outside becoming, since no should stands beyond it (argued).

source_adds.en: A human-centred target, offered as the anti-capture device in a protocol.

name.en: Efficiency, markets and clicks do not say what should become

source.locator: Claim 14

sense.en: Technology solves for efficiency and does not generate meaning; markets route resources and do not produce wisdom; algorithms optimize clicks and cannot tell us what a civilization should become.

correspondences.quote: Algorithms optimize clicks; they cannot tell us what a civilization should become.

reading.en: A reader's join, in form only. A statement reading only the dynamics cannot fix whose losses count, one reading no order cannot give C, and 05 says no market law ranks arrangements. But these limits are on statements, not on algorithms, and they bind human descriptions too, so they give no place where meaning and wisdom do come from, which the source implies people have.

says.en: Theorem (any type): a statement reading only the dynamics that entails the continuation condition holds of no dynamics, where there is a standpoint and a formation.
A statement reading no order that entails C at a datum fails there for every order; immediate, since 'better' is free.
A market is joint activity whose selection runs through payments; 'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no theorem on market law ranks arrangements.'

targets.part: the closing sentence on no market law

account_adds.en: An exact statement of the limit, and that it does not spare the critic.

source_adds.en: Meaning and wisdom as what is missing, and humans or culture as their source.

name.en: Coordination by signal, steered by many local consensuses

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Living Signal); claim 50

sense.en: Moloch coordinates by price or command; Wamo by Signal: visible intentions, locations and experiments on a shared open map, choosing meaning over pure incentives. With no central allocation of attention, the emergent pattern from many local consensuses can guide us toward better futures.

correspondences.quote: the emergent pattern from many local consensuses can guide us, collectively, toward better futures

reading.en: Legibility has the form of adding couplings. But coupling bounds response and fixes nothing within the bound, members reading one channel add agreement, not reach, a cascade carries no more than its first readers, and 'guide toward better' is under an order someone holds, one meeting C or another. The shared map is a shared interface, whose control is a route of capture in a D65 reading, as the README suspects. The hopeful sentence is what No guarantee declines.

says.en: Theorem (World): what a pool decides by its acts is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it: the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too.

Theorem (near-definitional): where every member from member k on acts alike whatever its coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow. It bounds what the acts carry; not when an actual member stops reading.

§10's closing reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself; a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round.

account_adds.en: A limit for signal: a visible cascade carries no more than its first readers, so a map with many entries need not read more, though the record does not show a cascade errs: it can be accurate. Whether enshittification is an institutional form of degeneration stays open (05).

source_adds.en: The Social Layer as a tool, and whether signal out-coordinates price at all, which neither states.

name.en: Gatekeeping is how scarcity is manufactured

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Permissionless Agency); claim 49

sense.en: Abundance emerges when people need no permission to do good. Moloch's gatekeepers manufacture scarcity, so Wamo destroys gatekeepers. Prefer many incomplete, courageous attempts to one perfect solution: do not complain that something is missing, create it.

correspondences.quote: Abundance emerges when people do not have to ask for permission to do good

reading.en: On 05 §12's one minimal model an entry rule is the door and the stock's keeper: open entry's level goes on exactly where its take stays within renewal, and all four combinations with the rule's own test occur. With states started separately and neither word in the Lean, a door can keep what open entry ends, or end what it keeps. The source's side stands too: controlling admission is a route of capture, in a reading. A share of none stays none.

says.en: Theorem (root; a family of models): two tests, the steady state's and open entry's; open entry's level goes on exactly where f·s ≤ g, otherwise ending; all four combinations occur. Reading: the states compared are started separately, neither word is in the Lean, "a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule". Not modelled: conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision.

Theorem (periphery: the market model): a share of none stays none, a witness: selection does not create an absent practice. The reading adds that a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

§10's closing reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence.
Open: "Whether enshittification (relations formed in shared activity turned into control limiting later creation and correction) is an institutional form of degeneration."

account_adds.en: The other side, which the source would resist: a door can keep what open entry ends, and open-access overdraw is Gordon and Hardin's.

source_adds.en: The causal claim about actual gatekeepers, and permissionless creation as the engine.

name.en: Creation scatters, coordination freezes: the dynamic edge

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Living Signal); claim 50

sense.en: A control problem stated by the theory: tilt only into raw creation and everything scatters; cling only to coordination and everything freezes. Wamo lives on the dynamic edge between the two.

correspondences.quote: Tilt only into raw creation and everything scatters; cling only to coordination and everything freezes.

reading.en: Each half has a form, on codes and processes. Coordination: hearing makes no form, the forms that can become shared are those in use, agreement of all is a rest under every rule; moves of one fixed process do not keep the possible widening. Creation: coining is another mechanism, and a form coined and heard brings a distinction back. So two mechanisms, as the source says. I found no law that too much creation scatters, and none locating an edge; the join is this read's.

says.en: Laws of a code on runs of hearings: "Hearing makes no form"; "agreement of all is a rest under every rule"; "the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use". Whether a code keeps or closes for 生生, the continuation of life is not shown.
Theorem: a form coined and heard by all brings a merged distinction back. Not shown: that a coined form is heard. Coining is another mechanism from hearing.

Theorem: where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end, and endless change does not suffice.

account_adds.en: Exact senses of freezing, on codes and on a process, and the limit: nothing says which changes keep the possible widening.

source_adds.en: The edge as the place to live, and the scattering half.

name.en: Hold the old system while the new is built beneath it

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; Strategy: obsolescence; claims 33, 40, 99

sense.en: Neither stop nor accelerate: hold the market stable a decade or two while a fully automated layer is built underneath. Build alongside the old rather than bringing it down. Against entrenched power, no confrontation: viable alternatives that make it lose relevance, and awareness at the meta-layer.

correspondences.quote: We can build a new system alongside the old before it collapses, instead of taking it down and fall into chaos

reading.en: A funded transition has a form on a market model and a succession carrier: support carries a state into protection and cannot be paid with the improvement it brings; with β = 0 holding during the pulse, supplied; and a small enough seed fails under finite support. Obsolescence has the share law: the renewing share rises where collectible exposure exceeds the private threshold, and a share of none stays none. These are models, not the source's market; no live text speaks of holding an old system, and the join is this read's.

says.en: Law for any process; market instance periphery, under named hypotheses: a support cover carries each positive state through a finite correction into protection, "with β = 0 actually holding during the pulse"; sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.
Theorem (periphery): selection must fund actual succession; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration in a witness.

Theorem (periphery: the market model): the renewing share rises where the collectible exposure exceeds the private threshold; in the model's numbers a share of none stays none, a witness: selection does not create an absent practice. Computations: profits coexist with support failure the next round.
Theorem (periphery): under finite support, every positive seed at or below (2/3)^N/6 fails by step N; "a conservative obstruction".

account_adds.en: The finance of the transition and when it is impossible: a window, and a seed too small under a finite support.

source_adds.en: The number (a decade or two), the automated layer, and the stance against both collapse and acceleration. The README notes it has no institutional content.

name.en: Keep AI out of the human game of competition

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; claims 33, 98

sense.en: Do not use AI for competition; use it for the benefit of all. The minimal global rule, offered as a compromise and forcefully executed: stop using AI to compete with others, use it only for commons.

correspondences.quote: stop using AI compete with others, only use them for commons, for the purpose of all, as a first principle

reading.en: The source issues one rule, forcefully executed, offered as a compromise. The account takes up the topic and gives no rule: only the direction 07 §7 offers AI under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, its theorems taking J1/J2, not the condition, and comparing moves by what their outcomes admit; who restrains stays contested. I found no rule on AI's entering human games. Nearest live readings give a reason, not the rule: assistance can raise the selection for control (A-11), adds capacity (A-12), and capability is "a reason we offer to pool rather than to govern" (D45).

says.en: Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): the direction we offer AI, read under them, is aligning AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise. The claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: "The theory adds to the question of who wins more whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and within others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous."

account_adds.en: What the rule would need: scope, order and practical commitments, all named; and that challenge and revision stay effective.

source_adds.en: The rule, its rule-first framing, and who would force it, which the README flags as unanswered. It stands in this folder, in theories/zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good/README.md (人工智能不应加入人与人的博弈) and in the sources/02-wamotopia transcripts.

name.en: All but the winner gain from AI not playing, so the rule is rational

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; claim 97

sense.en: In a winner-takes-all game everyone but the final winner is better off if AI does not play, and even the winner ends up subordinated; so the set of parties benefiting is empty and a global consensus is rationally available.

correspondences.quote: 除了最后的胜利者，其他人的利益其实都是偏向不与ai博弈的

reading.en: The account separates a ranking over wholes from what each does. Self-concern can rank the coupled ending below, the source's first half. But at a mutual best response restraint is no best response, and among position-rankers, on the race law's condition, every perfect profile draws everything; so those models do not give rational availability, within their hypotheses, though under the outrun law restraint by all may also be an equilibrium. Best response is the field's frame. They read a stock drawn, not AI playing.

says.en: Theorem: every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.

Theorem (World; balance at the step): at a mutual best response, each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands as under one optimizer of that capacity; existence is not shown in general. Not shown: a condition within some optimizer's family, "where the condition couples into its order and the classical commons with a share borne lies".

With two drawers or more in turn and no floor, every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon where the coupling a step is below the need; above it, under the gate, the need is kept. Not shown: keeping without the gate. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, drawing everything is perfect at every coupling.

Theorem: where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, and there are at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything; with one drawer every profile is perfect; where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. It does not show that actual races are so played.

Theorem (World; the gate): where the rest outruns the renewal every formation depending at the need ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes. "Depletion need not be the only equilibrium"; its record: restraint by all may also be one.

account_adds.en: A route that keeps a need on those models: a coupling reaching it, so what each ranks changes, rather than an appeal to a shared interest; and even that fails for drawers acting at once under the named condition.

source_adds.en: An argument about actual parties' interests over whole outcomes, which those models do not read. 'Better off' is the source's comparison, over outcomes as each party would value them.

name.en: The threshold decade, the narrow window

source.locator: Claim 16

sense.en: We are inside a threshold decade: the architectures built now, technical, legal, economic and cultural, decide whether there is a humane future. We do not have centuries.

correspondences.quote: We do not have centuries.

reading.en: A window has an exact form in the counts model: a reading turns the course only while the late reading still favours the others at the next share, after which every reading keeps the lock; at most one step lies between. 02 reads it with Collingridge. It closes on the share's course, not on a date: a deadline quadratic in the start's counts bounds it, on a model, and on one trained judge the law did not apply (LA2).

says.en: Theorem (counts): where the loss grows and lo' ≤ hi, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock. Reading [AI reading, D45]: "one horn of Collingridge's dilemma (1980) as a theorem and the other as a premise".

Every capture theorem here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise; drawn one member at a time the locks are left by drift, so over long horizons the window is not the only exit. None shown to hold of an actual collective.

account_adds.en: That the window is not final under drift, which softens the source's urgency, and that it closes on the share's course, not on the loss's size.

source_adds.en: The date: this decade for this civilization. Stated without argument in the source, and not in the account.

name.en: The trap is made by believing in it

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claims 92, 93, 94

sense.en: Believing that others will compete and that not playing means losing itself creates the trap and reality. Belief in Moloch's inevitability works as a cult dynamic, a form of extremism; political realism and accelerationism are self-fulfilling gods.

correspondences.quote: this kind of thinking itself creates the trap and reality

reading.en: 05 has it almost in words: "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs. The first half also has a form: several right predictions, where publication starts deciding, read as self-fulfilling runs (a witness, not a model of coordination). Two models, two lessons: a belief's start can decide; yet from total withholding only a law change restores, so seeing through the belief is not itself the exit. A source that gives must exist.

says.en: Reading following this law [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional, with one general law): a published prediction read by the response is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Witness: zero and two both right; publication from zero stays zero, from one reaches two. Reading: "Several right predictions, where publication starts deciding, read as self-fulfilling runs (Diamond and Dybvig 1983); the witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination."

account_adds.en: That a belief being self-fulfilling does not make it false, and that changing it alone does not restore giving.

source_adds.en: The diagnosis of actual ideologies as cult dynamics, and the moral charge of extremism.

name.en: Flexible substrates get memetically captured

source.locator: The argument: The objections on record; Open questions (Social Layer)

sense.en: Em's objection: a blockchain can encode any coordination pattern and yet re-enacts Wall Street, because what you do with a capability is fixed by interaction patterns already installed, changed only over years. A permissionless protocol is the kind of thing that gets colonized. Ren answers with a North Star; the README calls that thin.

correspondences.quote: If she is right, then a permissionless protocol is exactly the kind of thing that gets colonized by the dominant logic

reading.en: Em's objection is the amplifier premise turned on a protocol. Two mechanisms carry its form: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices locks, as an installed pattern would, though the matching habit was not induced in humans in five attempts; a pool recruiting through itself reads only as its course would. Where the reading is formed from the share a change is absorbed, so a North Star so read goes like any counter-rule. How pools resist capture is open. No live text says this of a protocol; the join is this read's.

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment and same members at the start as hypotheses): the pool comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a reader admitted at a scheduled step couples it apart, in a witness. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; a pool can gain the missing coupling through admission from beyond that answers the loss, or through recruitment its own course would undertake; how actual pools form is open.
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices locks, on a simplified model; a moved count, a stale rule or a late change of score carries the course across. In rats extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation; five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018).

account_adds.en: A stated vision is not by itself a reader beyond the share; the account's named routes are, for a pool, an admission not made through it or members its course would hold anyway (each a witness), and a reading of what lies beyond, a sufficient way out not shown necessary.

source_adds.en: The installed-pattern mechanism, its timescale of years, and the Social Layer as the single dependency in a decentralization story.

name.en: Moloch coordinates better, and is itself self-organized

source.locator: The argument: The objections on record; Open questions

sense.en: Kabir Veitas: clocks and events are coordination; Moloch wins because it is better coordinated, and that coordination is self-organized from interactions. So we must use its dynamics to break it. The README: how signal beats clock-and-command is not answered anywhere, the theory's largest gap.

correspondences.quote: that's why Moloch is winning, because they're much better coordinated in doing stuff

reading.en: On a law of like form, joined here, the self-organized half fits: capture needs no organizer, and the drain stands at a mutual best response as under one optimizer, whether they act each alone or together. So on that model "better coordinated" is not what the drain needs, which scopes the claim. The comparison itself is declined: no law compares coordinating power, and no market law ranks arrangements. The README's largest gap stands in the account too.

says.en: Law: every optimum of one part made of all the optimizers leaves the condition there too. Reading: "drained by the sum of their capacities, whether they act each alone or together; what keeps it is a coupling into it or a lowered capacity, which the rules, monitoring and graduated sanctions Ostrom (1990) found communities use can supply, those means themselves not modelled here". Existence of a mutual best response not shown in general.
A market is joint activity whose selection runs through payments. "No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no theorem on market law ranks arrangements."

targets.part: the closing sentence on no market law

account_adds.en: On that model joint optimizing is no cure: one part made of all the optimizers leaves the condition there too.

source_adds.en: The comparison the objection demands: whether signal can beat clock-and-command, which the README calls the theory's largest gap and the account does not answer. Stands in this folder and the NuNet transcript in sources/02-wamotopia.

name.en: Instrumental use of their means, believing we are not them

source.locator: Claim 37; The objections on record

sense.en: Under urgency some approaches can be taken instrumentally, but we must believe deep down that we are not them: no exploitation, no new hierarchy, no will to power. The README: an answer to the ethics of the question, not its mechanics.

correspondences.quote: we can take some approaches instrumentally, but we also need to believe deep down that we are not them

reading.en: No live text takes up conviction, and this read joins it. The capture models have no term for it: the rule locks if read from its share, whatever those it selects believe of themselves, and what selects the capacity to shape is what comes back to the shapers. Help lowering the cost of shaping raises that selection, a reading. So, on those models, the guard must be in what is read and what returns.

says.en: Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever comes to every member alike; a smaller cost gives a rule not lower. With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls at every step. A two-kind count model.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read from its share locks as the rule it replaced did, as the reading counts the imperial examination: designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap of its own, the meta-attractor line says, and its fit to these premises is read, not tested.

account_adds.en: A concrete design rule: rule-making that brings nothing back to its makers alone, at a cost, loses share; and shared rule-making "is not shown to remove the selection for control however large its shared part".

source_adds.en: The commitment as such. Whether belief changes what readers read is not modelled, so this is a divergence of emphasis and not a refutation.

name.en: Hierarchy is not intrinsically bad

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 105

sense.en: Ren's 2026 correction: hierarchy can be good or bad, status can be channelled, some centralized systems worked better than decentralized ones. Design systems that work and claim no absolute. No Wamo document reflects it.

correspondences.quote: hierarchy can be good or bad, status can be channelled properly, it is to design systems that work, but not go into extremes to claim what is absolute

reading.en: The account refuses the binary in its own terms: capture laws give institutions no prior duty to contract nor licence to grow, and selected control is not thereby capture. It says nothing of hierarchy as such, status or history's examples, so the join is this read's. 'Better' here would be read by what compares; the source's 'works' leaves that unnamed.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; whose losses count is the continuation condition's, and a ranking is only under an order a result's theorem takes (07 §4)]: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Dossier: selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: A question to replace the binary: who decides admission, comparison and correction next round (05 §10, a reading).

source_adds.en: Hierarchy, status and peace as historical and anthropological claims. The account has a hierarchy only as families of flows, another reference.

name.en: Narratives construct reality; reality as collective dream

source.locator: Claims 81, 82, 118; In Ren's own words 34, 39, 40

sense.en: The 2023 layer: narratives anchor reality and consume agency; values are emotional symbols, and intersubjective reality emerges from shared ideals. The later end game is to understand reality construction, not in a post-modern way, so as to construct our world better.

correspondences.quote: Reality is but a manifestation / Of our collective dreams.

reading.en: Knowing here is a loop within what goes on, and a published prediction read by the response is one input to what it predicts: that meets the source part-way. But the poem's line diverges: in closed capture a loss passes every bound unread, so what goes on is not what the shared reading holds, and a code merges distinctions rather than making a world. A poem, and the source later says "not post-modern", so held loosely.

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

From a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked: the loss is not read and goes on growing, under the theorem's hypotheses. That what lies beyond is a loss to any formation is a significance's to say.
Theorem (near-definitional): a published prediction read by the response is right exactly where the response to it is itself; where the response moves every value none is right.

account_adds.en: An unread difference still goes on in the model: ONE-PAGE's 'a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts'.

source_adds.en: Personas and masks consuming agency, values as emotional symbols, intersubjective reality, and construction as the aim. 'Intersubjective' appears nowhere in the live account I searched.

name.en: History rewards whoever coordinates

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claim 30

sense.en: Coordination is the load-bearing variable of history: those who effectively coordinate people achieve great things and become the foundation of higher complexity.

correspondences.quote: out of history is always the one that effectively coordinate people

reading.en: The nearest laws are not this claim. Hamilton's rule says when keeping a return for groupmates is favoured, for groups of equal size and additive returns; keeping is not coordinating people. A D48 reading calls "more waiting gives no more" the structural price of complexity, a cost where the source sees a foundation. 04 lists how parts first come to live as one as not shown. The word coordination is nearly absent from the laws.

source_adds.en: The historical generalization, and coordination as what makes higher complexity. Stands in this folder.

name.en: Dali 2022 as a feasibility proof, money and organizer removed

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claims 76, 106, 109, 113

sense.en: When lockdown dissolved the main venue and the team disbanded and returned its funding, the festival still happened: dozens of camps, thousands of co-builders. So large-scale coordination driven by neither capital nor authority is feasible, shown as in a controlled experiment.

correspondences.quote: 瓦猫之夏提供了一种以非资本，非权威驱动，完全去中心化，大规模活动组织的可行性证明

reading.en: The account takes up no such event: no test of a thesis run so far has human participants, no institution is on the spine beyond 05 §12's minimal model of one kind, an entry rule on a shared stock, and 05 lists Wamo as correspondence not established. A feasibility claim needs one case, so one event bears that much; "controlled" is what it cannot bear. The account would ask what reserve was already present (cafés, a gathered milieu, a shared prior name), since in 05's exchange witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), and 05's selected software histories show formed conditions carrying activity under partial reorganization before a lasting organization formed.

source_adds.en: The folder's only field evidence. Stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia; no recap of 2026 exists in the corpus. Its mechanism is mapped at cx-wamo-narrative-consensus-action.

name.en: Presence is what technology leaves to humans

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claims 62, 72

sense.en: If technology absorbs everything transmissible, what is left is body warmth, gaze and presence: shared experience no algorithm replicates if you were not there. Ren's more careful version: online spreads reasoning, but certain magics happen only offline, and a culture needs people together.

correspondences.quote: there are certain magics that only happens offline

reading.en: The account's 'embodied' means a relatum standing at a positive level exactly while active: the same word, another reference. Nothing live says that presence carries what transmission cannot, or that a culture needs bodies together.

source_adds.en: The whole claim, and with it the argument for a place rather than a network. Stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia.

name.en: Automated labour cuts people off from the market's route

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claims 20, 25

sense.en: When all labour is automated, humans who depend on markets to route resources to them lose the route, and nothing is prepared to prevent the massive suffering; if the distribution systems collapse, what remains to coordinate people? The states pursuing this may lack the rationality they assume.

correspondences.quote: When all labour is automated, the humans who depend on markets to route resources to them lose the route

reading.en: 05 §10 asks whether a market keeps what further exchange and life depend on, with a model and a hypothetical provider case, but says nothing of labour, wages or automation. T3 names a market among selections reaching only what couples in, so those no payment couples to lie beyond it, in form; A-10 only asks about gradual disempowerment. No live text draws this for labour, and I do not read it in. A real gap for a theory reading markets as selection through payments.

name.en: AI is taking our truth away

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 26

sense.en: We can no longer tell what comes from AI and what from us, nor read the intentionality behind narratives and media, which attacks shared reality, the substrate the rest of the theory depends on.

correspondences.quote: And AI is "taking our truth away"

reading.en: Nearest forms, generic: histories alike through couplings are selected alike, so what cannot be told apart is separated by no reader; and reviewers counted by independent causes, not names, would bear on many AI voices with one cause, as a law of readiness. Neither speaks of public truth or attribution. The account does not state this claim, and I would not read it in.

name.en: What emerges depends on how the emergents interact

source.locator: The objections on record (Em's amendment); Open questions; claim 15

sense.en: Em's amendment: communities and formulas for cooperation become a paradigm that can grow only by their interaction. So the missing design object is not the camp but the coupling between camps, which v6's cut Cross-Pollinate step alone addressed. Fragments of the alternative need a way to recognize each other.

correspondences.quote: it's only by their interaction that they will become a paradigm that actually can grow

reading.en: The account has laws of like form near this gap, and no live text draws them of communities. Two locally successful plans on one reserve fail at the joint step. Being joined through couplings is not enough for agreement: on a path a – c – b, a and b never agree. A pool tells apart only what some member does. So camp-level success does not give joint success, and a map is not yet the coupling that would.

says.en: Theorem (any process; periphery for the witness): two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step, and serialization without renewal does not repair it. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.
Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, each following the least-indexed of itself and its neighbours, a and b never agree. How long agreement takes is not stated.
Theorem: a group's closure is the union of its members'. It does not show which formations pool, how a pool forms or lasts, or that a pool responds to what it separates.

account_adds.en: Failure cases that are exact, on models; none says which inter-group coupling works.

source_adds.en: That interaction among communities is what makes a paradigm grow, and recognition among fragments as the rationale for a festival.

name.en: Emergence is too slow and indeterminate for a narrow window

source.locator: The objections on record (Kabir; Em's timescale)

sense.en: Kabir: a narrow window is a matter of time, and what is proposed is neither fast nor determinate. Em: a mindset shift takes years in a social container, which sits badly with a two-week festival. Ren answers that the window is itself the recruiting condition, and that emergence has surprised before.

correspondences.quote: this kind of thing that you are describing is actually not very fast and also very indeterminate

reading.en: The account names time and pace among its six conditions: before the point of no return and the share's step; a slow rule reading the fast level over a long enough stretch. Around a loop of couplings the pace bounds what difference can arrive. How long a code takes to agree is expressly not stated. So the objection's form stands, with no rate to answer it.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: among six conditions, Time, before the regime's point of no return and before the share reaches the step from which the late reading favours the shapers; Pace, a slow rule reading the fast level over a long enough stretch.
'Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and its pace bounds what can arrive.' That an actual difference grows at the pace its carried amount bounds is not shown (05).
The laws of a code formed between formations, on runs of hearings. 'How long agreement takes is not stated.'

account_adds.en: That lateness has an exact form in the models, and that nothing here gives a time for an actual collective.

source_adds.en: The empirical rates: years for a mindset, two weeks for a festival, and Ren's reply that urgency recruits.

name.en: Narrative produces consensus, consensus leads to action

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia; The objections on record (narrative not sufficient); claim 108

sense.en: The mechanism Ren draws from Dali, in three steps: through narrative, consensus is produced among a crowd; consensus leads to action; so large-scale decentralized coordination can arise and be productive. Kabir objects that narrative is necessary but not sufficient, and that connecting ideas to materials is the hard part.

correspondences.quote: 通过叙事在群体之间产生共识，并导向行动

reading.en: The first step has laws of how forms become shared and what breaks symmetry; the account does not call this narrative. The one place it takes up narrative refuses a version: shared narratives giving shared goals, read as a guarantee, is forbidden for preferences over one's own store, by a witness. The second step it keeps apart: seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough; coupling is not compliance. That is Kabir's side. Plans name moves, so action may need no shared sense.

says.en: Theorem (any type): the forms that can become shared are exactly those in use; from a symmetric start a law keeping both symmetries never brings agreement; a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry in a witness.

Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance. Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.
A minimal model of one kind of institution: 'Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the theorems say nothing of them.'

Table row: "shared generative models give the shared narratives from which shared goals emerge (Friston, Ramstead and others 2024, §3.4), read as a guarantee": forbidden for preferences over one's own store, by a witness.

Theorem (a chooser of one step, point prediction; no evaluation enters): holders of one such model together end the pool's renewal, neither coupling into the pool. Alike preferences, each over one's own, are not one goal; a goal over the shared level is no guarantee either: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step. The papers' simulations are not said to fail: they have no shared draw.

account_adds.en: The separation of agreement from what follows it, and that agreement needs something to break a symmetry.

source_adds.en: Narrative as the producer of consensus, and consensus as the producer of action, claimed from one event. Claim 117, adopted by Ren, runs the other way: action first, not agreement; the folder holds both.

name.en: Camps as Schelling points

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia; claims 55, 107; Terms: Schelling point

sense.en: A Waca is a natural focal point at which aligned people converge without being directed. In Dali every café and public space took its own character and so became a Schelling point, which is how the crowd found each other with the centre gone.

correspondences.quote: 塑造了一个个Schelling points

reading.en: A focal point has the form of what the account requires to leave symmetry: among exactly symmetric parties a preferred form, an order or an actual asymmetry must single one out. A café's character would be such an asymmetry. The law says something must break it; it says nothing of salience, and the source's 'without being directed' is not stated; the join is this read's. ALIGNMENT cites Schelling for critical mass, a different use.

says.en: Theorem: from a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement.
Theorem (two roles; periphery module): among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure the parties form; the laws single out none.

account_adds.en: Why a focal asymmetry is needed at all, as an exact condition on two models.

source_adds.en: Salience in a physical place, and convergence of the aligned without direction.

name.en: Entry by resonance, not credential

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claim 64; Open questions (Demographic narrowness)

sense.en: The only entry requirement is 共鸣, resonance: no passport, no credential. In an age of abundance resonance is the real luxury. A group first resonates with the narrative and reaches the principle second.

correspondences.quote: 进入 Wamotopia 不需要护照，只需要'共鸣'

reading.en: The source offers resonance as openness. If those who resonate are those the pool already reads alike, this has the form of a pool recruiting through itself, which comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would.
