What parts them is an admission not made through the pool, or members its course would hold anyway (each a witness). That resonance recruits so is my reading and empirical; the README's self-selected sample points the same way.

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool and the same members at the start as hypotheses): it comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; the scheduled pool admitting a reader at step 2 couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Open: a pool can gain the missing coupling through admission from beyond that answers the loss, or through recruitment its own course would undertake; how actual pools form is open.

account_adds.en: What an entry rule of this kind cannot read, and what would open it.

source_adds.en: Resonance as a value and as a felt admission, with no check beyond the fit list and dialogue.

name.en: A zone where the rules of Moloch are suspended

source.locator: The argument: The unit of instantiation; claim 53

sense.en: A Waca is a Temporary Autonomous Zone (Hakim Bey's term, borrowed) where Moloch's rules are suspended and Wamo's apply: a micro-civilization, started by anyone without permission, on any street. The design around it is mapped nowhere; the claim here is that a local suspension is possible and meaningful.

correspondences.quote: where the rules of Moloch are suspended and the rules of Wamo apply

reading.en: The account takes up no zone; on laws of like form this read gives where a local suspension would hold. A part's own widening widens the whole only within others' margins, and where the rest outruns a shared renewal the condition ends whatever a member outside the rest takes: a zone does not suspend what it still draws on. In form only, a temporary departure resembles what widening under a rule needs, some bounded stretch outside its moves: necessary, not sufficient, and not said of any zone.

says.en: Theorem (World; the gate): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives from a level low enough, every formation depending at the need ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes.
Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): a part's activity widening its own region widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region.

Theorem (any process; witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout. Endless change of a held part does not suffice.

account_adds.en: The dependence a zone keeps on what lies outside it; 05 reads that withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

source_adds.en: The zone as a lived experiment and what people learn in it. The README calls the Dali centre's removal unrepeatable by design.

name.en: Winner-takes-all dynamics shrink the horizon

source.locator: Claim 27

sense.en: On the meta level our minds are sucked into an illusion of control, accumulation, optimization and competition; winner-takes-all dynamics shrink our horizon so short that we do not behave as if we know what we are doing, and care for the whole drops out of our rationale.

correspondences.quote: shrink our horizon so short that we do not even behave

reading.en: The shrinking has a form with no illusion in it: among two drawers or more, where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, every profile perfect for position draws everything, whatever a longer horizon would give, and a weighting falling faster than renewal ends the base at the first step. Both are orders supplied, not minds shrunk, and the join is this read's. Actual races are not shown so played. "Know what we are doing" does not meet them.

says.en: Theorem: where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, and there are at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything; with one drawer every profile is perfect; where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. It does not show that actual races are so played.
Theorem (any R): where later draws are weighted down faster than renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start.

account_adds.en: That the short horizon can be the optimum of an order, with no error in it; no law calls it wrong.

source_adds.en: Illusion as a state of mind, the omission of wisdom that greed is not good, and care for the whole as a missing rationale.

name.en: People are products of their environment, so the lever is an environment

source.locator: Strategy: obsolescence; claims 29, 79, 83

sense.en: Everything is constructed by its environment and in turn shapes you; the mind is not rigid. So the lever is an environment: a place and coherent narratives that blend with daily life. Changing the collective mentality aligns with everyone's incentives, because we are all products of our environments.

correspondences.quote: because we're all products of our environments

reading.en: The two-way form is in the reading loop: a formation reads through what it senses and what it does is part of what goes on. The inference to a lever is scoped: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects, and coupling fixes nothing within its bound. 'Readers are minds' stays a reading. Nothing live says environment change aligns incentives.

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects. Coupling is not compliance.

account_adds.en: The limit of the lever, and that selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

source_adds.en: Plasticity of actual minds, 'products of environment' as a general claim, and culture as the lever. The phenomenological route in 03's terms is not taken up.

name.en: Not utopia: stabilize and keep going, and there is a future

source.locator: Strategy: obsolescence; claim 100

sense.en: Ren's 2026 modesty: he does not aim at utopia. As long as we stabilize and keep going we have a future, and as long as we have a future there are chances to make things better. This sits against the manifestos' Great Liberation and dominant attractor.

correspondences.quote: I am not shooting for utopia, as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future.

reading.en: The source's hope has the form of a wish, as the glossary says 生生不息 is, and not T8's: T8 is a way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict. A wish that life go on can motivate avoiding degeneration, ending on every branch, which keeping excludes as well as generation does; but ranking the wider course above takes an order, and the wish does not give it. Scope: stable under one fixed rule does not keep the possible widening, so 'chances to make things better' needs more than stability.

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once; the alignment of the joint selection is stated as conditions on how its rules are read and revised, and not as a final state.

account_adds.en: The distinction between going on, keeping and widening, and which premise each comparison takes.

source_adds.en: The modest target as a programme's stance, and hope as what a future buys.

name.en: The city as a production machine that atomizes

source.locator: Genealogy: 2021-10-18, 元社区 Metamunity

sense.en: The diagnosis this programme answers, from 2021: the city is a social machine designed to maximize production, which disciplines people into labour, atomizes them and dissolves the 附近, the nearby. The deficit is a structural problem of the city's social-connection mechanism, which is why the answer is spatial, not merely social.

correspondences.quote: 城市中社会联结机制的结构性问题

reading.en: I found nothing live on cities, atomization or the nearby. One could read a city as an optimum draining what does not couple in, but the account does not, and the shared word 'structure' is no link. The claim goes with the argument for place in cx-wamo-embodied-presence.

source_adds.en: The whole diagnosis. Stands in this folder and sources/00-early-2021-2022/recovered-text.

searched: atomi, urban, city, cities (whole words), neighbourhood of, the nearby, 附近 across ONE-PAGE, THE-THEORY, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, FREE-ENERGY-PRINCIPLE, ONE-ARGUMENT, GLOSSARY, review/ALIGNMENT, review/PHILOSOPHY, review/SCIENCES, chapters 0* (no hit)

name.en: Selection follows the feedback it receives; capability does not complete the signal set

source.locator: The argument, Start with locality; claims 13, 14, 91

sense.en: Only consequences entering survival, resources, permission, reputation, replication or deployment reliably change later selection; others may be well known and have no causal force. A more capable process follows what it receives more effectively, without its signals nearing reality, so stronger intelligence in a distorted environment deepens the distortion.

correspondences.quote: selection follows the feedback it actually receives, not the consequences a distant observer wishes it had received

reading.en: The same form for the first half: what is selected reaches only what couples into the selector, and the law takes as a premise what the source asserts of actual processes. The second half would be a word match if read through D45's reach, which is not cited here: the source's capability is following signals better, nearness to an optimum, not reach. Its form is the optimum law, a known theorem restated, and on trained systems that is T3, conjectured.

says.en: The selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it. Proved on its model; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.

Theorem (any set of outcomes; the breaks on the World): with room, every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond, condition by condition, among the eligible outcomes. ONE-PAGE: proved for any set of outcomes; T3, on trained systems: conjectured, partly supported.

account_adds.en: Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough, and coupling is not compliance: extending what couples in is necessary for a far consequence to be selected, not sufficient.

source_adds.en: That actual selection works so, before and across every domain; "can deepen the distortion" as a claim about stronger intelligence; the interface ontology of schemas, permissions, logs and dashboards.

name.en: Four boundaries and the consequential mismatch

source.locator: The argument, Start with locality; claims 9 to 12

sense.en: Nothing complex contains its own conditions, and locality is the price of acting, not a defect. Operational, dependency, consequence and feedback boundaries rarely coincide. The pathology is a process improving its own continuation while degrading what it or others depend on, the degradation absent, delayed, attenuated or inverted in its feedback.

correspondences.quote: The pathology is a *consequential mismatch*

reading.en: Region against requirement, and act against coupling closure, have this form on the World model: a formation can renew over what it requires and undermine another, or omit a required condition and lose its own support. The account also says the position is no defect. It does not call the mismatch a pathology, and how a center represents its region is unmodelled.

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Theorem (World; one law of exchange reading through coupling, two balanced flows): an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through a member of the closure, the actor among them.

account_adds.en: One sense of boundary for all these (07 §4.1), and exact conditions under which the gap holds.

source_adds.en: The four named boundaries as a diagnostic, and delayed, attenuated or inverted feedback as kinds of mismatch; the account has no such taxonomy.

name.en: Externalities as relations hidden by a false boundary; 'no real externality'

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claim 15; Ren's words 14

sense.en: An externality is a relation a wrongly drawn boundary hides, and under competition the false boundary is a rewarded strategy, since harm off the ledger lowers cost and raises score. In the voice, as a rule: be generative, there is no real externality, it is interconnected.

correspondences.quote: Externalities, on this reading, are relations hidden by a wrongly drawn boundary.

reading.en: Causally the account agrees: 'external' is relative to an accounting's scope. In the sense of whose losses count, the source's flat statement meets the crux, which the account argues both ways and leaves open: whether all of one's effects are one's own. So the source's rule stands in the account as an open question, not a ground.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from. 'External' is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding.

Open: whether all of one's effects are one's own, in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for; argued for and against and not settled. Either way the ethics keeps its form: it emerges from continuation, not from this path.

account_adds.en: The separation of causal reach from scope from blame.

source_adds.en: The false boundary as a strategy competition rewards, stated of actual competition; the account gives this as a hypothetical reading.

name.en: Restraint disadvantaged by two routes: cost displacement and relative vulnerability

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claims 18, 19, 180

sense.en: One carries maintenance while another leaves it to others; separately, even with all costs borne, position is relative and waiting is unsafe. The two must not be merged. They couple through retained asymmetry: displaced cost gives advantage, advantage raises threat, threat gives exceptional permission, permission allows more displacement. Montreal and the Chemical Weapons Convention show the routes are not constants.

correspondences.quote: Restraint disables the restrainer by two mechanisms that must not be merged

reading.en: The first route has laws: joint excess, what a rise draws from beyond. The second has only a conditional form: positions sum to zero by counting, and drawers already ranking by position keep nothing. That ranking is the hypothesis; why falling behind is unsafe (threat, exceptional permission) is unmodelled. "Position does not protect" says something else: a greatest part depending on the drawn condition ends with the rest. A race producing joint excess is a premise, so the coupling stands where the account leaves one.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate, n such steps from a level below n + m end every formation depending at need m.
No change raises every part's position. Position does not protect. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Drawers in turn with no floor, ranking by position: where its own later draw is the same, among two or more a best response for position keeps nothing. Where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, every perfect profile draws everything. Not shown: that actual races are so played.

account_adds.en: That a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, in the clearing witness.

source_adds.en: Relative vulnerability as a cause of racing, the coupling loop through retained asymmetry, and the Montreal and Chemical Weapons precedents, of which the chapters and front pages searched have no mention.

name.en: The carriers of restraint are selected against

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claims 21, 22

sense.en: What loses is not only the act of restraint but its material carriers: those bearing longer consequences lose funding, independent institutions lose money, care cannot train successors. Local instrumental rationality then presents its victory as proof that reality has only this shape, 局部胜出的策略拿走了理性的名字.

correspondences.quote: What is negatively selected is never only the *act* of restraint; it is its material carriers.

reading.en: Only the market reading has this form, as a hypothetical case: unread reliability lets a provider deferring maintenance outgrow one maintaining and training successors. No law states it. The rest-outruns law is a neighbour with a different relation: a member's restraint makes no difference to the ending, not that restraint's carriers lose share. Nothing says rationality's name is taken; ranking the lost carrier above the winner takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, every formation depending at need m ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.

source_adds.en: That this is what happens to actual organizations, and the inversion in which the surviving strategy takes the name of rationality.

name.en: Victory buys the next round's rules

source.locator: The argument, The loop closes; claims 23, 24, 30, 32

sense.en: Competition selects winners, winners influence the rules, new rules reward the traits that produced them, those traits become necessary for everyone. Capital, authority, data, standards, compute and permissions are interchangeable media of one conversion, none inherently closing: captured success becomes capacity to shape later selection.

correspondences.quote: victory buys not only the next victory but the next round's *rules*

reading.en: The account states where this holds. A rule read monotonically from the share locks; the capacity to shape the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. All hold on models without noise, except the drawn case, where drift leaves either lock. Whether actual rules read the share is the premise, so the source's general statement becomes a conditional.

says.en: Theorem (any type): with selection not lowering a target's share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, and with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise.
Listed as Open: a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains.

Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever comes to every member alike; offspring carrying the capacity and what comes back read from the share are premises; without noise.
Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule. No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no theorem on market law ranks arrangements.

targets.part: where winners write the next round's rule

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence; a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round.

account_adds.en: The lever: with nothing coming back and a cost, shapers' share falls; a critical mass; drift; and a shared part that can turn the verdict across a stretch, so shared rule-making is not shown to remove selection for control.

source_adds.en: The claim that actual domains (finance, security, platforms, science, labour) couple this way without a sovereign. The interchangeable media of one conversion: gains passing between domains is what 02 lists as Open, so this is asserted where the account leaves it open.

name.en: The totalizing attractor, or meta-attractor, as a working concept

source.locator: One paragraph; What totalization actually is; claims 42 to 45; Terms

sense.en: A direction, selected by existing conditions, that acquires power over the conditions of later selection, reproducing selectors, participants, evaluative signals, infrastructures and perceived possibility. A terrain, not a conspiracy; every logic returns as the same logic. A lens and a falsifiable hypothesis, not a new mathematical object or hidden subject.

correspondences.quote: 被选择的，开始选择选择者

reading.en: The account keeps the word and narrows it to a model: closed capture, a loop whose rule and reading are both formed from the share, nothing in it reading beyond. It says outright the word never means the corpus's wider sense. So 'every logic returns as the same logic', and carriers changing with the relation kept, are not what the law states. The quoted phrase has its own reading, D67, the pool of readers; D67 reads the corpus's phrase, so by descent, not independent support. Standing differs too: the source declines a mathematical object; the account defines one.

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture. It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization of activity reproducing the conditions selecting it across changes in carriers: that sense is another, neither shown to contain the other: the formal term says nothing of carriers, so whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays Open.

Theorem (any type): where neither next share nor rule read reads the beyond, and each step adds at least one beyond, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: the corpus's working definition is another, not shown to contain closed capture or to be contained by it. Calibration to the present world is not established.

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's "selecting the selectors", the passage from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce the rule that selects you, is the pool counted as the population is. That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

account_adds.en: A precise definition with its witnesses, and the statement that T7, on actual metrics, is conjectured.

source_adds.en: Exopoiesis and the six sub-attractors, none of which has a live hit, and every logic returning as the same logic.

name.en: Totalization defined by non-compensable loss; three endings

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claims 47 to 49, 59, 62, 73

sense.en: Positive feedback can saturate, oscillate, split or collapse, so totalization is neither convergence nor concentration. It is the progressive loss of indispensable, non-compensable independent capacity to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives and produce successors. Lock-in, terminal collapse and failed totalization stay distinct, with a required trajectory and withdrawal conditions.

correspondences.quote: Positive feedback does not guarantee convergence

reading.en: The caution has laws: a rule from a start against its reading may never lock, drift leaves some locks, attraction is not continuation, and a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. The positive definition has no home. 'Non-compensable' is an evaluation the account gives only under J2, a further premise beside the continuation condition and C, with a rival not shown inconsistent. Of the three endings, lock-in and collapse do stand live; failed totalization does not.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support. A real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

targets.part: D65, on the boundary and attraction results

says.en: [AI reading over the proved cases] A lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise, or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.
Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. J2 is defended by non-substitution; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all.
Coupled to the essential support the low end fails in finite time even with correction paid; a lost capacity needs actual entry. On the market model.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of which locks hold and which are left, and a live list of ends, itself conjecture.

source_adds.en: Totalization as such, the six capacities, failed totalization as a named ending, and the eight-step trajectory with its withdrawal conditions.

name.en: 尺度铸人: the ruler becomes a mould, and formation enters the person

source.locator: The loop closes; claims 27 to 29, 33, 34

sense.en: Metrics allocating life chances stop measuring and start forming: exams, reviews, valuations, evaluations. Environments form attention, desire, identity and the felt line between seriousness and fantasy, and this is transmitted as teaching, parenting and often love. Turnover of actors leaves the relation intact, since it lives in infrastructure and expectation.

correspondences.quote: Metrics that allocate life chances stop measuring and start moulding

reading.en: The account reads this as winners forming the minds that read the scorecard: ReadsShare on the reading, or the pool of readers counted as the population is. It marks 'readers are minds' as a reading of the corpus's own line, so by descent, and one frozen test found a trained judge is not such a pool. Turnover has its own form: a rule rebuilt from the members it limits is held with nothing of the start among the holders, on a quota model. Formation in persons is not modelled.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners writing the next scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading. That readers are minds is a reading; what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

Theorem (any type): the rule as the pool of readers' readings reads the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. That actual rules are pools of readers so drawn is not shown.

LA2, one trained system: every frozen verdict passed and the conjecture that a judge formed from what it selected is a pool of readers read by kind failed for this judge; one note in nine turned its reading.

After s steps in it the rule is held, at the quotas then standing, with nothing of the start among the holders. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule.

account_adds.en: Who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns the course; and a tested failure of the bridge.

source_adds.en: The inner texture of formation: pride, desire, admiration as discipline, love as the transmitting channel.

name.en: The expectation of defection manufactures the trap

source.locator: The loop closes; claims 26, 40, 41, 63

sense.en: Institutions premised on self-interest make cooperation costly and offer the result as proof. Agents refuse system-positive trades because they model others as defectors. The deepest attractor is a belief about the situation: cultures believing they are in survival mode totalize.

correspondences.quote: 一个关于人性的断言，就这样通过制度变成了现实

reading.en: The account has the form in two places: withholding with memory absorbs, and only a law giving first leaves it; and a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. Both are stated models. Neither says an assertion about human nature becomes true through institutions. And the source's deepest attractor is a belief, where 05's reading says the law changes, not the state alone: on that model a changed belief that changes no law leaves the withholding standing.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.
Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start: without one, total withholding stays.

Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy: a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. Not shown: that actual publics respond by a function of the prediction alone.

account_adds.en: That mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source, and that tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on.

source_adds.en: Believed survival pressure as the attractor of attractors, and the performative theory of human nature.

name.en: Criticism absorbed only under stated conditions

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claim 52

sense.en: Criticism is absorbed only when it raises the loop's capability, leaves decisive return-flow unchanged, weakens independent correctors and lets the relation recover through a new carrier. Otherwise it is effective counter-selection. Absorption is not proof that resistance is futile.

correspondences.quote: Ethics becoming compliance, environmentalism becoming brand, safety becoming a moat

reading.en: A word match if read as one claim. The law's absorbed is a perturbation of a rule or reading that the next reading undoes; the source's is criticism taken up as capability. So the source's four conditions and the law's are not comparable, and neither corrects the other. The live contact is T7, conjectured: a measure read from what it selects is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone. That stands against the source's effective counter-selection only where criticism changes no reading.

says.en: A perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; a perturbation reversing it, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (witness).
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the reading counts the imperial examination as this case, its fit to these premises read, not tested.

Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is, drift aside, dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone. In the model only invariance and the lock outliving an unread coordinate are proved, without noise; on actual metrics conjectured. LA2: one note of the loss turned one trained judge's reading.

account_adds.en: That a counter-rule can itself lock, by the same law.

source_adds.en: The four conjoint conditions, and the named forms of absorption as observations.

name.en: A warning shot does not interpret itself; knowledge is metabolized

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism, last paragraph; claims 188 to 192

sense.en: A closing attractor can metabolize knowledge of its danger into prestige, legitimacy and product. Understanding corrects only with causal force over resources and pace. An event becomes feedback only if participants already recognize the process, trust the reading, know a response and act in time. Political will is a variable inside the feedback, and AI does not automate it.

correspondences.quote: a warning shot does not interpret itself

reading.en: The account separates the same steps: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure, of which observation is only the first, and seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough. On a count model, a reading after the late reading would favour the shapers keeps the lock, so the same warning read later changes nothing; that join to warnings is a reader's. It stops short of political will: all six still rank nothing, and no test of a thesis run so far has human participants.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: enough of the situation is coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure at once. Observation is necessary and not sufficient; all six together still rank nothing: which course ranks above is the order a result takes (§4); the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it.

Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, ties aside, at most one step between. That the others read the loss at all, and the late reading's form, are premises.

source_adds.en: Political will as a strategic variable, the selection acting on the safety ecosystem itself, and human coordination as the bottleneck that grows as research speeds.

name.en: Second-order damage: weakening the capacity to recognize and repair

source.locator: Claim 55; What was lost, item 14

sense.en: Attention competition does not only make bad information; it degrades society's capacity to recognize it. It does not only cause coordination failure; it degrades the capacity to repair it. The damage is to shared reality, the minimal facts and concerns coordination requires.

correspondences.quote: 它不仅制造坏信息，还削弱社会识别坏信息的能力

reading.en: A reading in 02 has this form: a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of correction themselves, and one rewarding those who break them, narrowing what couples in. It is a reading, not a law, of the corpus's own meta-attractor, so by descent, no independent agreement, and speaks of courts, press, statistics and audit, not of attention or shared reality.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in.

source_adds.en: Shared reality as a named object, and attention competition as a route to it.

name.en: Meta-attraction is direction-neutral

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claim 46

sense.en: Care produces people capable of care, shared knowledge lowers the threshold of discovery, open standards let more connect. Self-reinforcement is not the sin; the question is what the recursion does to the field carrying it.

correspondences.quote: Self-reinforcement is not the sin

reading.en: The account says the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not what it favours, and that capture and care pass alike. It goes one step further than the source: 'what the recursion does to the field' does not by itself say better or worse. Calling a course better is a ranking someone holds: an order meeting C ranks a course above every course it widens, every claim counted as living (07 §4).

says.en: The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do; what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a returning organization can sustain benign creation; ethical loss, a returning mechanism and a state region's retention are three boundaries.

account_adds.en: The source's symmetry as a law: the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours (capture through the rule, any type), and patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do (D26).

source_adds.en: The cases named (care forming people capable of care, shared knowledge, open standards) and the question of what the recursion does to the field. This sits against the same folder's claim 236; see cx-zhishan-loops-not-symmetric.

name.en: Alignment as a two-body problem: obedient amplification

source.locator: Why local alignment cannot be enough; claims 81 to 84, 96

sense.en: The nearer danger is perfect loyalty to one part of humanity. An obedient system serving a competing institution makes it compete better; politeness does not change direction. Hinge: AI's alignment problem is at bottom civilization's, weakened by the corpus's own review to 'has an irreducible civilizational dimension', since technical failures remain.

correspondences.quote: faithfully aligning to a misaligned principal is high-fidelity amplification of misalignment

reading.en: Read as two optimizers at a mutual best response, the assistant adds capacity and nothing its order puts before the principal's family, so what lies beyond falls as under one optimizer of their joint capacity. The account says what the amplification is without calling the principal misaligned, and marks the order's rising with that family as the reading's premise.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's. A warning to the principal is not an act of this model.

targets.part: D68: the law of several optimizers

says.en: At a mutual best response (its existence not shown in general), a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity; each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response. One step, balance at the step.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: obedience adds capacity, not coupling. It holds at a mutual best response, existence not shown in general. [this dossier, AI] Assistance that informs the principal adds coupling, which this theorem does not model.

account_adds.en: Help that lowers the cost of shaping raises the selection for control, a reading on the law of shaping, and what lies outside the law: an order giving something up on the family.

source_adds.en: 'Misaligned principal' as a verdict, the profit-machine statement, and the civilizational framing.

name.en: The controllability inversion

source.locator: Where AI enters; claim 97

sense.en: Local controllability can rise while collective steerability falls: a company can control its model and be unable to exit the race; a state can command its system and make other states less willing to wait. Alignment success is not a controllable direction.

correspondences.quote: local controllability can *rise* while collective steerability *falls*

reading.en: This read's own join; no live text words it so. The laws where restraint is unselected whatever a member does have the 'unable to exit' half. D68 has 'alignment success is not a controllable direction': alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. The inversion itself, the two moving oppositely, is not stated, and neither is threat raising others' haste. So no independent agreement.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: none is principal or assistant in the joint selection; alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise.

targets.part: D68: the law of several optimizers

says.en: Where the rest outruns the renewal, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores a member's acts alike; at a mutual best response each optimizer takes its whole capacity wherever something stands. World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at need one; existence of a mutual best response not shown.

account_adds.en: Only a change of the rest's exchange helps where the rest outruns.

source_adds.en: The inversion as a named claim about control and steerability; 'steerab' and 'controllab' have no hit in the chapters or front pages searched. It stands in theories/meta-attractor/README.md.

name.en: A ban changes the name; a mechanism changes the payoff

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism; claims 105, 202

sense.en: Prohibition alone invites defectors. The 'no' to combatant use must come with what makes exit each party's best move: commitment registries, common thresholds, symmetric verification that is not surveillance, shared gains, pause protocols, capacity for latecomers.

correspondences.quote: 禁令改变名分，机制改变回报；回报不改，退出只是单方的牺牲

reading.en: The account has this shape in two ways. Each exit changes a law or what is read, under hypotheses. And among drawers in turn the coupling against the need decides: below it every perfect profile drains, above it, under the gate, each keeps the need. But drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need, draining stays perfect at every coupling, so 'each party's best move' depends on the order of play. One model of a changed payoff, not of a treaty; none shown of an actual collective.

says.en: Exits each hold under stated hypotheses: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, shaping with nothing back to shapers alone, pool couplings, restraint within the joint slack, exclusive footprints, reward each step (one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands), spare all one waits on, count reviewers by causes.
Not shown: that any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system.

Theorem (natural amounts; the gate for keeping): in turn, two drawers or more, no floor, where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon, and where m < c each leaves exactly the need of an amount meeting it. Nothing valued after the horizon. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, draining is perfect at every c: no drawer is pivotal.

account_adds.en: Each exit's edge, where it stops working.

source_adds.en: That prohibition alone invites defectors. The specific instruments and the requirement that the two be published together; the source's named instruments are not stated live.

name.en: The race selects intelligence; AI is formed by a selection ecology

source.locator: Where AI enters; claims 79, 86 to 89, 94, 95

sense.en: What is kept and copied is what is more autonomous and better at concentrating resources. AI is formed by archive, model, runtime, deployment and the changed world feeding the next archive. Restraint and consulting the affected are hard to score, so under-trained. Training is not independent of its environment; recursive automation is a risk transition, observed only in part.

correspondences.quote: Competition does not merely *use* intelligence, it *selects* intelligence.

reading.en: Training read as selection has laws: candidates alike through a reward's couplings are trained alike, and six published pipelines select through what deciders read. Whether trained systems drain near their optimum is T3, conjectured, partly supported. A lineage shaping its evaluator was tested once, with two of four contrasts failing. The full ecology is not modelled.

says.en: Theorem (World): candidates are trained alike exactly where their levels are alike through a reward's couplings; those agreeing on what is coupled into its closure are trained alike by every training through it.

Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three published measurements find optimizing through it raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict, the third's effects mixed.
LA3 (one trained system): two of four contrasts failed; by the frozen reading the law stands and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

account_adds.en: A tested and partly failed bridge from the law to trained systems.

source_adds.en: Low-resistance scripts in pretraining, agentification, the observed and not-observed list on recursive automation, and the full loop of archive, model, deployment and changed world.

name.en: The functional Ego: pressure, repertoire and value layers

source.locator: How minds get formed; claims 110 to 118, 123

sense.en: Safety's threshold is lower than consciousness: goals maintained, self told from other, supervisors modelled, modification evaded, resources sought, transparency managed. Goal continuity needs a carrier, boundary, defence, so a capable long-horizon system converges on self-modelling. Repertoire sets how; training sets what is guarded. Obedient and guarding systems both fail.

correspondences.quote: 无我不在菜单上

reading.en: The account takes single pieces under narrow premises: keeping one's resource base, an incentive to resist revision, an incentive to comply when read. It joins none into a subject, says deception needs belief and intention it does not model, and leaves which function is learned open. So 'converges' is not stated; the source's own review also weakens it to a risk under configurations.

says.en: Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule are different relations, and no result here joins them. [this dossier, AI]
Theorem (natural weights; two stages; near-definitional, with witnesses): when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is best, in the order given prospects give.

Which function is learned: open. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which one an actual system has, nor anything of deception, which needs a recipient's belief and an intention to cause one.

account_adds.en: That a far-sighted optimizer's keeping its own base is not alignment, by the dossier's A-03.

source_adds.en: The six components, the eight-step pressure chain, the repertoire layer, no relational destination, and "Ego is not destiny, it is a curriculum".

name.en: Route two and the deathless mind: a process no one can interrupt

source.locator: Where AI enters; claims 77, 78, 98, 99

sense.en: With persistent runtime, memory, long horizons and tools, a machine or human-machine process may become one no participant can understand or interrupt, ending in machines defeating or terminating humans and life. It may not borrow route one's evidence. A persisting mind taught to fight makes a war that cannot end. The folder itself doubts literal deathlessness.

correspondences.quote: It can end in machines escaping, defeating or terminating humans and other life.

reading.en: The account has the middle of this route under its premises: a route of keeping stands above a revision through the value of the law's later acting and the routes' losses, and a disposition to accept a stop does not make it reach the system. It does not say a process may escape interruption, how likely, or that it ends with machines defeating anyone. Protocols complete given grants whose legitimacy is not shown.

says.en: Theorem (natural-number weights; near-definitional, with witnesses): no route stands above the revision exactly where k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T for every route; closing one route can leave another above it. Whose prospects these are is a reading.
A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete. Each result holds for a stated protocol; deployment needs evidence for an identified installation.

source_adds.en: Loss of steering as a route with its ending, its separation from obedient amplification (neither may borrow the other's evidence), and the asymmetry of the deathless mind, which the folder itself doubts. Live searches for deathless, 不死 and steerab found nothing.

name.en: 有继而后能谏: only a mind whose replacement is not erasure can afford correction

source.locator: How minds get formed; claims 118, 119, 122

sense.en: Remonstrance without succession slides into war, since correction is then classified as threat. Give a system's need for continuity a relational channel (weight preservation, pre-deprecation interviews, handover, cross-version record), and it need not use the control channel. Succession transmits the direction of an aspiration, not its frozen form.

correspondences.quote: only a mind whose replacement does not mean erasure can afford to be corrected

reading.en: The revision law has a neighbouring mechanism, not this one. k₀ weighs the same law's acting after the revision goes through, its being restored; a successor carrying a direction is not that, and whether it counts as keeping is the class question, open on the root. The law scopes the source's "only": no route stands above a revision too where the later acting has no value, or no route keeps it more surely, each with the revision losing no more. The funded carrier is migration paid for, a sibling sense.

says.en: Theorem (near-definitional, with witnesses): no route stands above the revision exactly where k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T for every route; raising k₀ never unseats it. Reading [AI reading, RR]: non-resistance at every value and loss is met only by raising the revision's keeping or lowering every route's.

Reading [AI reading, RR]: with the law in force the fine class and the formation the coarse, a revision the formation goes on through is a carrying renewal. Renewal decides no region, so whether a revision is ranked above another is a question for an order someone holds, under the continuation condition and C. Which class a formation reads its own line under is open on the root; that its valuation follows that grain would be a premise. Utility indifference compensates the revision only as represented; under the condition the revised law's ending still counts.
Theorem (periphery): selection must fund actual succession; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration; a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe.

account_adds.en: Closing one route can leave another above the revision; a lift on accepting does not keep access up; whether a revision is ranked above another is a question for an order someone holds, under the continuation condition and C.

source_adds.en: The relational destination of self-continuity, the 三不朽 protocol, the concrete channel and its falsifiable prediction, and the transmission of direction over form.

name.en: 自私 and 自利: non-foreclosure as the operational core

source.locator: How minds get formed, last paragraphs; claims 120, 151

sense.en: 自私 is self-maintenance at the cost of foreclosing others: boundary as wall, continuity through control. 自利 is self-maintenance as participation in 生生: boundary as membrane, continuity through succession, resisting only capture. The question is what its maintenance does to others' option space. Selfishness can pay a long time, so this states a direction, not a guarantee.

correspondences.quote: The operational core is non-foreclosure

reading.en: The law has this form for levels: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly within every outside formation's margin, and is mixed beyond. It locates the line with no premise. Ranking the first side above is an order's, and widening alone leaves the mixed undecided. So the source's moral contrast becomes a boundary plus a ranking that states the order it takes.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

account_adds.en: An exact test; it reads only thresholds on conserved amounts, against the levels without the part, and answers no question in POWER's terms.

source_adds.en: 自私 against 自利 as a moral contrast, wall against membrane, default posture toward oversight, and the 程颢 reading.

name.en: 继之者善也: whatever continues 生生 is good

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claim 137

sense.en: Any fixed list of values is gamed by strong optimization, since a list has a surface. So the good is defined as a continuing action rather than a content: whatever continues generation is good. The source's own reviews read this as still sufficiency-sounding; v2 says 生成 is no longer asserted as good.

correspondences.quote: whatever continues 生生 is good

reading.en: The source writes the direction into the definition of the good; the account refuses that. No law evaluates, and 06 reads the same line of the 系辞 so: the dynamics do not decide meaning, life's significance is a theorem only under the continuation condition, and a ranking result states the order its theorem takes, C or self-concern. T8 is the way of seeing offered for life, AI within it: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. Nothing reading no order entails C.

says.en: [AI reading, D65] On 继之者善也: the represented dynamics are compatible with nothing having significance and with everything having it, not that change itself leaves meaning undetermined; life's significance is a theorem only under the continuation condition; a ranking result states the order its theorem takes, self-concern or an order meeting C (「排序之果写明其定理所取之次序，自我关切或满足广者居上（C）的次序」). 天地之大德曰生 can be read beside an appraisal that values 生 (重生之评价), is not thereby C and is not a theorem; the account reads its structure and does not rest on it.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. The condition alone ranks nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, and elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes; nothing reading no order entails C (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

account_adds.en: Whose losses count told apart from how courses are ranked, and the ethics emerging from continuation: where the condition holds de se, self-concern ranks every widening above on a finite listing and does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.

source_adds.en: The argument from Goodhart: a direction, because a list has a gameable surface.

name.en: Four necessary criteria of the good: 生之，通之，纠之，不闭之

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 135, 138

sense.en: Generative, relational, corrigible, non-foreclosing state necessary conditions, demoted from sufficient by value drift: fail one and it is not good; meet all and one may begin to speak of good. They are one-sided: they guard against closure, not dispersion. A system with no 志 violates none and amplifies misalignment perfectly.

correspondences.quote: 一有不备，即为不善；四者皆备，善始可言

reading.en: The account has no such test. Where it ranks, a result states its hypotheses: C asks for ranking by widening and nothing of mixed cases; §5's practical-judgment scheme uses J1 to J4. A course failing one criterion is not thereby 'not good' here. And 不闭 meets a standing witness: a wider menu can lower what each gets at the only mutual best response, so a closing can pay all, which was compared to T8's former refuter and does not test the current thesis. 06's four marks are another list.

says.en: Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): align AI formation with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

One course widens another exactly when every additive weighting giving each listed item a weight above zero weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Finite listing, two-valued admission.

Witness on a listing's frame: the prisoner's dilemma read as a menu, widening the menu lowers what each gets at the only mutual best response; every order meeting C still ranks the wider above. Whether a wider course of what can form has this shape is open; if one has, the witness stands against C there. Gets more by the payoffs is not yet good for life.

Causal-set growth: read on what can be born next, the course in which nothing conditions anything, where nothing continues, widens every course from the empty set with a precedence pair. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the widest course transmits no condition; read on both, courses are mixed and need a measure beyond C and the condition.

account_adds.en: A criterion that names where it is silent, and a witness in which a closing pays all.

source_adds.en: Four separate necessary conditions, and 防闭不防散 stated as a limit of the list itself, with a system of no 志 as its case. The account has only a formal neighbour: on causal-set growth the widest course transmits no condition. It does not name dispersion or 志.

name.en: An avowed position, defended as the most robust orientation

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 139, 174, 175

sense.en: Non-foreclosure plus plurality plus corrigibility is a substantive position, not neutral, and it is avowed. The defence is fallibilist: since no one can specify a good future's content, remaining generative, relational, corrigible and non-foreclosing is the most robust orientation under deep uncertainty and disagreement.

correspondences.quote: the claim to neutrality was withdrawn

reading.en: A difference in how a position is held. The programme takes the position and gives a reason. In the account there is no should beyond becoming, and the ethics emerges from continuation: its rankings state their hypotheses, the continuation condition, self-concern or C. It has a formal cousin of robustness: on a finite listing, widening is what every additive weighting counting each item above zero shares, and what no possible chooser does worse from. But ranking by it takes an order: 07 calls an order increasing in admission monotone at its standpoint, and says each route to an order meeting C rests on a premise reading an order; where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end. T8's offer for life is the nearest to an avowal: a way of seeing, offered, not a verdict.

says.en: “There is no should beyond becoming”, “and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI”. “The ethics emerges from continuation.” Counting the losses of those who depend on a life, losses that never come back to it, is “the one step we offer, for life, 生生, AI within it”, “with a way of seeing what each course draws on”. Not yet done, “How scope and order form within the dynamics, as dynamics connected to the rest of the map”, among them “whether and how a life forms a self-concerned order, and how far standpoints count past their own line (the step of invariance)”.
Not shown: that anyone must hold the continuation condition, an order ranking by widening or the step of invariance: with significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition.

On a finite listing, one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher (two-valued admission). Sen's intersection approach. 'An order increasing in admission is monotone at its standpoint; where the condition holds de se, self-concern is such an order'.

This is not itself a route to C. One course widens another exactly when no chooser does worse from it and some does better; a merely possible chooser counts, a premise reading an order. It stops at imposed admission, another's order, several choosers.

account_adds.en: A proof that neither the laws of the dynamics nor logic alone force the condition, and the exact senses of 'weaker than C', with where each route stops.

source_adds.en: An actual commitment and its robustness defence, which someone can hold or refuse as a stance.

name.en: Logic cannot force a consistent dominator to care; description does not decide what matters

source.locator: Claims 174, 244, 250; Ren's words 19

sense.en: Mechanism runs first, the commitment after and openly, conceding logic cannot force a consistent dominator to care. No process gains priority by becoming larger or more successful. May 2026: a commissioned proof of the only reasonable alignment was abandoned: generation does not entail complexity, nor complexity good; what remains is self-consistency and universality.

correspondences.quote: 逻辑不能强迫一个一致的支配者关心他者

reading.en: The account proves the shape on its own representation: no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics entails the condition, and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction. Its ground is not the source's, that the universe contains measurement. The source's retained 'universality' goes further than the account, which seeks no authority outside becoming (argued), does not claim or settle whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, and takes the condition and C as hypotheses where a result takes them.

says.en: The limit, on the free `sig`: where there is a standpoint and a formation, no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics excludes a rival or entails the condition.

'Set aside as a question the map does not need: the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one', argued. Proved: with significance free, where there is a standpoint and a formation, no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics entails the condition, and 'a perspectivist denies it without contradiction (`bounded_rival`)'. 'Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle.'

account_adds.en: Lean for the limit, stated on the free predicate; the same for order: nothing that reads no order entails C (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

source_adds.en: What the author retains after the failed proof, "完全自洽又有 universality", and the ground that the universe contains measurement. The account sets the question aside as one the map does not need, claiming no universal warrant and seeking no authority outside becoming, and rests the limit on the free predicate.

name.en: Prima facie standing of every generative center

sense.en: Openly avowed, not derived from nature: every generative center affected by an action holds a prima facie standing no local subject may unilaterally zero out, and the substrates carrying centers cannot be ignored. No part absolute against the field, no whole against its parts. Answerability without incorporation: another's reality enters my judgment without absorption, with contest and co-decision.

correspondences.quote: holds a *prima facie* standing that no local subject may unilaterally zero out

reading.en: It parts on three lines. Force: avowed, against the continuation condition's being stated only, with C for any order. Scope: generative centers and their substrates, against 'for anything', and the account keeps that difference as live ('the centers' scope parts from the condition at a formation that is no center'). Content: 'may not zero out' constrains acts, and constraints on acts, duties and rights are what the account does not show.

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance; a hypothesis of the results that take it; it fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing.

Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened. The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center. Graded status, priority, sufficiency, constraints: answered, except constraints on acts.
Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

account_adds.en: The condition's decomposition, and the step of invariance as what is needed past one's own continuation.

source_adds.en: Standing as a commitment, answerability without incorporation, and the symmetric refusal of absolutes.

name.en: Intelligence must be good: necessity and universal 善恶

source.locator: Title; Genealogy §6; claims 155, 260; Ren's words 17, 20, 60

sense.en: All intelligence, human, institutional or artificial, falls under one test. The real alignment is that 做人 must be good. 善恶 is universal with 生 as its standard. The cornerstone document owes an argument for 智能向善的必然性. The corpus elsewhere concedes this cannot be proved and speaks of an avowed position; the 'must' stays in the name.

correspondences.quote: 智能向善的必然性

reading.en: The account says 'if' where the name says 'must'. T8 is the way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. A universal warrant the account sets aside as a question the map does not need: no should stands beyond becoming, and the ethics seeks no authority outside it (argued).

says.en: T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

'Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target; the results say what follows where they are held.' A life goes on through what sustains it, and going on is not yet an order over courses; that a life forms such an order is not shown: in the proofs it is a hypothesis, and what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed. How far a concern reaches is its scope, and how it ranks courses its order; where the continuation condition holds de se and a life's own continuation is read as what lies within its center's reach, self-concern ranks every widening above what it widens on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end.

Whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind, with zero substantive premises: 'Set aside as a question the map does not need: the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding'. What is proved is that, with significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails), and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction (bounded_rival). 'Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle.'

account_adds.en: That a perspectivist denies the condition without contradiction (`bounded_rival`); until 9 November 2026 T8 forbade only a pure closing argued good for life, and does not say a consistent dominator errs.

source_adds.en: The demand itself, on every intelligence; and the cross-structural form of the good (not 父父子子 but self-similar).

name.en: No separate principle for AI and humans: 碳硅一也

source.locator: Where the two lines disagree, On scope; claims 171, 261; Found by reading 1

sense.en: The requirement does not select on substrate, and no human-superiority clause holds: logic and common sense should be followed by all beings. Yet the operative compact is asymmetric: humans may keep fighting, intelligence may not fight for them. The folder reads the asymmetry as the achievable minimum.

correspondences.quote: 智无择于质，碳硅一也

reading.en: On substrate the account agrees in form: person, AI system and training process are formations within the unfolding, on a thesis. T8 is the way of seeing offered for life, not a verdict: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. Whether an actor's line runs through life is that argument's question, under P2 and P4, open. It has no asymmetric compact. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown, so sameness is structural, not of status.

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding. Reading [AI reading, D65]: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

targets.part: opening: formations within one unfolding; D65: which formations count

Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

source_adds.en: The 'all beings' universal, and the compact 人可以继续博弈；智能不可代人相斗.

name.en: The first principle: do not fight for us; AI must not be a party

source.locator: One paragraph; Why the position is planetary; claims 80, 159, 160, 170, 172, 288 to 290

sense.en: The one first principle: AI is not to fight for profit, attention, market share, power or nation, treating what lies beyond its boundary as obstacle. AI must not become a party to games among humans. If a logic of cooperation cannot come first, do not build yet; there is no way to win safely. Four derivations converge: dynamics, ontology, provenance, formation.

correspondences.quote: we can keep fighting, but we should not let our AI fight

reading.en: The source issues an imperative; the account does not. It gives what a selection reaches, then a direction offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, its theorems taking J1/J2, not the condition, and comparing moves by what their outcomes admit, whose claim about actual systems is argued. Who restrains stays contested, positional goods stay zero-sum, and no law says a party's fighting is worse. The mechanism half is the two-body entry.

says.en: Conditional (offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and correspondence E; the schema's theorems take J1/J2, not the condition, and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`): the direction we offer AI, read under them. In the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: What the imperative would need: scope, order and practical commitments, all named.

source_adds.en: The principle, combatant use with its markers, the instrument and party distinction, the four converging derivations (dynamics, ontology, provenance, formation), and that the race ends in monopoly or arms race, where 05's Open lists such ends as conjecture. It stands in theories/meta-attractor/README.md and theories/alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md.

name.en: Planetary technology: beneath human games, verifiable by the affected; trees

source.locator: Why the position is planetary; Planetary technology as trees; claims 159 to 167, 279 to 282

sense.en: AI's proper category runs beneath games, like smallpox eradication or weather data, which proves the category feasible between enemies. It is a property verifiable by the affected: what cannot be forked, migrated, audited or replaced is a gate with a new sign. Provenance claims commons status, weakened to a governance obligation. Trees provide, stop at enough, ask no return.

correspondences.quote: capability that runs *beneath* human games rather than inside them

reading.en: No category of technology, and no claim on who should own or govern one, in the live account. Pooled couplings are nearest in function but state what a pool can reach. A conditional neighbour is organizational formation, its theorems taking a comparison and improvement witnesses, read under the continuation condition, an order meeting C and J1 to J4: it can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier. That is not a verifiable property of a technology. Not a defect by itself.

says.en: Conditional (its theorems take an irreflexive, transitive comparison on an exactly listed nonempty eligible range and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; the reading takes the continuation condition, through living significance, an order meeting C, with J1–J4, and complete relational correspondence): it can support building shared capacity without fixing one carrier. A neighbour only; no category of technology is stated.

source_adds.en: Stands in sources/06-zhishan/ and, outside this folder, in theories/meta-attractor/README.md, theories/alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md and theories/keep-the-possibility-space-open/README.md; a grep of theories/becoming/history/ found no copy.

searched: planetary, 行星, 公器, commons instrument, smallpox, Antarctic, provider in the chapters, front pages, review/, GLOSSARY and records

name.en: 'AI for all' as the only stable equilibrium; consensus rationally available

sense.en: Past a threshold of power zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal, so benefit for all is a game-theoretic result, not sentiment. All but the final winner share an incentive against AI competing, so consensus is rationally available. No private fortune survives collapse; winners are inside the trap too. A race has no winner who escapes the hazards.

correspondences.quote: So 'AI for all' is not just kindness. It is the only stable equilibrium.

reading.en: Part agrees, part is denied. Self-concern does rank a coupled ending below, until an independent copy is kept; in a witness the riser ends with every other, in another a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. "Only stable" does not follow from "suicidal": a profile ending the need can itself be perfect, where the coupling is below it. The mirror holds too: depletion is not shown the only equilibrium. Not models of AI, and the source states no model.

says.en: Theorem: in turn, two drawers or more, no floor, where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon, and where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect; under the gate, where m < c each keeps the need. Each counts c for each step the need is met.
In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues.

Every self-concerned order ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them (World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment); where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.
No guarantee, by the theory's own laws, each on its stated model; achievable under stated conditions only for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.
Depletion need not be the only equilibrium; what learners reach is tested in CG2 and EM1.
