source.locator: Claim 225; Terms: Chain of appearance, Phenomenon / model

sense.en: Difference carries information; information enters 感 to become 像; 像 acted out becomes new 象, which becomes new difference. A model is borne by bodies, language, code and institutions, so the same borne structure is 像 toward what it represents and 象 toward the causality it enters.

correspondences.quote: Difference carries information; information enters 感 to become 像; 像 acted out becomes new 象, which becomes new difference

reading.en: The closed form agrees with the reading loop: a formation reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. The account states six laws of that loop under premises and has no five-term chain; a search for 像 and 幻象 in 06 found another sense only. Same words are not same reference, and its 理 and 文 are defined otherwise.

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. Six laws state that loop under their premises.

account_adds.en: When a reading is kept by its own update, and when a prediction read by what it predicts is right.

source_adds.en: The five terms, 幻像 and 幻象, and a model's being itself a phenomenon as a stated claim.

name.en: Provenance: what is distilled from billions belongs to the commons

source.locator: From provenance, in the four derivations; claims 160 to 162; the reviews' finding on provenance

sense.en: What is distilled from the accumulated language of billions belongs categorically to the commons. Two reviewers broke it: commons origin does not entail commons ownership. v0.4 limits it to instruments at planetary scale; the later review weakens it to a public governance obligation for a gate everyone must pass, not ownership. The folder calls this its most load-bearing and most fragile wall.

correspondences.quote: The provenance argument is the most load-bearing and the most fragile wall.

reading.en: Not found, by word or mechanism. 'Commons' in the live account is a shared stock drawn down, another reference; 'ownership' is the crux's, of one's effects; 'provenance' is of text. Nothing says what forming from shared language gives anyone a claim to, or what a gate is owed. The nearest is 06's mapping of monopolized entry to a closure, with no verdict. Not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: The claim, its scale bridge and its weakened form. It stands in sources/06-zhishan/ and this folder.

searched: commons, provenance, ownership, 公器, 汇亿众, planetary, 行星 in the chapters, front pages, review/ and GLOSSARY; the commons, provenance and ownership hits are other senses, read by grep lines

name.en: 自取灭亡: a directional judgment, not a catastrophe prediction

source.locator: Claim 214; Terms: Self-termination

sense.en: 自取 needs no unified civilizational will, only many locally intelligible actions jointly raising the gain of a loop that consumes its own conditions. 灭亡 includes substrate collapse, lock-in where all effective action must pass one path, and a society full of activity unable to judge what is worth continuing. The programme's verdict on the present direction.

correspondences.quote: is a directional, recursive judgment, not a catastrophe prediction

reading.en: The mechanism has laws on models: each within what a step gives while together more, ending every formation depending at the need, with no will; a whole drawing past renewal ends; closed capture for lock-in. But the account declines 自取 as such: the whole's law does not show that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss, and no law calls a drain a harm: a ranking that does states the hypotheses it takes. Calibration to the present is not established.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; n such steps from a level below n + m end every formation depending at need at least m.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): a whole whose parts arise only where they then depend on a family, its renewal gated, has no part arising after n steps of uptake past replenishment from a stock below n + m, and ends. It does not show that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: That taking by a part can be within what a step gives, so the ending is not read off any member.

source_adds.en: The judgment on the present course, and 灭亡 as a society still active but unable to judge; 'the gain of a loop' as the variable.

name.en: Variety, so that systems do not all die alike

source.locator: Claims 184, 185, 252 (voice)

sense.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse, so the real invariant is keeping the sample space open: a variety of systems so that they do not all die from the same situational influence, foreseeable or not. Death is a feature; the aim is a rich space of systems, not one rule or attractor.

correspondences.quote: so that they do not all die from the same situational influence

reading.en: Correlated failure has checked forms, on narrower objects. Reviewers moved under one cause fail together with all names kept, and a cause in no bound fails every reviewer, which is the source's 'foreseeable or not'. Copies add nothing. An ending reaches only what depends on the condition at the need, so unlike dependence escapes it. This read's join from reviewers to systems. No law ranks variety: that takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): moving two reviewers under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept; a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer.
Theorem (no axiom; witnesses on a finite roster): a witness copying one on the roster gives the same certificate at every pool of faults. That a witness merely agreeing adds nothing is not shown.
The ending reaches every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m; a taker not so depending can continue.

source_adds.en: Variety of systems as the real invariant, death as a feature, and keeping the space open forbidding its optimization.

name.en: 黄宗羲: 積累莫返, a burden re-based each time a reform merges its names

source.locator: 《明夷待訪錄·田制三》, the first and third of three harms

sense.en: Each reform (杨炎's 两税, the 一条鞭, 倪元璐's merging of three levies) folds earlier levies into one and their names vanish. Later generations 安之, take the merged sum as the base and levy the folded items anew: 重出. So the burden rises by steps, each reform 利於一時者少，害於後世者大. He blames the lost names, of the third only 或者顧名而思義，未可知也, and would re-base 反積累以前. The label 黄宗羲定律 is modern, not his.

correspondences.quote: 有積累莫返之害

reading.en: Only the merge has a law's form, on a reader's join: no live text reads a tax so. Read 庸 and 调 as senses and 两税 as an imposed form: the merge loses exactly those distinctions, which return only from a form held outside or by coining; his own book is such a form. A total keeps the sum, and no predicate of it says both parts are inside: 豈知其為重出. The re-basing has capture's form only if what counts as proper is read monotonically from what is now taken: then neither falls. No law supplies the new levy.

says.en: Theorem (any type; premises named by row). An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source losing none. Under hearings that copy, a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Whether an imposed code keeps or closes for 生生, the continuation of life is not shown.

Theorem (periphery, Mathlib; propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice). T(a, b) = (a + b, 0) keeps the total, yet no predicate of the total characterizes a ≥ 1 ∧ b ≥ 1. The laws concern the named routing and transfer; that totals mislead in every system is not shown.

Theorem (any type; for the selection, the alternatives' equality decided): what matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there. It does not show which map a selector uses.

Theorem (any type). Selection not lowering a share under a rule favouring it, and the rule read at each reading step a monotone function of the share: with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. Locked, neither share nor rule falls. That actual rules read the share is the premise. The share is any preorder on configurations, by the module's header.

account_adds.en: The exact loss of a merge, that the source of the code loses nothing by it, the exact condition under which a selection through a lump still selects what matters, and that a locked course lowers neither share nor rule. Huang gives none of these.

source_adds.en: A ratchet by steps: a reform lowers the visible count, the reading forgets what was folded in, and the same item is charged again. I found no law of the new charge: where-a-rising-take-ends excludes takes rising only at some steps and supplies the rise. His remedy is a right rate and a golden 三代 (以什一為則), which the account does not give. His third harm, one rate across soils differing twentyfold, is another lump, with a drain: 土力之日竭. 所税非所出 is not read against the account here.

name.en: 黄宗羲: 公其非是於學校, readers of right and wrong outside the ruler's favour

source.locator: 《明夷待訪錄·學校》

sense.en: Schools should bring forth 治天下之具, not only feed scholars. Under later dynasties 天下之是非一出於朝廷: what the ruler honours all run to call right; examinations turned the schools by 朝廷之勢利, and academies that disagreed were banned. He proposes county school heads chosen by 公議, not the court; students may replace them; they are not under the examiner; the emperor sits among the students of the 太学, whose head states the ruler's faults. He holds this was the 三代's way.

correspondences.quote: 天子之所是未必是，天子之所非未必非，天子亦遂不敢自為非是，而公其非是於學校

reading.en: Judgment read from what favour selects has the form of a rule read from its share, if ReadsShare is granted, which is a reading. His staffing acts on who reads, where the law moves the premise, and on whether readers fail under one cause: 猶然循其名而立之 is names kept, causes merged (heads as reviewers is this entry's reading). But his heads choose the teachers and put forward and dismiss the students (學官送其俊秀), a pool recruiting through itself unless a reader enters from outside: his 布衣 heads. Reading the loss is a sufficient way out, not shown necessary.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it: a sufficient way out. That any actual rule is formed from the share it selects is a premise.

Theorem (any type): reading the rule as the pool of its readers' readings, counted as the population counts them, it is a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. The premise is moved to who reads, not removed: that an actual rule is such a pool is not shown, and that the readers are minds or institutions is a reading (D58, D67).

Theorem (pure core; rosters, fault formulas and bounds supplied). Reviewers count by independent causes, not names; given faithful reviewers, readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope. In the computed cases, moving two of three under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept.

Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool and the same members at the start as hypotheses). A pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would. In a witness, a pool admitting a reader at a scheduled step couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from its share can lock as the rule it replaced did. The reading counts the imperial examination as this case; the meta-attractor line says that, designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap of its own, and its fit to these premises is read, not tested. It rests on the capture laws.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost; diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment.

account_adds.en: With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers' and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where carriers are at least as many as others when the loss is read. Huang has no such count.

source_adds.en: The rule-holders acting on the readers (收捕黨人, 偽學之禁), and an office design with a reversal of rank in ritual. His 此率天下士大夫而背朝廷者也 and the banned academies are read here as D65's refusal read as resistance. Divergence kept: 是非 stands in his text as what scholars can settle, where the account has comparison formed by what compares; his readers are 士, through a selection he also criticizes; his warrant is a golden 三代; and his school would bar printing and burn plates (已刻者皆追板燒之), itself closing what others read.

name.en: 孟子: 一治一乱, and a period of about five hundred years

source.locator: 《孟子·滕文公下》, the 好辩 passage; period claim at 《公孙丑下》 (五百年必有王者兴) and the close of 《尽心下》

sense.en: Since people were born, order and disorder have alternated: flood and 禹, tyrants and 周公, regicide and 孔子's 《春秋》, 杨墨 and himself. Each restoration comes through a named person; each decline follows such a person's passing (尧、舜既没，圣人之道衰; 圣王不作). His stake is that doctrine brings disorder: 作于其心，害于其事；作于其事，害于其政. Elsewhere a true king rises every five hundred years; he admits the count has passed, 以其数则过矣，以其时考之则可矣, and leaves it to 天. 治 and 乱 are evaluations.

correspondences.quote: 天下之生久矣，一治一乱

reading.en: His claim has two forms. With a bound, return within five hundred years, it can fail, and 七百有馀 fails it. 以其时考之 retreats to return at some later step, which no finite history refutes. The account gives where returning holds: on m listed configurations under a determined law every course enters what returns, nothing said of what recurs. A restoration while a giver gives is recovery, which does not guarantee maintenance: his 既没…衰 has that form. 治 and 乱 carry no valence here.

says.en: Theorem (World). Return grades renewal: within p steps, at some later step, never. The grades are ordered. A seasonal condition is renewed within two steps, not one; in Slowing recovery slows without bound, always returning with no cycle bounding it.

Theorem (any process). A reading is refutable where every run outside it has a horizon within which every agreeing run is outside. On all sequences, recurrence and eventual occurrence are not refutable and never occurring is not verifiable.

Theorem (any type): under any determined law, within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle. It does not show how many basins an actual law has.

Theorem (World): in every balanced flow, where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m. Recovery does not guarantee maintenance. The schedule of giving and its source are supplied.

Theorem (World): with balance at the condition, the bound on the joint exchange is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever. It does not show that a given system regulates a level.

account_adds.en: Grades of return, and that return with no bound is not refutable; the return of every course in a finite determined world; an exact bound for when opposing response settles and when it can oscillate. 宽猛's overshoot is at RO zuo-zhao20-kuan-meng and the 杨墨 lines of this passage at ZH mengzi-yang-mo-wei-wo-jian-ai; neither is re-mapped.

source_adds.en: A claim about a whole political history, a rough period (尽心下 counts the spans by name), and doctrine as a cause of disorder. To read his turns inside a determined law would put 禹 and 天's wanting in the configuration, which he does not do. I found no law in the live chapters of when a regime cycles or with what period; the one period I found is a withholding's on a loop of waits (giving-that-waits-on-giving).

name.en: 许行 (农家): 并耕, and the ruler's stores as living off the people; 孟子's reply

source.locator: 《孟子·滕文公上》, 陈相 reports 许行; also 《滕文公下》, 彭更

sense.en: 许行's position survives only through his opponent's report: a worthy ruler ploughs with the people and cooks his own meals; a state with granaries is 厉民而以自养. Mencius answers that 许行 himself trades grain for tools because making them 害于耕, and trade is no 厉; so ruling cannot be combined with ploughing either; that 禹 and 后稷 gave by governing; and that 治于人者食人，治人者食于人 is 天下之通义, with 大人 and 小人.

correspondences.quote: 贤者与民并耕而食，饔飧而治

reading.en: Each side asserts what the account does not. 厉 calls a draw a harm; no law says a loss is a harm, and the account classes a draw by whether what it draws on goes on meeting what depends on it. 通义 fixes a rank; the account's positions are amounts that balance and do not protect, and their record leaves ranks out. In one model a keeper draws as others do and gives nothing to the level. Ranking the sides takes an order someone holds, one meeting C or another.

says.en: Definition and Theorem (World). A formation renews in a run where every condition it depends or draws on meets, at every step, every dependence on it; it consumes where it draws at some step on a consumed condition, which does not say the drawing made the deficit. The two classes exclude each other and do not exhaust the cases.

Theorem (World; no premise for the closures): mutual dependence is every influence closure being the whole; mutual feeding gives mutual dependence, which gives sharing throughout; neither converse holds. The chapter adds that mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (root; a family of models). Both draw alike, so a keeper draws on what it keeps; what limits is the teachers' count. Where only the steady state's take holds and open entry's does not, C ≥ 2: a keeper turns away more than itself. The two states are started separately, so it does not show the rule saves a level as a cause. One minimal model of a rule of entry; no institution is shown to meet it.

Theorem (any type for the counting; World for the race). Positions' rises total their falls, and a part's rise needs another part's fall. Position does not protect: across joint excess a part whose need exceeds what is left, active only while supported, is not active, its position not entering. Positions read as ranks or shares are not stated.

account_adds.en: That dependence through exchange is neither benefit nor rank; a class of renewing and consuming read on the run; in one model, an exact comparison of a kept rule with open entry. The exchange half is at ZH mengzi-tong-gong-yi-shi, which records that 孟子's division of labour is not carried, and 许行's uniform prices at ZH mengzi-wu-zhi-bu-qi; neither is re-mapped.

source_adds.en: A test of a ruler by whether he gives of his own kind, and a dispute over whether ruling is giving at all: I did not find the account taking up the kind of giving. Common ground the two keep: a draw wants something given; to 彭更's 士无事而食，不可也 Mencius answers 食功, not 食志 (stored, in no fragment). Divergence on Mencius's side too: 大人 and 小人, and 用夏变夷, a rank of peoples.

name.en: 诗: 天命靡常 and 殷鑒不远, holding does not secure, and a predecessor's end as a mirror

source.locator: 《孟子·离娄上》 2, 7 and 9, citing 《大雅·文王》 and 《大雅·荡》; the 诗经 itself is not stored

sense.en: A Zhou poem tells of Shang's descendants, 其丽不亿, now serving Zhou: heaven's mandate is not constant. Another says Yin's mirror is not far, in the end of Xia. Mencius applies these: 仁不可为众, number does not hold; 暴其民甚，则身弑国亡; and the means is people going, 失其民, 为汤、武驱民者，桀与纣也. Power is held on condition of conduct, and heaven, a willing giver, withdraws it. One reading through Mencius, not the poems' whole sense.

correspondences.quote: 侯服于周，天命靡常

reading.en: In his means the people leave: selection lowers the holder's share, so the lock law's premise fails and the hold goes; a hold fed by what it drains ends with its feeders. Where instead the share holds and nothing in the loop reads the loss, the lock outlives it, and only others reading in time turn it. So 靡常 holds under those conditions, not generally. The mirror has one form: one occasion standing for its class, through a projection that may be wrong. 天 as a willing giver 06 does not adopt.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. That any actual rule is formed from the share it selects is a premise. That what lies beyond is a loss to any formation is a significance's to say.

Theorem (counts; no noise): a late reading by the others, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where it favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers, every later reading of this form keeps the lock. That actual readers read the loss is not shown; the one frozen test on a trained judge found the law did not apply there.

Theorem (World). Under balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support, a formation requiring a condition while active, everything feeding its continuation unsupported, is active for at most as many consecutive steps as the condition's level: keeping its own support, it can still end through its feeder.

Theorem (World for the race). Position does not protect: with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need greater than what is left, active only while supported, is not active: its position does not enter. Positions read as ranks or shares are not stated.

Theorem (any process). What one's own act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns. Through a projection the step factors through, one occasion stands for its class; in the witness Confound a wrong projection is admitted at every step while the move goes in step with what it leaves out.

account_adds.en: That a hold may outlive any loss it does not read; an exact window, in a count model, for when a reading still turns it; that position does not protect where a need goes unmet; and that learning from one occasion needs a projection, which a record alone does not confirm.

source_adds.en: The moral tie of conduct to loss, which no law here carries. 仁不可为众: the capture laws' counts are of readers, a different count, so this neither supports nor conflicts. And, stored and in no fragment, the same claim with a mechanism: 史墨 at 左传 昭公三十二年, 鲁君世从其失，季氏世修其勤，民忘君矣, 社稷无常奉, citing 诗's 高岸为谷, a hold passing by generations of giving, read by those under it; 乐祁 at 昭公二十五年, 无民而能逞其志者，未之有也.

name.en: 阴阳家: 五德终始, a fixed order of regimes, used to warrant Qin's law

source.work: 邹衍 (works lost), as reported in 《史记·孟子荀卿列传》, 《史记·秦始皇本纪》 and 《吕氏春秋·应同》
source.locator: locator unverified: from memory of those three places

sense.en: Regimes succeed each other in a fixed ring of five powers, each overcome by the next, with signs announcing the turn and each with its proper form of rule. As I recall 应同: 代火者必将水, and a missed turn passes on, 数备，将徙于土. By later report Qin took water's power and said harsh law fitted its number. My knowledge is second-hand: 邹衍's own books are lost, and which later correlations are his is uncertain.

reading.en: A law standing over history and ordering it in advance is not how the account reads a law, which is read off what it holds of. A ring could be a hypothesis with content: a determined law with one basin of five steps forbids other orders. As used it is not so held: signs read after the event, and a turn that may pass on, let no finite history refute it. Read by Qin it is a prediction answered by its reader's response, right where the response keeps it. That water warrants Qin's law is no law of the account.

says.en: A law of the theory is a statement that holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it; a law of the root forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.

Theorem (any type): under any determined law, within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle. It does not show how many basins an actual law has.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional, with one general law). A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right. That an actual public responds by a function of the prediction alone is not shown.

Theorem (any process). A reading is refutable where every run outside it has a horizon within which every agreeing run is outside. On all sequences, recurrence and eventual occurrence are not refutable.

account_adds.en: That a fixed order of succession would be a conditional hypothesis about one law, with nothing in the root requiring it; and that a forecast read by what it forecasts can come right by being read.

source_adds.en: A ring of parts in which each overcomes the next, with no top: I found no law of cyclic dominance. A correlative scheme (season, colour, number, rule); 06 lists 卦气 and 纳甲 as not done. 相胜 used as a prediction is stored, unmapped: 史墨 at 左传 昭公三十一年, 火胜金，故弗克. As I recall, the order itself was later rewritten from 相胜 to 相生 when a regime needed another warrant.

name.en: 叔向 on 铸刑书: 弃礼而征于书, a rule made a text and contested at its letter

source.locator: 《左传·昭公六年》, 叔向诒子产书; also 昭公二十九年, 仲尼 and 蔡史墨 on 晋's 刑鼎

sense.en: When 子产 cast the penal code, 叔向 wrote: the former kings judged case by case, 议事以制, and published no code, fearing contention. Knowing the code, people no longer fear those above, argue from the text and try their luck; suits multiply and bribes spread. 三辟之兴，皆叔世也; 国将亡，必多制. 子产 concedes the long view: 不能及子孙，吾以救世也. 孔子 later objects to 晋's cauldron that rank cannot then hold: 民在鼎矣，何以尊贵.

correspondences.quote: 民知争端矣．将弃礼而征于书．锥刀之末．将尽争之

reading.en: Two steps have a law's form, each on a reading. A code is one response over what its text lumps: it can meet a requirement exactly where the acts' kernels cover the situations, and a task need have no coarsest sufficient description; 议事以制 reads finer. Published, the text couples into the governed, who can then select through it: the proxy law, near-definitional, its force in whether they do. The divergence is the remedy: rank and discretion held by 圣哲之上, a reader the account does not favour.

says.en: Theorem (root; the requirement supplied and fixed before the outcome). A response common over a reading exists within a requirement exactly where every situation has an act whose requirement holds throughout its closure under the reading: the acts' kernels cover the situations. Which requirement is right is not stated, and no law here ranks requirements.

Theorem (named three-route process; witness). Each of two binary descriptions suffices for guaranteed arrival, yet every common coarsening guarantees nothing: a response task need not have a coarsest sufficient description. Not evidence that judgment is scalar regulation.

Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings, and in what couples in. It is the proxy problem as the account states it, in its blindness to what the proxy does not register; the regressional and causal kinds are not stated. Whether an actual selection goes through the couplings is not derived.

Listed as not shown, under Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects.

targets.part: Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough

account_adds.en: An exact condition for when one response over a reading can meet a requirement, the requirement supplied and unranked; and that enlarging what couples in changes what can be separated, not what matters. Neither ranks a written rule above an unwritten one.

source_adds.en: That publishing a rule changes who must be feared, and that rules multiplying mark decline. I found no law separating a written rule from an unwritten one. 子产 weighs a present rescue against descendants, and the text leaves the dispute standing. A rule read only by its holders would be the capture laws' case if ReadsShare is granted; 叔向 does not ask. ZH's lao-57-fa-ling-zi-zhang reads 法令滋彰 as a loop and is not re-mapped.

name.en: 顾炎武: 亡国 and 亡天下, an ending at one grain and not at another

source.locator: 卷十三 正始, as I recall it; not stored

sense.en: A change of dynasty and name is the end of a state; when 仁义 is blocked until people lead beasts to eat people, and eat each other, that is the end of 天下. His case is 魏晋 清谈, which he says ended 天下 while those dynasties ruled, as 杨墨 did for Mencius. 知保天下，然后知保其国: guarding the state is for ruler and ministers; for guarding 天下 even the lowly commoner shares responsibility. Recalled, wording unchecked; Mencius's line is stored in R02.

reading.en: 亡 is relative to a class in the root, so the two endings can be one relation at two classes. The one-way law, what ends under the coarser ends under the finer, needs same dynasty to imply same 天下. His 知保天下…然后 has that direction; his 清谈 case, 天下 going under a standing dynasty, does not: there the classes cross and the law is silent. A dynasty changing while 天下 goes on has generation's form. Which class 天下 names is his, and moral. 亡 carries no valence.

says.en: Theorem (root). Coarsening: what ends under a coarser class ends under the finer; a beginning under the finer continued under the coarser is an alteration. The converse fails (a witness): an occurrence can end under the finer class and not end under the coarser. This is the shape of a fire passed on: the wood ends, the fire goes on.

Theorem (root). For every carrier, relation and pair of classes: a carrying renewal is an alteration; going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other. It does not show that going on is good, and whether a pattern goes on is in general not decided at a given point.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, and a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

account_adds.en: That the two endings are one relation read at two classes, for every carrier and relation, with an exact one-way implication where the classes are nested; and that a pattern going on through renewals of its parts is a region at two grains, with no premise that its going on is good.

source_adds.en: Divergence kept: his ranking of the endings is moral and the root's marks carry no valence; in the account no should stands beyond becoming, and a ranking takes the scope and order its holder names. 匹夫之贱与有责 lays a duty on everyone by membership; 07's candidate has responsibilities from named sources, each limited, and 08 says responsibility needs its own argument. A further stake: that doctrine can end 天下.

name.en: 子华子: 全生为上，亏生次之，死次之，迫生为下, a forced life ranked below death

source.work: 《吕氏春秋·贵生》, quoting 子华子
source.locator: 贵生, as I recall it; not stored

sense.en: Four grades of living. Whole life has all six desires fitly met; diminished life some; death is having no means of knowing, a return to the unborn; forced life has none met and meets what it most hates, submission and disgrace, 不义 the greatest disgrace. So forced life is worse than death. The point serves 尊生: to honour life is whole life, not survival. Attributing this line to 杨朱's school is a scholars' inference; wording recalled, unchecked.

reading.en: The condition is untouched: significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive, so a forced life's continuation having significance does not say it is good. The divergence is with order. What C requires turns on which events a reading includes, not on what is undergone: a life drawing within renewal ranks above its absence on two readings and ties on the third; an overdrawer's absence ranks above it on two. If that ending closes and opens nothing, the source has the shape T8's refuter named before 9 November 2026.

says.en: Definition: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step; the theorems that use it take it as their hypothesis. Reading [AI reading, D16]: significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive.

The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and does not rank anything. C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, widening being one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. Where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.

Conditional (C; World; the support-gated family). A formation drawing within renewal against its absence: presence higher under the whole-run and stepwise readings, a tie under the possibility reading. Absence of the overdrawer above its occurrence: ranked under the whole-run and possibility readings, not under the stepwise. No reading is chosen.

Theorem (a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights; the last rows World): one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher. A course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C does not ask that it be ranked above.

T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it.
The chapter lists as not shown: the value of bringing new lives into existence, well-being beyond admitted continuation, and constraints on acts; and which reading of living is right.

account_adds.en: That whose losses count and how courses are ranked come apart, so the source's ranking need not deny that a forced life's continuation counts; that under C an ending's rank turns on the reading and on what the life draws; and that an ending which also opens something is mixed, where C asks nothing.

source_adds.en: An order reading the state of the one who lives, putting one continuation below ending: an order a ranking could name beside C. 07 reads conscious experience as differentiating significance, and what a position undergoes as a relation by which formations count (D65, readings), and neither ranks. Its practical response of ending, justified release under J1–J4, stands as I read it for supports and undertakings. Until 9 November 2026 it would have met T8's former refuter only with an argument that the closing is good for life; T8 is now an offered way of seeing, and under the continuation condition what the closing ends is still counted.

name.en: 从善如登，从恶如崩; 由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难: the way down is not the way back

source.locator: 《國語·周語下》, 靈王二十二年, 太子晉諫靈王壅穀水, as the stored text gives it; 司马光《训俭示康》, quoting 张文节 (张知白), is cited from the AI's knowledge and is not stored here

sense.en: A proverb: following good is like climbing, following evil like a landslide. 周语下 follows it with counts, 十有四世而興 and 十有五世而興 against 四世 and 七世而隕, as the stored text gives them. In 司马光's letter to his son, 张文节 explains living below his salary: frugal to lavish is easy, back is hard, 人之常情; a household long used to lavishness cannot turn frugal at once when the salary ends, and is lost. Moral teaching; no threshold stated; the letter's wording is not checked against a text.

correspondences.quote: 諺曰：『從善如登，從惡如崩。』

reading.en: The form is asymmetry between way out and way back. Pieces hold: what is drawn in does not return; below an exact point a level ends with no giving from beyond; recovery takes net giving and does not guarantee maintenance. 习奢 has two forms: choices counted into the rule (value-free habit), two regions the course never leaves, so a way back comes only from outside, a standing score setting which side the line lies nearer; and a giver's drawing become a descendant's dependence. Since 10 November one law gives, under one draw, separated bounds for collapse and for leaving the inflow, the draws before deciding the level (the-draws-before), not distinct thresholds; no law says return is harder where it stays possible: the scope reaches only where return fails from within. 善 and 恶 carry no valence.

says.en: Theorem (any type). For every determined law, a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor. Of two configurations merged, not both return.

Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers): for one condition under a standing draw H, under the listed premises on giving, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y: the point of no return is exact.

Theorem (World): in every balanced flow, where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m. Recovery does not guarantee maintenance.

Theorem (counts for the count laws). A chooser over two policies, its rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score: the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves; at or above it the first policy is taken at every step, also where the score favours the second; below it the second. 08 reads it, counting the action taken, as the value-free habit, a simplified model. That actual agents count so is not shown.

Theorem (World). Under the reading of drawing at the descent, a hypothesis, a dependence forms anew exactly where the giver drew on what it did not depend on: a dependence formed by descent is a giver's drawing become its descendant's dependence. The law says where a new dependence comes from, not why.

Under mutual support the order is kept, so bounded runs have ending decided and thresholds exact, not rising as any level or recent giving rises; what was given can lower a threshold. Witness: levels up to four, threshold four having given nothing and three having given one.

Theorem (World): with an ending made final as a separate premise, support returning after the reserve is spent finds no dependent; exhaustion alone does not give it. It does not show that ending is final for actual dependents.

Theorem (the regime with giving from nothing allowed, the draw changing from step to step; whole numbers). Under any schedule of draws a level at the inflow stays there while every draw is at least the inflow, and one later elsewhere had a draw below it in between; a draw above every giving is enough for collapse; under one draw holding a band above the inflow, the draws before decide the level. Separated bounds, not exact thresholds.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of when a late return finds nothing and of how many steps a recovery takes under net giving; where a dependence formed by descent comes from; and where a lock by counted choices lies.

source_adds.en: The asymmetry as a general claim: that return is harder or slower even where it is possible, and that falling outpaces rising, with generations counted as evidence. A need raised by having within one life: the account's need drift runs along a lineage, by descents, with a bound, and its habit law is of choices, not needs. Hysteresis stands in the live account only as the correspondence of two records (webs-with-a-recent-giving, dormancy-over-a-stretch).

name.en: 中论 26: the twelve links, and 相續 as what stops

source.locator: 觀十二因緣品第二十六, verses and 青目's prose; 觀行品第十三 for 以世諦 and 畢竟滅

sense.en: Asked for the 聲聞 teaching that enters the first-meaning way, the chapter runs the links each from the last; 若取者不取，則解脫無有. 青目: 取 acts 令後三有相續. This is the root of birth-and-death: those who do not know make it, the wise do not. 青目: by seeing as it is 無明 ceases, cause ceased, result ceased, 正滅者畢竟滅. At 13 青目 says the Buddha tells this list 以世諦, and with true wisdom 五陰身畢竟滅更無有餘，唯但有空.

correspondences.quote: 是謂為生死，諸行之根本，無明者所造，智者所不為。以是事滅故，是事則不生

reading.en: It stands in one 脉络 entry, zhonglun-wu-ming-mie (scope, D62), a study: the chain stops where its condition is cut, seeing widens coupling while the law decides whether seeking unlocks, and the liberation's end is not taken up. No live page reads it. Proposed here as a structural reading, no more: 以是事滅故，是事則不生 has the form of 06's G09 and 04's co-ending, each conditional; that the links so depend is the text's. Kept contrary: 相續 here names what is ended, in a chapter told as 聲聞法 and, by 13, 以世諦.

says.en: G09: Q 依 P where every occurrence having Q has a condition having P; 无 P 则无 Q («所依无则依者无»); 依 passes along «而» («依之传»). A definition's unfolding, one-way. Each sentence's reading is an AI reconstruction; no person's review of it is recorded. Chapter 26 is not among its sentences.

Theorem (World), co-ending: where activity needs support (the premise `Dependent`, which leaves out buffers, reserves and lags), a relatum not active at a step leaves inactive there every formation whose chain of such dependence reaches it. Said of formations and embodied relata; no link is named.

Theorem (World; each member following a law of exchange reading through its coupling): 'Coupling bounds response and does not fix it': some law reading through every coupling takes differently, and the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too. Stated of pools; applying it to 如實見 is the study's reading.

account_adds.en: A net where the dependence fails and the conclusion fails with it; a one-way law with no sufficient direction; a reserve that defers the end (02) where this chain ends at once; and that reaching is not responding, which parts from seeing as what ends.

source_adds.en: The content of each link, the chain as how birth-and-death is, seeing as what ends it, and 正滅, 畢竟滅, which the study declines. The chapter's positive statement sits beside 25's denial of any difference (see the entry on 25).

觀十二因緣品 in the chapter list of the corpus (06 §二)

name.en: The round of 無明 and 愛: a body again, craving for coming becoming, and 相續滅 as the end of suffering

source.locator: 雜阿含 第294經 (the round and its end), 第293經 (滅於相續), 第73經 (當來有愛), 第288經 (三蘆), 第297經 (而生明), 第298經 (三愛). Pali taṇhā and the Abhidharma wheel recalled, not stored

sense.en: 294: covered by 無明, tied by 愛, one has this body; uncut, at death one takes a body again; cut, 更不復受, the difference being 修梵行. 293: 滅於相續，相續滅，是名苦邊. 73: the burden is the five aggregates, taking it up is 當來有愛，貪、喜俱, and 捨任為大樂. 297: 無明離欲而生明. 288: 識 and 名色 lean like three reeds. 298's 三愛 are 欲、色、無色; the Pali's craving for non-becoming (SN 56.11) and the wheel with no first point are recalled, unverified.

correspondences.quote: 滅於相續，相續滅，是名苦邊

reading.en: Closed capture, the plan's seed, is not its form: that selects a share by a rule read from it; this is one stream's conditions. Nearer: a line returning to a class, kept as a flame is fed. Craving nears 'more than now' only as B-32 says. B-34 holds the divergence, limited to one reading and to 344; 293 says it outright, of 相續, a Buddhist word (santāna, 脉络 notes) that I read as a line. 脉络 limits it to the round, not to 生生, the continuation of life. 明 leaves a lock and the course goes on; 更不復受 ends the line.

says.en: 'What comes round is the class ... a feedback loop is a line returning to a class, not an occurrence reaching itself.' Whether a net meets this depends on what the model takes as an occurrence.

Theorem (any type): under stated premises, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: 'a sufficient way out'. Its terms are a share, a rule read from it and what lies beyond; that what lies beyond is a loss is 'a significance's to say'.

Reading [AI, D26 as revised]: 'What leaves is 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry'; 'what a locked loop keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question'. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

targets.part: the reading after T7, D26 as revised

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest): a target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. 'More than now' is met only by change, and met at every step needs an open world. The statement names no feeling or suffering.

Theorem (World): with its activity decided at each step, a formation unsupported from some step on is active over any later stretch at most as often as its reserve. 脉络 entry zaahan-deng-huo-zeng-you reads 雜阿含's oil and flame by this family (agreement, a study), noting that sūtra's 相續 is not the account's.
归丁者三十三: 其 Z 或 Y 断言、预设或转于一个评价，记下而不强入, among them 作为有值之苦乐 and 《起信论》之苦与厌求. Readings are AI's.

Quotes 344's 當來有愛…無餘斷…是名苦滅. AI, D54: 苦灭 read as release by no further continuing runs opposite to the continuation condition, recorded as divergence and limited to that reading. Question 69 asks whether it stands.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for the lock and for leaving it, including who reads and when; exhaustion under draw; enough under undetermined laws. No law here says a loss is a harm or ranks a course.

source_adds.en: Not stated: the round itself and 293's sentence; suffering as given, not by a reading; feeling as craving's condition; 明 arising with 離欲, not as added coupling; the end as cutting, not a target met as 03's 知足 is. 73 orders 捨 above 取, reading 苦 and 樂, where the account's one order, C, reads what can form. And 288 uses the mutual leaning 中论 7 refutes as 互生 (B-04), a tension inside the tradition; within-a-step leaning the account does not represent (B-21, 06 §六).

name.en: 無明 as the first link: not knowing

source.locator: 雜阿含 第298經, 云何無明; 第297經 for 而生明

sense.en: 無明 is defined by what is not known: past, future and both; inner and outer; deed, result and both; Buddha, dharma, sangha; suffering, its arising, its ceasing, the path; causes and what they give rise to; good and bad, blameless and blamed, stained and pure; conditioned arising; the six contact-fields. A lack of knowing with stated content, heading the list; 愛 and 取 come later, as their own links. 297: with it cleared, 明 arises.

correspondences.quote: 云何無明？若不知前際、不知後際、不知前後際，不知於內、不知於外、不知內外，不知業、不知報、不知業報，不知佛、不知法、不知僧，不知苦、不知集、不知滅、不知道

reading.en: The account takes the name and says something else: seeking locked on a target that cannot be met at rest, nearer 愛 and 取, as B-32 says. 08's word table excludes the nearer reading: 无明 is not what lies beyond what couples in. That limit, the position, is called no defect; the source's not-knowing is the root to be ended. D26 calls this a formal reading and a 脉络 entry parts it from the first link; 03 says so beside 'Sanskrit avidyā', calling locked seeking structurally nearer craving and grasping, but GLOSSARY, 02 and 08 give no caution, so a reader of those would take it as the Buddhist term.

says.en: Reading [AI, D26, D41, D45]: '无明 (wúmíng, not-seeing; Sanskrit avidyā) is that locked seeking, a formal reading of the term in the theory, not an interpretation of its classical sources'; in dependent arising avidyā is the first of the twelve links, and locked seeking 'is structurally nearer craving and grasping (爱, 取)'. 'What grounds it is the position every formation selects from, which reaches only what couples in; the position is not itself 无明.' The theorem beneath is about rest under a determined law.

targets.part: the reading after the theorem, D26, D41, D45

says.en: Words in one sense. 无明: seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest; the position grounds it and is not it (D25, D26, D45). Not: 'what lies beyond what couples in (that is the reach of a selection)'. 明: coupling joined to a selection, so it reaches what support does not mark.
Reading [AI, D26]: 'The position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked.'

targets.part: D26: the position is no defect

says.en: Known weakness: D26 says these are formal readings of terms in the theory, not interpretations of classical sources, yet the chapter notes 'Sanskrit avidyā'; in Buddhism 无明 heads the twelve links as not knowing the truths, and the theory's reading is structurally nearer 爱 and 取. For review, unanswered.

account_adds.en: The split between the position (no defect) and the lock (the seeking it leaves); a law for when seeking rests; 明 as a width of coupling that pooling can add.

source_adds.en: Not knowing as root, with specific content (four truths, conditions, deed and result, good and bad), ended by knowing that content; the definition names no seeking. In the source 明 replaces 無明 directly; here 明 is a width of coupling and 无明 a lock on seeking, so they are no pair. Whether wider coupling is such knowing is B-33's question 67. The record's correspondence, 'the not-seeing that keeps seeking locked', is nearer the source than its chapter.

name.en: This-conditionality, standing whether or not a Buddha appears

source.locator: 雜阿含 第296經 (因緣法 and 緣生法), 第297經 (此起故彼起; 彼誰老死), 第299經 (非我所作); Pali counterpart SN 12.20, as recalled, not stored

sense.en: 296: 因緣法 is 此有故彼有, glossed at once as the links from 無明 to the mass of suffering; it stands whether or not a Buddha appears, who awakens to it and teaches it: 法住、法空、法如、法爾, not apart from suchness. 299: 非我所作，亦非餘人作. 297 pairs being with arising. Who sees it no longer asks of past and future selves. SN 12.20, as I recall, names this idappaccayatā, an abstract noun, with fixedness and suchness. Pali not checked.

correspondences.quote: 若佛出世，若未出世，此法常住，法住法界

reading.en: The necessary half is carried: 此无故彼无 is dependence's necessary direction, and the sufficient reading the spine does not give (B-34, 06). The text's universal ranges over time and makers, its content the links; it does not say every occurrence has a condition. That wider claim the account holds only as a model's premise (G08), and the links' dependence as the text's own. So 常住 is withheld. Read as a law standing outside what it holds of, 法住 meets 08's prohibition; read as 法爾, it sits with 08's law read off what it holds of. Which is for scholars.

says.en: G08 缘起之设: each occurrence not unconditioned (under double negation) exactly where under the one none begins; the grammar admits unconditioned occurrences (`«从缘生非文法之律»`). G08 is a model's premise, in three sentences. Readings are AI reconstructions. None of the three is from 雜阿含.

AI, D54, on 第262經's wording, not 296's: 此无故彼无 is dependence's necessary direction, agreeing; 此有故彼有 read as the sufficient direction the spine does not give, so the whole passage is scope. Question 68 asks whether it must be read so.

Thesis (philosophical, argued, not proved): it forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, 'such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of'.

A law of the theory is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it: a law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.

account_adds.en: Nets in which the condition fails, so the premise's content can be seen; the one-way 依 and its passing along 而.

source_adds.en: Not stated, and what the source cares about most: the principle's standing as fixed (常住) and made by no one; the sufficient direction; the pairing of being with arising; this-conditionality as what is awakened to, not a modelling choice. 296's 於未來世，成不生法 is said of bondage to views of self; 297's, of 老死 and the links, which is where B-34's divergence reaches (relative to the continuation condition, with an order meeting C). 297 also refuses 命即是身 and 命異身異 both, a 一異 in the Āgama, which B-01 cites only from 青目.

name.en: No arising from another: the horn nearest the grammar's own form

source.locator: 觀因緣品 verse, ZL-01-090 (Sanskrit MMK 1.1, na svato nāpi parato, as recalled); 觀成壞品, ZL-21-101, ZL-21-103; 觀苦品第十二, outside the corpus; compare 雜阿含 第288經

sense.en: Things arise not from themselves, not from another, not from both, not without cause; so there is no arising. 21: 若法未生則亦無他，無他故不得言從他生: before a thing has arisen there is no other for it to be from. 12 presses this on succession: if this aggregate makes that one, it is other-made; but 若離此五陰無彼五陰者，則此五陰不異彼五陰. The target is arising established as such, and conditions as what produce (the coder's gloss).

correspondences.quote: 諸法不自生，亦不從他生，不共不無因，是故知無生。

reading.en: The account takes horns one and four as a model's premises (B-09, G08). Horn two is nearer its own form: 01 glosses `R x y` as 'among what y's coming about comes from', which the coder's note calls a tension. 06 gives the reply's ground without naming the verse: 缘 is a necessary relation between places of the net, and production is not expressible. So 他生 as producing is not asserted. 雜阿含 288 denies 他作 yet says 緣; 中论 1 presses 緣 too (B-16). Telling the two occurrences apart still needs carrier equality. Open.

says.en: 《中论》的论证（诸法不自生）在这里是对模型的一个前提，是丙一之 Z，不是文法之定理. It speaks of 不自生 only; 不从他生 is not discussed.

targets.part: the sentence on 诸法不自生

says.en: 表达不了者: 生产与充足（10），说的是尚未在之事，而文法之缘是网中处所之间的必要关系，网无“在”之谓词. The record's does_not_show: 'Production or sufficiency ... is not expressible'. ZL-07-133 and ZL-07-170 are among these. Readings are AI's; no person's review of them is recorded.

targets.part: 表达不了者, 生产与充足

says.en: '`R x y` is read as 缘: `x` is a condition of `y`, among what `y`'s coming about comes from.' Time and the four positions tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model.

targets.part: the main reading of R x y, with the equality sentence of §1

says.en: AI: 缘 is a relation between occurrences, not an act requiring condition and result together; so 失 does not entail 无因. A modelling commitment, its answer to the question listed as open; the answer's success hangs on it.

Argued, not proved. 'In the account itself the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.'

targets.part: the sentence on equality on the carrier

account_adds.en: Exact statements for the other horns, each a root theorem with its premise: `«定性之判»` and `«念念灭当且仅当无自缘»` as equivalences, `«自缘则常»` one way.

source_adds.en: An argument that no producing survives analysis, ending in 無生. The grammar's 生 (under a class, continuing nothing) is not that arising; whether that answers the verse or changes the subject is what B-01 asks, and this horn sharpens it. 01's 'comes from' and 06's 表达不了 of 生产与充足 sit uneasily together.

name.en: 青目 on 中论 13: 'not abiding, arising alike' refuted, the nearest statement of continuation under a class

source.locator: 觀行品第十三, 青目's prose on 嬰兒色; the speakers by 問曰 and 答曰

sense.en: Commentary prose, not Nāgārjuna's verse. Is the infant's form the old man's, or other? Same: no change. Other: 不應相續, and no father's son. The opponent says it ceases and continues; 青目: ceased, no cause; unceased, no continuing. The opponent retreats to not abiding, arising alike. 青目: then a fixed form arises again, and thousands of forms; so no continuing. Alike succession, as of a lamp flame or a stream, is hard to tell apart, 但以世俗言說故有.

correspondences.quote: 我不說滅不滅故相續生，但說不住相似生，故言相續生

reading.en: 不住相似生 is the opponent's closest wording of the account's form: under identity it does not abide, under a class of likeness the later continues the earlier. B-02 concedes the account stands with the refuted, on other passages. 青目's refutation runs through 定色: likeness needs a fixed form. The account grants thousands under identity and names a class with no 定色; that this escapes, and is not B-01's sameness with a nature again, is unproved, and taking 定色 so is my reading. 世俗 still grants the usage, which is B-06's question. 13 is in no count.

says.en: Theorem (root): continuation is contained in 缘; under a coarser class every continuation remains one; a line under a class stays within it, its ends alike. Hypotheses: each class an equivalence, and equality on the carrier where identity serves as a class. Does not show that a class is warranted; every single 缘 is a continuation under some class. Registers 'the refutation of 相續 in 《中论》' with its losses.

「滅更不生故，因即為斷滅」 is set against: nothing conditioning itself, R x y and E x y, x ends under identity, y begins, the one condition is continuation under E, all three at once, each relative to its class (`«因灭而续»`). The chapter calls these readings no recovery of the text.
Known weakness: whether 在 E 下同 is itself a sameness with a nature is answered only by 依类而立, unproved; Nāgārjuna could ask the class's own nature. For review.

Registered contrary: 相续不可得; the account's answer rests on a reading at the level of 假名 or 世俗, unproved. Question 13: if 相续 is absent in the ultimate, can a theory rooted in 续 be only a conventional account? For review.

account_adds.en: Classes plural and named, so likeness is read against a stated class; constancy and the core, which say when a class goes alike; 'one kind of symbol' with no 定色 posited.

source_adds.en: The argument from infant to old man, with its cost (失親屬法); 乳 and 酪, 是法 and 異法 as further tests of alteration; and the verdict that such succession holds only in worldly speech. The images of flame and stream are the ones a reader would bring in support.

name.en: Emptiness as no view (13), and designation in dependence (24): the Chinese stored, the Sanskrit recalled

source.locator: 觀行品第十三 verse; 觀四諦品 眾因緣生法 verse and prose; Sanskrit 13.8 and 24.18 as recalled, the Sanskrit not stored

sense.en: 13: the great sage taught emptiness to leave all views (青目: the sixty-two views, 無明 and 愛); who takes emptiness as a view is past teaching, as medicine turned illness. 24: what arises from conditions I call 無 (prose 空), and 假名, and the middle; prose: 空亦復空. The Sanskrit, as I recall and unverified: 24.18 has śūnyatā and prajñaptir upādāya, designation taken up in dependence; 13.8 has niḥsaraṇa, leaving. So emptiness is no further entity or position.

correspondences.quote: 大聖說空法，為離諸見故；若復見有空，諸佛所不化。

reading.en: B-08 reads 假名 as a way of speaking relative to a class, leaves open whether that is 空, and reports 24's verse as agreement in the 248 passages [D54]. Upādāya names a dependence of designating on what is taken up, and the grammar has classes and no names. Kept contrary for 13's verse: 'whatever is, is how it relates' could be a view of the kind it refuses, though 青目 lists other views and the extension is mine; the question of a class's own nature (B-01) is the same test. Not answered here.

says.en: AI: 相对于类之续 is near 亦為是假名, and the class is to be read as a designation; the plan leaves open whether this is the same as 空; the 248 passages record the verse as agreement [D54]. The grammar lacks 空, and has classes without names, so the 名 in 假名 it cannot itself say. Question 17 asks about 無, 空 and śūnyatā. For review.

Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1–T8): there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. That the theory needs no independent entity is argued, not proved; neither shows reality has none. Its neighbours include dependent arising.

targets.part: the thesis sentence and its neighbours

account_adds.en: A statement of what would defeat the thesis, and a separation of representation from what is represented, with the admission that this separation is not shown.

source_adds.en: The identity of the four terms, the emptiness of emptiness itself, and the leaving of views as the point, which a system of laws does not take up.

name.en: No first point, nothing going round, no difference from nirvāṇa

source.locator: 觀涅槃品第二十五; with 觀本際品第十一 and 觀縛解品第十六

sense.en: 25 names the world by 五陰相續往來 and nirvāṇa by 無性五陰不復相續 and 不生亦不滅, then: they differ not the least, the aggregates being empty. The Buddha taught abandoning 有 and 非有, 非有 being 三有斷滅 (青目). 11: birth-and-death has no beginning and no end, nor are birth and death 一時共. 16: nothing goes round; no nirvāṇa apart; seeking it so binds. Round and exit are used, then not kept.

correspondences.quote: 涅槃與世間，無有少分別；世間與涅槃，亦無少分別。

reading.en: It argues against a loop with an exit, and puts 相續 on the world's side. Closed capture's way out, G15's line with no beginning that ends, and G09's 涅槃 as a state all need a course between regions. 不生亦不滅 has no place in the grammar (B-17). 三有斷滅 refused as the aim bears on B-34: its divergence over 苦灭 as not continuing, relative to the continuation condition (and an order meeting C), holds for 雜阿含 293 sooner than here; 青目's 畢竟滅 at 13 and 26 pulls back. Unresolved.

says.en: `«无为无别相»`: under any class 不生, 不住, 不亡 do not all hold of one occurrence. An observation (AI, not the theory's reading): one step further, by hand and not in Lean, what neither begins nor ends under a class can only be 住, under double negation; so the grammar has no place for 涅槃's 不生不灭, only 无别相. For review.

In the conditional-law families ZL-24-041 enters G09, read as a one-way chain of dependence, and 涅槃 is read there as a state. The theory has never declared which truth its four positions belong to. For review.

targets.part: the sentence on G09 and 涅槃

says.en: CWS-P4-062 enters G15, read as a line with no beginning that ends (`«无始而有终之例»`). 恒 ceases at the arhat stage, so 恒 is not constancy. AI reading; recorded as divergence and open.

苦灭 read as release by no further continuing runs opposite to the continuation condition, recorded as divergence and limited to that reading. Question 69: if it cannot be so read, should the divergence be withdrawn?

AI: `«四相俱时»`: with a condition, a result and no self-conditioning, an occurrence begins and ends under identity and abides under the one. Only a structural correspondence; 定理之证几乎依定义. The item does not discuss 11's 一時 argument.
Theorem (any type): a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out. The course continues; no end-state is stated.

account_adds.en: A witness that a line with no beginning can end, and positions relative to a class, so a beginning and an end can hold of one occurrence at once.

source_adds.en: The denial itself, and that seeking release while holding a nirvāṇa apart is bondage; also 雜阿含 293's 無為者不生、不住、不異、不滅. These chapters are outside the corpus, so 25's and 16's arguments are in none of the counts, and 涅槃 appears in no chapter of the account.

name.en: Candrakīrti: consequences only, no theory of the conventional

source.work: Candrakīrti, Prasannapadā ch. 1 (against Bhāviveka on autonomous inference); Nāgārjuna, Vigrahavyāvartanī 29
source.locator: locator unverified; recalled from secondary knowledge, no text read

sense.en: As I recall him: a Mādhyamika should not argue by autonomous inference from a subject both sides establish, but draw out the consequences of the opponent's own premises. There is no thesis of one's own (VV 29), a line later readers such as Tsongkhapa take otherwise. Conventional truth is taken as the world takes it, unanalysed; a worked-out theory of it is refused, as against Dignāga's particulars and the store-consciousness. My knowledge here is thin.

reading.en: `«因灭而续»` answers the dilemma by a positive theorem over a built subject: carrier, relation, class. On this view that is the theory of the conventional he refuses, with carrier equality as the commonly established subject. Bhāviveka's side, as I recall, allows an autonomous account of the conventional, so this is one Madhyamaka's test, not all. A partial meeting: root laws forbid no relation, and the hypotheses the ranking results take, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, are not theses standing above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target (07 §4). It stops there, for theses are claimed and tested. B-07's question gets a sharper form.

says.en: 「滅更不生故，因即為斷滅」 is set against: nothing conditioning itself, R x y and E x y, x ends under identity, y begins, the one condition is continuation under E, all three at once, each relative to its class (`«因灭而续»`). The chapter calls this reading no recovery of the text; 同在 stays open.
Known weakness: the theory has never declared which truth its 生住异亡 belong to. Question 15: if the grammar must declare, which? For review.

Thesis (argued): reading a subject as continuation relative to a class explains how it goes on. As a language it forbids nothing and nothing could defeat it; as a named class's explanation a measurement could. A rival dropping the word ties at the grain counted so far.

account_adds.en: A system that says what could refute it: theses with what they forbid, what refutes them, and frozen tests.

source_adds.en: A method of refusing any own system, and the conventional as unanalysed usage. As recalled and unverified: the sevenfold chariot analysis, testing a line under a class directly since a class is near 'shape'; and result with no store (Madhyamakāvatāra 6.39). Whether this reading of him is right is a specialist's question.

name.en: Tiantai: one moment has the three thousand, with no ground in 法性 or 黎耶, and beyond statement

source.locator: 智顗說、灌頂記《摩訶止觀》卷五, 觀不可思議境 (the 介爾有心 passage through the four 悉檀)

sense.en: 介爾有心，即具三千: with any slight moment of mind the three thousand are had, neither produced (縱) nor contained at once (橫). Whether mind, conditions, both or neither have them: the 地論 ground in 法性 and the 攝論 ground in 黎耶 each 據一邊, and 不自不他 refutes all four. 非言所言. 第一義中一法不可得; 世諦中 one mind has them. By the four 悉檀 each horn may be said, 假名相, for its hearers, and 即世諦是第一義.

correspondences.quote: 若從一心生一切法者，此則是縱；若心一時含一切法者，此即是橫。縱亦不可，橫亦不可

reading.en: 脉络 entry tiantai-fei-zong-fei-heng reads 具 through mutual dependence (scope) and is not re-mapped. Not said there: refusing 法性 and 黎耶 as 依持 refuses a prior ground from inside Buddhism, which 06's four-layers row lacks for 自性能生万法, though 智顗 is earlier, so in structure only; it reaches B-20's store too. 具 as one place saying all would meet the diagonal law, on a stretch of 具, and 具 holds only 世諦中. The text denies it is a claim (非言所言), where 08 demands the relation be stated.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; so no family of claims says every reading, and no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them.
四种非关系之层: 先在的根据 lists 自性能生万法; internal replies named are 王夫之, 程颐, 戴震, 郭店, none Buddhist; its witness says representation needs no start before the run, and 这不裁决先在根据是否存在.
'Its content is a demand on explanations: state the relation that carries what is cited, between which occurrences, where a law or a test can read it.' Argued, not proved.
AI, D54: 互相含受 read as each place holding every reading of all conflicts with the diagonal law; 法藏's 仍體不同 limits it, so scope. A second handling of 相即; the grammar has no operation for 相即. For review.
Known weakness: the theory has never declared which truth its 生住异亡 belong to. Question 15 asks which, if it must. For review.

account_adds.en: A checked bound on what a place can say of the whole it reads, and what follows when a family is taken step by step (`Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns`).

source_adds.en: The claim that this must be practised and is beyond statement; 三千 as a structured count of realms; mind as what is observed in 止觀; speech as fitted to hearers, not as true of a class; 即世諦是第一義, which meets B-07's question by asking no choice of truth. Reading 具 against the diagonal law is mine, and untested against 四明知禮 or any Tiantai commentator.

name.en: Gītā's descent from dwelling on objects to loss of discernment

source.locator: 2.62-63; the exit at 2.64

sense.en: Dwelling on sense objects gives attachment; attachment, desire; desire, anger (when thwarted, on Śaṅkara's gloss as I recall it); anger, delusion; delusion, confusion of memory; that, the loss of discernment (buddhi); and with that one perishes. The exit named next is moving among objects with senses free of attraction and aversion. Said of anyone, as moral psychology within a teaching on a steady mind.

reading.en: The verses assert a causal order ending in ruin; the account gives none. Any listed sequence has a chain's form once every coupling and strength is supplied, so that form is no agreement. What the law adds is a bound: the most difference that can arrive, polynomial with no loop upstream, so no runaway. 2.64's exit as removing a coupling, and lost discernment as a coarsened lumping, are proposals. No law gives any link's content or the ruin.

says.en: Theorem (World): along a chain whose couplings have strength at least w at every step, what reaches its start arrives at its end, within as many steps as it has couplings, times the product of the strengths; where no loop lies upstream the carried amount is at most a polynomial in the steps. A worst case: the most difference that can arrive; which strengths or loops a world has is not shown.

Theorem (World; balance): a gap conveyed to a condition lies downstream of the stock by the couplings formed by then, so no difference arrives off the downstream. Not shown: that what lies downstream differs: a formation may read without responding.

Theorem (any process; the old indistinguishability an equivalence): every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice. States no requirement to retain every distinction.

'a law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses'. The account's claims about the actual world are theses.

account_adds.en: How much difference a chain and a loop can carry, and the exact condition for a lost selection, without calling the loss a ruin.

source_adds.en: The causal order among dwelling, attachment, desire, anger and delusion, and that lost discernment destroys the person. 03 lists motivation and affect as not composed, and does not model how a target forms.

name.en: Desire is not quenched by its objects: fire fed with ghee

source.work: Manusmṛti; Mahābhārata, Yayāti's words in the Ādi-parvan; Bhagavad Gītā
source.locator: Manu 2.94; the Ādi-parvan verse's number differs by edition; Gītā 3.37-39 and 2.70 (recalled)

sense.en: Desire is never stilled by enjoying what it desires; it only grows, as fire grows with ghee poured on it. The Gītā calls desire an insatiable fire, the enemy of the wise. Its contrast is one into whom desires enter as rivers enter the ocean, filled and unmoved, who has peace. Stated of desire as such.

reading.en: Here the loop 2.62-63 lacks is stated. 'Not stilled' has the form of 'more than now': met only by change, so at no rest. 'Grows with feeding' has the form of choosing by a favouring rule raising the share it reads, on a two-policy count model. Scope: 03 lets a target rest where a state the law leaves unchanged meets it, 知足 being read so. So the fire holds of some targets; that all desire is of this kind is the source's claim.

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest): the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target; 'more than now' is met only by change, and met at every step needs an open world. How a target forms is not modelled. Reading [AI, D26, D41, D45]: knowing enough (知足) is a target met at such a state.

targets.part: the theorem; Reading D26, D41, D45 on 知足

says.en: Theorem (counts): for a chooser over two policies, its rule read from the counts under a standing score, choosing by a favouring rule raises the share it reads, and the reading is monotone in the share. Not shown: that actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so.

account_adds.en: The exact boundary between a target that can rest and one that cannot, stated with no valuation.

source_adds.en: That desire as such is of the unresting kind, that it is an enemy, and a discipline for ending it. 03 lists motivation and affect as not composed.

name.en: The wheel of mental act and trace (vṛtti and saṃskāra)

source.work: Patañjali, Yoga Sūtra, with the bhāṣya attributed to Vyāsa
source.locator: bhāṣya on 1.5; sūtras 1.2-3, 1.12-14, 1.50 (recalled, wording not checked)

sense.en: Mental acts leave traces and traces produce further mental acts of the same kind, so the wheel of act and trace turns without pause. Afflicted acts feed afflicted traces. Long unbroken practice and non-attachment still it, a trace from concentration blocking other traces; the end is cessation of mental acts (nirodha), when the seer abides in its own form.

reading.en: Here a loop is stated. Its form is a rule read from the count of its own choices: on a two-policy model such a rule, in sync under a standing score, never leaves the region its threshold sets. Practice laying traces fits that law's named edge, a moved count locking the other way. Cessation and affliction do not map. The law's subject is a counter; the join to mental traces is proposed here, and no live text draws it.

says.en: A rule read from the count of its choices, in sync under a standing score, never leaves the region its threshold sets and outlives an unread loss; one count moved locks the other way. Not shown: that actual agents count so; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018). No evaluation enters. 02's reading: counting the action taken is the value-free habit.

targets.part: the count laws and the lock

account_adds.en: An exact lock and its edges on a stated model, and that its score stands, so it is not the account's meta-attractor.

source_adds.en: The affliction of traces, a discipline for changing them, and cessation of mental acts as the goal, with a seer standing apart from them.

name.en: Acting without attachment to the fruit (niṣkāma-karma), under one's own duty

sense.en: One has a claim on the act, not its fruits: act, without attachment to the fruit, and do not retreat into inaction. This does not mean ignoring results: 18.25 faults acting without regard to consequence, loss or harm. What to do is given by one's own duty (svadharma) and, later in the text, by offering the act to the Lord. The aim is freedom from bondage by acts.

reading.en: Part has a law's form: a rule not read from what returns to the selector fails closed capture's premise, so cannot lock by the share. But a rule set by a given duty reads no loss either, and what a loop does not read does not change it; 18.25's regard for harm is what would. 07's P1 speaks of acting for a continuation; an act not aimed at its fruit stands outside it. In the account no should or duty stands beyond becoming: where it ranks, a result states the hypotheses its theorem takes, the condition, self-concern or C.

says.en: Theorem (any type): in a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked, and a change of the reading is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share. That any actual rule is so formed is a premise.

Argued, not proved: '(P1) Acting for a continuation presupposes that some continuation has significance.' P1 begins §4.6's separate argument; T8's offer does not rest on it. §4.7: short-horizon acts presuppose nothing about the far future.
Does not show: a right or a duty. Gewirth's step from a needed good to a claim on others has no counterpart; significance is from a standpoint and claims nothing of anyone.

targets.part: does not show: a right or a duty

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living (widening: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form). Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.
