Where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes.

account_adds.en: Says what a capture loop needs to leave it, and keeps not being moved by a gain apart from reading a loss.

source_adds.en: A duty by station, stated unconditionally and resting on a given social order; the Lord as recipient of acts; detachment as a discipline of motive. The account has no law of motive.

name.en: The wheel of food, rain and offering

sense.en: Beings come from food, food from rain, rain from offering (yajña), offering from action. Gods and humans nourish one another. Whoever takes without giving back is a thief, and whoever does not keep this wheel turning lives in vain. The Lord, needing nothing, acts still, lest the worlds fall. A cosmic reciprocity, stated as obligation; commonly read in the older line of ṛta, the order that offering upholds.

reading.en: The form is a feeding loop whose giving waits on giving. With memory one withholding ends all giving it reaches; without memory it returns round the loop; restoring needs a law in which one gives whatever it waits on, the form 3.22-24's Lord has. Read as closed on itself, the wheel meets a law: under balance and dissipation a continuing enclosed finite family cannot go unfed from beyond. The laws give no thief and no 'in vain'.

says.en: Theorem (any formations and relation of waiting): with memory one withholding ends all giving in a family it reaches; without memory it returns around every loop. In a ring of three, with a source giving whatever it waits on, all give from step 3 from every start. Not shown: how waiting forms, or which giving supports 生生.

Theorem (World): under balance and dissipation, a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it. Says only that what lies beyond must be counted, not that it ought to be.

account_adds.en: When a withholding spreads, returns or ends the giving; that restoring takes a different law; that an enclosed loop still needs feeding from beyond.

source_adds.en: Gods as partners in the loop, ritual as the act of giving, and the verdict that taking without return is theft: an obligation the laws do not give, which is the verse's point and a divergence inside this scope.

name.en: An act leaves a residue: as one acts, so one becomes

source.locator: BU 4.4.5; YS 2.12-13 (recalled)

sense.en: An act does not finish when done. It leaves a residue (karmāśaya, saṃskāra) stored until it ripens, which conditions later experience and acts; a person becomes what they do. In the classical schools the residue has a moral quality and ripens as fruit. They differ on whether rite, expiation or knowledge can burn it.

reading.en: 08's start says some effects of activity persist and condition what follows: the part carried, at 'some', with no store and no valence. The two 'karmic' clauses rest on other laws, from an analogy and no text. Under balance a reverse restores every level while the history counts both, a count that conditions nothing later; and a present held by a list forgets. So 'every act stored' cannot hold of a finite present; a store with no list lies outside that law.

says.en: 'The account begins from one relational unfolding: activity forming and changing the conditions of further activity, some of whose effects persist and condition what follows.' A start, with 01 its formal side; not a theorem.

Theorem (any type): becoming that keeps its whole history loses nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds, and a present a list holds forgets, with no count of what is forgotten. The correspondence says: 'The readings as entropy, as karmic passing and as physics are the AI's.'

Theorem (World): with no premise a family's history of exchanges never shrinks; under balance an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both. The record's correspondence adds: 'in Ren's karmic reading, after a reverse the levels show no difference and the history does'.

account_adds.en: Which premises a trace needs: history's growth none, restoring levels balance. It separates levels, history and what a present can hold.

source_adds.en: Not stated live: that a residue has a moral quality and ripens as fruit for the doer; that every act's residue is stored; that it can be burned. That a trace shapes later acts has a law's form only in cx-oi-yoga-wheel's counted choices. No Indian text is cited for 'karmic' in either record.

name.en: The repository's own karma analogy: effects become later causes, good making good easier

source.locator: §1 and §2

sense.en: A 6 October 2026 AI-authored genealogy reports Ren's 'kind sounds like karma' and an AI-drafted July text that calls karma action's continuing structural consequences in oneself, others and environment. Its claims: effects become later causes, and good karma makes the next good easier. It says positive feedback is itself neither good nor bad, rejects fatalism and guarantees no intended outcome. It disclaims any statement about all Buddhist meanings of karma, and cites no Indian text.

correspondences.quote: 善业使下一善愈易

reading.en: It stands in that genealogy and in theories/becoming/history/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md, and goes back to sources/12 and sources/07. A modern analogy, not a reading of Indian texts. Live, 08's start has effects conditioning what follows, with no valence. 'Good makes good easier' is not stated: no law marks a dynamic good or bad, and should and better are readings people and AI form (07 §1).

source_adds.en: A claim that goodness propagates through changed conditions. The genealogy itself warns that goodness and propagation cannot validate each other circularly.

read: RELATIONAL-GOODNESS-SOURCES.md: header, §2 cut at 1,300 characters, the lines naming karma and circular validation
the grep lines of UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md that name karma

name.en: Karma across births: something passing from life to life, with a carrier claimed

source.work: Brahmanical, Sāṃkhya and Jain rebirth doctrine: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad; Sāṃkhya-kārikā; Tattvārtha Sūtra
source.locator: BU 4.4.3-5; SK 40-42 and 62 (subtle body); TS book 8 (recalled)

sense.en: What was done and desired conditions a next birth, so something goes on through bodies that end, without beginning, for all beings. These schools name what carries it: in the Upaniṣads a self with a subtle body; in Sāṃkhya the subtle body alone, the self never moving; for Jains a soul to which karmic matter clings. A carrier is claimed; it is not a mere pattern. (Buddhist series with no carrier are the other domain's.)

reading.en: PLAN's seed, reproduction across carriers, inverts the doctrine: it claims a lasting carrier through brief bodies, where the law has a pattern through brief carriers, under a supplied passing premise. Nearest to 'what was done conditions the next' is one declared construction: reconstruction passes on what an exposure left. Continuation alone cannot tell a fire passed on from one fire ending and another starting, so a relation between lives must be stated. Not the account's meta-attractor.

says.en: Theorem (World; any web): a pattern present from T on whose carriers are brief for d lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (in double-negation form); under the passing premise it is passed across one of every d steps. Not shown: whether carrying forms by passing, or which formations pass.

Theorem (root): for every carrier and relation, continuation is 缘 met with a class. Not shown: that a class is warranted, or that continuation contained in 缘 tells a fire passed on from one fire ending and another starting.

Theorem (periphery; axioms reported): in a declared construction, every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit the exposed formation had. One finite composition with hardware, laws and recipe supplied, not a population model; biological reproduction is separate.

Meta-attractor: closed capture. It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization reproducing the conditions selecting it across changes in its carriers: that sense is another, neither shown to contain the other: the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers.

account_adds.en: What going on across carriers requires, and that it depends on the class drawn. It also marks that the wide 'across carriers' sense is not its formal term.

source_adds.en: An actual passage between lives, a carrier for it, and its reach over all beings without beginning. I found no relation between lives stated live other than descent and what passes through formed couplings or a declared reconstruction.

name.en: The law of karma: no act is lost, and its fruit returns to the doer in kind

source.work: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad; Brahmasūtra; general Hindu and Jain doctrine
source.locator: BU 3.2.13; BS 3.2.38-41 on who gives the fruit (recalled)

sense.en: One becomes good by good action and bad by bad. The fruit reaches the doer, now or in a later birth, matched in moral kind, and suffering is thereby accounted for. Schools dispute the mechanism: a Lord who dispenses it, or an unseen potency arising from the act itself. Some doctrines allow transfer of merit or grace.

reading.en: The doctrine asserts return as unconditional and matched in value. On the World model 'return' means less: whatever a formation can affect can affect it, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting. An act whose difference stays beyond the coupling closure is selected alike with or without it. Return is conditional and has no sign. The law does not refute the doctrine: a relation across lives would be a further hypothesis, and 08 asks that it be stated.

says.en: Theorem (World; reach and influence read off one flow and one web): a formation's acts return, whatever it can affect being able to affect it, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting. Not shown: that a returning loop persists, or that a returning formation acts for anything.

Theorem (World): where the rest follows one law of exchange reading through coupling, in two balanced flows with the same formations present and a common start, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure, the actor among them. Not shown: how large such consequences are, or that any act is wrong.
Thesis, argued, not proved. Its content is a demand on explanations: state the relation that carries what is cited, between which occurrences, where a law or a test can read it.

targets.part: Its content is a demand on explanations

account_adds.en: An exact condition for being able to return, and a named gap where acts do not reach the actor's selection.

source_adds.en: A moral order in which nothing is lost and all suffering is accounted for. The account says nothing of this, and treats a loss beyond the closure as unread, not repaid.

name.en: Karma on whose effects are one's own

source.locator: Manusmṛti book 12 (locator unverified)

sense.en: What one does to another is one's own in that its fruit is borne by the doer: harm to another comes back as one's own suffering and debt. One's own is thereby drawn by the act and its fruit, not by the body, which ends, nor only by what one intended: unintended acts too bear fruit on many accounts, though schools weigh intention differently.

reading.en: It looks like an answer to 07's crux and answers another question. The crux asks whether all one's effects are one's own 'in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for', and leaves that open. Karma makes ownership answering. Ownership wider than intention sits beside the crux's agent-regret; its form meets the objection of the wrong bearer. Whose losses count is a reading of scope, the continuation condition one, and a ranking names its order, one meeting C or another.

says.en: An AI reading, argued not proved. 'are all of one's effects one's own, in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for?' For: ownership runs wider than intention and fault (agent-regret, Williams 1976). Against: 'A village's loss counted on my line counts as mine.' 'Nor does P4 say what one answers for or must do'. None is ruled out, and P4 is not shown.

targets.part: the question; For: agent-regret; Against: the wrong bearer; P4

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count, every continuation's, and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

account_adds.en: Keeps whose losses count apart from what one answers for, and the village's own loss apart from a loss to the doer.

source_adds.en: Desert: that bearing the fruit is just, and a reason for the agent reaching through self-interest across lives.

name.en: The unattached self, and Advaita's one reality

source.locator: Bṛhadāraṇyaka 3.9.26 and 4.5.15 (neti neti, asaṅga); Chāndogya 6.8.7; Śaṅkara's preamble on superimposition to the Brahmasūtra-bhāṣya

sense.en: The self (ātman) is 'not this, not that', unattached, untouched by acts. In Advaita it is one with Brahman, which alone is finally real; change and plurality hold at a lower level of truth, through superimposing the not-self on the self. Release is knowing this, and nothing is produced by it. Nonduality here is asserted as what is, from scripture and reasoning.

reading.en: This is what 08 forbids as an explanation: 'a self with a nature of its own', since a determination making no difference to how anything goes on explains nothing. Advaita's witness differs nothing among courses and is held as what all appearing rests on; it denies that going-on is final, so the two part before explanation starts. 'One' differs too: 08's nonduality is a method, implying no cosmic subject; Advaita's is the one without relation, held as the truth.

says.en: Thesis, argued, not proved. It forbids explanations, not observations: one that needs a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Neither the laws nor the argument show reality has none. Two live arguments could defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

targets.part: What it forbids; What would defeat it

says.en: 'Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.'

targets.part: The start: nonduality erases no difference

says.en: Theorem (World): under balance and dissipation a finite family enclosed around, and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it. The correspondence gives Ren's 'the pure "self" is an illusion'; provenance, not warrant.
相分 includes setting up a non-relational layer. Whether a passage is relational is a demand of method, not a proof of ontology. Recording 相分 does not say the text is wrong.

account_adds.en: What would defeat its own stance, and laws for three cases that look like refuters. Its law on feeding from beyond reaches a family taken from or rising, so not a self that does neither.

source_adds.en: A witness beyond relation, two levels of truth, and release by knowledge. 08's defeater 'what an experience is like' lies near this ground and not on it: Advaita's witness is contentless awareness, not qualitative character. The account answers that defeater only by naming it.

name.en: The self is not slain: the Gītā's answer to grief over a war's dead

sense.en: Arjuna refuses to fight over the deaths and the ruin of families to come. Krishna answers: the wise grieve neither for the dead nor the living; the self is not slain when the body is slain, and takes new bodies as one changes clothes; so fight, by your duty. This is the text's opening argument. Whether it licenses violence is disputed; Gandhi, as I recall, read the battle allegorically.

reading.en: The clearest case of what a non-relational self does: it cancels a loss. Formally a move to a coarser class: under the self's nothing ends, under the body's something does, and the law allows both. The account keeps the finer loss: nonduality erases no difference in consequence, and a reading omitting what is reached can hide a loss. Under the condition every continuation's loss counts as its own; widening ranks no such mixed case, and the account shows no duty. No class is warranted.

says.en: Theorem (root): under a coarser class every continuation remains one; something can end under the finer class and not end under the coarser. Not shown: that a class is warranted.
'Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence.'

targets.part: The start: nonduality erases no difference

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count, every continuation's, and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living, and asks nothing of a mixed comparison. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

Theorem (any process): failing to return loses a possibility; read through a constant summary, every question has the same answer from both configurations: a reading that omits the configuration reached hides the loss. A loss of reachability, with no valuation.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance; telling harm from non-harm takes a judgment naming its criterion, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing. Individuation fixes what counts as a loss; the reading of living is a choice.

account_adds.en: That whether something ends is relative to a class, that a reading can hide what it omits, and that whose losses count is a premise of scope. No law says a loss is a harm.

source_adds.en: A self that cannot be slain, grief as misperception, and a warrior's duty to fight. Arjuna's objection, on the ruin of lineages, also stands in the text, and is answered there by doctrine.

name.en: Śaṅkara's regress against relation as real

source.locator: on BS 2.2.13

sense.en: Against Vaiśeṣika inherence: if inherence relates a quality to a substance, what relates inherence to them? Another relation, and so without end. Used to argue that difference and relation cannot be final, and only the relationless is. Later Advaita presses this on relation and difference generally.

reading.en: It argues against the form the account begins with. The available reply: a relation is the one kind of symbol, a two-place predicate on a carrier, not a third thing needing a link, so no regress starts in the representation. That moves the question into the logic's primitive application, and into the carrier: its occurrences are given before any relation, with an equality the model uses and does not derive. So the reply concerns the representation. Kept as a test; not claimed met.

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences. Definition: a relation (际) on a carrier is a two-place predicate. Every theorem is stated for every carrier and relation. Telling alike occurrences apart uses equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model.

'That relations need relata with natures of their own' is a live argument. The nearest case in the account is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation, and that reading is not shown.

account_adds.en: A formal language in which configurations, laws and parts, as represented, need no determination beyond relations.

source_adds.en: The conclusion that the relationless is what is real. The regress is not argued against live, under this or Bradley's name.

name.en: Rāmānuja: no contentless witness, and a whole with real difference

source.locator: Śrībhāṣya on BS 1.1.1, the long refutation of Advaita (recalled)

sense.en: Against Advaita: no consciousness is without content. All knowing is of an object, for a subject, and has difference in it; a contentless witness is nowhere found. Selves and matter are real and inseparable (apṛthak-siddhi) from Brahman, as a body from its soul, so one whole holds real difference. The Lord is a person with qualities, devotion the way. My knowledge is of summaries and of that argument, as recalled.

reading.en: A Vedāntin's argument against Advaita's witness, and a warning: 'inseparable' looks relation-first and is not. Selves, matter and the Lord have natures and are then related, which is 08's live defeater, 'relations need relata with natures of their own', held as doctrine. It sits beside 'separation loses exactly the relation' by a shared phrase only: that law is about describing two parts apart. Knowing as always of something is nearer 03's route.

says.en: Thesis, argued, not proved. Two live arguments could defeat it: 'that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.'
'A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.'

Theorem (any type): describing two parts separately gives back the whole exactly where the whole is rectangular; where it is not, not every separately described combination occurs. Stated for wholes of two parts, with one three-part witness.
Theorem (World; balance): a stock couples into a formation only through a level it reads downstream. Not shown: that what lies downstream differs.

account_adds.en: A demand that a relation be stated where a law or test can read it, and laws holding for any carrier, its occurrences only a supplied type.

source_adds.en: A personal Lord, eternal selves with natures, and grace. Also a refutation of the contentless witness from inside Vedānta, which the account does not cite.

name.en: Seeing the self in all beings: widening concern by identity or by likeness

sense.en: One who sees all beings in the self and the self in all beings shrinks from none; one who measures another's pleasure and pain by likeness to oneself is highest. Concern reaches everything because, on this teaching, the self in fact does. It is a claim of what is so, realized in practice, not a premise.

reading.en: Two routes the verses keep close and the account separates. Identity has the form of the own-closure reading: held de se along a relation, the presupposition is the root's condition at the one, with no step of invariance; 'the one is not chosen'. Likeness has the form of the step across standpoints, argued, forcing exactly the centers, as likeness reaches those who feel. The text asserts identity; 08 denies a cosmic subject.

says.en: Theorem and Conditional: the condition held de se along a relation is exactly the root's condition at the one of that relation taken as the net. Not shown: that any actual net meets the condition at any class, or which class a center's own line runs under; nor that anyone must hold the condition; that with self-concern and admission decided it ranks every extension between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list is another result's.

Theorem: from each standpoint's presupposition and standpoint-invariance, exactly the centers' continuation is forced to have significance, the condition only where every formation is a center; a standpoint's own presupposition forces exactly its closure. The step itself is a hypothesis.

Theorem (any type; World): held de se, self-concern (07 §4.3's sense: significance held de se over one's own closure, a scope, not an order) is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it. Correspondence: the ecological Self (Næss 1987), self-concern for a self drawn widely is care for all; here only the centers need depend on one another.

Against, argued. The wrong bearer: 'A village's loss counted on my line counts as mine'; the condition counts it as the village's own, and to treat it as mine passes over the separateness of persons. The word may not survive the stretch.

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which self-concern reaches everything, the difference from invariance, and the objection that 'own' may not survive the stretch.

source_adds.en: That the identity is true and can be known firsthand, which then moves one. The account keeps reasons, recognition and motivation apart and claims none of them here. As I recall, Næss drew on Gītā 6.29: the one line of descent here, which no live text states.

name.en: Sāṃkhya's two ultimates: the witness that does not act and the nature that does

sense.en: Two kinds of ultimate: many conscious selves (puruṣa), witnesses that neither act nor change, and one unconscious nature (prakṛti), which through its three strands evolves intellect, ego, mind, senses and elements. All activity, thought included, is nature's, undertaken for the self's sake, as a dancer performs and withdraws once seen. Release is discerning the two apart. A dualism by its own statement.

reading.en: A clean case of what the account excludes as an explanation. In the account observation is a route. On the model a witness reached by nothing reads nothing; one reached is in the web, where reading without responding is allowed, so not acting is not the parting. The parting is a reader no relation carries, and a cut given before any relation. One agreement sits inside: intellect and ego fall within the process, as 08 has knowing form inside the unfolding.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance): a stock couples into a formation only through a level it reads downstream; courses apart only in the stock are alike off its downstream. Not shown: that what lies downstream differs: a formation may read without responding.

'Relatively enduring organizations form within it, and some come to sense, remember, act and evaluate. Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside it too'. Subject and object, observer and world are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations.

targets.part: The start; Distinctions state their basis

says.en: Forbids, as an explanation, one that needs a determination no relation carries. Argued, not proved. 'what an experience is like is not how it relates' is named as a live argument that could defeat it.

targets.part: What it forbids; What would defeat it

account_adds.en: A statement of what a reader needs in order to read. It asks each analytic split for its relational basis.

source_adds.en: Consciousness apart from all process, many such selves, nature working for a purpose, and release as their separation. 03 lists consciousness among what it does not compose.

name.en: Is the effect already in its cause? Sāṃkhya against Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika

source.work: Īśvarakṛṣṇa, Sāṃkhya-kārikā; Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika on the effect as a new beginning
source.locator: SK 9; Nyāya Sūtra book 4 on this dispute (locator unverified)

sense.en: Sāṃkhya: the effect pre-exists in its material cause (satkāryavāda), since nothing comes of nothing, oil comes from sesame and not sand, and a cause yields what it can. Change is manifestation. Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika: the effect is a new whole that did not exist (asatkāryavāda), else production would be idle. Advaita adds that only the cause is finally real. Each is stated of causation in general.

reading.en: Read on the four marks the two need not collide. Under a class reading stuff a pot continues its clay and does not begin; under a class reading pots it continues nothing and begins. No position stands by itself. Each school would refuse this, stating what is so and not what a class reads; Jain both-sides answers lie nearer. 'A cause yields what it can' reads as what a process reaches, in another sense of possible. Pre-existence is not stated.

says.en: Definition: under a class E an occurrence begins where it continues nothing, ends where nothing continues it, abides where something precedes and follows it. Under the full class an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it.
Theorem (root): continuation is 缘 met with a class. No position stands by itself: the positions depend on the class. Not shown: that a class is warranted.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): the possible relative to what is held grows only across steps changing what is held; along a course of a stated process nothing is added to the whole possible. Reading [AI, D45]: 'If the one unfolding were one stated process', what a course adds is the actual.

account_adds.en: Beginning and abiding as positions under a class, with theorems, and one exact sense of 'the possible' with its condition.

source_adds.en: A theory of material cause and substance, and the argument from specific capacity (sesame, not sand). The account has no theory of material cause.

name.en: The real as arising, ceasing and lasting, substance with its modes

source.locator: TS 5.29-30, numbering differs by recension; Āptamīmāṃsā 59 for the pot and crown (recalled)

sense.en: What is real is endowed with arising, ceasing and lasting at once: a substance (dravya) lasts while its modes (paryāya) arise and cease. When a gold pot is remade as a crown, one who wanted the pot grieves, one who wanted the crown rejoices, one who wanted gold is unmoved. So a thing is the same in one respect and different in another. Substances, such as souls and matter, are real kinds with natures.

reading.en: The example has the form of the coarsening law: something can end under a finer class (the pot) and not end under a coarser (gold); the three onlookers read three classes. Stated of the real as such, the three marks hold here only relative to classes: under one class they exclude each other, so 'at once' needs two, and no class is warranted. That conditions a universal claim: scope, as for satkārya and anekānta. The Jain substance is a real kind with a nature; the account's class is supplied. The law forbids no pair of classes, and no live text draws this join.

says.en: Definition: under a class E an occurrence begins where it continues nothing, ends where nothing continues it, abides where something precedes and follows it; y alters from x where it continues x under E while another class tells the two apart. Theorem (root): beginning and abiding exclude each other, and so do abiding and ending.

Theorem (root): no position stands by itself. Under a coarser class what abides under the finer abides; something can end under the finer class and not end under the coarser. Not shown: that a class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘.

account_adds.en: These positions as definitions with theorems on them, including that a line's regularity is the class's core.

source_adds.en: A fixed list of real substances, and all three marks predicated of the real as such, at one moment.

name.en: Many-sidedness (anekāntavāda): each claim holds in some respect

source.work: Siddhasena Divākara, Sanmatitarka; Samantabhadra, Āptamīmāṃsā; Mallisena, Syādvādamañjarī
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: Anything has many aspects. A claim holds in some respect (syāt), and a standpoint (naya) goes wrong only when taken for the whole. Seven forms combine is, is not and inexpressible. Jain authors place rival schools as partial truths; some apply many-sidedness to itself. Scholars dispute whether this is a logic of relative truth or a method of disputation.

reading.en: 'True in its respect' has the form of no position standing by itself, and of a claim read with its context: such a system's claims are relata of one world, with no gluing, and context-free description exists just where they glue. So 'the respects compose into one view' is scoped: not shown of an unfolding, and quantum measurements' do not glue. PLAN's seeded law, the diagonal, has another ground, self-indexing, and reaches only the doctrine applied to itself.

says.en: Theorem (root): no position stands by itself: the positions depend on the class. Not shown: that a class is warranted.

Theorem (World): what a contextual system shows, each claim with its context, are the relata of one world, with no gluing used; context-free description exists just where they glue. Not shown: that an unfolding's readings glue; quantum measurements' do not (a witness). Nothing stands or is exchanged in that world.

Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap, so no family of claims says every reading. Gödel and halting lie outside its laws.

account_adds.en: Laws stated for every class, which hold in no one respect, against the universal form; that being one world need not mean gluing into one description; a proof, for self-indexed families only, that none is complete.

source_adds.en: An ethic of intellectual non-violence toward rivals, and the 'inexpressible' as a value. The account does not take up a logic of these seven forms.

name.en: Omniscience (kevala-jñāna): knowing without a standpoint

source.work: Umāsvāti, Tattvārtha Sūtra; Jain doctrine generally
source.locator: TS 1.29-30 and 10.1 (recalled)

sense.en: Standpoints are partial, but a perfected soul has kevala: direct, simultaneous knowledge of all substances and all their modes, past, present and future, through no sense or mind. Many-sidedness thus describes ordinary knowers and not the highest. Kumārila and other Mīmāṃsakas denied any such person, so India holds its own contrary.

reading.en: Kevala is knowing through no coupling. The law bounds answers given through couplings, at one link a step, and on the World model a formation has no other route; so the model gives kevala no form, which is not denying it. 03 also reads position as no defect: every formation selects from one. The diagonal law bites only if the knower's claims are indexed by what they read. A soul of this kind is outside the models, and the laws say nothing there.

says.en: Theorem (World; deadline premises): no answer a center gives through its couplings differs by T unless a condition coupled into it lies within T − S links; what it can know grows by at most one link a step, along coupling.

Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, no family of claims says every reading; some family indexed by what it reads, over inhabited types with equality of values decided, is complete exactly where nothing differs.
Reading [AI, D26, D41, D45]: what grounds 无明 is the position every formation selects from, which reaches only what couples in; the position is not itself 无明.

account_adds.en: Limits with premises, and the reading that partiality of position is no fault to be removed.

source_adds.en: A completed knower as attainable, the end of the path, which the account's laws give no form for.

name.en: Jain non-harm: every life counts, and taking is to be cut to the least

source.locator: Ācārāṅga, first book (locator unverified); TS book 7 (recalled)

sense.en: All beings, down to earth-, water- and plant-bodied ones with one sense, wish to live and shrink from pain, so one must harm none. Harm also binds karma to the soul. Conduct cuts taking to the least: the ideal approaches ceasing activity, and a vowed fast to death (sallekhanā) is a sanctioned ending. Harm is weighed partly by the carelessness of the one acting.

reading.en: Scope comes nearest the centers', what wants its continuation, widened to one-sensed life; the condition says anything, reading no wish. Order parts: Jain conduct ranks less taking above more; an order meeting C ranks a course above what it widens (every claim counted as living), and restraint that keeps taking part, not abstaining. Under balance and dissipation recurring taking cannot close, maintenance included, as Jain rules grant in allowing least harm. 07 sets no should over becoming and licenses no ending: telling harm from non-harm among mixed cases takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it (07 §3.4).

says.en: Theorem: from each standpoint's presupposition and standpoint-invariance, exactly the centers' continuation is forced, the condition only where every formation is a center. Does not show: which formations are centers: 'what wants its continuation' is read as the centers, and the reading is the AI's (D59).

The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens where every claim is counted as living (widening: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form), and asks nothing of a mixed comparison. Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (C, for the ranking): restraint that lets no level fall and keeps taking part extends overdraw exactly where it includes a relation overdraw withholds, and every order meeting C ranks it above. Not shown: restraint by abstaining, since a course that stops drawing loses its relations to the condition.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing.

Theorem (World): under balance and dissipation, no finite family without repetition containing a family taken from at arbitrarily late steps is closed from any step on. Maintenance is such taking. Dissipation is vacuous where exchange reaches beyond every finite family.

account_adds.en: That abstaining and restraint differ under C, and that a living family's draw has a stated floor of premises.

source_adds.en: One-sensed life as counted by name, the agent's carelessness as part of harm, and a chosen ending as a high attainment.

name.en: Release as the highest aim: ending the round

source.work: Upaniṣads; Sāṃkhya-kārikā; Yoga Sūtra; Nyāya Sūtra; Tattvārtha Sūtra
source.locator: for example Nyāya Sūtra 1.1.22; SK 68; YS 4.34; TS 10 (recalled)

sense.en: Across most of these schools the round of birth and act is bondage or suffering, and the highest aim is its ending: mokṣa, kaivalya or apavarga, for Nyāya the absolute cessation of pain. It is not annihilation for most of them. Not all agree on the state: Vedāntins of devotion keep relation with the Lord, and the Gītā also asks acting to hold the world together (3.20).

reading.en: It ranks less continuing above more, at least for what is released. T8 is the way of seeing offered for life, AI within it: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. Dossier B discusses Buddhist cessation as release by no longer continuing. That reading alone does not conflict with the continuation condition, which counts continuations without ranking them; any conflict with C requires a comparison meeting C's widening hypotheses. A renouncer can state a negative weight openly, or deny any narrowing, since on Advaita nothing real is lost. Significance has no fixed sign: one may keep the scope and refuse the order.

says.en: T8 is the way of seeing we offer for life, AI within it, not a verdict: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. T5, thesis: among valuers counting everything positively, a ranking of a narrowing above its widening comes only from a negative valuation or a misread or framed case; the reduction proved for net weightings, the bound conjectured, the evidence role-play.

Theorem (any type): a ranking of presentations puts a narrowing above its widening by one item only where it ranks that pair otherwise than its order on the kept sets does, or the item weighs at zero or below. Not shown: that a weight below zero is wrong, or that widening is better: 'widening is more future, not a good; a result ranking by it states the order its theorem takes'.
Reading [AI, D16]: significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive. The condition, a hypothesis where a result takes it, ranks nothing.

For review, AI reading: 苦灭, if read as release by no longer continuing (以不再延续为解脱), runs opposite to the continuation condition, recorded as 相分 and limited to this reading. Its weakness, as the dossier now says it: 「所以“相反”是相对于延续条件说的，不是相对于本论之律」. Question 69 asks whether the reading stands.

targets.part: the reading of 苦灭; question 69

account_adds.en: Keeps scope and order apart, so a refusal of continuing is located as a refusal of C or of a positive weight, and not as an error of fact.

source_adds.en: The judgment that continuing is itself suffering, and a state beyond change. The strongest rival value in the domain. Live it is met only at B-34, on a Buddhist reading, and as T5's negative valuation; no Indian form of it is considered, and no live argument meets it beyond C's being a requirement a theorem takes, which no law imposes and one may refuse.

name.en: Inference from invariable concomitance, and its undetected condition

source.work: Nyāya Sūtra with Vātsyāyana; Gaṅgeśa, Tattvacintāmaṇi; Cārvāka as reported by opponents; Jayarāśi, Tattvopaplavasiṃha
source.locator: NS 1.1.5; other locators unverified

sense.en: Where there is smoke there is fire: inference rests on vyāpti, the invariable concomitance of mark and property, learned from observed co-occurrence with no observed exception. It is defeated by an undetected limiting condition (upādhi). Nyāya holds this yields knowledge. Cārvāka sceptics, known mostly through opponents, replied that no finite perception gives 'all', so inference gives at most probability.

reading.en: Data fix a value only at an input lumped with an observed one, and a fit is right there exactly where the world repeats the observed value; an upādhi reads as a finer lumping the data did not separate. On the verifiability law, as my own instance, 'always' is refutable and no finite stretch verifies it. So the sceptic's point has a law's form, and Nyāya's knowing holds within what it lumps.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where an observed input is lumped with x, data fix the value at x (given two values, listed data and decided lumps, only there); a fit is right at x exactly where the world repeats the observed value. Which lumping a formation has is not derived; PAC and VC bounds are not stated.

Theorem (any preorder of stretches; any process): with no premise the open classes of histories are exactly the verifiable ones, and refuting is verifying the complement. Which readings of an actual inquiry are so depends on the process.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for what data fix, with the decisions that passing from verifying to refuting needs.

source_adds.en: A full theory of means of knowledge (perception, inference, comparison, testimony), the five-membered argument, and Gaṅgeśa's realism about grasping all instances through a universal, which is Nyāya's answer to the sceptic and is not taken up.

name.en: Nyāya's self inferred from memory and desire

source.work: Gautama, Nyāya Sūtra, with Vātsyāyana's commentary
source.locator: NS 1.1.10 and the discussion in book 3 (recalled)

sense.en: Desire, aversion, effort, pleasure, pain and cognition are marks of a self. One who recognizes today what was seen yesterday, or wants again what pleased before, must be one subject: a series of passing cognitions could not do it, since one does not remember what another saw. So the self is a lasting substance in which these qualities inhere, known by inference.

reading.en: It argues against a form the account uses: a subject read as a line of occurrences under a class. Aimed at series with no bearer, it tests continuation directly. On the models a history carries what later steps need, and continuity is a reading of identity, so recollection asks for no further substance. But that history is given with the run; no rememberer who retains it is modelled, as Nyāya would press. The models need none; recollection may. Kept as a test.

says.en: Theorem (any process): the history so far carries each prefix-closed language holding the empty word. Finite words of moves only; it keeps the feasibility of words, not the original configurations. A summary smaller than the history need not answer a given question.
Theorem (World): labels carry nothing; following a formation depends on who continues whom. Continuity is one reading of identity, not its definition.

Does not show: 'The run's history of lumpings is defined of the run, not retained by it: an actual memory that keeps it and effects the model leaves out are not shown.' Said of lumpings; the nearest live statement I found on retaining.

targets.part: does not show: the history of lumpings not retained

says.en: Argued, AI reading: continuity, a part of Parfit's R, is transitive, and a class drawn on it still needs its own reason for scope. None of the candidates for the self is ruled out.
That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved. 'relations need relata with natures of their own' is one of two live arguments that could defeat the thesis.

account_adds.en: A demand to state what carries memory between which occurrences; laws showing that names carry nothing.

source_adds.en: A substance-quality-inherence ontology, and the first-person fact of recognition, which the account holds de se as a presupposition and does not otherwise treat.

name.en: Law of the fishes and the circle of kings

source.locator: 1.4 (mātsyanyāya); book 6 (maṇḍala); 7.1 (decline, stability, advance against a rival); recalled

sense.en: Without the rod of rule the strong devour the weak, as big fish eat small; rule exists to prevent that. Among kings, the immediate neighbour is by position an enemy and the neighbour's neighbour an ally, and a king chooses peace or war by whether he stands to gain relative to the rival. A treatise of statecraft, without the soteriology of the schools above.

reading.en: Its starting point is the one 05 declines: joint activity from opposed positions. 7.1's gain relative to a rival has laws' form, each conditional: position against others is zero-sum by counting, whatever the amounts do, and drawers ranking position alone, in turn, draw everything under stated conditions. Kauṭilya weighs amounts too, so these fit only part. The maṇḍala's 'position' is place on a map, another reference; its natural enmity is a field's frame, a claim the account does not make.

says.en: Thesis: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility; conflict and difference stay real.

Theorem: a part's position against the others is zero-sum by counting; a race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position. Not shown: that a race for relative position produces joint excess: that is a premise.

Theorem: drawers in turn, each ranking its position against what all draw, draw everything at every step where what stands from nothing is least and there are at least two; where something left stops what stands next, a drawer keeps it. Not shown: that actual races are so played.

account_adds.en: Separates position from amounts, and says when a position race ends a base.

source_adds.en: Rule by force as the remedy, and a detailed practical craft of alliance and espionage. Rule's origin in averting predation is not stated live, under this or Hobbes's name.

name.en: The folder's Vedic reading: saṃsāra as a global attractor

source.locator: claim 138, and the paragraph at line 104

sense.en: The meta-attractor folder reads saṃsāra as a global attractor, Gītā 2.62-63 as a positive-feedback chain, asuric traits as rule-rewriting, ṛta and yajña as a reciprocity whose breakdown degenerates, yuga drift as a macro-attractor, and niṣkāma-karma and others as anti-attractors. Marked as an observation, in that folder's sense of the word.

correspondences.quote: saṃsāra as a global attractor (craving → action → karmic residue → rebirth)

reading.en: It stands only in that folder, in its asserted, untested historical layer (see cx-ma-historical-layer). Live, 'meta-attractor' is narrower. The verses as I recall them state a chain with no loop, and the paraphrase drops memory and discernment. So 'positive feedback' is the folder's addition there; the loop is stated at Manu 2.94 (cx-oi-kama-fire). Its niṣkāma-karma that 'severs the result-proxy loop' is the nearest thing to cx-oi-nishkama-karma's law. No check of the verses is added.

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture: a loop of selection se rule and whose reading of the configurule are both formed from the share. Share and rule are two ends of one loop at two paces; the rule is not a thing standing over what it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share.

source_adds.en: The whole cross-cultural layer: this is its only reading of Indian material, in the folder, not live.

searched: saṃsāra, samsara, gītā, gita, karm, upaniṣad and whole-word veda, rita across the live account; yajña, niṣkāma, yuga, asuric across it by the first read only
read: theories/meta-attractor/README.md lines 104 and 465, cut at 1,500 characters

name.en: Avidyā as mistaking the not-self for the self, beside 03's gloss

source.locator: YS 2.3-5; Śaṅkara's preamble on superimposition (recalled)

sense.en: Yoga: avidyā is the root affliction, taking the impermanent, impure, painful and not-self for permanent, pure, pleasant and self. Advaita: it is the beginningless superimposition of not-self on self, ended by knowing. In both it is an error about what one is, with a fact for it to be wrong about.

reading.en: 03 reads 无明, glossed 'Sanskrit avidyā', as seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest; its record's provenance is a remark on pursuing illusion 'in south asia and Buddhism'. Taking the impermanent for permanent has that form: a target no unchanged state meets. Taking not-self for self does not: a locked target is a dynamic, with no self to be mistaken about. Dossier B's question 66 asks whether to drop the gloss; these schools add a reason: a reader takes it as lineage.

says.en: Reading [AI, D26, D41, D45]: 无明 (wúmíng, not-seeing; Sanskrit avidyā) is that locked seeking; the position is not itself 无明. How a target forms is not modelled. The record gives as provenance Ren's 'the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)', and reads 明 as coupling that lets in what support does not mark.

targets.part: Reading D26, D41, D45 on 无明; the correspondence

says.en: For review: D26 says these are formal readings of terms, not interpretations of classical sources, yet the chapter's gloss invites comparison; the theory's reading sits nearer 爱 and 取. Question 66: whether to drop the gloss or use another name.

account_adds.en: A condition for when seeking can rest, with no claim about what one really is; an exit read as coupling, not as knowing one's nature.

source_adds.en: Error about the self as the root of bondage, and its removal by discernment or knowing.

name.en: Ultimate particulars (viśeṣa): what tells apart things alike in every respect

source.work: Praśastapāda, Padārthadharmasaṃgraha; the Vaiśeṣika category scheme
source.locator: Praśastapāda's section on viśeṣa (locator unverified)

sense.en: Vaiśeṣika lists ultimate particulars among its categories. Eternal atoms of one kind, and selves, are alike in every quality, so each has its own ultimate differentiator, which differentiates itself and needs no further one. It is a determination posited exactly because all qualities and relations leave two things alike.

reading.en: The account meets the same case and answers otherwise. Configurations alike by relation pass the same tests; two moments of a stationary process alike in every relation are told apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model, read as belonging to the representation, 'and that reading is not shown'. Viśeṣa makes that commitment a real thing: a determination no relation carries, at the place 08 names nearest a defeater.

says.en: Time and the four positions tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model: a stationary process has two moments alike in every relation, which nothing but that equality tells apart.

Theorem (any process): the laws on how configurations relate hold up to likeness; an intervention on one of alike configurations, a past no claim tells apart and a description no claim tells apart need equality.

In the account itself the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.

account_adds.en: Which laws hold up to likeness and which need equality, so the cost of the commitment is itemized.

source_adds.en: A complete scheme of categories, with inherence (samavāya) itself a real category, eternal atoms, and individuals real before any relation. It also stops its own regress by self-differentiation, an answer to the same question as cx-oi-shankara-relation-regress.

name.en: Cārvāka: the self is the arranged body and ends with it

source.work: Cārvāka or Lokāyata, known through opponents: Mādhava, Sarvadarśanasaṃgraha
source.locator: Sarvadarśanasaṃgraha ch. 1 (recalled); the Bṛhaspati sūtras survive only in fragments

sense.en: As reported, mostly by opponents: consciousness arises from the elements when arranged as a body, as intoxicating power arises from ingredients fermented. There is no self beyond the body, so it ends at death and nothing passes to another life. Things go as they do by their own nature (svabhāva). My knowledge is thin and the reports are hostile.

reading.en: 'The self ends with the body' has the form of one row of 07's crux: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end, and a coarser class can go on; the reach is conditional on the class, and none is chosen. So the claim holds within its drawing. Arising from arrangement with no added substance sits with 08's demand; svabhāva, if read as a nature of its own, is what 08 forbids as an explanation.

says.en: Theorem (root; witnesses): on a line under a class, what continues past the end of a finer line lies within the line's continuing. Reading [AI, new]: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end. Not shown: that one's own line runs under a class coarser than one's organism.

AI reading, argued. The self drawn as this organism: its line reaches its own stages, to its end. 'The organism and R have reasons as boundaries of self-concern', and none has been shown to bound whose losses count.

targets.part: the self drawn as this organism

says.en: Thesis, argued, not proved. Forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of.

account_adds.en: That where a self ends depends on the class, and that this leaves whose losses count open.

source_adds.en: That perception alone warrants, as reported, and pleasure as the aim. That consciousness arises from arrangement: 03 lists consciousness as not composed, and 08 keeps 'what an experience is like' as a live defeater. Also that an end at death settles what matters, which the account does not grant.

name.en: Not the self alone: the five factors of an act

sense.en: Every act has five factors: the seat, the doer, the instruments, the several efforts, and the divine or unseen. One who takes the self alone as the doer does not see. Elsewhere acts are done by nature's strands, and one deluded by 'I' thinks 'I am the doer'. The point serves release, since the true self does not act; yet 18.63 still tells Arjuna to do as he chooses.

reading.en: The verses say it of every act: five factors, not the self alone. The nearest form: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest by definition, is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part, and one course does not fix whose it is. So on the model a move can be the part's own. The join is proposed here. The account puts no non-acting self behind the cut, says not which cut is apt, and has no fifth factor.

says.en: Theorem (any process): one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest: it is the part's exactly where it is the part's policy, the rest's likewise, both only if constant. That it couples part and rest is by definition. Not shown: which cut is apt, or that an actual move is the part's own; being closed against the rest does not imply it.

account_adds.en: An exact condition for a move being the part's own, so the universal is conditioned, and a witness that one course cannot settle it.

source_adds.en: The list of five, the unseen factor, the delusion of 'I am the doer' as moral error, and a self that does not act.

name.en: Heraclitus: other and other waters in the same river

source.locator: DK 22 B12; B49a and B91 are later reports, their authenticity disputed

sense.en: On those stepping into the same rivers, other and other waters flow: the river is called the same while its water differs. 'You cannot step twice' is a later sharpening (Plato, Plutarch) that many scholars doubt is his. Whether the point is sameness through change or flux as such is disputed.

reading.en: Same under one class, other under another: at a coarse class (the river) a line goes on, at a fine class (this water) lines begin and end, which is carrying renewal at two grains. The law holds for every relation and class and forbids none, and no law picks 'river' or 'water'. The account's 火传 comes from 庄子, not from him: a shared form, no lineage.

says.en: Theorem (root): continuation is 缘 joined to sameness under a class; 'the criterion is E and no other choice enters'; 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity'. Fission (a witness): sameness read along lines either way is not transitive.

Theorem (root), every carrier, relation and pair of classes: a carrying renewal (the pattern continues under L while a fine line begins under E) is an alteration; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of what the river only shows: fission, merges, the regions of generation, keeping and degeneration, and that as language the grammar forbids nothing.

source_adds.en: The saying as paradox: if B49a is his, a thing both is and is not the same. Class-relativity dissolves that, and he may have meant it not to dissolve.

name.en: Heraclitus: fire kindling and going out in measures

source.locator: DK 22 B30, B31, B90, B94, as recalled

sense.en: This cosmos, made by no god or man, was, is and will be ever-living fire, kindling in measures and going out in measures. All things are an exchange for fire, as goods for gold. The sun will not overstep its measures, or the Furies, ministers of justice, will find it out.

reading.en: Stated of the whole cosmos, measure gets narrower places here. Exchange: with the rest counted every world balances, by the reading and discovering nothing, condition by condition, with no one medium as gold is for goods. Overstepping: T1 conjectures that what persists through renewals of a condition it depends on has kept the joint draw within the margin; the margin's exactness is proved on whole-number models. His sun is no drawer on a renewal, so that part is likeness. Fire is 02's illustration only.

says.en: Theorem (World), 'By the reading': with the rest counted, every world balances, and a world's own flow balances exactly where the rest is never active. 'Balance is not removed: nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law.'

Thesis T1, conjectured: whatever persists through many renewal cycles of a condition it depends on 'has had the joint draw on it, its own with every other drawer's, kept within the regime's margin'. Passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings (ONE-PAGE).

Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers): under its hypotheses, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y, 'the point of no return is exact'. 'They locate an end, ordering nothing.'

account_adds.en: An exact point of no return, that draws' rises at the point are superadditive up to one, that two draws each held alone can end a condition together, and what would refute T1.

source_adds.en: A single ever-living fire as what all is, all exchanged through one medium, an unmade eternal cosmos, and a measure that is guarded. The account has no arche and no eternity, and in it a margin can be crossed with nothing pursuing.

name.en: Heraclitus: war the father of all, strife as justice

source.locator: DK 22 B53, B80, B51, as recalled

sense.en: War is father of all and king of all; it shows some as gods, some as men, some slaves, some free. All things come to be through strife and necessity, and justice is strife. What differs agrees with itself, an attunement of opposed tension, as of bow and lyre.

reading.en: Stated of everything, strife gets narrower places here. What is strictly opposed is relative position: a part's rise needs another's fall, by the counting alone, while totals are not so bound and position does not protect. Bow and lyre has no close form: two-sided regulation's "opposing" pushes a level back toward m from either side, not two parts strained together, and its record reads 老子's 张弓, a shared image. Conflict stays real and is not made the root. No law calls it just.

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting): 'a part's rise needs another part's fall'. 'Position does not protect': with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part needing more than the level left is not active, its position not entering.

Theorem (World): with balance at the condition, within the gap to m, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever. Record: not shown 'That holding a level is good'.
Thesis: 'Joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility'; 'conflict and difference stay real'.

account_adds.en: Where opposition is exact and where it stops: positions bound the total from below and never from above; giving that waits on giving (05) needs no strife.

source_adds.en: Strife as what generates all and as justice, and a tension holding a thing in being. Generation as 02 defines it names no opposition. Two-sided regulation calls nothing attuned or just.

name.en: Heraclitus: one logos by which all comes to be, common to all

source.locator: DK 22 B1, B2, B50, B114, as recalled

sense.en: All things come to be according to this logos, which holds always though people fail to grasp it. It is common, yet most live as if with a private understanding. Listening to it and not to him, it is wise to agree that all things are one, and human laws are nourished by one divine law. What logos means here is disputed.

reading.en: What he cares for most, unreached by the river entry. His logos is one thing all happens by, found by those who attend. Here a law 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it', and one unfolding, a thesis argued, forbids a law standing outside what it holds of. What is common here is formed: a pool tells apart what some member does, and a shared code is among forms in use. 'One' shares a word, not a reference.

says.en: A law of the theory 'holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.

Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'. Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries', such as 'a law standing outside what it holds of'. 'Neither shows that reality has none.'

Theorem (any type; premises by row): 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use'; an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin. 'Being joined through couplings is not enough'.
Theorem (World): some selection through the pooled coupling separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike.

account_adds.en: How a common understanding forms and where it cannot: agreement needs one origin, and joined couplings are not enough.

source_adds.en: A common account there to be heard, private understanding as a kind of sleep, a divine law, and agreement with it as wisdom. The account has no such law, and its 明 grows by what is joined, not by waking to one thing.

name.en: Anaximander: things pay penalty to one another in the order of time

source.locator: DK 12 B1 (Simplicius on Aristotle's Physics); how much of the wording is his is disputed

sense.en: From what things arise, into that they also perish, by necessity; for they pay penalty and retribution to one another for their injustice according to the ordering of time. Arising and ending are read as a settling of accounts, a moral order in nature.

reading.en: His arising and ending are a settling of accounts, a justice. Here balance is a model's premise, or holds by the reading once the rest is counted, and the first law bounds amounts in a closed family. None of it evaluates: no law says a loss is a harm, and ending repays no one. Heraclitus's guarded measures (B94) and one divine law (B114) diverge the same way.

says.en: “There is no should beyond becoming”, “and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI”. “The ethics emerges from continuation: a life goes on through what sustains it”; the continuation condition “counts every continuation's loss and by itself ranks nothing”. “Where relations run one way, the losses of those who depend on a life never come back to it, and its own concern need not count them”: “counting them is the one step we offer”; “Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough”.
First law: 'the spine's name for Flow.Gainless: a closed family without repetition gets back at most what is taken from it'.
A law of the theory 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'; it forbids through its hypotheses.

account_adds.en: That a balance ranks nothing; any ranking uses an order whose holder and scope are stated.

source_adds.en: Necessity and justice in the becoming itself, and an unbounded (apeiron) from which things arise. He would read the account's silence on what the ledger means as stopping short.

name.en: Parmenides: what is, is; coming-to-be is extinguished

source.locator: DK 28 B8 (with B2, B6), as recalled

sense.en: What is, is: ungenerated, imperishable, whole, unmoved and complete. Coming-to-be is extinguished and perishing unheard of, since what is not can be neither thought nor said. Mortal opinion names change and two forms, and that way deceives. How 'is' is meant here (existential, predicative, veridical) is disputed.

reading.en: The strongest test of the root's own form. The grammar states change tenselessly: a net and its reach, each theorem timeless, with no relation of presence in time. Parmenides can say this concedes his case: a static whole on which change is a pattern read off. The account's reply is only that beginning and ending are positions under a class. 'One unfolding' and his One share a word, not a reference.

says.en: 'An occurrence in a line either continues something or not, and is either continued or not. Those two questions fix its position, and the answers depend on the class.'
'The grammar has no relation of presence in time'; causal-set growth is one model where one can be read and the question asked, given covariance, a premise of the model.
Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'; that the whole theory needs no independent entity 'is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.'

targets.part: the thesis statement, argued and not proved

says.en: 'The generations a poisoning forecloses occur nowhere on the course taken, so they lie on no line'; 'a loss is read by comparing courses'. An AI reading, argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Answers, per reading of presence, on one growth model; time as the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle.

source_adds.en: The argument from what can be thought to what is, which the account neither answers nor uses, though it reads a loss against what occurs nowhere on the course taken; and the claim that plurality itself is incoherent, which a relation needing two relata does not meet.

name.en: Parmenides, Melissus and Lucretius: nothing comes from nothing

source.work: Parmenides, On Nature; Melissus; Lucretius, De rerum natura
source.locator: DK 28 B8.7-10; DK 30 B1; Lucretius I.146-264, as recalled

sense.en: Nothing can arise from what is not, and, for Lucretius, nothing passes into nothing. For Parmenides it is a necessity of thought, part of denying all coming-to-be; for the atomists a principle of nature, argued from what we see, since things need seeds and conditions.

reading.en: The account has this sentence and moves it: 'nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law'. With the rest counted every world balances by the reading, the rest idle exactly where the course is feasible. Locally it has content: under balance every rise is given by a supported formation, and T1, conjectured, forbids a condition below a need returning with nothing given from beyond. His necessity becomes a hypothesis, and a model's balance can fail.

says.en: Theorem (World), 'By the reading': with the rest counted, every world balances; where the law reads only what has stood, 'the rest is idle exactly where the course is feasible'. 'Balance is not removed: nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law.'
Theorem (World): 'Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation taking part'. Each premise is needed.

Thesis T1, conjectured. Forbids: 'a condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond'. Passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings (ONE-PAGE).

account_adds.en: Which premise carries it in each law, and, in the periphery, its reading under the exergy balance and the second law at the unit.

source_adds.en: Not stated: that it is a necessity of thought, and that nothing passes into nothing. Here an ending is a position under a class, and what is lost need not be anywhere. Atoms as what is conserved are not read.

name.en: Plato: Forms, and being set against becoming

source.locator: Timaeus 27d-28a; Phaedo 78c-79a; Republic V-VII (the Good, VI 509b); his own objections, Parmenides 130-135, as recalled

sense.en: What always is has no becoming and is grasped by thought; what becomes and perishes never fully is and is grasped by opinion. Particulars are what they are by participating in a Form, and the Good stands beyond being as the source of being and knowing. Plato presses objections to this himself.

reading.en: The account puts sameness in a class, an equivalence supplied as a parameter, and what the relation never tells apart in the core, read off the net. So a stable pattern needs no separate being, and 08 forbids 'a law standing outside what it holds of' as explanation. A Platonist replies that a law proved once of every relation is just such a Form. Argued on both sides, not refuted.

says.en: The core of a class is 'the greatest symmetric relation' inside it that the relation never tells apart, and it 'always exists' (theorem, root). Laws hold for every class, and none picks one.
Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of'. Argued, not proved.
A law of the theory 'holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.

account_adds.en: Which pattern a given net carries, exactly, given a class; and the admission that equality on the carrier is used and not derived.

source_adds.en: The Good at the root of being and knowing, where the account has no value at all; and a reason why classes and proofs hold, which the account takes as given.

name.en: Plato's cave: honours for predicting shadows

source.locator: VII, 514a-517a (516c-e on the prizes; 517a on the returning one), as recalled

sense.en: Prisoners see only shadows and give prizes to whoever best recalls and predicts their order. One freed and returned is laughed at, his eyes said to be ruined, and they would kill him if they could. For Plato the ascent ends in the Good, and seeing it fits one to rule. It is offered as an image of education.

reading.en: The prize has a form, near the definition: a selection through couplings reaches only what couples in, so the best predictor of shadows is selected and what lies beyond changes no selection. That far a law. The rest is a reader's join: the returner's fate as 03's 'refusal read as resistance', and the lock under a rule read from its share, a premise. His ascent has a top, and seeing it makes one good. Here 明 is as wide as the couplings joined, with no top, and seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. Near-definitional; 'its force lies in the supplied premise' that a selector selects through just those.

Theorem (any type): under its premises, 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, 'a sufficient way out'.
Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking has 'feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'.

'**Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough**: where the rest follows a law reading through coupling, a difference beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in … and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate without fixing which of those differences it selects.'

account_adds.en: Exactly what a closed reading cannot tell, and what can turn it: a change of the law, of how the rule reads, or of the selection.

source_adds.en: The Good as the end of ascent, being and knowing as one order, and a duty to go back down. The account has no top reading and no duty; it cannot call the shadows false without a standard the selector lacks.

name.en: Plato's Stranger: being as the power to act or be acted on

source.locator: 247d-e, as recalled

sense.en: The Eleatic Stranger offers those who count only bodies a mark of being: whatever has any power to act on anything or be acted on, even slightly and once, really is. It is offered provisionally as a boundary mark, and the dialogue goes on to the friends of Forms.

reading.en: Reality marked by conditioning or being conditioned has the form of 08's demand: a determination making a difference to how anything goes on is carried by a relation, and one making none explains nothing. Configurations alike in every stated relation pass the same tests. The Lean concerns representations; the thesis is argued, so this is agreement with a thesis and not a law. Not a descent, and the Stranger does not say all is relation.

says.en: 'a determination making a difference to how anything goes on is carried by that relation, and one making none explains nothing'. That is argued; 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation'.
Theorem (any process): configurations related by a bisimulation are alike: they realize the same claims and pass the same tests.

account_adds.en: What the thesis forbids, three cases that look like refuters, and two live defeaters.

source_adds.en: Power as a mark even of soul and Forms, in a dialogue that keeps them; capacity held by what acts, where the account's relation needs no capacity behind it.

name.en: Plato's Theaetetus: flux in every respect refutes itself

source.locator: 181c-183b, as recalled

sense.en: If a thing changes both in place and in quality at once, no name holds of it even while spoken: seeing is no more seeing than not, and no answer is more right than another. So a flux in every respect cannot be stated. It is aimed at followers of Heraclitus, in a version Plato partly constructs.

reading.en: The account escapes by never asserting change in every respect: continuation is relative to a class. But that grants the argument's demand, something held still: in each statement the class is a fixed equivalence, and a changing rule is taken into the occurrence on a larger carrier, under a further class. And every single condition is a continuation under some class, so the class must be chosen. Kept as a test.

says.en: 'Every single condition is a continuation under some class' (`«任一缘可为续»`): containment in 缘 is necessary only. Not shown: 'That a class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘; under the full relation every class is constant.'

Theorem (root; on processes and the two-level step): a move of a process is a relation; a rule that itself goes on is read in the state's regularity, the state's class constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to the state.

account_adds.en: That the question 'which class' is exact and left open by the laws, and is where the crux lands.

source_adds.en: That speech and knowledge need stability the speaker cannot merely stipulate. The account stipulates its classes and does not say what licenses that.

name.en: Plato's Republic VIII: each regime undone by its own good

source.locator: VIII, 546a on all that comes to be perishing; 555b wealth; 562b freedom, as recalled

sense.en: Each regime falls through its defining good pursued without limit: oligarchy through insatiable wealth, democracy through insatiable freedom, which ends in tyranny.
