Reading [AI, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, 'a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from'.

account_adds.en: The exact conditions and the point of no return, near-definitional by 08's verdict; and that every selection holding only where a family rises past its inflow favours a draw on what no member couples into (`Flow.favours_reaching_beyond_inflow`).

source_adds.en: Why this selection compels: separated producers and the wage relation. And its limit by struggle: the Factory Acts as a reading forced from outside.

name.en: Marx: the rift in the metabolism with the soil

source.work: K. Marx, Capital, vol. I ch. 15 §10 and vol. III ch. 47; the term 'metabolic rift' is J. B. Foster's reading (2000)
source.locator: as named; locators from memory

sense.en: Capitalist agriculture carries nutrients off to the towns and does not return them. An irreparable rift opens in the metabolism prescribed by natural laws, and production undermines the sources of its own wealth, soil and worker. On Foster's and Saito's reading, value does not represent the soil's renewal.

reading.en: A formation whose represented region omits a required condition can lose its own support through its own draw: same shape, on the World. Marx's rift is a historical claim about one mode of production; the law is a witness and says nothing of value. Whether soil and capital meet the premises is empirical.

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support'. 'How a center represents the region is unmodelled.'

account_adds.en: The exact split of self-undermining from undermining another. T1 on renewable conditions: proved in the model, conjectured beyond it, passing and failing on frozen tests, with 'no field test of a need measured in advance'.

source_adds.en: The historical mechanism: town and country, rent, and the value form's blindness to what it does not price.

name.en: Marx: the fetishism of commodities

sense.en: Value is a social relation among producers that appears as a property of things. The appearance is not mere error: under commodity production relations among persons really are mediated as relations among things, so it holds objectively.

reading.en: The method's demand has the form: reconstruct the relation before treating a term as given, state the relation that carries what is cited. 'Intrinsic value' in 08 is not Marx's value, so the match is of form only. It is a rule of explanation, with no law of why the appearance forms or holds; Marx's second sentence has no counterpart.

says.en: Argued: forbids an explanation needing 'a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value'. 'Its content is a demand on explanations: state the relation that carries what is cited.'

targets.part: What it forbids; its content as a demand

says.en: 'Before two terms are treated as independently given, the relation said to join them is reconstructed.'

account_adds.en: The demand generalized to subject and object, fact and value, with a five-step test of constitutive claims.

source_adds.en: That the misreading is produced by the relation itself. 02's closed loop comes near in form, and does not state it of value.

name.en: Marx: labour value, exploitation and class

source.locator: Part I ch. 1; Part III chs. 7 to 9

sense.en: The value of commodities is socially necessary labour time. The wage buys labour-power at its value while its use yields more, and the unpaid part is surplus. So exploitation is a structural relation of classes, compatible with equal exchange, and the source of a moral and political critique.

reading.en: No such theory stands in the account. Who draws from whom it can state, and a formation giving a family more than it takes (05), but 'exploitation' asks for a measure of a due that its amounts do not carry, and it claims no right or duty. 05's 'extracting' practice pays for political organization, in a model with no classes, and 'class' here is an equivalence. Not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: Any theory of value or of class. The market model of 05 §10 has no class relation, and 08 §8 assesses it: 'the theory's vocabulary adds no mathematical advantage there.'

read: 07 what the chapter does not show

name.en: Marx: the system's contradictions and its supersession

source.work: K. Marx, Capital, vol. I (1867), ch. 32; Preface to A Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy (1859); with Engels, The Communist Manifesto (1848), ch. 1; The German Ideology (1846, published 1932)
source.locator: as named (Fowkes numbering); German Ideology locator unverified

sense.en: Forces of production outgrow the relations that shaped them, and capital produces its own gravediggers. History has a direction from its material contradictions, and critique is warranted partly by this tendency, with communism as the movement abolishing the present state of things. How far this is a law of history his readers dispute, and his later letters limit it.

reading.en: The account gives no such tendency, and no law marks a dynamic good. A loop reading only its share stays locked under its premises; a way out is a change of what is read, and whether anyone makes it is not a law. Ordering arrangements would be a ranking someone holds, and would take further premises.

says.en: “There is no should beyond becoming”, “and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI”. “The ethics emerges from continuation: a life goes on through what sustains it”; the continuation condition “counts every continuation's loss and by itself ranks nothing”. “Where relations run one way, the losses of those who depend on a life never come back to it, and its own concern need not count them”: “counting them is the one step we offer”; “Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough”.
'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no theorem on market law ranks arrangements.'

targets.part: the paragraph on capture through the rule

account_adds.en: What does turn a loop, by which readers and when, under stated premises.

source_adds.en: A theory of why those who read the loss come to be many and organized; the account's nearest case is a reading in time by the others, on counts. The shengsheng lineage's synthesis (history) lists 'Marx's historical telos and determinism' as refuted, an earlier sieve, not argued live.

name.en: Simondon: the individual as a phase of individuation

source.work: G. Simondon, L'individuation à la lumière des notions de forme et d'information (1958; 2005)
source.locator: Introduction, against substantialism and hylomorphism

sense.en: To explain the individual from a given principle, substance or form-on-matter, begins from what must be explained. Being is pre-individual; the individual is one result of an operation of individuation, and never exhausts the pre-individual charge it carries.

reading.en: The account's word 'individuation' is the supply of identity, another sense. At formations it is near him: who continues whom is read, labels carry nothing and a class is free. Below that his objection bites: the grammar starts from occurrences on a carrier, whose equality comes with it, 'a commitment of the model'. He would count that as beginning from individuals. 08 reads it as belonging to the representation, and says that reading is not shown.

says.en: Time and the four positions 'tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model'.

'In the account itself the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.'

Theorem (World): labels carry nothing; the pattern of names across steps carries identity, 'a correspondence premise the representation supplies'; 'the individuation of formations' is taken up there as who continues whom.
§3.4: 'Individuation fixes what counts as a loss; the reading of `living` is a choice.'

account_adds.en: What depends on identity and what does not: readings of each step do not, readings following a formation do. These structural results can inform the way of seeing T8 offers, without a ranking.

source_adds.en: A being before individuals, with a charge that remains in each; no such layer exists in the account, whose thesis might read it as what no relation carries, or as relation before terms. A history study read his introduction as a comparator for genesis (DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST); nothing live.

name.en: Simondon: relation has the rank of being

source.work: G. Simondon, L'individuation à la lumière des notions de forme et d'information (1958; 2005)
source.locator: Introduction; locator from memory

sense.en: Relation is not a tie added between terms that already exist. It is itself of the order of being, one aspect of the system's internal resonance, and the terms arise with it.

reading.en: The method's rule and the thesis have this form, and one law is near: describing parts apart loses exactly the relation. Scope: shown of what is represented, argued of the theory; 'Neither shows that reality has none.' No live page names him. Terms still are given at the carrier (see the previous entry).

says.en: Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity 'is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.'

targets.part: the thesis and how far it has been seen

says.en: Describing the parts separately gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a relation forms only by joint action.

account_adds.en: A checked statement of what separation loses, and the arguments that remain live against the thesis.

source_adds.en: Relation as resonance within a tense system, with no counterpart in a two-place predicate.

name.en: Simondon: metastability, the seed and transduction

source.work: G. Simondon, L'individuation à la lumière des notions de forme et d'information (1958; 2005)
source.locator: Part I, the crystal in a supersaturated solution

sense.en: A system charged with potentials it cannot resolve at rest is metastable. A structural seed resolves the tension, and the structure spreads step by step, each part structuring the next (transduction). The information is the disparity the new dimension resolves, not a message from outside.

reading.en: The account has thresholds, a point of no return, a critical mass of readers, and near cases in 05: 'one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin', a shock carrying a course into another retained region. None is a structure propagating out of a field of incompatible potentials; a coined form spreads by hearing, with no tension. 'Seed' in 01 and 07 is another sense. A possible gap, beside PLAN §4.4's transitions between regions.

source_adds.en: A mechanism of forming from tension, and information as disparity. It stands only in a history study's one clause (DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST: 'Pages 11-12 describe transduction').

read: 05 joint plans from a supported start
05 §10's reading of four routes of transition
02 shaping the rule, its threshold clause

name.en: Simondon: the collective from the pre-individual, not from individuals

source.work: G. Simondon, L'individuation psychique et collective (1989), part of the same thesis
source.locator: Part on the transindividual; locator from memory

sense.en: A collective is not a sum of constituted individuals nor a mould imposed on them. It individuates from the pre-individual charge they still carry: a further individuation, the transindividual, in which shared meaning is formed and not exchanged between finished parties.

reading.en: The account starts joint activity from actual relations, which is near. But its law of a code forming between formations says the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining at one formation. Simondon denies that form for the collective. The law's premises are its own, and it does not claim to exhaust how understanding forms.

says.en: Theorem (any type; runs of hearings, equality of formations and senses decided; each further premise named): 'Hearing makes no form'; 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use' (hearings that take the form heard; a finite list); summarized at 07 §1 as 'a shared code reached among codes already held'.
'Joint activity starts from actual relations, not from opposed interests or a fixed common utility.'

account_adds.en: Exact conditions under which a code converges, that being joined through couplings is not enough, and what an imposed code loses.

source_adds.en: A shared meaning that neither party held in any form before; this bears directly on the account's aim of a shared understanding, and is not stated.

name.en: Jonas: the imperative of responsibility

source.work: H. Jonas, The Imperative of Responsibility (1979; English 1984)
source.locator: ch. 1 §V

sense.en: A categorical imperative for the age of technology: act so that the effects of your action are compatible with the permanence of genuine human life. The existence of humanity may not be staked on any wager, since no comparison of outcomes can offset that loss.

reading.en: The ranking's part is stated with neither the continuation condition nor C: an ending of what everyone needs, with no second copy, is ranked below by every order rising with its own continuation. That is under hypotheses and from a standpoint; it obliges no one, and an independent copy makes it mixed. The record said 'the existence of the whole', wider than his human object, until 7 November 2026; it now says humanity as a whole.

says.en: Theorem (any type; World): correspondence 'Jonas (1979): the existence of humanity as a whole is never to be staked; here a condition everyone needs, with no second copy, has its ending ranked below by every standpoint's self-concern'. Not shown: 'that a ranking obliges anyone: an order is from a standpoint'.
Question put to reviewers: how the condition compares with Jonas's imperative, 'whose object is the permanence of genuine human life'.

account_adds.en: The exact case: one copy, every later generation dependent, stock and gate stated; that self-concern is itself 'a hypothesis, asking less of an order than C does'; and a limit: where another course keeps an item beyond, some such order ranks either way.

source_adds.en: A duty that binds unconditionally; the human object; and a ban on the wager itself, which is about risk. The record: a recurring risk of ending is not formalized.

name.en: Jonas: an ought founded in being

source.work: H. Jonas, The Imperative of Responsibility (1979; English 1984)
source.locator: chs. 3 and 4, purposes in nature, the good and the ought

sense.en: Against the is-ought gap as a dogma of a value-stripped nature: purposiveness is real in nature, and having a purpose is a good in itself over purposelessness. Life's self-affirmation is being's emphatic no to not-being, so being itself grounds an ought.

reading.en: The account takes the topic and refuses the form as a law: with significance free, no satisfiable statement reading only the represented dynamics entails the condition, by construction. That does not refute Jonas: the chapter says it is about the representation, and 08's test says a toggled predicate 'shows non-entailment, not that the fuller structure allows the toggle'. His claim would enter only as an argument for a hypothesis a ranking takes, the condition, self-concern or C; in the account no should stands beyond becoming, the ethics seeks no authority outside it (argued), and it emerges from continuation in a sense that derives no ought: where the condition holds de se, a self-concerned order (one ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach) ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and that a life forms such an order is not shown (07 §4.9).

says.en: Theorem (any type); 'the result shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined or needs the condition'.
'No theorem says that a standard which formed is a significance.' The condition and C are supplied, entering as hypotheses.
Step 4: 'Toggling a predicate in a weaker model shows non-entailment, not that the fuller structure allows the toggle, and declaring an identity does not make it true.'

account_adds.en: A map of what is shown, read and supplied, and the near-parallel for C (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

source_adds.en: A positive argument that purpose in nature is itself a value. The account has no claim of this strength: with no should beyond becoming, it seeks no authority outside becoming (argued), and whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind it does not claim or settle.

name.en: Jonas: metabolism and needful freedom

source.work: H. Jonas, The Phenomenon of Life (1966)
source.locator: locator unverified; the essays on metabolism and on Is God a Mathematician?

sense.en: An organism is a form that persists through the exchange of its matter: free of any given stuff, yet needing stuff. Its being is its own constant task, with not-being always at hand. So inwardness, concern and freedom begin with metabolism.

reading.en: The structural half has this form: a pattern going on through renewal of what carries it, a formation fed from beyond, and a member rebuilt from the level whose 'stock buys it time' and whose 'end does not come back', 04's reading of a minimal organism. The account does not credit him. The other half it withholds: inwardness and concern are not read off metabolism, and that model has 'one constraint', below closure of constraints.

says.en: Reading [AI, D65], above that section: 'Life is continuation that renews its own conditions'; the chapter argues this reading from the laws, and it is not one of them.

Theorem (World): under balance and dissipation, a finite family enclosed around from some step on and taken from at arbitrarily late steps cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it; it needs a fixed unit, and at a unit that splits it can fail.

Theorem (root; a family of models): over the four members, 'the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level'. Reading [AI, new]: 'one constraint, with turnover, regenerated from the flow it regulates, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure'.

account_adds.en: The two grains (02 §1): at one class sustaining turnover and ending turnover look alike.

source_adds.en: That concern itself starts here, so that value is not an addition to life. In 07 §1, whether a formed standard gains influence, recognizes its target, has reasons behind it or is followed are four questions, none answered by metabolism.

name.en: Jonas: responsibility without reciprocity

source.work: H. Jonas, The Imperative of Responsibility (1979; English 1984)
source.locator: ch. 4, parental responsibility as archetype

sense.en: The duty toward the future cannot rest on reciprocity or on rights of those who do not yet exist. Its archetype is the newborn, whose mere breathing addresses an ought: one-sided responsibility to the vulnerable and to what comes after.

reading.en: Self-concern along need reaches nothing active only later, and 07 reads further formation as able to count 'with no existing beneficiary', so counting there asks no reciprocity. Where Jonas founds a duty there, the account claims none. Scope over later continuations rests on a line (§4.6's P1 to P4; P2 and P4 not shown) or the step; the condition fixes whose losses count; C is a requirement on an order.

says.en: Theorem (World) and witness: over flows in which only active formations give, a formation active at no step of the stretch is needed only vacuously; 'need reaches only what is active within the stretch it is read across, and nothing active only after it'.
Reading [AI, D65]: 'further living formation can count with no existing beneficiary, inventing no unlimited duty to create'.
Not shown: 'Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance'; and the value of bringing new lives into existence.

account_adds.en: The exact route by which the future is and is not reached without a further premise.

source_adds.en: The vulnerable other as the source of an ought. On responsibility 07 reads 'Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited', and 08 says 'Responsibility needs its own argument'; neither has the newborn's address.

name.en: Jonas: the heuristics of fear and the priority of the bad prognosis

source.work: H. Jonas, The Imperative of Responsibility (1979; English 1984)
source.locator: ch. 2

sense.en: Where the effects of action are vast and uncertain, the prophecy of doom is to be heeded over that of bliss: knowledge of what we stand to lose comes first by fearing it, and decisions must favour the worse prognosis.

reading.en: The nearest live text names the gap: ergodicity and systemic ruin are 'not formalized here', and a recurring risk of ending is under what the record does not show. Worst-case forms exist with no priority among prognoses: E asks every admitted continuation, the conservative L every outcome over every outcome, a guard every admissible disturbance. 03's 'the stakes of error change what to investigate, not what is true' is no decision rule. None favours the worse prognosis.

source_adds.en: A decision rule under deep uncertainty. Whether it should enter as a further premise beside A, D, E, L and J1 to J4 is not asked in the account.

name.en: Spinoza: every thing strives to persevere

source.locator: III p6, p7

sense.en: Each thing, as far as it is in itself, strives to persevere in its being, and this striving is its actual essence. It holds of every thing, a stone or a state as well as a person, as a degree of power.

reading.en: Conatus has not the condition's form: it says each thing strives, the condition that from every standpoint each continuation is counted. On reading D59 centers are what want their continuation, and with standpoint-invariance the premises force exactly theirs. Conatus would make every thing a center, yet the step across standpoints is still needed, since his good is each thing's own. And no law has things tending to persist. How courses are ranked is apart.

says.en: Theorem (any type): each standpoint's presupposition about its own continuation, with standpoint-invariance, forces 'exactly the centers' continuation; the condition only where every formation is a center'.
The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center: 'a tumour does not tell the scopes apart, a hurricane only on a stronger reading of wanting'.
Only mention: a question comparing the condition with 'a conatus reading of Spinoza', quoting a history study.
AI reading, argued, among the case against a self as a regularity: 'A finite, dependent being's going-on is exactly what its being does not fix.'

account_adds.en: What is forced at each scope, and that nothing here rules out a formation that is no center.

source_adds.en: Striving as essence, a nature of its own, which 08's thesis forbids in explanation; and power as degree. The account's 'wanting' is a labelled reading and does not cover every thing.

name.en: Spinoza: no thing is destroyed except by an external cause

source.locator: III p4; IV p20 scholium, on suicide

sense.en: A thing's definition affirms its essence and does not negate it, so while we attend only to the thing, nothing in it can destroy it. Whatever destroys it, suicide included, comes from outside.

reading.en: The laws state formations ending by their own draw: with a required condition left out of the region, or an optimum ending its own stock. Spinoza may reply that the draw's fatality lies with what is outside the thing's essence, so his claim holds by definition. The account makes 'outside' depend on a region drawn along a relation.

says.en: Theorem (World): 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support' (`Omitted.loses_own`).
Where the weighting falls faster than every positive level renews, 'every optimum ends its own stock at the first step': capacity covering, any `R`.
Reading [AI, D45, D61]: a boundary is given by a region; 'Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed.'

account_adds.en: Which region must be left out, and which conditions make own draw fatal.

source_adds.en: An essence that fixes what is the thing and what is not, so inside and outside are not chosen.

name.en: Spinoza: one substance, its modes in another

source.locator: I definitions 3 and 5; I p14, p15

sense.en: There is one substance, God or Nature, in itself and conceived through itself. Everything else is a mode: in another and conceived through another, so finite things are not independent units.

reading.en: Modes conceived through what conditions them are near the thesis. He could press 'one unfolding' as his substance: it too relates to nothing beyond itself, and the thesis says only that whatever is, is how it relates within it. What stays apart is a nature: substance with infinite attributes and necessary existence, a determination no relation carries. 08 gives the whole none, says a shared process implies no cosmic subject, and does not name him.

says.en: Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'; neighbours named are ontic structural realism, process philosophy, dependent arising, the identity of indiscernibles.
On the thesis, argued and not proved, 'positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value'.

account_adds.en: A demand on explanation, with no attributes or necessary being. These structural results can inform the way of seeing T8 offers, without a ranking.

source_adds.en: A ground with a nature of its own, derived by demonstration; and parallel attributes of thought and extension.

name.en: Spinoza: only what is actual was possible

source.locator: I p29, p33 and its scholium

sense.en: Nothing in nature is contingent; things could not have been otherwise or in another order. We call things possible or contingent only through a defect of our knowledge.

reading.en: Widening compares courses by what can form, and a counterfactual is the course one law generates from a different act. If only the actual was possible, the comparison ranks what never could be: a comparison within ignorance. The account's reply is partial: its models hold both a net of possibilities and one history, and say the model does not pick.

says.en: 'In the net of possibilities every two intact moments of a nucleus are alike ... and each may stay or decay', and 'With one history taken as the net, the time left tells them apart'. 'Which net an actual decay is, the model does not say.'

targets.part: the two nets of a decaying nucleus

says.en: 'a counterfactual being the course the same law generates from a different act'.

account_adds.en: The two nets side by side, each law keeping to its own.

source_adds.en: An argument that the single history is the only net; on that, the comparison of courses by widening needs another reading, stated nowhere.

name.en: Spinoza: we call good what we desire; comparison is a mode of thinking

source.locator: III p9 scholium; IV Preface; IV definition 1

sense.en: We do not desire a thing because it is good; we judge it good because we desire it. Good and bad indicate nothing positive in things: they are modes of thinking, notions formed by comparing things with one another, though a model of human nature can be retained for use.

reading.en: Agreement with the sorting in 07: standards form within the unfolding and none owns value; 'better' is free in the dynamics. Two distances: 07 adds that a standard can be wrong and that a disposition is not a reason; and Spinoza keeps his own standard, what is certainly useful to a thing's power, where a ranking in the account names its order, most often one meeting C.

says.en: On the thesis, argued: standards form within the unfolding; 'it can be wrong, and learning a disposition is not learning a reason'.

'Significance and order left free, given a standpoint, a formation and a widening, the represented dynamics entail neither the continuation condition nor C (`Comparison`: with every claim counted as living, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens), by construction.'

account_adds.en: The limit theorems for the free parameters, each by construction.

source_adds.en: An account of the affects producing the judgments. The account has only what acts show of an order, near-definitional.

name.en: Spinoza: what lets the body affect and be affected in more ways is useful

source.locator: IV p38, p39; locators from memory

sense.en: What disposes the body to be affected, and to affect others, in more ways is useful, the more so the more ways, and what lessens this is harmful; the mind's power grows with it. The ranking follows from each thing's seeking its own advantage. IV p39 limits it: what keeps the body's proportion of motion and rest is good, what changes it bad.

reading.en: Widening's shape on another carrier: more that can happen ranked above less. He derives it from one's own advantage, so the nearest law is self-concern's: an order rising with its own continuation ranks a widening adding to what that marks, with no C. It stays that order's, self-concern a hypothesis in the proofs; where the condition holds de se, self-concern ranks every widening above on a finite listing and does what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end, so his route from one's own advantage is near the account's own there. Nothing reading no order entails C. His count is of one body's capacities, and p39 caps it. Widening reads admitted formations; the condition fixes whose losses count.

says.en: An order is increasing in its own continuation 'when it ranks higher every widening adding to the items its own continuation marks'. Not shown: that a standpoint's order is so: 'a hypothesis, asking less of an order than C does'.

Widening: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (`Comparison`) where every claim is counted as living', and it asks nothing of mixed comparisons. 'Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target'; 'A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails'.

Theorem and Conditional: 'This is not itself a route to C: it says what "weaker" can mean and where each route to an order meeting C rests.' Where the class of one's line holds everything downstream, on a listing of what lies downstream, an order increasing in its own continuation is increasing in admission. 'P2 and P4 rank nothing; self-concern does'.

account_adds.en: That a wider menu can lower what each gets among several choosers (`Weighting.Restraint`), and exactly where one's own concern stops being everything.

source_adds.en: A ranking of one body's states by power, with its limit in keeping the body's form; joy as the feeling of the passage to greater power. A derivation of the ranking, which the account does not offer for C.

name.en: Spinoza: nothing is more useful to a person than a person

source.locator: IV p18 scholium, p35, p37 scholium 1

sense.en: Virtue is founded on seeking one's own advantage. So far as people live by reason they agree in nature, and each is most useful to another; rational self-seeking gives the common good. The same reasoning excludes animals: no bond of like nature.

reading.en: Route (b) has this form: a loss returns through what feeds one, and where centers feed each other self-concern has one scope. It holds exactly where every center lies within every center's closure, and that humans do is empirical. The clearer's witness marks the limit, and the animals Spinoza leaves out are what the condition counts; how courses are ranked is another matter.

says.en: Theorem (any type; World): held de se, self-concern (07 §4.3's sense: significance held de se over one's own closure, a scope, not an order) is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it.

Route (b), AI reading D17, as 07 now words it: 'that reading is one condition of a response retaining what lies within its closure, a reason of its own; it does not produce the response'; in `Clearing` the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller.

account_adds.en: The exact condition, and a witness of who is lost beyond it.

source_adds.en: Agreement in nature under reason: a claim about what rational beings are, not feeding closures. Stated nowhere.

name.en: Parfit: reductionism; identity is not what matters

source.locator: Part III, chs. 10 to 15

sense.en: A person's existence consists in nothing beyond a brain, a body and connected events. Identity is not what matters in survival: Relation R is, psychological connectedness and/or continuity with any cause. This can reduce the difference between my life and others' lives.

reading.en: 07 states the thesis as a premise of the step across drawings, a hypothesis where used and 'coherently denied', and uses R as the live rival to the widest self: connectedness is no class, continuity can be one. Nearest to what matters coming in degrees is the own-good route: significance supervening on profiles of connection, passing by tolerance, both 'substantive and contested'. A line under a class need not carry R (P-18).

says.en: Across drawings, 'the reductionist step of Parfit (1984) and Siderits (2003)'; argued, soundness not shown; 'P4, Parfit's thesis that identity is not what matters, is coherently denied'.

AI reading: 'Connectedness comes in degrees and is not transitive, so it is no class ...; continuity, the other part of R, is transitive, and a class drawn on it still needs its own reason for scope.'
Correspondence: 'Parfit: what matters passes to successors in degrees; here need does not pass at all, and the reach past one's end is a question of classes'.

Theorem (any process): where significance supervenes on profiles of connection and passes along each small step between them (tolerance), living significance holds on what the standpoint's activity can reach. 'Supervenience and tolerance are substantive and contested; without tolerance a threshold rival is consistent and a present-aim evaluator escapes'.

account_adds.en: Which classes are lines; a self read as a choice of class with its own laws; a path beyond R, resting on P1 to P4.

source_adds.en: The claim as one Parfit holds and argues, not a premise; the thought experiments; and any-cause R. The live account does not take Parfit's side.

name.en: Parfit: fission

source.locator: Part III ch. 12

sense.en: If I divide into two who each continue me, I cannot be both, by the logic of identity, and yet nothing that matters is lost. So what matters can hold where identity cannot, because it can take a branching form.

reading.en: The root has the first half as a witness, with Parfit uncredited there: continuation splits, and sameness read along lines is not transitive. The second half, that identity is not what matters, belongs to no law: 07 §4.2 names it as Parfit's thesis, P4 of the strongest argument for the step, argued, coherently denied and not shown. The record on own good puts fission in scope of a correspondence premise.

says.en: 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity.' Witness: 'where one occurrence is continued by two that go no further, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive (`«分叉»`). The family gathers the branches; it is coarser than identity.'

The strongest argument for the step, argued, not proved: '(P4) What acting presupposes is that continuation has significance, not continuation under a description of its own drawing'; soundness is not shown, and 'P4, Parfit's thesis that identity is not what matters, is coherently denied'.
Differentiation is 'a correspondence premise in scope for fission, copying, forking and AI successors'.

account_adds.en: The family as the class that gathers branches; merges as well as splits. These structural results can inform the way of seeing T8 offers, without a ranking.

source_adds.en: The fission case as the argument for the second half, and the claim that the branching relation is all that matters in survival, which 07 holds only as P4, argued and not shown.

name.en: Parfit: the Extreme Claim

source.locator: Part III ch. 14; the same objection in Wolf 1986

sense.en: If reductionism is true, we may have no reason for special concern about our own futures at all: the view may dissolve concern as well as extend it. Parfit takes it as defensible and does not hold it himself as forced.

reading.en: Kept in 07 as an objection to the widened line, and in P as the standard objection to the step across drawings. The reply, that P1 chooses since it is held fixed, stands in a labelled reading and is argued.

says.en: AI reading: 'Stretched to everything downstream, "my continuation" keeps the word and can lose the concern (Parfit's Extreme Claim).'

targets.part: Reading: the word may not survive

says.en: Known weakness: 'reductionism can dissolve concern as easily as extend it (Wolf 1986; Parfit's Extreme Claim)'; the study's answer that P1 chooses is quoted from a history study. 07 §4.2 reading D59: 'P1 chooses'.
Correspondence: 'Wolf's (1986) point that reductionism can dissolve concern is Boundaries' not_subTrue_of_invariant'.

account_adds.en: The dichotomy made exact: invariant, the presupposition holds at no drawing if any continuation lacks significance, and anywhere gives everything.

source_adds.en: That the claim is about one's own future given Reductionism, beside a Moderate Claim he also finds defensible. 07 uses it on a self stretched to everything downstream.

name.en: Parfit: non-identity, mere addition and the Repugnant Conclusion

source.locator: Part IV

sense.en: Our choices fix who will exist, so a policy can harm no one and still seem wrong. Adding lives worth living seems not to make things worse, yet that path leads toward the Repugnant Conclusion. No satisfactory Theory X has been found.

reading.en: An order meeting C is stronger at the first step: it ranks a costless addition above, not merely not below, even of a life not worth living, as admission reads no quality. C asks nothing of mixed comparisons, so neither yields nor blocks the later steps. 08 lists the results as unstated. The condition fixes whose losses count; C is a requirement on an order.

says.en: Stated by prior frameworks and not yet here: 'Parfit's mere addition, the Repugnant Conclusion and the non-identity problem (an order meeting C ranks a course with a costless addition above the course without it; the philosophy dossier keeps what it owes open)'.

[this dossier, AI]: an order meeting C (`Comparison`) 'also ranks adding a life not worth living above not adding it, against the procreation asymmetry'; widening leaves mixed comparisons unranked, so 'it neither yields nor blocks the paradox's later steps'.
AI reading: the generations a poisoning forecloses 'occur nowhere on the course taken, so they lie on no line'; a loss is read by comparing courses.

account_adds.en: Admission as what is compared, which sets this comparison up differently from welfare totals.

source_adds.en: The puzzles themselves, as tests C has not faced; 07 does not show the value of new lives.

name.en: Parfit: theories directly collectively self-defeating

source.locator: Part I ch. 4

sense.en: In each-we dilemmas, if each successfully follows an agent-relative theory, the aims it gives each are worse achieved than if none had. Common-sense morality is so self-defeating in many-person cases, and should be revised there.

reading.en: Two forms. The accounting law has the many-person case for one condition: each within what a step gives, together past it. Nearer his own is `Weighting.Restraint`, a prisoner's dilemma read as a menu: widening a shared menu lowers what each gets at the one mutual best response, while every order meeting C ranks the wider above. 07 calls that a conflict, no inconsistency, and asks whether any course has the shape.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending, activity needing support, only active giving, the gate local): 'Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more' (`Pair.own_not_joint`). Verdict in 08: near-definitional.

Witness on a listing's frame: 'widening the one menu both choose from can lower what each gets by the game's payoffs'; 'That is no inconsistency'; 'neither reading is shown to be the one that counts'. Open: if a course of what can form has this shape, 'the menu witness stands against C there'.

account_adds.en: The point of no return for a gated condition, whatever each drawer's own draw; on the menu, that where no choice bears on another's a widening cannot lower what each gets.

source_adds.en: His criterion: a theory so self-defeating is to be revised there. 07 stops short: 'neither reading is shown to be the one that counts'.

name.en: Parfit: mistakes in moral mathematics

source.locator: Part I ch. 3

sense.en: An act can be wrong though it makes no difference or none perceptible, since it may be one of a set of acts that together harm. To judge by one's own share, or to ignore small or overdetermined effects, is a mistake.

reading.en: The record names the comparison, 'from the AI's prior knowledge, not newly read'. The law gives the form: parts that make a difference only together, while no member alone does, and the overdetermined case is 'my share makes no difference'. It stops before his conclusion: neither test 'yields responsibility or duty', and no law calls the act wrong.

says.en: Theorem (any process; withholding a supplied map; the move taken held fixed): parts make the difference together while no member alone does exactly where they make it together and withholding any one leaves the same move breaking it (`Dependence.differenceOnlyTogether_iff`). In the witness Pool the first drawer's part makes no difference.

account_adds.en: The exact condition, and that but-for and participation come apart; only for the single-part, run-level test, the record says.

source_adds.en: The moral claim itself, that each act in such a set is wrong; and imperceptible harms (the harmless torturers).

name.en: Parfit: the present-aim theory and the attack from two sides

source.locator: Part II, chs. 6 to 8

sense.en: Self-interest is temporally neutral yet agent-relative, and so is unstable: it can be attacked from the present-aim side, by those who deny the first, and from the moral side, by those who deny the second. Neither neutrality is forced, and treating them apart is arbitrary.

reading.en: The present-aim evaluator stands in a record as who escapes the route from own good, and a significance bounded in time as a rival: that is where his attack from the present-aim side lands. The other side does not map: the step's two forms split by drawing and by standpoint, and a drawing varies a region, not a time. His instability argument is not stated, and the link is this reader's.

says.en: Not shown: 'a present-aim evaluator meets the other premises and gives the formed other no significance'.
Theorem (any type; World witness): a significance caring only for continuations up to a step is a rival of the condition wherever there is a standpoint and a formation.

account_adds.en: Witnesses of each rival; P-15's question on cutoffs against discounting.

source_adds.en: The argument from instability, which would bear directly on P-11's de se case.

name.en: Parfit: normative truths and convergence

source.locator: vol. 1 ch. 16 (Triple Theory); vol. 2 Part Six (non-naturalism); locators from memory

sense.en: There are irreducibly normative truths, not natural facts, and reasons are not given by desires. The best Kantian, contractualist and consequentialist theories converge, climbing one mountain from different sides, and such convergence supports that there are such truths.

reading.en: T5 has a convergence claim, and a much narrower one: a bound on where those counting everything positively can disagree. It reduces to a shared partial order, widening, and is proved only for net weightings; mixed cases stay open. No normative fact underlies it: no should stands beyond becoming, and the account seeks no authority outside it.

says.en: T5: the reduction proved for net weightings, the bound conjectured; 'That actual valuers count every item above zero is what the thesis takes, not shown'; VD1 failed, VD2 passed in part, role-play, human valuers untested.
Not shown: 'That anyone must hold the continuation condition, an order ranking by widening or the step of invariance: with significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition'.

account_adds.en: A theorem under the convergence, and frozen tests that failed in part.

source_adds.en: A realist account of what warrant would be; the account's nearest is that standards form within becoming and none stands beyond it, argued (07 §1; P-02's question).

name.en: Ontic structural realism: there are no things, or none prior to structure

source.work: J. Ladyman and D. Ross, Every Thing Must Go (2007); S. French, The Structure of the World (2014); M. Esfeld and V. Lam (2008) for the moderate form
source.locator: Ladyman and Ross chs. 1 to 3

sense.en: Physics, especially permutation invariance in quantum theory, supports that the world's structure is what exists: relata either are not self-subsistent or exist only as nodes (eliminative or moderate forms). Structure is modal and objective.

reading.en: 08 names it as a neighbour with no argument. The representation has this shape: configurations, laws and parts 'need no determination beyond relations', and labels carry nothing. Scope: shown of what is represented, argued of the theory, 'Neither shows that reality has none'. The thesis's sentence is as ontic as OSR's, yet its stated content is a demand on explanation and its warrant is not physics. Its model keeps relata told apart by equality on the carrier.

says.en: 'These show that configurations, laws and parts, as represented, need no determination beyond relations; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.' 'Its neighbours are ontic structural realism (Ladyman and Ross 2007) ...'

targets.part: how far it has been seen; its neighbours

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Labels carry nothing': a renaming preserves the five readings checked, 'while the pattern of names across steps carries identity'.
Calibration (World): 'Identity read off relations is identity up to indiscernibility'; 'names carry one decided identity more than relations do'.

account_adds.en: Three cases that look like refuters, and the laws that settle them; the nearest case against, equality on the carrier.

source_adds.en: The arguments from physics, the modal claim, and the debate between eliminative and moderate forms. 'Relations need relata' is named in 08 as live and not worked through.

name.en: Ladyman and Ross: the principle of naturalistic closure

source.work: J. Ladyman and D. Ross, Every Thing Must Go (2007)
source.locator: ch. 1

sense.en: Metaphysics is to be taken seriously only if it unifies hypotheses that current science motivates, and fundamental physics constrains the rest. A metaphysics argued from intuition or from a domestic picture of things is to be discontinued.

reading.en: By this rule the account's thesis has a problem it admits: 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength'. It is argued from representations, and classical texts are among its readings. Its explanatory reading does meet his form: it takes explanation as deriving many conclusions from few patterns, counts them, and reports a tie with a rival dropping the word. A neighbour who might accept that test and not the neighbourhood.

says.en: 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation, and the argument is that none could refute it. That is argued, not proved.'

'Proofs check relations under a representation, empirical work tests realization and correspondence, and philosophy examines constitutive identities. No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method.'

'A theory explains, on the account taken here ..., by deriving many conclusions from few patterns of argument'; 'On a first count, at the grain of §7's shared laws, there is a tie'; 'A tie does not make the reading false.'

account_adds.en: An open statement of its thesis's strength, and a separate label for each kind of claim, saying how far it has been seen.

source_adds.en: A rule for what metaphysics may be, which would put the thesis outside; the account does not answer it by name.

name.en: Dennett, Ross and Ladyman: to be is to be a real pattern

source.work: D. Dennett, 'Real Patterns' (1991); J. Ladyman and D. Ross, Every Thing Must Go (2007)
source.locator: Ladyman and Ross ch. 4, rainforest realism

sense.en: A pattern is real if it supports projection and compresses information relative to a physically possible computer, at its scale. What exists is relative to scale and is not reducible to one level; there are many real grains with no privileged one.

reading.en: A class closed under the relation adds nothing when read through: lumpability, here constancy, and grain-relative, as the account's classes are. A class named for a domain can fail by a smaller class explaining more, near to a compression test. No live page names the view; 'real' is not said of any class.

says.en: Theorem (root): for a class `E`, constancy is exactly that `R` read through the class adds nothing, `E;R;E ⊆ R;E` (`«闭合当且仅当有常»`). The record calls the law the relational analogue of lumpability, 'a correspondence not proved here'.

A class named for a domain can be defeated by 'two members alike under the class going on differently beyond measured error, another class of no more variables leaving less of the next state unaccounted for'. As a language, nothing could.

account_adds.en: A core for each class, and a named test (T2 has this form, AI reading).

source_adds.en: An existence criterion and an information measure. The account's reading does not say which classes are real; 'a class is warranted' is not shown.

name.en: Leibniz: the identity of indiscernibles

source.work: G. W. Leibniz, Discourse on Metaphysics (1686) §9; Correspondence with Clarke; M. Black, 'The Identity of Indiscernibles' (1952), for the two spheres
source.locator: as named

sense.en: No two things are exactly alike in every respect. Two things are never merely numerically different; a purely extrinsic difference would make no sense. Black's two spheres in an otherwise empty space is the standard counterexample.

reading.en: Asked as a universal, 08's calibrations give where it holds: identity read off relations is identity up to indiscernibility, and that this is decided is excluded middle over every world. Twin successors are Black's spheres in the model, and equality on the carrier separates them. 08's neighbour is the relational form: Leibniz asks a difference in intrinsic denomination, what the thesis refuses to explain by. Whether reality has such twins the account does not say.

says.en: Calibration (World): 'Identity read off relations is identity up to indiscernibility'; asked of every world, that indiscernibility is decided is exactly excluded middle; 'names carry one decided identity more than relations do'.
Theorem (any process): 'Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move (`identifiesAlike_id_iff`).'
'The thesis would be empty if "relation" meant whatever difference turns up, as the identity of indiscernibles is trivial if any property counts.'

account_adds.en: The calibration of what deciding identity costs.

source_adds.en: The principle as true of what exists, its ground in sufficient reason, and difference as finally intrinsic.

name.en: Sen: the intersection approach

source.work: A. Sen, Collective Choice and Social Welfare (1970); 'Interpersonal aggregation and partial comparability' (1970); 'On Weights and Measures' (1977)
source.locator: Collective Choice chs. 7 and 7*

sense.en: Where weights are not fully known or agreed, take the judgments every admissible weighting shares. They form a quasi-ordering, incomplete and still usable, with partial comparability as a range between no comparison and full.

reading.en: Credited at the home: on a finite listing, widening is what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero shares, the two-valued case. The weighted-ratio law states part of the graded case. C, the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (every claim counted as living), is the account's, not Sen's.

says.en: Theorem (any type; finite listing, two-valued admission). 'This is Sen's intersection approach, and Pareto dominance as the unanimity of positive weightings'; 'An order increasing in admission is monotone at its standpoint; where the condition holds de se, self-concern is such an order'.

Every positive weighting whose weights stand within n/d of each other ranks the course keeping p items above the one keeping q exactly where n q < d p. 08 lists this as Sen's graded comparisons already stated.

account_adds.en: Any class of orders from positive weightings up to every order ranking each widening higher (`Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class`).

source_adds.en: Any admissible set of weights over real-valued welfare, and partial comparability as a family of ranges between none and full. The weighted-ratio law is one such range, on kept counts.

name.en: Sen: capability as the space of evaluation

source.work: A. Sen, 'Equality of What?' (1980); Commodities and Capabilities (1985); 'Welfare, Preference and Freedom' (1991); Development as Freedom (1999)
source.locator: as named; locators from memory

sense.en: Assess a person's position neither by utility nor resources but by capability: the set of beings and doings she has real freedom to achieve, which she has reason to value. Selecting and weighing functionings is left to public reasoning, and rankings may be partial. Against counting options, the worth of a freedom is not independent of what one prefers or has reason to value.

reading.en: 'What can form' has the shape of a capability set, and 07's chooser route brings it nearer: a course widens another exactly when no chooser does worse from it and some does better, Foster's effective freedom with every preference admitted. There Sen parts: that range counts 'a merely possible chooser', and he reads freedom by what a person has reason to value. His bearer is a person; widening counts any admitted formation, and whose losses count is a separate reading of scope, the continuation condition one such.

says.en: 'One course widens another exactly when no chooser does worse from it by its own valuation and some does better by its own'; 'what is assumed instead is that a merely possible chooser counts'; 'the chooser route is Foster's effective freedom with every preference admitted'. 'This is not itself a route to C: it says what "weaker" can mean and where each route to an order meeting C rests.'
How two courses differ in what can form: closest prior 'opportunity sets (Pattanaik and Xu 1990)', near-definitional; the rankings by diversity not stated.
'The lexical order is the two-tier order read on realized claims, then reachable ranges, near Sen's achievement and freedom (1985).'; near-definitional or a witness.
Not shown: 'The value of bringing new lives into existence, well-being beyond admitted continuation, and constraints on acts.'
Reading [AI, D45]: 'Capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure'; another sense of the word.

account_adds.en: Widening over courses and steps, not one person's present set; what a course keeps reachable; what a range of choosers needs, and three witnesses where the route stops.

source_adds.en: Functionings valued by reasons, and well-being as what they are for. 07's RP alone mentions 'resources or capabilities', in passing. A process study (GAP-MAP §6.2) says the capability approach is never weighed against C.

name.en: Sen: the process aspect of freedom

source.work: A. Sen, Rationality and Freedom (2002); Development as Freedom (1999)
source.locator: Rationality and Freedom, introductory ch. and chs. 20 to 21; locators from memory

sense.en: Freedom has an opportunity aspect, what one can achieve, and a process aspect, how it comes about. Being forced to do what one would have chosen differs from choosing it, even at the same outcome; opportunity alone misses this.

reading.en: Widening reads only what is admitted, and 07 now says so: 'Nothing in a course's admitting a formation makes the formation chosen', and where admission is imposed a widening can stand below what it widens on a net weighting. Under the priority of basic conditions alternatives realizing the same claims compare alike unless the acting part is adjoined. That is his objection in the account's own terms.

says.en: 'Where admission is imposed, an item a net weighting counts below zero can put a widening below what it widens'; 'Nothing in a course's admitting a formation makes the formation chosen, so whether what a course adds is left by a chooser or imposed is not shown'.

Conditional (J1/J2): 'alternatives realizing the same claims are compared alike'; adjoined as a basic claim, the acting formation's part orders them. 'Neither which is worse nor that the acting part is basic is shown.'
Reading [AI, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: 'a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round'.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the comparison goes blind, what would adjoin it, refusal as an item in every menu, and a witness of imposed admission.

source_adds.en: Process as a value in itself; agency as distinct from well-being. J4's 'legitimate feasible choice' and the direction's 'effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise' are a premise and a proposal, not this.

name.en: Sen: adapted preferences misreport deprivation

source.work: A. Sen, Commodities and Capabilities (1985); On Ethics and Economics (1987)
source.locator: locator unverified; the hopeless beggar and tamed housewife passages

sense.en: People long deprived come to want little and take pleasure in small mercies, so a metric of desire or happiness reads their condition as fine. Their reports are formed by what they suffer and cannot serve alone as the measure of it.

reading.en: A reading formed from what the selection has done reads the share, not what lies beyond it; a loss so unread leaves the loop as it was. 07's chooser witness has the split he needs, a chooser gaining by its own order while what it takes stands lower in the order reading the result (07 credits Strotz; the Sen reading is mine). That readers are minds is a reading, and no law evaluates.

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: 'Later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.'

Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond (`Unread`), courses alike in share and rule stay alike; 'a change of the reading of any size is absorbed' where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share. Not shown: that any actual rule is so formed.
Premise D, a hypothesis where used: 'every position with access to a response securing new living content has a contributory reason for it, whatever its endorsement'.

'Where the chooser's order is not the order reading the result, the chooser can gain and what it takes stand lower in that order' (`Weighting.AnotherReads`), which 07 says 'has the shape of Strotz's inconsistency'.

account_adds.en: The exact premise under which the reading moves nothing.

source_adds.en: What to read instead: capability. The account's answer is a reading of what lies beyond the share, by whoever reads it.

name.en: Sen: choice does not reveal welfare; commitment

source.work: A. Sen, 'Behaviour and the Concept of Preference' (1973); 'Rational Fools' (1977)
source.locator: as named

sense.en: Consistency of choice yields a binary relation and no measure of welfare. Commitment, acting against one's own expected welfare, drives a wedge between choice and welfare; a person reduced to a preference ordering is a rational fool.

reading.en: The law on choices stops where Sen does: what acts show is a shown relation and its reach, and nothing whose good it is. 07's chooser witness has the wedge in form: a chooser can gain by its own order while what it takes stands lower in the order reading the result. It says nothing of why the orders part, so the account has no commitment as a kind. 08's 'Sen (1977)' is not clearly this paper.

says.en: Theorem (root; no premise; near-definitional): the choices show `x` above `y` where `x` was chosen while `y` was open; the positive comparisons every such order shares are exactly the shown reach.
AI reading: 'Motivation is apart: that a loss counts from one's standpoint moves no one by itself.'
'Where the chooser's order is not the order reading the result, the chooser can gain and what it takes stand lower in that order' (`Weighting.AnotherReads`).

account_adds.en: Revealed preference on the root, with what no choice data separates. These structural results can inform the way of seeing T8 offers, without a ranking.

source_adds.en: Commitment as a distinct ground of action, and the several concepts 'preference' confounds.

name.en: Sen: maximal choice, comparative justice

source.work: A. Sen, 'Maximization and the Act of Choice' (1997); The Idea of Justice (2009)
source.locator: Idea of Justice, Introduction and ch. 4

sense.en: Reasoned choice does not need a complete ranking: pick an option not worse than any other. Justice needs comparison of feasible alternatives and no account of the perfect arrangement. Incompleteness may be assertive, and is not a defect.

reading.en: C has the first half: it decides no mixed comparison. The maximal route is stated: with the comparison weakly decided on the menu an undefeated option exists, and L leaves a response with one good and one bad outcome incomparable both ways. No live line joins these to Sen; that join is this reader's. They are laws of choice, not ethics: the maximal-choice law uses its stated decision premise, and §5 separately studies practical judgments under its named premises.

says.en: 'On a reading of `living`, an order meeting C ranks a course above each course it extends there ... and C asks nothing of any other pair'; 'The judgment of this section takes more, following from neither the condition nor C'.

Calibration: 'That every nonempty listed set of options at a frame's step, under an irreflexive transitive comparison, has an undefeated option is exactly weak excluded middle'; 'with the comparison weakly decided on the menu the option exists (`Requirement.frontier_exists`)'. L: 'a response with one good and one bad outcome is incomparable both ways.'

targets.part: the Calibration and Lifting and choice just below this anchor; the calibration has no record of its own

says.en: Premises as named at P-21: J1–J4: 'complete comparison with retained losses, priority of basic conditions, bounded responsibility, legitimate feasible choice', each a hypothesis where used. Whether J1's 'complete comparison' (08's card: 'retained losses') asks a complete order, the gloss does not settle.

account_adds.en: A calibration: that every nonempty listed menu has an undefeated option is exactly weak excluded middle.

source_adds.en: Comparative justice against an account of the perfect arrangement, and assertive incompleteness: a judgment that two are not comparable, not a gap in information.

name.en: Sen: the impossibility of a Paretian liberal

source.work: A. Sen, 'The Impossibility of a Paretian Liberal' (1970)
source.locator: article as a whole

sense.en: Unrestricted domain, weak Pareto and a minimal liberty for each person over a personal sphere cannot all hold in a social choice with no cycle. Unanimity can conflict with even minimal rights.

reading.en: The account's unanimity is on admission, not preferences, so the theorem does not transfer directly. Nearest is 07 §4.4's standpoints route, a Pareto relation among self-concerned orders: 'an order ranking below every widening that adds nothing to its own', read there as positional concern, stops the relation, the shape of a meddling preference: a proposal here, no stated form. No personal sphere is stated, nor whether one can conflict with widening.

source_adds.en: A proved limit on unanimity plus liberty. A study names it (foundation-assessment/GOVERNANCE-LITERATURE.md), and ig-integration-gaps/GAP-MAP.md §6.1 flags it, with Arrow, as unstated. P-04's question on rights and constraints is where it would go.

read: 07 what the chapter does not show

name.en: Sen: positional objectivity

source.work: A. Sen, 'Positional Objectivity', Philosophy & Public Affairs 22 (1993)
source.locator: article as a whole

sense.en: What one observes depends on one's position, yet observation from a position is interpersonally checkable by anyone who takes it. Objectivity need not be a view from nowhere; a positional view can still be mistaken as a trans-positional claim.

reading.en: Only the first half agrees: no view from nowhere, knowers inside the unfolding, de se apart from de dicto. His test is invariance at one position: same position, same observation, whoever takes it. 03's objectivity runs across differences of access, and counts checks 'only where they are differently vulnerable'; two at one position share a vulnerability, which is why his positional illusion survives the check. So his check is one the account would not count alone. An assessment, no law.

says.en: Assessment, continuity and objectivity: 'Objectivity is answerability to the relations a judgment concerns across differences of access, not consensus; shared inquiry adds checks only where they are differently vulnerable'.
'Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside it too, so their adequacy is part of the inquiry, not a vantage outside it.'

Theorem (any type): where each witness added copies one on the roster, inspection gives the same certificate; 'That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown.'

account_adds.en: The law of copied witnesses, on copies only; that checks count only where differently vulnerable is 03's assessment, not a law.

source_adds.en: Objectivity at one position as a kind of its own, positional illusion as a named error, and the transposition test.

name.en: Tragedy of the commons as a trap of missing feedback

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems: A Primer (2008)
source.locator: chapter 5, System Traps: Tragedy of the Commons

sense.en: A shared resource erodes because the feedback from its condition to its users is missing or too delayed, while each user's gain from use is direct. The ways out as she lists them: educate and exhort, privatize so each bears its own consequences, or regulate by mutual coercion.

reading.en: Two forms. Joint excess has the erosion, in near-definitional arithmetic. The missing feedback is the coupling law: a condition none of the drawers couples into falls by their joint capacity. Restoring it is scoped: among drawers in turn a coupling per step met keeps a need only where it exceeds the need; drawing at once with no pivotal drawer the drain stays perfect at any coupling; where the rest outruns the renewal no weight selects restraint. Privatizing has exclusive footprints: a partition, not bearing consequences.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; the ending also activity needing support, only active giving, the gate local). Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; n consecutive such steps from below n + m end every dependent at need m or more. Near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less. Its record: it treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal.

Theorem (a; World). At a mutual best response, each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands at what the formations outside them leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing. Existence not shown in general; the classical commons with a share borne lies outside. Reading [AI]: what keeps it is a coupling into it or a lowered capacity.

Theorem (any law G; the gate for keeping). Each drawer counting c for each step what all leave meets a need m: in turn, two drawers or more, where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon; under the gate, where m < c each leaves exactly the need. Drawing at once, no portion reaching the need and none returning more than one for one, draining is perfect at every coupling. No evaluation enters.

Theorem (World). Where the rest alone take jointly more than a step gives across n steps from below n + m, dependents end whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike.

Theorem (World: balance). With takes divided by exclusive footprints at every step the level never falls below its start. It does not show that an actual division is by exclusive footprints, or that the level rises.

T3's evidence, its clause on trained systems conjectured: in a gated commons the learner rewarded for its own catch took the last apple in 118 of 118 decisions, the coupled learner in 0 of 2,360, while the prediction that it keeps the stock to the end failed, 59% against 90%. LLM fishers kept no dependent they were not told of, under any instruction tried (0 of 10 per cell).

account_adds.en: An exact end under the gate; an exact threshold for a coupling, the need and not the renewal forgone; that a restored coupling still fails where the rest outruns the renewal or none is pivotal; that no law calls the drain a harm.

source_adds.en: Feedback only weak or late: the laws take the corner none couples into, the share-bearing commons being outside (08: "here only the corner"). Education and exhortation, against which T3 forbids an instruction keeping a dependent it does not couple in. Mutual coercion, since 05 §12 models no sanctions. Her practical judgement, which the laws do not make.

name.en: Success to the successful

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Meadows chapter 5, Success to the Successful; Senge appendix 2

sense.en: Winners are rewarded with the means to win again, a reinforcing loop that ends in exclusion of the losers. Exits as Meadows lists them: diversify so losers can compete elsewhere, limit the winners' share (antitrust), level the field periodically, reward what does not bias the next round.

reading.en: Several laws have the lock's form: a rule read from the share it selects, a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices. What comes back to the shapers alone is the resource loop's nearest form, and a part coming to every member alike leaves the direction at a step, near her unbiased reward. Full taking excludes; drawn one at a time a kind fixes or is lost. A rule read against the share is levelling's form. That rules read the share is a premise.

says.en: Theorem (any type). With selection not lowering a target's share under a favouring rule, the rule read monotonically from the share, and start and readings favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. A perturbation reversing the direction, held past a threshold, is not absorbed (witness).
Theorem (counts, two policies, a standing score). A threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves. Read in 02 as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989) [AI reading].

Theorem (any type). Where the rule is read against the share, selection under favouring rules does not lower it, and the rules favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's.

Theorem (counts). Drawn one member at a time among M + 1, the rule read at each step at the current count: histories still varied vanish geometrically, the share fixing the shapers tends to the potential at the start over that at the top, and noise leaves either lock.

Theorem (counts). Shaping gives s to the shapers alone and p to every member alike and costs each shaper c. At a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p; a larger p pulls the rule toward even; across a stretch the shared part can turn the verdict. That offspring carry the capacity and that what comes back is read from the share are premises.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need). Full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from below n + m ends every formation depending at need m or more, the full taker included. Where one takes all that is given at every step, no named other is present and taking at every one of the level + 1 steps from T.
Reading [AI, D48]. Term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: Exactly what leaves a lock (a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection); that a count lock holds also where a standing score favours the other policy; that drift leaves some locks; that position does not protect: the greatest part ends with the rest where it so depends.

source_adds.en: The source's own loop, in which means rather than a rule raise the next win: what comes back is a supplied constant, and that taking more yields more offspring is not derived (target-capture's record). Also the losers' exclusion as where the loop ends; diversification; a limit on the winners' share as a law, since 05 only reads antitrust, as pooling. The live sentence names Arthur's increasing returns, not this trap.

name.en: Seeking the wrong goal

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008)
source.locator: chapter 5, Seeking the Wrong Goal

sense.en: A system obediently produces what its goal or indicator specifies, whatever was intended; effort is confused with result, as with GNP counted for welfare. The way out: indicators and goals that reflect the system's real welfare.

reading.en: A selection reaches only what couples into its selector, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does, where it ranks outcomes by an order rising with what couples in: the trap's form, between indicator and what it omits. T7 says why it stays: a measure read from what it selects is kept however large a loss it does not read. 03 reads locked seeking as feedback adjusting only the means. No law says "wrong": that needs something comparing, which the account names rather than assumes.

says.en: Theorem. Every order rising with what couples in has its optima least beyond exactly where no eligible outcome above another beyond is unbeaten on it; room is a hypothesis. No evaluation: not that the fall beyond is a harm. Read as the proxy problem (Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell 2020) [AI reading]; 03 states only its blindness to what a proxy does not register.

Thesis T3. Optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings, where that gives room. The law for optima is proved; the clause on actual trained systems is conjectured, with partial support and its locus unresolved.

targets.part: the thesis and how far it has been seen

says.en: Thesis T7. A measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation: kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and, drift aside, dropped only through a change in what the loop reads. In the model only invariance and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, without noise; a reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.

targets.part: the thesis and how far it has been seen

says.en: Reading [AI, D65], following this law. Locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment.

Theorem (b; any R). Added c for each step the need stays met: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps it at every horizon; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling. One optimizer's law, supplied; not that the need ought to be kept or a coupling set.

account_adds.en: Where the trap does not bite: no room, no drain; a plateau decides otherwise; exact conditions at optima; why the measure outlives its refutation, in the model. Which order a goal must rise in is left open.

source_adds.en: That a goal can be right or wrong against a system's real welfare, a comparison the laws do not state. Also the confusion of effort with result, which no law addresses. A better indicator as the exit has only one optimizer's coupling law.

name.en: Rule beating

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008)
source.locator: chapter 5, Rule Beating

sense.en: Those under a rule act so as to meet its letter and defeat its intent, as with departments spending a budget by year's end so it is not cut. She reads the response as useful feedback, and the way out as redesigning rules to release that creativity toward the purpose.

reading.en: A rule is a selection through what couples into it, so acts it couples alike are selected alike: that gap is the room, and 03 reads it as the proxy problem (Goodhart), stating only its blindness to what a proxy does not register. With room, optima of what the letter reads drain what it omits. Her budget spent by year's end has a row: what is valued only at the horizon is held, then regrown at the last step. Agreement holds of the room only: no law gives evasion's learning, and PLAN §6.3 names no target.

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. The main law holds by construction; its force lies in supplied premises. It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975 and others) as the account states it: what is stated is its blindness to what the proxy does not register, not Manheim and Garrabrant's regressional and causal kinds.
